title: Universal Short-Time Fourier Transform: Data-Adaptive Window-Length Selection for Time-Frequency Analysis
summary: The short-time Fourier transform (STFT) characterizes the local frequency content of time-varying signals by evaluating the discrete Fourier transform over a sliding analysis window. The STFT is governed by a fundamental resolution trade-off: a short window localizes rapid transients in time at the cost of frequency resolution, whereas a long window resolves closely spaced harmonics at the expense of temporal resolution. The Universal Short-Time Fourier Transform (U-STFT) resolves this trade-off sequentially by modeling the analysis window duration as a data-adaptive state variable that indexes the number of hops included in the current observation interval. At each frame, a bank of candidate window durations is scored using normalized order-three Rényi entropy to quantify joint time-frequency concentration. A window length trellis aggregates the resulting $\mathcal{O}(3^M)$ candidate window schedules with linear complexity per frame, guaranteeing a cumulative mix-loss regret bound of $\mathcal{O}((k+1)\log M)$ relative to any hindsight window schedule with $k$ resolution changes over $M$ frames. By linearity of the Fourier transform, posterior expectation across the candidate bank yields a single spectrum equivalent to an STFT evaluated with a data-adaptive effective window, while an envelope-normalized synthesis stream guarantees exact overlap-add reconstruction. Evaluations on synthetic and marine bioacoustic signals demonstrate adaptive resolution tracking, enhanced spectral concentration, and exact time-domain invertibility.

AI.tldr: 提出通用短时傅里叶变换（U-STFT），将分析窗长建模为数据自适应的状态变量，用三阶Rényi熵对候选窗长打分，并结合线性复杂度的窗长trellis聚合，得到单一等效STFT谱与可精确重构的合成流。
AI.motivation: STFT受制于时频分辨率折衷：短窗利于瞬态时间定位但频率分辨率差，长窗分辨密集谐波但时间分辨率差。现有固定窗方案无法随信号局部特性自适应调整。
AI.method: 按帧序贯处理：将窗长设为数据自适应状态变量，以其索引当前观测区间内的跳数hop数；每帧对候选窗长库用归一化三阶Rényi熵评分以量化时频联合集中度；用窗长trellis以每帧线性复杂度聚合O(3^M)条候选调度，保证相对任意k次分辨率变化的事后调度的累积mix-loss后悔界O((k+1)log M)；利用傅里叶变换线性性，对候选库取后验期望得到等效于数据自适应有效窗的单一STFT谱；并用包络归一化合成流保证精确重叠相加重构。
AI.result: 在合成信号与海洋生物声学信号上，实现自适应分辨率跟踪、谱集中度提升以及精确时域可逆性。
AI.conclusion: U-STFT以序贯自适应窗长选择缓解了STFT的分辨率折衷，兼具单一谱输出、理论后悔界保证与精确可逆性，适用于非平稳信号分析。

title: Doppler-Shannon Association in Vehicular Networks: A Stochastic Geometry Analysis
summary: Historically, in cellular networks, the user equipment (UE) association with a base station (BS) has been largely confined to nearest BS association strategies. Unlike cellular networks wherein the BSs are static, vehicular networks are prone to high mobility, resulting in the UE experiencing a Doppler shift. The Doppler shift further results in the fading channel exhibiting high temporal variability. In this work, we present a novel stochastic geometry framework, modeling the effects of the Doppler shift on the physical layer network performance through the coherence time. First, the statistics of the Doppler shift are studied in a two- and three-dimensional Poisson point process (PPP) setting. The distribution and the geometric factors influencing the Doppler shift are analyzed. Next, we propose Doppler shift aware utilities, modeling the Doppler shift induced Shannon rate achievable in time-selective fading links. Through these utilities, we analytically study the outage and coverage probabilities for a UE to achieve a given quality of service. These probabilities are computed based on the optimal BS association in vehicular networks, which goes beyond the closest Euclidean distance. In the UE-BS line of sight, the novel BS association policies factor the BS direction of motion and the fading gain, in addition to the Euclidean distance. We show that the nearest BS is no longer the optimal BS association, resulting in non-convex coverage tessellations associated with the BSs. Our analytical and simulation results illustrate the need for a Doppler shift correction, complementing the ideal SNR based Shannon performance. The network performance achieved through the proposed Doppler-Shannon based association is proved, analytically as well as through simulations, to be superior to the classical Shannon based association.

AI.tldr: 将多普勒频移通过相干时间纳入随机几何框架，提出多普勒感知的基站关联策略，证明其性能优于传统最近距离/理想香农关联。
AI.motivation: 车联网中基站高移动性导致多普勒频移与时变衰落，传统最近距离关联在时选性衰落链路下不再最优，需重新建模与关联策略。
AI.method: 在2D/3D泊松点过程下分析多普勒频移的统计特性与几何影响因素；提出多普勒感知的效用函数刻画时选性衰落链路的可实现香农速率；基于此解析推导中断概率与覆盖概率，并提出同时考虑基站运动方向、衰落增益与欧氏距离的新型关联策略。
AI.result: 最近基站不再是最优关联，产生非凸的覆盖镶嵌结构；解析与仿真均表明需进行多普勒频移校正以补充理想SNR香农性能；所提多普勒-香农关联性能优于经典香农关联。
AI.conclusion: 多普勒频移感知的关联策略可提升车联网覆盖与中断性能，为高移动场景下的物理层网络设计提供理论依据。

title: Neuroscience of Improvisation Across Music and Other Domains: A Survey and Outlook
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables, submitted to IEEE for possible publication
summary: Improvisation (or Improv), the real-time generation of novel, context-appropriate action, occurs in music, dance, theater, sport, education, therapy, and professional practice. Its neuroscience, however, has been studied almost exclusively for music, where most quantitative neuroimaging evidence lies. A PRISMA-style search done by authors quantifies this imbalance: of 111 identified studies, 70.3\% concern musical improvisation or general psychometric creativity. This explains why earlier surveys are either music-centered or confined to a single construct. This survey addresses that gap in two ways. First, for music, it organizes findings from functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), electroencephalography (EEG), functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS), hyperscanning, neurofeedback, and brain stimulation, and reports transparently where the evidence agrees (e.g., experience-dependent changes in frontal engagement, increased frontal alpha and theta power) and where it is heterogeneous (e.g., the direction of lateral prefrontal activity, hemispheric lateralization, the interpretation of alpha power). Second, it extends the review to dance, theater, sport, education, therapy, and professional practice, where behavioral, qualitative, and simulation-based studies predominate. Overall, the current evidence does not point to a universal neural signature of improvisation within music domain or other domains. We conclude with an outlook on wearable EEG--fNIRS sensing and closed-loop brain--computer interfaces for musical improvisation, the domain with sufficient evidence, formulated as an expertise-gated control problem and discussed as a possible complement to deliberate practice, and we list the evidence needed for other domains.

title: A Subsample Time-Delay Estimator with a Farrow Structure
summary: A novel solution to the classical problem of subsample time-delay estimation (TDE) for a wideband signal received by two adjacent sensors is described. A mean squared-error (MSE) measure of dissimilarity is defined and evaluated using a variable fractional-delay (VFD) filter bank with a finite impulse response (FIR). Using a filter bank with a Farrow structure allows the MSE power to be expressed as a polynomial function of the filter delay with a local minimum at the unknown signal delay. In Monte-Carlo simulations, the proposed estimator outperforms the generalized cross-correlation (GCC) technique when the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is not low (less than 10 dB).

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于可变分数延迟(FVD)滤波器组的宽带信号亚采样时延估计方法，将MSE表示为滤波器延迟的多项式并以局部极小值定位时延。
AI.motivation: 经典亚采样时延估计(TDE)在宽带、两相邻传感器场景下，传统广义互相关(GCC)方法在中高信噪比下精度受限，需更精确的估计方案。
AI.method: 定义基于均方误差(MSE)的相异性度量，用有限冲激响应(FIR)的可变分数延迟滤波器组评估；采用Farrow结构使MSE功率成为关于滤波器延迟的多项式函数，其在未知信号时延处存在局部极小，据此求解时延。
AI.result: 蒙特卡洛仿真显示，在信噪比不低于约10 dB时，所提估计器性能优于GCC方法。
AI.conclusion: Farrow结构FVD滤波器组可将时延估计转化为多项式极小值搜索，在中高SNR条件下较GCC具优势；低SNR下优势不明显。

title: Search-Guided Reasoning Trace Curation for Verilog Generation
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have improved Verilog generation. However, most training pipelines distill natural-language reasoning traces whose intermediate design decisions are weakly structured and are primarily selected according to the correctness of the final generated RTL. We present MCTS-SFT, a verifier-guided framework for curating reasoning traces for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of Verilog generation models. MCTS-SFT formulates trace construction as search over intermediate reasoning states and uses Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to propagate functional feedback from complete Verilog rollouts to earlier design decisions. Within this framework, we introduce Plan-MCTS, which searches over compact hardware-design plans that explicitly represent interfaces, timing, state, behavior, and update rules. We further study plan-preserving supervision, in which the searched structured state is retained as part of the downstream SFT target. Our experiments find that Plan-MCTS achieves the highest functional trace yield, with 84.2% correct traces compared with 81.9% for one-shot structured planning and 82.0% for unguided tree exploration. For identical Plan-MCTS trajectories and Verilog outputs, retaining the explicit searched plan during SFT raises pass@10 from 52.56% to 57.7%, demonstrating that the representation of intermediate design decisions materially affects downstream learning. In a separate 6,000-trace study, MCTS-curated supervision improves pass@10 over full-response chain-of-thought distillation by up to 3.7 points while reducing downstream generation length by approximately 50% on VerilogEval-v2. These results demonstrate that structured hardware planning, verifier-guided search, and explicit intermediate-state supervision provide complementary mechanisms for constructing more effective and token-efficient training data for Verilog generation.

AI.tldr: MCTS-SFT：用蒙特卡洛树搜索在"硬件设计计划"状态空间上搜索，把完整Verilog rollout的功能反馈回传给早期设计决策，以筛选高质量推理轨迹用于SFT；保留搜索到的显式计划作为监督目标可进一步提升Verilog生成效果。
AI.motivation: 现有Verilog生成模型的训练流程多沿用自然语言推理链蒸馏，其中间设计决策结构松散，且仅依据最终RTL正确性来筛选轨迹，导致中间推理质量与训练数据效度不足。
AI.method: 提出verifier-guided的轨迹筛选框架MCTS-SFT，将轨迹构建建模为中间推理状态的搜索问题，用MCTS把最终Verilog rollout的功能反馈传播到早期决策；其中Plan-MCTS在紧凑的硬件设计计划空间（接口、时序、状态、行为、更新规则）上搜索；并研究plan-preserving supervision，即把搜索到的结构化计划保留为下游SFT目标的一部分；实验对比one-shot结构化规划与无引导树搜索，并另设6,000条轨迹研究对比full-response chain-of-thought蒸馏。
AI.result: Plan-MCTS功能轨迹产出率最高（84.2%正确），高于one-shot结构化规划（81.9%）与无引导树搜索（82.0%）；相同Plan-MCTS轨迹与Verilog输出下，SFT保留显式计划使pass@10由52.56%提升至57.7%；6,000条轨迹研究中，MCTS筛选监督较full-response CoT蒸馏在VerilogEval-v2上pass@10最高提升3.7个点，同时下游生成长度约减少50%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化硬件规划、验证器引导搜索与显式中间状态监督三者互补，可构建更有效且token更高效的Verilog生成训练数据；中间设计决策的表示方式对下游学习有实质性影响。

title: A photonic-integrated optomechanical mid-infrared detector
summary: Tracking the resonance frequency of a mechanical oscillator is the basis of atomic force microscopy, mass sensing and thermometry. Nanomechanical thermal detectors exploit this principle to sense absorbed radiation, most effectively with tensile-stressed resonators, whose tension converts thermal expansion into a large frequency shift and dilutes dissipation. Approaching their fundamental sensitivity limit, however, has required free-space or fibre-coupled interferometers, hindering compact deployment and scaling to arrays. Here we remove this bottleneck by monolithically integrating a high-Q nanomechanical resonator with a silicon nitride photonic integrated circuit. A tensile-stressed silicon nitride trampoline with an impedance-matched platinum absorber is dispersively coupled to a photonic integrated microresonator beneath it. At room temperature and with microwatt-level optical power, the detector reaches a noise-equivalent power of 3.4 pW/$\sqrt{\rm Hz}$ for broadband thermal radiation (3-12 $μ$m), referred to incident power. Referred to absorbed power, this is within a factor of 1.5 of its fundamental thermal fluctuation limit. Using our detector in a state-of-the-art commercial Fourier-transform infrared spectrometer, we resolve the vibrational fingerprint of a polymer film across 2-20 $μ$m and reach the precision of the built-in pyroelectric detector with about an order of magnitude lower incident power. This architecture opens a route to multiplexed optomechanical focal-plane arrays.

AI.tldr: 该工作将高Q氮化硅纳米机械谐振器与氮化硅光子系统单片集成，用光微腔色散耦合读出，实现室温、微瓦光功率下3.4 pW/√Hz噪声等效功率（3–12 μm宽带热辐射），接近热涨落极限，并可用于FTIR光谱测量。
AI.motivation: 追踪机械振子共振频率是原子力显微镜、质量传感与温度测量的基础，纳米机械热探测器据此敏感吸收辐射；拉伸应力谐振器能将热膨胀转化为大频移并稀释耗散，但达到基本灵敏度极限此前依赖自由空间或光纤耦合干涉仪，妨碍了紧凑部署与阵列化扩展。
AI.method: 单片集成：高Q氮化硅"蹦床"式拉伸应力谐振器，配阻抗匹配的铂吸收层；其下方色散耦合一个光子集成微环谐振器，以光读出机械频率；在室温、微瓦级光功率下表征宽带（3–12 μm）热辐射响应，并置于商用FTIR中测聚合物薄膜振动指纹。
AI.result: 入射功率参考下噪声等效功率3.4 pW/√Hz（3–12 μm）；折算到吸收功率时距基本热涨落极限仅1.5倍以内；在FTIR中跨2–20 μm解析聚合物薄膜振动指纹，以约低一个数量级的入射功率达到内置热释电探测器的精度。
AI.conclusion: 去除干涉仪瓶颈、实现集成光电机械热探测，性能逼近基本极限，为多路复用光机械焦平面阵列提供路径。

title: The FlightFinder Occurrence Corpus: harmonising 128 aviation-safety source codes into one deduplicated cross-national accident dataset
comment: 34 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Dataset deposited at Zenodo: version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22303316 (the exact snapshot every reported number is computed from); concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22228451
summary: National aviation-investigation databases are deep but territorial; global compilations such as the Aviation Safety Network and the Bureau of Aircraft Accidents Archives are hand-curated, apply their own inclusion thresholds, and publish no per-record lineage. The FlightFinder Occurrence Corpus harmonizes 279,485 occurrences and 131,882 attached narratives from 128 source codes -- national accident-investigation authorities, occurrence-reporting systems and four global compilations. Records are mapped into one schema; each normalized record reduces to exactly one key from an ordered ladder -- event signature, registration and date, rounded position and date, or source and native identifier -- so a missing field never creates a link, and the key is the occurrence identifier. Records the ladder cannot reach are scored in a blocked pass into an explicit merge table and applied only within an automatically approved score band or after a person confirms them. Field conflicts follow a documented source ranking; one provenance row per contributing source -- its native identifier and URL -- is retained, with attribution and licence terms per source code. Linkage error is measured on five adjudicated samples totalling 200 pairs. A recorded uniform random draw of 60 from the 3,441 merges the automatic band applies as it ships found no error; the exact two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on its false-merge rate is 6.0%, or 205 pairs. The measured error covers the scored band only; the ladder's deterministic joins are not adjudicated. The corpus has no exposure denominators and inherits the under-reporting of its sources. It is offered as a base for cross-national safety statistics, source-disagreement studies and narrative text mining; a frozen, DOI-referenced snapshot accompanies the live API.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布 FlightFinder Occurrence Corpus：一个将 128 个来源（各国事故调查机构、事件报告系统与四个全球汇编）的 279,485 起事件与 131,882 条叙述文本统一到单一 schema 的语料库，并以有序键阶梯与约束性合并表实现可溯源、可度量错误率的记录链接。
AI.motivation: 现有国家航空调查数据库覆盖面深但受地域限制；Aviation Safety Network、Bureau of Aircraft Accidents Archives 等全球汇编依赖人工整理、各自设定收录门槛，且不公开逐条记录的来源谱系，难以支撑跨国安全统计与来源分歧研究。
AI.method: 将 128 个来源代码的记录映射至统一 schema。规范化记录经由有序键阶梯归并为唯一键（事件签名 / 注册号与日期 / 取整位置与日期 / 来源与原始标识符），缺失字段不产生链接，该键即事件标识符；阶梯无法覆盖的记录在分块（blocked）匹配中打分，写入显式合并表，仅自动批准分数带内或经人工确认后生效。字段冲突按文档化来源排序解决，每个贡献来源保留一行溯源记录（原始标识符与 URL）及归属与许可条款。链接误差在 5 个裁决样本（共 200 对）上度量，并对自动带内 3,441 条合并中随机抽取的 60 条做记录式检验。
AI.result: 在出厂版本自动分数带应用的 3,441 条合并中，均匀随机抽样的 60 条未发现错误；其错误合并率的精确双侧 95% Clopper-Pearson 上界为 6.0%（即 205 对）。另有 5 个裁决样本共 200 对用于误差度量。
AI.conclusion: 误差度量仅覆盖评分带，阶梯的确定性连接未经裁决。语料库不含暴露分母、继承来源的低报偏差，定位为跨国安全统计、来源分歧研究与叙述文本挖掘的基础数据集；随附冻结的、带 DOI 引用的快照。

title: Moment-Guided Optimizers for Noisy Deep Learning: MGO-SC as a Simple Consistency Gate for Adam-Style Updates
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE Global Emerging Technologies Conference (iGET), Irvine, CA, USA, Oct. 21-25, 2026
summary: Adaptive optimizers are widely used in deep learning, yet their behavior can degrade under heavy stochasticity and label noise where the sign and magnitude of gradients can be unstable. We study MGO-SC (Moment-Guided Optimizer with Sign-Consistency), a lightweight modification of Adam-style methods that derives a coordinate-wise consistency gate from the magnitude of a sign exponential moving average (EMA): coordinates whose gradient sign is stable are trusted, while coordinates whose sign fluctuates are down-weighted. We show that the naive form of this gate, which can only shrink updates, loses effective step size and underperforms when the learning rate is matched to the baseline. We therefore introduce a mean-preserving variant that reallocates trust across coordinates without changing the net per-tensor step magnitude. On CIFAR-10 with ResNet-18, under a matched learning rate and decoupled weight decay, mean-preserving MGO-SC consistently improves over its AdamW baseline across clean, symmetric, and asymmetric label noise (e.g., +1.4 points at 40% symmetric noise; paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero; Wilcoxon p<0.01), while adding no second-order information or per-sample filtering. We report matched-seed effect sizes, nonparametric bootstrap confidence intervals, and paired significance tests, and we release code and raw logs.

AI.tldr: 提出MGO-SC：利用梯度符号EMA幅值构造逐坐标一致性门控，并给出"保均值"变体，在CIFAR-10/ResNet-18标签噪声下稳定优于AdamW。
AI.motivation: Adam类自适应优化器在高随机性、标签噪声下梯度符号与幅值不稳定，行为会退化；作者希望在不大幅增加开销的前提下提升其鲁棒性。
AI.method: 从符号指数滑动平均的幅值导出逐坐标一致性门控：符号稳定坐标予以信任，符号波动坐标降权。发现朴素门控只能收缩更新、损失有效步长而落后于基线，故提出保均值（mean-preserving）变体，在坐标间重新分配信任而不改变张量级净步长；不引入二阶信息或逐样本过滤，与解耦权重衰减、匹配学习率联用。
AI.result: CIFAR-10+ResNet-18，在匹配学习率与解耦权重衰减下，保均值MGO-SC在干净、对称与非对称标签噪声下均一致优于AdamW（如40%对称噪声+1.4个百分点）；配对bootstrap 95%置信区间不含零，Wilcoxon p<0.01。
AI.conclusion: 一致性门控需保均值才有增益；MGO-SC是轻量、无需额外二阶信息的即插即用改进，实验采用匹配种子效应量、非参数置信区间与配对显著性检验，并公开代码与原始日志。

title: Sparse tensor networks for individual tree diameter estimation in mixed forests
summary: Measurements of tree diameter at breast height (DBH) are fundamental to forest inventories, but manual surveys across entire stands or regions are impractical. UAV-borne laser scanning (ULS) enables scalable automated forest surveys, yet canopy occlusion makes accurate DBH estimation from ULS point clouds non-trivial. Limited stem-level point density of ULS data constrains approaches relying on detailed stem reconstruction, such as Quantitative Structure Models (QSMs) and circle fitting. Empirical machine learning methods based on predefined point cloud metrics are an alternative. New deep learning approaches offer an even more principled solution, allowing models to learn directly from point clouds. Sparse tensor networks have shown particular promise, transforming forestry tasks such as tree species classification. We investigate whether these strengths can be extended to estimate individual tree DBH from ULS data across four mixed-species temperate forest plots in Germany. We further advance existing sparse tensor networks by introducing TreeNext, a lightweight deep learning architecture for direct individual tree parameter estimation from voxelized LiDAR point clouds. We present a fully automated forest inventory pipeline from individual tree instance segmentation to DBH regression, and quantify the impact of segmentation errors by comparing performance on automatically segmented and ground truth instances. TreeNext achieves an $R^2$ of 0.8355 on automatically segmented trees and 0.9380 on ground truth segments, outperforming strong tabular baselines including Random Forest and XGBoost. Segmentation quality emerges as the dominant error source in the automated pipeline. TreeNext proves highly data-efficient, performing well even in small data scenarios. Our findings establish sparse tensor networks as a practical foundation for automated individual tree DBH estimation from ULS.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量稀疏张量网络TreeNext，从无人机激光扫描点云直接回归单木胸径，实现全自动森林清查流程。
AI.motivation: 人工测量胸径（DBH）难以覆盖整个林分或区域；ULS可规模化获取点云，但冠层遮挡导致树干点密度不足，使QSMs与圆拟合等依赖树干重建的方法受限，需要更直接、更数据高效的学习式方案。
AI.method: 在德国四块混交温带森林样地采集ULS数据；将点云体素化输入所提出的轻量稀疏张量网络TreeNext，直接回归单木DBH；构建从单木实例分割到DBH回归的全自动流水线，并分别在自动分割实例与真值实例上评估，以量化分割误差影响；与Random Forest、XGBoost等表格基线对比。
AI.result: TreeNext在自动分割树上R²=0.8355，在真值分割上R²=0.9380，优于强表格基线；分割质量成为自动化流水线中的主导误差来源；模型数据效率高，小样本场景下仍表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏张量网络可作为ULS单木DBH自动估计的实用基础，验证了其从树种分类向回归类森林参数估计的可扩展性。

title: Forward-Backward Map Matching for Airborne Magnetic Anomaly Navigation
comment: 37 pages, 11 figures, submitted for publication: The Journal of Navigation (CUP)
summary: Airborne magnetic anomaly navigation provides a passive, unjammable alternative to Global Navigation Satellite Systems positioning by matching magnetometer measurements against a lithospheric magnetic anomaly map. Existing map-matching algorithms either assume a Gaussian posterior (extended Kalman filter), require Monte Carlo sampling (particle filter), or discard posterior uncertainty in favour of a single optimal path (Viterbi algorithm). Here we formulate map matching as inference on a chain-structured factor graph and solve it segment by segment using the forward-backward algorithm, which yields a discrete posterior over candidate positions and its Shannon entropy $H_t$ at time $t$. Over the \texttt{Renfrew\_395} map, $10^3$ synthetic trials yield a median position error of $32.7$ m, $91\%$ below the median inertial drift of $362$ m. On these trials and $10^3$ flight paths, the median error is $43\%$ below the extended Kalman filter and particle filter. Across these paths, a threshold on segment-level entropy detects $47\%$ of segments with errors above two map cells and $94\%$ of those above three, at a $10\%$ false-alarm rate. The foregoing results indicate that $H_t$ provides a truth-free diagnostic of map-conditioned navigation ambiguity.

AI.tldr: 该文将航空磁异常地图匹配建模为链式因子图上的推理问题，用前向-后向算法逐段求解，得到候选位置的离散后验及其香农熵，并以此作为无需真值的导航歧义诊断量。
AI.motivation: 现有磁异常地图匹配算法各有缺陷：扩展卡尔曼滤波假设高斯后验，粒子滤波需蒙特卡洛采样，维特比算法则丢弃后验不确定性只保留单一最优路径。作者希望在保留完整后验不确定性的同时避免采样开销，并获得可用于在线判别的置信度量。
AI.method: 将地图匹配形式化为链式结构因子图上的推理问题，采用前向-后向算法分段求解，输出时刻t候选位置的离散后验分布及其香农熵H_t。在Renfrew_395磁异常图上用10^3次合成试验与10^3条飞行路径进行验证，并与EKF、粒子滤波对比；另用分段级熵阈值检测大误差航段。
AI.result: 在10^3次合成试验中位位置误差为32.7 m，较362 m的中位惯性漂移降低91%；在相同试验及10^3条飞行路径上，中位误差比EKF和粒子滤波低43%。以分段级熵为阈值，在10%虚警率下可检出47%误差超过两个地图网格的航段，以及94%误差超过三个网格的航段。
AI.conclusion: 基于因子图的前向-后向推理在磁异常地图匹配中精度优于EKF与粒子滤波，且其后验熵H_t可作为无需真值参考的诊断指标，用于量化地图条件下的导航歧义并触发告警或重初始化。

title: zkDuel: Characterizing SumCheck Prover Kernels across GPU Programming Models
summary: SumCheck is a central prover primitive in zero-knowledge proofs, exposing table-parallel work that maps naturally to GPUs but becomes increasingly arithmetic-intensive as finite fields widen. We study how this shift affects the cost of programming SumCheck in Triton rather than CUDA. Our benchmark, zkDuel, provides matched implementations of 25 zkPHIRE-derived constraints alongside diagnostic polynomials, covering 32-, 64-, 128-, and 256-bit prime fields, with independent CPU-reference validation and cross-backend checksum gating. Of 800 configurations attempted on an NVIDIA H100, 758 complete with matching checksums. CUDA's median advantage over Triton falls from 3.5x at 32 bits to 1.4x at 256 bits, and Triton is faster on 19 large-table configurations; the same convergence appears on an A100, where the gap falls from 4.4x to 1.6x. Profiling shows that the small-field gap largely reflects host launch overhead and redundant modular additions in Triton's original block reduction, whose relative costs diminish as multi-limb Montgomery work grows. Replacing that reduction with tl.reduce brings Triton's median kernel time within 8% of CUDA on both GPUs, while specialized point interpolation improves 256-bit evaluation kernels by 1.55-1.75x. At cryptographic widths, these results show that a Python-embedded DSL can approach CUDA performance, although the largest fully unrolled constraints still expose compiler-scalability limits.

AI.tldr: 本研究用基准 zkDuel 对比 Triton 与 CUDA 实现 SumCheck 的性能，发现 Triton 相对 CUDA 的差距随有限域位宽增大而收敛（32 位 3.5x→256 位 1.4x），并用 tl.reduce 优化后接近 CUDA。
AI.motivation: SumCheck 是零知识证明的核心预处理原语，其表并行结构天然适配 GPU，但随着有限域位宽增大，算术强度显著上升，可能改变硬件与编程模型之间的成本权衡。作者希望回答：在算术密集型场景下，用 Python 嵌入的 DSL（Triton）而非 CUDA 编写 SumCheck 是否仍然代价高昂。
AI.method: 构建基准 zkDuel：对 25 个源自 zkPHIRE 的约束给出 CUDA 与 Triton 的配对实现，并加入诊断性多项式，覆盖 32/64/128/256 位素数域；采用独立的 CPU 参考实现进行正确性校验，并以跨后端校验和（checksum）作为门控。在 NVIDIA H100 与 A100 上运行，共 800 组配置；结合 profiling 分析瓶颈，并尝试用 tl.reduce 替换原有分块归约、以及专门的 point interpolation 优化。
AI.result: H100 上 800 组配置中 758 组完成且校验和一致。CUDA 相对 Triton 的中位优势从 32 位时的 3.5x 降至 256 位时的 1.4x，且 Triton 在 19 个大表配置上更快；A100 上呈相同收敛趋势（4.4x→1.6x）。Profiling 表明小域差距主要来自主机端启动开销与 Triton 原始分块归约中的冗余模加，这部分相对成本随多 limb Montgomery 运算增长而稀释。改用 tl.reduce 后，Triton 中位 kernel 时间在两款 GPU 上均进入 CUDA 的 8% 以内；专用 point interpolation 使 256 位求值 kernel 提升 1.55–1.75x。
AI.conclusion: 在密码学所需位宽下，Python 嵌入型 DSL（Triton）可以接近 CUDA 性能，二者差距的收窄机制明确且可被针对性优化消除；但完全展开的最大约束仍暴露出编译器可扩展性限制。该工作为 ZKP 加速器的实现语言选择提供了可复现的定量依据。

title: An Eigenmode Expansion Framework for Bi-Directional Multimode Nonlinear Mixing Processes
summary: An approach to simulating complex photonic systems is the eigenmode expansion method, in which scattering matrices are used to model and track the electric field in layered media. In this work, we formulate parametric nonlinear processes within the eigenmode expansion framework, enabling the simulation of nonlinear generation in varying photonic systems. This new simulation method includes both classical nonlinear processes and their quantum counterparts, including spontaneous parametric down-conversion and spontaneous four-wave mixing.

AI.tldr: 该工作将参量非线性过程（含经典与量子情形，如SPDC、SFWM）纳入本征模展开框架。
AI.motivation: 本征模展开法（EEM）已在分层介质中通过散射矩阵建模并追踪电场，能高效模拟复杂光子体系，但尚缺乏在其中描述参量非线性产生的统一形式化方法，限制了该框架对非线性光子系统的适用范围。
AI.method: 在本征模展开框架内对参量非线性过程进行形式化表述，将非线性产生过程嵌入基于散射矩阵的分层介质电场追踪体系，并同时覆盖经典非线性过程与其量子对应过程（自发参量下转换 SPDC、自发四波混频 SFWM）。
AI.result: 提出一种新的仿真方法，可在多样的光子系统中模拟非线性产生，且能统一处理经典与量子参量非线性过程。
AI.conclusion: 本征模展开框架可作为模拟复杂光子系统中参量非线性（含量子自发过程）的通用工具。

title: Scoring Explanations Without Reading Them: Structural Shortcuts in Automated-Interpretability Evaluation Data
summary: Automated interpretability scores an explanation of a sparse-autoencoder (SAE) feature by asking a model to predict, token by token, where the feature fires on evaluation examples or to judge whether marked tokens fit it. We find that the evaluation data standard pipelines build can be scored without reading the explanation. On Neuronpedia's stored fuzzing runs for 500 random GPT-2 small features, 91.3% of activating examples are cropped with the peak on the centre token, and a rule that says "yes" when the centre token is marked reaches balanced accuracy 0.979, against 0.838 for the stored LLM scorers (recomputed from the stored per-item verdicts, on marks rebuilt from the pipeline's code); a rule reading only the mark count reaches 0.969. The cue changes form across pipelines: current delphi always marks the same slot in its fuzzing negatives, and full-context runs mark negatives with more tokens. OpenAI's simulation benchmark lists each neuron's top-activating sequences first; a rule that predicts activity on the first five scores 0.227 in pooled correlation against 0.160 for GPT-4's published simulator (post hoc). We give closed forms for what such rules can score; show that one scorer's simulation scores are higher on stored snippets than on natural windows but not shown to be reordered; and build windows that remove the position cue, derive but do not build negatives that remove the mark cues, and separate the sequence cue by decomposition. On natural-text windows cut at random offsets, the best fixed-offset prior shared by all features scores 0.015. On them, that scorer, a typed decision model (Jev), reaches a pooled correlation of 0.331 over 49 features, against 0.013 with shuffled explanations, and an open 8B simulator with the original read-out reads the explanation there (0.194 against 0.019). Scores should be reported beside the best explanation-free rule on the same items.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示自动可解释性评分（对SAE特征解释的打分）可被"无解释规则"刷分：Neuronpedia存储的GPT-2 small 500个特征fuzzing数据上，仅凭"中心token被标记"规则即达0.979平衡准确率（存储LLM打分器0.838），并给出此类规则的闭式得分、诊断方法与去偏评估集。
AI.motivation: 现有自动可解释性评估（让模型逐token预测SAE特征触发位置，或判断标记token是否契合解释）被认为能衡量解释质量，但作者怀疑其评估数据本身含有可利用的捷径线索，导致分数可在不读解释的情况下被刷高，因此需要检验并给出稳健的评估方式。
AI.method: (1) 在Neuronpedia存储的500个随机GPT-2 small特征的fuzzing运行上，用仅依赖标记模式的规则（中心token是否被标记、标记计数）重算平衡准确率，并与存储的LLM打分器对比；(2) 分析线索在不同管线（当前delphi的固定槽位负例、全上下文负例标记更多token）中的形式变化；(3) 检验OpenAI模拟基准中"top-activating序列排在最前"的序列线索；(4) 给出此类规则的闭式得分表达式，用分解法分离序列线索，并构建消除位置线索的随机偏移自然文本窗口（负例去偏仅推导未构建）；(5) 在去偏窗口上评估Jev（类型化决策模型）与8B开源模拟器，并与打乱解释、共享固定偏移先验对照。
AI.result: 中心token标记规则平衡准确率0.979，仅用标记计数0.969，均高于存储LLM打分器的0.838；OpenAI模拟基准上"预测前五个序列"规则池化相关0.227，超过GPT-4已发布模拟器的0.160（事后分析）；某打分器在存储片段上分数更高但未被证明存在重排序；去偏自然文本窗口上，最优共享固定偏移先验仅0.015；Jev在49个特征上池化相关0.331（打乱解释0.013），8B开源模拟器0.194（打乱解释0.019）。
AI.conclusion: 自动可解释性评分易受与解释无关的捷径线索（位置、标记计数、序列次序）污染，现有基准分数被系统性高估。作者建议：报告分数时须同时给出同一批样本上"最佳无解释规则"的基线，并采用去除位置/标记线索的去偏评估集。

title: What a Weight Update Buys: Leverage Across Training Stages
summary: Post-training moves a language model's weights by about a thousandth of their norm and changes its behavior sharply; pretraining moves them by a third and buys a slow drift. We introduce leverage, an exact measure of what a unit of weight change buys: the Fisher quadratic form of an update, computed with one forward-mode pass per direction, divided by the same form for random directions of the same size at the same checkpoint. Leverage orders released Olmo-3, Tülu-3, Zephyr, and OLMo-2 checkpoints over four orders of magnitude: pretraining windows sit at the random level on prose, SFT five times above it, RL-Zero and RLVR at 400-1,500, and DPO at 400-23,000. With this instrument we find that pretraining accumulates into noise: windows of 30k to 1M steps are no more consequential on prose than random directions of their size, as a noisy quadratic model of SGD predicts. We find that training precision changes what an update looks like: training bf16 parameters without an fp32 master copy freezes 36-99% of coordinates, lowers leverage up to sevenfold, and creates an alignment between update magnitudes and the diagonal Fisher that fp32 training does not show. We derive and verify a law for reuse: the sign-flip null predicts the relative damage of random drop-and-rescale (DARE) at keep rate $p$ as $(1-p)/(p\,ρ_{\mathrm{sign}})$, within a factor of two of measurement wherever DARE succeeds. Two controls make these readings reliable: every controlled SFT and DPO trajectory with fp32 master weights loses leverage as it moves, and two re-runs of a released DPO stage from its anchor with its published recipe land within 1% of the released displacement and 4% of its leverage, where a plain recipe reads five to six times lower; leaving one component out traces the level to the length-normalized loss and its batch size of 128 together.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"leverage"（杠杆）这一精确度量：以权重更新的Fisher二次型除以同尺寸随机方向的Fisher二次型，量化"单位权重变化买到多少行为改变"。该度量在Olmo-3、Tülu-3、Zephyr、OLMo-2上跨越四个数量级地排序各训练阶段：预训练≈随机水平，SFT约5倍，RL-Zero/RLVR达400–1500，DPO达400–23000。据此发现预训练主要累积噪声、bf16无fp32主副本训练会冻结36–99%坐标并降低leverage，并推导出DARE损坏率随保留率的标度律。
AI.motivation: 后训练仅改变约千分之一范数的权重却带来剧烈行为变化，而预训练改变约三分之一范数却只换来缓慢漂移，二者"每单位权重改变的收益"差异巨大却缺乏统一、可比的量化工具。作者希望构造一个精确、可跨检查点与跨阶段比较的"性价比"测量仪，用以回答：不同训练阶段到底把权重改变花在了什么上、训练精度如何塑造更新结构、以及权重剪枝/复用方法（如DARE）的成功能否被预测。
AI.method: 定义leverage为更新的Fisher二次型 uᵀFu，除以同一检查点上同尺寸随机方向的同一二次型，用每方向一次前向模式（forward-mode）微分精确计算。在开源模型族（Olmo-3、Tülu-3、Zephyr、OLMo-2）上跨预训练窗口（30k–1M步）、SFT、RL-Zero、RLVR、DPO阶段测量。附加实验：对比有无fp32主副本的bf16训练、检验"符号翻转零假设"对DARE在保留率p下相对损坏率 (1-p)/(p·ρ_sign) 的预测、以及对已发布DPO阶段从锚点按论文配方重跑的可复现性对照。
AI.result: leverage在四数量级范围内有序区分阶段：预训练窗口在散文上处于随机水平（与SGD噪声二次模型预测一致），SFT约5倍，RL-Zero与RLVR为400–1500倍，DPO为400–23000倍，整套检查点跨越四个数量级。无fp32主副本的bf16训练冻结36–99%坐标、leverage最多降七倍，并产生更新幅度与对角Fisher的对齐（fp32无此现象）。DARE损坏率律 (1-p)/(p·ρ_sign) 在DARE有效处与实测相差不超过两倍。对照实验：所有fp32主权重下的受控SFT/DPO轨迹随训练推进leverage下降；按发布配方重跑DPO阶段，位移与发布值差1%、leverage差4%，而朴素配方读数低5–6倍；逐步消融将这一水平定位到长度归一化损失与其batch size 128的共同作用。
AI.conclusion: 权重改变本身的信息量依赖于方向与检查点，必须用相对随机基线的Fisher二次型来度量；leverage提供了一个精确、可复现、跨阶段可比的标尺，揭示预训练在"买噪声"、后训练在"买行为"，并解释训练精度与优化器细节如何塑造更新的几何结构与可复用性。该工具可作为评估训练算法效率、诊断数值精度副作用与预测权重剪枝/复用成败的通用手段。

title: GOFish: Full Field-of-View Gaussian Splatting and Mesh Extraction
summary: Robots, autonomous vehicles, and consumer 360° cameras use fisheye lenses for wide fields of view (FoVs). Simulation-ready digital twins require photorealistic rendering across the full FoV and an aligned collision mesh. However, prior fisheye Gaussian Splatting methods only rasterize up to 180° and do not produce meshes, while Gaussian surface reconstruction methods assume pinhole training images. We present GOFish, the first 3D Gaussian Splatting surface reconstruction method to train directly on fisheye images, rasterize FoVs beyond 180°, and extract an aligned mesh from the same scene. Calibrated densification recovers the surface across the entire FoV, while Calibrated Mip Filtering and Wide-Angle Appearance Modeling keep pixel blur and lens falloff out of the scene and mesh. Across the 200° FIORD and 205° FullCircle benchmarks, GOFish improves PSNR over the best prior method by 2.28 and 1.97 dB, respectively. It also outperforms fisheye rendering baselines within their own FoVs and achieves the highest mesh F-score on FIORD and the main ScanNet++ set. Together, the Gaussian scene and mesh form a LiDAR-free, simulation-ready digital twin that renders in real time, ray traces the full FoV, and provides collision geometry.

AI.tldr: GOFish是首个直接在鱼眼图像上训练、光栅化超过180°视场、并从同一场景提取对齐网格的3D高斯泼溅表面重建方法。
AI.motivation: 机器人、自动驾驶与消费级360°相机使用鱼眼镜头获得大视场，仿真就绪的数字孪生需要全视场逼真渲染及对齐的碰撞网格。然而现有鱼眼高斯泼溅方法仅能光栅化至180°且不产生网格，而高斯表面重建方法假设针孔训练图像。
AI.method: GOFish直接基于鱼眼图像训练3D高斯泼溅并做表面重建，光栅化视场超过180°，并从同一场景提取对齐网格。其中标定感知的致密化（Calibrated Densification）恢复整个视场内的表面；标定Mip滤波（Calibrated Mip Filtering）与广角外观建模（Wide-Angle Appearance Modeling）将像素模糊与镜头暗角从场景和网格中排除。
AI.result: 在200° FIORD与205° FullCircle基准上，GOFish相比最佳先前方法的PSNR分别提升2.28 dB和1.97 dB；在其自身视场内也优于鱼眼渲染基线；并在FIORD和ScanNet++主集上取得最高网格F-score。
AI.conclusion: 高斯场景与网格共同构成无需LiDAR、仿真就绪的数字孪生，可实时渲染、光线追踪全视场并提供碰撞几何。

title: A 3D measurement workflow for assessing replication quality and tool degradation in moulded microfluidic channels
comment: 20 pages, 11 figures, 5 tables; supplementary material (19 pages) appended
summary: Mould-based replication, such as injection moulding with 3D-printed inserts, needs a check of how faithfully microchannels are transferred from master to polymer replica. It is usually limited to a width or depth ratio from one cross-section, which misses the sidewall shape and depends on where the section is taken. We present a workflow that assesses the whole channel from 3D scans of master and replica, without sectioning. The scans are registered on a common grid, and each height map is converted into a map of local slope. The correlation of the two slope maps over the channel interior, RQ$_d$, is reported with the channel dimensions and height- and slope-error maps. These outputs separate a change of shape from a change of size and locate it. A user can thereby compare mould materials, detect tool wear, and tell whether a deviation arose before or during moulding. On synthetic channels with known degradation, RQ$_d$ fell steadily as the sidewalls were rounded, whereas the height correlation levelled off. For injection moulding with stereolithography-printed inserts in three resins, RQ$_d$ ranged from 0.17 to 0.91 over fifteen insert-to-part pairs. The height correlation placed the ten well-formed channels within 0.03. Over a twenty-shot run, one insert's RQ$_d$ fell from 0.90 to 0.72 as its sidewalls wore, while its height correlation stayed above 0.93. We developed open-source software that implements the workflow. Because the workflow needs only registered 3D scans of a master and its replica, it can in principle be applied to other mould-based processes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于主模与复制件三维扫描的无切片全通道保真度评估流程，以局部坡度图相关性RQ$_d$为核心指标，可分离并定位形状偏差与尺寸偏差。
AI.motivation: 基于模具的复制（如3D打印嵌件注塑）需评估微通道从母模到聚合物复制件的转移保真度。现有方法通常只从单一横截面计算宽深比，忽略侧壁形状，且结果依赖切片位置，难以反映整体形貌与偏差来源。
AI.method: 对母模与复制件进行三维扫描，配准到统一网格；将各高度图转换为局部坡度图；在通道内部计算两坡度图的相关性RQ$_d$，并输出通道尺寸及高度误差图、坡度误差图。用已知退化程度的合成通道验证指标敏感性，并对三种树脂的SLA打印嵌件注塑（15组嵌件-制件对）及20次注射磨损实验进行实测；配套开源软件。
AI.result: 合成通道侧壁逐渐圆化时，RQ$_d$持续下降而高度相关性趋于饱和；注塑实验中15组配对的RQ$_d$为0.17–0.91，高度相关性将10个成形良好通道的差异压缩在0.03以内；20次注射过程中某嵌件RQ$_d$由0.90降至0.72（侧壁磨损），而高度相关性仍高于0.93。
AI.conclusion: RQ$_d$对侧壁形状变化更敏感，与高度误差图、坡度误差图及尺寸信息联合使用，可将形状变化与尺寸变化分离并定位，支持模具材料比较、工具磨损检测及判断偏差产生于成型前或成型中。方法仅需配准后的母模与复制件三维扫描，原则上可推广至其他基于模具的复制工艺。

title: LRMoE: Demand-Side Load Re-Calibration for Efficient MoE Training on Memory-Constrained Nodes
summary: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models offer scalable capacity for Web applications, but uneven routing creates computation and communication bottlenecks. Existing placement and replication methods redistribute this workload, yet additional expert copies compete with token-related buffers for limited GPU memory. We present LRMoE, a memory-aware MoE training system that jointly recalibrates backward demand and balances the retained workload. During forward execution, it plans retention quotas and expert placement under resource constraints while preserving all routed computations. During backpropagation, a load recalibration metric estimates each token-expert pair's contribution to the expert update and selects pairs within these quotas. A capacity-aware routing algorithm distributes retained pairs among eligible instances of their original experts. Physical compaction then forms smaller communication payloads and variable-size grouped GEMMs, reducing backward traffic, computation, and execution-buffer demand. Experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B and GLM4.5-106B-A12B show that LRMoE reduces cumulative MoE-layer training time to fixed-loss targets by 21.2-44.8% relative to SYMI.

AI.tldr: LRMoE：一种内存感知的MoE训练系统，通过前向规划保留配额与专家放置、反向以负载重校准指标筛选token-expert对、容量感知路由与物理压缩，降低反向通信、计算与缓冲区需求。
AI.motivation: 稀疏MoE模型具备可扩展容量，但路由不均导致计算与通信瓶颈；现有放置与复制方法虽可再分配负载，冗余专家副本却挤占有限的GPU显存（与token相关缓冲区竞争）。
AI.method: 联合重校准反向需求并平衡保留负载：（1）前向执行在资源约束下规划保留配额与专家放置，且保留全部被路由计算；（2）反向传播用负载重校准指标估计每个token-expert对对专家更新的贡献，并在配额内筛选；（3）容量感知路由将保留对分配到原专家的可用实例；（4）物理压缩形成更小的通信负载与可变尺寸分组GEMM。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B与GLM4.5-106B-A12B上，相较SYMI，达到固定损失目标所需的MoE层累计训练时间减少21.2%–44.8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过前向配额规划与反向贡献筛选的协同，LRMoE在不增加专家副本的前提下缓解显存竞争与路由不均瓶颈，显著加速MoE训练。

title: Covariance Learning for Direction-of-Arrival Estimation with Sparse Linear Arrays
summary: Covariance learning (CL) estimates source powers and sensor-noise variance by minimizing the Type-II (marginal) negative log-likelihood of the array measurements. We develop both grid-based and gridless CL direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimators applicable to arbitrary sparse linear array (SLA) geometries. The grid-based DOA estimator minimizes the Type-II objective on an angular grid via successive convex approximation (SCA) and estimates the noise variance by a scalar bisection search. The gridless DOA estimator then refines each grid-based DOA over the continuum using a Newton method. Simulations on a six-sensor nested array, including an underdetermined case with nine sources, show that the proposed DOA estimators outperform state-of-the-art methods, despite jointly estimating the sensor noise variance.

AI.tldr: 提出基于网格与无网格两种协方差学习（CL）DOA估计器，适用于任意稀疏线阵，先SCA在网格上最小化Type-II负对数似然并用标量二分法估计噪声方差，再用牛顿法做无网格精化，在六阵元嵌套阵（含九源欠定场景）上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 协方差学习通过最小化阵列观测的Type-II（边缘）负对数似然来估计源功率与传感器噪声方差；作者希望把该框架扩展到任意稀疏线性阵列几何，并同时获得网格型与无网格型DOA估计器，且能联合估计噪声方差。
AI.method: 网格型估计器在角度网格上以连续凸近似（SCA）最小化Type-II目标函数，并将噪声方差通过标量二分搜索单独估计；无网格估计器随后以牛顿法在连续域上对每个网格DOA进行精化。
AI.result: 在六传感器嵌套阵仿真中（含九个源的欠定情形），所提DOA估计器在联合估计传感器噪声方差的前提下仍优于现有先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于Type-II似然的协方差学习可用于任意SLA几何的网格与无网格DOA估计；SCA加标量二分与牛顿精化的组合有效，且在欠定条件下表现稳健。

title: The Code Behind the Layout: AI Agents for Analog Layout Generators
summary: Analog layout remains largely manual and hard to automate. Generator frameworks such as gLayout express layouts as programs, producing layouts from parameterized, design-rule-aware generators; however, writing such generators still takes expert effort. Large language models (LLMs) could now write generator code, and frontier models can even draw layout geometry from design intent. This raises a practical question: if a model can draw the layout itself, what does a generator framework still contribute, and is applying these models to a generator framework better than having them draw a layout from scratch? Through controlled experiments on gLayout in SKY130, we find that the main obstacle to drawing a layout directly is its time and token cost, and that the main advantage of a model building on a generator framework is reusability. Its verified primitives keep each model edit small enough to check, and its parameters allow a single edit to be evaluated across an entire family of layouts. Accordingly, a model is most effective when it develops the layout from the generator source of the family that the design intent belongs to, and tests each edit on the family members most likely to fail, so that one verified change improves every layout the generator produces. The results of these family tests can then serve as supervision for a local model, which learns edits that hold across the family at a fraction of the inference cost.

AI.tldr: 在SKY130上对gLayout的受控实验表明：直接让LLM画版图的主要瓶颈是时间与token开销，而基于生成器框架的核心优势是可复用性；模型最有效的用法是沿设计意图所属"布局族"的生成器源码迭代、在族内最易失败的成员上验证每次编辑，并将族测试结果作为监督蒸馏到本地模型以降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 模拟版图仍高度依赖人工、难以自动化。gLayout等生成器框架把版图表达为程序，可由参数化、规则感知的生成器产出布局，但编写此类生成器仍需专家投入。前沿LLM已能写生成器代码、甚至直接从设计意图绘制几何图形，于是引出两个实际问题：(1) 若模型能自行绘制版图，生成器框架还有什么贡献；(2) 在生成器框架上使用模型，是否优于让模型从零绘制。
AI.method: 在SKY130工艺下对gLayout开展受控实验，比较"直接绘制版图"与"基于生成器框架构建"两条路径，分析各自的时间与token成本及可复用性；进而提出按设计意图所属布局族的生成器源码进行迭代开发，并在族内最可能失败的成员上验证每次编辑，最后用族测试结果作为监督，通过微调让本地模型学习跨族成立的有效编辑。
AI.result: 直接绘制版图的主要障碍在于时间与token成本；生成器框架的主要优势在于可复用性——其经校验的基元使每次模型编辑足够小、可被检查，其参数使单次编辑能在一整族布局上被评估。族测试结果可作为监督信号，使本地模型以远低于前沿模型的推理成本学到跨族通用的编辑。
AI.conclusion: 生成器框架与LLM并非替代关系而是互补：模型应在其所属布局族的生成器源码上进行开发，并以族内最易失败成员作为验证靶点，从而让一次经确认的修改改进该生成器产出的所有布局；族级验证结果还可蒸馏为低成本本地模型能力。

title: Automated identification of quasi-BIC modes in disordered resonator chains using spatial field envelopes and resonance descriptors
summary: Structural disorder turns bound states in the continuum (BICs) into quasi-BIC resonances and mixes them with spectrally close eigenmodes, so the target mode must be identified anew in every disorder realization. We develop an automated procedure for this task and test it on a chain of 50 ceramic disks, where disorder reorders the standing-wave eigenmodes at the edge of the BIC band: at disorder amplitude $σ=0.05$, the highest-quality-factor ($Q$) mode is the target in only 45\% of realizations, and above $σ\approx0.06$ the highest-frequency mode is no longer the target. The target is identified from the spatial envelope of its field and its resonance parameters by an ensemble of a convolutional--recurrent neural network and two gradient-boosted decision-tree models. On 299 held-out realizations, the ensemble selects the target in 82.6\% of cases, against 60.9\% and 49.5\% for the highest-frequency and highest-$Q$ rules, and in 69.5\% of cases for $σ\ge0.09$, where the best of these rules reaches 57.6\%. The mean $Q$ of the selected modes follows that of the manually labeled modes ($\langle Q\rangle\proptoσ^{k}$, $k=-0.80\pm0.05$ versus $-0.86\pm0.04$). After adaptation on 50 labeled realizations, the workflow identifies the quasi-BIC of a Ge$_2$Sb$_2$Te$_5$ bar metasurface in 98--100\% of labeled cases, including a lossy phase where $Q$ does not distinguish the mode.

AI.tldr: 提出自动化识别无序下准BIC目标模式的流程，用CNN-RNN与梯度提升树集成在50个陶瓷圆盘链上验证，准确率82.6%，优于最高频率(60.9%)与最高Q(49.5%)规则，并迁移至GST超表面达98–100%。
AI.motivation: 结构无序使BIC转变为准BIC共振，并与光谱邻近的本征模混合，导致每种无序实现中目标模式都需重新识别；而常用的“最高频率”或“最高Q”等简单规则在无序下失效（σ=0.05时最高Q规则仅45%命中，σ≈0.06以上最高频率也不再是目标）。
AI.method: 构建自动化识别流程，利用目标模式的空间场包络与共振参数作为特征，集成一个卷积–循环神经网络与两个梯度提升决策树模型进行分类；在50个陶瓷圆盘链的299个留出实现上评估，并在50个标注实现上微调后应用于Ge₂Sb₂Te₅条形超表面。
AI.result: 留出集上集成模型识别目标占82.6%（对比60.9%与49.5%）；σ≥0.09时达69.5%（最佳规则57.6%）；所选模式平均Q随σ的幂律标度与人工标注一致（k=−0.80±0.05 vs −0.86±0.04）；迁移至GST超表面后98–100%正确，包括Q无法区分的损耗相。
AI.conclusion: 基于场包络与共振参数的多模型集成可实现无序体系中准BIC的稳健自动识别，显著优于传统启发式规则，并具备跨材料平台的可迁移性。

title: The Best Second Opinion Is Right Where the Primary Is Wrong: Partner Selection for Selective Span Tagging
summary: A span tagger that ranks its outputs by risk can defer the riskiest ones to a person, and a second model can sharpen this ranking. Which second model should it be? Partner selection is conditional, not global: the best second opinion is the model that is right where the primary is wrong. Across eight tagger types, three seeds and three English benchmarks (576 evaluated primary-partner pairings), choosing the partner by held-out accuracy on the primary's errors recovers 82% of the best partner's gain, against 69-70% for span F1 or a random pick. Frozen before a fourth dataset was chosen, the rule replicated there (Spearman 0.40 vs. 0.04 for span F1). Partner value is also directional. The predictive distribution is the second opinion: hard labels discard half of a partner's value, and scoring the served label improves 94% of pairings. Fixed before the fourth dataset was chosen, this score also replicated there. For LoRA-tuned decoders, independently trained partners beat every readout of the primary network. Applied zero-shot to 51 MASSIVE locales, every primary has a helpful trained partner in every locale, and the preferred partner follows competence.

AI.tldr: 在风险排序的span标注任务中，第二模型（伙伴）的选择应是条件性的：以主模型错误样本上的留出准确率选伙伴，可恢复最优伙伴增益的82%，显著优于span F1（69–70%）与随机选择，并在第四个数据集上复现；预测分布本身即"第二意见"，评分被服务标签可提升94%的配对；跨51个MASSIVE语种每个主模型均存在有帮助伙伴。
AI.motivation: 风险排序型span标注器可将最高风险样本转人工审核，而引入第二模型能进一步锐化风险排序；但"哪个第二模型最好"并非全局问题，而是条件性的——最佳第二意见应在主模型出错处正确，因此需要一套可操作、可迁移的伙伴选择准则，并厘清伙伴价值的来源（硬标签还是预测分布）与方向性。
AI.method: 构建8种标注器类型×3个随机种子×3个英文基准的576个主-伙伴配对评估；以主模型错误样本上的留出准确率作为伙伴选择规则，与span F1、随机选择对比；在第四个数据集上于预先冻结规则后进行复现验证（Spearman相关）；用预测分布（而非硬标签）对被服务标签评分；对LoRA微调解码器，比较独立训练的伙伴与主网络各类读出；将方法零样本应用于51个MASSIVE语种。
AI.result: 按主模型错误上的留出准确率选伙伴可恢复最佳伙伴增益的82%，span F1为69–70%，随机选择相当；第四个数据集上复现（Spearman 0.40 vs. span F1 的0.04）。硬标签丢弃约一半伙伴价值，改用预测分布评分使94%的配对得到改善，并在第四数据集复现。LoRA解码器上独立训练的伙伴优于主网络的所有读出。51个MASSIVE语种中，每个主模型在每个语种均能找到有帮助的已训练伙伴，且偏好伙伴随能力而变。
AI.conclusion: 伙伴选择是条件性而非全局性的，应以"在主模型错误处是否正确"为准则；第二意见体现在预测分布而非硬标签；伙伴价值具方向性与语种依赖性。该准则预先冻结后可跨数据集复现，具备实用性与可迁移性。

title: Threshold Compatibility and Support-Selection Diagnostics in Neural Discovery of Partial Differential Equations
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables; includes supplementary material
summary: Accurate regression need not yield the correct equation after support selection. For a median/sample-standard-deviation threshold in neural PDE discovery, we derive an exact two-signal retention boundary and a complete-vector perturbation bound. Exact advection-diffusion libraries lose diffusion despite coefficient recovery to numerical precision. True-support refits of forty saved sparse states reduce diffusion error without restoring all derivative accuracy. A fixed sequential threshold ridge comparator recovers exact support in sixty ideal controls but selects extra terms in every learned state. All-fold correct-support candidates are rejected by conditional validation; post hoc energy pooling preserves their higher minimum loss in all sixty states. Supplied-support estimates outperform unchanged selected equations in all 240 physical-residual comparisons on four unused analytic trajectories. With coefficients, observation points and weights fixed, exact replacement of the learned library and target reverses their learned-row ordering in 59/60 states. Weighting both losses also fails the specified Burgers diffusion-benefit criterion at every tested budget. These finite diagnostics distinguish threshold incompatibility, refit damage and score rejection; they establish neither automatic correction nor general recovery or predictive stability.

AI.tldr: 该文针对神经PDE发现中的中位数/样本标准差阈值准则，给出精确的双信号保留边界与全向量扰动界，证明稀疏支持选择失败不等同于回归不准确，并区分阈值不兼容、重拟合损伤与评分拒绝三类失效机制。
AI.motivation: 精确回归未必导致支持选择后得到正确方程。作者希望澄清"系数回归精度高"与"发现正确方程结构"之间的分离现象，并量化阈值型稀疏选择在PDE发现中的有限样本诊断极限。
AI.method: 对中位数/样本标准差阈值推导精确的双信号保留边界和完整向量扰动界；在精确平流-扩散库上检查扩散项丢失；对40个保存的稀疏状态做真支持重拟合；用固定序贯阈值岭回归比较器在60个理想控制与所有学习状态上对比；采用条件验证与事后能量池化考察正确支持候选；在4条未用解析轨迹上做240次物理残差比较；固定系数、观测点与权重，做精确库与目标替换的行序检验；并测试加权损失在Burgers扩散收益准则下的表现。
AI.result: 精确平流-扩散库在系数恢复到数值精度时仍丢失扩散项；真支持重拟合降低扩散误差但未恢复全部导数精度；比较器在60个理想控制中全部恢复精确支持，却在所有学习状态中选出多余项；所有折正确支持候选被条件验证拒绝，而事后能量池化在全部60个状态保留其更低的最小损失；在240次物理残差比较中，给定支持估计均优于未修改的已选方程；精确替换学习库与目标后，59/60个状态的学习行序反转；加权两种损失在所有测试预算下均未满足Burgers扩散收益准则。
AI.conclusion: 这些有限诊断可区分阈值不兼容、重拟合损伤与评分拒绝，但不构成自动纠错、一般性恢复或预测稳定性的证明，结论局限于所考察的有限设置。

title: Convex Potential Learning for Optimal Transport Between Medical Images
summary: Computing optimal transport maps between medical images plays a fundamental role in morphological analysis. However, existing methods are either difficult to scale to large 3D medical images or rely on regularized formulations that provide only approximate transport maps. To improve the accuracy of downstream medical image analysis, we propose a novel approach for estimating optimal transport maps by parameterizing the convex potential function. By construction, the resulting transport map is guaranteed to be curl-free, consistent with Brenier's theorem. We evaluate the proposed method on both 2D and 3D medical imaging datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves lower transport estimation errors and produces higher-quality image reconstructions than existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出通过参数化凸势函数来估计医学图像间最优传输映射的新方法，所得映射由构造保证无旋，符合Brenier定理，在2D/3D医学数据上取得更低传输误差与更优重建质量。
AI.motivation: 医学图像形态学分析依赖图像间的计算最优传输映射；但现有方法要么难以扩展到大规模3D医学图像，要么依赖正则化形式只能给出近似传输映射，从而限制下游分析精度。
AI.method: 以凸势函数为参数化对象来估计最优传输映射，使映射按其构造天然满足无旋性（curl-free），与Brenier定理一致；在2D与3D医学影像数据集上进行评测。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法相比现有方法具有更低的传输估计误差，并生成质量更高的图像重建结果。
AI.conclusion: 参数化凸势函数的思路可兼顾可扩展性与传输映射的精确性，有助于提升下游医学图像分析任务的表现。

title: 800 $^\circ$C Air-Ambient Operation of Extreme-Bandgap Al$_{x}$Ga$_{1-x}$N (x>0.6) Digital and Random-Alloy Channel HEMTs
summary: This work demonstrates the high-temperature (room to 800 $^\circ$C) operation of thin Al$_{0.62}$Ga$_{0.38}$N digital alloy (DA) short-period superlattice (SPSL), and random alloy (RA) Al$_{0.64}$Ga$_{0.36}$N channel MOSHEMTs on sapphire. The RA devices employ a doped $n^{+}$-85%-Al barrier and a highly doped $n^{++}$-Al$_{0.86\rightarrow0.20}$Ga$_{0.14\rightarrow0.80}$N reverse-graded layer (RGL) for surface ohmic contact formation, whereas the DA devices employ a binary AlN barrier and selectively regrown $n^{++}$-GaN source/drain contacts. At 800 $^\circ$C, the DA channel devices exhibit better thermal stability: their saturated drain current decreases from 460 to 172 mA/mm (62.6%) compared with 338 to 98 mA/mm (71.0%) for the RA channel, and a lower subthreshold swing (459 for DA versus 550 mV/dec for RA). All tested DA devices also exhibit superior threshold-voltage stability ($<\pm 10\%$ versus $>\pm 19\%$ for RA) and maintain an ON/OFF current ratio >$10^4$ at 800 $^\circ$C, compared with ~$10^3$ for RA, thus establishing the DA channel HEMTs as a promising new platform for high-temperature electronics.

AI.tldr: 在蓝宝石衬底上对比AlGaN数字合金（DA）短周期超晶格与随机合金（RA）沟道MOSHEMT的高温（室温至800 °C）特性，DA器件的热稳定性与阈值电压稳定性均优于RA器件。
AI.motivation: 高温电子学需要在高温柔性下保持性能稳定的AlGaN/GaN基HEMT沟道，而传统随机合金沟道在高温下电流与开关特性退化明显，需评估数字合金超晶格沟道作为替代方案的可行性。
AI.method: 在蓝宝石衬底上制备两种沟道MOSHEMT：RA器件采用掺杂n⁺-85%-Al势垒与高掺杂n⁺⁺-Al₀.₈₆→₀.₂₀Ga₀.₁₄→₀.₈₀N反向渐变层形成表面欧姆接触；DA器件采用Al₀.₆₂Ga₀.₃₈N短周期超晶格沟道、二元AlN势垒及选择性再生长n⁺⁺-GaN源漏接触。在室温至800 °C范围内测试饱和漏电流、亚阈值摆幅、阈值电压稳定性及开关比。
AI.result: 800 °C下DA沟道器件饱和漏电流由460降至172 mA/mm（降幅62.6%），RA为338→98 mA/mm（降幅71.0%）；DA亚阈值摆幅459 mV/dec，优于RA的550 mV/dec；DA阈值电压漂移<±10%，RA>±19%；DA在800 °C仍保持>10⁴的开关比，RA仅约10³。
AI.conclusion: 数字合金短周期超晶格沟道HEMT在高温下表现出更优的热稳定性、阈值电压稳定性和开关特性，是有前景的高温电子学新平台。

title: Amortized Localized Posterior Inference for Model Calibration with Application to an Ocean Turbulence Closure
summary: Model discrepancy may prevent a single calibration parameter from reproducing a physical response across the context domain. In addition, uncertainties in observations and contexts affect calibration and must be accounted for and quantified. We construct a family of localized posteriors by weighting observation likelihoods according to their proximity to a target context. Gaussian localization weights incorporate context uncertainty through covariance inflation, with reflection at domain boundaries and an optional correction for uneven context sampling. A conditional normalizing flow approximates the family of posteriors through amortized variational inference. Integrating the localized posteriors under a prescribed context measure gives the marginalized parameter distribution. In a twin experiment with the Branin-Hoo model, we compare global and localized inference under uniform and skewed context distributions. Localization reduces the reported aggregate predictive errors relative to the global posterior. An application to the k-$ε$ turbulence closure in a single-column ocean model, with atmospheric surface forcing as context, shows that localized posterior calibration reduces temperature and zonal-velocity errors relative to deterministic and global-posterior calibration. Both twin experiments are constructed to admit local compensation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于高斯权重与条件归一化流的局域化贝叶斯校准方法，处理模型差异与情境不确定性，并提升预测精度。
AI.motivation: 单一校准参数难以在整个情境域内重现物理响应（模型差异），且观测与情境不确定性会影响校准过程，需要显式建模与量化。
AI.method: 按观测与目标情境的距离对似然加权，构造局域后验族：高斯定位权重通过协方差膨胀纳入情境不确定性，在域边界反射，并对不均匀情境采样加可选修正；用条件归一化流通过摊销变分推断近似后验族；按给定情境测度对局域后验积分得到边缘化参数分布。
AI.result: Branin-Hoo孪生实验中，在均匀与偏斜情境分布下比较全局与局域推断，局域化降低了聚合预测误差；单柱海洋模型k-ε湍流闭合应用（大气表面强迫为情境）中，局域后验校准相较确定性与全局后验校准降低了温度与纬向速度误差。
AI.conclusion: 局域化后验校准能有效应对模型差异与情境不确定性，获得更优的聚合预测性能；孪生实验设计允许局部补偿。

title: Two-Layer Microwave Linear Analog Computer (MiLAC)-Aided Multi-User MIMO Networks
summary: Microwave linear analog computer (MiLAC)-aided beamforming, which performs signal processing directly in the analog domain, has recently emerged as a promising alternative to fully digital and hybrid beamforming for multi-antenna systems. However, existing studies have shown that a single lossless and reciprocal MiLAC at the transmitter cannot, in general, attain the performance of fully digital beamforming in multi-user scenarios. To overcome this limitation, we propose a two-layer MiLAC-aided transmit beamforming architecture for downlink multi-user multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) networks. Leveraging multiport microwave network theory, we first establish a general physics-compliant model of the proposed architecture, and then derive a simplified model under the assumptions of unilateral and perfectly matched amplifiers. We prove that, with lossless and reciprocal MiLACs, the two-layer MiLAC-aided transmitter can realize any fully digital transmit beamformer, while a single-layer MiLAC-aided receiver can attain the same achievable rate as a fully digital linear combiner. We then derive closed-form mappings from fully digital transmit beamformers and receive combiners to their corresponding MiLAC-aided analog implementations. Based on these equivalence results, we formulate a sum-rate maximization problem for the considered multi-user MIMO network and develop an optimization framework for jointly designing the power allocation and scattering matrices of the MiLAC-aided transceivers. Numerical results validate the theoretical analysis and show that the proposed two-layer MiLAC-aided design attains the same sum-rate performance as its fully digital counterpart.

AI.tldr: 提出两层MiLAC辅助的发射波束成形架构，证明无损互易MiLAC可实现任意全数字发射波束成形器，单层MiLAC接收机可达全数字线性合并器的速率，并给出闭式映射与联合优化框架，性能与全数字方案相当。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明，发射端单个无损互易MiLAC在多用户场景下一般无法达到全数字波束成形的性能，需突破该限制。
AI.method: 针对下行多用户MIMO网络提出两层MiLAC辅助发射架构；基于多端口微波网络理论建立通用物理一致模型，并在单边、完美匹配放大器假设下推导简化模型；证明等效性并给出全数字波束成形器/合并器到模拟实现的闭式映射；进而构建和速率最大化问题，联合优化功率分配与散射矩阵。
AI.result: 理论证明：无损互易的两层MiLAC发射机可实现任意全数字发射波束成形器，单层MiLAC接收机可达到与全数字线性合并器相同的可达速率；数值结果验证理论分析，所提设计达到与全数字方案相同的和速率性能。
AI.conclusion: 两层MiLAC架构克服了单层MiLAC在发射端的性能局限，为模拟域波束成形提供了可与全数字方案媲美的可行途径。

title: GI-RTL-Fuzz: Grammar-Informed RTL Generation with LLMs for End-to-End Differential Simulator Fuzzing
summary: Register-Transfer Level (RTL) simulators are fundamental to modern IC design workflows, yet like any complex software, they frequently contain critical bugs that compromise simulation accuracy. To systematically stress-test these tools, we introduce GI-RTL-Fuzz, a grammar-informed fuzzing framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate high-quality RTL test cases. Our key innovation is guiding the LLM's generation process using Backus-Naur Form (BNF) grammar coverage information, enabling the exploration of complex and rarely-tested language features. By performing differential testing against different RTL simulators, our framework uncovered a significant number of previously unknown inconsistencies in both the linting process and simulation results of major Verilog simulators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GI-RTL-Fuzz，一种结合 BNF 文法覆盖信息引导 LLM 生成 RTL 测试用例的模糊测试框架，通过差分测试发现主流 Verilog 仿真器的未知不一致性缺陷。
AI.motivation: RTL 仿真器是现代 IC 设计流程的核心工具，但其如其他复杂软件一样常含关键缺陷，会影响仿真正确性，因此需要系统化的压力测试手段。
AI.method: 以 BNF 文法覆盖信息作为反馈信号，引导 LLM 生成高质量 RTL 测试用例，从而探索复杂且少被测试的语言特性；并对不同 RTL 仿真器执行差分测试。
AI.result: 在主流 Verilog 仿真器的 lint 检查与仿真结果中发现大量此前未知的不一致性问题。
AI.conclusion: 将文法覆盖引导与 LLM 生成结合，可有效提升 RTL 测试用例质量与缺陷发现能力，为仿真器可靠性验证提供可行路径。

title: Drift-induced nonreciprocity in image-polariton-mediated dipole emission
summary: Electrical current bias offers a magnet-free route to nonreciprocal light propagation at the nanoscale. Here, we theoretically explore drift-induced nonreciprocity in graphene heterostructures containing hexagonal boron nitride (hBN), where graphene plasmons interact with hBN phonon polaritons in the infrared. Both the random-phase approximation and the Boltzmann transport equation are used to characterize the nonlocal optical response of drift-biased graphene. We compare graphene on hBN with an image-polaritonic structure comprising graphene, a thin hBN spacer, and a gold substrate. Carrier drift produces pronounced directional shifts of the polariton dispersion, while coupling to hBN phonon polaritons strongly modifies the nonreciprocal response. In the image-polaritonic structure, the graphene polaritons become up to twice as confined while retaining a comparable Fizeau shift. The nonreciprocal polariton dispersion produces directional near-field emission and nonreciprocal dipole-dipole interactions, the latter quantified through the cross density of optical states, reaching a left-right dissymmetry of up to ~40%. Our results identify image polaritons in drift-biased graphene as a compact, electrically tunable platform for directional coupling between quantum emitters at the nanoscale.

AI.tldr: 本文理论上研究了漂移偏置石墨烯/hBN异质结中的非互易等离激元传播：电流驱动产生等离激元色散的方向性频移，hBN声子极化激元耦合显著修饰该响应；在石墨烯-薄hBN-金衬底的"镜像极化激元"结构中，极化激元限制增强近两倍而Fizeau频移相当，并实现约40%的左右不对称度的非互易偶极-偶极相互作用。
AI.motivation: 纳米尺度非互易光传播通常依赖磁光材料或外磁场，难以集成。电流偏置提供无磁、电可调的替代方案，但石墨烯漂移非互易性与hBN声子极化激元耦合、以及镜像极化激元构型下的调控规律尚不清晰。
AI.method: 采用随机相位近似（RPA）与玻尔兹曼输运方程共同描述漂移偏置石墨烯的非局域光学响应；对比石墨烯/hBN双层与石墨烯-薄hBN间隔层-金衬底构成的镜像极化激元结构；计算极化激元色散、近场发射方向性，并通过交叉光学态密度（CDOS）量化偶极-偶极相互作用的非互易性。
AI.result: 载流子漂移引起极化激元色散显著的方向性频移；与hBN声子极化激元耦合强烈修饰非互易响应；镜像极化激元结构中石墨烯极化激元限制增强至约2倍，同时保持相当的Fizeau频移；非互易色散导致定向近场发射与非互易偶极-偶极相互作用，CDOS左右不对称度最高约40%。
AI.conclusion: 漂移偏置石墨烯中的镜像极化激元是一种紧凑、电可调的平台，可实现纳米尺度量子发射体之间的定向耦合，为无磁非互易纳米光子学提供方案。

title: Exposure Is Not Commitment: Double-Stratified Evaluation of Latent Monitors for Tool-Using Agents
comment: Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Agents in the Wild (AIWILD); OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=dSY5sYX014 . 16 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Code: https://github.com/rishabhsinha17/latent-state-auditing
summary: Tool-using language agents are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection, and a growing literature probes model internals to catch unsafe actions before they execute, with sharply conflicting results. We argue much of the conflict is an evaluation artifact, and propose a double-stratification protocol: separate injection exposure from behavioral commitment, in both the evaluation and the training population. On the primary Qwen AgentDojo grid, monitors trained on the naive mixed unsafe-versus-rest contrast mostly learn exposure: they flag exposed trajectories whether or not the agent complies, and barely predict which cases turn unsafe. Retrained on exposed cases only, the same probe families predict the model's own unsafe tool call up to two steps early, the maximum the three-step trajectories admit (logistic AUROC 0.853, matched by a trained TF-IDF text baseline at 0.855). Mistral-7B reaches 0.896 and OLMo-2-7B 0.912; their naive contrasts learn different things: inverted exposure ranking on one, both axes on the other. Representations separate on exposure (probe 1.000 versus trained text 0.908) and where visible context is sanitized or unavailable. Training contrast alone reproduces the shape of recent pre-action-probe negative results, one candidate explanation for the conflict: the signal exists, but the model's own zero-shot forecast and NLA verbalizations do not reliably recover it. An unstratified AUROC overstates what a latent monitor knows, and what a naive contrast learns is population-dependent: evaluations should stratify both.

AI.tldr: 该文指出间接提示注入监测中的矛盾结果多为评估伪影，提出"双重分层"协议（在评估与训练总体中均分离"注入暴露"与"行为承诺"），证明朴素对比训练出的探针主要在学暴露而非是否违规；仅在已暴露样本上重训后，探针可提前至多两步预测模型自身的不安全工具调用。
AI.motivation: 工具型语言智能体易受间接提示注入攻击，已有大量工作通过探查模型内部状态在执行前拦截不安全动作，但结论严重冲突。作者认为冲突主要源于评估设计缺陷：未区分"是否被注入暴露"与"是否真正执行不安全行为"，导致监测器的预测能力被混淆与误读。
AI.method: 提出双重分层（double-stratification）评估协议，在评估集与训练总体中同时分层暴露与承诺两个维度。在Qwen AgentDojo网格上对比两种训练对比：(1) 朴素的"不安全 vs 其余"混合对比；(2) 仅在暴露样本上重训。并与训练式TF-IDF文本基线、零样本预测、NLA言语化对比；在Mistral-7B与OLMo-2-7B上复现。
AI.result: 朴素混合对比的探针主要学到"暴露"：无论智能体是否顺从都会标记已暴露轨迹，几乎无法预测哪些案例转为不安全。仅在暴露样本上重训后，同类探针可提前至多两步（三步轨迹的上限）预测模型自身的不安全工具调用：逻辑回归AUROC 0.853，与训练式TF-IDF文本基线0.855持平；Mistral-7B达0.896，OLMo-2-7B达0.912。朴素对比在不同模型上学到不同内容（一个呈现暴露排序反转，另一个同时学到两个轴）。表征在暴露维度上可分性极强（探针1.000 vs 训练式文本0.908），且在可见上下文被清洗或不可用时依然可分。仅改变训练对比即可复现近期"行动前探针"负面结果的形态。模型的零样本预测与NLA言语化无法可靠恢复该信号。
AI.conclusion: 未分层的AUROC会高估潜在监测器真正掌握的信息，朴素对比学到什么依赖于总体构成。因此评估应同时分层暴露与承诺；信号本身存在，但需通过分层训练对比提取，模型的自我预测与言语化不可替代。

title: Predicate Neuron: Differentiable Quantization of Predicate Relations in Gradient-based Learning
summary: In machine learning, symbolic reasoning approaches often rely on static architectures that hinder integration into deep neural networks and gradient-based optimization. To address this, we introduce the Native Predicate Neuron, a differentiable logic-reasoning neural module that enriches standard architectures with symbolic reasoning capabilities via first-order logic quantization. The proposed neuron models relational logic by learning to alternate between operations using a single trainable parameter. It features a tailored gradient mechanism with a dual-nature formulation: executing hard logical operations during training while maintaining differentiability for backpropagation. By quantizing both its input and choice state, the Predicate Neuron approximates continuous and non-continuous functions, effectively resolving discontinuities that standard deep learning architectures struggle with. We evaluate the Predicate Neuron across Fully-Connected, Convolutional, Recurrent, and Transformer architectures on benchmarks like MNIST and Wikitext. Results show that incorporating Predicate Neurons accelerates convergence, boosts accuracy, and lowers loss in general, with particularly strong improvements in tasks requiring monotonic reasoning or handling discontinuities. Overall, the Predicate Neuron natively integrates into standard neural networks to enable fuzzy logic operations and is available in Keras and PyTorch.

AI.tldr: 提出"原生谓词神经元"(Native Predicate Neuron)——一种可微的一阶逻辑量词化逻辑推理模块,通过单参数学习操作交替、硬逻辑正向+可微反向的双重梯度机制,原生嵌入FC/CNN/RNN/Transformer,在MNIST、Wikitext等任务上加速收敛、提升精度。
AI.motivation: 符号推理方法多依赖静态架构,难以与深度神经网络及基于梯度的优化融合;而标准深度架构在处理不连续函数与单调关系推理上存在局限。作者希望让符号逻辑能力以可训练、可微分的方式原生嵌入现有网络。
AI.method: 核心构件为Native Predicate Neuron:以first-order logic quantization对输入与"选择状态"进行量化,通过单一可训练参数学习在多种逻辑运算间交替;采用定制梯度机制(Dual-nature formulation):前向执行硬逻辑操作,反向保持可微以支持BP。由于输入与状态均被量化,该神经元可同时逼近连续与非连续函数,缓解标准架构面对的不连续性问题。实现于Keras与PyTorch。
AI.result: 在MNIST与Wikitext等基准上,将Predicate Neuron接入全连接、卷积、循环与Transformer四类架构:总体上加速收敛、提高精度并降低损失;在需要单调推理或处理不连续性的任务上提升尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 谓词神经元可原生集成到标准神经网络中以实现模糊逻辑操作,兼具符号推理表达力与梯度优化兼容性;代码已在Keras与PyTorch中开源。

title: Effects of Deep Learning Architecture and Pretraining on Automated Vocal Fold Segmentation in Ex Vivo High-Speed Phonation Images
summary: Two-dimensional (2D) intraglottal particle image velocimetry (PIV) of ex vivo phonation experiments quantifies vocal fold medial surface dynamics and the intraglottal flow field. However, it relies on manual segmentation because residual glare, low tissue-to-flow contrast, and tracer-particle speckle obscure the vocal fold boundaries. This study assessed how deep learning architecture and ImageNet pretraining affect automated vocal fold segmentation in these high-speed images. Four established architectures from three categories were benchmarked: the convolutional neural network (CNN)-based UNet and UNet++, the hybrid CNN-transformer-based TransUNet, and the pure transformer-based Swin-UNet, the latter two trained from scratch and from ImageNet-pretrained weights. Using 16,344 expert-annotated images from 227 phonation trials of excised canine larynges, the six pipelines were trained with five seeds under a standardized protocol and compared on 50 held-out test trials using trial-level Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with Holm correction. Mean Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) spanned only 0.9734 to 0.9764, so the pipelines differed mainly in boundary fidelity. Pretraining significantly improved the boundary F1 score (BF1) and 95th percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) of the TransUNet and Swin-UNet, about four times more for the Swin-UNet. Once pretrained, the two performed similarly, although the Swin-UNet has only about a quarter of the trainable parameters. Without pretraining, the TransUNet had a significantly higher BF1 and a lower HD95 than both CNN-based pipelines and about half their share of images with HD95 > 50 pixels. To our knowledge, this is the first study to apply deep learning to vocal fold segmentation in 2D intraglottal PIV, and it offers a reference framework for segmenting experimental flow-visualization images with noisy optical conditions or highly deformable objects.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次将深度学习应用于二维声门内PIV图像中的声带分割，基准比较了4种架构（UNet、UNet++、TransUNet、Swin-UNet）及ImageNet预训练的影响，发现各流程DSC差异极小（0.9734–0.9764），主要差异体现在边界精度上。
AI.motivation: 二维声门内PIV实验依赖人工分割声带，因残余眩光、组织-流场对比度低及示踪粒子散斑而难以自动分割，亟需评估深度学习架构与预训练对该任务的作用。
AI.method: 采用16,344张专家标注图像（来自227次离体犬喉发声试验），对6条流程（UNet、UNet++、TransUNet、Swin-UNet，后两者分别从头训练与ImageNet预训练）以统一协议、5个随机种子训练，在50个留存测试试验上用试验级Wilcoxon符号秩检验（Holm校正）比较DSC、BF1与HD95。
AI.result: 平均DSC仅0.9734–0.9764，差异集中于边界保真度；预训练显著提升TransUNet与Swin-UNet的BF1和HD95，Swin-UNet提升约四倍；预训练后两者表现相近，而Swin-UNet可训练参数仅为约四分之一；无预训练时TransUNet的BF1更高、HD95更低，HD95>50像素图像占比约为CNN类流程的一半。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次将深度学习用于二维声门内PIV声带分割，为噪声光学条件或高度可变形对象的实验流动可视化图像分割提供了参考框架。

title: A guide to enriched continuum modeling: advances on wave propagation in metamaterials through the relaxed micromorphic framework
summary: This contribution provides a systematic framework for modeling the dispersive behavior of mechanical metamaterials by an enriched continua approach using the relaxed micromorphic model (RMM). We give the identification of its frequency-independent constitutive parameters from Bloch-Floquet dispersion data of the periodic metamaterial by combining analytical relations for characteristic features with a subsequent numerical optimization. Particular emphasis is placed on the underlying structure and limitations of the resulting dispersion relations, including their cut-offs, and asymptotic behavior. Finally, the transition from infinite periodic media to finite-size specimens is addressed, highlighting the role of the microscopic unit-cell cut and discussing null-Lagrangian contributions, effective interface forces, and surface Lagrangians as approaches to incorporate boundary effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用松弛微极模型（RMM）这一富集连续介质方法对机械超材料的色散行为进行系统建模，并给出从Bloch-Floquet色散数据识别频率无关本构参数的框架。
AI.motivation: 机械超材料的色散行为通常需借助周期性微结构计算获得，而连续介质模型若能准确刻画则更利于分析与工程应用；但如何系统识别RMM参数、明确其色散关系的结构局限，以及处理有限尺寸样品的边界效应，仍缺乏统一框架。
AI.method: 采用松弛微极模型（RMM）作为富集连续介质描述；结合解析特征关系与后续数值优化，从周期性超材料的Bloch-Floquet色散数据中识别频率无关的本构参数；并分析所得色散关系的结构、截止频率与渐近行为；最后讨论从无限周期介质到有限尺寸试件的过渡，涉及微观单胞切割、null-Lagrangian贡献、有效界面力与表面Lagrangian等边界效应处理方式。
AI.result: 建立了参数识别的系统流程（解析关系+数值优化），阐明了RMM色散关系的结构特征、截止与渐近行为及其局限，并梳理了刻画有限尺寸样品边界效应的若干途径。
AI.conclusion: RMM可为机械超材料色散建模提供系统、可参数识别的富集连续介质框架；但其色散关系存在固有结构限制，向有限尺寸样品的推广需借助单胞切割处理、null-Lagrangian、有效界面力与表面Lagrangian等手段来纳入边界效应。

title: ThinkJev: One Thought, Every Budget for Calibrated Typed Decisions
summary: Many uses of language models end in a typed decision: a choice among a closed set of options, whose probabilities code can act on. Reading those probabilities from one forward pass is fast but often wrong on decisions that take several steps, such as arithmetic, counting, and date comparison. Letting the model think first fixes most of these errors, but costs seconds per decision instead of milliseconds. To pay for thinking only where it helps, ThinkJev builds a fast and a slow system from one open hybrid-thinking model that can answer directly or after a thought. System 1 reads the model's probabilities for the option letters when it answers directly; System 2 reads the same letters after the model has thought on the same cached prompt, so escalating repeats no work and both systems give probabilities over the same options. Because the letters can be read after any number of thought tokens, one sampled thought also gives the answer under every thinking budget. Without training, ThinkJev lets System 1 answer alone only where a statistical test on labeled dev data guarantees that its accepted answers stay under a target error rate. At a 5% target, Qwen3.5-27B answers 24.5% of 8359 test decisions this way with a realized error of 3.9% (Qwen3.5-4B and 9B: 6.5% and 0.0%). For the rest, stopping each thought as soon as its answer is confident reaches 81.6% accuracy, against 82.7% for always thinking, with 72% of the thought tokens. Choosing when to think from System 1's confidence alone saves less, because the decisions System 1 is least sure of are often not the ones thinking fixes. On the public items of JevBench, an independent benchmark of typed-decision services, Qwen3.5-27B thinks on 29.4% and is not distinguishable in accuracy from the two thinking APIs listed (exploratory). Code and data generators are available at https://github.com/ding-xiaolu/ThinkJev.

AI.tldr: ThinkJev 用同一个混合思考模型构建快慢两套系统（System 1 直接读选项字母概率，System 2 在缓存提示上思考后读同一组字母概率），无需训练即可在统计保证下按需升级，仅对高风险决策调用思考以节省算力。
AI.motivation: 语言模型的许多用途最终归结为在封闭选项集上做分类决策，单次前向读取概率虽快但在算术、计数、日期比较等多步决策上易错；先思考可修正错误但每次决策耗时从毫秒升至秒级，因此需要只在真正有帮助处才付出思考代价。
AI.method: 基于一个开放混合思考模型构建 System 1 与 System 2：System 1 在直接作答时读取选项字母概率，System 2 在同一缓存提示上思考后读取相同字母概率，升级时不重复计算，且单次采样可在任意思考预算下复用；无需训练，利用带标签验证集上的统计检验，仅当接受的答案满足目标错误率时才让 System 1 单独作答，其余情况以置信度作早期停止。
AI.result: 5% 目标错误率下，Qwen3.5-27B 在 8359 条测试决策中由 System 1 单独作答 24.5%，实际错误率 3.9%（4B 与 9B：分别为 6.5% 与 0.0%）；对其余决策在置信后停止思考达 81.6% 准确率（始终思考为 82.7%），仅用 72% 的思考 token；仅凭 System 1 置信度决定是否思考收益更低；JevBench 上 27B 仅 29.4% 触发思考，准确率与两个思考型 API 无显著差异（探索性）。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享提示缓存与统一字母概率读取，可在无训练条件下实现带统计错误保证的快慢级联决策，显著降低思考 token 消耗；System 1 置信度并非思考收益的良好指示器，需借助验证集上的统计检验进行升级判定。

title: Adaptive Orbit-Aided Vector Tracking for Orbit Determination of LEO Satellites
summary: Reliable orbit determination for CubeSats is essential for emerging low-Earth-orbit positioning, navigation, and timing (LEO-PNT) applications. However, onboard orbit determination remains constrained by single-frequency GNSS code-based receivers, intermittent signal reception, and highly dynamic orbital conditions. This paper proposes an adaptive orbit-aided vector tracking (OAVT) algorithm for LEO-PNT CubeSat orbit determination under these conditions. The method employs a GNSS vector tracking loop (VTL) as the primary navigation estimator and loosely couples it with a low-fidelity orbital dynamics model (ODM), which provides auxiliary position and velocity pseudo-measurements. The contribution of the ODM is regulated through adaptive covariance assignment based on GNSS stress and the residual consistency between the ODM and GNSS solutions. Under nominal conditions, OAVT preserves the accuracy advantage of VTL over the conventional scalar tracking loop. The 3D position root-mean-square error (RMSE) is reduced from 2.631\,m for STL to 1.081\,m, while the 3D velocity RMSE decreases from 0.3985\,m/s to 0.1023\,m/s. Under degraded conditions, OAVT provides substantially greater robustness than both STL and standalone VTL. The 3D position RMSE remains bounded at 8.27\,m during a complete signal outage, 10.17\,m during gradual signal loss and reacquisition, and 26.65\,m under variable visibility, whereas STL fails to produce valid solutions and standalone VTL loses lock. These results demonstrate that OAVT substantially improves solution robustness and state continuity with only a moderate increase in computational burden, making it suitable for CubeSat orbit determination and future LEO-PNT missions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出自适应轨道辅助矢量跟踪（OAVT）算法，将GNSS矢量跟踪环（VTL）与低精度轨道动力学模型（ODM）松耦合，通过自适应协方差分配提升LEO-PNT CubeSat定轨的精度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: CubeSat星载定轨受限于单频GNSS码基接收机、信号间歇可用及高动态轨道条件，传统标量跟踪与独立VTL在信号中断或衰减时易失锁或无法给出有效解，难以满足LEO-PNT对可靠定轨的需求。
AI.method: 以GNSS矢量跟踪环作为主导航估计器，与低精度轨道动力学模型松耦合，由ODM提供辅助位置与速度伪量测；依据GNSS应力状态以及ODM与GNSS解的残差一致性，自适应分配ODM的协方差权重，从而动态调节其贡献。
AI.result: 标称条件下三维位置RMSE由STL的2.631 m降至1.081 m，三维速度RMSE由0.3985 m/s降至0.1023 m/s；退化条件下OAVT显著优于STL与独立VTL：完全信号中断时位置RMSE保持在8.27 m，信号渐失与重捕时10.17 m，可见性变化时26.65 m，而STL无法给出有效解、独立VTL失锁。
AI.conclusion: OAVT仅以适度计算量增加为代价，显著提升解的鲁棒性与状态连续性，适用于CubeSat定轨及未来LEO-PNT任务。

title: Exploring and optimizing the Vivado Flow on large FPGA designs: A Practical Analysis of Strategies and Their Impact on Timing
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Achieving timing closure in FPGA designs is crucial, especially for high-performance applications. The Vivado Design Suite offers several strategies for optimization, but finding the best configuration for a given project remains challenging. This paper explores the various Vivado's timing directives and strategies to improve performance across timing, area, and runtime. Through two test-case designs, an NQR spectrometer SoC-FPGA and a digital readout ASIC prototype for high energy physics particle detector's, different strategies and configurations are compared to identify the most efficient flow.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两个测试用例（NQR 谱仪 SoC-FPGA 与高能物理数字读出 ASIC 原型）系统比较 Vivado 各类时序指令与策略，从时序、面积、运行时间三个维度识别最高效的实现流程。
AI.motivation: FPGA 设计中的时序收敛至关重要，尤其在高性能应用中；Vivado 提供多种优化策略，但为具体工程挑选最佳配置仍具挑战性，缺乏针对策略与指令的系统性对比依据。
AI.method: 以两个实际测试用例设计为对象，遍历并对比 Vivado 的多种时序指令（timing directives）与实现策略（strategies），在同一评价框架下考察时序性能、资源面积与运行时间。
AI.result: 在两个测试用例上获得了不同策略与配置的对比数据，据此识别出在时序、面积与运行时间之间综合最高效的实现流程；摘要未给出具体量化指标。
AI.conclusion: Vivado 策略选择对设计质量影响显著，需按设计特性进行针对性配置，为工程实践中的时序收敛策略选择提供了参考依据。

title: Confocal ellipsoidal displaced Gregorian structure for stand-off millimeter-wave imaging
summary: Reflective-based structures are favorable candidates as the optical section of millimeter-wave and terahertz (THz) stand-off imaging systems due to decreasing frequency-dependent losses and aberrations compared to refractive-based counterparts. In this paper, we propose a simple confocal ellipsoidal displaced Gregorian (CEDG) dual-mirror configuration for stand-off imaging systems that exhibits superior performance in terms of mitigating optical blockage and enabling object scanning. The proposed structure is composed of a standard elliptical main mirror, which focuses the emanated rays on the focal plane, and a modified secondary mirror (SM) that reduces the optical blockage effect and improves the imaging performance of the structure. A detailed step-by-step procedure is proposed for constructing the structure, followed by an analytical study and deriving closed-form design equations. By performing ray tracing simulations, it is observed that the optical blockage of the proposed CEDG structure is reduced compared with the standard Gregorian. Also, the resolution and the depth-of-focus (DoF) are obtained at 1.5 cm and 49.7 cm in full-wave simulations, respectively, demonstrating good agreement with the theoretical predictions. Moreover, the scanning performance of the CEDG structure is investigated by utilizing the tilting of the SM and feed point displacement, presenting a maximum field-of-view (FoV) of 40 cm at a distance of 3 m, which is acceptable for modern practical stand-off imaging systems. Finally, the capability of the proposed structure for tuning the stand-off distance by lateral displacement of the feeding source is verified. As a result, the proposed compact, low-cost configuration shows potential for practical mm-wave and THz stand-off imaging systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一种共焦椭球位移格雷戈里（CEDG）双反射镜结构用于毫米波/太赫兹远距离成像，通过改进副镜减弱光遮挡并实现扫描与调焦。
AI.motivation: 反射式结构在毫米波与THz远距离成像中因频率相关损耗与像差随频率升高而降低，优于折射式，因此需要设计低遮挡、可扫描的紧凑反射光学系统。
AI.method: 主镜为标准椭球面，将光线聚焦至焦平面；副镜为改进型SM以减小光遮挡；给出逐步构造流程与闭式设计方程；采用光线追迹与全波仿真评估遮挡、分辨率、焦深；通过副镜倾斜与馈源位移研究扫描FoV，并通过馈源横向位移调谐成像距离。
AI.result: 光遮挡相对标准格雷戈里结构降低；全波仿真分辨率1.5 cm、焦深49.7 cm，与理论预测一致；3 m处最大FoV 40 cm；馈源横向位移可调谐远距离。
AI.conclusion: 该紧凑、低成本CEDG配置在实用毫米波与THz远距离成像系统中具有应用潜力。

title: Artifact Distillation: Training-Free Transfer from Frontier to Small Language Models
comment: 10 pages (4 pages main text), 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: Closing the gap between frontier and smaller language models is usually approached by distillation: fine-tuning the small model (student) on a frontier model's (teacher) outputs, which binds transfer to training compute and leaves the transferred knowledge largely opaque. We propose Artifact Distillation: a teacher solves training instances and externalizes its problem-solving procedure into an artifact bank that a student queries at inference time, with no gradient updates. Across four LiveBench tasks, a bank written by Claude Opus 4.5 lets Claude Haiku 4.5 outperform unaided Claude Sonnet 4.5 on spatial reasoning (0.707 vs. 0.647) at 60% of its cost, and reach Sonnet 4.5's level on table joining at 89% of its cost. The same raw bank raises Qwen3.5-27B's pooled score from 0.730 to 0.800, showing that transfer is not confined to the teacher's model family.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"制品蒸馏"(Artifact Distillation)：教师模型将解题过程外化为制品库，学生模型在推理时按需查询，无需梯度更新，实现跨模型族的低成本能力迁移。
AI.motivation: 传统蒸馏通过在小模型(学生)上微调前沿模型(教师)的输出以缩小能力差距，但这种迁移受制于训练算力，且迁移的知识高度不透明。作者希望摆脱对训练算力和梯度更新的依赖，并提升知识迁移的可解释性。
AI.method: 教师模型求解训练实例，并将其解题过程外化为一个"制品库"(artifact bank)；学生模型在推理阶段查询该制品库以辅助作答，全程无需梯度更新(无参数微调)。
AI.result: 在四个 LiveBench 任务上：由 Claude Opus 4.5 编写的制品库使学生模型 Claude Haiku 4.5 在空间推理上超过无辅助的 Claude Sonnet 4.5（0.707 vs. 0.647），成本仅为其 60%；在表连接任务上达到 Sonnet 4.5 的水平，成本为其 89%。同一原始制品库还将 Qwen3.5-27B 的汇总得分从 0.730 提升至 0.800，表明迁移不局限于教师模型所属的模型族。
AI.conclusion: 制品蒸馏是一种免训练、可解释且跨模型族有效的能力迁移方法，能以更低成本让小模型逼近甚至超越更大模型的表现，为缩小模型间能力差距提供了新路径。

title: Selective Transfer Learning for Groundwater Level Anomaly Forecasting: Accuracy-Risk Trade-offs
summary: This work studies context-aware selective transfer learning for multi-well groundwater anomaly forecasting in the Netherlands. Source-domain pretraining can raise average accuracy but is not uniformly reliable: it degrades performance on a substantial fraction of heterogeneous wells. Context-Aware Selective Learning (CASL) uses calibration-trained, constrained contextual blending of frozen no-transfer and fixed-transfer parents.
