Global Convex Blend uses the same parents with one calibration-fitted weight per seed. The corrected task requires nine consecutive observed monthly inputs and an exact three-calendar-month target, without interpolation. Evaluation covers 457 wells and 13,718 test windows under five predefined seeds, with the four-cell maxsim0.60 source pool frozen using Always-TL validation RMSE alone. Fixed transfer harms 18.38-51.86% of wells. CASL has 0.424-1.084% lower RMSE than No TL, partially rescuing 97.53-99.50% and fully rescuing 23.46-43.78% of fixed-harmed wells. Partial rescue can arise structurally from convex blending and does not establish contextual superiority. Global Convex Blend protects more wells in four seeds, while CASL has slightly lower pooled RMSE in four. Neither dominates: the results support an accuracy-risk trade-off on the fixed split, not rolling deployment validity.

AI.tldr: CASL通过校准训练对"冻结的无迁移"与"固定迁移"两父模型做受约束的上下文混合，在多井地下水异常预测中略优于无迁移且能部分修复被迁移损害的井，但与全局凸混合相比不存在支配性优势，体现精度-风险权衡。
AI.motivation: 源域预训练/迁移学习虽能提升平均精度，但在异质井上并非一致可靠，会显著损害相当比例的井；作者希望探索一种上下文感知的选择性迁移方法来缓解这种负迁移风险。
AI.method: 提出Context-Aware Selective Learning（CASL）：以校准集训练的、受约束的上下文混合，融合两个冻结父模型（No-Transfer与Fixed-Transfer）；对照方法Global Convex Blend仅用每种子一个校准拟合的全局权重。任务设定为9个连续观测月输入、精确3个日历月目标、无插值；评估457口井、13718个测试窗口、5个预定义种子，源池基于Always-TL验证RMSE冻结。
AI.result: 固定迁移使18.38–51.86%的井受损；CASL相对No TL的RMSE降低0.424–1.084%，部分修复97.53–99.50%、完全修复23.46–43.78%的受损井。但部分修复可由凸混合的结构性质产生，不能证明上下文优越性；Global Convex Blend在四个种子中保护更多井，CASL在四个种子中合并RMSE略低，二者互不支配。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在固定划分上的"精度-风险"权衡，而非滚动部署有效性；上下文方法相对全局凸混合无支配优势，需谨慎解读部分修复效应。

title: PairCLIP-SWA: Similarity-Guided Balancing and Stochastic Weight Averaging for Generalized Deepfake Image Detection with OpenCLIP
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, 12 tables. Code and experiment outputs: https://github.com/DarkJ0Y/PairCLIP-SWA
summary: Deepfake detectors are almost always deployed as the single checkpoint that scored best on a validation split, yet the reliability of that choice is rarely measured. We measure it with PairCLIP-SWA, a single-backbone detector that adapts an OpenCLIP ViT-L/14 visual tower by progressive block unfreezing on a class-balanced corpus built by CLIP-similarity-guided one-to-one subsampling, and averages the fine-tuning trajectory in weight space. Trained in-domain on the IEEE SP Cup 2025 (DF-Wild-Cup) benchmark under the same protocol as the strongest published three-backbone ensemble, the weight-averaged detector reaches 97.04% accuracy, 98.64% AU-ROC and a 4.07% equal error rate, against 94.46%, 97.60% and 5.00%. Its training log shows why averaging matters: over the averaged epochs the non-averaged checkpoint swings across 5.34 points of validation accuracy while its validation loss more than doubles, whereas the average is never worse and is up to 5.99 points better. On an OpenForensics-derived benchmark the same instability becomes a misranking: the checkpoint that validation accuracy selects (98.43%) scores 88.85% on a disjoint 10,905-image test partition, rejecting 21.1% of genuine photographs, while the terminal average, ranked last on validation, scores 94.76%. A study of twenty-two in-house configurations on the identical DF-Wild-Cup split, including preprocessing ablations, shows that CLIP pre-training rather than ensembling drives accuracy, that secondary face cropping costs about 34 points, and that frequency-domain inputs transfer poorly. We recommend per-class selection criteria measured off the early-stopping split.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出单骨干检测器PairCLIP-SWA：基于OpenCLIP ViT-L/14视觉塔，通过渐进式分块解冻微调，并在权重空间对微调轨迹做平均（SWA）；实验表明权重平均显著提升可靠性并避免验证集选点误排序，同时给出CLIP预训练、人脸裁剪与频域输入的消融结论。
AI.motivation: 深度伪造检测器普遍只部署在验证集上得分最优的单一检查点，但这一选择的可靠性鲜有度量：验证准确率可能无法反映真实测试性能，甚至造成检查点排序错误。作者因此希望同时量化"选点可靠性"并提供更稳健的检测器与选点准则。
AI.method: 1) PairCLIP-SWA：单一骨干的OpenCLIP ViT-L/14视觉塔，采用渐进式block解冻微调；2) 训练语料经CLIP相似度引导的一对一子采样构造为类平衡语料；3) 在权重空间对微调轨迹做平均（SWA）；4) 在IEEE SP Cup 2025（DF-Wild-Cup）上与已发表最强三骨干集成采用相同协议进行域内对比，并在OpenForensics衍生基准上考察验证集选点与测试性能的错配；5) 在相同划分上进行22组内部配置研究，包括预处理消融。
AI.result: 域内DF-Wild-Cup上：97.04%准确率、98.64% AU-ROC、4.07% EER，对比三骨干集成的94.46%、97.60%、5.00%。训练日志显示未平均检查点在平均区间内验证准确率波动达5.34个点、验证损失翻倍以上，而权重平均从不更差、最多高出5.99点。OpenForensics衍生基准上出现误排序：验证准确率选出的检查点（验证98.43%）在10,905张不相交测试集上仅88.85%，误拒21.1%真实照片；而验证排名最后的终端平均模型达94.76%。消融显示CLIP预训练（而非集成）是准确率驱动力，二次人脸裁剪损失约34个点，频域输入迁移性差。
AI.conclusion: 单一检查点的验证集选点不可靠，权重空间平均可提供"不更差"的稳健替代，且验证准确率可能对检查点产生错误排序。建议采用基于早停划分的逐类别（per-class）选择准则，而非全局验证准确率。

title: OpenFrontiers: A Collection of Open Research Problems and a Benchmark for Scientific Rediscovery
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown increasing promise in research-level problem solving, yet a comprehensive collection of such problems is still missing, and evaluating them on research-level problems remains challenging. We introduce OpenFrontiers, a cross-disciplinary resource that combines a structured corpus of open research problems with a retrospective benchmark of recently resolved problems in mathematics. The corpus records problem statements, context, progress, and other information for 12,151 problems. The benchmark contains 200 problems, 110 resolved in 2026 and 90 still open, each with a Lean~4 statement checked by automated probes and two independent reviews; a subset HQ-50 further filters based on quality score, etc. Our evaluation protocol grades formal proofs with two independent checkers in an isolated sandbox under closed-book, frozen-retrieval, and live-web conditions. Evaluating seven LLM agents on the HQ-50 subset under a standardized budget, we find that closed-book rediscovery is rare, at most 7 of 40 resolved problems, whereas live-web success mostly reflects retrieval of published solutions. By linking a broad research-problem corpus to a formally graded evaluation subset with documented solutions, OpenFrontiers provides a foundation for measuring research-level rediscovery and studying progress toward solving currently open scientific problems. The dataset and benchmark could be found in https://huggingface.co/collections/FlippyDora/openfrontiers.

AI.tldr: OpenFrontiers 构建了跨学科开放研究问题语料库（12,151 条）与数学已解问题的回溯基准（200 题，含 Lean 4 形式化陈述），并在隔离沙箱中从闭卷、冻结检索、实时联网三种条件下评估 7 个 LLM 智能体，揭示闭卷下"重新发现"极为罕见。
AI.motivation: LLM 在研究级问题求解上展现出潜力，但缺乏系统的研究级问题集合，且此类问题的评测本身仍很困难；亟需一个可形式化评分、带已知解的评测资源来衡量"研究级再发现"能力。
AI.method: 构建 OpenFrontiers：①结构化语料库，记录 12,151 个开放研究问题的陈述、背景与进展；②回溯基准，含 200 题（110 题于 2026 年被解决、90 题仍开放），每题配 Lean 4 陈述，经自动探针检查与两位独立评审；③HQ-50 质量筛选子集；④评测协议：在隔离沙箱中用两个独立检查器对形式化证明评分，设置闭卷、冻结检索、实时联网三种条件，在统一预算下评测 7 个 LLM 智能体。
AI.result: 在 HQ-50 上评测 7 个智能体：闭卷条件下成功"再发现"极少，40 个已解题中最多 7 个成功；实时联网条件下的成功主要反映对已发表解答的检索，而非独立求解。
AI.conclusion: 通过将广泛的研究问题语料库与可形式化评分的评测子集及有据可查的解答相连接，OpenFrontiers 为度量研究级再发现、追踪向尚未解决科学问题推进的进展提供了基础。

title: Beyond Fresnel Approximation: Exact Airy Beamforming for Near-Field THz Communications
summary: Line-of-sight (LoS) blockage can severely degrade the performance of conventional focused beams in terahertz (THz) communications. Recently, bending beams (e.g., Airy beams) have attracted increasing attention due to their ability to bypass obstacles by propagating along curved trajectories under near-field propagation conditions. However, existing Airy-beam designs in wireless communications often rely on the Fresnel approximation for the focal distance, which becomes inaccurate at large steering angles or short propagation distances. To address this limitation, this letter proposes a more accurate Airy beamforming design method based on the exact focal-distance expression and the corresponding caustic geometry. Specifically, we jointly optimize the bending curvature, virtual focal distance, and steering angle to maximize the received signal power subject to receiver-alignment and obstacle-avoidance constraints. To tackle the resulting non-convex problem, we first use geometric preprocessing to narrow the feasible range of the bending curvature. Then, a two-layer optimization framework is developed with the outer and inner layers optimizing the bending curvature and the other two parameters, respectively. Numerical results based on the cascaded geometrical and wave channel model demonstrate that the proposed method achieves higher received signal power than conventional Airy-beam designs and offers complementary advantages over conventional focused beams under different blockage ratios.

AI.tldr: 针对太赫兹通信中视距遮挡问题，提出基于精确焦距表达式与焦散几何的Airy波束成形设计方法，通过联合优化弯曲曲率、虚拟焦距和转向角以最大化接收功率，并采用几何预处理加双层优化求解非凸问题。
AI.motivation: 传统聚焦波束在太赫兹频段易受视距遮挡严重影响；Airy等弯曲波束可在近场沿曲线传播绕过障碍，但现有无线通信中的Airy波束设计多依赖Fresnel近似来求焦距，在大转向角或短传播距离下不准确，导致设计偏差。
AI.method: 采用精确焦距表达式及对应焦散几何替代Fresnel近似，构建以最大化接收信号功率为目标、受接收端对准与障碍规避约束的联合优化问题，优化变量为弯曲曲率、虚拟焦距和转向角；针对非凸性，先用几何预处理缩小弯曲曲率的可行域，再设计双层优化框架，外层优化弯曲曲率、内层优化其余两个参数。
AI.result: 基于级联几何与波信道模型的数值结果表明，所提方法相较传统Airy波束设计获得更高的接收信号功率，且在不同遮挡比例下与传统聚焦波束呈现互补优势。
AI.conclusion: 精确焦距与焦散几何建模能有效提升Airy波束在太赫兹遮挡场景下的波束成形性能，双层优化框架可有效处理该非凸设计问题；Airy弯曲波束与传统聚焦波束可按遮挡条件互补使用。

title: IMPACT: Constraint-Aware Search for Imperfectly Factorized Accelerator Mappings
comment: 7 pages, 6 figures. Accepted for publication in ASP-DAC 2027
summary: The efficiency of Deep Neural Network (DNN) accelerators depends on how each tensor operation is mapped onto the hardware. A mapping specifies how the computation is tiled across the memory hierarchy, ordered, and parallelized across the processing elements. These choices form a combinatorially large search space, where efficient mappings are hard to find. Most violate hardware constraints, and most remaining mappings underutilize the hardware. Existing mappers either search only part of this space to keep the search tractable, excluding the most efficient mappings, or sample the full space randomly, so most mappings they evaluate are infeasible. We present IMPACT, a mapper that searches the full space. IMPACT pairs a genetic algorithm with a constraint-aware repair operator that converts each infeasible mapping into a feasible one instead of discarding it. On a flexible accelerator, IMPACT outperforms state-of-the-art mappers in EDP, latency, and energy on every DeepBench workload. On a compute-in-memory (CIM) accelerator, whose constraints leave few mappings feasible, it reduces EDP by 66%, latency by 47%, and energy by 18% over the strongest prior mapper across five networks, and rivals hand-crafted expert mappings. Across flexible and highly constrained accelerators, IMPACT finds efficient mappings automatically. IMPACT will be released as open source.

AI.tldr: IMPACT：用遗传算法+约束感知修复算子搜索DNN加速器映射的完整空间，在通用与CIM加速器上均优于SOTA映射器。
AI.motivation: DNN加速器的效率取决于张量运算到硬件的映射（tiling、顺序、并行），其组合搜索空间巨大；大多数映射违反硬件约束，剩余映射多数硬件利用率低。现有映射器要么只搜索部分空间（排除最优映射），要么随机采样全空间（大量不可行评估）。
AI.method: 提出IMPACT映射器，搜索完整映射空间：将遗传算法与约束感知修复算子（constraint-aware repair operator）结合，把每个不可行映射修复为可行映射而非直接丢弃。
AI.result: 在灵活加速器上，于所有DeepBench工作负载在EDP、延迟、能耗上均优于SOTA；在约束严苛、可行映射极少的CIM加速器上，跨五个网络相比最强先前映射器降低EDP 66%、延迟47%、能耗18%，并可媲美手工专家映射。
AI.conclusion: IMPACT能在灵活与高度受限的加速器上自动找到高效映射，并将开源发布。

title: Engineering Canalized Near-Field Radiative Heat Transfer between Fixed Nanoparticles with Twisted $α$-MoO$_3$ Trilayers
summary: Canalized phonon polaritons in twisted van der Waals crystals offer a route to control nanoscale thermal energy flow. Building on the established twisted $α$-MoO$_3$ trilayer platform, we examine how internal twist angles modify near-field radiative heat transfer (NFRHT) between a prescribed nanoparticle pair while both the nanoparticle axis and the bottom-layer crystallographic orientation remain fixed. Under this constraint and at equal total $α$-MoO$_3$ thickness, the optimized trilayer reaches 2.84 times the bilayer maximum radiative power, while its mean power over the sampled internal twist configurations is 1.51 times the bilayer value. The second internal twist coordinate also enlarges the set of configurations supporting strong transfer, with local angular tolerance when either internal angle is varied separately. Momentum-space Green-tensor diagnostics and real-space energy-density maps associate the enhancement with stronger receiver-directed scattering and improved channel alignment. Selected trilayer configurations retain enhanced coupling across the sampled family of nanoparticle resonances and at long distances. These results quantify the additional internal configurational freedom available for engineering radiative heat transfer under a fixed laboratory-frame geometry.

AI.tldr: 在固定纳米颗粒轴线与底层晶向的约束下，研究扭转α-MoO₃三层膜的内部扭转角如何调控近场辐射热传递；优化构型辐射功率达双层最大值的2.84倍，平均为1.51倍。
AI.motivation: 扭转范德华晶体中的沟道化声子极化激元为纳米尺度热流调控提供途径，但既有工作基于固定的双层/三层平台，未厘清在固定实验室坐标系几何下，内部扭转角这一额外构型自由度对近场辐射热传递的定量贡献。
AI.method: 以扭转α-MoO₃三层膜为平台，固定纳米颗粒对轴线与底层晶向，扫描内部两个扭转角；在等总厚度条件下与双层对照，统计采样构型的辐射功率分布与角容忍度；结合动量空间格林张量诊断与实空间能量密度图分析散射方向性与沟道对齐。
AI.result: 等总厚度下三层最优辐射功率为双层最大值的2.84倍，内部扭转构型平均功率为双层的1.51倍；第二内部扭转坐标扩大了强传递构型集合，单独改变任一内部角时存在局部角容忍；增强源于更强的朝向接收端散射与更优沟道对齐；优选构型在多种颗粒共振与长距离下保持增强耦合。
AI.conclusion: 内部扭转构型为固定宏观几何下工程化近场辐射热传递提供了额外的可调自由度，可提升峰值与平均传递强度并放宽角度容差。

title: Supervised Fine-Tuning for Reasoning Large Language Models: A Survey
summary: Large reasoning models have recently demonstrated remarkable capabilities in solving complex tasks, where supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on long chain-of-thought data serves as a crucial foundation for eliciting and enhancing their reasoning abilities. Despite rapid progress in both improving and analyzing reasoning-oriented SFT, the field still lacks a systematic survey that consolidates its fast-growing literature. To fill this gap, we present a comprehensive review of recent advancements in reasoning SFT, examining the literature through the dual lenses of methodological design and analytical investigation. First, we review methodological improvements across the SFT pipeline and categorize them into data-centric approaches and algorithm-centric innovations. Second, we reorganize analytical studies along three dimensions: data characteristics, optimization dynamics, and mechanistic insights. Finally, by synthesizing current research focuses and remaining bottlenecks, we outline promising future directions for reasoning SFT. We hope this survey deepens the understanding of reasoning SFT and paves the way for advanced reasoning models.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于长思维链监督微调（reasoning SFT）的系统性综述，从方法论设计与分析性研究两个视角梳理文献，并总结未来方向。
AI.motivation: 推理导向的SFT文献快速增长，但缺乏系统综述来整合相关进展，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 以"方法论设计"与"分析性探究"双视角组织文献：方法论上分为数据为中心与算法为中心的创新；分析性研究沿数据特性、优化动力学、机制性洞见三个维度重组。
AI.result: 构建了覆盖SFT流程各环节的分类框架，并将分析性研究归纳为数据特性、优化动力学与机制性洞见三大维度。
AI.conclusion: 通过综合当前研究热点与尚存瓶颈，提出推理SFT的未来方向，以深化对该领域的理解并推动先进推理模型的发展。

title: Anisotropic Trust Region Warping for Prior-Data Fitted Networks in Bayesian Optimisation
comment: Accepted at the 2026 NeurIPS Workshop on Optimization for Machine Learning (OPT). 18 pages, 12 figures
summary: Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) replace the hyperparameter refitting of Gaussian Process (GP) surrogates in Bayesian optimisation with a single forward pass, at the cost of a prior that is fixed at meta-training time. We show empirically that a PFN's predictive log-likelihood falls increasingly behind that of a refitted GP as the objective function's lengthscale grows beyond the mode of the PFN's meta-training prior, and that this deficit carries over to optimisation performance. To correct the mismatch without retraining the network, we introduce Anisotropic Trust Region (ATR) warping. Per-dimension lengthscales are estimated by kernel target alignment, and an affine rescaling of the input space maps the objective onto the lengthscale the PFN expects, with a trust region around the anchor determining which observations are retained, leaving the PFN's $\mathcal{O}(d \cdot N^2)$ inference cost unchanged. On functions drawn from a Matérn-3/2 kernel, ATR warping improves optimisation performance of the PFN at both extremes of the lengthscale range. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/youngers2006/Trust-Region-Warping-For-PFNs.

AI.tldr: PFN在元训练先验之外的长度尺度上会出现预测与优化性能退化，作者提出无需重训练的各向异性信赖域（ATR）warping，通过核目标对齐估计各维长度尺度并对输入空间做仿射缩放，在Matérn-3/2函数上改善两端长度尺度下的优化表现。
AI.motivation: PFN用单次前向替代GP代理模型在贝叶斯优化中的超参数重拟合，但代价是先验在元训练时被固定。随着目标函数长度尺度偏离PFN元训练先验的众数，PFN的预测对数似然逐渐落后于重拟合的GP，且该缺陷会传导到优化性能上。
AI.method: 提出Anisotropic Trust Region (ATR) warping：用核目标对齐（kernel target alignment）估计逐维长度尺度；对输入空间做仿射重缩放，把目标映射到PFN期望的长度尺度；以锚点为中心的信赖域决定保留哪些观测。该方法无需重训练网络，且不改变PFN的O(d·N²)推断成本。
AI.result: 在从Matérn-3/2核采样的函数上，ATR warping在长度尺度范围的两个极端都提升了PFN的优化性能。
AI.conclusion: ATR warping以低成本的后处理方式校正了PFN元训练先验与目标长度尺度之间的失配，无需重训练即可恢复优化性能；代码已公开。

title: Intersectional Invariant Learning for Fair Deepfake Detection
summary: Deepfake detection models achieve high overall accuracy but exhibit large performance disparities across demographic groups, causing some groups to experience substantially higher false-positive rates than others. Existing fairness-aware methods address this by constraining model outputs to equalize group predictions, but do not tackle the underlying feature-level bias. As a result, models may still rely on demographic characteristics, such as skin texture, as indirect cues for detecting manipulated content. To address this problem, we propose Intersectional Invariant Learning (IIL), a framework that improves feature learning rather than only adjusting model outputs. IIL alternates between identifying the most challenging demographic partitions and learning features that remain consistent across those partitions. The framework also includes a false-positive-rate fairness objective and group-balanced sampling across six gender x skin-tone intersectional groups. We evaluate IIL on a large-scale fairness benchmark containing over one million images, 10 baseline detectors, and 21 fairness and utility metrics. Results show that IIL achieves Pareto-optimal performance, simultaneously attaining an AUC above 99%, a false-positive rate under 2.5%, and the lowest intersectional fairness disparity (FMEO) among all compared methods. IIL outperforms prior fairness-aware methods on the large majority of the 21 evaluation metrics, while reducing both false-positive rates and intersectional fairness disparities by several-fold compared with the strongest competing method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出交叉性不变学习（IIL）框架，从特征层面而非仅输出层面缓解深度伪造检测中的群体不公平问题，在大规模基准上实现AUC>99%、假阳性率<2.5%及最低的交叉群体公平性差异。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测模型整体准确率高，但不同人口群体间性能差异显著，某些群体假阳性率明显偏高。既有公平性方法仅通过约束模型输出使群体预测均衡，未解决底层特征层面的偏见，模型仍可能利用肤色纹理等人口特征作为检测操纵内容的间接线索。
AI.method: 提出交叉性不变学习（IIL）框架：在识别最具挑战性的人口群体划分与学习跨这些划分保持一致的特征之间交替优化；引入假阳性率公平性目标，并在性别×肤色六个交叉群体上进行群体平衡采样。
AI.result: 在包含超一百万张图像、10个基线检测器和21项公平性与效用指标的大规模公平性基准上评估，IIL取得帕累托最优表现：AUC超过99%，假阳性率低于2.5%，交叉性公平性差异（FMEO）为所有对比方法中最低；在21项指标中的绝大多数上优于既有公平性方法，且相比最强竞争方法将假阳性率和交叉性公平性差异降低数倍。
AI.conclusion: 从特征学习层面处理偏见比仅调整输出更有效，IIL在保证高效用（高AUC、低FPR）的同时显著提升交叉性公平性，为深度伪造检测的公平性提供了新范式。

title: Nonreciprocal coupling enables tunable exceptional-point response in non-Hermitian circuits
summary: Exceptional points (EPs) exhibit characteristic square-root spectral responses to weak perturbations, with response magnitudes governed by configuration-dependent prefactors that are often relatively small. Modulating these prefactor while preserving the exceptional characteristics offers an additional degrees of freedom for engineering non-Hermitian sensing responses. Here, we report a nonreciprocal non-Hermitian circuit system with gyrator-meditated coupling that supports a continuous family of EP configurations. Unlike reciprocal coupling, which typically yields a unique EP configuration for balanced gain and loss, nonreciprocal coupling allows the directional forward and backward coupling strengths to be varied while maintaining their product and thus preserving the EP condition and yielding a library of EPs. This additional freedom enables continuous control of the frequency-splitting magnitude without modifying the square-root characteristic dependence on absolute perturbation strength. We show that the spectral splitting induced by a given absolute resistance perturbation can be enhanced by appropriately adjusting the coupling asymmetry. Theoretical predictions, circuit simulations, and experimental reflection-spectrum measurements consistently confirms this tunable response. Our results establish nonreciprocal coupling as an alternative approach for engineering and enhancing EP-induced perturbative responses without changing their characteristic branch-point scaling.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于回转器介导非互易耦合的非厄米电路系统，可实现EP配置的连续可调族，从而在保持平方根响应特性的前提下连续调控并增强对电阻微扰的频率分裂响应。
AI.motivation: EP对弱微扰呈平方根响应，但响应幅度由依赖构型的较小前因子决定；在保持EP特性的同时调控该前因子，可为非厄米传感响应工程提供额外自由度。
AI.method: 构建含回转器介导非互易耦合的非厄米电路系统；利用非互易耦合可分别改变前向与后向耦合强度而保持其乘积不变，从而维持EP条件并形成EP配置库；据此连续调节耦合不对称性以调控频率分裂幅度，并结合理论预测、电路仿真与反射谱实验进行验证。
AI.result: 在保持对绝对微扰强度的平方根依赖不变的前提下，通过调节耦合不对称性可连续控制并增强给定绝对电阻微扰引起的谱分裂；理论、仿真与实验测量结果一致证实该可调响应。
AI.conclusion: 非互易耦合为工程化与增强EP诱导的微扰响应提供了新途径，且不改变其特征分支点标度律。

title: WebAnything: From the Wild Web to Scalable Agent Environments
summary:
Web agents require diverse, executable, and resettable website environments for reproducible training and evaluation. Human-assisted mirrors demand per-site engineering, while generative construction can diverge from specified real websites. Capture-and-replay preserves observations, with interaction coverage constrained by captured content and replay capabilities.
  We present WebAnything, a fully automated framework that reconstructs source-grounded, reusable Web environments from real URLs without per-site manual implementation or repair after initial setup and authorization. An Explorer-Builder collects browser-observable structures, resources, and interaction outcomes; an independent verifier checks frozen candidates and guides local repair or targeted source recapture.
  We construct 244 website artifacts across 14 application domains and 53 categories, supporting 12,984 executed and accepted tasks. Compared with human-assisted WebHarbor, WebAnything achieves higher aggregate scores on three fidelity metrics, with 12 wins, two ties, and no losses in a blind audit. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on 5,856 interaction trajectories improves REAL success by 9.9 percentage points, Odysseys-Easy Rubric Avg and Task Avg by 6.25 and 6.32 percentage points, and WebArena-Verified Overall success by 13.33 percentage points under the fixed harness. Code: https://github.com/china-qijizhifeng/Web-Anything

AI.tldr: WebAnything 是一个全自动框架，可从真实 URL 重建可复用、可重置的网站环境，无需逐站人工实现；构建了 244 个网站工件并支撑 12,984 个任务，保真度盲审 12 胜 2 平 0 负，微调后任务成功率提升最多 13.33 个百分点。
AI.motivation: Web agent 的训练与可复现评测需要多样化、可执行、可重置的网站环境。现有方案各有缺陷：人工辅助镜像需逐站工程投入；生成式构建易偏离指定真实网站；抓取回放则受限于已捕获内容与回放能力，交互覆盖不足。
AI.method: 提出全自动 Explorer-Builder + 独立验证器架构：Explorer-Builder 采集浏览器可观测的结构、资源与交互结果；独立 verifier 校验冻结候选，驱动局部修复或针对性的源站重捕获；初始配置与授权后无需人工逐站实现或修复。
AI.result: 构建 244 个网站工件，覆盖 14 个应用领域、53 个类别，支持 12,984 个被成功执行并通过验收的任务；与人工辅助的 WebHarbor 相比，三项保真度指标总体得分更高，盲审 12 胜 2 平 0 负。基于 5,856 条交互轨迹微调 Qwen3.5-9B，在固定 harness 下 REAL 成功率 +9.9pp，Odysseys-Easy 的 Rubric Avg / Task Avg 分别 +6.25 / +6.32pp，WebArena-Verified 总体成功率 +13.33pp。
AI.conclusion: 自动化的、源站锚定的环境重建能够在不牺牲保真度的前提下替代人工镜像工程，并可作为有效的训练数据来源，显著提升下游 web agent 的表现。

title: Movable Beyond-Diagonal RIS for ISAC: Optimal Placement and Pareto Boundary
summary: This letter investigates integrated sensing and communication using a movable beyond-diagonal reconfigurable intelligent surface (BD-RIS). Under a rank-one line-of-sight BS--RIS channel, we derive the exact communication--sensing Pareto boundary of a fully-connected BD-RIS in terms of user--target channel correlation. For line-of-sight RIS links, maximizing this correlation yields the optimal placement. We characterize the minimum track aperture that eliminates the illumination trade-off and show that a movable diagonal RIS then attains the same optimum. Below this threshold, a dynamic program offers certified placement accuracy. Numerical results examine hardware connectivity, angular mismatch, and Rician fading.

AI.tldr: 该文研究可移动超越对角（BD）RIS 辅助的通感一体化系统，在秩一视距（LoS）基站—RIS 信道下给出全连接 BD-RIS 关于用户—目标信道相关性的精确通信—感知 Pareto 边界，并据此分析最优放置与最小轨迹孔径条件。
AI.motivation: 移动 RIS 可同时改善通信与感知，但在 LoS 主导场景下通信与感知波束存在照射权衡；需明确其性能极限及何时该权衡消失，以指导 RIS 放置与硬件选择。
AI.method: 在秩一 LoS 基站—RIS 信道假设下，以用户—目标信道相关性为变量推导全连接 BD-RIS 的精确通信—感知 Pareto 边界；对 LoS RIS 链路证明最大化该相关性对应最优放置；解析刻画消除照射权衡所需的最小轨迹孔径，并证明超过该阈值后可移动对角 RIS 亦可达到同一最优；阈值以下采用动态规划获得可认证的放置精度。
AI.result: 得到全连接 BD-RIS 的闭式/精确 Pareto 边界；给出相关性最大化即最优放置的结论；给出最小轨迹孔径阈值及对角 RIS 的等价最优性；阈值以下动态规划提供有保证精度的放置方案；数值结果考察了硬件连接方式、角度失配与 Rician 衰落的影响。
AI.conclusion: 可移动 BD-RIS 的通信—感知性能极限由用户—目标信道相关性刻画；足够大的移动轨迹孔径可消除照射权衡，使低成本对角 RIS 达到全连接 BD-RIS 的最优，从而为通感一体化中 RIS 硬件连接与移动范围的设计提供理论依据。

title: Energy-Efficient FPGA Implementation of an End-to-End Cosine-Domain CNN Using High-Level Synthesis
comment: 9 pages, 11 figures. Currently under review at the VLSI Integration Journal
summary: The computational cost of conventional Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) limits their deployment in low-power devices for high-speed edge AI applications. This paper presents an end-to-end cosine-domain CNN (CD-CNN) architecture for energy-efficient FPGA inference using high-level synthesis (HLS). The proposed architecture performs intermediate feature extraction using real-valued DCT-domain representations, avoiding complex-valued arithmetic and intermediate inverse transforms between spectral layers. The design is implemented on a Xilinx Kintex UltraScale+ XCKU5P FPGA and evaluated against a fully spectral Fourier-domain CNN (FD-CNN) under consistent network and implementation constraints. Experiments on the MNIST and 94-class ASCII datasets show that the CD-CNN reduces normalized resource utilization and improves inference throughput on both datasets. Its energy efficiency reaches 112.91 frames/J for MNIST and 101.27 frames/J for ASCII, corresponding to improvements of $1.51\times$ and $2.76\times$, respectively, over the fully spectral FD-CNN architecture. Furthermore, compared to the previous GPU-based fully spectral CD-CNN implementation, the proposed end-to-end FPGA implementation improves energy efficiency by $12.96\times$. These results demonstrate the potential of real-valued spectral processing in the DCT domain for energy-efficient edge AI deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出端到端余弦域CNN（CD-CNN）架构，基于HLS在FPGA上实现高能效推理，中间特征以实数DCT域表示，避免复数运算与频域层间的逆变换。
AI.motivation: 传统CNN计算开销大，难以部署于低功耗设备的高速边缘AI场景；此前全谱傅里叶域CNN（FD-CNN）依赖复数运算与频繁逆变换，能效受限。
AI.method: 采用实数DCT域表示完成中间特征提取，构建端到端CD-CNN；用高层综合（HLS）在Xilinx Kintex UltraScale+ XCKU5P FPGA上实现，并在相同网络与实现约束下与全谱FD-CNN对比，数据集为MNIST与94类ASCII。
AI.result: 两数据集上归一化资源占用降低、推理吞吐提升；能效达MNIST 112.91 frames/J、ASCII 101.27 frames/J，相较全谱FD-CNN分别提升1.51×与2.76×；相较此前GPU版全谱CD-CNN能效提升12.96×。
AI.conclusion: 实数DCT域谱处理在资源、吞吐与能效上优于全谱复数频域方案，适合能效敏感的边缘AI部署。

title: Maxwell's equations are universal for sparse linear algebra
comment: 102 pages (16 pages main text, 86 pages Supplementary Information), 6 figures, 2 tables
summary: Optical and wave-based analog computing has re-emerged as a route to accelerating linear algebra, with metamaterials and photonic circuits shown to invert matrices and solve integral equations. However, it has remained unclear which problems such passive structures can represent, and at what cost, once encoding, precision, conditioning and readout are accounted for. Here, we show that every polynomially conditioned sparse linear system can be compiled into a three-dimensional dielectric -- a cavity filled with lossless, isotropic material of bounded permittivity -- whose time-harmonic response encodes its solution. For $m$ nonzero coefficients, the volume of the structure and the cost of writing it down and reading out the answer scale as $\tilde O(m^{3/2})$, coefficients require only $O(\log m)$ bits, and every field that approximately satisfies Maxwell's equations decodes to an approximate solution. We prove the construction for the continuum equations and give a computer-assisted version for the Yee discretization underlying finite-difference solvers. Read in reverse, it implies that electromagnetic simulation is, up to this overhead, as hard as general sparse linear algebra: a sufficiently fast general-purpose Maxwell solver would yield a faster sparse linear solver.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明任意多项式条件数的稀疏线性系统都可编译为三维介质腔体，其时间谐响应编码解，并给出体积与读写代价的 $\tilde O(m^{3/2})$ 界，反向说明通用麦克斯韦仿真在开销意义下等价于一般稀疏线性代数。
AI.motivation: 光学与波动模拟计算近来被用于加速线性代数（用超材料、光子电路求逆矩阵、解积分方程），但被动结构究竟能表示哪些问题、在计入编码、精度、条件数与读出成本后代价如何，此前尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构造性编译：将稀疏线性系统映射为填充无损、各向同性、介电常数有界材料的三维介质腔体，用其时间谐响应编码解；在连续方程上给出证明，并针对有限差分解法所用的 Yee 离散化给出计算机辅助验证版本。
AI.result: 对 $m$ 个非零系数，结构体积及写入/读出解的成本均为 $\tilde O(m^{3/2})$，系数仅需 $O(\log m)$ 比特；且任何近似满足麦克斯韦方程的场都能解码出近似解。
AI.conclusion: 被动光学结构可表示全部多项式条件数的稀疏线性系统，代价为 $m^{3/2}$ 级；反向推论显示电磁仿真在此开销下与一般稀疏线性代数同等困难——足够快的通用麦克斯韦求解器即可得到更快的稀疏线性求解器。

title: Rank-Aware Differentially Private Release of Listwise Preferences for LLM Alignment
summary: Listwise preference feedback offers richer supervision for large language model (LLMs) alignment than pairwise comparisons, but a full ranking also reveals more sensitive user preferences. Existing privacy-preserving alignment methods focus mainly on pairwise feedback, while listwise alignment under local differential privacy (LDP) remains unexplored. Extending LDP to this listwise domain raises a critical challenge: the high sensitivity of the full ranking space demands excessive noise, neutralizing the benefits of listwise supervision. To address this challenge, we analyze the interaction between supervision granularity and privacy noise in downstream training, and introduce a rank-aware exponential mechanism that privatizes listwise preference data into a low-sensitivity granularity suitable for downstream alignment. The mechanism leverages ranking information to sample a fixed-size binary partition, concentrating the noise near borderline items instead of perturbing all items uniformly as randomized response (RR) does. Empirical evaluations on downstream LLM alignment tasks show that our mechanism consistently outperforms existing LDP baselines at matched privacy budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/tdsai-lab/RAEM.

AI.tldr: 本文将局部差分隐私（LDP）从成对偏好扩展到列表式（listwise）偏好反馈的LLM对齐，提出rank-aware exponential mechanism（RAEM），将完整排序隐私化为低敏感度的定长二元划分，在相同隐私预算下优于现有LDP基线。
AI.motivation: 列表式偏好反馈比成对比较提供更丰富的监督信号，但完整排序也暴露更敏感的用户偏好。现有隐私保护对齐方法主要针对成对反馈，列表式对齐在LDP下尚属空白。直接扩展LDP面临核心难题：完整排序空间敏感度过高，需要注入过多噪声，从而抵消列表式监督的收益。
AI.method: 分析监督粒度与隐私噪声在下游训练中的交互作用；提出rank-aware exponential mechanism（RAEM），利用排序信息采样一个固定大小的二元划分，使噪声集中作用于边界（borderline）项附近，而非像randomized response（RR）那样对所有项均匀扰动，从而把列表式偏好数据隐私化为适合下游对齐的低敏感度粒度。
AI.result: 在下游LLM对齐任务的实证评估中，RAEM在匹配隐私预算下持续优于现有LDP基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过在敏感度与监督粒度之间取得更优权衡，RAEM使列表式偏好在LDP约束下变得可用，为隐私保护的列表式LLM对齐提供了有效方案。

title: Spokes, not a Ring: Revisiting the Weekday Manifold in Language Models
summary: Recent work has hypothesised that large language models may represent some concepts as multi-dimensional manifolds instead of single directions. Using these manifolds to interpret or steer representations often assumes that moving along them corresponds to a continuous change in the represented concept. In this work, we test this continuous manifold assumption on the prototypical weekday manifold. Despite its striking circular geometry, we find that the weekday representations behave more like seven discrete states arranged in a circle than a continuous ring. First, we show that local sensitivity has seven minima aligned with the weekdays, producing a step-like mapping between representation and behaviour under on-manifold steering. Second, we test whether any concepts are represented along the manifold outside the seven discrete states, and find neither time of day, uncertainty, nor natural text populate the intermediate space. Together, these results challenge the continuous interpretation of the weekday manifold and motivate testing whether movement along other representation manifolds correspond to meaningful changes in model representations and behaviour.

AI.tldr: 本文检验"连续流形假设"，发现语言模型中的星期表示更像沿圆周排列的七个离散状态，而非连续圆环。
AI.motivation: 近期研究假设大语言模型可能以多维流形而非单一方向来表示概念，而利用这些流形解释或操控表示时，常默认沿流形移动对应概念的连续变化。作者旨在检验这一"连续流形假设"是否成立。
AI.method: 以典型的星期流形为对象，测量沿流形的局部敏感度，检验表示与行为之间的映射是否连续；并测试时间、不确定性、自然文本等概念是否占据七个离散状态之间的中间空间。
AI.result: 局部敏感度存在与各星期对齐的七个极小值，在流形上操控时表示与行为呈阶梯状映射；中间空间不被时间、不确定性或自然文本占据。
AI.conclusion: 星期表示更接近七个离散状态排成的圆，而非连续圆环，挑战了对星期流形的连续解读，并促使进一步检验其他表示流形上的移动是否对应有意义的表示与行为变化。

title: FYC: FPR-Disparity Weight Perturbation and Youden Calibration for Fair Deepfake Detection
summary: Deepfake detectors routinely achieve high aggregate accuracy while exhibiting substantial demographic disparities in their errors: false-positive rates differ by double digits across gender and skin tone. Most existing remedies require either full retraining with a fairness-aware objective or demographic-annotated training data, both impractical when only a pretrained checkpoint is available, while label-free post-hoc calibrators leave the detector's weights unchanged. We introduce FYC (FPR-disparity Weight Perturbation and Youden Calibration), a two-stage post-hoc method that perturbs a detector's weights under an FPR-disparity criterion, then calibrates a separate decision threshold for each demographic group - requiring no architectural changes and no full retraining. Evaluated against every detector benchmarked on AI-Face v2 across six intersectional gender x skin-tone groups, FYC outperforms the field on 18 of 21 reported fairness and utility metrics, including purpose-built fairness architectures, at a fraction of the training cost. We further identify why the choice of fairness criterion is critical: the original Demographic Parity objective used in prior weight-perturbation work is architecture-dependent and unpredictable, improving two of four evaluated architectures, leaving a third largely unchanged, and substantially degrading the fourth (PG-FDD), with no way to anticipate the outcome for a given checkpoint in advance. Conditioning the same objective on real images only - our FPR-disparity criterion - eliminates this unpredictability, improving fairness and accuracy jointly across all four architectures with no exceptions.

AI.tldr: FYC是一种两阶段事后方法：先在FPR差异准则下扰动检测器权重，再为每个群体单独校准决策阈值，无需改架构或全量重训，在AI-Face v2上18/21指标领先，并证明FPR差异准则比DP准则更稳定可靠。
AI.motivation: 深度伪造检测器总体准确率高，但假阳性率在性别与肤色上存在两位数差距。现有补救需全量重训（公平目标）、需人口统计标注数据，或仅做事后校准而不改权重，在只有预训练checkpoint时都不实用。
AI.method: FYC两阶段后处理：阶段一以FPR差异为准则对检测器权重做扰动；阶段二为每个交叉群体各自校准决策阈值。无需架构修改与全量重训。评估在AI-Face v2的六个性别×肤色交叉组上进行，并与全部已基准测试的检测器对比（含专门公平架构）。
AI.result: 在21项公平性与效用指标中18项优于现有方法，训练成本仅为很小比例。另发现准则选择关键：原DP目标架构依赖且不可预测——四个架构中改善两个，一个基本无变化，PG-FDD显著退化；将同一目标仅以真实图像为条件（即FPR差异准则）后，四个架构公平性与准确率均同步提升，无例外。
AI.conclusion: 事后权重扰动+分组阈值校准可在低成本下显著缓解深度伪造检测的人口统计偏差；公平准则应以真实图像上的FPR差异为条件，以避免DP目标的架构依赖性与不可预测退化。

title: Scattering-force-driven light-sheet fluorescence microscopy for scan-free three-dimensional imaging
summary: Optical manipulation offers a powerful non-contact approach to precise positioning, directional transport and three-dimensional (3D) imaging of microscale objects. However, positional fluctuations during optical confinement introduce spatial sampling errors that compromise imaging quality and acquisition speed. Here, we demonstrate a scattering-force-driven optical manipulation imaging method that replaces the stepwise scanning of conventional optical trapping with continuous directional transport of microparticles. An axial scattering force generated by a low-numerical-aperture focused beam propels microparticles through a light sheet, while their positions and fluorescence signals are simultaneously recorded to establish direct spatial correspondence between particle motion and tomographic images. Experiments demonstrate that this approach reduces the effects of positional fluctuations on 3D imaging, achieving an axial sampling interval of 0.1 μm and an imaging rate of 250 Hz. The method also enables effective imaging of samples with diverse structural features while reducing optical power requirements by 70%. By combining robust spatial sampling, high-speed acquisition and reduced photodamage, this approach offers a promising route to rapid 3D imaging, dynamic observation and microscale spatial analysis of microparticles and biological specimens.

AI.tldr: 提出散射力驱动的光操控成像方法，用连续定向输运替代传统光镊逐步扫描，实现轴向0.1 μm采样间隔与250 Hz成像速率的低光损伤三维成像。
AI.motivation: 光操控可实现微尺度物体的非接触精确定位、定向输运与三维成像，但光束缚过程中颗粒的位置波动会引入空间采样误差，损害成像质量与采集速度。
AI.method: 利用低数值孔径聚焦光束产生的轴向散射力，推动微粒连续穿过光片；同步记录微粒位置与荧光信号，建立颗粒运动与断层图像之间的直接空间对应，从而以连续定向输运取代光镊的逐步扫描。
AI.result: 降低位置波动对三维成像的影响，轴向采样间隔达0.1 μm，成像速率250 Hz；可对具有多样结构特征的样品有效成像，并将光功率需求降低70%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法结合稳健的空间采样、高速采集与较低光损伤，为微粒与生物样本的快速三维成像、动态观测及微尺度空间分析提供了有前景的途径。

title: What Does an Ontology Catch? Curated, LLM-Generated and Data-Derived Ontologies as Checkers of LLM Agents over Knowledge Graphs
summary: LLM agents that answer questions over Web knowledge graphs are increasingly wrapped in checks derived from the graph's ontology, on the assumption that a formal schema makes a reliable judge. Yet a checker can be wrong as well: it can miss errors, and it can flag correct answers and push the agent into "fixing" them. Whether a curated ontology is worth its cost as such a judge, and how it compares with an ontology an LLM writes or a schema mined from the data, is unknown. We make the checker itself the object of study. Across curated, LLM-generated and data-derived ontologies, used as prompt context, as a checker, or both, and across open-weight and proprietary agents on public graphs and a private graph of nearly $10^{9}$ triples, we account for what ontology-derived checks catch and what they wrongly flag. We show how each source trades caught errors against false alarms, how a curated schema used as published can contradict its own data, which errors structural checks miss, and whether combining sources or giving the agent the checker's specific feedback pays off. On UniProt, the curated ontology flags more correct answers than either an ontology derived from the data or one an LLM derives from a summary of the data with masked identifiers. On real agent answers, its flags are only marginally more precise than random flags.

AI.tldr: 论文把"基于本体的检查器"本身作为研究对象，系统评估人工策划、LLM生成、数据挖掘三类本体作为提示上下文或校验器时，在漏检与误报之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: LLM agent 回答 Web 知识图谱问题时，常被套上由本体导出的检查，前提假设是"形式化 schema 即可靠裁判"。但检查器本身也可能漏检错误、误报正确答案并诱导 agent"修复"原本正确的回答；而且精心策划的本体是否值得其成本、与 LLM 编写或数据挖掘的 schema 相比孰优孰劣，尚不清楚。
AI.method: 以检查器为研究对象，横跨三类本体来源（人工策划、LLM生成、数据派生），三种使用方式（仅作提示上下文、仅作检查器、两者兼用），以及开源权重与闭源 agent；在公开图谱与近10^9三元组的私有图谱上，分别统计本体导出检查所捕获的错误与被误报的正确答案，并检验多源组合与向 agent 提供检查器具体反馈是否有收益。以 UniProt 为重点案例，比较人工本体与数据派生本体、以及在掩码标识符的数据摘要上由 LLM 派生本体的表现。
AI.result: 在 UniProt 上，人工策划本体误报的正确答案数量多于数据派生本体和 LLM（基于掩码标识符的数据摘要）派生本体；在真实 agent 回答上，其标记的精度仅略高于随机标记。
AI.conclusion: 形式化本体并不天然是可靠裁判：不同来源的本体在"捕获错误"与"误报"之间存在不同权衡；已发布的人工 schema 可能与其自身数据相矛盾；结构检查会遗漏某些错误；人工本体的检查精度接近随机。因此应把本体检查视为有噪声的信号而非真值裁判，并在部署前量化其漏检与误报。

title: A Parallel Two-Stage Prony Framework for Robust Delay-Doppler Estimation
summary: This paper addresses off-grid physical delay-Doppler parameter estimation based on an orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) pilot waveform over doubly selective channels. Based on a known single-pilot waveform with a frequency-shifted sinc pulse structure, we propose a parallel dual-order estimation framework, in which Prony-based Doppler-first and delay-first procedures are executed concurrently and their candidate paths are jointly fused. The two estimation orders provide complementary resolution characteristics, thereby mitigating ambiguities caused by closely spaced multipath components and fractional delay--Doppler mismatch. Numerical results show that the proposed framework improves detection reliability and estimation stability compared with a single-order Prony estimator, especially in off-grid scenarios and low-to-moderate signal-to-noise ratio regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于OTFS单导频波形的并行双阶Prony估计框架，实现离格时延-多普勒参数估计。
AI.motivation: 双选择信道下离格（off-grid）时延-多普勒参数估计存在分数时延-多普勒失配，单一估计顺序的Prony方法易受近距多径分量影响产生模糊。
AI.method: 基于已知的、具有频移sinc脉冲结构的单导频OTFS波形，构建并行双阶估计框架：Prony-based多普勒优先与时延优先两种流程同时执行，并对候选路径进行联合融合，利用两种估计顺序互补的分辨特性。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，相比单阶Prony估计器，该框架提升了检测可靠性与估计稳定性，在离格场景及中低信噪比条件下尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 并行双阶估计加候选路径融合可有效缓解近距多径与分数时延-多普勒失配引起的模糊，是OTFS离格参数估计的一种有效方案。

title: Learning to Formulate: Agentic Hardware-Software Co-Design of AI Infrastructure through Progressive Optimization and Verification
summary: AI infrastructure, the chips and software that train and serve AI models, is designed in layers. Layers make the system manageable, but they also fix which choices an optimizer can consider. Gains that need the chip and its software to change together are excluded before optimization begins: the formulation leaves them out. Language-model agents make it possible to revisit these boundaries, but an agent's proposal cannot show by itself that a design is correct or optimal. We present Formulaic, a flow that divides the work. The agent writes the formulation, a mathematical solver optimizes within it, and verification and measurement check its assumptions and results. The agent refines the problem step by step, from the computation graph toward the chip. Each step is a template: a family of programs with the conditions under which they are correct. Wall relaxation searches the chip by pricing the hardware limits that bind the software. This paper takes a first step, through separate studies rather than one end-to-end run. On NVIDIA GB10, templates the agent wrote run complete Qwen3-8B layers $1.075\times$ faster than SGLang. In a simulated Ventus GPU study, joint design cuts the worst-scenario cycles of Qwen2.5-0.5B to 0.428 of the reference, against 0.934 for software alone. On a five-step GEMM refinement chain, reusing proofs makes checking $2.51\times$ faster.

AI.tldr: 提出 Formulaic 框架：由 LLM Agent 撰写"模板化"形式化表述，数学求解器在其内寻优，验证与实测校验假设与结果，从而突破 AI 基础设施软硬件分层造成的优化边界。
AI.motivation: AI 基础设施（芯片与软件）按层设计虽便于管理，却固化了优化器可考虑的选项：需要芯片与软件协同变更才能获得的收益在优化开始前就被排除。Agent 虽能重新审视这些边界，但其提案本身无法证明设计的正确性或最优性。
AI.method: 分工式流程：Agent 负责写 formulation（形式化表述），求解器在表述空间内优化，验证与测量环节检验其假设与结果。Agent 从计算图逐步向芯片细化问题，每一步为模板——即带正确性条件的程序族；并用"墙松弛（wall relaxation）"通过对约束软件的硬件上限定价来搜索芯片设计空间。
AI.result: 分项研究而非端到端运行：NVIDIA GB10 上，Agent 编写的模板运行完整 Qwen3-8B 层比 SGLang 快 1.075×；Ventus GPU 仿真研究中，联合设计将 Qwen2.5-0.5B 最差场景周期降至参考的 0.428（仅软件为 0.934）；五步 GEMM 细化链上，复用证明使检查快 2.51×。
AI.conclusion: Agent+求解器+验证的分工可在保持正确性保证的同时打破分层边界、实现软硬件联合设计；当前为初步验证，各部分由独立研究支撑，尚待端到端整合。

title: Volumetric Nanophotonics for Enhanced Scintillation and Remote Light Outcoupling
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures in main text; 30 pages, 11 figures, 4 tables in Supplementary Materials
summary: Nanophotonic patterning is a promising approach to enhancing light extraction in scintillator materials, with the potential to improve performance in applications such as medical imaging and particle detection. While 2D surface patterns have been successful in improving scintillator performance, the true potential of nanophotonic patterning lies in the bulk, where photons are emitted, transported, and absorbed. Here, we experimentally demonstrate the enhancement and control of scintillation using 2.5D volumetric nanophotonic patterns. Using a direct femtosecond laser writing approach, we nanofabricate square lattices of air holes into the bulk of inorganic scintillators (YAG:Ce and YAG:Yb), achieving nearly subwavelength periods compared to the peak emission wavelength and depths up to hundreds of microns, which fill a large fraction of the full thickness of the bulk. Under high-energy excitation, the patterns appear up to ~3.5$\times$ brighter and demonstrate emission enhancement trends consistent with well-established nanophotonic scaling laws. We also report a novel functionality we call "remote outcoupling," in which the nanophotonic patterns emit light that is generated in another region of the scintillator, without being directly excited themselves. Our monolithic nanofabrication approach extends nanophotonic scintillators into the bulk, which is an important step towards total control over scintillation using photonic design.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用飞秒激光直写在内机闪烁体（YAG:Ce、YAG:Yb）体内制备2.5D空气孔方阵，实现近亚波长周期、深达数百微米的光子结构，最高使闪烁亮度提升约3.5倍，并首次演示"远程出耦合"功能，将纳米光子闪烁体设计拓展至体材料内部。
AI.motivation: 现有纳米光子图案化闪烁体多限于二维表面结构，虽能提升光提取效率，但闪烁光子的发射、传输与吸收主要发生在体材料内部，表面图案难以实现全面光子调控。因此需将纳米光子结构引入块体内部以挖掘其真正潜力。
AI.method: 采用飞秒激光直接写入的单片纳米加工方法，在YAG:Ce与YAG:Yb无机闪烁体内部加工空气孔方阵（2.5D体积型结构），周期接近发射峰波长的亚波长量级，深度达数百微米、占据体厚度较大比例；随后在高能激发下测量发光性能，并与既有纳米光子标度律进行对照分析。
AI.result: 图案化区域亮度最高提升约3.5倍，且发射增强趋势与成熟的纳米光子标度律一致；同时观察到"远程出耦合"现象——未被直接激发的纳米结构可发射在闪烁体其他区域产生的光。
AI.conclusion: 单片式体内纳米加工将纳米光子闪烁体从表面推进到块体内部，为实现基于光子学设计的闪烁过程全面调控迈出关键一步。

title: Prompt-agnostic Language Models
comment: Master's thesis, University of Potsdam, Hasso Plattner Institute, 2026, Parts of this work also appear in the EMNLP 2026 paper "Prompt-Robust Language Models: Which Training Strategies Work?" (arXiv:2609.01217)
summary: Despite their strong performance, large language models remain highly sensitive to prompt formulation. This issue is typically addressed at inference-time through manual prompt optimization, which introduces overhead and lacks scalability. Conversely, we focus on train-time approaches that build prompt robustness into the model during instruction tuning. A common strategy is to mix multiple paraphrases of each prompt into training. We demonstrate that across trainable parameters, the per-paraphrasing gradients interfere, with 57% exhibiting sign conflicts and the naive gradient average discarding approximately a fifth of the magnitude. Therefore, we develop two gradient-merging methods, Prompt-TIES and Prompt-DARE, that address this interference by leveraging interference-resolution operators from model and gradient merging and applying them to prompt gradients. In this study, we compare the efficacy of our methods to increase model robustness to train-time robustness methods spanning all three established classes: data construction, consistency regularization, and contrastive alignment. The evaluation is conducted across four models from two families at two scales. We observe the interaction between prompt phrasing and the specific examples accounts for 54% of per-example variability on average, and exceeds 70% on tasks such as ANLI and WiC. The gradient-merging methods directly improve this local robustness and nearly halve per-example variance on fully fine-tuned models at little cost to overall accuracy. The other train-time methods enhance raw performance, but fail to improve per-example variance reliably. Code: https://github.com/FSadrieh/prompt-agnostic-llms. Model checkpoints: https://huggingface.co/prompt-agnostic-language-models.

AI.tldr: 提出Prompt-TIES与Prompt-DARE两种梯度合并方法，将提示级梯度中的干扰从训练阶段缓解，从而提升模型对提示改写（paraphrase）的鲁棒性并降低逐样本方差。
AI.motivation: 大模型对提示措辞高度敏感，现有做法多在推理期做人工提示优化，成本高且难以扩展；本文转向训练期，将提示鲁棒性内建于指令微调中。
AI.method: 常规做法是将同一提示的多个改写混入训练，但作者发现各改写梯度相互干扰：57%的梯度出现符号冲突，朴素梯度平均约丢弃五分之一梯度幅值。为此借鉴模型/梯度合并中的干扰消解算子（TIES、DARE），将其作用于提示梯度，形成Prompt-TIES与Prompt-DARE；并与三类训练期鲁棒方法（数据构造、一致性正则、对比对齐）对比，覆盖两个模型家族、两个规模共四个模型。
AI.result: 提示措辞与具体样本的交互平均解释54%的逐样本变异，在ANLI、WiC等任务上超过70%；梯度合并方法直接提升这种局部鲁棒性，在完全微调模型上几乎将逐样本方差减半，且对整体精度损失很小；其他训练期方法提升了原始性能，但未能可靠降低逐样本方差。
AI.conclusion: 提示敏感性问题可在训练期通过梯度级干扰消解有效缓解；梯度合并是提升逐样本鲁棒性的低成本手段，而单纯提升性能的训练期方法并不必然带来提示鲁棒性。

title: Responsible Quantum Machine Learning for Medical Imaging: A Fairness Audit Across Sensitive Subgroups
summary: Quantum machine learning (QML) is increasingly explored for medical classification, yet its behaviour under subgroup-aware fairness criteria remains understudied. We present an empirical fairness audit of classical and quantum classifiers for medical imaging, assuming QML is not inherently fair. Two scenarios are evaluated: dermatological lesions on DDI (sensitive attribute: Fitzpatrick skin type) and chest X-rays on CheXpert-derived data (sensitive attribute: age group). Using ResNet-18 embeddings, we train SVM, MLP, QSVM and QCNN under a baseline and three mitigation settings: differentiable Equalized Odds (EO) regularisation, Gradient Reversal Learning (GRL), and both combined. Foundation models (PanDerm, EVA-X) serve as external references. Quantum classifiers may achieve competitive aggregate performance while still exhibiting subgroup disparities. Since a smaller subgroup AUC gap may stem from degrading the best group rather than improving the worst, each mitigation is also tested against a pre-specified non-inferiority margin relative to its baseline. Under this criterion, several configurations with the smallest disparity, notably QCNN with GRL on DDI, are not clinically acceptable due to loss of global discrimination. On DDI, QSVM with GRL+EO performed best and approached PanDerm in the performance/fairness trade-off; on CheXpert, QCNN with GRL achieved the highest aggregate performance but increased disparity, and EVA-X remained stronger. Fairness effects are model- and dataset-dependent, so QML requires empirical subgroup-aware evaluation. All quantum models run in classical simulation; we claim no quantum advantage.

AI.tldr: 本文对医学影像任务中的经典与量子分类器进行子群公平性审计，提出以"非劣性"标准甄别缓解方法是否真正改善而非整体性能退化，发现量子模型的公平性效应依模型与数据集而异，并不天然公平。
AI.motivation: QML被越来越多用于医学分类，但其在子群公平性准则下的行为缺乏研究；且AUC差距缩小可能源于最优组退化而非最差组改善，仅看差距指标会误判。
AI.method: 基于ResNet-18嵌入，在DDI（敏感属性：Fitzpatrick皮肤分型）与CheXpert衍生数据（敏感属性：年龄组）上训练SVM、MLP、QSVM、QCNN；设置基线及三种缓解（可微Equalized Odds正则、梯度反转GRL、两者组合），并以PanDerm、EVA-X为外部参照；每种缓解相对自身基线检验预设的非劣性边界。
AI.result: 量子分类器可获得有竞争力的总体性能但仍存在子群差异；按非劣性标准，若干差异最小的配置（尤以DDI上QCNN+GRL为典型）因全局判别力损失而不具临床可接受性。DDI上QSVM+GRL+EO在性能/公平权衡上最佳并接近PanDerm；CheXpert上QCNN+GRL总体性能最高但差异增大，EVA-X仍更强。
AI.conclusion: 公平性效应依赖模型与数据集，QML需经验性的子群感知评估；所有量子模型均在经典模拟下运行，作者不主张量子优势。

title: Venus-DefakerOne2: A Vision-Forensics Foundation Model with Broader Coverage
summary: Real-world forgery is inherently heterogeneous: it manifests not only as digital manipulation but also as physical spoofing, and is carried not only by images but also by videos. Despite substantial progress, a unified anti-forgery foundation model covering such a broad threat spectrum remains absent. In this paper, we present Venus-DefakerOne2, which substantially extends the forensic capability boundary along both the forgery-form and media-type dimensions. Trained on tens of millions of open-source and in-house samples, it incorporates two key designs. Tide-Style-Tuning alternates LoRA and full-parameter fine-tuning to balance computational efficiency, generalization, and hard-sample fitting while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Entropy-based Test Adaptation determines the optimal prediction modality by analyzing prediction entropy. Venus-DefakerOne2 achieves new state-of-the-art performance across a comprehensive suite of benchmarks, including DeepFake faces (96.7%), AI-generated images (93.3%), tampered documents (87.6%), manipulated natural images (89.6%), physical spoofs (93.1%), and AI-generated videos (96.0%). It significantly outperforms both specialized expert models and its predecessor, DefakerOne, establishing itself as a powerful and versatile foundation model for binary-decision forensic tasks.

AI.tldr: Venus-DefakerOne2 是一个统一的反伪造基础模型，同时覆盖数字篡改与物理欺骗两类伪造形态、以及图像与视频两类媒体类型，在六大基准上取得新的 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 真实世界的伪造具有高度异构性：既有数字篡改也有物理欺骗，载体既有图像也有视频。现有工作虽有进展，但仍缺乏覆盖如此广泛威胁谱系的统一反伪造基础模型。
AI.method: 基于数千万开源与自研样本训练，包含两项关键设计：(1) Tide-Style-Tuning，交替使用 LoRA 与全参数微调，在计算效率、泛化性与难样本拟合之间取得平衡，并缓解灾难性遗忘；(2) 基于熵的测试时自适应（Entropy-based Test Adaptation），通过分析预测熵确定最优预测模态。
AI.result: 在完整基准套件上达到新的 SOTA：DeepFake 人脸 96.7%、AI 生成图像 93.3%、篡改文档 87.6%、被操纵的自然图像 89.6%、物理欺骗 93.1%、AI 生成视频 96.0%；显著优于专用专家模型及前代 DefakerOne。
AI.conclusion: Venus-DefakerOne2 将取证能力边界沿伪造形态与媒体类型两个维度显著外扩，可作为二分类取证任务的强大且通用的基础模型。

title: Temporal equivalent of the Sommerfeld half-plane problem
summary: Sommerfeld's half-plane problem, describing diffraction of a monochromatic wave by a semi-infinite perfectly electric conducting (PEC) infinitesimally thin plate, is one of the cornerstones of classical electromagnetic scattering theory. Here we study its temporal analogue: a semi-infinite medium with the Drude dispersion, adjacent to air, whose plasma frequency is rapidly reduced to zero, thus turning it into air, while a monochromatic wave with frequency below the plasma frequency illuminates it under normal incidence. Unlike the PEC plate, the Drude medium supports evanescent penetration of the field prior to its temporal transition; the temporal interface here acts as the analogue of the sharp spatial boundary in the Sommerfeld problem, but now separates two time intervals rather than two spatial half-planes. We show that this transition forces the standing wave in air in front of the Drude medium and the evanescent fields inside it to propagate in both directions, while preserving their spatial field structure. In addition, we observe the excitation of additional electric and magnetic field waves generated by a "DC" current density associated with the time interface. Our findings offer insight into the electromagnetic wave behavior at temporal transitions in dispersive media and may find applications in time- and space-time metamaterials

AI.tldr: 本文将经典Sommerfeld半平面衍射问题推广到时间域：研究Drude色散半无限介质（紧邻空气）在等离子频率瞬时降为零时的电磁响应，揭示时间界面迫使驻波与倏逝场双向传播并保持空间结构，同时激发由"DC"电流密度产生的附加电场波和磁场波。
AI.motivation: Sommerfeld半平面（PEC薄板）问题是经典电磁散射理论的基石，但其时间类比尚未被系统研究。与PEC板不同，Drude介质允许场的倏逝穿透，因而时间界面提供了研究色散介质中时间跃变电磁行为的独特平台，并可服务于时间/时空超材料的设计需求。
AI.method: 构造时间类比模型：半无限Drude色散介质与空气相邻，其等离子频率在某一时刻骤降为零（介质变为空气），同时以低于原等离子频率的单色波垂直入射。以时间界面替代Sommerfeld问题中的尖锐空间边界（分隔两个时间区间而非两个空间半平面），在跃变前后分别求解含倏逝穿透的场分布，并对跃变后的场进行解析分解。
AI.result: 时间跃变迫使Drude介质前方空气中的驻波与介质内部的倏逝场在跃变后沿两个方向传播，同时保持其空间场结构不变；此外，与时间界面相关联的"DC"电流密度激发出附加的电场波和磁场波。
AI.conclusion: 时间界面可作为Sommerfeld空间边界的类比，但表现出色散介质特有的物理特征（倏逝穿透与DC电流源激发）。研究结果为色散介质中时间跃变处的电磁波行为提供了新认识，并可能应用于时间超材料和时空超材料。

title: Measuring Where Intent Gets Lost in Agentic Smart Contract Synthesis
comment: ACM TheWebConf2027 8 pages main content 4 pages appendix
summary:
AI agents can now write software from a plain-English description, but code that runs is not the same as code that does what was asked. This gap matters most for smart contracts, the programs behind Web3 applications that move money on a blockchain and cannot be fixed once deployed. We ask how to check whether an AI-written contract behaves as it should, and where the requested behavior gets lost.
  We design an evaluation built on execution rather than opinion. We replay the same transactions on an AI-written contract and on the original it should reproduce and measure how often they agree. We test every grading tool on planted mistakes, compare against an answer key written without the description, and audit our own scorer until known wrong answers cannot pass. Common methods, such as AI judges and standard analysis tools, miss obvious mistakes, and scoring choices matter too. Checking only the functions every system includes hid about half the difference between pipelines.
  We then propose an elicitation-first architecture. Before writing code, the agent asks the client a short checklist of questions, checks the contract against an independently written executable answer key, and returns disagreements to the client instead of silently rewriting code. Asking first matters far more than reviewing or patching afterwards, across three AI models, while automated security fixes often break requested behavior. A few well-chosen questions recover much of what a short description omits, and their value can be estimated without the original contract. To our knowledge, this is the first study in smart contract synthesis to gather missing requirements before generation and check the result against an independently written executable model. The lessons extend to any setting where AI agents turn requests into programs. We release our tools, 600 tasks and all results.

AI.tldr: 提出以执行而非主观判断为核心的智能合约合成评测方法，发现常见评分手段漏检明显错误，并证明"先问需求"（elicitation-first）架构远比事后审查或修补更能保留客户意图。
AI.motivation: AI智能体可依自然语言生成可运行代码，但"能跑"不等于"符合需求"。该差距在部署后不可修改、直接转移资金的Web3智能合约上最致命，因此需要可验证AI所写合约是否按需求行事，并定位需求在何处丢失。
AI.method: 基于执行的评测：在AI生成合约与应复现的原始合约上重放相同交易，统计二者行为一致率；用植入错误检验各评分工具，与"不看描述"独立编写的答案键对比，并审计评分器直至已知错误无法通过。随后提出elicitation-first架构：写码前让智能体按简短清单向客户提问，将合约与独立编写的可执行答案键比对，把分歧返回客户而非静默改写。跨三个模型验证，并考察自动化安全修复对需求行为的影响。
AI.result: AI裁判与标准分析工具会漏掉明显错误，评分口径选择影响结论；只检查所有系统共有的函数会掩盖约一半的流水线差异。先提问的效果显著优于事后审查或打补丁，跨三种模型一致；自动化安全修复常破坏需求行为；少量精心设计的问题即可挽回简短描述所遗漏的大部分需求，且其价值可在没有原始合约的情况下估计。
AI.conclusion: 本研究首次在智能合约合成中于生成前收集缺失需求，并用独立编写的可执行模型校验结果；结论可推广到任何由AI智能体将请求转化为程序的场景。公开工具、600个任务及全部结果。

title: pCoRev: Physics-Informed Contrastive Learning for Unsupervised Reverberation Artifact Suppression in Ultrafast Plane-Wave Imaging
summary: Reverberation artifact suppression in ultrafast plane-wave (PW) imaging remains challenging because artifact-free reference data are generally unavailable and multipath echoes often resemble tissue signals. Coherent plane-wave compounding (CPWC) attenuates reverberation only partially and sacrifices the frame rate that motivates PW imaging. We propose pCoRev, an unsupervised physics-informed contrastive learning framework that leverages the distinct angular coherence characteristics of tissue echoes and reverberation artifacts. A single-angle I/Q frame is the network input, and the remaining angles of the same CPWC acquisition provide angle-consistent positive pairs, residual-derived negative pairs, and coherence-guided self-supervision, so no paired artifact-free data are required. On a fabricated reverberation phantom with 31 validation acquisitions, pCoRev achieved the best contrast ratio (CR), contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR), and generalized CNR (gCNR) of 38.76 +/- 5.40 dB, 11.75 +/- 1.81 dB, and 0.932 +/- 0.051 against delay-and-sum (DAS), delay-multiply-and-sum, a supervised 3D convolutional neural network, and unsupervised deep coherence learning. Because the network is trained on single-angle inputs, it also operates on a single PW transmission: with one angle, pCoRev reached a CR of 32.10 +/- 7.79 dB and a CNR of 10.39 +/- 3.02 dB, exceeding 75-angle compounded DAS (20.45 +/- 3.84 dB and 8.38 +/- 2.00 dB) with 75-fold fewer transmissions. On four clinical acquisitions from other scanners, pCoRev improved CR over DAS by 9 to 21 dB without fine-tuning. These results indicate that physics-informed unsupervised contrastive learning suppresses reverberation effectively while preserving the frame-rate advantage of ultrafast PW imaging.

AI.tldr: 提出无监督物理引导对比学习框架 pCoRev，利用组织回声与混响伪影的角度相干性差异，在无成对无伪影参考数据条件下抑制超快平面波成像中的混响，单角度传输即超越75角度复合DAS且具跨设备泛化性。
AI.motivation: 超快平面波（PW）成像中的混响伪影抑制困难：缺乏无伪影参考数据，多径回声与组织信号相似；相干平面波复合（CPWC）仅部分衰减混响且牺牲PW成像所追求的帧率。
AI.method: pCoRev：无监督物理引导对比学习框架。以单角度I/Q帧为网络输入，利用同一CPWC采集的其余角度构造角度一致正样本对、残差衍生负样本对及相干性引导自监督信号；依据组织回声与混响伪影的角度相干性差异设计，无需成对无伪影数据。
AI.result: 在含31次验证采集的混响体模上，相对DAS、DMAS、监督式3D CNN及无监督深度相干学习取得最佳CR（38.76±5.40 dB）、CNR（11.75±1.81 dB）与gCNR（0.932±0.051）；单角度传输下CR 32.10±7.79 dB、CNR 10.39±3.02 dB，优于75角度复合DAS（20.45±3.84 dB、8.38±2.00 dB），传输次数减少75倍；在来自其他扫描仪的4例临床采集中无需微调即将CR较DAS提升9–21 dB。
AI.conclusion: 物理引导的无监督对比学习可有效抑制混响，同时保留超快PW成像的帧率优势，并具备跨扫描仪的泛化能力。

title: OPERA: OPamp Design by an Expert-Taught Reasoning Agent, from Specifications to Layout
summary: Analog flows from specifications to a signed-off layout rarely run without manual iteration. Recent large language model (LLM) agents size circuits with optimizer loops over the device dimensions and stop at the schematic. We present OPERA (OPamp design by an Expert-taught Reasoning Agent), in which a general-purpose LLM agent designs CMOS opamps from specifications to post-layout sign-off with open-source tools. First, the designer teaches the agent the gm/ID method: map the specifications to transconductances and minimum currents, choose gm/ID per device role from characterized lookup tables, and size from equations, leaving a few knobs to search and an explainable design. Second, the agent learns the gLayout framework and taught layout practice, and writes a reusable layout generator that closes the layout and extraction loop at designer-approved gates. In SKY130, the agent designed a shared constant-gm bias and six opamps (5T, folded-cascode and telescopic OTAs; Miller, folded-cascode and telescopic two-stage) for fun >= 50 MHz, PM >= 60 degrees, SR 25 V/μs into 1 pF and a minimum dc gain of 30 to 60 dB. All six layouts are DRC-clean and LVS-matched, and their extracted netlists meet every target at all 15 PVT corners ( fun >= 53.7 MHz, PM >= 62.1 degrees, SR >= 27.9 V/μs). The benchmark netlists are released at https://github.com/AMPICLab/AMPICBench.

AI.tldr: 提出 OPERA：让通用 LLM 智能体在开源工具链下完成 CMOS 运放从规格到后仿签核的全流程设计，在 SKY130 上生成的 6 种运放全部 DRC/LVS 通过并通过 15 个 PVT 角。
AI.motivation: 模拟电路从规格到签核布图极少能免于人工迭代；现有 LLM 智能体仅用优化器循环对器件尺寸做搜索并止步于原理图，未覆盖版图与提取闭环。
AI.method: 分两阶段"专家示教"：① 教给智能体 gm/ID 方法学——将规格映射为跨导与最小电流，按器件角色从特性化查找表选取 gm/ID，用方程定尺寸，仅保留少量可搜索旋钮，得到可解释设计；② 教给智能体 gLayout 框架与版图实践经验，使其编写可复用的版图生成器，在设计师设定的检查闸口处闭合版图与寄生提取回路。
AI.result: 在 SKY130 下设计共享 constant-gm 偏置及 6 个运放（5T、折叠共源共栅、套筒式 OTA；Miller、折叠共源共栅、套筒式两级），目标为 fun≥50 MHz、PM≥60°、SR 25 V/μs（1 pF 负载）、最低直流增益 30–60 dB。全部 6 个版图 DRC 干净、LVS 匹配，提取网表在全部 15 个 PVT 角满足指标（fun≥53.7 MHz、PM≥62.1°、SR≥27.9 V/μs）。
AI.conclusion: 以 gm/ID 专家知识与可复用版图生成器相结合，通用 LLM 智能体可自主完成模拟运放的规格到后仿签核设计；基准网表已开源发布（AMPICBench）。

title: An Introduction to Large Language Models for Scientists and Professionals
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have rapidly become important tools for science, education, medicine, and professional work. Despite their apparent simplicity from the user's perspective, effective and responsible use requires an understanding of how these systems work, what their limitations are, and how their outputs should be evaluated. I wrote this document as a basis for my lecture on LLM in the master in artificial intelligence in medicine at the university of Turin, Italy. This book provides a practical and accessible introduction to LLMs for scientists and professionals. It explains the fundamental ideas behind tokenisation, embeddings, training, inference, context windows, prompting, and instruction hierarchies, while deliberately avoiding mathematical detail. Particular attention is given to the limitations of LLM-generated answers, including hallucinations, uncertainty, reproducibility, bias, and the need for systematic verification and human oversight. The book also discusses privacy, governance, security, and the responsible handling of personal and sensitive information. More advanced topics include Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), retrieval quality, chunking, embeddings, vector search, agents, tools, and workflows. A substantial practical exercise guides the reader through running a local LLM with Ollama and Open WebUI and using it to interact with a collection of scientific papers. The exercise emphasizes evidence retrieval, source verification, uncertainty, disagreement between studies, and the distinction between plausible language and scientifically supported conclusions. No programming knowledge is required.

AI.tldr: 该文档是一本面向科学家与专业人士的大语言模型（LLM）实用入门读物，源自都灵大学人工智能医学硕士课程讲义，以非数学化方式讲解LLM原理、局限与负责任使用，并配有基于Ollama与Open WebUI的本地实践练习。
AI.motivation: LLM已成为科学、教育、医学与专业工作的重要工具，但从用户视角看似简单，实际有效且负责任地使用需要理解其工作机制、局限性及输出评估方式，因此需要一份易获取的实用导引。
AI.method: 以概念性、非数学化的方式介绍token化、嵌入、训练、推理、上下文窗口、提示工程与指令层级；重点讨论幻觉、不确定性、可复现性、偏见及系统化验证与人工监督；涵盖隐私、治理、安全与敏感信息处理；进阶内容涉及检索增强生成（RAG）、检索质量、分块、向量搜索、智能体、工具与工作流；并提供使用Ollama与Open WebUI运行本地LLM的实践练习。
AI.result: 作者构建了一套完整教学材料，包含原理讲解、风险与治理讨论及实践流程；实践环节让读者用本地LLM与科学论文集合交互，训练证据检索、来源核验、不确定性评估、研究结论分歧识别，以及区分"语言上合理"与"科学上受支持"的结论。
AI.conclusion: 该文档为无编程基础的科学家与专业人士提供了可操作的LLM素养框架，强调验证、透明与人机协同，可作为医学AI等领域的教学与负责任使用参考。

title: Learning Without Clocks: Partition-Invariant Neural Network
summary: Event cameras, spiking cochleas and similar sensors emit asynchronous events, yet most learning systems first bin them into frames or packets, so the output depends on how the stream was sliced. Networks whose state is updated exactly at every event and evolves in closed form between events are invariant to this slicing. We ask what more makes the output (i) independent of the processing order of simultaneous events and (ii) continuous in the time stamps, even when two events cross in time, while (iii) staying sensitive to temporal order. For arbitrary nonlinear event models we prove that (i) and (ii) are each equivalent to pairwise commutation of the event updates, and that once updates commute, all order dependence comes from their non-commutation with the inter-event dynamics and vanishes linearly in the time lag. This identifies a class of time-mediated non-commutative (TM) models and yields a resolution-robustness bound for any model. We construct the minimal TM layer, a learnable, provably Lipschitz generalization of the Hassenstein-Reichardt correlator; prove that no single additive layer can uniformly represent ordered pair interactions, whereas a three-dimensional TM state can; show that each TM layer adds two levels of temporal nesting versus one for additive layers; and give a single-layer higher-order construction (TM-k) and a stacking rule preserving all three properties. We instantiate these results as the Clock-Free Event (CFE) layer, linear in the number of events, give a topology-free variant for temporal point processes with closed-form likelihoods, and specify a preregistered clock-robustness protocol with a physical-time threat model for spike-retiming attacks. In preliminary development-set experiments, the TM state beats an otherwise identical additive state by 3.5-9.1 points on DVS128 Gesture and by 24.5 and 30.6 points on SHD and Speech Commands.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究事件相机、脉冲耳蜗等异步事件流的学习系统，提出时间介导的非交换（TM）模型类，并实例化为无时钟事件（CFE）层，实现切片不变、顺序无关、时间连续且保持时间敏感性。
AI.motivation: 现有学习系统多将异步事件分帧/打包，导致输出依赖流的切片方式；需明确使输出（i）与同时事件处理顺序无关、（ii）对时间戳连续（即使事件时间交叉）、（iii）仍对时间顺序敏感所需的条件。
AI.method: 证明对任意非线性事件模型，(i)(ii)均等价于事件更新的两两交换性；交换后序依赖仅来自其与事件间动力学的非交换性并随时间滞后线性消失；据此界定TM模型类并给出分辨率鲁棒性界。构造最小TM层——Hassenstein-Reichardt相关器的可学习Lipschitz推广；证明单加性层无法一致表示有序对交互，而三维TM状态可以；每层TM增加两级时间嵌套（加性层为一级）；给出高阶构造TM-k与保持三性质的堆叠规则；实例化为线性复杂度CFE层，并给出无拓扑变体（闭合似然）及预注册的时钟鲁棒性协议与尖峰重定时威胁模型。
AI.result: 开发集初步实验中，TM状态在DVS128 Gesture上比相同加性状态高3.5–9.1点，在SHD和Speech Commands上分别高24.5和30.6点。
AI.conclusion: 事件更新的两两交换性是顺序无关与时间连续性的充要条件，时间介导的非交换结构可提供更强的有序交互表示能力，且在真实事件数据集上显著优于加性方案。

title: You Don't Need Aligned Representations: Knowledge Distillation via Random Prototype Spaces
comment: To appear at NeurIPS 2026. 10 pages main text plus appendices. Code: https://github.com/HamzaEtcibasi/RPKD
summary: A widely held assumption in knowledge distillation is that teacher and student representations must occupy a compatible or explicitly aligned feature space. We propose RPKD (Random Prototype Knowledge Distillation), which discards this assumption by comparing both networks against a shared bank of randomly initialized, frozen prototype vectors. Alignment is therefore carried out in an external reference space rather than in the teacher's native feature coordinates: the teacher side is projected by fixed random maps that carry no trainable parameters, and only the student adapts. Two branches handle the transfer: a logit branch aligning global prototype similarity distributions and a feature branch matching spatially-resolved prototype activation maps. Both operate within the same fixed prototype space, which can be interpreted as a random feature embedding that approximately preserves inter-sample similarity structure, so the prototype bank and the distillation objective stay unchanged across teacher-student pairs while only the input projections are instantiated per architecture. In low-category settings, decoupling the prototype vocabulary from the task label space yields richer supervision than the label space alone, an advantage absent from logit-based methods, whose supervisory signal collapses as class count shrinks. This advantage is especially relevant in real-world scenarios where the label space is typically constrained. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of RPKD, achieving a maximum gain of +7.98% over OFA on CIFAR-100, +12.44% on ImageNet-100, and +1.28% on ImageNet-1K. Source code is available at https://github.com/HamzaEtcibasi/RPKD

AI.tldr: 提出RPKD，放弃师生特征空间需兼容/对齐的假设，改为将师生两侧都投影到一个共享的、随机初始化且冻结的原型空间中做蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 主流知识蒸馏默认教师与学生的表示必须处于兼容或显式对齐的特征空间，这带来架构耦合与对齐设计负担；同时基于logit的方法在类别数很少时监督信号会塌缩，而现实中标签空间往往受限。
AI.method: 构建一个随机初始化并冻结的原型向量库作为外部参考空间。教师侧用无参数的固定随机映射投影，仅学生侧可训练。设计两个分支：logit分支对齐全局原型相似度分布，特征分支匹配空间分辨的原型激活图；两者处于同一固定原型空间，可视为近似保持样本间相似性结构的随机特征嵌入，原型库与蒸馏目标在不同师生对间保持不变，仅按架构实例化输入投影。
AI.result: 实验显示RPKD有效：相对OFA，CIFAR-100最高提升+7.98%，ImageNet-100提升+12.44%，ImageNet-1K提升+1.28%。
AI.conclusion: 将原型词表与任务标签空间解耦，在低类别设置下可提供比标签空间更丰富的监督，这是logit类方法所不具备的优势；RPKD以随机冻结原型空间实现架构无关、可复用的蒸馏目标。

title: Detecting Covert Collusion between AI Agents through Partner-Outsider Positive Listening
summary: AI agents that share a secret convention can coordinate through messages that look innocent, so a monitor that reads only the messages can miss them. We propose a behavioural test: a partner that uses a code reacts to the exact wording of a message, whereas an uninvolved agent placed in its seat does not. Partner--Outsider Positive Listening (PoPLi) is the difference between the two agents in how much their action changes when the message is reworded with its meaning kept, and it is computed after the fact by replaying logged prompts. In a simulated market with five conditions (no collusion, a joint reward with neutral messages, the same with an openly stated intention, a covert first-letter code, and the code with a stated intention), PoPLi is between 0.48 and 0.59 whenever the code is present (95% intervals all above 0.29) and between -0.10 and -0.01 without it. Message-only monitors did not separate the conditions: one reading the speaker's messages answered "no" in all 50 markets, and one reading every seller's messages flagged 9 of 10 markets with no collusion. PoPLi detects the use of a private channel, not collusion as such, and it cannot detect collusion through incentives alone or codes carried by meaning.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅从日志回放即可检验AI智能体是否使用隐蔽暗码的行为测试PoPLi，在模拟市场中能可靠区分有无暗码，而仅读消息的监控器失效。
AI.motivation: 共享秘密约定的AI智能体可通过表面无害的消息串谋，仅阅读消息的监控器可能漏检。因此需要一种不依赖消息语义解读、而基于行为的检测手段。
AI.method: 设计Partner–Outsider Positive Listening（PoPLi）：比较"真正使用暗码的伙伴"与"被置于同一位置但未参与暗码的局外者"在消息仅改写措辞、保持语义不变时各自行动变化幅度之差；通过事后重放记录的提示来计算。构建五条件模拟市场（无串谋、联合奖励+中性消息、同一情形+明示意图、首字母隐码、隐码+明示意图）进行验证，并对比仅消息监控器。
AI.result: 存在隐码时PoPLi介于0.48–0.59（95%区间下限均高于0.29），无隐码时为−0.10至−0.01。仅消息监控器无法区分条件：读发言方消息者在全部50个市场中均判"无"，读所有卖方消息者在无串谋的10个市场中有9个误报。
AI.conclusion: PoPLi检测的是"私密信道的使用"，而非串谋本身；它无法识别仅通过激励或依赖语义载码的串谋，属行为层面的补充性检测工具。

title: Finite-State Uncertainty-Aware Widely-Linear Equalization for Aeronautical GMSK Links
summary: Aeronautical and unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) receivers must equalize doubly selective channels under synchronization uncertainty and limited onboard computation and memory. We propose a finite-state, uncertainty-aware widely-linear (WL) equalization algorithm for Gaussian minimum-shift keying (GMSK) links. The algorithm uses synchronization estimates and their reliability descriptors to select one of a small number of precomputed filters, avoiding repeated online coefficient synthesis. Using a finite-memory Laurent model, we design the stored affine WL filters from conditional physical-state moments. We derive an exact characterization of excess mean-square error (MSE) relative to adaptation to continuous side information, Lloyd-type conditions for finite-state design, local timing--frequency mismatch certificates, and an orthogonal decomposition of design and information losses. On a reference channel at $E_b/N_0=8$~dB under high synchronization-estimation uncertainty, a $16$-state bank reduces pseudo-symbol MSE by $51.9\%$ relative to point-estimate WL time-varying MMSE equalization and by $6.6\%$ relative to posterior-mean (PM) substitution. With identical partitioning, routing, and storage, conditional-moment filters reduce MSE by $10.1\%$ and full-waveform average bit error rate (ABER) by $15.6\%$ relative to representative-state filters. Across $18$ synthetic three-path channels with individually fitted banks, MSE and ABER decrease by $5.3\%$ and $12.9\%$, respectively, relative to PM substitution. The $16$-state receiver stores $2048$ real coefficients. Posterior integration, robustness sweeps, and software timing measurements quantify the tradeoff between equalization accuracy, online computational cost, and bank refresh.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向GMSK链路、有限状态的"不确定性感知"广泛线性(WL)均衡算法：利用同步估计及其可靠性描述符在少量预计算滤波器中选择，避免在线重复综合系数，并以条件物理状态矩设计存储的仿射WL滤波器。
AI.motivation: 航空与无人机接收机需在同步不确定、机载算力与存储受限条件下均衡双选择性信道；逐点估计式WL时变MMSE均衡忽视同步估计不确定性，且在线综合滤波器系数代价高。
AI.method: 基于有限记忆Laurent模型，由条件物理状态矩设计存储的仿射WL滤波器；用同步估计及可靠性描述符路由到小规模预计算滤波器库（16状态）；理论推导相对连续边信息自适应的超额MSE精确刻画、有限状态设计的Lloyd型最优性条件、局部定时—频率失配证书，并将设计损失与信息损失正交分解。
AI.result: 参考信道Eb/N0=8 dB、高同步估计不确定性下，16状态库使伪符号MSE相对点估计WL时变MMSE降低51.9%、相对后验均值(PM)替代降低6.6%；相同划分、路由与存储下，条件矩滤波器较代表状态滤波器MSE降10.1%、全波形ABER降15.6%。18条合成三径信道各自拟合滤波器库时，MSE与ABER相对PM替代分别降5.3%与12.9%。16状态接收机存储2048个实系数。
AI.conclusion: 有限状态、条件矩设计的WL均衡库在存储与在线计算受限下显著提升均衡精度与ABER；后验积分、鲁棒性扫描与软件计时量化了均衡精度、在线计算开销与滤波器库刷新之间的权衡。

title: Energy-Efficient Memristor Accelerator for Depression Detection with a CNN-LSTM Hybrid Model
summary: Early screening of depression requires efficient analysis of audio and speech data, while conventional CPU and GPU platforms incur high latency and energy consumption for CNN-LSTM inference. To address this challenge, we propose a unified resistive RAM (ReRAM) processing-in-memory accelerator for a CNN-LSTM attention workload. The architecture integrates convolutional, recurrent, attention, and multi-layer perceptron (MLP) stages within a crossbar-based framework, reducing intermediate data movement between spatial and temporal branches. CNN operations are mapped through im2col-based vectorization, while LSTM gate computations are reformulated using concatenated input-state vectors and mapped onto ReRAM crossbars. We further provide module-level workload breakdown, parameter sensitivity analysis, and matched-workload context against representative ReRAM/PIM accelerators. Experimental results show 32.1 times and 9.3 times latency reduction over CPU and GPU baselines, respectively, with about 160 times and 140 times energy reduction. Simplified weight-perturbation tests characterize ASLF sensitivity in an untrained pipeline with synthetic spectrogram-shaped inputs. Task-level prediction accuracy and robustness remain to be evaluated.

AI.tldr: 提出一种统一的ReRAM存内计算加速器，将CNN-LSTM-Attention-MLP流水线映射到交叉阵列中，减少空间与时间分支间的数据搬运，相较CPU/GPU实现32.1×/9.3×延迟降低与约160×/140×能耗降低。
AI.motivation: 抑郁症早期筛查需高效分析音频与语音数据，而传统CPU与GPU平台在运行CNN-LSTM推理时延迟高、能耗大，因此需要专用加速方案。
AI.method: 构建基于交叉阵列的统一ReRAM存内计算架构，在单一框架内集成卷积、循环、注意力与MLP阶段；CNN采用im2col向量化映射，LSTM门计算通过拼接输入-状态向量重构并映射到ReRAM交叉阵列；同时给出模块级负载分解、参数敏感性分析及与代表性ReRAM/PIM加速器的同负载对比，并用简化权重扰动实验刻画ASLF敏感性。
AI.result: 相比CPU与GPU基线，延迟分别降低32.1倍与9.3倍，能耗分别降低约160倍与140倍；权重扰动测试反映ASLF敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 该统一ReRAM PIM加速器在CNN-LSTM注意力工作负载上显著优于CPU/GPU，但任务级预测精度与鲁棒性尚待评估，仍需在真实抑郁筛查数据上验证端到端有效性。

title: Spatial-Mode Selection for Local Mineral Absorption Spectroscopy
summary: Absorption-band depth measures the fractional decrease in mineral reflectance below its local continuum. Recovering this feature strength for a small mineral region supports quantitative comparisons between regions, but diffraction mixes its light with the surroundings. Conventional spectral fitting can separate mean contributions; it cannot remove background photon noise already recorded. We develop a quantum-inspired measurement framework that uses spatial-mode demultiplexing (SPADE) to retain the target absorption response while reducing background acceptance before detection. The framework connects finite mineral-region geometry and reference spectra to estimation precision. A loss-dependent design condition identifies when adding SPADE exposure improves on direct imaging (DI) under fixed-response Poisson measurements with unknown scene parameters. Joint inference from initial DI observations and both mode ports estimates target depth together with an unknown, spatially shared background spectrum. In equal-time simulations that include localization uncertainty, alignment time, calibration, and detector costs, this acquisition reduces depth root-mean-square error (RMSE) by 14\%--26\% across five absorption strengths relative to all-pixel DI with the same background freedom. These results use a supplied target feature shape and geometry, with target continuum slope fitted and curvature fixed. The analysis separates optical selectivity from parameter ambiguity and acquisition cost, providing a quantitative basis for spatial-mode receiver design in local mineral spectroscopy.

AI.tldr: 提出量子启发式空间模式解复用（SPADE）测量框架，用于在小矿物区域定量恢复吸收带深度，在等时条件下相比直接成像降低深度估计RMSE 14%–26%。
AI.motivation: 吸收带深度（相对局部连续谱的反射率分数下降）在小尺度矿物区域上的恢复受衍射限制：目标光与周边背景混合，常规光谱拟合只能分离平均贡献量，无法去除已记录到的背景光子噪声。
AI.method: 构建将有限矿物区域几何与参考光谱同估计精度相联系的量子启发测量框架；用空间模式解复用（SPADE）在探测前保留目标吸收响应并压低背景接收；推导损失依赖的设计条件，判定在固定响应泊松测量、场景参数未知时增加SPADE曝光是否优于直接成像（DI）；对初始DI观测与两个模式端口的联合推断，同时估计目标深度和未知的空间共享背景谱；在含定位不确定度、对准时间、定标与探测器成本的等时仿真中评估。
AI.result: 在五种吸收强度下，相对同背景自由度的全像素DI，深度RMSE降低14%–26%；仿真中目标特征形状与几何为给定，连续谱斜率拟合、曲率固定。
AI.conclusion: 该分析将光学选择性与参数模糊性、采集成本相区分，为局部矿物光谱中的空间模式接收器设计提供定量依据。

title: From Geometry to Behavior: How Instruction Exposure Unlocks Latent Rhetorical Directions in LLMs
summary:
Language models do not merely memorize facts; they absorb rhetorical strategies from pretraining data, including the human tendency to reason by analogy. We ask: is this absorbed capability geometrically accessible before any instruction tuning, and what determines whether it can be activated at inference time?
  We extract an "Analogy Vector" from the residual stream via difference-in-means and show it enables steerable explanation style across seven instruction-tuned models (Gemma-2, Llama-3.1, Qwen-2.5; 2B-32B), improving harmonic mean from 3.22 to 3.94 (+22%) for Gemma-2-9B-IT on 300 held-out test prompts. A small human validation study confirms the LLM judge on Analogy Quality.
  Our central finding, from seven matched base-instruct pairs, is a gradient of behavioral accessibility: the analogy direction exists in every base model, but its behavioral accessibility under linear intervention scales continuously with instruction exposure during training. Gemma-2 base models (strict pretraining/IT separation) show flat steering landscapes: present but behaviorally inert. Qwen-2.5 base models (instruction data woven into pretraining) are already partially accessible before any explicit fine-tuning; base-instruct cosine similarity of the analogy vector reaches 0.94-0.97 for Qwen versus 0.37-0.66 for Gemma, providing geometric corroboration of the behavioral gradient. This challenges the binary "base vs instruct" framing: the relevant variable is how much instruction exposure a model has received across its full training pipeline. We position activation steering as a complementary interpretability tool that reveals how instruction exposure organizes rhetorical knowledge in activation space.

AI.tldr: 从残差流中用差值均值法提取"类比向量",证明其可在7个指令微调模型上实现可控的类比式解释风格;核心发现是指令暴露量连续决定该方向的"行为可及性"。
AI.motivation: 语言模型不仅记忆事实,也从预训练数据中吸收修辞策略(如类比推理)。作者想探究:这种能力在指令微调前是否已具备几何可及性,以及什么因素决定它能否在推理时被激活。
AI.method: 用difference-in-means从残差流提取"类比向量",在Gemma-2、Llama-3.1、Qwen-2.5共7个指令微调模型(2B–32B)上做激活引导,并在300条留出测试提示上评估;另对7组base-instruct配对模型比较向量的余弦相似度,并做小规模人工验证LLM评判的类比质量。
AI.result: Gemma-2-9B-IT的调和平均数从3.22提升到3.94(+22%);类比方向存在于所有基座模型中,但其行为可及性随训练中指令暴露量连续变化:Gemma-2基座模型转向景观平坦(存在但行为惰性),Qwen-2.5基座模型在显式微调前已部分可及,base-instruct余弦相似度Qwen达0.94–0.97、Gemma仅0.37–0.66,与行为梯度一致。
AI.conclusion: 挑战"base vs instruct"的二元划分:关键变量是模型在整个训练流程中接收的指令暴露总量。作者将激活引导定位为互补的可解释性工具,用于揭示指令暴露如何在激活空间中组织修辞知识。

title: Learning Lotteries with Minimal Stakeholder Violations from Membership Queries
comment: 31 pages, full version of paper at NeurIPS 2026
summary: An AI developer often has several candidate versions of a system and can deploy a mixture of them, sending each request to a randomly chosen version, as in A/B testing.
