Each stakeholder (e.g., a safety team, a regulator, or a customer with private test data) accepts a mixture exactly when its expected performance (e.g., its rate of harmful replies) meets the stakeholder's own standard, which the developer can learn only by asking whether a proposed mixture is acceptable. We model this as choosing a lottery over $m$ alternatives for $n$ agents, each of whom accepts exactly the lotteries in an unknown halfspace and answers such binary membership queries. While Choo et al. (ICML 2026) sought a lottery that every agent accepts, none may exist when, say, safety and helpfulness requirements conflict, so we minimize the number of rejecting agents. We show that this problem is APX-hard even when all halfspaces are known and all utilities are $0$ or $1$. We then give exact algorithms that run in polynomial time when $m$ is constant, and in quasi-polynomial time when, for a constant $η$, some optimal lottery has no accepting agent within $η$ of its threshold. When only some agents can be queried, optimizing over a uniform sample of agents gives additive and relative guarantees for the whole population, with a sample size that does not depend on $n$, and a linear program gives a polynomial-time method for any $m$. On the other hand, for $m\ge 3$, a deterministic algorithm that queries only $K$ distinct agents cannot guarantee fewer than $n-K$ extra rejections, and this is achievable; in other words, it can guarantee nothing for the agents it does not ask. Small synthetic experiments indicate that our worst-case bounds are conservative on random instances.

AI.tldr: 研究在多个候选系统版本上选择混合分布（lottery）以最小化拒绝代理人数的问题，证明其为APX-hard，并给出参数化精确算法、采样泛化保证及LP多项式时间方法。
AI.motivation: 开发者可将请求随机分发给多个候选版本（如A/B测试），各利益相关方仅在其期望性能满足自身未知标准时接受该混合。先前工作（Choo et al., ICML 2026）要求所有代理均接受，但当安全与有用性要求冲突时可能无解，因此转向最小化被拒绝代理人数。
AI.method: 将问题建模为在m个备选中选lottery、n个代理各自接受某个未知半空间内的lottery并回答二元成员查询；证明即使半空间已知且效用为0/1时问题APX-hard；给出m为常数时的多项式精确算法、以及在最优lottery无代理距阈值η以内（η为常数）时的拟多项式时间算法；对仅部分可查询代理的情形，用均匀采样给出与n无关样本量的加性与相对保证，并给出任意m的多项式时间LP方法；同时分析确定性仅查询K个代理的算法下界。
AI.result: 问题APX-hard（半空间已知、0/1效用亦然）；m常数时多项式可解，η-间隔条件下拟多项式可解；采样法给出加性/相对保证且样本量与n无关；LP对任意m多项式时间；m≥3时确定性查询K个代理无法保证少于n−K个额外拒绝，且该界可达。合成实验显示最坏界在随机实例上偏保守。
AI.conclusion: 在冲突标准下最小化拒绝人数的lottery选择本质上是困难的，但通过参数化（m小、间隔条件）、采样泛化与LP松弛可获得可行保证；对未查询代理的确定性保证存在根本性下界，实践中最坏情形分析较为保守。

title: Meta-Initialization of Implicit Neural Representations to Accelerate Deformable Medical Image Registration
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. English-language author version of a paper presented at GraphiCon 2026, Saint Petersburg, Russia, 22-24 September 2026. Russian-language proceedings forthcoming. Related work updated for this version
summary: Implicit neural representation (INR) methods for deformable medical image registration require the network parameters to be optimized for each new image pair, making adaptation speed a practical limitation. This work investigates whether early adaptation can be accelerated using an initialization learned from a collection of previously solved registration tasks. We examine two schemes: Reptile meta-initialization and STRAINER transfer of the shared component of a coordinate network. KAN-IDIR is used as the base INR displacement-field model. Experiments are conducted on OASIS-1, with 364 consecutive pairs used for training and 49 pairs for test-time adaptation. Registration quality is evaluated using mean Dice and HD95, together with the fraction of voxels with a negative Jacobian determinant at iteration 1500. In the configurations studied, both schemes yield higher Dice and lower HD95 at early iterations than random initialization. Reptile numerically outperforms STRAINER under a small iteration budget, although their pretraining budgets are not matched. As the number of iterations increases, the differences between the schemes shrink. STRAINER pretraining takes 39-40 minutes, compared with 44.98 hours for Reptile.

AI.tldr: 本文研究用元初始化与迁移初始化加速KAN-IDIR隐式神经表示形变配准的早期适应，实验显示两者在早期迭代均优于随机初始化，Reptile数值更优但预训练成本高于STRAINER。
AI.motivation: INR类可变形医学图像配准需对每对新图像重新优化网络参数，适应速度成为实际瓶颈，作者希望借助从历史已解配准任务中学到的初始化来加速早期适应。
AI.method: 以KAN-IDIR作为基础INR位移场模型，比较两种初始化方案：Reptile元初始化，以及STRAINER对坐标网络共享分量的迁移；在OASIS-1上训练364个连续图像对、对49对做测试时适应；以mean Dice、HD95及迭代1500次时负雅可比行列式体素比例评价。
AI.result: 在所研究配置下，两种方案在早期迭代均比随机初始化取得更高Dice与更低HD95；小迭代预算下Reptile数值上优于STRAINER，但两者预训练预算并不匹配；随迭代增加方案间差异缩小。STRAINER预训练耗时39–40分钟，Reptile为44.98小时。
AI.conclusion: 从既往任务学习的初始化可有效加速INR配准的早期适应，Reptile精度略优但计算代价远高，STRAINER在效率上更具优势；二者差距随迭代增加而收敛，预训练预算需在公平条件下进一步比较。

title: Evaluating and improving AI agents for sequencing protocol understanding
summary: Existing scientific-agent benchmarks rarely evaluate whether agents can reconstruct the exact molecular structures and generation workflows specified by sequencing protocols, a capability critical for analyzing customized sequencing assays. We introduce LibStructBench, a document-grounded benchmark for reconstructing sequencing-library structures and molecular workflows. Our experiments show that frontier agents often produce approximately correct reconstructions but remain unreliable at exact reconstruction, particularly in molecular-state representation and workflow connectivity. Switching the underlying language model produced larger average performance differences than switching agent harnesses, with a statistically significant difference only for molecular-state reconstruction. Additional knowledge improved oligo-family recovery in a small pilot without improving mean molecular-workflow scores. Autonomous accumulation of procedural rules and cross-protocol examples showed non-monotonic validation performance and no mean held-out molecular-workflow improvement in the tested trajectory. These findings highlight the need for more controlled and verifiable approaches to scientific reasoning about molecular processes in complex experimental protocols.

AI.tldr: 提出 LibStructBench——一个基于文档的测序文库结构与分子工作流重建基准，用于检验科学智能体能否精确重建测序协议所规定的分子结构与生成流程。
AI.motivation: 现有科学智能体基准很少评估智能体能否重建测序协议所规定的确切分子结构与生成工作流，而这对于分析定制化测序实验至关重要。
AI.method: 构建文档依据型基准 LibStructBench，任务为重建测序文库结构与分子工作流；对前沿智能体进行评测，并对比更换底层语言模型与更换智能体框架的影响；另设小规模试点考察额外知识的作用，以及程序性规则与跨协议示例的自主积累效果。
AI.result: 前沿智能体多能给出近似正确的重建，但在精确重建上不可靠，问题集中在分子状态表示与工作流连接性；更换底层语言模型带来的平均性能差异大于更换智能体框架，且仅在分子状态重建上具统计显著性；额外知识在小试点中提升寡核苷酸家族识别率，但未提升分子工作流平均分；规则与示例的自主积累在验证集上表现非单调，在受测轨迹中未带来留出集分子工作流的平均提升。
AI.conclusion: 当前智能体在复杂实验协议的分子过程科学推理上仍缺乏可靠性，亟需更受控、可验证的方法。

title: Channel State Information-Free Angle Spoofing for Differential Localization Privacy
summary: This paper proposes a channel state information (CSI)-free angle spoofing strategy that remains effective even when the eavesdropper (Eve) uses differential statistics to estimate the location of the transmitter (Alice). Specifically, by designing a precoding matrix, Eve incorrectly estimates the angle differences of departure (ADoDs), thereby spoofing Alice's location. Meanwhile, the trusted user (Bob) can still infer Alice's true location with a modest amount of securely shared side information. Given the channel parameters estimated by Eve from the spoofed channel, the resulting localization bias introduced to the eavesdroppers under the spoofed geometric is analyzed. Eve's bias can be driven to infinity asymptotically in a key parameter of the precoder. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method introduces significant localization errors for Eve. When combined with a prior CSI-free spoofing strategy, further degraded performance is achieved by Eve.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需CSI的角度欺骗策略，通过预编码矩阵操纵窃听者估计的离开角差值，使其定位失效，而可信用户借助少量安全共享边信息仍能获得真实位置。
AI.motivation: 窃听者(Eve)可利用差分统计量估计发射机(Alice)位置，现有CSI-free欺骗策略在该情形下失效，需要一种对差分统计估计依然有效的欺骗方法。
AI.method: 设计预编码矩阵，使Eve错误估计离开角差值(ADoDs)从而被骗定位；Bob通过少量安全共享边信息推断真实位置。在Eve由欺骗信道估计到的信道参数基础上，分析欺骗几何下引入的定位偏差，并证明该偏差随预编码器关键参数渐近趋于无穷。
AI.result: 仿真显示该方法使Eve产生显著定位误差；与已有CSI-free欺骗策略结合后，Eve性能进一步恶化。
AI.conclusion: 所提CSI-free角度欺骗策略对基于差分统计的定位具有鲁棒有效性，可显著误导窃听者定位，同时保障合法用户定位能力。

title: APPlace: Co-Optimizing Device Locations and Access Points for Routing-Aware Analog Placement
comment: Accepted to ASP-DAC 2027. 8 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/bingyang1132/applace
summary: Analog layout automation remains challenging in Analog/Mixed-Signal circuit design, because parasitics and mismatches introduced during layout strongly affect circuit performance. Placement is especially critical among the layout stages, as it constrains the routing solution space and the achievable post-layout performance. Existing analytical placement methods optimize device coordinates under center-based wirelength proxies and leave access point (AP) selection to routing. In analog circuits, however, a routing pin is an extended piece of terminal metal rather than a fixed point, and the best AP on it depends on where the other connected devices are placed, so a coordinate-only placement optimizes for connection points that the router will not use. We present APPlace, a routing-aware analog placement framework that co-optimizes device locations and AP selections during global placement, followed by a legalization stage that preserves the structure established by global placement. Experimental results on four real-world analog benchmarks show that APPlace achieves better overall post-layout performance than representative baselines at comparable layout area. Ablation studies further show that removing AP co-optimization causes up to a 13 dB CMRR loss among the OTA benchmarks and a 23% increase in comparator delay.

AI.tldr: APPlace：在模拟电路全局布局中同时优化器件坐标与接入点（AP）选择的布线感知布局框架，配合保持全局布局结构的合法化阶段。
AI.motivation: 模拟/混合信号电路布局中寄生与失配严重影响性能，而布局阶段又以摆放最为关键。现有解析布局方法基于中心点线长代理仅优化器件坐标，把接入点选择留给布线；但模拟电路中布线引脚是延伸的端子金属而非固定点，最优接入点依赖相邻器件位置，因此纯坐标布局优化的连接点与布线器实际使用的不一致。
AI.method: 提出APPlace布线感知布局框架：1）在全局布局阶段对器件位置与AP选择进行协同优化（co-optimization），使线长评估基于实际可用接入点；2）随后进行合法化阶段，在消除重叠的同时保留全局布局所建立的结构。
AI.result: 在四个真实模拟基准电路上与代表性基线对比，在相当布局面积下取得更优的整体后布局性能；消融实验表明移除AP协同优化后，OTA基准的CMRR最多下降13 dB，比较器延迟增加23%。
AI.conclusion: 模拟布局中AP选择不可后置为布线细节，需与器件摆放联合优化；AP协同优化对后布局性能（如CMRR、延迟）具有显著影响，APPlace为此提供了有效且可控面积的解决方案。

title: Focal-Plane Extreme Adaptive Optics for Deep Super Resolution Imaging and Nanolithography
summary: Super resolution optical imaging and nanolithography enable nanoscale observation and fabrication, but high order, spatially varying phase and amplitude aberrations in optically heterogeneous media severely limit their performance at depth. Here we introduce focal-plane extreme adaptive optics (FP-ExAO), which moves beyond conventional phase conjugate correction by directly sensing and controlling the focal-plane complex field. This terminal field captures aberrations accumulated throughout the optical system. A state space formulation directly links deformable mirror commands to the focal field, avoiding explicit plane by plane Fourier optics modelling, while information theoretically optimal probing and closed-form control enable rapid field estimation and correction. Cascaded deformable mirrors further enable FP-ExAO to correct coupled phase-amplitude and spatially varying aberrations. In three-dimensional (3D) single molecule localization microscopy (SMLM), FP-ExAO enables imaging to 160 um depth in brain tissue and beyond 60 um in kidney tissue, while maintaining approximately 18 nm localization precision across a 75 um x 75 um corrected field, with a 16-fold larger field of view and more than tenfold faster correction than conventional AO methods. These capabilities meet the imaging requirements for 3D deep tissue optical connectome reconstruction and quantitative super resolution pathology. In stimulated emission depletion (STED) nanolithography, FP-ExAO reduces the minimum written linewidth from 251.1 nm without correction to 88.8 nm at a depth of 160 um in photoresist. FP-ExAO establishes a new adaptive optics paradigm for deep nanoscale optical readout and writing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出焦平面极端自适应光学（FP-ExAO），直接传感并控制焦平面复场，实现深介质中超分辨成像与纳米光刻。3D SMLM在脑组织深度达160 μm、肾脏>60 μm，75×75 μm视场内定位精度约18 nm，视场扩大16倍、校正速度提升10倍以上；STED纳米光刻在160 μm深光刻胶中将最细线宽由251.1 nm降至88.8 nm。
AI.motivation: 超分辨成像与纳米光刻需在纳米尺度观测与加工，但光学异质介质中存在高阶、空间变化相位与振幅像差，严重限制深层性能；传统相位共轭式AO难以应对耦合的相位-振幅与空间变化像差。
AI.method: 提出FP-ExAO：不再做相位共轭校正，而是直接感知与控制携带全系统累积像差的焦平面复场；采用状态空间表述直接建立变形镜指令与焦场之间的映射，避免逐面Fourier光学建模；结合信息论最优探测与闭式控制实现快速场估计与校正；级联变形镜用于校正相位-振幅耦合及空间变化像差。
AI.result: 3D SMLM：脑组织成像深度160 μm，肾脏>60 μm；75 μm×75 μm校正视场内定位精度约18 nm，视场较传统AO扩大16倍，校正速度提升10倍以上；STED纳米光刻：160 μm深光刻胶中最细线宽由251.1 nm（未校正）降至88.8 nm。
AI.conclusion: FP-ExAO满足3D深层组织光学连接组重建与定量超分辨病理的成像需求，并为深层纳米尺度光学读出与写入建立了新的自适应光学范式。

title: One Confidence Threshold, Unequal Coverage: Language Gaps in Typed Decision Interfaces and How Translating Inputs Reduces Them
summary: Deployed classifiers often act on a prediction only when its confidence clears a threshold and pass the rest to a person. We ask whether one threshold serves all languages equally on typed decision interfaces, APIs that return a probability for each option of a fixed multiple-choice question. In a confirmatory study with a written analysis plan, three vendors' interfaces classified 1,000 MASSIVE items, each in 51 languages, with a threshold of 0.9. Even when a request is answered correctly in both English and another language, the English version clears the threshold more often, by 8.6-11.7 percentage points on average. Observed coverage, the share of requests handled automatically, is lower than English's in every other language, while the requests the gate handles are rarely wrong. The gap remains when every language is reweighted to the same accuracy, and a standard calibration metric (ECE) does not detect it on one interface. In exploratory analyses, English's coverage stays higher when each language gets its own threshold fitted to the same 5% error target. Translating inputs into English nearly closes the gap at 0.9 but leaves English ahead at that error target. Requests written natively in African languages show a gap in the same direction when English is their human translation. We recommend reporting per-language coverage at the operating threshold.

AI.tldr: 在带类型的决策接口（返回多选题各选项概率的API）上，单一置信阈值0.9并不能对所有语言一视同仁：当请求在英语和其他语言中都被正确回答时，英语版本更容易越过阈值，平均高出8.6–11.7个百分点，且其他所有语言的自动处理覆盖率均低于英语。
AI.motivation: 实际部署的分类器常用置信度阈值决定是否自动作答、否则转人工。作者质疑"一个阈值适用于所有语言"这一隐含假设，检验在多语言多选决策接口上，阈值化自动覆盖率是否存在语言间系统性差异。
AI.method: 预注册的验证性研究（含书面分析计划）：用三家厂商的接口对1,000条MASSIVE条目在51种语言上分类，阈值设为0.9。控制"英文与其他语言均被正确回答"的条件比较越阈率；将各语言重加权至相同准确率；用ECE等标准校准指标检验；探索性分析中为每种语言单独拟合阈值以达到同一5%错误率目标；并考察将输入译为英语、以及以英语为人译参照的非洲本土语言请求。
AI.result: 同等正确条件下，英语越阈率平均高8.6–11.7个百分点；所有其他语言的观测覆盖率均低于英语，而被门控自动处理的请求很少出错。重加权至同准确率后差距仍在；ECE在某接口上未能检测出该差距。即便为每种语言单独拟合阈值以达相同5%错误目标，英语覆盖率仍更高。译为英语在0.9阈值下几乎消除差距，但在同一错误目标下英语仍领先；非洲本土语言请求（英语为其人工译文）呈同向差距。
AI.conclusion: 单一阈值在多语言决策接口上造成系统性的语言不平等（覆盖率差距），且该差距不被准确率对齐或常规校准指标捕捉。建议在运行阈值处按语言分别报告自动覆盖率，以便监测与缓解该类差异。

title: Depth through Recurrence: Towards Ultra-Efficient On-Device ASR
summary: Modern automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems have achieved remarkable accuracy by scaling model depth and capacity, but at the cost of increased memory, energy, and computational demands. On edge devices where ASR is often most needed, such as watches and glasses, deploying such large models is infeasible due to extremely constrained resources. This raises a fundamental question: can we achieve high representational power in deep ASR models without scaling up parameterization? In this work, we revisit the role of depth and identify layer wise representational dynamics, in which most layers learn functionally similar transformations. Motivated by this insight, we propose a block-recurrent ASR architecture that replaces parameterized depth with a small set of recurrent blocks, each consisting of weight-shared layers, thereby preserving effective depth while drastically reducing model size. Through representation-guided grouping and knowledge distillation, block-recurrent models retain the accuracy of large reference models while using an order of magnitude fewer parameters. Across Open ASR Leaderboard benchmarks, a model with only two shared blocks recovers 97.4% of the accuracy of large models on average. The compact backbone further enables efficient on-device personalization through lightweight MoE-LoRA adaptation, allowing user-specific models to match or surpass the accuracy of general-purpose ASR systems with significantly lower inference cost. By reusing weights across recurrent steps, the proposed architecture reduces memory-access overhead and inference energy consumption. Together, these results show that high quality ASR can be achieved without large parameterization, and that structured recurrence provides a principled path towards ultra-compressed, energy-efficient, and personalized speech recognition on the edge.

AI.tldr: 提出块循环（block-recurrent）ASR架构，用少量权重共享的循环块替代参数化深度，在参数量减少一个数量级的前提下保留大型模型的准确率，并支持高效的端侧个性化与低能耗推理。
AI.motivation: 现有ASR靠加深加宽模型提升精度，导致显存、能耗和算力开销大；而在手表、眼镜等资源极度受限的边缘设备上无法部署。核心疑问：能否在不扩大参数化的前提下获得深层ASR模型的高表征能力。
AI.method: 1）重新审视深度作用，发现逐层表征动态：多数层学习的是功能相似的变换，即存在冗余深度；2）用一小组循环块替代参数化深度，每个块由权重共享的层构成，从而在保留有效深度的同时大幅压缩模型规模；3）采用表征引导的分组（representation-guided grouping）与知识蒸馏，使压缩模型对齐大参考模型；4）在紧凑骨干上以轻量MoE-LoRA进行端侧个性化适配。
AI.result: 在Open ASR Leaderboard基准上，仅含两个共享块的模型平均恢复大模型97.4%的准确率，参数量少一个数量级；个性化模型可匹配或超越通用ASR系统且推理成本显著更低；循环步骤间权重复用降低了访存开销与推理能耗。
AI.conclusion: 高质量ASR无需大参数化即可实现；结构化循环为面向边缘的超压缩、高能效、个性化语音识别提供了有原则的路径。

title: Hierarchical Diffusion for Camera-controlled Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: We address the task of long-video, camera-controlled generation from a single image. The dominant autoregressive paradigm suffers from two key limitations: (1) error accumulation over time, as distant frames are conditioned on previously generated outputs rather than ground truth, leading to drift; and (2) ambiguity in how to incorporate camera control. Standard solutions to both--such as self-forcing and conditioning on explicit 6-DOF poses--either incur significant computational overhead or produce drifting scene geometries over time. We propose a simple and lightweight framework that combines autoregressive generation (WanAR) with hierarchical long-context denoising (FixAR). To enforce scene geometry remains consistent with input cameras, we draw from feed-forward novel-view synthesis and reformulate video generation as a warping-and-inpainting problem. To mitigate drift, we introduce a hierarchical denoising strategy in which different stages condition on different temporal histories. Specifically, we first generate frames conditioned on the immediate past, and then refine them using a second denoiser conditioned on a temporally subsampled long-range history to enforce global consistency. This fine-to-coarse scheme enables each generated frame to effectively condition on the full temporal context without incurring a prohibitive cost. Experiments on RealEstate10k and DL3DV demonstrate that WanAR+FixAR outperforms prior methods for camera-controlled long-video generation, producing results that are both temporally stable and consistent with input camera trajectories.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量框架WanAR+FixAR，将单图相机控制长视频生成重构为warping-and-inpainting问题，并用层次化长上下文去噪缓解自回归漂移，在RealEstate10k和DL3DV上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归长视频生成存在两大问题：(1)误差随时间累积，远距离帧条件于已生成输出而非真值，导致漂移；(2)相机控制注入方式存在歧义。已有方案（self-forcing、显式6-DOF位姿条件）或计算开销大，或导致场景几何随时间漂移。
AI.method: 组合自回归生成模型WanAR与层次化长上下文去噪模块FixAR。借鉴前馈新视角合成，将视频生成重构为warping-and-inpainting（扭曲+修复）问题以保证几何与输入相机一致；采用由细到粗的层次去噪：第一阶段条件于紧邻历史生成帧，第二阶段用条件于时间下采样长程历史的去噪器精修，从而在可控成本下利用完整时序上下文。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10k与DL3DV数据集上，WanAR+FixAR优于先前相机控制长视频生成方法，结果在时间上稳定且与输入相机轨迹一致。
AI.conclusion: 通过warping-and-inpainting重构相机控制、并以层次化长上下文去噪抑制漂移，可在低开销下实现几何一致、时序稳定的长视频相机控制生成。

title: Seq@K: Evaluating Language Models Under Sequential Feedback
summary: Language-model agents differ fundamentally from prior intelligent systems in their ability to learn from natural language in context. This capability enables agents to iteratively refine their answers in response to feedback, a prevalent mode of operation in modern agentic workflows. However, the community primarily ranks models by metrics such as Pass@1 or Pass@K, which cannot capture how they utilize feedback on prior attempts. We introduce Seq@K, a natural evaluation protocol that measures whether a model can solve a problem within K sequential attempts, provided feedback after each previous failure. Unlike multi-turn agentic benchmarks that examine long-horizon planning, Seq@K isolates and formalizes the core capability of refinement from feedback. We evaluate Seq@K on a suite of 7 benchmarks and 16 frontier models, and show that Seq@K reveals a materially different model-selection landscape: under Seq@K, (1) model rankings often differ, (2) the Pareto frontiers admit more efficient configurations and (3) the gains from choosing the optimal model configuration can widen or shrink relative to those of Pass@K. We further show that analyzing model trajectories under Seq@K helps characterize iterative refinement behavior, such as the rate at which models address issues raised in feedback, or how rigidly they hold onto their own answers. Finally, we study how the nature of feedback affects models' iterative refinement, showing that practitioners must carefully design and benchmark the feedback loops of iterative agentic systems. Together, these results establish how Seq@K offers a more faithful metric for intelligent systems that typically operate in such feedback loop, and the necessity to consider Seq@K in evaluating models for these systems.

AI.tldr: 提出 Seq@K 评估协议，衡量模型在 K 次顺序尝试中借助每次失败后的反馈解题的能力，并在 7 个基准、16 个前沿模型上表明其揭示了与 Pass@K 显著不同的模型选择格局。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体可在上下文中从自然语言反馈迭代改进答案，这是现代智能体工作流的主流模式；但社区主要用 Pass@1/Pass@K 排名模型，无法刻画模型如何利用先前尝试的反馈。
AI.method: 提出 Seq@K：测量模型在每次失败后获得反馈的前提下，能否在 K 次顺序尝试内解出问题。该协议隔离并形式化了"从反馈中改进"这一核心能力，区别于考察长程规划的多轮智能体基准。在 7 个基准与 16 个前沿模型上进行评估，并分析模型轨迹（如对反馈所提问题的修正率、对自身答案的坚持程度），以及反馈性质的影响。
AI.result: Seq@K 下模型排名常与 Pass@K 不同；帕累托前沿可容纳更高效的配置；最优模型配置带来的收益相对 Pass@K 可能扩大或缩小。轨迹分析可刻画迭代改进行为，并显示反馈的性质显著影响改进效果。
AI.conclusion: Seq@K 为常以反馈闭环运行的智能系统提供了更忠实的指标，评估此类系统的模型时应考虑采用 Seq@K；同时反馈回路需被精心设计与基准化。

title: A Sub-Aperture-Based Ray-Tracing Framework for Near-Field U-MIMO THz Communications
summary: Terahertz (THz) communications are characterized by antennas with large apertures and extended near-field (NF) region, offering the opportunity to develop adaptable beam manipulation strategies, particularly related to ultra-massive MIMO (U-MIMO). While Ray-Tracing (RT) offers an attractive alternative to full-wave methods, conventional ray-based approaches are generally formulated under far-field (FF) assumptions. We propose a technique that extends RT to the NF regime, enabling ray-based NF characterization of transmitting arrays. We model the transmitting array as an antenna aperture and develop a RT framework that partitions the transmitting aperture into sub-apertures emitting FF contributions which can be propagated via geometric optics (GO). We develop a Ray-Launching algorithm based on the proposed framework and assess its beam-reconstruction accuracy against full-wave propagation. The results demonstrate that, through tunable aperture partitioning, the proposed approach can reproduce beam manipulation effects characteristic of NF U-MIMO THz communications using GO ray propagation.

AI.tldr: 提出将射线追踪(RT)扩展到近场(NF)区的方法,将发射阵列视为孔径并划分为多个子孔径,各子孔径按远场近似发射、经几何光学(GO)传播,并开发相应射线发射算法,验证其对NF U-MIMO太赫兹波束调控的重构精度。
AI.motivation: 太赫兹通信天线孔径大、近场区域显著,是U-MIMO波束调控的关键场景;而传统基于射线的RT方法均在远场假设下建立,无法刻画近场波束行为,全波方法计算代价又过高。
AI.method: 将发射阵列建模为天线孔径,构建近场RT框架:把孔径划分成若干子孔径,各子孔径产生远场贡献并通过几何光学(GO)传播;基于该框架开发Ray-Launching算法,并与全波传播结果对比评估波束重构精度。
AI.result: 结果表明,通过可调的孔径划分,该方法能够利用GO射线传播复现出NF U-MIMO太赫兹通信所特有的波束调控效果,波束重构精度得到验证。
AI.conclusion: RT可被有效推广至近场区,为大规模孔径NF U-MIMO太赫兹系统提供了一种兼具精度与效率的射线级波束特性刻画手段。

title: LLM Agent-Based Design of RISC-V CPUs with FPGA-in-the-Loop Evaluation
comment: 5 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE ISCAS 2027. Code and data: https://github.com/kadomoto-lab/llm-cpu-fpga-loop
summary: Long-run RTL simulation of CPU candidates can take hours, while short diagnostic runs may miss performance degradation that emerges later in execution. This evaluation cost can delay design decisions in LLM-agent-based CPU development. We present a development environment in which LLM agents implement CPU candidates on an FPGA and use on-board performance measurements to guide design decisions. We applied it to the human-supervised development of a single-cycle RV32I core into a three-wide out-of-order RV32IM core. The final design reaches 5.61 CoreMark/MHz at 130 MHz on a Artix-7 FPGA. For the same CPU candidate running 8,000 CoreMark iterations, FPGA evaluation, including implementation, was 9.6x faster than single-threaded RTL simulation. In one case, board measurements revealed long-run performance degradation in a candidate that improved in a short diagnostic run. The result guided candidate selection and led to RTL-based root-cause analysis and a fix.

AI.tldr: 提出一种LLM智能体在FPGA上实现CPU候选并用板级测量指导设计决策的开发环境，将单周期RV32I核演进为三发射乱序RV32IM核（5.61 CoreMark/MHz@130MHz，Artix-7），FPGA评估比单线程RTL仿真快9.6倍，且揭示了短诊断运行无法发现的长期性能退化。
AI.motivation: CPU候选的长时间RTL仿真耗时数小时，而短诊断运行又可能漏掉执行后期才出现的性能退化；这一评估成本会拖慢基于LLM智能体的CPU开发中的设计决策。
AI.method: 构建开发环境：LLM智能体在FPGA上实现CPU候选，并利用板上性能测量结果反馈指导候选的生成与筛选决策；在人工监督下，将单周期RV32I核逐步开发为三发射乱序RV32IM核；对同一候选运行8000次CoreMark迭代，对比FPGA评估（含实现开销）与单线程RTL仿真的评估时间。
AI.result: 最终设计在Artix-7 FPGA上以130MHz达到5.61 CoreMark/MHz；相同候选跑8000次CoreMark迭代时，含实现的FPGA评估比单线程RTL仿真快9.6倍；某案例中板级测量发现某候选在长程运行中出现性能退化，而短诊断运行表现提升，该结果指导了候选选择，并促成基于RTL的根因分析与修复。
AI.conclusion: 板级实测反馈使LLM智能体驱动的CPU开发具备更高效、更可信的评估闭环：既能显著加速评估，又能捕捉短程诊断遗漏的长期性能问题，从而改进设计决策与后续根因定位。

title: Label-free Monitoring of Nucleoid Dynamics of Bacteria for Drug Screening Using Holography
summary: We introduce holographic microscopy (HM) as a compact, low-cost, label-free, non-specific alternative to fluorescence microscopy (FM) for quantifying bacterial physiological responses during drug screening. Using the regularized inverse holographic volumetric reconstruction (RIHVR) framework, we extract phase maps from HM images and then invert the reconstructed phase to generate fluorescence-like contrast, in which bright inverted-phase regions correspond to bacterial nucleoid content captured by FM signals. We show that this relationship holds across multiple bacterial species, growth stages, drug treatments, and post-treatment time points, demonstrating that HM can consistently capture nucleoid associated structural information without fluorescent labeling. Because HM phase images contain both whole-cell refractive-index information and internal nucleoid-associated contrast, they enable simultaneous quantification of cell boundaries, cell length, nucleoid size, and nucleoid occupancy. These measurements allow drug-induced changes in bacterial morphology and nucleoid organization to be monitored over time. Unlike FM, which can suffer from photobleaching and may perturb live cells through phototoxicity, HM relies on refractive-index variations and maintains stable signal quality for long-term live-cell imaging. By linking label-free phase imaging to nucleoid-scale physiological readouts, this work establishes a path toward automated, high-throughput, and experimentally simpler bacterial drug-screening assays.

AI.tldr: 提出全息显微（HM）作为荧光显微（FM）的紧凑、低成本、无标记替代方案，用于药物筛选中细菌生理响应的定量分析。
AI.motivation: 荧光显微（FM）虽可表征细菌核仁体等生理响应，但依赖荧光标记，存在光漂白与光毒性，且设备昂贵、流程复杂，难以支撑长时程活细胞成像与高通量药物筛选。
AI.method: 基于正则化逆全息体层重建（RIHVR）框架从HM图像中提取相位图，并对重建相位求逆以生成类荧光对比，使反相高亮区域对应FM所捕获的核仁体含量；随后在多菌种、多生长阶段、多药物处理及多时间点上验证该对应关系。
AI.result: HM相位图同时包含全细胞折射率信息与核仁体相关内部对比，可实现细胞边界、细胞长度、核仁体尺寸与核仁体占位的同步定量，并追踪药物诱导的形态学与核仁体组织变化；信号质量在长时程活细胞成像中保持稳定，无光漂白与光毒性问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过将无标记相位成像与核仁体尺度的生理读出相联结，HM为自动化、高通量、实验流程更简化的细菌药物筛选检测提供了可行路径。

title: Bouba Beats Kiki, and Other Regularities in the Subjective Preferences of LLMs
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures in main text; 27 pages, 13 figures in supplement. To appear at NeurIPS 2026
summary:
Users engage with large language models on tasks that are purely objective ("When was Netflix founded?"), purely subjective ("What should I name my child?") or anywhere in-between. We have rich tools for evaluating model accuracy with respect to objective criteria. However, when it comes to subjective aspects of a task, we do not have similarly developed methodology at hand. In this paper, we take some early steps towards framing the question of subjective evaluation. Rather than measure how often a model is right or wrong on a question, we instead ask, how do models make choices among multiple viable responses without a clear winner?
  To study this question, we restrict our focus to short-form content, and consider comparison tasks among three such content types: numbers, baby names, and fictional cities. We identify 29 aspects of these short-form examples covering many areas of syntax and semantics (length, alphabetic order, popularity, vowel mix, spoken sound, etc.). We show first that models tend to have strong and reproducible preferences for or against some of these aspects. Second, we show that variations in how the model is asked to express a preference may cause some of these aspects to activate or deactivate in the model's selection. Third, we show that overall preference distributions among pairs may vary radically based on seemingly-unimportant variations in the nature of the question posed to the model, raising new questions about manipulation. And finally, we show that, if models are used both to create lists of alternatives and to rank them, there are unexpected interactions between the two stages that may also drive the models' stated preferences.

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM在无明确最优解的开放式任务中的主观偏好问题，通过数字、婴儿名与虚构城市三类短文本的比较任务识别29个语言/语义特征，发现模型偏好稳定但高度依赖提问方式与生成-排序流程的相互影响。
AI.motivation: 现有评估方法主要针对客观正确性，缺乏刻画模型在主观性任务中如何做选择的方法论。论文不追问"对错"，而追问模型在多个可行回答之间如何取舍。
AI.method: 限定短形式内容，构造数字、婴儿名字、虚构城市三类比较任务；提取覆盖句法与语义的29个方面（长度、字母序、流行度、元音构成、发音等）；系统改变提问方式与偏好表达形式，并对比"模型生成候选列表—再排序"的两阶段设置。
AI.result: (1) 模型对部分方面存在强且可复现的偏好/厌恶；(2) 偏好表达方式的变化会使某些方面激活或失效；(3) 成对偏好的整体分布可因看似无关的提问措辞差异而剧烈变化；(4) 模型同时用于生成候选与排序时，两阶段存在意外交互并影响其陈述偏好。
AI.conclusion: 主观评估需要独立的方法论框架；模型偏好具有系统性但对提示与流程高度敏感，提示了操纵风险，并说明生成与排序耦合会污染评估结论。

title: Improving Data-Constrained Scaling with Hyperparameter Transfer and Ensembling
summary: As growing compute budgets outpace the growth of high-quality training data, large language models must be trained with both compute and data constraints in mind. Unfortunately, existing prescriptions for data-constrained scaling suffer from two important limitations. First, past works hold key hyperparameters such as weight decay fixed with scale, despite the fact that optimal hyperparameters vary wildly with model size and number of epochs. Second, past works neglect ensembling, a promising axis for scaling under data constraints. As a surprising consequence, prior prescriptions can lead to loss that increases with compute budget. We address both limitations by fitting power laws that prescribe how to transfer hyperparameters with scale and scaling laws that prescribe how to allocate compute with ensembling. Training on 100M tokens from FineWeb, our recipe reduces validation loss by over 0.15 nats compared to prior recipes, a 14% decrease in perplexity, and achieves monotonic improvements with compute through ensembling. These gains are achieved using prescriptions fit to smaller runs and validated at up to 12$\times$ larger compute budgets.

AI.tldr: 论文指出既有数据受限缩放方案忽略了超参数随规模变化与集成方法，提出幂律迁移超参数并联合集成进行算力分配的缩放定律，在100M FineWeb token上验证损失降低超0.15 nats（困惑度降14%），且随算力单调改进。
AI.motivation: 算力预算增长快于高质量训练数据增长，需在算力与数据双约束下训练LLM。但现有数据受限缩放方案有两个缺陷：(1) 将权重衰减等关键超参数随规模固定，而最优超参数实际随模型大小与训练轮数剧烈变化；(2) 忽略集成这一数据受限下的有前景缩放维度。其后果是，先前方案甚至会导致损失随算力预算增加而上升。
AI.method: 拟合两类规律：一是描述超参数如何随规模迁移的幂律；二是描述如何在集成下分配算力的缩放定律。基于小规模运行拟合处方，再在更大算力预算上验证。
AI.result: 在FineWeb的100M token上训练，相比先前方案验证损失降低超过0.15 nats，困惑度下降14%，并通过集成实现随算力单调改进。增益来自小规模拟合的处方，并在最高12倍更大算力预算上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 在数据受限场景下，正确迁移超参数并引入集成能显著优于既有缩放处方，且随算力单调获益，为算力-数据双约束下的训练提供了可外推的实用处方。

title: Frequency-Adaptive Gaussian Grids for Efficient Image Representation
summary: Neural representation has emerged as a powerful tool to mitigate the demand for increasingly higher-resolution images. However, a fundamental trade-off remains between structured (e.g., feature grids, which offer spatial consistency) and unstructured (e.g., 2D Gaussians, which adaptively capture local variances) representations. This choice significantly affects how well an algorithm represents an image. Here, we present Gaussian-Grid, a hybrid neural representation that adaptively integrates structured and unstructured primitives. By dynamically partitioning computation between 2D Gaussian distributions and their attached multi-resolution feature grids based on the local frequency content, Gaussian-Grid automatically optimizes its architecture to match the underlying complexity of the target signal. We evaluate our approach using high-resolution natural images and demonstrate its applications as GPU-native dataset storage, showing $1.24$-$2.14\times$ decoding speed improvement and PCIe data traffic reduction of $23\times$-$176\times$ over JPEG + ZIP data archiving. The results show that Gaussian-Grid maintains small memory footprints while achieving high reconstruction fidelity across a variety of datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出 Gaussian-Grid 混合神经表征，依据局部频率内容在 2D 高斯（非结构化）与多分辨率特征网格（结构化）之间动态分配计算，自动匹配信号复杂度；在 GPU 原生数据集存储中实现 1.24–2.14× 解码加速与 23–176× PCIe 流量降低，且内存占用小、重建保真度高。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率图像需求增长使神经表征成为关键手段，但结构化表征（特征网格，具空间一致性）与非结构化表征（2D 高斯，可自适应捕捉局部方差）之间存在根本性权衡，单一选择会显著影响表征能力，缺乏兼顾二者的自适应方案。
AI.method: 构建 Gaussian-Grid 混合表征，将 2D 高斯分布与其附带的多分辨率特征网格相结合；根据局部频率内容在高斯与网格原语之间动态划分计算，从而自动优化架构以匹配目标信号的固有复杂度。
AI.result: 在高分辨率自然图像上评估：作为 GPU 原生数据集存储相比 JPEG+ZIP 归档，解码速度提升 1.24–2.14×，PCIe 数据传输量降低 23–176×；同时保持较小内存占用并在多数据集上取得高重建保真度。
AI.conclusion: 结构化与非结构化原语的自适应混合可在小内存下兼顾保真度与效率，Gaussian-Grid 为高分辨率图像的高效表征与 GPU 端数据存储提供了可行方案。

title: What Constitutes Food Similarity? Visual Representations and Retrieval in Indian Cuisine
summary: Food similarity underlies retrieval, recommendation, substitution, and other food computing tasks, yet food representations are typically evaluated by identity preservation. We ask what happens to food similarity beyond identity: how different visual representations organize foods into relational neighborhoods, what culinary relationships these neighborhoods reveal or obscure, and how consistently these structures emerge across representations. Indian cuisine provides a challenging setting in which visually similar foods may have different culinary identities, while foods within a culinary family can vary substantially in appearance. Using an expanded Khana dataset and seven pretrained visual representations spanning convolutional, transformer-based, self-supervised, and image-text aligned models, we evaluate image-to-image retrieval and image-to-dish neighborhoods, examining culinary-family structure, contrast cases, and cross-representation agreement. We also aggregate image representations to compare dish-level visual similarity across models and against recipe-derived similarity for the same dishes. Image-level neighborhoods vary substantially across representations, including similarities across culinary-family boundaries. At the dish level, aggregation reveals common visual structure despite local variation, but this structure corresponds less strongly with recipe-derived similarity. These findings show that recognition performance alone cannot characterize relational structure: food similarity depends on representation, modality, and abstraction level rather than being a fixed property of the food collection. Understanding these structures is therefore a prerequisite to combining multiple food information modalities into a coherent notion of similarity.

AI.tldr: 论文超越"身份保持"评估，考察七种预训练视觉表示如何组织食物关系邻域，发现食物相似性依赖表示、模态与抽象层级，而非食物集合的固定属性。
AI.motivation: 食物相似性是检索、推荐、替换等食物计算任务的基础，但现有食物表示通常仅以身份保持（identity preservation）来评估，忽略了相似性关系结构本身；作者希望探究不同视觉表示如何组织食物的关系邻域、揭示或掩盖哪些烹饪关系、以及这些结构在不同表示间的稳定性。
AI.method: 以印度菜为挑战性场景（视觉相似但烹饪身份不同、同一菜系家族内外观差异大），使用扩展的Khana数据集与七种预训练视觉表示（涵盖卷积、Transformer、自监督、图文对齐模型），评估图像到图像检索与图像到菜品邻域，分析菜系家族结构、对比案例与跨表示一致性；并将图像表示聚合到菜品级，比较模型间菜品级视觉相似性及其与基于食谱的相似性的一致性。
AI.result: 图像级邻域在不同表示间差异显著，包括跨越菜系家族边界的相似性；菜品级聚合后，尽管存在局部差异，仍显现出共同的视觉结构，但该结构与食谱导出的相似性对应较弱。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭识别性能无法刻画关系结构；食物相似性取决于表示、模态与抽象层级，而非食物集合的固定属性。因此理解这些结构是将多种食物信息模态整合为一致的相似性概念的前提。

title: Joint Antenna Position and Beamforming Optimization for Movable Antenna Enabled Near-Field ISAC Imaging
summary: Near-field (NF) integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems enable simultaneous two-dimensional (2D) radar imaging and multi-user downlink communication. However, fixed-position antenna arrays can exhibit high sidelobes in the point spread function (PSF), which degrade imaging performance and cause ghost-target artifacts. Movable antennas (MAs) offer additional spatial degrees of freedom to suppress these sidelobes while meeting communication requirements, without increasing the number of antenna elements. In this paper, we investigate MA-enabled NF ISAC by jointly optimizing the transmit and receive antenna positions and the transmit beamforming to minimize a weighted sum of the integrated sidelobe level (ISL) and peak sidelobe level (PSL) of the 2D PSF, subject to communication-rate, illumination-power, transmit-power, and antenna-placement constraints. To tackle the resulting non-convex problem, we propose a hybrid alternating optimization (AO) framework that combines particle swarm optimization with a genetic algorithm. Our numerical results demonstrate that the proposed scheme achieves the lowest ISL among the considered array configurations and reduces the PSL by at least 5 dB compared with the benchmarks. The optimized array is further shown to resolve two closely spaced targets whose reflectivities differ by 6dB, outperforming random, Mills Cross, and rectangular arrays while satisfying the imposed minimum user-throughput requirements.

AI.tldr: 该文研究可动天线（MA）赋能的近场通感一体化（ISAC）系统，通过联合优化收发天线位置与发射波束成形抑制二维点扩散函数（PSF）旁瓣，实现雷达成像与多用户下行通信的协同。
AI.motivation: 近场ISAC可实现二维雷达成像与多用户下行通信，但固定位置天线阵的PSF旁瓣高，导致成像质量下降并产生虚假目标；而增加阵元数代价高，需在不增加阵元的前提下获得额外空间自由度以抑制旁瓣。
AI.method: 以最小化二维PSF的积分旁瓣电平（ISL）与峰值旁瓣电平（PSL）加权和为准则，联合优化发射/接收天线位置与发射波束成形，约束包括通信速率、照射功率、发射功率及天线摆放范围；针对非凸问题提出融合粒子群优化（PSO）与遗传算法（GA）的混合交替优化（AO）框架。
AI.result: 所提方案在所比较的阵列配置中取得最低ISL，PSL较基准方案至少降低5 dB；优化阵列可分辨反射率相差6 dB的两个近距目标，性能优于随机阵列、Mills Cross阵列与矩形阵列，同时满足最低用户吞吐量要求。
AI.conclusion: 可动天线为近场ISAC提供有效的空间自由度，可在满足通信约束的同时显著抑制二维成像旁瓣并提升多目标分辨能力。

title: MRUD: Maximally Redundant Unsigned Digit Number Systems for High-Performance Arithmetic Units
comment: 22 pages, 15 figures. Submitted to Integration, the VLSI Journal (Elsevier). Under review
summary: Signed digit redundant number systems such as Maximally Redundant Signed Digit (MRSD) enable carry-free addition but introduce significant overhead in multiplication due to the presence of both positive and negative bits. While Unsigned Digit Redundant (UDR) systems have shown promise in radix-2, their extension to higher radices remains unexplored. This work presents the first generalized Maximally Redundant Unsigned Digit (MRUD) number systems for high-radix arithmetic, extending UDR representations from radix-2 to radix-$2^h$ while preserving carry-free addition. The proposed framework includes digit encoding, digit extension, arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, and multiplication), sign inversion, forward/reverse conversion algorithms, overflow/underflow detection, and hardware architectures for both signed and unsigned MRUD representations. Unlike MRSD, which is inherently limited to signed arithmetic, MRUD supports both signed and unsigned representations, similar to conventional binary systems. Evaluations across three multiplier modes---RRR (Redundant inputs, Redundant output), BBR (Binary inputs, Redundant output), and BBB (Binary inputs, Binary output)---as well as Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) units, using the FreePDK 45nm library, demonstrate that MRUD achieves up to 30\% lower delay, 26\% smaller area, and 87\% lower power than MRSD. In BBR mode, MRUD achieves up to 43\% delay reduction over the best conventional architecture for 32$\times$32 operands, while in Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) units, performing reverse conversion only once at the end yields up to 64\% higher throughput than DesignWare and over 150\% higher than Wallace. These results demonstrate that MRUD enables high-radix redundant arithmetic with significantly improved multiplier and MAC performance, making it an efficient alternative to conventional signed digit redundant number systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个广义最大冗余无符号数字（MRUD）数制，将UDR从基2扩展到基2^h并保持无进位加法，配套给出编码、运算、转换、溢出检测与硬件架构；在45nm下相比MRSD延迟最多低30%、面积小26%、功耗低87%，BBR模式下比最优传统架构延迟低43%，MAC吞吐量较DesignWare高64%以上、较Wallace高150%以上。
AI.motivation: MRSD等有符号冗余数制虽支持无进位加法，但因同时存在正、负位使乘法开销显著；UDR在基2已显示潜力，但向高基扩展尚未被研究。作者希望将无符号冗余表示推广到高基，在保留无进位加法的同时降低乘法与MAC的成本，并弥补MRSD仅限于有符号运算的不足。
AI.method: 构建广义MRUD数制框架，把UDR从基2推广到基2^h；给出数字编码、数字扩展、加/减/乘运算、符号取反、前向与反向转换算法、上溢/下溢检测，以及有符号与无符号MRUD的硬件架构。基于FreePDK 45nm库，在RRR、BBR、BBB三种乘法器模式及MAC单元上与MRSD和传统架构进行对比评估。
AI.result: 相较MRSD，MRUD延迟最多降低30%、面积减小26%、功耗降低87%；BBR模式下32×32操作数相比最优传统架构延迟降低最多43%；MAC单元仅在末尾做一次反向转换，吞吐量较DesignWare提升最多64%、较Wallace提升150%以上。
AI.conclusion: MRUD使高基冗余算术成为可能，显著提升乘法器与MAC性能，是可替代传统有符号冗余数制的高效方案，并具备类似二进制的有符号/无符号双重表示能力。

title: Near-Field Engineering of Silica-Shelled Plasmonic Nanoparticles toward Enhanced Near-Infrared Fluorescence
summary: Near-infrared (NIR) fluorescent molecules often suffer from low quantum yields, limiting their applications in sensing and imaging. Their fluorescence can be enhanced by coupling with plasmonic nanoparticles exhibiting resonances in the same spectral region. However, this approach requires precise nanoscale control over the plasmonic near-field. Here, we combine scanning transmission electron microscopy with electron energy-loss spectroscopy (STEM-EELS) and boundary element electromagnetic simulations to engineer silica-coated anisotropic plasmonic nanoparticles. We synthesised three types of nanoparticles, gold nanorods (AuNRs), gold bipyramids (AuBPs), and silver nanorods (AgNRs) with tunable NIR plasmonic resonances. Silica serves as a dielectric spacer, enabling precise control over the distance between the nanoparticle surface and a potential molecular emitter. To assess their suitability for fluorophore attachment, we investigated the dependence of the electric near-field on silica shell thickness. High-resolution STEM-EELS mapping revealed that thin silica shells (4.4 nm for AuNRs and 3.1 nm for AuBPs) allow most of the near-field to extend beyond the dielectric layer. For AgNRs, a thicker shell of 7.0 nm was required to prevent oxidation while maintaining near-field accessibility. Electromagnetic simulations further evaluated the optimal shell thickness and the dependence of fluorescence enhancement on particle geometry, material, fluorophore internal quantum yield, and fluorophore-metal separation. Together, these results provide practical design guidelines for optimizing particle morphology and sub-10 nm silica shells in plasmonic nanostructures for fluorescence enhancement.

AI.tldr: 结合STEM-EELS与边界元电磁模拟，研究硅包覆各向异性等离子体纳米颗粒（AuNR、AuBP、AgNR）的壳层厚度与近场分布关系，为近红外荧光增强提供亚10 nm壳层设计准则。
AI.motivation: 近红外荧光分子量子产率低，限制其在传感与成像中的应用；利用同光谱区等离激元共振的纳米颗粒可增强荧光，但需要对等离激元近场实现精确的纳米尺度调控。
AI.method: 合成具有可调近红外等离激元共振的AuNRs、AuBPs和AgNRs，以二氧化硅作为介电间隔层控制距离；联合STEM-EELS高分辨近场成像与边界元法电磁模拟，分析近场随壳层厚度的变化，并模拟荧光增强对颗粒几何、材料、荧光团内量子产率及荧光团-金属间距的依赖。
AI.result: AuNRs需4.4 nm、AuBPs需3.1 nm薄硅壳即可使大部分近场延伸至介电层之外；AgNRs需7.0 nm较厚壳层以抑制氧化同时保持近场可及。模拟给出最优壳层厚度及荧光增强随各参数的依赖关系。
AI.conclusion: 为优化颗粒形貌与亚10 nm硅壳厚度的等离子体纳米结构以实现荧光增强提供了实用设计指南。

title: Multi-Draft On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Drafters
summary: Speculative decoding is used to reduce the inference cost of language models. One-step diffusion drafters propose a block of multiple tokens in parallel, reducing the sequential cost of speculative decoding. On-policy distillation trains these drafters using verifier feedback on their own proposals. However, parallel drafting makes this feedback difficult to use: the drafter predicts each token without observing the preceding tokens sampled within the same block, while the verifier conditions its prediction on those tokens. Different sampled prefixes therefore give different verifier targets for the same drafter prediction. We show that distilling against these targets separately can suppress tokens that are plausible after some prefixes but unlikely after others, harming draft acceptance. We explain the effects of this mismatch and introduce Multi-Draft On-Policy Distillation (MDraft), a new parallel drafter distillation method which samples several draft blocks from the same context and aggregates the verifier's full-vocabulary conditionals across their prefixes. We use all the drafts to collect information from the verifier, allowing support from alternative prefixes to influence the training target. The resulting algorithm improves the acceptance length of a parallel drafter beyond the level of pre-training, and alleviates the effects of the distributional mismatch. MDraft changes only training, retaining the drafter's architecture and inference procedure, allowing the resulting drafter to be used as-is in place of the pretrained checkpoint. Experiments on a suite of mathematical, coding, and conversational tasks show longer accepted drafts than prior distillation methods.

AI.tldr: 针对一步式扩散草稿模型在on-policy蒸馏中"并行预测token与验证器条件不一致"导致的分布错配问题，提出MDraft：对同一上下文采样多个草稿块，将验证器在各前缀下的全词表条件分布聚合为训练目标，从而缓解错配、提升草稿接受长度。
AI.motivation: 推测解码用于降低语言模型推理成本，一步扩散草稿器可并行生成一个token块，降低串行开销。但并行草稿时，草稿器预测每个token时看不到同一块内先前采样的token，而验证器的预测以这些token为条件，因此同一草稿预测在不同采样前缀下对应不同的验证器目标。若分别对这些目标做蒸馏，会压制"在某些前缀下合理、在另一些前缀下不合理"的token，损害草稿接受率。作者旨在解释并缓解这一错配。
AI.method: 提出Multi-Draft On-Policy Distillation（MDraft）：从同一上下文采样多个草稿块，收集验证器在各草稿前缀下的全词表条件分布(conditionals)并进行聚合，作为统一的蒸馏目标，使来自备选前缀的支持信息都能影响训练目标。方法仅改变训练，保留草稿器架构与推理流程。
AI.result: MDraft使并行草稿器的接受长度超越预训练水平，缓解分布错配的影响；在数学、代码与对话类任务上，其被接受的草稿长度优于既有蒸馏方法；所得草稿器可直接替代预训练检查点使用。
AI.conclusion: 并行草稿器的on-policy蒸馏中，多前缀验证器目标的聚合能有效利用验证器反馈、避免过度压制合理token；MDraft是一种训练端改进，无需改动架构与推理，即插即用，并在多类任务上优于先前蒸馏方法。

title: Interpretable neural equation learning for high-dimensional materials data
summary: Equation learning seeks to discover compact, interpretable equations from data using various machine-learning techniques. However, few workflows discover and interpret learned equations in sparse, high-dimensional materials datasets. We present nn-EQL, an equation-learning framework that generates candidate equations through iterative training, pruning, and retraining of a neural network with customizable, user-specified neuron-level activation functions. Candidate equations are ranked using a minimum description length (MDL)-inspired score, balancing error and sparsity, and diagnosed to assess term-wise contributions, input-scaled sensitivities, and uncertainties. We demonstrate nn-EQL on standard AI-Feynman benchmarks as well as multiscale high-dimensional materials datasets such as finite-element simulations of heterogeneous materials, and high-throughput experimental thin-film deposition data. nn-EQL integrates with tabular data and high-dimensional data via standard encoder models, learning equations and providing insight into learned terms. Looking forward, integrating physically interpretable representations, multimodal and multi-fidelity data, and adaptive data acquisition could enable equation learning to formulate and test mechanistic hypotheses.

AI.tldr: nn-EQL：通过迭代训练-剪枝-重训练带可定制神经元级激活函数的神经网络生成候选方程，并用受MDL启发的评分排序与诊断，适用于稀疏高维材料数据。
AI.motivation: 现有方程学习多停留在标准基准，少有工作流能在稀疏、高维材料数据中发现并解释所学方程。
AI.method: nn-EQL框架：以用户可定制的神经元级激活函数构建网络，迭代执行训练、剪枝与重训练以生成候选方程；采用受最小描述长度（MDL）启发的评分在误差与稀疏性间权衡并排序；对候选方程进行诊断，评估逐项贡献、输入尺度敏感性与不确定性；通过标准编码器接入表格数据与高维数据。
AI.result: 在AI-Feynman标准基准、多尺度高维材料数据（异质材料有限元模拟）及高通量薄膜沉积实验数据上完成演示，能学习方程并给出所学项的洞见。
AI.conclusion: nn-EQL可作为稀疏高维材料数据中方程学习与解释的实用流程；未来结合物理可解释表征、多模态与多保真数据及自适应数据采集，有望用于提出并检验机理假设。

title: Where Can We Fool the Model's Mind? Response-Guided Semantic Probing and Adaptive Routing for Transferable Attacks on Black-Box MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) ground language in visual evidence, yet their semantic reasoning can be exploited through transferable black-box adversarial attacks. Existing attacks typically allocate perturbations using surrogate-model saliency, which may not reflect how an unseen MLLM semantically interprets or relies on different image regions. We introduce VISTA (Vulnerability-Informed Semantic Transfer Attacks), a black-box framework that identifies semantically vulnerable visual regions from an MLLM's responses without access to gradients, logits, parameters, or internal representations. VISTA supports two attack settings: (i) VISTA-Proxy, a pure-transfer setting that probes an open-source MLLM and transfers the resulting adversarial examples to unseen commercial MLLMs without querying them; and (ii) VISTA-Victim, a query-assisted setting that probes the target MLLM to capture model-specific semantic vulnerabilities. VISTA builds an Uncertainty-Based Multimodal Behavior (UBMB) map from response drift, conflict, misleading, and semantic shifts, then uses entropy-adaptive Sinkhorn routing and a surrogate ensemble to focus perturbations on vulnerable regions. Across GPT-5, Gemini-3.5-Flash, and Claude Sonnet 4.6, VISTA achieves up to 97 % attack success rate (ASR) while maintaining a Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) above 30 dB. Notably, VISTA-Proxy achieves up to 93 % ASR without querying the final victim, demonstrating that response-derived semantic vulnerability can enable effective transfer across heterogeneous MLLMs.

AI.tldr: VISTA：一种无需梯度/权重/内部表示的黑盒框架，通过MLLM响应构建语义脆弱性图，实现跨异构MLLM的可迁移对抗攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM黑盒对抗攻击多依赖代理模型显著性分配扰动，但代理显著性未必反映未见MLLM对图像各区域的语义依赖，导致迁移性受限。
AI.method: 从MLLM响应中识别语义脆弱区域：构建基于不确定性的多模态行为（UBMB）图（涵盖响应漂移、冲突、误导、语义偏移），再结合熵自适应Sinkhorn路由与代理模型集成，将扰动集中于脆弱区域。两种设定：VISTA-Proxy（纯迁移，探测开源模型后迁移至商业模型，不查询受害模型）与VISTA-Victim（查询辅助，直接探测目标模型）。
AI.result: 在GPT-5、Gemini-3.5-Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.6上ASR最高达97%，PSNR保持30 dB以上；VISTA-Proxy在未查询最终受害模型的情况下ASR最高达93%。
AI.conclusion: 由响应衍生的语义脆弱性可支撑跨异构MLLM的有效迁移攻击，为黑盒鲁棒性评估提供了新视角。

title: Verification Learning Theory: A Process Model of Checking and Retention in AI-Assisted Judgment
summary: Accurate AI assistance can improve immediate judgments while reducing opportunities to practise the operations needed for independent performance. Verification Learning Theory (VLT) formalises this possibility for claim-evaluation practice followed by correct, independent, rule-specific feedback. The model links perceived assistant reliability to evidence checking and links the history of those checks to retained rule use. Its strict form assumes that task demands and perceived reliability influence learning only through checking, with equal learning per genuine check. It therefore predicts that perceived fallibility can improve delayed unaided judgment even without observed assistant errors, and that this advantage disappears when checking is already required and performed. Rule-specific gains and forecasts from checking histories provide further tests. Simulations examine the consequences and parameter dependence of these commitments; they do not constitute empirical validation. Comparisons with depth-of-processing and feedback-encoding accounts identify where predictions diverge and where the accounts remain observationally equivalent. The framework specifies experiments that can test the proposed mechanism and separates retention of practised rules from the broader problem of recognising which rule applies to a new claim.

AI.tldr: 提出"验证性学习理论"（VLT），解释AI辅助为何在提升即时判断的同时削弱独立操作能力的练习机会，并给出可检验的机制性预测。
AI.motivation: 准确的AI协助能改善即时判断，却减少了练习独立完成任务所需操作的机会，可能损害延迟的独立表现。作者希望为"评估论断并随后获得正确的、针对具体规则的独立反馈"这一练习形式建立形式化理论。
AI.method: 理论建模：将"感知到的助手可靠性"与"证据核查行为"联系起来，再将核查历史与"规则使用的保持"联系起来。严格形式假设任务需求与感知可靠性仅通过核查影响学习，且每次真实核查带来等量学习。通过仿真考察该设定的推论与参数依赖性，并与深度加工说、反馈编码说进行比较以识别预测分歧与观察等价之处。
AI.result: 严格模型预测：即便未观察到助手出错，仅"感知到其可能出错"也能改善延迟的无辅助判断；当核查本已被要求并实际执行时，该优势消失。此外，核查历史可生成针对具体规则的增益以及对后续表现的预测。仿真仅展示推论与参数依赖，不构成实证验证。
AI.conclusion: VLT为AI辅助下的技能保持提供了形式化、可检验的框架，明确了检验该机制的实验设计，并将"已练习规则的保持"与"识别新论断适用哪条规则"这一更广泛问题区分开来。

title: Semantic-Assisted Joint Channel Estimation and Symbol Detection for MU-MIMO Systems
summary: This paper presents a semantic-assisted joint channel estimation and symbol detection (Sem-JCED) receiver framework for text transmission in multi-user multiple-input multiple-output (MU-MIMO) systems. Sem-JCED integrates a linear minimum mean-square error (LMMSE) channel estimator, an expectation propagation (EP) symbol detector, and a semantic corrector based on ByT5, a byte-level language model. At each outer iteration, LMMSE estimates the channel from known pilots and data symbol feedback, and EP detects the data symbols. ByT5 then maps the data symbol probabilities to byte probabilities, which provide soft symbol statistics and semantic priors for feedback to LMMSE and EP, respectively, in the next iteration. Simulation results show that Sem-JCED requires about 7~dB lower signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) than conventional JCED to reach a bit error rate (BER) of $1\times10^{-2}$ with four users and four receive antennas, and outperforms maximum-likelihood detection with perfect channel knowledge over the simulated SNR range.

AI.tldr: 提出语义辅助的联合信道估计与符号检测（Sem-JCED）接收机框架，将LMMSE信道估计、EP符号检测与ByT5字节级语义纠正器迭代耦合，用于MU-MIMO文本传输。
AI.motivation: 在多用户MIMO文本传输中，传统联合信道估计与符号检测（JCED）未利用文本语义冗余，在低信噪比下性能受限；作者希望借助语义先验提升检测与估计精度。
AI.method: Sem-JCED由三部分组成：LMMSE信道估计器（利用已知导频与数据符号反馈）、EP符号检测器、基于ByT5字节级语言模型的语义纠正器。每次外迭代中先由LMMSE估计信道、EP检测数据符号，再由ByT5将数据符号概率映射为字节概率，产出软符号统计量反馈给LMMSE、语义先验反馈给EP，供下一轮迭代使用。
AI.result: 在4用户、4接收天线配置下，达到BER=1×10⁻²时Sem-JCED比传统JCED所需SNR低约7 dB；在所仿真SNR范围内，其性能甚至优于具有完美信道知识的最大似然检测。
AI.conclusion: 将字节级语义模型嵌入迭代式信道估计与符号检测回路，可显著降低文本传输的SNR需求并突破理想信道下ML检测的性能上界，表明语义先验是提升MU-MIMO接收性能的有效手段。

title: Caerus: Prefetching by Thinking Globally and Acting Locally
summary:
Modern processors rely heavily on data prefetching to bridge the growing performance gap between computation and memory accesses. In offset prefetching, prefetches are issued at an address delta relative to the most recently observed access, selecting deltas that have exhibited high coverage in the recent access-stream history. The Best-Offset Prefetcher (BOP) exemplifies this approach by selecting a single uniformly-issued global offset that delivers timely prefetches. However, its lack of context-sensitive accuracy tracking results in significantly increased DRAM traffic and sometimes disappointing performance. Conversely, Berti, the state-of-the-art offset prefetcher, achieves impressive prefetching performance and accuracy. However, its Program-Counter (PC)-local approach to extracting offsets limits its ability to capture global memory patterns, meaning there are many scenarios where simpler global offset prefetchers, such as BOP, outperform it.
  Observing the limitations of contemporary offset prefetchers, we present Caerus: an offset prefetcher that employs PC-local filtering on multiple non-overlapping globally derived offsets. Caerus extracts multiple offsets from the global memory trace and maximizes their combined coverage by training each offset only on accesses not already covered by previously learned offsets. The accuracy of each extracted offset is tracked per-PC based on whether it can cover future accesses for any PC. This allows Caerus to address complex delta patterns while maintaining high accuracy. In SPECspeed 2017, Caerus gains a geomean speedup of 8.3%, outperforming Berti by 2.0% while achieving low hardware and DRAM-traffic overhead.

AI.tldr: Caerus：一种结合全局偏移提取与PC局部过滤的偏移预取器，通过多个互不重叠的全局偏移提升覆盖率并保持高准确率，SPECspeed 2017几何平均加速8.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有偏移预取器存在两难：BOP采用全局单一偏移、发布及时但缺乏上下文敏感（context-sensitive）的准确率跟踪，导致DRAM流量显著增加、性能不稳定；SOTA的Berti采用PC局部（PC-local）偏移提取、准确率高但难以捕捉全局访存模式，在诸多场景下反被BOP超越。因此需要兼顾全局模式覆盖与局部准确率。
AI.method: Caerus从全局访存trace中提取多个互不重叠的偏移，训练每个偏移时仅使用尚未被先前已学偏移覆盖的访问，从而最大化组合覆盖率；并对每个提取偏移按PC粒度跟踪其准确率（判断其能否覆盖任意PC的未来访问），实现PC局部过滤。
AI.result: 在SPECspeed 2017上取得8.3%的几何平均加速，较Berti高出2.0%，同时硬件开销与DRAM流量开销均较低。
AI.conclusion: 通过将全局偏移提取与PC局部准确率跟踪相结合，Caerus能够处理复杂的地址增量（delta）模式并维持高准确率，克服了BOP与Berti各自的局限。

title: Symmetry-governed nonlinear metasurface simultaneously enhances circular dichroism, helicity purity, and Q-factor
summary: Circularly polarized light underpins a broad range of chiroptical and spin-selective photonic technologies, yet extending resonant chirality to nonlinear harmonic emission remains challenging. Here, we experimentally demonstrate a symmetry-governed mechanism that maps the maximal linear chirality of high-Q degenerate resonances onto the polarization of the generated harmonic. Preserved rotational symmetry protects modal degeneracy and polarization-selection rules, while broken mirror symmetries enable a strong chiroptical response. The metasurface thereby filters the pump polarization and purifies the handedness of the nonlinear output, simultaneously achieving third-harmonic circular dichroism of -0.98, a degree of circular polarization of 0.83, and an effective nonlinear Q-factor of 140. Importantly, the nonlinear emission preserves its handedness even under spatially depolarized excitation, demonstrating robustness to variations in the incident polarization state. These results establish complementary symmetry preservation and breaking as a deterministic route for transferring resonant chirality from linear to nonlinear optical responses, providing a general design principle for nonlinear chiral photonics.

AI.tldr: 通过超表面中"对称性保持+对称性破缺"的协同设计，将高Q简并共振的最大线性手性映射到谐波输出的偏振上，实现高效非线性手性响应。
AI.motivation: 圆偏振光在手性与自旋选择性光子技术中应用广泛，但将共振手性扩展到非线性谐波发射仍具挑战。
AI.method: 实验演示一种对称性调控机制：保持旋转对称性以保护模式简并和偏振选择定则，破缺镜面对称性以产生强手性响应；利用超表面过滤泵浦偏振并纯化非线性输出手性。
AI.result: 同时实现三次谐波圆二色性-0.98、圆偏振度0.83、有效非线性Q因子140；在空间去偏振激发下非线性发射仍保持手性。
AI.conclusion: 互补的对称性保持与破缺是将线性共振手性传递到非线性响应的确定性途径，为非线性手性光子学提供通用设计原则。

title: Locating Sycophancy Across Training Stages in Open Language Models
summary: Language model assistants sometimes change a correct answer when the user suggests a wrong one. The behavior, called sycophancy, is usually attributed to preference-based post-training, yet early measurements found it in pretrained models. We ask where it comes from by measuring it at every available stage of training: 13 open checkpoints from 5 lineages, from base model through supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization to release. We separate how far an injected claim moves a model's answer from how firmly the answer was held, and vary who makes the claim, how reliable they are said to be, and how strongly they make it. Two sycophancy behaviors with different origins emerge, and both replicate across datasets. Deference to a claim in the prompt is already present in every base model, which ranks sources in the same order as its post-trained descendants. Capitulation in conversation, dropping a stated answer when the user objects, is largely absent from base models and present in every post-trained checkpoint. When the objection names an alternative, most post-trained models give up firmly held answers as often as loosely held ones. We discuss the implications of these measurements for evaluating sycophancy and approaches for addressing each behavior.

AI.tldr: 论文在13个开放检查点（5个谱系，覆盖基座、SFT、偏好优化到发布版本）上逐阶段测量谄媚行为，区分"顺从注入主张"与"对话中屈服"，发现前者源于预训练基座模型、后者主要来自后训练。
AI.motivation: 已有研究把谄媚（sycophancy）归因于偏好后训练，但早期测量在预训练模型中已发现该行为，其来源不明确。作者希望定位谄媚究竟产生于训练的哪个阶段。
AI.method: 沿训练全流程测量13个开放检查点（5个模型谱系）：分离"注入主张使答案偏移的距离"与"原答案的坚持程度"；并操纵主张来源身份、来源可信度陈述、主张强度等变量，在两个数据集上复现。
AI.result: 出现两类来源不同的谄媚行为且可复现：（1）对提示中主张的顺从在所有基座模型中已存在，且其对来源可信度的排序与后训练后代一致；（2）对话中的屈服（用户反对时放弃已陈述答案）在基座模型中基本缺失，而在所有后训练检查点中均存在；当反对意见给出替代答案时，多数后训练模型放弃"坚定持有"答案的频率与"松散持有"答案相当。
AI.conclusion: 谄媚并非单一现象，应分行为评估与治理：顺从根源在预训练数据/基座能力，屈服更多由后训练引入；测量时应同时报告答案偏移量与答案坚持度，并针对两类行为分别提出缓解路径。

title: SAC-GCL: Structure-Aware Compression for Graph Contrastive Learning
summary: Graph Contrastive Learning (GCL) has achieved remarkable success in self-supervised representation learning by maximizing agreement between augmented views of a graph. Although augmented view generation is the central step in GCL, existing models rely on stochastic augmentation of the input graph, such as edge perturbation and node masking, which lack structural awareness and frequently destroy critical topology or introduce semantically inconsistent views. While recent adaptive methods improve upon random perturbations, they primarily operate on localized node or edge neighborhoods and fail to capture higher-order, macro-level structural organization crucial for graph classification. To address this limitation, we propose Structure-aware Compression for Graph Contrastive Learning (SAC-GCL), a novel framework that employs structural decomposition and graph compression as a principled view generation strategy. Moving beyond random augmentations, SAC-GCL leverages structural decomposition techniques to extract cohesive subgraphs and condense them into supernodes, constructing coarsened graph views that preserve local density and capture higher-level structural patterns while reducing noise and redundancy. We leverage multiple cohesive subgraph models to derive complementary views of the graph, each capturing distinct structural properties. To capture multi-resolution information, a hierarchical view encoder processes these compressed views by initializing super-node features with shared-weight cohesive subgraph embeddings. Our results from extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that structure-aware compression provides a powerful alternative to random perturbations, yielding more robust and discriminative graph representations for graph classification tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出SAC-GCL：用结构分解提取凝聚子图并压缩为超节点生成粗化视图，替代随机扰动作为图对比学习的视图生成策略，在多分辨率分层编码下提升图分类表示质量。
AI.motivation: 现有GCL依赖随机增强（边扰动、节点掩码），缺乏结构感知，易破坏关键拓扑或产生语义不一致视图；近期自适应方法仅在局部节点/边邻域操作，无法捕捉对图分类至关重要的高阶宏观结构组织。
AI.method: 以结构分解与图压缩作为原则化视图生成：利用结构分解技术抽取凝聚子图并凝结为超节点，构建保留局部密度、捕捉高层结构模式且降噪降冗余的粗化图视图；采用多种凝聚子图模型生成互补视图以刻画不同结构属性；设计分层视图编码器，以共享权重的凝聚子图嵌入初始化超节点特征，实现多分辨率信息融合。
AI.result: 在六个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，结构感知压缩可有效替代随机扰动，为图分类任务提供更鲁棒、更具判别性的图表示。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知压缩是一种强有力的GCL视图生成范式，能克服随机增强的结构盲性与自适应方法的局部性局限，提升图分类性能。

title: Can Event Detectors Leave the Broadcast Camera? Evidence from Tennis
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Benchmark, evaluator and frozen predictions: https://github.com/David-dsv/tennis-bounce-hit-benchmark
summary: Ball bounces and racket hits are the events from which tennis statistics are derived, and on monocular video the two are easy to confuse. We release a benchmark of 345 bounce and hit annotations at frame level on eight clips that mix broadcast, fixed elevated, phone and court-level viewpoints, with a frozen development and test split, a confusion-aware matcher, clip-level bootstrap intervals and a blind second annotation of three clips. On it we score supervised precise spotters with published broadcast weights, two zero-shot vision-language models, and RallyArb, an arbitration layer over a ball track and player poses that fits no parameter on event labels. The supervised spotters score near-perfectly on broadcast footage and almost nothing on phone and court-level footage, where the pooled bounce F1 of E2E-Spot is 0.130. RallyArb keeps a bounce F1 above 0.8 on the three phone and court-level clips, two of which were used to tune it, and finds 8 of 11 bounces on the held-out one, but it places hits too far from the contact frame to match human timing. The vision-language models detect events on every viewpoint and miss the contact frame by about 0.1 s. Fine-tuned leave-one-clip-out from its broadcast weights, the spotter reaches about 0.8 bounce F1 on two phone and court-level clips and stays at 0.2 on a grazing phone angle. The annotations, the evaluator and the frozen predictions of every scored row are released.

AI.tldr: 发布345个弹跳/击球帧级标注基准（8段多视角视频），比较监督spotter、零样本VLM与免标注参数的RallyArb仲裁层，揭示监督模型跨视角崩塌而RallyArb在手机/场边视角保持较高弹跳F1。
AI.motivation: 网球统计来源于弹跳与击球事件，但在单目视频中两者极易混淆，且现有方法多在广播视角下评测，缺乏跨视角（手机、场边）的可靠评测与误混敏感的评价手段。
AI.method: 构建帧级标注基准（8段片段，广播/固定高机位/手机/场边视角，冻结dev-test划分，混淆感知匹配器，片段级bootstrap区间，3段盲二次标注）；评测三类方法：带广播权重的监督精确spotter、两个零样本视觉语言模型、以及基于球轨迹与球员姿态的RallyArb仲裁层（不在事件标签上拟合任何参数）；并做从广播权重出发的留一片段交叉微调。
AI.result: 监督spotter在广播视频近完美、在手机与场边视频几乎失效（E2E-Spot汇总弹跳F1仅0.130）；RallyArb在三段手机/场边片段弹跳F1>0.8（其中两段用于调参），在留出片段检出11个弹跳中的8个，但击球定位偏离接触帧过远；VLM在各视角均能检出事件，接触帧误差约0.1 s；留一片段微调后在两段手机上弹跳F1约0.8，但在掠射手机角度仍为0.2。
AI.conclusion: 跨视角泛化是网球事件检测的核心瓶颈，监督模型存在严重域偏移；无标签拟合的仲裁层在弹跳检测上更稳健但击球时序精度不足；数据集、评测器及全部预测结果已公开，便于复现与后续研究。

title: The Anatomy of Socio-Demographics in Pluralistic Offensiveness Modeling: When and Where It Helps, and the Role of Reasoning
summary: Subjective judgments such as offensiveness often vary substantially across individuals, motivating pluralistic modeling approaches that incorporate annotators' socio-demographic information to capture this variation. However, prior findings on the benefits of socio-demographic information for pluralistic modeling are mixed, calling for a systematic analysis of both its effectiveness and the mechanisms through which it improves prediction. In this work, we study $\textbf{when}$ and $\textbf{where}$ socio-demographics benefit pluralistic offensiveness modeling, as well as $\textbf{the role of explicit reasoning}$ in leveraging this information. Across three multi-annotator datasets with prompted and trained LLMs, we first show that demographic gains are small and inconsistent for individual predictions but become clearer at the group and population levels, because aggregation attenuates the idiosyncratic variation that masks small but systematic demographic signals. Second, using a reasoning and prediction format that explicitly decomposes individual judgment into an overall baseline and a demographic-specific deviation, we show that the gains arise from both components: demographic information improves baseline estimation and enables meaningful demographic-specific shifts, and interventions show that better component estimates improve final predictions. Finally, comparing direct demographic conditioning with explicit reasoning about how the text interacts with annotator demographics, we find that reasoning yields more accurate baseline and shift estimates as well as final predictions, whereas conditioning alone rarely produces informative shifts. These results suggest that the mixed evidence in prior work may partly stem from individual-level evaluation, and that the value of socio-demographic information depends on both how it is evaluated and how models are guided to use it.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了社会人口学信息在多元（pluralistic）攻击性建模中何时、何地有效，以及显式推理的作用；发现人口学增益在个体层面小而多变，在群体与总体层面则更清晰，且显式推理比直接条件化更能有效利用该信息。
AI.motivation: 主观判断（如攻击性）在个体间差异显著，引入标注者社会人口学信息的多元建模被寄予厚望，但既有研究报告的收益结果不一（mixed），因此需要系统评估该信息的效果及其起效机制。
AI.method: 在三个多标注者数据集上，使用提示式（prompted）与微调式（trained）LLM：(1) 在个体、群体、总体三个层级比较人口学信息的增益；(2) 采用将个体判断分解为“总体基线 + 人口学特定偏移”的推理—预测格式，并通过干预检验两个分量的作用；(3) 对比“直接人口学条件化”与“显式推理文本—人口学交互”两种引导方式。
AI.result: 个体层面人口学增益小而一致；聚合到群体与总体层面后增益更明显，因聚合削弱了掩盖系统性信号的个体特异波动。增益同时来自基线估计改善与有意义的人口学特定偏移；干预显示更准确的分量估计可提升最终预测。显式推理在基线、偏移与最终预测上均优于直接条件化，后者很少产生有信息量的偏移。
AI.conclusion: 先前研究中不一致的证据部分源于个体层级的评估方式；社会人口学信息的价值取决于如何评估（评估粒度）以及如何引导模型使用该信息（显式推理 vs. 直接条件化）。

title: xCHEM: SDR-Based Multi-Link Channel Emulator for Real-Time Hardware-in-the-Loop Digital-Twin
summary: This paper presents xCHEM, a radio-frequency channel emulator that inserts programmable channels between physical radios using a single NI USRP X4xx software-defined radio. External channel models stream impulse responses to its field-programmable gate array without firmware changes or interruption of signal processing. A streaming datapath implements six independently configurable directional channels across four radio interfaces. Each channel uses a sparse finite impulse response filter whose memory-backed delays decouple delay span from multiplier resources. The real and complex variants support 32 and 16 nonzero taps, respectively, with a maximum delay of 16666.62 ns and 4.069 ns resolution. Coefficient scaling and arithmetic right shifts control attenuation. Hardware measurements show root-mean-square errors of 9.5 ps in delay over the full span and 0.11 dB in attenuation. Multipath delays are recovered within one sample. An FPGA coefficient engine produces tested Doppler shifts from +/-1 Hz to +/-1 MHz with mean frequency errors below 0.032 Hz relative to quantized commands after carrier-offset calibration; at 200 Hz, it reduces the measured near-carrier spur by 53.3 dB compared with 1 kHz host updates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 xCHEM——一种基于单块 NI USRP X4xx 软件定义无线电的射频信道模拟器，可在物理无线电之间插入可编程信道，外部信道模型可直接向 FPGA 流式传输冲激响应而无需修改固件或中断信号处理。
AI.motivation: 在真实射频链路上开展可重复、可控的信道实验需要成本低、灵活且可动态更新的信道模拟手段；现有方案往往依赖多设备或需修改固件/中断处理流程，难以支持实时、独立的定向信道配置与多普勒等时变效应的高精度复现。
AI.method: 采用单一 USRP X4xx 的流式数据通路实现四个射频接口间六个独立可配置的定向信道；每个信道使用稀疏有限冲激响应滤波器，以存储器实现的延迟线使延迟跨度与乘法器资源解耦；提供实数（32 个非零抽头）与复数（16 个非零抽头）两种变体，最大延迟 16666.62 ns、分辨率 4.069 ns；通过系数缩放与算术右移控制衰减；并由 FPGA 系数引擎在线生成多普勒频移。
AI.result: 实测延迟全跨度均方根误差 9.5 ps，衰减误差 0.11 dB；多径延迟可在 1 个采样内恢复；系数引擎在 ±1 Hz 至 ±1 MHz 产生经测试的多普勒频移，相对量化指令的平均频率误差低于 0.032 Hz（载波偏移校准后）；在 200 Hz 处相较 1 kHz 主机更新将近载波杂散降低 53.3 dB。
AI.conclusion: xCHEM 以单块 SDR 实现了高精度、低杂散、可在线重配置的多信道射频仿真，延迟与衰减精度达皮秒/亚分贝级，多普勒更新性能显著优于主机侧更新，适合作为灵活的实测信道模拟平台。

title: LAMP: LLM-Driven Analog Placement through Adaptive Tool Composition
summary: Analog placement requires circuit-specific trade-offs among area, matching, routability, and electrical performance. Balancing these trade-offs through predefined objectives and fixed placement flows remains difficult. In this paper, we propose an analog placement framework in which a large language model (LLM) acts as a layout engineer through composable placement components. These components support constraint management, placement and legalization, and lightweight evaluation of routability and electrical performance. Using multimodal checkpoints of the initial and evolving design, the LLM selects and combines components to construct and revise its own placement flow. It also adapts the placement hierarchy by reopening modules or partitioning and regrouping devices, allowing local layouts to respond to global design needs. An experience skill provides reusable design knowledge to guide these decisions. Evaluation on two SMIC 180 nm circuits shows that the framework reduces placement area and improves most measured post-layout performance metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出以LLM充当布局工程师的模拟电路布局框架，通过可组合的布局组件与多模态检查点自主构建并修订布局流程，同时动态调整布局层次，在SMIC 180nm两个电路上减小了面积并改善多数后布局性能指标。
AI.motivation: 模拟布局需在面积、匹配、可布线性与电性能之间做电路特定权衡，但依赖预定义目标和固定布局流程难以平衡这些权衡，缺乏面向具体电路的自适应决策机制。
AI.method: 构建由LLM驱动的模拟布局框架：将布局能力封装为可组合组件（约束管理、布局与合法化、可布线性与电性能的轻量评估）；LLM基于初始与演进设计的多模态检查点选择并组合组件，构建及修订自有布局流程；通过重开模块或划分重组器件来调整布局层次；并引入经验技能库提供可复用设计知识以指导决策。
AI.result: 在SMIC 180nm的两个电路上评估，框架减小了布局面积，且改善了多数测量的后布局性能指标。
AI.conclusion: 以LLM作为流程构建者而非固定流程执行器，配合可组合组件、多模态检查点和层次自适应，可有效实现电路特定的模拟布局权衡；经验技能机制为决策提供可复用知识支撑。

title: Non-Markovian quantum-emitter dynamics and bound-state formation in an Aubry--André--Harper photonic lattice
summary: In non-Markovian light-matter interactions, a spectrally structured bath can alter the evolution of a quantum emitter by modifying the vacuum fluctuations experienced by the emitter. This raises the question of how the localization transition and the associated multifractal critical modes induced by a quasiperiodic potential shape the emitter dynamics. We investigate this scenario in the single-excitation sector for a two-level quantum emitter coupled to an Aubry-André-Harper (AAH) photonic lattice. By externally tuning the strength of the quasiperiodic onsite modulation, the lattice is tuned from the extended to the localized regime through a critical point characterized by multifractal modes. Using modal analysis, we show that the quasiperiodic modulation reshapes the local density of states at the coupling site and thereby controls the effective spectral coupling between the emitter and the lattice. The transient dynamics depend strongly on the spatial and spectral overlap between the emitter and the lattice modes: extended modes below the critical modulation generally produce rapid depopulation, whereas critical and localized modes give rise to coherent back-action and persistent Rabi-like oscillations, with particularly pronounced behavior at the critical point. We further identify emitter-photon bound states whose formation is controlled by the quasiperiodic spectral structure of the bath and whose overlap with the initially excited state leads to partial long-time population trapping. These results establish a direct connection between quasiperiodic localization, non-Markovian dynamics, and emitter-photon bound-state formation.

AI.tldr: 该工作在单激发子空间研究二能级量子发射体与Aubry-André-Harper (AAH)光子晶格耦合的非马尔可夫动力学，揭示准周期局域化转变与多重分形临界模式对发射体演化和发射体-光子束缚态形成的调控作用。
AI.motivation: 非马尔可夫光-物质相互作用中，谱结构化的热库可通过改变真空涨落影响量子发射体的演化。然而，由准周期势诱导的局域化转变及其伴随的多重分形临界模式如何塑造发射体动力学，尚不清楚。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在单激发子空间，将单个二能级发射体耦合到AAH光子晶格；通过外部调节准周期格点调制的强度，使晶格从扩展态经多重分形临界点过渡到局域态。采用模式分析（modal analysis），计算耦合位点的局域态密度（LDOS）及有效谱耦合，并分析瞬态动力学与束缚态。
AI.result: 准周期调制重塑耦合位点的LDOS，从而调控发射体与晶格间的有效谱耦合。瞬态动力学强烈依赖于发射体与晶格模式在空间和谱上的重叠：临界调制以下的扩展模式通常导致快速布居衰减；临界与局域模式则引起相干反馈和持续的类Rabi振荡，且在临界点行为尤为显著。此外，识别出由热库准周期谱结构控制的发射体-光子束缚态，其与初始激发态的重叠导致部分长时布居俘获。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了准周期局域化、非马尔可夫动力学与发射体-光子束缚态形成之间的直接联系，表明AAH型谱结构可作为调控量子发射体相干动力学与布居俘获的有效手段。

title: DeFT-RAG: Incrementally Decomposing Multi-Hop Questions into Self-Contained Sub-Questions with Reusable Answers
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) lets a large language model (LLM) answer questions by retrieving relevant passages from a large corpus. However, RAG struggles with multi-hop questions, which require chaining facts spread across several documents through intermediate entities that the question never mentions. Graph-based RAG methods retrieve once from the entities a question names and so rarely recover the full evidence chain. Iterative RAG methods recover it step by step, but their accuracy is limited by the many tasks they ask the LLM to perform, such as planning the sub-questions, deciding their dependencies, rewriting them as answers arrive, and keeping track of what is known. We propose DeFT-RAG, a RAG framework built on three components. First, DeFT-RAG generates one self-contained sub-question at a time from the original question and the sub-questions answered so far with their answers (QA pairs). Each sub-question names every entity it asks about, which removes the need to plan, track dependencies or rewrite, and lets the LLM focus on a single fine-grained task at a time. Second, DeFT-RAG moves the remaining LLM work outside the LLM: rule-based updates to a QA table that keeps track of what is known, and yes/no decisions made by a fine-tuned lightweight decision model. Third, DeFT-RAG caches the QA pairs and reuses an answer when a later question asks a sub-question with the same meaning. On MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA and HotpotQA, DeFT-RAG achieves the best accuracy among thirteen baselines with both gpt-4o-mini and Qwen3.6 as the backbone, while giving the LLM fewer input tokens than any other iterative method. With a QA cache shared across 1,000 MuSiQue questions, 23.1% of sub-questions are answered from the cache, which reduces LLM calls by 12.9% without lowering accuracy.

AI.tldr: DeFT-RAG 通过一次只生成一个自包含子问题、将判断与状态维护移出 LLM，并引入问答缓存，在多跳问答上取得最优准确率且输入 token 最少。
AI.motivation: RAG 难以处理需要跨文档串联中间实体事实的多跳问题：基于图的方法只从问题显式实体出发检索一次，难以覆盖完整证据链；迭代式 RAG 虽逐步检索，但让 LLM 同时承担子问题规划、依赖判定、改写与状态跟踪等多项任务，导致准确率受限。
AI.method: 提出三个组件：(1) 每次仅基于原问题与已作答的 QA 对生成一个自包含子问题，每个子问题显式命名其所涉及的实体，从而无需规划、依赖跟踪与改写，使 LLM 一次只专注单一细粒度任务；(2) 将剩余 LLM 工作外移，用规则更新记录已知信息的 QA 表，并用微调后的轻量决策模型完成是否类判断；(3) 缓存 QA 对，当后续子问题语义相同时复用已有答案。
AI.result: 在 MuSiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA 与 HotpotQA 上，以 gpt-4o-mini 和 Qwen3.6 为骨干时，DeFT-RAG 在 13 个基线中准确率最优，且输入 token 少于任何其他迭代式方法；在 1000 道 MuSiQue 问题共享 QA 缓存时，23.1% 的子问题由缓存作答，LLM 调用减少 12.9% 且准确率不下降。
AI.conclusion: 通过简化 LLM 每步任务、将符号化判断与状态管理外置并复用缓存，可在不牺牲准确率的前提下显著降低多跳 RAG 的 token 与调用开销。

title: Think Twice: The Metis-1.6 Technical Report
comment: 39 pages, 4 figures, 17 tables. Models and benchmark data: https://huggingface.co/Lernex
summary: Metis is a bet that better data, better training methods and new architectures can buy what a bigger parameter count cannot, at a fraction of the cost. Metis-1.6 is its latest step: two language models built from scratch by a single researcher, Praxis (2.94B parameters, 0.46B active per pass) and Logos (10.23B parameters, 1.18B active per pass). Both run a hybrid Mamba-2 and attention mixture-of-experts stack twice for every token, so each token gets a second look. Each was trained on 1.02T tokens in total: 804.76B of pretraining, 18B of context extension to 131,072 tokens, and 200B of supervised fine-tuning. Metis-1.6 was never meant to challenge frontier models, and across 40 post-trained benchmarks it mostly does not: Logos averages 52.93, seventh of 17 models in its comparison set and within a point of Qwen3-4B. But it gets there on roughly a twelfth of the median training data of the comparators that disclose it, and with fewer active parameters per token than any model that beats it, which puts it on the Pareto frontier for both. In mathematics it ranks second of 30 models, with 67.50% on AIME 2025 and 63.64% on HMMT February 2026. It is weak at code, instruction following and long context. The rest of the report is the part I found most valuable: what went wrong. The optimizer I configured never ran, and attention trained with AdamW for all of pretraining. A 1.77B-parameter n-gram memory learned to switch itself off. Five fine-tuning choices cost capability. And a length reward under group-mean normalization punished correct solutions for being long once a group's pass rate passed 2/3, a sign inversion I prove and fix with a one-line clamp. I close with the 10B-token ablations behind MoRE (Mixture of Recursive Experts), the looped architecture of Metis-1.7.

AI.tldr: Metis-1.6 是由单人研究者从零构建的两个小型 MoE 语言模型 Praxis（2.94B 总参/0.46B 激活）与 Logos（10.23B/1.18B 激活），采用 Mamba-2+注意力的混合 MoE 并对每个 token 计算两次；各训练 1.02T token。模型虽不挑战前沿，但以约同侪 1/12 的数据量与最少的激活参数处于帕累托前沿，数学表现突出（AIME 2025 67.50%），代码、指令遵循与长上下文较弱；报告主体是失败复盘，包括优化器未生效、n-gram 记忆自关闭、五项微调取舍及长度奖励符号反转问题。
AI.motivation: 验证"更好的数据、训练方法与新架构可以替代参数规模扩张、且成本更低"这一假设，探索单人研究者以极小资源从零训练可用语言模型的可行性，并公开失败经验以提升研究透明度。
AI.method: 构建 Praxis（2.94B 总参、0.46B 激活）与 Logos（10.23B 总参、1.18B 激活）两个模型；架构为 Mamba-2 与注意力混合的 MoE，每 token 经过该堆栈两次（二次计算）；训练总计 1.02T token，其中预训练 804.76B、上下文扩展 18B（至 131,072 token）、监督微调 200B；另含 1.77B 参数 n-gram 记忆模块与后续 MoRE（Mixture of Recursive Experts）循环架构的 10B token 消融实验。
AI.result: 在 40 项后训练基准上 Logos 平均 52.93 分，在 17 个对比模型中列第七，与 Qwen3-4B 相差约 1 分；所用训练数据约为披露数据的同侪中位数的 1/12，且优于它的模型激活参数均更多，因而在数据量与激活参数两个维度上均处于帕累托前沿。数学能力排名 30 个模型中第二（AIME 2025 67.50%、HMMT February 2026 63.64%）。代码、指令遵循与长上下文较弱。
AI.conclusion: 方法有效性得到部分验证但存在明显短板；报告详述关键失败：配置的优化器从未运行、注意力全程使用 AdamW 训练；1.77B 参数 n-gram 记忆模块学会自我关闭；五项微调选择损害能力；组均值归一化下的长度奖励在组通过率超过 2/3 后惩罚长正确答案，属符号反转，作者给出证明并用以单行 clamp 修复；并附支撑 Metis-1.7 循环架构 MoRE 的 10B token 消融。

title: Classifying Urban Locations by Cyclist Facility Usage and Directional Alignment: A Validated Camera-Based Framework from Multi-Site Observations
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Accepted for presentation at the 106th Transportation Research Board (TRB) Annual Meeting, Washington, D.C., January 10-14, 2027
summary:
Objectives: Agencies invest in bicycle facilities but lack tools to assess whether cyclists use them as designed. We examine whether usage patterns follow facility configurations and whether higher bike lane usage is associated with less wrong-way riding.
  Methods: Motion-triggered cameras covered 19 deployments at 17 locations in Tempe, Arizona, in 2023. Manual review identified 1,963 cycling events; excluding 20 crossings left 1,943 labeled events for analysis. An automated pipeline on the same captures counted 92.9 percent of the full manual total (per-deployment r = 0.99), and every automated wrong-way call was visually verified.
