Deployments were classified using thresholds on facility usage shares.
  Findings: Deployments were bike-lane dominant (9), sidewalk dominant (6), or mixed (4). Cyclists in bike lanes rode against the flow in 4.6 percent of events; on sidewalks, riders opposed the near-side traffic flow in 49.6 percent. Across deployments, bike lane share and wrong-way rate were negatively correlated (Spearman rho = -0.87, p < 0.001, n = 16). An independent volunteer count in the same city showed a similar sidewalk-direction pattern (rho = 0.79).
  Novelty: The study combines multi-site still-camera observations with a fully hand-verified benchmark to characterize facility use and travel direction.
  Practical Applications: The workflow offers planners a low-cost screen for locations with high sidewalk cycling and travel against the near-side traffic flow, supporting more detailed site investigation.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用多地点运动触发相机与全人工核验的计数基准，刻画自行车设施使用结构与逆行行为的关系，发现自行车道使用占比越高，逆行率越低，并提出低成本筛查工作流。
AI.motivation: 管理机构投资自行车设施，却缺乏评估骑行者是否按设计方式使用设施的工具；尤其需要判断设施配置是否与实际使用模式匹配，以及车道使用是否与更少的逆行行为相关。
AI.method: 2023年在亚利桑那州坦佩17个地点开展19次部署，采用运动触发相机抓拍。人工复核识别1,963起骑行事件，剔除20起穿越事件后保留1,943起用于分析；同一影像上的自动流水线计数达到人工总量的92.9%（各部署 r = 0.99），且每一次自动逆行判定均经视觉核验。依据设施使用份额阈值将部署分为自行车道主导、人行道主导与混合三类。
AI.result: 部署构型为自行车道主导9处、人行道主导6处、混合4处。自行车道内骑行者逆行占4.6%；人行道上骑行者逆向于近侧车流方向的比例为49.6%。跨部署分析中，自行车道使用份额与逆行率呈负相关（Spearman rho = -0.87，p < 0.001，n = 16）。同城一项独立志愿者计数显示类似的人行道方向模式（rho = 0.79）。
AI.conclusion: 设施使用结构（车道与人行道的份额分配）与逆行行为强相关，自行车道主导的部署逆行率显著更低。多地点静帧相机结合全人工核验基准的方法可稳健刻画设施使用与行进方向；该流程为规划者提供了低成本筛查工具，用于识别人行道骑行高发及逆向近侧车流的点位，支持后续更细致的现场调查。

title: FilingLoop: Evaluating and Evolving LLM Agents for Corporate Disclosure Review and Revision
summary: Public disclosure repositories such as SEC EDGAR support informed investment through web access to corporate filings. Supporting their review with language model agents requires discovering unstated deficiencies across related documents, acquiring missing company facts, and verifying that requested revisions satisfy evidence-backed requirements. Existing financial question-answering evaluations provide limited evidence of these interactive capabilities. We introduce \textbf{FilingLoop}, an interactive benchmark and a self-evolving agent framework for corporate disclosure review and revision. Grounded in historical U.S.\ Securities and Exchange Commission correspondence, FilingLoop reconstructs 380 predominantly IPO review tasks from 96 companies under distinct information constraints. An evaluator separate from the acting agents scores final filings and responses against 6,099 eligible requirements and audits unsupported claims and harmful revisions. Our framework couples iterative review and revision within each case with procedural learning across cases, converting requirement-level evaluation feedback into role-specific guidance without updating model weights. Updates affect only subsequent cases, allowing procedural adaptation to be assessed without retrying scored tasks. On the evaluated stream, evolution increases requirement fulfillment from 24.28\% to 27.96\% and full comment resolution from 16.90\% to 20.75\%, with a 5.8\% increase in total cost over the fixed-policy variant. FilingLoop connects the concerns an agent discovers with the company facts it obtains and the revisions it commits, providing requirement-level feedback for procedures used in later review tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 FilingLoop：基于 SEC 历史意见函构建的交互式基准与自演化智能体框架，用于公司信息披露文件的审阅与修改，通过跨案例程序性学习提升需求满足率。
AI.motivation: 现有财务问答评测难以体现"发现未明示缺陷—获取缺失事实—验证修改证据充分性"这类交互能力，缺乏对企业披露文件审阅与修订过程的评估手段。
AI.method: 以 SEC 历史往来函件为基础，从 96 家公司重构 380 个以 IPO 审阅为主、信息约束各异的任务；由独立于执行智能体的评测器基于 6,099 条合规要求打分，并审计无依据声明与有害修改。框架在案例内耦合迭代审阅与修订，在案例间进行程序性学习，将要求级反馈转化为角色特定指导，不更新模型权重，且更新仅作用于后续案例。
AI.result: 在评测流上，需求满足率由 24.28% 提升至 27.96%，完整意见解决率由 16.90% 提升至 20.75%，总成本较固定策略变体增加 5.8%。
AI.conclusion: FilingLoop 将智能体发现的关注点、获取的公司事实与所做修改相连接，并提供要求级反馈以改进后续审阅任务所用程序，为披露审阅中的交互式能力提供了可量化评估。

title: Learning Latent Fields in Multiobject Tracking
summary: Multiobject tracking using measurements from ar- rays of wireless sensors is a key task in applications ranging from autonomous navigation to public safety. Many existing methods compress raw complex-valued signals into detections or intensity maps during preprocessing, thereby discarding poten- tially relevant information about the objects and the propagation environment. We propose a Bayesian framework for multiobject tracking that relates object states to raw complex-valued signals via a physics-based superpositional model. The model combines a physics-based array manifold, such as radar steering vectors or the replica vectors of matched-field processing, with a latent field. This latent field is a family of context-dependent signal- power distributions that captures the effects of the objects and the propagation environment and is shared across objects and time. It is parameterized by a conditional normalizing flow, which is trained during runtime without labeled data by maximizing an evidence lower bound (ELBO) derived from the Bayesian model. Learning and inference are thus coupled in a sequential framework. We evaluate the method in simulation and in real-world radio and acoustic experiments, with spatial scales ranging from meters to kilometers, and show that it outperforms detection-based methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种贝叶斯多目标跟踪框架，直接利用原始复数无线信号，通过物理阵列流形与条件归一化流建模的隐场相结合，在运行时无标签地最大化ELBO进行学习与推理耦合。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在预处理阶段将原始复数信号压缩为检测结果或强度图，丢弃了关于目标与传播环境的潜在相关信息。
AI.method: 构建将目标状态与原始复数信号通过基于物理的叠加模型关联的贝叶斯框架；模型结合物理阵列流形（如雷达导向矢量或匹配场处理的副本矢量）与一个隐场；隐场为上下文相关的信号功率分布族，刻画目标与传播环境影响并在目标与时间间共享，由条件归一化流参数化，运行时通过最大化由贝叶斯模型导出的ELBO无标签训练，实现学习与推理的顺序耦合。
AI.result: 在仿真及真实无线电与声学实验中（空间尺度从米到千米）进行评估，性能优于基于检测的方法。
AI.conclusion: 直接在原始信号层面进行贝叶斯建模可避免预处理信息损失，且无需标注数据即可在线学习传播环境表征，具有跨尺度适用性。

title: NORmal: Architecting 3D Ferroelectric NOR Flash as Main Memory -- From Co-Fabricated BEOL Arrays to 200B-Class Multi-Agent LLMs in a Smartphone
summary: Smartphone agents increasingly work as teams, in which a large planner directs parallel workers across long sessions. Running such a team on the device requires 200B-class models and contexts that exceed phone DRAM many times over, yet existing tiers treat flash as storage: UFS starves per-token weight streaming, and mobile High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) needs a redesigned SoC and cannot absorb continuous KV writes. We show that a non-volatile memory can join an unmodified LPDDR6 bus as a plain rank only if its access latency fits the DRAM timing window, a condition no NAND tier meets. We present NORmal, to our knowledge the first main-memory architecture for 3D ferroelectric NOR flash. We have fabricated and experimentally characterized back-end-of-line (BEOL) 3D FeNOR arrays that co-integrate dense 3-bit MLC and fast, high-endurance in-place-writable SLC with sub-7.5 ns sensing. NORmal turns these co-fabricated arrays into a byte-addressable, deterministic-timing load/store rank on an unmodified LPDDR6 interface through an under-array DRAM-emulation bridge, staggered bank reads with zero-cycle weight swizzling, and posted SLC writes. Across this rank and DRAM, NORmal places agent state by mutability and lifetime rather than by hotness, serving 200B-class models and persistent planner contexts in place while dynamically partitioning subchannels across agent phases. In serving-level simulation on production agent traces, NORmal is 8.9$\times$--28.0$\times$ faster than UFS offloading, within 0.4% of an unlimited-DRAM ideal, and 2.8$\times$--6.3$\times$ faster than HBF on sessions beyond 256K tokens, with 8.1$\times$--17.8$\times$ less memory energy per token.

AI.tldr: NORmal 是首个面向 3D 铁电 NOR 闪存的主存架构，通过将 BEOL 3D FeNOR 阵列（3-bit MLC + 高耐久 SLC）经 DRAM 仿真桥接入未修改的 LPDDR6 总线，实现按可变性与生命周期（而非热度）放置智能体状态的异构主存，支撑 200B 级模型与长会话规划上下文。
AI.motivation: 智能手机智能体以"大规划器 + 并行 worker"的团队形态运行长会话，需 200B 级模型和远超手机 DRAM 容量的上下文。现有分层方案把闪存当存储：UFS 无法满足逐 token 权重流式读取的带宽，移动 HBF 需重设计 SoC 且无法承受持续 KV 写入。核心洞察是：非易失存储器只有在其访问延迟落入 DRAM 时序窗口时，才能作为普通 rank 挂载于未修改的 LPDDR6 总线，而现有 NAND 层级均不满足。
AI.method: 作者流片并实验表征了 BEOL 3D FeNOR 阵列，共集成高密度 3-bit MLC 与快速高耐久、可原位写入的 SLC（感测 <7.5 ns）。NORmal 通过三项机制将其变为字节可寻址、时序确定的 load/store rank：阵列下方的 DRAM 仿真桥、错峰 bank 读取配合零周期权重 swizzling、posted SLC 写。状态放置依据可变性与生命周期而非访问热度，并在智能体各阶段动态划分 subchannel。
AI.result: 在生产级智能体 trace 上的服务级模拟中：较 UFS offloading 快 8.9×–28.0×，与无限 DRAM 理想方案相差 0.4% 以内；在超过 256K token 的会话中较 HBF 快 2.8×–6.3×，每 token 访存能耗低 8.1×–17.8×。
AI.conclusion: 3D 铁电 NOR 闪存可在未修改的 LPDDR6 接口上作为主存级 rank 使用，使端侧智能体团队在有限 DRAM 下近乎达到"无限 DRAM"的推理性能，并在长上下文场景全面优于 UFS offloading 与移动 HBF。

title: Partially temporal coherent spatiotemporal Laguerre-Gaussian and its propagation dynamics
summary: Optical spatiotemporal vortices carrying transverse photonic orbital angular momentum have become an intense research topic in the recent study of structured light fields. Despite being mainly studied within the framework of fully coherent optical pulses, the complex topologies of the light field are also investigated with partially coherent light sources, offering an alternative pathway in applications. In this work, we theoretically and experimentally investigate partially temporally coherent spatiotemporal Laguerre-Gaussian (STLG) field with independently controllable radial and azimuthal indices. The spatiotemporal topological information, carried by the structured amplified spontaneous emission source, are well preserved in the presence of inherent instantaneous random temporal phase fluctuations. Under combined spatiotemporal astigmatism and group velocity dispersion, the partially temporally coherent STLG field can be converted into spatiotemporal Hermite-Gaussian (STHG) field. Both structures maintain their spatiotemporal characteristics after propagating through scattering media. Partially temporally coherent structured light fields may offer new insights into photonic topology and complex wave dynamics, with potential applications in high-fidelity optical communications and high-dimensional information processing in highly scattering environments.

AI.tldr: 该工作从理论与实验上研究部分时间相干时空拉盖尔-高斯(STLG)场，其径向与角向指数可独立调控；拓扑信息在随机时间相位涨落下保持良好，并在时空像散与群速度色散作用下转换为时空厄米-高斯(STHG)场，两种结构经散射介质后仍保持时空特性。
AI.motivation: 携带横向光子轨道角动量的光时空涡旋是结构光研究热点，但多在全相干脉冲框架下讨论；部分相干光源下的复杂拓扑研究提供替代路径，故需探索部分时间相干下的时空拓扑结构及其可调控性与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 以结构化放大自发辐射(ASE)源产生部分时间相干STLG场，独立调控径向与角向指数；分析瞬时随机时间相位涨落对时空拓扑信息的影响；在时空像散与群速度色散联合作用下实现STLG到STHG的转换；并进行经散射介质传输的实验验证。
AI.result: STLG场的时空拓扑信息在固有瞬时随机时间相位涨落下得到良好保留；在时空像散与群速度色散共同作用下可转换为STHG场；STLG与STHG两种结构经散射介质传播后均保持其时空特性。
AI.conclusion: 部分时间相干结构光场为光子拓扑与复杂波动力学研究提供新视角，在高保真光通信及强散射环境中的高维信息处理方面具有潜在应用价值。

title: Human-Residual Steering: Aligning Frozen LLM Judges with Human Judgment Distributions
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used as automated judges, yet most alignment methods target aggregated human judgments and overlook variation among individual annotators. Existing approaches to matching the full distribution of human ratings mainly rely on output-level calibration or parameter fine-tuning. We propose Human-Residual Steering (HRS), to our knowledge the first method to align frozen LLM judges with human judgment distributions through learned hidden-state interventions. An oracle analysis shows that low-rank corrections at a single layer remove most of the discrepancy between judge and human distributions. HRS learns to predict such corrections from the judge's hidden representation and rating logits, training on individual annotations with proper scoring rules for ordinal and nominal judgments and optimising through the frozen downstream layers. Across 14 benchmarks and four judges from three model families, HRS outperforms all evaluated frozen-weight baselines. With Qwen2.5-7B, it achieves the lowest Jensen-Shannon distance on 13 of 14 benchmarks, reducing the mean from 0.565 to 0.352 versus 0.377 for the strongest calibrator. HRS also raises mean Spearman correlation with aggregate human scores from 0.449 to 0.579, improves population-level estimation under limited annotation budgets, and trains about 88 times fewer parameters than distributional fine-tuning at a modest cost in alignment.

AI.tldr: HRS提出在冻结LLM的隐藏状态上学习低秩残差干预，将自动评审与人类评分分布对齐，14个基准中13个取得最优JSD。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评审对齐方法多针对聚合的人类评分，忽略标注者个体差异；已有分布级对齐依赖输出层校准或参数微调，成本高且未利用内部表征。
AI.method: 先做oracle分析，证明单层低秩修正可消除评审与人类分布间大部分差异；随后HRS以评审的隐藏表示与评分logits为输入，学习预测该低秩修正，在个体标注上以适用于序数/名义判断的proper scoring rules训练，并穿过冻结的下游层反向优化。
AI.result: 在14个基准、3个模型家族的4个评审模型上，HRS优于所有冻结权重基线；Qwen2.5-7B上13/14基准JSD最低，均值由0.565降至0.352（最强校准器为0.377）；平均Spearman由0.449升至0.579，并提升有限标注预算下的人群级估计；可训练参数约为分布微调的1/88。
AI.conclusion: 通过隐状态层面的低秩残差干预，可在不修改主干参数的前提下实现个体标注者分布级对齐，兼具高效性与跨模型泛化性。

title: TERRA: Task-Oriented Edge AI for Regional Fire Detection with Identity-Free Reporting
comment: Accepted for publication at the 16th International Conference on the Internet of Things (IoT 2026)
summary: Distributed fire-monitoring systems may involve many sensing devices reporting over a shared uplink, even though the operational objective is often to identify regions exhibiting evidence of fire rather than to recover device-specific measurements. We introduce TERRA (Task-Oriented Edge Representation and Regional Aggregation), an edge-AI framework that combines task-oriented local inference, identity-free region-tagged reporting, and permutation-invariant regional evidence aggregation. TERRA supports two reporting modes: TERRA-Score, in which each device communicates a quantized local fire probability, and TERRA-Feature, in which it communicates a compact learned representation for receiver-side aggregation using a permutation-invariant DeepSets model. Using all 15 numerical sensing modalities of the distributed indoor EN54 fire-alarm dataset as a proof-of-concept testbed, we evaluate regional inference for an episode-level fire-scenario target under repetition-disjoint three-fold cross-validation. We study representation size, task-payload quantization, report availability, and robustness to missed and false recovered messages. With nine reports and perfect message recovery, TERRA-Feature achieves mean AUPRC 0.990 using a 24-bit task payload, while TERRA-Score achieves 0.987 using only 6 bits; both attain an MDR of 1.81% at FAR $\leq$1%. TERRA-Feature achieves slightly higher AUPRC under reliable recovery, whereas the more compact TERRA-Score is less sensitive to increasing false-message contamination.

AI.tldr: 提出边缘AI框架TERRA，将任务导向本地推理、无身份区域标签上报与置换不变区域证据聚合结合，实现分布式火灾监测的区域级推断，并在EN54数据集上验证其在上报开销与鲁棒性间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 分布式火灾监测系统中大量传感设备共享上行链路，而系统目标往往是识别存在火灾证据的区域，而非恢复各设备的特定测量值，因此存在以任务为中心、降低上报开销并保持区域推断性能的需求。
AI.method: TERRA包含两级模式：TERRA-Score由设备上报量化后的本地火灾概率；TERRA-Feature由设备上报紧凑学习表征，接收端用置换不变的DeepSets模型聚合。采用无身份的区标签上报，并使用EN54分布式室内火灾报警数据集全部15种数值传感模态作为概念验证平台，在按重复划分的三折交叉验证下评估区域级火灾场景推断，考察表征大小、任务载荷量化、上报可用性以及对漏检和误恢复消息的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在9条上报且消息完美恢复条件下，TERRA-Feature以24比特任务载荷达到平均AUPRC 0.990；TERRA-Score仅用6比特即达0.987；两者在FAR≤1%时MDR均为1.81%。可靠恢复下TERRA-Feature的AUPRC略高，而更紧凑的TERRA-Score对虚假消息污染的敏感性更低。
AI.conclusion: 任务导向的区域聚合可在极低上报开销下实现高精度区域火灾推断；表征大小与鲁棒性之间存在权衡，紧凑的分数式上报更适合信道污染较重的场景。

title: Vision Tomography: Towards Portable 3D Bidirectional Face-Skull Inference from Visual Data
summary: Traditional computed tomography (CT) can capture paired 3D face and skull geometry, but it remains costly, fixed in location, and exposes patients to radiation. For applications such as remote diagnostics, digital healthcare, forensic identification, missing-person investigation, and archaeological analysis, there is an urgent need for a portable, safe, and accessible solution to capture 3D skull geometry. In this work, we introduce Vision Tomography (VT), a concept and framework capable of reconstructing paired 3D face-skull geometry from various visual modalities, and also enabling joint manipulation of 3D facial and skull geometry. To achieve this, we first construct a dataset of over 200 samples, where each case includes a CT-based skull, a CT-based face, and a high-fidelity textured face scan. Secondly, we propose a novel dense ray matching registration method that ensures topological consistency across face, skull, and their tissue correspondences. Building on this registration, we introduce the 3D Bidirectional Face-Skull Morphable Model (BFSM) as the foundation of Vision Tomography, which enables shape inference between the face and skull through a shared coefficient space, while also modeling tissue thickness variation to support one-to-many facial reconstructions from the same skull, reflecting individual facial changes such as age or body fat. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of Vision Tomography across various forensic and medical applications, including paired 3D face-skull reconstruction from images or sketches and predicting surgical outcomes with joint face-skull editing. Extensive experiments confirm the robustness and accuracy of our method. Vision Tomography is available at https://github.com/wang-zidu/BFSM

AI.tldr: 提出"视觉断层扫描"(VT)框架，从图像/素描等视觉模态重建配对3D人脸-颅骨几何，核心是稠密射线匹配配准与双向人脸-颅骨可变形模型(BFSM)。
AI.motivation: CT可获得配对的人脸与颅骨3D几何，但成本高、地点固定且有辐射。远程诊断、数字医疗、身份识别、失踪人员调查与考古等场景亟需便携、安全、易获取的3D颅骨几何采集方案。
AI.method: 1) 构建200+样本数据集，每例含CT颅骨、CT人脸与高保真纹理人脸扫描；2) 提出稠密射线匹配配准方法，保证人脸、颅骨及其软组织对应关系的拓扑一致性；3) 构建3D双向人脸-颅骨可变形模型(BFSM)，通过共享系数空间实现人脸与颅骨间形状互推，并建模软组织厚度变化以支持同一颅骨的一对多面部重建（如年龄、体脂变化）。
AI.result: 在图像或素描驱动的配对3D人脸-颅骨重建、以及联合人脸-颅骨编辑预测手术效果等法医与医学应用中验证有效；大量实验确认方法的鲁棒性与准确性。
AI.conclusion: VT提供了便携、无辐射、可及性强的替代方案，实现视觉模态到配对人脸-颅骨几何的重建与联合操控；方法有效且开源(BFSM)。

title: Beyond Low-Pass Dynamics: Frequency-Selective Spiking Reservoirs with Resonant Neurons
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 30 pages (10 main text), 4 figures. Code: https://github.com/AuroraMicheli/HRF-Res
summary: Spiking reservoir computing combines the training efficiency of fixed recurrent reservoirs with the energy efficiency of event-driven inference, where computation is triggered by sparse spikes rather than executed densely at every timestep. However, existing spiking reservoirs almost exclusively rely on Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neurons, whose low-pass dynamics limit their ability to distinguish information encoded at different temporal frequencies. We introduce HRF-Res, a liquid state machine in which LIF neurons are replaced by a heterogeneous population of Harmonic Resonate-and-Fire (HRF) neurons. These neurons exhibit intrinsic oscillatory dynamics and selectively respond to input frequencies, enabling the reservoir to capture frequency-specific temporal patterns. The result is more discriminative representations and higher classification accuracy than LIF-based reservoirs, achieved without sacrificing the energy efficiency of spiking computation, with up to 19x lower energy consumption than an equivalent non-spiking oscillatory reservoir. Evaluated on ten benchmarks spanning time series, sequential images, audio spike trains, and neuromorphic vision, HRF-Res achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among spiking reservoir methods. These results demonstrate that introducing frequency-selective dynamics into spiking reservoirs improves representational quality and classification performance while preserving their inherent energy efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出HRF-Res，用异构谐振-发放（HRF）神经元群替换LIF神经元构建液态状态机储备池，实现频率选择性时间动态表征，在十个基准上取得脉冲储备池方法中的最优精度，且能耗显著低于非脉冲振荡储备池。
AI.motivation: 现有脉冲储备池几乎全部依赖LIF神经元，其低通动态难以区分不同时间频率上编码的信息，限制了储备池表征的判别力。
AI.method: 构建液态状态机HRF-Res：以异构的Harmonic Resonate-and-Fire（HRF）神经元群替代LIF神经元，利用其内在振荡动态与对输入频率的选择性响应，使储备池捕获频率特异的时间模式；储备池保持固定、仅训练读出层，推理为事件驱动的稀疏脉冲计算。
AI.result: 相比LIF储备池获得更具判别力的表征与更高分类精度；相较等效非脉冲振荡储备池能耗最高降低19倍；在涵盖时间序列、序列图像、音频脉冲串与神经形态视觉的十个基准上，达到脉冲储备池方法中的SOTA精度。
AI.conclusion: 在脉冲储备池中引入频率选择动态可提升表征质量与分类性能，同时保持脉冲计算固有的能效优势。

title: Waveform Bandwidth and Frequency Diversity in FDA-MIMO Range-Angle Estimation: A CRLB Perspective
summary: Frequency-diverse array multiple-input multiple-output (FDA-MIMO) radar introduces range-dependent phase diversity through element-dependent carrier-frequency offsets, in addition to the delay information carried by transmitted waveforms. This paper develops a bandwidth-aware Cramer-Rao lower bound (CRLB) framework to characterize how these two mechanisms jointly affect range-angle estimation. Starting from a Nyquist-rate sampled observation model that retains waveform delays and FDA frequency offsets, we derive an equivalent Fisher information matrix (EFIM) after eliminating an unknown quasi-static complex scattering coefficient as a nuisance parameter. We derive closed-form CRLB approximations that reveal the interplay between waveform root-mean-square (RMS) bandwidth and FDA frequency diversity. A three-factor decomposition of the squared normalized cross-information further characterizes range-angle coupling. Results show that when increased independently, both waveform RMS bandwidth and FDA frequency diversity reduce the range CRLB, but FDA frequency diversity increases the angle CRLB at fixed nonzero waveform bandwidth, whereas waveform RMS bandwidth reduces it. Additionally, under a fixed aggregate spectral budget, the range CRLB exhibits an interior maximum, whereas the angle CRLB increases monotonically with the FDA spectral-allocation fraction. Numerical results corroborate the closed-form approximations and the predicted trends.

AI.tldr: 论文提出带宽感知的CRLB框架，解析刻画波形RMS带宽与FDA频率分集对FDA-MIMO雷达距离-角度联合估计的耦合作用，给出闭式近似与三因子分解，并揭示固定频谱预算下的距离CRLB内部极大值等非单调规律。
AI.motivation: FDA-MIMO雷达通过阵元载频偏移提供与距离相关的相位分集，与波形时延信息并存，但两类机制如何联合影响距离-角度估计精度缺乏定量的理论刻画，尤其在带宽资源受限条件下缺少可解释的性能界与设计准则。
AI.method: 建立保留波形时延与FDA频偏的Nyquist采样观测模型；将未知准静态复散射系数作为冗余参数消去后推导等效Fisher信息矩阵（EFIM）；据此给出闭式CRLB近似，并对归一化交叉信息平方作三因子分解以刻画距离-角度耦合；最后用数值仿真验证。
AI.result: 单独增大波形RMS带宽或FDA频率分集均可降低距离CRLB；但在波形带宽固定且非零时，FDA频率分集反而使角度CRLB升高，而波形RMS带宽可降低角度CRLB。在总频谱预算固定时，距离CRLB随FDA频谱分配比例呈内部极大值，角度CRLB则单调递增。数值结果与闭式近似及趋势预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 波形时延与FDA频偏两种距离信息来源在估计性能上并非简单叠加，存在显著的距离-角度耦合与带宽权衡；所提带宽感知EFIM/CRLB框架可为FDA-MIMO雷达的频谱与带宽资源配置提供解析设计依据。

title: A Case Study of a Multi-Agent Kernel-Optimization Loop That Learns a New AI Accelerator
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Round 1 of the NPU Model Optimization Competition at MICRO 2026. Code: https://github.com/bgchun-fs/multi-agent-kernel-gen-loop
summary: Frontier large language models write correct CUDA kernels for most single-operator benchmark tasks, yet their accuracy collapses on accelerators whose architecture and programming language they have rarely seen. We present a case study of an LLM agent loop built for such accelerators. Our example is the FuriosaAI RNGD NPU, programmed in a recent, sparsely documented Rust DSL, where the loop optimized three Gemma-4-12B decode kernels over 12 days on a shared, scarce device. The loop builds its own target knowledge: it writes and checks a summary of the DSL documentation, measures the chip with microbenchmarks, records compiler-derived legality rules, and revisits this knowledge when the toolchain changes, rechecking rules and measurements where it can. A role-based search over per-kernel Design Trees explores whole-kernel designs and accumulates small accepted changes in the best version of each kernel. Because device time is scarce and readings are noisy, cheap checks screen new designs before any device run, and late in the run a change was accepted only after repeated comparisons with the best kernel on the device. The final kernels reach a 9.293x geomean speedup over the official baseline, each within 1.25x of the cycles needed just to move its weights. Our prompts, profiler and acceptance test are available at https://github.com/bgchun-fs/multi-agent-kernel-gen-loop.

AI.tldr: 面向架构与语言文档稀疏的新加速器（FuriosaAI RNGD NPU、Rust DSL），构建LLM智能体循环，通过自建目标知识、角色化设计树搜索与噪声鲁棒的分层验收，12天内在稀缺共享设备上优化3个Gemma-4-12B解码kernel，取得9.293倍几何平均加速。
AI.motivation: 前沿大模型在常见单算子基准上能写出正确CUDA kernel，但在架构与编程语言罕见、文档稀疏的加速器上准确率骤降。本文以真实稀缺设备的案例研究，探索智能体如何在此类目标上自主构建知识并完成高性能kernel优化。
AI.method: 构建LLM智能体循环：①自建目标知识——撰写并核验DSL文档摘要、微基准测量芯片、记录编译器导出的合法性规则，并在工具链变更时复检规则与测量；②角色化搜索——在每kernel的Design Tree上进行角色分工搜索，既探索整kernel设计也累积小幅被接受的改动到各kernel最优版本；③分层验收——先以廉价检查在设备运行前筛选设计，因设备时间稀缺且读数噪声大，运行后期仅在设备上与最优kernel重复对比后才接受改动。
AI.result: 最终kernel相对官方基线达到9.293倍几何平均加速，每个kernel的周期数均在其权重搬运所需周期的1.25倍以内（接近内存带宽下界）。
AI.conclusion: 案例表明，LLM智能体可通过自建并维护目标知识、结构化搜索与噪声鲁棒的分层验收，在文档稀疏、设备稀缺的新加速器上实现接近权重搬运下界的高性能kernel优化；提示词、profiler与验收测试已开源。

title: Integrated Circular Polarisation Beam Shaper Based on Tilted Waveguide Bragg Gratings
summary: Scalable quantum platforms require optical systems that deliver well-defined polarisation without relying on macroscopic bulk optics or manual alignment, motivating chip-integrated approaches capable of shaping both the spatial mode and the polarisation of the emitted field. By developing a full three-dimensional analytical model of the scattering process together with numerical simulations to design and evaluate the emitted field, we show that tilted waveguide Bragg gratings can act as integrated polarisation beam shapers. We find that scattering two co-propagating, orthogonally polarised pumps on a single grating is fundamentally limited: waveguide birefringence and the difference in scattering efficiency prevent full polarisation control. We overcome this with an orthogonal superimposed-grating architecture in which two gratings driven independently by two pumps propagating perpendicular to each other succeed in generating any desired polarisation output apart from directions in a narrow spatial region. The approach provides a scalable, chip-integrated route to polarisation-engineered light delivery for quantum technologies.

AI.tldr: 提出倾斜波导布拉格光栅作为集成偏振光束整形器，通过正交叠加光栅架构克服单光栅的偏振控制局限，实现几乎任意期望偏振输出。
AI.motivation: 可扩展量子平台需要不依赖宏观体光学元件和人工对准的光学系统，以提供良好定义的偏振，因此需要能同时整形出射场空间模式与偏振的芯片集成方案。
AI.method: 建立散射过程的全三维解析模型，并结合数值仿真设计与评估出射场；分析倾斜波导布拉格光栅的偏振整形能力，进而提出正交叠加光栅架构，由两束相互垂直传播的泵浦独立驱动两个光栅。
AI.result: 发现将两束共传播、正交偏振的泵浦作用于单一光栅存在根本限制：波导双折射与散射效率差异导致无法实现完整偏振控制；采用正交叠加光栅架构后，除狭窄空间区域内的方向外，可生成任意期望的偏振输出。
AI.conclusion: 该方案为量子技术中偏振工程化的光传输提供了一条可扩展的芯片集成路径。

title: Grounding Long Financial Text with Semantically-Enriched Tables via Multimodal Learning
comment: Accepted to Neurips Long-context foundation model workshop
summary: We propose a multimodal transformer framework for efficiently modeling long1 financial documents that combine structured tabular data with noisy, unstructured2 textual disclosures. The framework represents financial tables as semantically3 enriched token sequences and integrates them with long-form text through a cross-4 attention mechanism that explicitly captures cross-modal dependencies. In par-5 ticular, we augment each numerical variable with a semantic embedding derived6 from its textual definition, enabling the model to encode both numerical magnitude7 and economic meaning. This design yields a more expressive and parameter-8 efficient representation of tabular data compared to value-only embeddings. Using9 a large-scale dataset of financial statements and MD&A disclosures, we show that10 structured numerical features remain the dominant source of predictive signal;11 however, textual information provides consistent incremental gains when incor-12 porated via cross-attention rather than simple concatenation. Our results further13 demonstrate that noisy textual disclosures are most useful when conditioned on a14 stable, semantically structured tabular representation. In particular, using frozen15 variable-level tabular representations as cross-attention queries enables the model16 to weight MD&A chunks differently for each financial variable and observation.17 These findings suggest that cross-attention provides an efficient mechanism for18 table-conditioned aggregation of long-form narrative evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出面向长文档金融报告的多模态Transformer框架：将表格表示为语义增强的token序列，与长文本通过交叉注意力融合，并让冻结的变量级表格表示作为查询，实现表格条件下的文本聚合。
AI.motivation: 金融文档由结构化表格（财务报表）与含噪非结构化文本（MD&A）共同构成，如何高效建模二者的跨模态依赖、并在长文本噪声中提取有用增量信息，是现有方法未充分解决的问题。
AI.method: 表格转为语义富化token序列：每个数值变量附加由其文本定义导出的语义嵌入，使表示同时编码数值大小与经济含义，比仅数值嵌入更具表达力且参数效率更高；文本经交叉注意力与表格交互，并对比"冻结的变量级表格表示作查询"与简单拼接两种融合方式。
AI.result: 在财务报表与MD&A大规模数据集上，结构化数值特征仍是预测信号的主要来源；但文本通过交叉注意力（而非简单拼接）融合时带来稳定的增量收益；含噪文本在稳定的语义结构化表格表示条件下最有用，冻结变量级表格表示作查询可使模型对每个变量、每个观测差异化加权MD&A片段。
AI.conclusion: 交叉注意力为长篇幅叙述性证据的表格条件聚合提供了高效机制；文本的价值在于以结构化表格为条件进行对齐与加权，而非独立贡献。

title: Generative modeling for fusion: a large-scale benchmark of stellarator fast-ion simulations
summary: Stellarators offer a promising magnetic confinement approach for achieving controlled nuclear fusion. However, stellarator design remains challenging, as evaluating configuration performance requires computationally expensive, high-fidelity simulations. In particular, key performance metrics derived from guiding center simulations are costly to include directly in the design optimization loop, and are almost exclusively used as diagnostics. Machine learning has the potential to advance fusion research by enabling rapid generation and evaluation of new stellarator configurations. Effectively applying ML for fusion demands large-scale datasets that capture both design diversity and high-fidelity simulation outputs. In this work, we introduce the Benchmark of Stellarator Simulations (BoSS), a dataset of stellarator designs paired with guiding center simulation results and trajectories. The BoSS is the first large-scale dataset of guiding center simulations, containing simulation data for 180,000 distinct magnetohydrodynamic equilibria spanning a wide range of magnetic geometries and confinement properties. To exemplify the utility of ML to accelerate stellarator design, we formulate and address two sets of modeling tasks: generative modeling for designing stellarators with good particle confinement, and surrogate modeling for predicting stellarator heat deposition patterns and particle trajectories. The tasks reveal the potential impact ML can have in the stellarator field and important opportunities to improve the applicability of ML models in the sciences. Our baselines generate diverse, performant stellarators and provide useful surrogate predictions, and point to long-horizon trajectory forecasting and out-of-distribution generation as key directions for future work. The BoSS can be accessed through https://boss.flatironinstitute.org/.

AI.tldr: 提出 BoSS：首个大规模导向中心模拟数据集，含 18 万个不同 MHD 平衡的仿星器设计及粒子轨迹，并用生成建模与代理建模两类任务验证其价值。
AI.motivation: 仿星器设计需依赖高成本高保真模拟，导向中心模拟得到的关键性能指标难以直接进入优化循环，通常仅作诊断；机器学习可加速设计与评估，但缺乏同时涵盖设计多样性与高保真输出的大规模数据集。
AI.method: 构建 Benchmark of Stellarator Simulations（BoSS）数据集，将仿星器设计与其导向中心模拟结果及轨迹配对；并设定两组建模任务：面向良好粒子约束设计的生成建模，以及预测热沉积模式与粒子轨迹的代理建模，并建立基线与评估。
AI.result: 数据集覆盖 180,000 个磁流体力学平衡，涵盖广泛磁几何与约束性能；基线模型可生成多样且性能良好的仿星器，并提供有效的代理预测。
AI.conclusion: BoSS 展示了 ML 在仿星器领域的潜力，并指出长时程轨迹预测与分布外生成是未来关键方向；数据集通过 https://boss.flatironinstitute.org/ 公开获取。

title: From Next Day Wildfire to Next Days Wildfire: A New Multi-Continent Dataset of Active-Fire Spread for Sequence-to-Sequence Forecasting
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027. 19 pages including supplementary material, 12 figures, 13 tables
summary: Benchmarks such as WildfireSpreadTS (WSTS) have enabled data-driven forecasting of wildfire spread from multimodal satellite time series, but they suffer from limitations: size restricts them to large fires that burn for weeks, and they are from similar environments. We introduce AFSeq, a multimodal dataset of 1,194 recent fire events (2023 to 2026) from 8 different countries across three regions, dominated by the short, small fires that existing benchmarks underrepresent. Our dataset is the largest and most diverse to date for time-series-based wildfire spread prediction. We also introduce UTAE-AR, an extension of a classical U-Net with Temporal Auto Encoder, enhanced with recurrent modules before the decoder. This allows the model to not only predict the next day but the whole sequence in an autoregressive way. Moreover, our model can feed its own predicted fire mask back one day at a time, producing the day-by-day forecasts that single-step models cannot. Our results show that UTAE-AR surpasses state-of-the-art on both WSTS, WSTS+ and AFSeq for next-day accuracy while having 21.5% of their parameters, and being able to predict confidently at a longer horizon.

AI.tldr: 论文提出多模态野火数据集AFSeq（1,194场2023–2026年火灾，覆盖8国3区域，以短时小火为主）及模型UTAE-AR（在UTAE解码器前加入循环模块，支持自回归多日预测），在WSTS、WSTS+与AFSeq上以约21.5%的参数量超越SOTA的次日精度。
AI.motivation: 现有基准（如WildfireSpreadTS）存在两大局限：数据集规模受限，只能覆盖持续数周的大火；且火灾来自相似环境，多样性不足。此外，单步预测模型无法生成逐日滚动预报。
AI.method: 构建AFSeq多模态时序数据集；提出UTAE-AR，在经典U-Net+时间自编码器（UTAE）架构的解码器前引入循环模块，使模型可自回归地预测整段序列，并将自身预测的火mask逐日回灌，实现逐日预报。
AI.result: UTAE-AR在WSTS、WSTS+和AFSeq上的次日预测精度均超过SOTA，而参数量仅为其21.5%，并能在更长预测时域上保持高置信度。
AI.conclusion: AFSeq填补了短时小火与跨区域多样性的数据空白，UTAE-AR以轻量参数实现更强的单步与多步野火蔓延预测能力。

title: SciGame: Let Agents Play the Scientific Discovery Games in the Real and Counterfactual World
summary: Large language model agents are increasingly used for scientific discovery. However, existing benchmarks mix law inference with programming, score data fitting instead of prediction on unseen inputs, and do not separate empirical evidence from pretrained priors. We introduce SciGame, a controlled benchmark that converts scientific literature into structured scientific cards. Each card yields a pair of Original and dimensionally consistent Counterfactual environments with the same task interface. SciGame contains a Historical collection of canonical laws and a live Temporal collection curated from papers published after model knowledge cutoffs. It evaluates agents in candidate-guided Identification and open-ended Discovery settings. Each setting runs under Prior-only, Fixed, and Adaptive protocols. Experiments on five frontier models yield three findings. First, familiar priors hurt performance once the governing relation is altered. Second, adaptive experimentation helps the strongest models but harms weaker ones under limited budgets. Third, good explanations can hide quantitative failures. Recovering the exact symbolic form remains the main bottleneck, even when agents interpret evidence correctly. Current agents can investigate systems actively, but inducing exact laws in unfamiliar settings remains an open challenge.

AI.tldr: 提出SciGame基准：将科学文献转为结构化科学卡片，每张卡片生成同任务接口的Original与反事实环境，在Prior-only/Fixed/Adaptive协议下评测LLM智能体在鉴别与开放式发现任务中的定律归纳能力，发现先验有害、自适应实验利弊分化、解释可掩盖定量失败，精确符号定律恢复仍是主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有科学发现基准存在三类缺陷：将定律推断与编程能力混为一谈；以数据拟合而非对未见输入的预测作为评分标准；未能将经验证据与预训练先验分离，因而无法判断智能体是真正归纳定律还是依赖记忆。
AI.method: 构建受控基准SciGame，把科学文献转化为结构化科学卡片，每卡生成一对量纲一致的Original与Counterfactual环境并共享同一任务接口；包含典律的Historical集合与取自模型知识截止后论文的Temporal集合；评测涵盖候选引导的Identification与开放式Discovery两种设定，各在Prior-only、Fixed、Adaptive三种实验协议下运行；在五个前沿模型上开展实验。
AI.result: 三项主要发现：1）当支配关系被改动后，熟悉的先验反而损害性能；2）自适应实验在预算有限时有利于最强模型、却损害较弱模型；3）良好的解释可能掩盖定量失败，即便智能体正确解读证据，恢复精确符号形式仍是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 当前智能体已能主动探究系统，但在陌生设定中诱导出精确定律仍是开放挑战；SciGame通过分离先验、解耦编程与量纲，为科学发现能力的受控评测提供了框架。

title: Stability-Performance Trade-off in Maritime Integrated Sensing, Communication, and Computation: A Lyapunov-Guided Dual-Timescale Hierarchical RL Approach
summary: Driven by the ever-growing demand for intelligent maritime services, cooperative unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) and unmanned surface vehicle (USV) operations, together with wireless integrated sensing, communication, and computation (ISCC), have become pivotal in maritime environments. However, the distinctive maritime environment precludes a direct application of terrestrial ISCC models, while sensing, communication, and computation compete for the same spatio-temporal resources, thus yielding inherent performance trade-offs that become particularly severe in resource-constrained ocean scenarios. To address these issues, we investigate an ISCC system in which multiple UAVs detect targets at the sea surface and partially offload the collected data to a USV for cooperative processing. Characterizing the maritime-specific environment impairments, we incorporate sea clutter and wave-induced USV roll motion into the sensing and communication models, respectively. Moreover, we introduce data queueing models at both the UAVs and the USV to capture the dynamic coupling among sensing-data generation, wireless offloading, and computation execution. The optimization objective is to minimize the long-term average system energy consumption by jointly optimizing UAV-target association, UAV trajectories, beamforming, time allocation, offloading ratios, and computation resource allocation. Given that these decisions differ in update frequency and time sensitivity, we propose a Lyapunov-guided dual-timescale hierarchical soft actor-critic (LTH-SAC) framework, which transforms the long-term problem into a sequence of queue-aware online subproblems and coordinates optimization across the two timescales. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed framework and demonstrate its capability to balance the stability-performance trade-off among sensing, communication, and computation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究海上UAV-USV协同的通感算一体化（ISCC）系统，在模型中海杂波与浪致横摇，并引入数据排队模型刻画感知-卸载-计算的动态耦合；提出Lyapunov引导的双时间尺度分层SAC（LTH-SAC）框架最小化长期平均能耗。
AI.motivation: 海上智能服务需求增长使UAV-USV协同与ISCC成为关键，但海上环境特殊难以直接套用陆地ISCC模型；感知、通信、计算争夺同一时空资源，在资源受限的海洋场景中性能折衷尤为严重。
AI.method: 构建多UAV海面目标探测并向USV部分卸载数据的ISCC系统；感知模型含海杂波，通信模型含浪致USV横摇；在UAV与USV两侧建立数据排队模型以刻画感知生成、无线卸载与计算执行的动态耦合。联合优化UAV-目标关联、轨迹、波束成形、时间分配、卸载比例与计算资源分配，最小化长期平均能耗。由于各决策在更新频率与时间敏感性上不同，提出Lyapunov引导的双时间尺度分层soft actor-critic（LTH-SAC），将长期问题转化为一系列队列感知的在线子问题并跨两个时间尺度协调优化。
AI.result: 仿真结果验证了所提框架的有效性，并表明其能够平衡感知、通信与计算之间的稳定性-性能折衷。
AI.conclusion: 面向海上环境的ISCC系统需显式建模海杂波、浪致横摇及排队动态耦合；采用Lyapunov引导的双时间尺度分层强化学习可有效处理多时间尺度耦合决策，在资源受限海况下实现能耗最小化与三域折衷的平衡。

title: Edge intelligence for distributed acoustic sensing with ultracompact neural networks
summary: Distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) transforms optical fibres into dense arrays of vibration sensors for continuous, long-range monitoring with high spatial resolution. Yet converting these large-scale measurements into actionable information with compact models that retain task performance remains challenging. Existing artificial-intelligence approaches are typically optimized for specific sensing environments and tasks, but their computational requirements can hinder deployment in compact, power-constrained field systems. Here, we introduce DAS-NanoNet, a framework that automatically constructs lightweight neural networks for different DAS scenarios and tasks, together with OmniDAS, an open benchmark spanning six representative environments. Using lightweight temporal operators tailored to DAS signals, an adaptive neural architecture search strategy derives a compact network for each scenario-task pairing. Across classification, localization, compression, and denoising tasks in diverse DAS applications, DAS-NanoNet consistently yields highly compact architectures. On a six-class dataset, it achieves 99.68% accuracy with only 1,391 trainable parameters, while delivering comparable or better performance with up to 18,098-fold fewer parameters than previously reported high-accuracy networks. Its compact architecture further enables edge deployment, achieving sub 9 $μ$s inference latency on the deployed hardware platform across different DAS applications. DAS-NanoNet provides a route towards edge intelligence for compact, low-power and real-time DAS systems through ultracompact networks tailored to individual sensing scenarios and tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAS-NanoNet框架与OmniDAS基准，通过面向DAS信号的轻量时序算子与自适应神经架构搜索，为不同DAS场景与任务自动生成超紧凑网络，在六类数据集上以1,391参数达99.68%准确率，并在边缘硬件上实现亚9微秒推理延迟。
AI.motivation: DAS可将光纤转化为密集振动传感阵列，实现高空间分辨率的长距离连续监测，但海量数据难以用紧凑模型转化为可用信息；现有AI方法多针对特定环境与任务优化，算力需求大，难以部署于紧凑、功耗受限的现场系统。
AI.method: 构建OmniDAS开放基准，覆盖六类代表性DAS环境；设计适配DAS信号的轻量时序算子；采用自适应神经架构搜索策略，为每个"场景—任务"组合自动推导紧凑网络；评测涵盖分类、定位、压缩与去噪四类任务。
AI.result: 在各DAS应用中均得到高度紧凑的架构；六类分类数据上仅1,391个可训练参数即达99.68%准确率，相比已报道高精度网络参数量最多减少18,098倍且性能相当或更优；紧凑架构支持边缘部署，在目标硬件平台上跨应用实现低于9微秒的推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: DAS-NanoNet通过为个体传感场景与任务定制的超紧凑网络，为紧凑、低功耗、实时的DAS系统提供了通往边缘智能的可行路径。

title: FAD-KV: Adaptive Dictionary KV Caching for Efficient Reasoning Decoding
summary: Key-value (KV) caching is a core mechanism in large language models, where intermediate key and value representations are stored to accelerate autoregressive decoding. As generation length increases, KV cache memory and computation grow linearly, making compression critical for efficient long-output reasoning. Dictionary-based sparse KV compression is appealing because it represents each token's KV states as a sparse combination of learned basis elements (atoms) in a dictionary, preserving token-level structure without enforcing a global low-rank constraint. However, existing dictionary-based methods face two practical limitations during decoding: iterative sparse coding methods such as Orthogonal Matching Pursuit add decoding-time overhead, and static dictionaries may mismatch evolving KV distributions under test-time generation. While adaptive dictionary updates can reduce this mismatch, naive append-only strategies lead to dictionary growth during generation. We propose FAD-KV, a \textbf{F}ast \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{D}ictionary KV caching framework for efficient reasoning decoding. FAD-KV integrates (i) a screening-based sparse coding scheme, where a one-shot Top-\(n\) selection identifies a small candidate pool followed by lightweight coefficient refinement, and (ii) a fixed-size dictionary adaptation mechanism that reuses inactive atoms instead of expanding the dictionary. By controlling both sparse coding cost and adaptive dictionary growth, FAD-KV provides a memory-bounded and computation-efficient KV compression framework for long reasoning workloads. Experiments on reasoning and long-context benchmarks show that FAD-KV achieves a strong quality-efficiency trade-off while avoiding unbounded dictionary growth during decoding.

AI.tldr: FAD-KV是一个基于快速自适应字典的KV缓存压缩框架：用一次性Top-n筛选加轻量系数精修替代迭代稀疏编码以降低解码开销，并用固定大小字典复用非活跃原子避免字典无限增长，在推理与长上下文基准上取得较优的质量-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: KV缓存随生成长度线性增长，长输出推理需要压缩。基于字典的稀疏KV压缩能保留token级结构、不强加全局低秩约束，但现有方法存在两个实用瓶颈：迭代稀疏编码（如正交匹配追踪OMP）带来解码时延；静态字典与测试时演化的KV分布不匹配，而朴素append-only自适应更新会导致字典在生成过程中膨胀。
AI.method: FAD-KV包含两部分：(i) 筛选式稀疏编码——一次性Top-n选择得到小候选池，再做轻量系数精修，替代迭代OMP；(ii) 固定大小字典自适应——复用非活跃原子而非扩展字典，实现内存有界。
AI.result: 在推理与长上下文基准上，FAD-KV实现了较强的质量-效率权衡，且在解码过程中不出现字典无界增长。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时控制稀疏编码开销与自适应字典增长，FAD-KV为长推理负载提供了内存有界、计算高效的KV压缩框架。

title: Muon Makes the First Mixture-of-Experts Layer Harder to Balance
comment: 34 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Code and runs: https://github.com/marcoshernanz/muon-moe-routing
summary: Many open mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models train with Muon instead of AdamW. Most balance the load with a bias on each expert's routing score, adjusted after every step. Their recipes disagree on whether Muon should also train the router. In models with 55M and 108M active parameters, we measure how the optimizer changes the span of these biases, the largest minus the smallest in a layer. The span grows when all tokens favor the same experts, so it shows how hard a layer is to balance. At learning rates tuned on shorter runs, Muon raised the span of the first MoE layer at every seed, roughly doubling it on average, while the other layers changed much less. The rise came from Muon on the rest of the network, whichever optimizer trained the router. In those runs, the inputs to the first router shared a direction, and soon after the warmup its busiest expert averaged four to seven times its fair share. Over the first 3,000 steps, subtracting the batch mean from these inputs removed this overload while barely changing the loss. On the smaller model, halving Muon's learning rate removed most of the rise and slightly improved the loss. Moving only the router to AdamW made the loads shift more during the warmup and slightly raised the loss, so at this scale the results favor keeping the router on Muon.

AI.tldr: 在55M与108M激活参数的MoE语言模型中，作者测量路由偏置跨度以量化负载均衡难度，发现Muon（用于除路由器外的网络）会显著放大第一层MoE的路由偏置跨度并导致专家过载，而对该层路由输入去均值可消除过载且几乎不损损失。
AI.motivation: 开源MoE模型普遍用Muon替代AdamW训练，并以逐步调整的专家路由分数偏置来均衡负载；但现有配方对"路由器是否也用Muon训练"存在分歧，缺乏对优化器如何影响负载均衡的可测量分析。
AI.method: 在55M和108M激活参数模型上，定义并跟踪每层路由偏置的"跨度"（最大减最小）作为该层均衡难度的指标；在短程调好的学习率下跨随机种子对比Muon与AdamW（含路由器优化器的切换），并分析第一层路由输入的方向结构，测试输入去批均值与降低Muon学习率的效果。
AI.result: Muon在每个种子下都提高了第一层MoE的偏置跨度，平均约为翻倍，其他层变化很小；该上升源于用Muon训练网络其余部分，与路由器优化器无关。此时第一层路由输入共享同一方向，warmup后最忙专家平均承担公平份额的4–7倍。前3000步内对输入去批均值可消除过载而损失几乎不变；较小模型上把Muon学习率减半可消除大部分跨度上升并略改善损失；仅把路由器换成AdamW会使warmup期间负载迁移更剧烈并略增损失。
AI.conclusion: Muon是MoE第一层负载不均衡的主要来源，其机制与路由输入的共享方向有关；在此规模下结果支持路由器继续使用Muon，而去均值是一种低成本缓解手段。

title: The Prestige: Benchmarking Cognitive Visual Reasoning using Magic Tricks
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Track on Evaluations and Datasets
summary: We introduce The Prestige, a video understanding benchmark that probes cognitive visual reasoning through professional magic performances, where deliberate misdirection challenges models to track events and explain unexpected outcomes. The benchmark comprises open-ended questions ranging from temporal and causal understanding to robustness against adversarial questions. Evaluation of leading open-source and proprietary VLMs reveals a substantial gap between even the strongest model and human performance. We also find systematic discrepancies between human and automated grading and identify recurring model failure modes. Ablations further show that models can select correct multiple-choice answers even when they fail to generate correct explanations independently, motivating further investigations into question formats. Together, these findings highlight limitations in both VLM reasoning and its evaluation, underscoring the need for more reliable video understanding models and more rigorous benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 The Prestige——基于专业魔术表演的视频理解基准，通过"误导"机制探测认知视觉推理，揭示VLM与人类差距、自动评分的系统性偏差及多选题掩盖推理缺陷的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解基准多考察表层感知，难以检验模型对事件追踪与因果推理的深层认知能力；缺乏具有对抗性与开放性的评测来暴露VLM推理局限及评测方法本身的不足。
AI.method: 构建以专业魔术为素材的开放式问答基准，题目覆盖时序理解、因果理解及对对抗性问题的鲁棒性；对主流开源与专有VLM与人类受试者进行评测，并在人类与自动评分间做一致性比较，辅以失败模式分析与题目格式（开放生成 vs. 多选）的消融实验。
AI.result: 最强VLM仍与人类存在显著差距；人类评分与自动评分之间存在系统性不一致；模型呈现反复出现的典型失败模式；消融显示模型在多选题上可选出正确答案，却无法独立生成正确解释。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM的认知视觉推理能力及评测体系均存在局限，亟需更可靠的视频理解模型与更严格的基准设计；题目格式对评测结论有实质影响，值得进一步研究。

title: VerifiedLab: Harnessing Knowns for Unknowns
summary: Across human history, knowledge has undergone several transitions, from orality to writing and then to digital archives. At each transition, humans established new conventions to preserve knowledge for the new era. Nowadays, as research agents are increasingly deployed for laboratory experiments, knowledge is crossing another boundary: from records written for humans to those for machines. In this work, we introduce VerifiedLab, a multi-agent harness framework for this human-to-machine transition of knowledge. VerifiedLab transforms research output from passive artifacts into active systems that accelerate downstream use, adoption and prediction of future trends. In VerifiedLab, a team of AI scientists with distinct roles reasons over records verified field by field: a principal investigator plans, a librarian computes the evidence directly from the records, specialists draft, and a gate and a critic check each claim against the measured reliability of its data before the harness decides whether to release or withhold it. We demonstrate the efficacy of VerifiedLab through extensive experiments on perovskite solar cells: VerifiedLab recovers known physical trends, anticipates devices reported a year later, and lets AI scientists inherit the literature together with a measure of how far it can be trusted. By scaling the inference-time verification compute, VerifiedLab introduces a new pathway for knowledge dissemination and machine harness for AI co-scientists.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VerifiedLab——面向"知识从人类记录走向机器记录"的多智能体 harness 框架，将科研产出由被动文献转为可验证、可主动推理的系统，并在钙钛矿太阳能电池数据上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 知识载体经历口述→文字→数字档案的多次跃迁，每次都需要新规范。当前研究智能体大量参与实验室实验，知识正跨越"为人写"到"为机器写"的新边界，但现有科研记录仍是供人阅读的被动制品，缺乏字段级可验证性与可信度度量，难以被机器直接继承和高效利用。
AI.method: VerifiedLab 采用多智能体分工的 harness：PI 负责规划，librarian 直接从记录中计算证据，领域专家负责起草，gate 与 critic 依据数据的实测可靠性逐条核验论断，最终由 harness 决定该结论放行还是扣留。核心机制是对记录进行逐字段验证，并通过扩展推理阶段的验证算力提升可信度。
AI.result: 在钙钛矿太阳能电池数据上的大量实验表明：VerifiedLab 能复现已知物理规律、预测一年后才被报道的器件，并使 AI 科学家在继承文献的同时获得"可信任程度"的量化度量。
AI.conclusion: 通过推理时验证算力的扩展，VerifiedLab 为知识传播提供了新路径，也为 AI 共同科学家提供了可用的机器 harness，支撑人机知识迁移时代的可验证知识复用。

title: Sensing Fast and Distant Targets in Overspread Channels with Zak-OTFS and Modular Arithmetic
summary: Delay-Doppler (DD) modulations, such as Zak-transform-based orthogonal time frequency space (Zak-OTFS) modulation, represent the channel as a sparse set of delay and Doppler shifts, which makes them well suited for radar sensing. Sensing with a single DD frame, however, is unambiguous only when the channel spread factor, i.e., the product of the delay and Doppler spreads, is below one. Long-range mobility scenarios, including drones, airplanes, low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites, and underwater acoustic links, typically violate this crystallization condition, so that a single frame aliases the target delays, Doppler shifts, or both. Existing methods add a time-frequency pilot to a conventional DD frame and resolve the aliasing in only one dimension. We propose a frame design that combines multiple DD bases with different delay and Doppler periods, which together cover an overspread channel, on the same bandwidth and frame size. For two frames, we show that modular arithmetic on the wrapped peak positions uniquely recovers each target by pairing the peaks through their common projection and their gains, and we derive the condition under which this pairing is ambiguous. We implement the design with two superimposed Zak-OTFS frames and propose two receivers: dual-frame sensing (DS), which performs the joint detection directly, and DS with cross-pilot cancellation (DS-XC), which additionally cancels the cross-pilot interference, re-estimates the gains by joint least squares, and removes ghost targets. Both receivers keep a detection rate close to one as the spread factor grows, and DS-XC also achieves the lowest false-alarm rate and channel normalized mean squared error (NMSE). In a 100 km drone scenario, DS-XC detects 98% of the targets, compared with 81% for the best baseline, with a complexity that grows near-linearly with the time-bandwidth product for a fixed number of targets.

AI.tldr: 提出在同一带宽与帧长上叠加多个具有不同延迟/多普勒周期的DD基（两个Zak-OTFS帧），利用模运算与峰值配对解开过扩展信道的混叠，并给出DS与DS-XC两种接收机。
AI.motivation: 单帧DD调制（如Zak-OTFS）仅在扩展因子（延迟扩展×多普勒扩展）小于1时无模糊；无人机、飞机、LEO卫星、水声链路等长距离高机动场景违反该"结晶条件"，单帧会出现延迟、多普勒或两者同时混叠。现有方法在常规DD帧中加时频导频，只能解决单一维度的混叠。
AI.method: 设计一种帧结构：将多个具有不同延迟周期与多普勒周期的DD基叠加在同一带宽和帧尺寸上，共同覆盖过扩展信道。对两帧情形，通过在包裹峰值位置上的模运算，借助公共投影与增益对峰值进行配对，从而唯一恢复各目标，并推导配对出现模糊的条件。实现上用两个叠加的Zak-OTFS帧，提出两种接收机：DS（直接联合检测）与DS-XC（额外消除交叉导频干扰、联合最小二乘重估增益、去除鬼影目标）。
AI.result: 随扩展因子增大，两种接收机检测率均保持接近1；DS-XC获得最低虚警率与最低信道NMSE。在100 km无人机场景中，DS-XC检测到98%的目标，最优基线为81%；固定目标数时复杂度随时间带宽积近线性增长。
AI.conclusion: 通过多DD基叠加与模运算配对，可在不增加带宽和帧长的前提下实现对过扩展信道的无模糊雷达感知，DS-XC在检测率、虚警率与NMSE上均优于现有基线，且复杂度可接受。

title: QMUL_AK at AISA-ArabicFC: Schema-Constrained Function Calling with ALLaM
comment: Published at ArabicNLP 2026 (Shared Tasks), co-located with EMNLP 2026. ACL Anthology: https://aclanthology.org/2026.arabicnlp-sharedtasks.203/
summary: We describe the QMUL_AK submission to AISA-ArabicFC 2026. The system adapts the Arabic-English ALLaM-7B-Instruct model to function calling with low-rank adaptation (LoRA). It combines an Arabic schema-aware prompt, dialect and no-call resampling, a token-weighted training objective, and deterministic validation of generated calls against the candidate tool schema. The same output supports Track A function calling and Track B reasoning-augmented calling. Training uses only the official task data. On the development set, the system achieves 0.9982 function accuracy and 0.8920 argument exact match, corresponding to overall A and B scores of 0.9345 and 0.9454. On the blind test set, the system reaches overall A and B scores of 0.9253 and 0.9380, ranking 3rd on both submission tracks and 1st of 21 teams on the Track C dialect-robustness diagnostic with a macro-averaged score of 0.9075 and the smallest dialect gap in the shared task (0.077). The results show that function selection is nearly saturated, while argument extraction remains the main source of error.

AI.tldr: QMUL_AK 将 ALLaM-7B-Instruct 以 LoRA 适配到阿拉伯语 function calling，配合 schema-aware 提示、方言与 no-call 重采样、token 加权目标与确定性 schema 校验；盲测 A/B 总分 0.9253/0.9380，Track C 方言鲁棒性 21 队第一。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语 function calling 缺乏系统研究，方言差异导致性能退化；且需在受限的官方数据条件下构建统一支持标准调用（Track A）与推理增强调用（Track B）的系统。
AI.method: 基于阿拉伯语-英语双语 ALLaM-7B-Instruct 进行 LoRA 微调；输入采用 schema 感知的阿拉伯语提示；数据层面做方言重采样与 no-call 样本重采样以缓解类别失衡；训练目标采用 token 加权 loss，突出参数/关键字段 token；推理阶段对生成的调用与候选工具 schema 做确定性校验。仅使用官方任务数据，同一输出可同时服务 Track A 与 Track B。
AI.result: 开发集 function accuracy 0.9982、argument exact match 0.8920，A/B 总分 0.9345/0.9454；盲测 A/B 总分 0.9253/0.9380，两赛道均第 3；Track C 方言鲁棒性诊断 macro 均分 0.9075，列 21 队第 1，方言差距 0.077 为共享任务最小。
AI.conclusion: 函数选择已接近饱和（0.9982），参数抽取（0.8920）是主要误差来源；方言重采样与 schema 校验有效缩小方言差距，但参数级生成仍是后续优化重点。

title: Bi-Phase Training: Learning Efficiently From Scratch
summary: Pre-training foundational models is computationally expensive as models scale. In this work, we introduce Bi-Phase Training (BPT), a parameter-efficient pre-training method that preserves the high-rank learning dynamics observed in full-parameter optimization with substantially reduced trainable parameters. BPT parameterizes each weight update as a composition of constrained high-rank left/right transformations via trainable diagonal matrices and low-rank adapters whose updates are periodically merged into the frozen base weights, resulting in a compounding expansion of accessible directions during training. Across language-model pre-training from scratch (Qwen2.5 models from 100M to 1.5B parameters and OLMo-2-1B) on FineWeb-Edu (10B and 100B tokens), BPT achieves validation perplexity close to full-parameter baselines while using far fewer trainable parameters; e.g., at the 1.5B scale, BPT uses 66% fewer trainable parameters with only a small validation-perplexity gap. Additionally, a comprehensive evaluation across diverse downstream tasks shows that BPT preserves much of the full-parameterized model's downstream performance.

AI.tldr: 提出Bi-Phase Training (BPT)参数高效预训练方法，通过约束的高秩左右变换+低秩适配器+周期合并，实现接近全参数预训练的效果而显著减少可训练参数。
AI.motivation: 基础模型预训练计算开销随规模急剧增长，需要在减少可训练参数的同时保持全参数优化中的高秩学习动态。
AI.method: BPT将每个权重更新参数化为由可训练对角矩阵和低秩适配器构成的约束高秩左/右变换组合，并周期性将更新合并进冻结的基座权重，使可及方向在训练中复合式扩张。
AI.result: 在FineWeb-Edu（10B与100B tokens）上从头预训练Qwen2.5（100M–1.5B）及OLMo-2-1B：验证困惑度接近全参数基线；1.5B规模下可训练参数减少66%，仅有小幅困惑度差距；多下游任务评测显示保留了大部分全参数模型的下游性能。
AI.conclusion: BPT是一种兼顾参数效率与高秩学习动态的预训练方案，在大幅降低可训练参数的同时维持验证困惑度和下游性能，具备从零预训练基础模型的实用价值。

title: What Does LOL Measure? Hidden Label Shifts in Low-Light Enhancement Benchmarks
summary: LOL-v1 and LOLv2-Real are the standard benchmarks for supervised low-light image enhancement, and several leading methods ship hand-set test-time adjustments with their evaluation scripts. We audit both benchmarks with 18 public checkpoints of eight methods under one metric implementation that reproduces every published number to within 0.09 dB, and find that their test labels differ from their training labels. (i) The 15 LOL-v1 test labels are rendered differently: the same captures appear in LOLv2 with labels of identical luminance but 1.48x lower saturation, and LOL-v1's own training labels match the LOLv2 rendering; we confirm this on the official release. (ii) The LOLv2-Real test set is the contiguous block of images 690-789, whose labels are 14% darker than the training labels (Cliff's delta = -0.45, p < 1e-12) with no comparable shift in the input statistics we examined; methods trained without any labels score up to 5.5 dB higher on test than on train. (iii) All 15 LOL-v1 test inputs reappear in LOLv2-Real, 12 in its training set. The released test-time settings are consistent with compensating for these shifts. Separating what can be calibrated on training data from what only test-set tuning finds, the test-only residual has median 0.00 dB on LOLv2-Syn, which has no shift, but 0.37 dB on LOL-v1 and 0.92 dB on LOLv2-Real (up to 3.9 dB). Under the shift, test-set checkpoint selection inflates a from-scratch model by 0.9-2.0 dB, and removing the released settings changes which method ranks first. We give concrete reporting recommendations.

AI.tldr: 该文审计LOL-v1与LOLv2-Real两个低光照增强基准，发现测试标签与训练标签存在系统性差异（渲染不一致、亮度偏移、测试样本与训练集重叠），且主流方法的测试时调节参数与这些偏移相吻合，导致基准排名不可靠。
AI.motivation: LOL-v1与LOLv2-Real是监督式低光照图像增强的标准基准，多个领先方法在评测脚本中附带手工设定的测试时调节。作者怀疑这些基准的测试标签与训练标签分布不一致，使得测试时调参成为"隐性信息泄漏"，从而扭曲方法比较与排名。
AI.method: 在统一指标实现（复现所有已发表数值误差≤0.09 dB）下，用8种方法的18个公开检查点审计两个基准。具体：(i) 对比LOL-v1与LOLv2同一采集的标签亮度/饱和度差异；(ii) 统计分析LOLv2-Real测试块（图像690–789）与训练标签的亮度偏移（Cliff's delta、显著性检验），并考察无标签训练方法在train/test上的表现差；(iii) 检查测试输入与LOLv2-Real训练集的重叠；(iv) 将测试时增益拆分为"训练数据可校准部分"与"仅测试集调参可得残差"。
AI.result: (i) LOL-v1的15张测试标签渲染方式不同：同一采集在LOLv2中亮度相同但饱和度低1.48倍，而LOL-v1自身训练标签与LOLv2渲染一致。(ii) LOLv2-Real测试集为690–789连续块，标签比训练标签暗14%（Cliff's delta=-0.45，p<1e-12），输入统计无可比偏移；无标签训练方法测试比训练高5.5 dB。(iii) LOL-v1全部15张测试输入在LOLv2-Real中重现，其中12张属其训练集。测试集独有的增益残差在无偏移的LOLv2-Syn上中位数为0.00 dB，LOL-v1为0.37 dB、LOLv2-Real为0.92 dB（最高3.9 dB）；测试集检查点选择使从零训练模型虚高0.9–2.0 dB，去掉发布的调节设置会改变第一名归属。
AI.conclusion: LOL-v1与LOLv2-Real存在训练/测试标签分布偏移及测试-训练样本重叠，已发表的测试时手工调节实际在补偿这些偏移，使基准排名与增益幅度被高估。作者建议：报告须区分可在训练数据上校准的部分与仅靠测试集调参获得的部分，明确检查点选择协议、披露测试时设置，并在无偏移基准（如LOLv2-Syn）上交叉验证。

title: GARDEN: Generalist Autonomous Reward Design Through Evidence Navigation for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) enables teams of agents, such as robots and autonomous vehicles, to learn coordinated behavior, but what such teams learn is largely determined by their reward function. Because task success alone provides too little guidance for learning, intermediate rewards are usually designed by hand, and this effort must often be repeated whenever the environment or the team changes. Large language models (LLMs) can automate the effort by writing reward functions as code, yet the resulting rewards are typically designed and tested in a single setting. To enable their reuse across settings, GARDEN (Generalist Autonomous Reward Design through Evidence Navigation) is proposed, in which one reward program is developed for a family of related scenarios and transferred, unchanged, to scenarios that were not available during its design. During development, environment code, training records, and agent behavior are investigated by an LLM reward engineer, and draft rewards are tested in trial training runs, while the learning algorithm and the rule for selecting the final reward are held fixed. On unseen scenarios of the Overcooked and SMAX benchmarks, task returns were increased by 58.2% and 52.5% over the default rewards on two kitchen layouts, and the mean win rate in two combat scenarios was raised from 51.0% to 89.9%. Under matched candidate and probe budgets, this exceeded the 84.2% and 79.2% obtained with fixed diagnostic feedback and Eureka-inspired reward reflection. These results show that a single autonomously engineered reward can be reused effectively across related cooperative scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出 GARDEN 框架，用 LLM 作为"奖励工程师"，在多种相关场景证据（环境代码、训练记录、智能体行为）导航下开发单个可复用的奖励程序，并原样迁移到未见场景；在 Overcooked 与 SMAX 未见场景上显著超越默认奖励与固定诊断反馈、Eureka 式奖励反思基线。
AI.motivation: 合作式多智能体强化学习的效果高度依赖奖励函数，但任务成功率本身提供的学习信号过少，中间奖励通常需人工设计，且环境或团队一变就要重做。LLM 自动编写奖励代码可减轻该负担，然而现有方法产生的奖励往往只在单一设定下设计并验证，缺乏跨场景复用性。
AI.method: GARDEN（Generalist Autonomous Reward Design through Evidence Navigation）：面向一族相关场景开发单一奖励程序，并在设计阶段不可见的场景上原样迁移、不做修改。开发过程中，LLM 奖励工程师考察环境代码、训练记录与智能体行为等证据，通过试训练运行检验奖励草稿；学习算法与最终奖励的筛选规则保持固定，以保证公平比较（候选与探测预算匹配）。
AI.result: 在 Overcooked 与 SMAX 的未见场景上：两个厨房布局的任务回报较默认奖励分别提升 58.2% 与 52.5%；两个战斗场景的平均胜率由 51.0% 提升至 89.9%。在候选数与探测预算匹配条件下，优于固定诊断反馈（84.2%）与受 Eureka 启发的奖励反思（79.2%）。
AI.conclusion: 单个自主工程化的奖励函数可有效复用于相关合作场景，说明基于证据导航的 LLM 奖励设计能产生具备跨场景泛化性的奖励，减少随环境与团队变化而重复的人工奖励设计开销。

title: Turning Multipath into Positioning Information: Persistent Electromagnetic-Twin DoA Localization
summary: Reflected paths can support localization when line-of-sight (LoS) links are blocked, but their usefulness depends on how accurately the stored model predicts their directions. This paper develops electromagnetic-twin (ET) direction-of-arrival (DoA) localization with a persistent, physically calibrated path-angle field. A nominal floor plan supplies virtual-path geometry, and sparse reference probes at known positions learn a compact directional correction. Field order and regularization are selected from calibration data alone. For each user, unordered DoAs are processed by joint position estimation and one-to-one path association, using assignment-aware multistart search and robust Gauss--Newton refinement. New trusted probes update the stored correction through recursive least squares (RLS), without reprocessing all previous measurements. The analysis establishes calibration rank conditions, objective descent, and conditional information gains from reflected paths, while also distinguishing the decay of initialization bias from the convergence of localization error. Synthetic experiments use 500 queries per operating point. At 50% LoS blockage and $1.5^\circ$ DoA error, the calibrated ET achieves 0.39 m root-mean-square error, versus 0.55 m for nominal geometry. After a wall change, its final error is 0.43 m, versus 0.63 m for a frozen calibrated map. Equal-evidence comparisons show competitive calibrated alternatives and faster abrupt-change recovery with sliding-window updates than with the configured RLS. The results support reusable directional calibration, not a universally superior map or update rule, and validation is limited to synthetic first-order reflections with trusted calibration labels.

AI.tldr: 提出"电磁孪生"(ET)DoA定位方法，用稀疏参考探针学习紧凑的方向角修正场并持续校准，在50%视距遮挡下达到0.39 m RMSE（标称几何为0.55 m）。
AI.motivation: 反射路径在视距(LoS)受阻时可用于定位，但其有效性取决于存储模型对反射方向的预测精度；标称户型图与实际电磁环境存在偏差，需要可复用、可持续更新的方向校准。
AI.method: 以标称平面图生成虚拟路径几何；用已知位置的稀疏参考探针学习紧凑的方向修正（场阶数与正则化仅由校准数据选取）；对每个用户的无序DoA进行联合位置估计与一对一路径关联，采用assignment-aware多起点搜索与鲁棒Gauss–Newton精化；新可信探针通过RLS递归更新存储修正，无需重处理历史测量。
AI.result: 理论分析给出校准秩条件、目标函数下降性与反射路径的条件信息增益，并区分初始化偏差衰减与定位误差收敛。合成实验每工况500次查询：50% LoS遮挡、1.5° DoA误差下校准ET的RMSE为0.39 m（标称几何0.55 m）；墙体改变后最终误差0.43 m（冻结校准地图0.63 m）；等证据比较中其他校准方案具竞争力，滑窗更新比所配置RLS更快恢复突变。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持"可复用的方向校准"，而非普适最优的地图或更新规则；验证仅限于合成一阶反射与可信校准标签。

title: Ghosts in the nanomachine: dynamical slowing-down in the phase-space of nanomechanical strings
summary: The linear behavior of micro- and nanomechanical devices has been the topic of intense study over the past years. Their nonlinear behavior, on the other hand, continues to provide new and interesting dynamics. This work leverages a cavity opto-mechanical system whose very high sensitivity and low dissipation rate allows to capture the dynamics of fast transients that occur when strongly-driven nonlinear resonators relax to their equilibrium state. We experimentally study the ringdown dynamics of a nanomechanical Duffing resonator in both the time domain and in phase space. The resonator exhibits very different ringdown dynamics depending on whether it is subject to one or two tone driving. In the former case the ringdown follows a regular exponential decay, whereas the latter case shows exotic dynamics such as libration, slowing-down while scattering in phase-space, and ghost slowing-down. We demonstrate that this distinct difference can be attributed to the structure of the phase space itself. Surprisingly, we find that the energy in the resonator changes non-monotonously and that long delay between turning off the drive and the decay of the motion amplitude results in dynamical meta-states.

AI.tldr: 利用高灵敏度、低耗散的腔光力系统研究纳米机械Duffing振子在强驱动下的瞬态弛豫（ringdown）动力学：单音驱动表现为规则指数衰减，双音驱动则出现天平动、相空间散射中的减速及"幽灵减速"等奇异现象，其根源在于相空间结构本身。
AI.motivation: 微纳机械器件的线性行为已被充分研究，而非线性行为仍不断揭示新奇的动力学。作者希望借助高灵敏度、低耗散的腔光力系统，捕捉强驱动非线性振子弛豫到平衡态过程中快速瞬态（ringdown）的动力学，以揭示其相空间结构对瞬态演化的决定性作用。
AI.method: 采用高灵敏度、低耗散的腔光力（opto-mechanical）系统，在时域与相空间同时实验测量纳米机械Duffing振子的ringdown动力学，并对比单音驱动与双音驱动两种情形下振子的瞬态行为。
AI.result: 单音驱动时ringdown为规则的指数衰减；双音驱动时出现奇异动力学，包括天平动（libration）、相空间散射过程中的减速（slowing-down while scattering）以及幽灵减速（ghost slowing-down）。此外，振子内能量呈非单调变化，且关断驱动后运动幅度衰减前存在长延迟，形成动力学"亚稳态"（meta-states）。作者证明这些差异源于相空间本身的结构。
AI.conclusion: 非线性Duffing振子的ringdown行为强烈依赖于驱动音数与相空间结构：单音与双音驱动导致定性不同的瞬态路径，双音驱动下能量非单调演化并出现长延迟的动力学亚稳态，表明相空间几何结构是理解强驱动非线性微纳谐振器瞬态动力学的关键。

title: Large Language Models for Accurate Medical Chart Abstraction: Enabling Scalable and Secure Artificial Intelligence Deployment in Stroke
summary: Medical chart abstraction transforms unstructured clinical narratives into structured variables for research and quality monitoring. We evaluated a prompting-based large language model (LLM) framework for extracting eight clinical variables from 2,416 neurointerventional acute stroke intervention reports across three hospitals. Twenty-two instruction-tuned open-source LLMs were evaluated across architectures, model sizes, and biomedical adaptations using Quick Response and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting. Non-expert staff annotations served as the cross-model reference standard. Evaluation was restricted to report-variable pairs with a valid LLaMA3.3-70B CoT prediction and a corresponding reference label. Performance measures included extraction accuracy, inference latency, and agreement with expert adjudication. Twenty discordant cases per variable underwent review by two senior physicians and four medical students. LLaMA3.3-70B achieved the highest overall accuracy (94.8%). CoT improved performance on inference-dependent variables such as site of occlusion, while Quick Response was optimal for directly stated procedural fields. Expert adjudication showed that AI predictions were more closely aligned with expert interpretations than non-expert annotations for most variables, with intracranial angioplasty remaining a challenge. Locally deployed LLMs can support scalable clinical information extraction and retrospective stroke registry curation, with expert oversight for ambiguous cases.

AI.tldr: 评估22个开源LLM在2,416份神经介入急性卒中手术记录中抽取8个临床变量的表现，LLaMA3.3-70B的CoT提示总体准确率最高（94.8%）。
AI.motivation: 病历抽象需将非结构化临床叙述转为结构化变量以支持研究与质量监测，需检验提示式LLM框架在多中心卒中记录上的可行性与准确性。
AI.method: 在3家医院2,416份报告中，对22个指令微调开源LLM（覆盖不同架构、规模及生物医学适配版本）采用Quick Response与Chain-of-Thought（CoT）两种提示；以非专家标注作为跨模型参考标准，仅评估具有有效LLaMA3.3-70B CoT预测及对应参考标签的报告-变量对；指标为抽取准确率、推理延迟及与专家裁决的一致性，每个变量抽取20例不一致病例由2名资深医师与4名医学生复核。
AI.result: LLaMA3.3-70B总体准确率最高（94.8%）。CoT在依赖推理的变量（如闭塞部位）上优于Quick Response，而Quick Response对直接陈述的手术字段更优。专家裁决显示多数变量上AI预测比非专家标注更贴近专家判断；颅内血管成形术仍为难点。
AI.conclusion: 本地部署LLM可支撑可扩展的临床信息抽取与回顾性卒中登记库整理，但歧义病例仍需专家监督。

title: Finite-Step Geometry of Marginal-Preserving Velocity Fields in Generative Flows
summary: Generative flows can admit different velocity fields that induce the same continuous marginal evolution but behave differently after numerical discretization. We study this finite-step non-equivalence while keeping the marginal path and numerical method fixed. Projected modified equations characterize the component of local integration error that changes the marginal law and give sufficient conditions for higher marginal convergence order. For affine fixed-shape distributions, we characterize exact finite-step reachability and derive spectral obstructions and sharp nearest-reachable Wasserstein errors. For diffusion probability-flow ODEs, we construct skew-score perturbations that preserve the exact marginal path under exact scores and quantify their leakage under score error. Controlled Gaussian and mixture experiments recover the predicted order, reachability, and obstruction phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文在固定边缘路径与数值方法的前提下，研究生成流（generative flows）中速度场的"有限步非等价性"：即使连续边缘演化相同，离散化后行为可不同；作者用投影修正方程刻画影响边缘律的局部积分误差，给出更高边缘收敛阶的充分条件，并对仿射固定形状分布刻画有限步可达性与谱障碍，最后针对扩散概率流ODE构造保持精确边缘路径的skew-score扰动。
AI.motivation: 生成流允许多个速度场诱导同一连续边缘演化，但在数值离散后，这些速度场可能产生不同结果。已有工作关注连续极限的等价性，却忽视了有限步离散下的非等价性问题，因此需要在不改变边缘路径和数值方法的前提下，理解离散化误差中的哪一部分真正改变边缘分布。
AI.method: 1）采用投影修正方程（projected modified equations），分离出局部积分误差中改变边缘律的分量，并据此导出更高边缘收敛阶的充分条件；2）对仿射固定形状（affine fixed-shape）分布，刻画精确有限步可达性，推导谱障碍（spectral obstructions）与尖锐的最近可达Wasserstein误差；3）对扩散概率流ODE，构造skew-score扰动，使其在精确score下保持边缘路径不变，并量化其在score误差下的泄漏（leakage）；4）通过受控的高斯与混合分布实验验证理论预测。
AI.result: 实验在受控高斯与混合分布设定下复现了理论所预测的收敛阶、可达性与谱障碍现象，验证了投影修正方程对边缘误差分量的刻画能力，以及skew-score扰动在精确/近似score下的保持与泄漏行为。
AI.conclusion: 有限步离散下速度场并不等价，边缘律的差异可由投影修正方程中改变边缘的分量精确刻画；仿射情形下存在结构性谱障碍与尖锐可达误差界；对概率流ODE可通过skew-score扰动在不改变连续边缘路径的情况下改变离散行为，为理解与设计生成流数值方案提供了理论框架。

title: StepControl: Long-Horizon Human Motion Generation from Foot-Contact Schedules
summary: Controllable human motion generation has largely focused on specifying what action should occur or where the body should move. We study a complementary question: can full-body motion be controlled by specifying only when each foot contacts the ground? We introduce StepControl, an autoregressive diffusion model conditioned on a future binary left/right foot-contact schedule, without requiring target root and body poses, or semantic prompts. StepControl represents contact as explicit temporal events and injects them through dedicated cross-attention with classifier-free guidance. We further introduce a stochastic mixture noise schedule and warmup strategy for stable long-horizon autoregressive generation. Experiments show that StepControl follows prescribed contact timing more accurately than adapting existing spatially guided motion generators to contact constraints. It maintains effective contact control over long continuous rollouts and responds to edited schedules such as cadence changes, stop-and-go pauses, limping gaits, and bilateral jumping. Our results show that minimal foot-contact schedules provide an effective and intuitive temporal interface for controllable motion generation.

AI.tldr: 提出StepControl——以未来左右脚着地时序表为唯一条件的自回归扩散模型，实现全身动作可控生成。
AI.motivation: 现有可控人体动作生成多关注"做什么动作"或"身体往哪里移动"（语义提示、根节点轨迹、目标姿态），但缺少对"何时着地"这一时序接口的研究。作者探究一个互补问题：仅给定每只脚与地面接触的时间表，能否控制完整全身动作。
AI.method: StepControl为自回归扩散模型，条件为未来的二值左/右脚步态触地时间表，无需目标根节点与身体姿态或语义提示。将接触表示为显式时间事件，通过专用交叉注意力注入，并采用classifier-free guidance；此外引入随机混合噪声调度（stochastic mixture noise schedule）与warmup策略，以保证长时程自回归生成的稳定性。
AI.result: StepControl比将现有空间引导动作生成器改造为接触约束的方案更准确地遵循给定触地时序；在长时间连续rollout中保持有效的触地控制；并能响应编辑后的时间表，如步频变化、走走停停的停顿、跛行步态与双侧跳跃。
AI.conclusion: 最小化的脚部触地时间表是一种有效且直观的时序接口，可用于可控动作生成。

title: Understanding Large Language Models as Numerical Optimizers
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as potential tools for numerical optimization. Despite promising results, their intrinsic optimization capabilities and limitations remain poorly understood, particularly in high dimensions. This paper investigates the ability of LLMs to exploit mathematical problem structures and generate feasible, near-optimal solutions. We develop an evaluation framework that distinguishes solution quality from execution failures, including numerical inaccuracies, constraint violations, and output-format errors. Using representative problems from convex optimization, fractional programming, and constrained projection, we assess LLM performance against deterministic reference solvers across different dimensions. Our results reveal that LLMs can capture useful optimization structures and produce near-optimal solutions, even when their outputs fail to satisfy numerical or formatting requirements. However, reliability deteriorates with increasing problem dimension and depends strongly on the underlying optimization structure. To further investigate the limitations, we deploy an iterative refinement mechanism that provides targeted feedback on feasibility and solution quality. The results demonstrate that iterative refinement substantially improves reliability and extends the range of problem dimensions over which LLMs produce valid solutions. Nevertheless, persistent numerical and structural errors limit their applicability as standalone optimizers. These findings provide insights into the capacity and limits of LLM-based optimization and motivate hybrid approaches that combine LLM reasoning with deterministic numerical verification.

AI.tldr: 本文构建评估框架，区分"解的质量"与"执行失败"（数值误差、约束违反、格式错误），在高维凸优化、分式规划、约束投影问题上对比LLM与确定性参考求解器，并引入迭代精炼机制。结果显示LLM能捕获有用的问题结构并给出近优解，但可靠性随维度升高而下降且强依赖问题结构；迭代精炼可显著提升可靠性并扩展有效维度范围，但仍无法作为独立优化器。
AI.motivation: LLM作为数值优化工具已有初步成果，但其内在优化能力与局限（尤其在高维情形）认识不足，且现有评估常把"解质量差"与"执行失败"混为一谈，缺乏细粒度诊断。
AI.method: 提出评估框架，将解质量与执行失败（数值不精确、约束违反、输出格式错误）分离；选取凸优化、分式规划、约束投影的代表性问题，在不同维度下与确定性参考求解器对比；并部署迭代精炼机制，对可行性与解质量提供定向反馈。
AI.result: LLM能捕获有用的优化结构并产出近优解，即使输出未满足数值或格式要求；但可靠性随问题维度增加而退化，且强烈依赖底层优化结构；迭代精炼显著提升可靠性并扩大LLM能产生有效解的维度范围；然而持续存在的数值与结构性错误仍限制其单独使用。
AI.conclusion: LLM具备可利用的优化推理能力但不足以作为独立优化器，研究结果支持将LLM推理与确定性数值验证相结合的混合方法。

title: An Efficient SIM Beamforming Scheme Based on Physical-Empowered Projected Gradient
summary: Stacked Intelligent Metasurfaces (SIMs) have emerged as a promising technology for next-generation wireless systems. Especially in multi-input multi-output (MIMO) systems, it has the potential to realize complicated wave-domain transformations with low hardware costs and energy consumption. However, SIM-assisted MIMO systems face two major challenges in channel estimation and beamforming. As the SIM elements do not have the signal processing capability, channel estimation can only be conducted in an indirect manner, which makes it challenging. Moreover, the precoding optimization after channel estimation is non-convex and also difficult. Targeting these issues, we exploit the time-division duplex (TDD) channel reciprocity to calculate the gradient backpropagation in an over-the-air manner. Based on this structure, we propose a gradient-based optimization framework that optimizes beamforming without explicitly estimating the SIM--UE channel. The proposed method, namely the physical projected gradient descent (P2GD) method, optimizes the achievable sum rate while incorporating zero-forcing (ZF) constraints. Based on the method of incorporating the ZF restriction, we propose two variations of P2GD, namely user equipment (UE)-P2GD and base station (BS)-P2GD. We also provide a theoretical convergence analysis and projected gradient techniques to ensure physical feasibility. Simulation results show that the proposed approach can achieve suboptimal beamforming in the multi-user system within a small number of over-the-air iterations, using a per-direction signaling budget below the pilot cost of explicit SIM--UE channel estimation. The proposed method provides a low-overhead beamforming scheme for SIM systems without explicit SIM--UE channel estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于梯度回传的P2GD框架，在不显式估计SIM-UE信道的情况下优化SIM辅助MIMO波束成形，并给出UE-P2GD与BS-P2GD两种变体及收敛性分析。
AI.motivation: SIM元件无信号处理能力，只能间接估计信道；且SIM辅助MIMO的预编码优化非凸且困难，显式信道估计与后续波束优化开销大、难度高。
AI.method: 利用TDD信道互易性在空中计算梯度反向传播，构建梯度优化框架；提出P2GD（物理投影梯度下降）直接优化可达和速率并融入ZF约束；通过与ZF约束结合方式的不同，衍生UE-P2GD与BS-P2GD两变体；辅以理论收敛分析与投影梯度技术保证物理可行性。
AI.result: 仿真表明可在少量空中迭代内获得多用户系统的次优波束成形，每方向信令开销低于显式SIM-UE信道估计的导频开销。
AI.conclusion: 为SIM系统提供了一种无需显式SIM-UE信道估计的低开销波束成形方案。

title: Unlimited-Range Absolute Distance Interferometry Outdoors via Tunable Synthetic and Pseudo-Supersynthetic Wavelengths: The TeleYAG-II Interferometer
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, research data openly available under the following DOI: https://doi.org/10.7795/720.20261014
summary: Absolute distance interferometry requires an unlimited non-ambiguity range to be truly absolute. Tunable synthetic wavelength interferometry allows for the construction of pseudo-supersynthetic wavelengths using a limited number of optical sources and a standard interferometer setup. This approach facilitates the creation of a series of consecutively deployable synthetic wavelengths, ultimately combining macroscopic unambiguity with microscopic interferometric accuracy. We have implemented and demonstrated this concept in the TeleYAG-II interferometer, designed as an SI-traceable standard for the calibration of geodetic baselines. The system employs two Nd:YAG lasers as optical sources, with their frequency difference controlled by a versatile optical phase-locked loop. Specifically engineered for robustness in field conditions, the heterodyne interferometer was validated through an outdoor measurement campaign. The results demonstrate the efficacy of the method, achieving an expanded measurement uncertainty of 0.13 mm over a distance of 224 m without the need for auxiliary length measurements.

AI.tldr: 提出基于可调谐合成波长与伪超合成波长的绝对距离干涉测量方案，在TeleYAG-II干涉仪上实现224 m范围内0.13 mm扩展不确定度、无需辅助测长的绝对测距。
AI.motivation: 绝对距离干涉测量要真正"绝对"，必须具备无限的非模糊范围；而传统方案受限于光源数量与装置复杂度，难以兼顾宏观无模糊与微观干涉精度。
AI.method: 利用有限数量光源（两台Nd:YAG激光器）配合标准干涉仪结构，通过光锁相环（OPLL）灵活控制两激光频率差，构建伪超合成波长序列并逐级可部署的合成波长链，实现由粗到精的逐级解算；采用外差干涉结构并针对野外环境做鲁棒性设计。
AI.result: TeleYAG-II作为可溯源至SI的大地测量基线校准标准，经户外测量活动验证：在224 m距离上获得0.13 mm的扩展测量不确定度，且不需任何辅助长度测量。
AI.conclusion: 可调谐合成波长干涉结合伪超合成波长链，可在标准干涉仪配置下以少量光源同时实现宏观无模糊与微观精度，适用于野外大地测量基线的绝对校准。

title: Beyond Aggregate WER: In-domain Adaptation, Learner Speech, Code-Switching, and Speaker Attribution in Online Spanish Learning Classrooms
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) increasingly supplies transcripts for educational NLP, but aggregate word error rate (WER) can conceal errors concentrated in learner speech, multilingual turns, and speaker attribution. We compare platform-integrated, open-weight, adapted, and commercial ASR configurations on held-out sessions of online L2 Spanish interaction between L1 English learners and their instructors and tutors. Because English is the learner's shared first language, the interactions contain Spanish-only, English-only, and code-switched turns. Evaluation combines overall WER and character error rate (CER), WER disaggregated by speaker role and language context, and diarization error rate (DER). We also adapt Whisper large-v3 and MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize with LoRA using human-corrected in-domain classroom data. MOSS adaptation produced consistent improvements across speaker roles and language contexts, whereas Whisper showed smaller gains. Domain match proved more important than data volume: Larger out-of-domain bilingual and learner corpora did not outperform the smaller classroom corpus, where learner speech and code-switching are embedded in instructor--learner interaction. The open-weight MOSS adapter was competitive with commercial Muse Voice Transcribe on WER and CER and achieved lower system-provided DER on the recordings eligible for each system. Learner, English-only, and code-switched speech remained more difficult than instructor and Spanish-only speech. The findings demonstrate the value of condition-aware evaluation and interactionally matched data for bilingual educational ASR.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较多种ASR配置在二语西语在线教学互动中的表现，采用分角色、分语言情境的WER与DER评估，并以LoRA进行域内自适应；发现域匹配比数据规模更重要，经适配的MOSS与商业系统相当。
AI.motivation: 教育NLP日益依赖ASR生成转写，但整体WER会掩盖集中于学习者语音、多语轮次和说话人归属上的错误；因此需要按条件细化的评估，并探究怎样的数据与适配方式能真正改善双语教育场景下的识别。
AI.method: 在L1英语学习者与教师/辅导者在线L2西语互动的留出会话上，比较平台集成、开放权重、适配后与商业四类ASR配置；互动包含纯西语、纯英语与语码转换轮次。评估包括整体WER、CER、按说话人角色与语言情境分解的WER，以及DER；并用人工校正的域内课堂数据以LoRA适配Whisper large-v3与MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize，同时对照更大规模的域外双语与学习者语料。
AI.result: MOSS适配在各说话人角色与语言情境上均带来一致提升，Whisper提升较小；域匹配比数据量更重要，更大的域外语料未超过较小的课堂语料。开放权重MOSS适配器在WER、CER上与商业Muse Voice Transcribe相当，并在各自可用录音上取得更低的系统提供DER。
AI.conclusion: 学习者语音、纯英语与语码转换语音仍显著难于教师语音与纯西语语音；结果表明条件感知评估与互动匹配数据对双语教育ASR具有重要价值。

title: SAG-Sep: Sparse Augmented Graphs and Onion-Guided Search for Rounded Capacity Cut Separation
comment: 42 pages, 4 figures, 26 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Main Track). Code: https://github.com/henryleo180/SAG-Sep
summary: Rounded capacity cuts (RCCs) are among the most effective cuts for capacitated vehicle-routing relaxations, but exact separation is computationally prohibitive at scale. Existing heuristic and neural separators can be fast, but often fail to produce sufficiently many effective cuts within practical separation budgets.
