We introduce SAG-Sep, a separator that scores node membership in RCC-inducing subsets across vehicle-count levels from a fractional LP solution in a single encoder forward pass, avoiding the iterative predict-and-coarsen inference used by NeuralSEP-style separators. SAG-Sep encodes the LP solution as a Sparse Augmented Graph (SAG), adding flow-informed multi-hop edges that expose long-range routing structure without densifying attention. Beyond LP-aware sparse encoding, we observe that high-value exact RCCs are typically nested, organizing into onion-like subset families, and SAG-Sep's node scores track subset nesting depth. This motivates Onion-Sweep (OS), a training-free decoder that ranks customers by their scores, evaluates the RCC violation of every prefix of the ranking in one vectorized pass, and emits the most violated prefix of each replica together with a cross-replica family of nested proposals, converting independent node scores into structurally coordinated RCC candidates without a tuned threshold or probing band. On the NeuralSEP benchmark with N=1000 customer instances, SAG-Sep with OS reduces the average root gap by 17.7% relative to the strongest NeuralSEP baseline, while the single-pass SAG-Sep separator achieves a roughly 30-fold per-iteration neural separation speedup. Our findings suggest that LP-aware sparse encoding and the nested structure of high-value cuts are structural patterns worth leveraging in neural separation more broadly.

AI.tldr: 提出SAG-Sep与Onion-Sweep，基于稀疏增广图单次前向打分并利用割的嵌套结构批量解码，在N=1000实例上根间隙较最强NeuralSEP基线降低17.7%，神经分离单次迭代加速约30倍。
AI.motivation: RCC（圆整容量割）对CVRP松弛最有效，但精确分离在大规模下计算不可行；现有启发式与神经分离器虽快，却在有限的分离预算内难以产出足够多的高效割。NeuralSEP类方法还需迭代的predict-and-coarsen推理，成本高。
AI.method: 1) SAG-Sep：将分数LP解编码为稀疏增广图（SAG），引入流量引导的多跳边以刻画长程路径结构而不致注意力稠密化；单次编码器前向即对所有车辆数层级输出节点属于RCC诱导子集的归属分数，避免迭代推理。2) Onion-Sweep（OS）：观察到高价值精确RCC呈嵌套的"洋葱式"子集族，节点分数可反映嵌套深度；据此设计免训练解码器，按分数排序顾客，一次向量化扫描评估所有前缀的RCC违背度，输出每个replica最违背前缀及跨replica的嵌套候选族，无需调阈值或探测带。
AI.result: 在NeuralSEP基准、N=1000顾客实例上，SAG-Sep+OS使平均根间隙相对最强NeuralSEP基线降低17.7%；单次前向的SAG-Sep分离器实现约30倍的单次迭代神经分离加速。
AI.conclusion: LP感知的稀疏编码与高价值割的嵌套结构是可推广至更广泛神经分离任务的有效结构性规律。

title: REEL: Same Frames, Different Answers and Different Costs
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027, Datasets and Evaluation Track
summary:
Video understanding keeps moving toward longer recordings, and the longer a recording is, the more questions can be asked about it. But processing it again for every question does not scale, so many systems watch the video once, build a memory, and answer later questions from it. Yet what to remember is decided before anyone knows what will be asked, and whatever is left out cannot be recovered later.
  Moreover, whether the savings pay off is judged by token counts, which fall when the input gets shorter but not when the model reuses what it has already computed. We present REEL, an evaluation framework that compares three saved representations built from exactly the same observed frames, so that a change in answers can come only from what the system remembered. Text writes a short record of what happened, Visual keeps the encoder outputs, and Prefix State also keeps the language-model prefix. Each is compared with full reprocessing (Frames) by paired correctness changes, cumulative GPU time, and storage size. Across six vision-language models and two benchmarks, Text and Frames differ in correctness on 20\% to 29\% of questions, even when their mean accuracy is almost the same. By contrast, Visual and Prefix State stay much closer to Frames. With unlimited storage, Prefix State is the cheapest in total GPU time among memories that keep almost all of the answers Frames gets right, for every model on both benchmarks. The trade-off is storage: Prefix State keeps up to about 21 GiB per video, whereas Text needs only kilobytes. Reusing computation and discarding information both look like efficiency, but only the second removes evidence that later questions may need, and neither mean accuracy nor token count tells them apart. REEL makes that difference measurable for any system that answers many questions from one saved memory.

AI.tldr: 提出REEL评测框架：在完全相同观测帧上比较Text、Visual、Prefix State三种记忆表示与全量重处理(Frames)，用配对正确性变化、累计GPU时间、存储规模衡量，揭示"复用计算"与"丢弃信息"两种效率的本质差异，且均值准确率与token数均无法区分二者。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答中，为每个问题重复处理视频不可扩展，故系统倾向"看一次、建记忆、后续作答"。但记忆内容在问题未知时就已确定，被丢弃的信息无法恢复。现有以token数衡量节省的做法有缺陷：token数下降只反映输入变短，并不反映模型是否复用已算结果，因而无法区分"复用计算"与"丢弃证据"两种效率。
AI.method: REEL框架基于同一批观测帧构建三种保存表示：Text（事件的简短文字记录）、Visual（保留编码器输出）、Prefix State（额外保留语言模型前缀），并与Frames（全量重处理）对照。评测指标为配对正确性变化、累计GPU时间与存储大小；实验覆盖6个视觉语言模型、2个基准。
AI.result: Text与Frames在20%–29%的问题上正确性不同，即便平均准确率几乎一致；Visual与Prefix State则明显更接近Frames。在存储不受限时，Prefix State在两种基准、所有模型上，是"几乎保留Frames全部答对题"的记忆中总GPU时间最低者；代价是存储，每视频最高约21 GiB，而Text仅需KB级。
AI.conclusion: 复用计算与丢弃信息表面上都表现为效率提升，但只有后者会移除后续问题所需的证据，而平均准确率与token计数都无法区分二者。REEL使这一差异对任何"一次记忆、多问作答"的系统可测量、可比较。

title: SkillMem: Compact External Skill Memory for Latent Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Latent multi-agent systems reduce inference cost by keeping intermediate reasoning and inter-agent communication in continuous representations.\ Reusable skills, however, are commonly supplied as text or stored as layer-wise Key-Value states or skill-specific model parameters, introducing repeated processing or substantial per-skill storage.\ We introduce \textbf{SkillMem}, which represents each reusable skill as a small external latent memory and makes it directly available during latent multi-agent reasoning.\ A role-conditioned cross-attention reader allows the same memory to guide different agents according to their roles and current hidden states.\ We train the skill memories and shared reader through behavioral distillation, matching the change in token predictions induced by a textual skill while keeping the backbone frozen.\ For our experiments, we obtain textual skills from paired successful and failed multi-agent trajectories, although existing skills can also be compiled directly.\ Across six benchmarks and Qwen3 models ranging from 4B to 14B parameters, SkillMem provides strong gains for smaller backbones while preserving efficient latent multi-agent inference across model scales.\ We use the same $8\times256$ memory configuration across all evaluated model scales, requiring 9.6\,KB of skill-specific storage per skill, including its retrieval embedding.\ For a library of 100 skills, SkillMem reduces total storage by more than $38\times$ compared with alternative skill representations and achieves up to a $4.23\times$ end-to-end inference speedup.\ These results show that compact procedural memories can be reused without sacrificing the efficiency of latent multi-agent reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出SkillMem，将可复用技能表示为小型外部潜在记忆，通过角色条件交叉注意力读取器在潜在多智能体推理中直接使用，实现高效技能复用。
AI.motivation: 潜在多智能体系统通过将中间推理与智能体间通信保持在连续表示中以降低推理成本，但可复用技能常以文本形式提供或存为逐层Key-Value状态、技能专用模型参数，导致重复处理或大量按技能存储开销。
AI.method: 将每个可复用技能编码为小型外部潜在记忆，采用角色条件交叉注意力读取器使同一记忆依据智能体角色与当前隐状态指导不同智能体；通过行为蒸馏训练技能记忆与共享读取器——匹配文本技能所诱导的token预测变化，同时冻结骨干模型；文本技能可由配对成功/失败多智能体轨迹获得，亦可直接编译已有技能。
AI.result: 在六个基准与Qwen3（4B–14B）上，SkillMem对较小骨干提升显著，并在各规模保持高效潜在多智能体推理；统一使用8×256记忆配置，每技能含检索嵌入仅需9.6 KB技能专用存储；100技能库下总存储较替代方案降低逾38倍，端到端推理最高加速4.23倍。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的程序性记忆可在不牺牲潜在多智能体推理效率的前提下实现复用。

title: Anchor-Free Range-Free 3D IoT Localization in Buried Environments with Connectivity-Informed Power Selection and Temporal Refinement
summary: In underground and surface mines, wireless Internet-of- Things (IoT) tags deployed with ore or muck loads can support material and grade tracking after burial, when conventional ranging and surveyed localization infrastructure may be unavailable. Building on the three-dimensional Pro- traction Technique (3D-PT), this paper introduces 3D-PT with Power Selection (3D-PT-PS), which selects informative transmit-power levels from binary pilot measurements, and 3D-PT-PS with Temporal Refinement (3D-PT-PST), which incorporates recorded load-deposition times as weak, non- metric cues. Both methods are anchor-free and range-free and require no RSSI, measured ranges, surveyed anchors, pile dimensions, or material parameters. Monte Carlo simulations evaluate different pile sizes and tag densities. In a 5000-t crusher-pocket scenario with 125 tags, 3D-PT-PST achieves 6.12% mean NRMSE and 2.20 m 3D RMSE, reducing mean NRMSE by 13.5% relative to 3D-PT-PS and by 43.6% and 69.1% relative to calibrated MDS-MAP(P) and CATL, respectively. These results show that connectivity and timing provide complementary information.

AI.tldr: 提出无锚点、无测距的3D-PT-PS与3D-PT-PST方法，仅利用二元导频测量与装载时间线索实现矿堆内IoT标签定位，5000 t场景下NRMSE达6.12%。
AI.motivation: 井下与露天矿山中，IoT标签随矿石/废石装载被埋后，常规测距与测站定位基础设施不可用，需要支持物料与品位追踪的定位手段。现有3D-PT依赖固定发射功率的二元连通信息，定位精度与信息利用率仍有提升空间。
AI.method: 在3D-PT基础上提出两项扩展：3D-PT-PS从二元导频测量中筛选信息量高的发射功率等级；3D-PT-PST进一步将记录的装载沉积时间作为弱非度量线索。两方法均为无锚点、无测距，不需要RSSI、实测距离、测站坐标、矿堆尺寸或材料参数。采用蒙特卡洛仿真评估不同矿堆规模与标签密度。
AI.result: 在5000 t破碎机矿仓、125个标签场景下，3D-PT-PST取得6.12%平均NRMSE与2.20 m三维RMSE；相比3D-PT-PS降低NRMSE 13.5%，相比校准MDS-MAP(P)与CATL分别降低43.6%和69.1%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明连通性信息与时间信息具有互补性，二者结合可在无基础设施条件下显著提升矿堆内标签定位精度。

title: Multistable nematic liquid crystal pores as reconfigurable optical vortex metasurfaces
summary: Nematic liquid crystals confined in cylindrical pores adopt multiple stable director topologies --- radial, escaped, and arches --- each imprinting a distinct optical signature on transmitted circularly polarized light, with topological charge set by the projected director winding number, $\ell = 2m$. Using Landau--de Gennes and Jones-calculus modeling validated against micron-scale experiments, we show that this mechanism persists as the pore diameter shrinks toward the optical wavelength. However, full-wave Maxwell simulations of periodic sub-wavelength pore arrays reveal that the resulting vortex is a near-field phenomenon only: each topology imprints a distinguishable phase-singular signature --- differing in core multiplicity, core width, and ring amplitude --- directly below the pore array, but this signature does not survive propagation into the far field, where diffraction and inter-pore interference erase it within about one wavelength. Landau--de Gennes simulations further demonstrate that an applied electric field switches the pore between topologies, and hence between their near-field optical signatures. Because each topology is locally stable, sub-wavelength NLC pore arrays constitute an electrically reconfigurable, non-volatile platform for topology-encoded near-field optical readout, with potential application to optical labeling and anti-counterfeiting.

AI.tldr: 亚波长向列相液晶孔阵列中，不同指向矢拓扑各自在近场印刻可区分的相位奇异光涡旋签名，但该签名不能传播至远场；电场可在局部稳定拓扑间切换，构成电可重构、非易失的拓扑编码近场光学读出平台。
AI.motivation: 圆柱孔中受限向列相液晶存在径向、逃逸、拱形等多种稳定指向矢拓扑，且各自对圆偏振透射光留下不同光学印记；作者希望厘清这一"拓扑—光学"对应关系在孔直径缩小至光学波长时是否仍然成立，以及能否作为可重构的拓扑编码光学平台。
AI.method: 采用Landau–de Gennes理论描述指向矢拓扑及其电场切换，用Jones矩阵计算透射圆偏振光的偏振/相位响应，并以微米尺度实验进行验证；进一步对周期性亚波长孔阵列开展全波Maxwell仿真，考察相位奇异签名的近场结构与远场传播行为。
AI.result: 拓扑电荷由投影指向矢绕数决定，ℓ = 2m；该机制在孔径趋近光学波长时依然有效。全波仿真显示所生成涡旋仅为近场现象：各拓扑在孔阵列正下方呈现可区分的相位奇异签名（核的多重度、核宽度、环振幅不同），但在约一个波长的传播距离内即被衍射与孔间干涉抹除，无法进入远场。Landau–de Gennes仿真表明外加电场可在各拓扑间切换，从而切换其近场光学签名。
AI.conclusion: 由于各拓扑局部稳定，亚波长向列相液晶孔阵列可作为电可重构、非易失的拓扑编码近场光学读出平台，潜在应用于光学标记与防伪。

title: CARF: Context-Aware Reasoning Supervision for Scientific Evidence Screening
summary: Systematic reviews synthesize biomedical evidence to inform clinical and public-health decision-making, but require domain experts to manually screen thousands of studies against detailed eligibility criteria. We investigate whether language models can assist with this bottleneck by learning from expert feedback on title and abstract screening decisions and model-generated reasoning. We introduce the Context-Aware Reasoning Framework (CARF), a human-in-the-loop framework that uses expert feedback on model-generated reasoning to adapt language models to context-dependent screening tasks. We evaluate CARF on systematic reviews of verbal autopsy and cause-of-death ascertainment methods used in global public health mortality surveillance. CARF shows competitive screening performance compared to evaluated models while retaining high sensitivity, and is more inclined to retain ambiguous, context-dependent studies for human review. Together, these findings suggest that expert-corrected reasoning is a promising supervision signal for context-dependent scientific screening, while retaining a role for human oversight.

AI.tldr: 提出人机协同框架CARF，利用专家对模型生成推理的反馈来适配语言模型，用于系统综述的标题与摘要筛选。
AI.motivation: 系统综述需专家手工筛选数千篇文献，成为证据合成的瓶颈；筛选标准高度依赖情境，需探索语言模型能否借助专家推理反馈减轻该负担。
AI.method: Context-Aware Reasoning Framework（CARF）：以模型生成的筛选推理为对象，收集专家对推理的纠正反馈，将其作为监督信号对语言模型进行情境适配，实现human-in-the-loop的文献筛选；在口头尸检与死因判定方法的系统综述上评估。
AI.result: CARF筛选性能与所评估模型具竞争力，同时保持高敏感度；更倾向把模糊、情境依赖的研究保留给人工复核。
AI.conclusion: 经专家纠正的推理是情境依赖型科学筛选的有效监督信号，但人工监督仍不可替代。

title: Self-Supervised Latent Action-Conditioned World Modeling for Time Series
summary: Time-series data play an important role in various tasks, such as weather forecasting, web traffic analysis, and speech recognition. Recently, pioneering studies have increasingly adopted Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) based encoders to learn time-series representations through latent-space prediction. However, they often overlook the underlying factors governing transitions between time-series observations. In this work, we hypothesize that explicitly modeling the information behind changes in time series can facilitate time-series modeling. Building on this hypothesis, we propose ACTS-WM, a self-supervised latent action-conditioned world model framework for time-series analysis. First, we introduce a latent action modeling approach that infers the underlying information behind time-series transitions as latent actions, without requiring explicit action annotations. We then develop a JEPA-based encoder and an action-conditioned world model to predict target time-series representations conditioned on the learned latent actions and task information. We evaluate ACTS-WM across 4 representative tasks on 22 datasets from diverse domains, covering univariate and multivariate forecasting and classification. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that ACTS-WM can improve downstream performance over pretrained JEPA-based encoders by learning complementary representations.

AI.tldr: 提出ACTS-WM：一个自监督的潜动作条件世界模型框架，通过推断时间序列状态转移背后的潜动作并对目标表示进行条件预测，提升时序下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于JEPA的时序编码器仅做潜空间预测，忽略了支配时间序列观测之间转移的潜在因素（underlying factors）。作者假设显式建模时序变化背后的信息可促进时序建模。
AI.method: 1) 潜动作建模：无需显式动作标注，从相邻时间步的状态转移中推断其背后的潜动作；2) 基于JEPA构建编码器；3) 动作条件世界模型：以学到的潜动作与任务信息为条件，预测目标时间序列的表示。整个框架为自监督训练。
AI.result: 在22个跨领域数据集、4类代表性任务（单变量/多变量预测与分类）上进行评估，ACTS-WM相较预训练JEPA编码器提升了下游性能，表明其学到了互补表示。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模时序转移背后的潜动作是可有效增强时序表示学习的途径，ACTS-WM通过动作条件世界模型与JEPA编码器结合，获得更优的泛化与下游表现。

title: Neighbourhood shortcuts in building damage assessment from very-high-resolution satellite imagery: diagnosis and a building-evidence plug-in
summary: Building damage assessment (BDA) from very-high-resolution imagery supports disaster response, and deep models now achieve high overall accuracy on public benchmarks. Because damage is spatially clustered, most buildings share the damage level of their neighbours, so overall scores are dominated by such buildings, whereas damaged buildings among intact ones are rare and easily overlooked. A high overall score therefore cannot tell whether a model judges the building itself or relies on its neighbourhood as a shortcut, and this study tests which of the two current models do. We stratify buildings by their agreement with their neighbours, move buildings into new neighbourhoods with their pixels unchanged, and diagnose nine models covering the main paradigms of BDA. All models miss a third to half of the isolated damaged buildings, and in non-flood events they call 73--87% of intact buildings damaged once these are moved into a damaged neighbourhood. We propose a building-evidence plug-in that adds two experts to an existing model without retraining it. One expert sees only the building, and the other sees its surroundings but is trained with seamlessly swapped neighbourhoods so that it learns not to trust them. With each of the nine models, the plug-in maintains or improves overall accuracy, reduces errors on buildings that disagree with their neighbours by 8--18%, and cuts by 40--69% the intact buildings that a damaged neighbourhood turns into damaged ones. It also raises the detection of synthetic isolated damage from 1--6% to 13--39% and carries over to optical--SAR data and to an unseen earthquake. High overall scores thus conceal a systematic reliance on the neighbourhood, which building-level evidence reduces at low cost.

AI.tldr: 该文指出BDA模型的高总体精度掩盖了对邻域上下文的系统性依赖（捷径学习），并通过邻域交换/分层诊断九种模型；进而提出无需重训的"建筑证据"插件（双专家），在保持总体精度的同时显著降低邻域偏置、提升孤立损毁建筑检测。
AI.motivation: 毁损评估中损毁具空间聚集性，多数建筑与邻居等级一致，总体指标被此类建筑主导；真实场景中"完好中的孤立的损毁建筑"稀少却关键。故高总体分数无法判别模型是判断建筑本体还是利用邻域捷径。
AI.method: 按建筑与邻居的一致性分层；在像素不变前提下将建筑移入新邻域做反事实测试；诊断覆盖BDA主要范式的九个模型。提出建筑证据插件：在已有模型上新增两个专家（一个仅看建筑本体，一个看周边但以无缝交换邻域训练以免信任上下文），无需重训原模型。
AI.result: 九模型均漏检1/3至1/2的孤立损毁建筑；非洪涝事件中，移入损毁邻域的完好建筑有73–87%被误判为损毁。插件使全部九模型总体精度持平或提升，邻域不一致建筑误差降低8–18%，邻域导致的误判减少40–69%，合成孤立损毁检出率由1–6%提升至13–39%，并可迁移至光学–SAR数据与未见地震场景。
AI.conclusion: 高总体分数系统性地掩盖模型对邻域上下文的依赖；以建筑级证据为核心的轻量插件可低成本缓解该捷径，提升真实关键场景的可靠性。

title: GAUSS: A Workload-Aware Analytical and Monte-Carlo Simulator for LLM Inference Serving
summary: Large language model (LLM) inference has become an operational workload that fleets must provision, monitor, and bill against latency service-level objectives (SLOs). A single throughput number cannot answer the questions operators actually face, because generative serving couples two phases with very different service characteristics, continuous batching reshapes the effective service process, and user-visible tail latency can degrade long before aggregate throughput saturates. We present GAUSS, a workload-aware analytical and Monte-Carlo simulator that predicts the full distributions of time-to-first-token (TTFT) and time-between-tokens (TBT), together with the sustainable request rate, for a given workload, engine, and accelerator. GAUSS pairs calibrated, phase-specific latency surfaces for prefill and decode with a Lindley-recurrence model of queueing under stochastic arrivals and estimates performance by ensemble Monte-Carlo sampling rather than by replaying a single trace. This lets GAUSS reason about workloads, routing policies, and hardware that have never been deployed, and to capture the latency tails that trace-driven simulators systematically under-sample. We describe the model and show how it supports operating-point selection, traffic segmentation, and shortest-remaining-processing-time scheduling capacity questions that trace-driven simulators cannot address.

AI.tldr: 提出GAUSS：面向LLM推理服务的workload-aware解析+蒙特卡洛模拟器，预测TTFT/TBT完整分布与可持续请求速率。
AI.motivation: 单一批量吞吐数字无法回答运维实际问题：生成式服务包含prefill与decode两阶段且特性迥异，continuous batching重塑有效服务过程，且尾延迟在总吞吐饱和前就已恶化。因此需要一个能刻画延迟分布、支持未部署工作负载/路由/硬件分析的预测工具。
AI.method: GAUSS将prefill与decode各自的、经校准的分阶段延迟曲面（latency surfaces）与随机到达下的Lindley递推排队模型结合，通过集成蒙特卡洛采样（ensemble Monte-Carlo）而非单条trace回放来估计性能分布。
AI.result: 能预测TTFT与TBT的完整分布及可持续请求速率；可对从未部署过的工作负载、路由策略和硬件进行推理，并能捕获trace驱动模拟器系统性欠采样的延迟尾部。
AI.conclusion: GAUSS支撑trace驱动模拟器难以处理的运维问题，包括运行点选择（operating-point selection）、流量分段（traffic segmentation）以及最短剩余处理时间（SRPT）调度容量分析。

title: Evaluating Generalization and Long-Term Stability of Smartwatch-Based Cuffless Blood Pressure Monitoring
comment: Accepted by the 2026 IEEE EMBS International Conference on Biomedical and Health Informatics (BHI 2026)
summary: Smartwatch-based cuffless blood pressure (BP) monitoring is a promising low-burden solution for long-term cardiovascular management, but practical deployment remains constrained by model complexity, uncertain cross-dataset generalization, and insufficient evidence on long-term tracking stability. This study presents an efficient Signal-Context Gated Fusion Network (SCGBPNet) for cuffless BP estimation from photoplethysmography (PPG) signals. SCGBPNet integrates signal-level representations through self-attention and further incorporates subject-specific contextual information via a compact gated fusion module. On Aurora-BP, SCGBPNet achieved SBP/DBP mean absolute errors (MAEs) of 7.08/4.90 mmHg, compared with 6.44/4.89 mmHg under within-dataset validation on the private smartwatch dataset, indicating a modest within-dataset discrepancy. Cross-dataset transfer from Aurora-BP to the smartwatch dataset increased the MAEs to 8.98/6.47 mmHg, demonstrating substantial cross-dataset degradation. For long-term stability, the proposed method showed low week-to-week performance variation and a low daily decay rate, indicating good stability over a follow-up period of more than one month. Nevertheless, estimation accuracy deteriorated when BP deviated substantially from an individual's baseline. These findings indicate that favorable aggregate MAE alone should not be interpreted as evidence of deployment-ready performance. More systematic and stratified evaluation across dataset settings, BP ranges, and baseline-deviation levels is needed to assess the practical reliability of smartwatch-based cuffless BP monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级信号-上下文门控融合网络SCGBPNet，用PPG估计无袖带血压；组内MAE尚可但跨数据集迁移与偏离基线时性能显著下降，呼吁分层系统评估。
AI.motivation: 智能手表无袖带血压监测是有前景的低负担长期心血管管理方案，但实际部署受限于模型复杂度高、跨数据集泛化不确定、长期追踪稳定性证据不足三大问题。
AI.method: 构建高效Signal-Context Gated Fusion Network（SCGBPNet）：以自注意力整合信号级PPG表征，再通过紧凑门控融合模块引入受试者特定的上下文信息；在Aurora-BP公开数据集与私有智能手表数据集上开展组内验证、跨数据集迁移评估，并进行逾一个月的长期稳定性（周间波动、日衰减率）与基线偏离分层分析。
AI.result: Aurora-BP上SBP/DBP MAE为7.08/4.90 mmHg，私有手表数据集组内验证为6.44/4.89 mmHg（组内差异不大）；Aurora-BP→手表数据集迁移后MAE升至8.98/6.47 mmHg，跨数据集退化明显；长期随访周间波动小、日衰减率低，稳定性良好；但当血压显著偏离个体基线时精度明显下降。
AI.conclusion: 总体MAE指标良好不足以证明模型具备部署可用性；需在数据集设置、血压区间与基线偏离水平上进行系统化、分层化评估，方能判断手表无袖带血压监测的实际可靠性。

title: Scale-free wave localization at topological multicriticality
summary: Spatial wave localization at boundaries is conventionally restricted to exponential decay. Here, we observe a scale-free boundary mode exhibiting anomalous polynomial decay, highlighted by strictly linear spatial envelopes, driven by topological multicriticality in acoustic metamaterials. We establish a universal geometric bulk-boundary correspondence rooted in singularity theory by mapping n-th order topological multicriticality onto Arnold An catastrophe. We prove that defectiveness in the spatial transfer matrix enforces a (n-1)-th power spatial decay of boundary modes. At a topological tri-critical point, the singularity of winding function manifests as an A2 fold catastrophe. This dictates a strictly linear spatial decay, marking a sharp departure from the conventional exponential scaling paradigm. Using acoustic metamaterial platforms tuned to a tricritical point, we experimentally demonstrate this linear decay envelope in 1D, and further generalize it to two-dimensional systems to realize scale-free corner modes with simultaneous linear decay along orthogonal directions. While existing critical topology frameworks rely on entanglement spectra to diagnose mode existence in gapless regimes, our work bridges catastrophe theory with topological matter at multicriticalities, advancing the field from abstract mode identification to deterministic real-space wavefunction engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文在声学超材料中观测到由拓扑多重临界性驱动的无标度边界模式，其空间包络呈严格线性（多项式）衰减而非指数衰减，并借助突变理论建立了几何体-边对应关系。
AI.motivation: 传统空间波局域化在边界处被限制为指数衰减，而已有临界拓扑框架主要依赖纠缠谱在无能隙区诊断模式存在性，缺乏对实空间波函数衰减形式的确定性刻画与工程化调控手段。
AI.method: 将n阶拓扑多重临界性映射到Arnold A_n 突变，基于奇点理论建立几何体-边对应；证明空间转移矩阵的亏损性（defectiveness）强制边界模式呈(n-1)次幂空间衰减；在拓扑三临界点上，绕数函数的奇异性表现为A2折叠突变，从而给出严格线性衰减。利用调至三临界点的声学超材料平台，在一维实验验证线性衰减包络，并推广至二维实现沿正交方向同时线性衰减的无标度角模式。
AI.result: 在一维声学超材料中实验观测到严格线性的边界模式空间包络；在二维系统中实现无标度角模式，其沿两个正交方向均呈线性衰减，显著偏离传统指数标度范式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将突变理论与多重临界点的拓扑物质相桥接，把研究从抽象的模存在性识别推进到确定性的实空间波函数工程，为超越指数局域化范式的无标度波调控提供了普适理论框架与实验平台。

title: From Error Prediction to Causal Influence: Auditing SAE Features in Multiple-Choice QA
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) can predict internal features associated with model errors, but association alone does not establish causal influence. We study this distinction in multiple-choice question answering, where answer preference can be measured by the logit margin between the correct answer and the competing choices. Across eight datasets, we analyze Gemma~3 1B and 4B with Gemma Scope SAEs. We propose a pipeline to filter out the features that have high correlation with format and content artifacts, such as prompt and answer permutation, and evaluate the remaining ones with causal feature interventions. Our results show that SAE activations contain predictive signals about wrongness and uncertainty across models and datasets. After filtering artifact-contaminated features, selected features for causal intervention at question and option spans produce larger absolute margin shifts and a higher wrong-to-correct rate than randomly selected features, indicating greater causal leverage. However, answer flips are rare, and we do not observe stable effect directions across meaning-preserving changes in prompt format and answer order. An adapted HalluSAE baseline produces larger final-token margin changes, but relies on substantially contaminated features and does not significantly improve correction rates. Therefore, the identified features reflect context-dependent answer competition rather than the mechanism of incorrect answer errors.

AI.tldr: 该论文区分SAE特征的"相关性"与"因果性"，提出过滤格式/内容伪影的特征筛选流程，并用因果干预证明筛选后特征具有更大因果杠杆，但翻转率低、方向不稳定，说明这些特征反映的是上下文相关的答案竞争而非错误机制本身。
AI.motivation: SAE虽能预测与模型错误相关的内部特征，但相关性不等于因果影响。作者希望在多项选择问答中厘清二者区别，检验SAE特征是否真正构成错误答案的因果机制，而非仅受提示格式、答案排列等伪影驱动的表面关联。
AI.method: 以正确选项与竞争选项间的logit margin度量答案偏好；使用Gemma 3 1B/4B与Gemma Scope SAE，在八个数据集上分析。提出流程先剔除与格式及内容伪影（提示词、答案排列变换）高相关的特征，对剩余特征在问题与选项span上进行因果特征干预；并设随机特征与改编版HalluSAE基线作对照。
AI.result: SAE激活在不同模型与数据集上均含有关于错误与不确定性的预测信号。过滤伪影后，选中特征在问题与选项span干预时产生更大的绝对margin位移及更高的错→对转换率，显示更强因果杠杆；但答案翻转罕见，且在保持语义的提示格式与答案顺序变化下未观察到稳定效应方向。HalluSAE基线产生更大末token margin变化，但依赖严重受污染的特征，纠正率无显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 所识别的SAE特征体现的是上下文相关的答案竞争，而非错误答案产生的机制。相关性分析与因果干预需严格区分，特征筛选须控制格式与内容伪影，否则因果杠杆会被高估。

title: Application of PDE emulators for a multi-material, multi-physics simulation problem
comment: Accepted at ICMLA 2026, Rochester, MI, USA
summary: Machine learning (ML) architectures are being developed for fast emulation of numerical simulators to accelerate both scientific discovery and engineering design. While these approaches are well-tested on popular PDE (partial differential equation) benchmarks, it is necessary to evaluate their performance on datasets that more accurately reflect industrial and engineering applications. We evaluate several computer vision-based architectures trained as surrogate models on a challenging computational physics task involving multiple materials, revealing significant implementation challenges for adapting certain pre-trained models, including transformer-based architectures. For such multi-physics multi-material datasets, our results underscore the importance of learning algorithms designed for sparse and imbalanced data, techniques for adapting spatial encodings and physical consistency metrics, in addition to methods for reducing the cost of generating sufficient training data.

AI.tldr: 本文评估多种计算机视觉架构作为代理模型在多材料计算物理任务上的表现，揭示Transformer等预训练模型在工业级多物理多材料数据集上的适配难题。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习代理模型多在主流PDE基准上验证，缺乏对更贴近工业与工程应用数据集的性能评估。
AI.method: 在涉及多种材料的挑战性计算物理任务上，将若干基于计算机视觉的架构训练为代理模型，并对比其适配性与性能。
AI.result: 发现包括基于Transformer架构在内的部分预训练模型存在显著实现挑战；此类多物理多材料数据集对稀疏与不平衡数据的学习算法、空间编码与物理一致性度量适配技术，以及降低训练数据生成成本的方法尤为敏感。
AI.conclusion: 面向多物理多材料数据集，需重视针对稀疏不平衡数据的学习算法、空间编码与物理一致性度量适配，以及降低数据生成成本的方法。

title: Complementing Text Based Moderation with Multimodal Grounding: Detecting Fraudulent Inducement Behaviors on Short Video Platforms
summary: Short video platforms have become a primary channel for black and gray industry operations in internet finance, where inducements such as prompts to like, follow, join private chat groups, or click external links frequently steer users toward fraud. Because such videos are short, dynamic, and often convey intent through fleeting visual cues rather than stable text, a moderation system must guarantee detection recall and localize the offending segment so reviewers inspect only the relevant clip. Existing OCR+LLM pipelines transcribe on-screen text frame by frame and classify the transcript, but exploit only textual information. Many inducements are conveyed through visual cues OCR cannot observe, and keyframe-based localization cannot recover precise temporal boundaries. We explore OCR+MLLM, which augments the text pipeline with a Multimodal Large Language Model, and compare three routes: OCR+LLM, OCR+MLLM, and a large zero-shot MLLM, along detection, latency, token consumption, and deployment complexity. OCR preserves the text signal that guarantees recall, while the MLLM jointly performs OCR-grounded discrimination and temporal grounding, localizing both textual and non-textual inducements. We construct a dataset of 2,419 internet finance short videos (66.49 hours) with 3,194 annotated events across four categories, and study reward design for RL-based grounding under class imbalance. We report two findings: auxiliary reward terms are exploited through reward hacking, and stronger localization rewards degrade class-balanced detection. We therefore design a recall-weighted F2 localization reward with class-balanced resampling. Experiments show OCR+MLLM localizes better than the keyframe OCR+LLM baseline (mIoU 26.52 vs. 14.49) and detects non-textual inducements that text-only pipelines miss, while maintaining 67.0 percent macro recall.

AI.tldr: 提出 OCR+MLLM 混合路线，兼顾文本召回保证与非文本诱导线索的判别和精确时间定位；并揭示 RL 定位奖励设计中的奖励破解与类别不平衡问题，采用召回加权 F2 定位奖励与类别平衡重采样解决。
AI.motivation: 短视频平台成为互联网金融黑灰产主要渠道，点赞/关注/私聊/外链等诱导易引向诈骗。此类视频短、动态、意图依赖瞬时视觉线索而非稳定文本，治理需同时保证检测召回并精确定位违规片段以便人工只复核相关片段。现有 OCR+LLM 流水线仅逐帧转写文本并分类，忽略 OCR 无法观察的视觉诱导，且基于关键帧的定位无法恢复精确时间边界。
AI.method: 构建 2,419 条互联网金融短视频（66.49 小时）、3,194 个标注事件、四类别的数据集；对比三条路线：OCR+LLM、OCR+MLLM、大规模零样本 MLLM，从检测、时延、token 消耗与部署复杂度评估。OCR 保留保障召回的文本信号，MLLM 联合执行 OCR 接地判别与时间定位，可定位文本与非文本诱导。研究类别不平衡下 RL 定位的奖励设计，提出召回加权 F2 定位奖励 + 类别平衡重采样。
AI.result: 发现两点：辅助奖励项会被奖励破解（reward hacking）利用；更强的定位奖励会损害类别平衡检测性能。实验显示 OCR+MLLM 定位优于关键帧 OCR+LLM 基线（mIoU 26.52 vs. 14.49），可检出纯文本流水线漏掉的非文本诱导，并保持 67.0% 宏平均召回。
AI.conclusion: OCR+MLLM 在保证文本召回的前提下，通过 MLLM 实现文本与非文本诱导的联合判别和精确时间接地，优于纯文本 OCR+LLM 与关键帧定位方案；RL 定位奖励需谨慎设计以避免奖励破解与检测性能退化。

title: Algorithmic Bias from the Perspectives of Healthcare Professionals
summary: This paper focuses on algorithmic bias of machine learning and artificial intelligence applications in healthcare information systems. Based on the quantitative data and qualitative comments from a survey and interviews with healthcare professionals, who have different job roles (e.g., clinical vs. administrative), this study provides findings about the relationships between algorithmic bias, perceived fairness, and the intended acceptance and adoption of ML algorithms and algorithm generated outcomes. The results suggest that the opinions of healthcare professionals toward the causes of algorithmic bias, the criteria of algorithm assessment, the perceived fairness, and bias mitigation approaches may vary depending on their job roles, perspectives, tasks, and the algorithm characteristics. More research is needed to investigate algorithmic bias to ensure fairness and equality in healthcare.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于问卷调查与访谈，考察医疗信息系统中医护人员对机器学习算法偏见的成因、评估标准、感知公平性及偏误缓解方式的态度，并分析其与算法接受和采用意愿的关系。
AI.motivation: 机器学习与人工智能在医疗信息系统中的应用日益广泛，算法偏见可能损害公平与平等，而不同岗位人员对偏见的认知差异尚不清楚。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：对具有不同岗位角色（如临床与行政）的医疗专业人员进行问卷调查（定量数据）与访谈（定性评论），分析算法偏见、感知公平性与ML算法及算法生成结果的预期接受与采用之间的关系。
AI.result: 医护人员对算法偏见成因、算法评估标准、感知公平性和偏误缓解途径的看法，可能因其岗位角色、视角、任务及算法特征的不同而存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 需进一步研究算法偏见，以确保医疗领域的公平与平等。

title: On the Performance of AoA-Based Physical-Layer Authentication Under Multi-Source Impersonation Attacks
summary: This paper investigates cooperative impersonation attacks against angle-of-arrival (AoA)-based authentication for a wireless communication receiver equipped with a digital uniform linear array. Specifically, we characterize the vulnerability and robustness of this authentication system in relation to adversarial angular diversity and the relative numbers of adversarial sources and receive antennas. To this end, we first derive the optimal precoding vector for multiple spatially distributed adversarial sources by minimizing the mean squared error between legitimate and adversarial received signals. By means of the rank property of Vandermonde matrices, we then establish necessary and sufficient conditions under which the adversarial sources can reproduce the legitimate transmitter's spatial signature. With fewer adversarial sources than receive antennas, perfect reproduction is not possible without at least one adversarial source satisfying a specific AoA condition. In the other case, increasing the number of receive antennas can reduce impersonation success probabilities when none of the adversarial sources has an AoA satisfying this condition. Numerical results validate the theoretical analysis and evaluate the security performance of AoA-based authentication.

AI.tldr: 本文研究针对基于到达角（AoA）认证的协作冒充攻击，在数字均匀线阵接收机场景下，刻画了系统脆弱性与鲁棒性与对抗角分集及对抗源/接收天线数量比之间的关系，并给出了对抗源完美复现合法空间签名的充要条件。
AI.motivation: 基于AoA的物理层认证依赖发射机空间签名的不可伪造性，但多个空间分布的对抗源可能协作冒充合法发射机，其可行性与安全性边界尚缺乏理论刻画，尤其缺乏关于对抗角分集与天线/源数量比的定量分析。
AI.method: 1）以合法与对抗接收信号间均方误差最小化为准则，推导多空间分布对抗源的最优预编码向量；2）利用Vandermonde矩阵的秩性质，建立对抗源能够复现合法发射机空间签名的必要且充分条件；3）分对抗源数少于接收天线数与其他两种情形分别分析，并结合数值仿真验证。
AI.result: 当对抗源数少于接收天线数时，除非至少有一个对抗源满足特定AoA条件，否则无法完美复现合法空间签名；在另一情形下，若无对抗源满足该AoA条件，增加接收天线数量可降低冒充成功概率。
AI.conclusion: AoA认证的安全性由对抗角分集以及对抗源与接收天线的相对数量共同决定；增加接收天线数量在特定条件下可有效提升抗协作冒充能力，理论分析经数值结果验证。

title: Contact-free charge carrier density determination of doped sub-μm thin cubic GaN layers with terahertz time-domain spectroscopy
summary: As cubic GaN is a promising material for optoelectronic applications, its layers need to be precisely doped to realize the desired properties. While contact-based methods are established to measure the realized charge carrier density, contact-free techniques are more advantageous for this purpose. We show terahertz time-domain spectroscopy measurements of cubic GaN layers with thicknesses between 0.6 $μ$m and 2 $μ$m with doping densities in the range from $10^{18}$ cm$^{-3}$ to $10^{20}$ cm$^{-3}$. From these measurements, we determine the charge carrier densities and verify the results with time-of-flight secondary-ion mass spectrometry measurements. The results are in accordance with simulations of the doping ranges which the technique is expected to be sensitive in. In preparation for the terahertz time-domain spectroscopy measurements, we validated the layer thicknesses by Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy measurements. With this, a wide range of doped cubic GaN samples can be addressed by optical methods. In the future, these techniques could allow for a fast and non-destructive characterization of GaN layers, right after or even during the growth process.

AI.tldr: 利用太赫兹时域光谱无损测定立方GaN层的载流子浓度，并与SIMS和模拟结果相互验证。
AI.motivation: 立方GaN在光电器件中应用前景好，需精确掺杂；接触式测载流子浓度虽已成熟，但无接触方法更具优势。
AI.method: 对厚度0.6–2 μm、掺杂10^18–10^20 cm^-3的立方GaN层进行太赫兹时域光谱测量，提取载流子浓度；用飞行时间二次离子质谱验证结果，并与灵敏度范围模拟对比；测量前用傅里叶变换红外光谱标定层厚。
AI.result: THz-TDS提取的载流子浓度与SIMS结果一致，且落在模拟预测的灵敏掺杂区间内；层厚经FTIR验证。
AI.conclusion: 光学方法可覆盖较宽掺杂范围的立方GaN样品，有望实现生长后甚至生长过程中的快速、无损表征。

title: Prompt Lottery in LLM-as-a-Judge: Measuring and Mitigating Sensitivity to Syntactic Rephrasing
summary: LLM-as-a-Judge has become a standard for evaluating large language models, yet most approaches implicitly assume that a single judge prompt functions as a stable evaluation instrument. Prior work has primarily explored deliberate prompt modifications such as scoring rubrics, role descriptions, or chain-of-thought reasoning in order to optimize accuracy. In contrast, we investigate whether validated prompt variants intended to preserve evaluation semantics while differing in surface realization (\textit{paraphrastic rephrasings}) yield consistent judgments under a fixed evaluation task. We introduce \textit{Prompt Lottery}, a phenomenon in which paraphrastic rephrasings produce different LLMaJ judgments. Across a large-scale study spanning diverse evaluation tasks, judge families, and model backbones, we find that these variations can alter evaluation outcomes and, in some settings, reverse relative model rankings. A user study with 10 human annotators shows that LLMaJ judges exhibit 6-9$\times$ larger agreement degradation under prompt rephrasings than humans, falling below the generally accepted threshold in usability studies. This indicates that single-prompt evaluation is insufficiently robust for model ranking. Finally, we show that multi-prompt aggregation substantially improves robustness by emphasizing judgments that remain consistent across prompt variants.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"Prompt Lottery"现象：语义等价但表述不同的prompt改写会使LLM-as-a-Judge评判结果变化，甚至反转模型相对排名。人类在改写下的一致性退化远小于LLM评判者（后者为6-9倍），说明单prompt评估不足以支撑模型排名，而多prompt聚合可显著提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-as-a-Judge研究多假设单一judge prompt是稳定的评估工具，既往工作主要关注刻意的prompt改动（评分标准、角色设定、CoT）以提升准确率，却忽视了"保持评估语义、仅改变表层表述"的改写是否会导致判断不一致，从而质疑单prompt评估的稳健性。
AI.method: 构造经验证的paraphrastic rephrasings（保持语义、改变表面形式），在多样化评估任务、多种judge家族和模型backbone上进行大规模实验，考察改写对评判结果及模型排名的影响；结合10名人类标注者的用户研究，对比人类与LLM judge在改写下的一致性退化幅度；并提出多prompt聚合方法，强调跨prompt变体一致性的判断。
AI.result: paraphrastic rephrasings会改变评估结果，某些设置下甚至反转模型相对排名；人类标注者在改写下的一致性退化远小于LLM judge，LLM judge的退化幅度为人类的6-9倍，并低于可用性研究中普遍接受的一致性阈值；多prompt聚合能显著提升稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 单prompt的LLM-as-a-Judge评估对模型排名而言稳健性不足，评估结果部分取决于prompt表述这一"抽签"式偶然性；应采用多prompt聚合、聚焦跨变体一致判断的方式来提升评估可靠性。

title: Sometimes less is more: Investigating inductive biases of MLPs and Transformers on noisy k-parity features
summary: We empirically investigate how MLPs and Transformers differ when trained on data sets containing one or more features encoded by noisy k-parity. Noisy k-parity gives us hard synthetic data sets in which we can control the predictivity and availability of every feature. Across a range of data distributions, data scales and model sizes, we find large differences in the training dynamics and inductive biases of the two architectures: Transformers are more robust to noisy features but struggle to learn complex, low-availability features, whereas MLPs show the opposite trend and improve steadily with more data. We also find that, under a fixed training budget, increasing the number of unique training examples can slow Transformer optimisation enough to reduce final accuracy, so that a smaller data set performs better. Training-accuracy results show this is an optimisation-speed effect; it shrinks, but does not vanish, when the budget is scaled with the data set size. By giving precise control over feature predictivity and availability, this testbed offers a clear starting point for understanding when and why Transformers and MLPs learn differently, and for designing data and training budgets that exploit those differences.

AI.tldr: 该文用含噪声k-parity特征的合成数据集，实证比较MLP与Transformer的训练动力学与归纳偏置差异。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺少对特征"可预测性"与"可用性"可精确控制的实验平台，难以厘清Transformer与MLP学习行为差异的成因。
AI.method: 构建以噪声k-parity编码特征的合成数据集，可独立控制每个特征的可预测性与可用性；在多种数据分布、数据规模与模型规模下，对比MLP与Transformer的训练动力学，并考察固定训练预算下样本数量对收敛速度与最终精度的影响。
AI.result: Transformer对噪声特征更鲁棒，但难以学习复杂、低可用性的特征；MLP呈相反趋势，并随数据量增加稳步提升。在固定训练预算下，增加唯一样本数会拖慢Transformer优化，导致最终精度下降，即更小数据集反而更优；训练精度结果表明这是优化速度效应，预算随数据规模缩放时该效应减弱但未消失。
AI.conclusion: 该测试平台通过精确控制特征可预测性与可用性，为理解Transformer与MLP学习差异的时机与原因、以及设计数据集与训练预算提供了清晰起点。

title: Silhouette-Based Gaitomics for Frailty Assessment in Older Adults
summary: Walking offers a window into physical function that may support interpretable video-based frailty assessment. We developed silhouette-based "gaitomics" to connect frailty predictions with measurable patterns of body configuration and movement. In 66 older adults assessed using the Fried Frailty Phenotype, standardized silhouettes and gait energy images yielded 90 descriptors of shape, temporal variation, motion, and texture. Minimum redundancy maximum relevance selection using the mutual information difference criterion prioritized informative features while limiting redundancy. Each classifier was evaluated using nested stratified cross-validation with five outer and three inner folds at the participant level, with feature ranking and feature-count selection confined to training partitions. Shapley additive explanations examined contributions to held-out predictions. Bilateral silhouette difference led the aggregate feature-selection rankings for three-class classification and both comparisons involving frail participants. Attribution profiles differed across tasks, with texture and consecutive-frame silhouette differences prominent in three-class classification. Among classifier-specific evaluations, CatBoost achieved the highest mean three-class micro-AUC of 0.647 \pm 0.085. Leading pairwise mean micro-AUCs were 0.833 \pm 0.249 for frail versus nonfrail, 0.765 \pm 0.168 for frail versus prefrail, and 0.554 \pm 0.129 for prefrail versus nonfrail classification. These findings connect model predictions to explicit gait characteristics while revealing task-dependent feature priorities and limited separation of prefrail and nonfrail participants. The framework provides an interpretable basis for further investigation, with larger independent studies needed to establish reliability and clinical relevance.

AI.tldr: 提出基于轮廓的"步态组学"(gaitomics)，将衰弱预测与可测量的身体构型与运动模式关联，并在66名老年人中验证可解释性。
AI.motivation: 步行可反映身体功能，有望支撑可解释的、基于视频的衰弱评估，但预测模型与可量化步态特征之间缺乏明确联系。
AI.method: 基于标准化剪影与步态能量图提取形状、时间变异、运动与纹理共90个描述子；用mRMR（互信息差准则）做特征选择；以参与者为单位的嵌套分层交叉验证（5外层×3内层）评估分类器，特征排序与数量选择仅在训练集内进行；用SHAP分析对留出预测的贡献。
AI.result: 双侧剪影差异在三分类及两个涉及衰弱者的比较中位列特征选择首位；归因模式随任务而异，三分类中纹理与相邻帧剪影差异较突出。CatBoost三分类平均micro-AUC最高为0.647±0.085；成对平均micro-AUC：衰弱vs非衰弱0.833±0.249、衰弱vs衰弱前期0.765±0.168、衰弱前期vs非衰弱0.554±0.129。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将模型预测与明确的步态特征相连接，揭示任务依赖的特征优先级及衰弱前期与非衰弱区分能力有限的问题；为后续研究提供可解释基础，仍需更大规模独立研究确证其可靠性与临床价值。

title: Assessing Language Models for Scientific Applications: Inertial Confinement Fusion as a Use Case
summary: Advancing language models for specialized scientific applications requires evaluations of scientific fluency, physical reasoning, and quantitative analyses. Using inertial confinement fusion (ICF) as a test case, we have developed an expert-curated benchmark of 250 questions spanning qualitative reasoning, numerical calculation, symbolic derivation, and equation formulation. Responses have been evaluated using deterministic numerical and symbolic checks together with language-model judges. We compared a variety of out-of-the-box closed-source and open-source large language models with Prospero, a model specialized through combined domain-adaptive pretraining and supervised fine-tuning for ICF. We also conducted initial retrieval-assisted evaluations. Prospero improved its aggregate score by 10.7 percentage points over its base model, with gains across all question types. Frontier models achieved the highest aggregate scores, but critical physics errors persisted, particularly in numerical calculations. We note that domain-specific performance can improve through specialization, but benchmark gains alone do not establish scientific reliability. Retrieval improved performance for a smaller model but yielded no statistically significant improvement for a frontier model. Two scientific stress tests further illustrate useful capabilities and the need for expert assessment of physical assumptions and model validity. Based on these findings, we recommend evaluating existing domain capabilities and retrieval benefits before committing to substantial additional specialization.

AI.tldr: 以惯性约束聚变(ICF)为测试场景，构建250题专家基准（定性推理、数值计算、符号推导、方程构建），用确定性数值/符号校验加LLM评判对比闭源/开源模型与领域特化模型Prospero，发现特化可提分但不足以证明科学可靠性。
AI.motivation: 科学专用语言模型需要评估科学流畅性、物理推理与定量分析能力，但缺乏专家把关的领域基准，且领域特化与检索增强的实际收益尚不明确，需在投入大量特化工作前先摸清现状。
AI.method: 构建250题的ICF专家人工整理基准，覆盖定性推理、数值计算、符号推导与方程构建四类任务；采用确定性数值与符号检查结合语言模型评判进行评分；对比多种开箱即用的闭源与开源大模型，以及通过领域自适应预训练+监督微调特化的Prospero模型，并开展初步的检索辅助评估与两项科学压力测试。
AI.result: Prospero相对其基座模型总分提升10.7个百分点，且四类题型均有增益；前沿模型取得最高总分，但仍存在关键物理错误，数值计算尤为突出；检索对小模型有提升，对前沿模型无统计显著提升；两项压力测试显示模型具备可用能力，但物理假设与模型有效性仍需专家判断。
AI.conclusion: 领域特化可提升领域内表现，但基准分数提升并不等同于科学可靠性；建议在投入大规模额外特化之前，先评估现有模型的领域能力与检索收益，并强调专家评估在物理假设与模型有效性判断中的必要性。

title: Beyond Diagonal RIS for Physical-Layer Security: Low-Complexity Solution in the Low-SNR Regime
comment: Submitted for publication in IEEE journals
summary: This letter investigates beyond diagonal reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (BD-RIS) for physical-layer security (PLS) in correlated wiretap channels. A multi-antenna transmitter is considered, and transmit antenna selection (TAS) is used to exploit transmit-side diversity with a single active radio-frequency (RF) chain. Using the first-order secrecy rate approximation, we develop a two-stage scheme to maximize the secrecy rate in the low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) regime. In the first stage, two TAS schemes are developed based on the effective channel upper-bound. In the second stage, an eigenvector-based BD-RIS scattering matrix is designed for single-connected, group-connected, and fully-connected architectures. Unlike legitimate-user-centric or eavesdropping-nulling designs, the proposed approach balances legitimate-user signal enhancement and information-leakage suppression without forcing zero leakage. Simulation results show improved secrecy performance, particularly under a strong correlation between legitimate and eavesdropping channels.

AI.tldr: 该文研究相关窃听信道下基于超越对角可重构智能表面（BD-RIS）的物理层安全（PLS），提出低信噪比区间两阶段方案：先基于有效信道上界设计两种发射天线选择（TAS）方案，再为单连接/群连接/全连接架构设计基于特征向量的BD-RIS散射矩阵，以提升保密速率。
AI.motivation: 在相关窃听信道场景中，需以单个射频链路获得发射分集并利用BD-RIS增强物理层安全；现有以合法用户为中心或窃听零陷式设计未兼顾信号增强与信息泄露抑制。
AI.method: 采用一阶保密速率近似，在低SNR区间构建两阶段优化：第一阶段依据有效信道上界推导两种发射天线选择（TAS）方案；第二阶段设计基于特征向量的BD-RIS散射矩阵，覆盖单连接、群连接与全连接三种架构。
AI.result: 所提方案在不强制零泄露的前提下兼顾合法信号增强与泄露抑制，仿真显示保密性能提升，且在合法信道与窃听信道强相关时尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: BD-RIS结合TAS可有效提升相关窃听信道下的物理层安全性能，特征向量式散射矩阵设计为多架构BD-RIS提供了低复杂度且折中的保密优化途径。

title: Nemotron 3.5 Super and Lightning: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Models for Agentic AI
summary: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Super and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, open and efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer models designed for reasoning, long-context understanding, and agentic workloads. Super is a 120B-parameter, 12B-active multimodal model, while Lightning is a smaller 30B-parameter, 3B-active text model; both designed for efficient deployment. Both models combine large-scale distillation, long-context training, and native speculative decoding, while Super further incorporates Indic continued pretraining and agentic software-engineering mid-training. We develop a comprehensive post-training pipeline spanning supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RLVR and RLHF), complemented in Super by specialized teacher training and multi- teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). This transforms Super from a text-only base model into a multimodal agent capable of reasoning over text, images, video, and interactive tool environments. We further explore test-time scaling through parallel agent execution and self-verification. Across training and deployment, we jointly optimize capability and efficiency. Indic continued pretraining improves Indian-language benchmarks by up to 9.82 percentage points, while agentic mid-training strengthens software-engineering capabilities and robustness across agent harnesses. The post-trained Super model achieves 51.78% on SWE-bench Pro, surpassing Nemotron 3 Ultra despite using approximately 4.6x fewer active parameters. Post-training MTP boosting improves speculative- decoding acceptance length by up to 21.8% under probabilistic draft sampling, while NVFP4 quantization achieves 99.62% median accuracy recovery relative to BF16. Inference optimizations enable up to 4,856 output tokens/s/GPU on GB200 while sustaining at least 50 tokens/s/user.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Nemotron 3.5 Super（120B总参/12B激活，多模态）与 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning（30B总参/3B激活，纯文本）两款开源高效 MoE Hybrid Mamba-Transformer 模型，面向推理、长上下文与智能体任务；通过大规模蒸馏、长上下文训练、原生投机解码、Indic 继续预训练与软件工程智能体中训练，并结合 SFT/RLVR/RLHF 及多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）的后训练流水线，在能力与效率上同时取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 面向推理、长上下文理解与智能体（agentic）负载，需要兼顾强能力与部署效率的模型；本文旨在以更少激活参数实现更强表现，并在训练与部署全流程中联合优化能力与效率。
AI.method: 采用 MoE Hybrid Mamba-Transformer 架构（Super：120B总参/12B激活、多模态；Lightning：30B总参/3B激活、文本）；预训练阶段结合大规模蒸馏、长上下文训练、原生投机解码，Super 额外加入 Indic 继续预训练与智能体软件工程中训练；后训练包含 SFT、RLVR、RLHF，Super 另设专门教师训练与多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD），将其从纯文本基座转为可对文本、图像、视频和交互式工具环境进行推理的多模态智能体；并探索并行智能体执行与自验证的测试时扩展（test-time scaling）。
AI.result: Indic 继续预训练使印度语基准最高提升 9.82 个百分点；智能体中训练增强软件工程能力及跨 agent harness 的鲁棒性；后训练 Super 在 SWE-bench Pro 上达 51.78%，在激活参数约为 Nemotron 3 Ultra 的 1/4.6 情况下实现超越；后训练 MTP boosting 在概率式草稿采样下将投机解码接受长度提升最高 21.8%；NVFP4 量化相对 BF16 达到 99.62% 的中位精度恢复；推理优化在 GB200 上实现最高 4,856 output tokens/s/GPU，同时保持至少 50 tokens/s/user。
AI.conclusion: 通过架构、训练与推理优化的协同设计，Nemotron 3.5 Super 与 Lightning 在显著更低的激活参数下实现更强能力与更高部署效率，验证了能力—效率联合优化的有效性。

title: Separability Is Not Alignability: Representations for Spectrum-to-Molecule Retrieval
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Representations for the Physical Sciences (RPS). OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=kqgbNulQ8A
summary: Identifying a small molecule from its tandem mass spectrum is limited by paired data. Foundation models offer a way around this scarcity: pretrain a spectrum encoder on unlabeled spectra and a molecule encoder on a large corpus of structures, then align the two frozen representations, as in vision-language and as the Platonic Representation Hypothesis suggests. We audit this route on MassSpecGym with spectrum encoders retrained free of test-fold contamination. Alignment needs a metric relating distinct molecules, but the objectives that produce spectrum encoders never see molecular structure: we prove that some predictive objectives fix molecular identity without fixing that metric. Moreover, we find that a candidate-based objective rewards a spectrum-independent prior over the benchmark's decoys, which we isolate. What ultimately addresses data scarcity is not architectural: simulated spectra surpass frozen geometry.

AI.tldr: 该论文审查了"未标注质谱+大规模结构预训练、再对齐冻结表示"这一基础模型路线的可行性；发现在MassSpecGym上对齐目标缺乏可靠的分子间度量，且候选式目标会奖励与谱无关的先验；最终真正缓解数据稀缺的是模拟质谱而非冻结几何。
AI.motivation: 串联质谱鉴定小分子受限于成对的谱-结构数据稀缺。受视觉-语言对齐与Platonic Representation Hypothesis启发，一种自然思路是分别用未标注谱预训练谱编码器、用大规模结构语料预训练分子编码器，再对齐两个冻结表示，从而绕开配对数据瓶颈。作者希望检验这条路线的有效性与可靠性。
AI.method: 在MassSpecGym基准上审计该路线，并使用不受测试折污染的谱编码器重新训练。理论上分析：对齐需要一个界定不同分子间关系的度量，而产生谱编码器的预测式目标从未见过分子结构，论文证明某些预测目标可以在不固定该度量的情况下固定分子身份。实证上分离并量化候选式目标（candidate-based objective）对基准诱饵（decoys）所奖励的与谱无关的先验。最后比较模拟谱与冻结几何表示的效果。
AI.result: 对齐所依赖的分子间度量无法由谱编码器的训练目标保证；候选式目标确实会利用谱无关的诱饵先验，构成对基准分数的虚高。相对地，模拟谱带来的收益超过冻结表示几何对齐的收益。
AI.conclusion: 解决数据稀缺的关键不在架构或表示对齐，而在数据本身：模拟质谱优于冻结几何。基础模型式的"双塔预训练+冻结对齐"路线在质谱-结构任务上存在可证明的度量缺失与目标先验漏洞，需要谨慎对待其基准表现。

title: MEV: A Multi-Event Video Dataset for Long-Take Generation
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://mev-dataset.github.io/
summary: Current datasets for text-to-video generation are largely limited to short clips depicting a single event or coarse-grained captions. As a result, they provide limited supervision for modeling long-take temporal dependencies, often leading to temporally inconsistent generations when describing multiple events. In this paper, we introduce MEV, a multi-event video dataset designed for long-take video generation. MEV provides high-quality real-world videos where subjects can perform a sequence of distinct, non-overlapping events, featuring precise temporal boundaries and fine-grained procedural annotations. This event-centric discretization reduces confounding factors and enables models to support temporally localized conditioning and build long-take videos from atomic event units. Furthermore, we introduce a comprehensive annotation pipeline that segments videos into temporally grounded events, and generates structured captions at both the global level and the event level. In addition, under an event-centric evaluation protocol, we conduct multi-event generation experiments by fine-tuning on MEV with temporally grounded event conditioning, leading to improved long-take event transitions and more coherent content. We believe this work provides a publicly available resource for multi-event fine-tuning and event-centric evaluation, together with practical insights into learning from temporally structured video-text data.

AI.tldr: 提出MEV——一个面向长镜头多事件视频生成的数据集，含精确时间边界与细粒度过程标注，并配套标注流水线与事件中心评测协议，微调后可提升长镜头事件转换与内容连贯性。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到视频数据集多为单一事件短视频或粗粒度描述，对长镜头时间依赖的监督不足，导致描述多事件时生成结果在时间上不一致。
AI.method: 构建MEV数据集：真实高质量视频中主体执行一系列互不重叠的独立事件，提供精确时间边界与细粒度过程标注；提出标注流水线，将视频切分为时间定位事件并生成全局级与事件级结构化描述；在事件中心评测协议下，采用时间定位事件条件进行微调实验。
AI.result: 在MEV上微调并引入时间定位事件条件后，长镜头事件转换更自然、内容更连贯，验证了事件中心离散化能减少混淆因素并支持时间局部化条件控制。
AI.conclusion: MEV为多事件微调与事件中心评测提供公开资源，并为从时间结构化视频-文本数据中学习提供实践洞见。

title: PromptSense: Sentiment-Aware Mental Health Chatbot with Dynamic Prompting
summary: Current Large Language Models (LLMs)-based mental health chatbots often lack sufficient empathy, contextual awareness, and safety mechanisms, potentially leading to ineffective or harmful interactions. This paper proposes a novel framework that integrates sentiment and depression analysis with a rule-based filtering mechanism prior to model inference. By dynamically constructing prompts based on emotional and risk-related insights, the framework aims to significantly improve the contextual relevance, empathy, and risk-aware of model-generated responses. We evaluated four model strategies and two prompt engineered variants across qualitative metrics such as empathy, helpfulness, clarity, relevance, safety, as well as toxicity assessments using the Perspective API. Experimental results indicate that the prompt engineering approaches outperforms DSFT and RLAIF by 1.8\% and 1.1\% respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个在模型推理前融合情感与抑郁分析并结合规则过滤的框架，通过动态构建提示词提升心理健康聊天机器人的共情、情境相关性与风险意识；实验表明提示词工程方法在定性指标上分别比 DSFT 和 RLAIF 提升 1.8% 和 1.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的心理健康聊天机器人普遍缺乏足够的共情能力、情境感知和安全机制，可能导致低效甚至有害的交互，因此需要一种在推理阶段即引入情绪与风险感知的改进方案。
AI.method: 提出一个新颖框架：在模型推理之前，将情感分析与抑郁分析同基于规则的过滤机制相结合；依据情感与风险相关的洞察动态构建提示词（prompt），从而引导模型生成更具情境相关性、共情性与风险意识的回复。评估覆盖四种模型策略及两种提示词工程变体，采用共情、帮助性、清晰度、相关性、安全性等定性指标，并使用 Perspective API 进行毒性评估。
AI.result: 提示词工程方法在定性指标上优于 DSFT 与 RLAIF，分别高出 1.8% 与 1.1%；同时结合 Perspective API 完成了毒性评估。
AI.conclusion: 在推理前引入情感/抑郁分析与规则过滤并动态构建提示词，是提升 LLM 心理聊天机器人共情性、情境相关性与风险感知的有效途径，且优于 DSFT 与 RLAIF 等策略。

title: Human Activity Recognition using Ceiling-Mounted Multi-Radar Sensors
summary: Continuous activity monitoring in assisted living should work without cameras or wearable devices. Radar meets this requirement, but most radar studies use a single sensor and activities recorded in isolation, and few deliver results in real time. We present an indoor monitoring system in which point clouds from three ceiling-mounted radar sensors are fused using density-based clustering, movement and posture features are derived for activity classification, and results are shown on a real-time dashboard. In a preliminary study with eight participants performing everyday activities as one continuous scenario, a random forest reached 74% frame-level accuracy with a random 80/20 split and 68% with leave-one-participant-out evaluation. Without position features, accuracy fell to 46% and 44%, indicating partial dependence on room layout, while window-level features without position reached 67% and 65%.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无摄像头、无穿戴设备的三雷达点云融合室内活动监测系统，实时仪表盘展示分类结果，初步实验中随机森林帧级准确率74%（随机划分）/68%（留一被试），去除位置特征后降至46%/44%，说明模型部分依赖房间布局。
AI.motivation: 辅助生活场景的连续活动监测需避免摄像头与穿戴设备以保护隐私并降低使用负担；雷达可满足该要求，但现有研究多为单传感器、活动孤立录制，且少有实时输出结果。
AI.method: 三台天花板安装的雷达传感器点云经密度聚类融合；提取移动与姿态特征用于活动分类（随机森林）；结果在实时仪表盘上呈现。评估采用帧级与窗口级特征、随机80/20划分与留一被试（LOPO）两种协议，并做位置特征消融实验。
AI.result: 八名被试执行连续日常活动场景：帧级准确率随机划分为74%、LOPO为68%；去除位置特征后降至46%和44%；仅用窗口级特征且无位置时为67%和65%。
AI.conclusion: 多雷达融合加实时可视化具备可行性，但位置特征对性能贡献显著，模型对房间布局存在部分依赖；窗口级特征可在一定程度上补偿位置信息的缺失，提升泛化稳健性。

title: Nonlinear Jackiw-Rebbi exciton-polaritons at van der Waals topological interfaces
comment: 25 pages, 5 main-text figures; includes Supplementary Information
summary: Topological photonic structures provide a powerful means of confining and directing light through interface states formed between photonic phases with distinct topological properties. Van der Waals (vdW) materials offer complementary opportunities for nanophotonics: their optical properties can be selected from a wide family of layered crystals, while their atomically smooth surfaces and lack of lattice-matching constraints enable complex photonic heterostructures to be assembled layer by layer. This flexibility allows topological photonic confinement and strong excitonic coupling to be engineered separately within the same structure. Here, patterned low-loss dielectric hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) defines the photonic modes, while an encapsulated WSe2 monolayer provides the excitonic resonance that couples directly to the confined optical field. We use this approach to realise Jackiw-Rebbi exciton-polaritons in a one-dimensional hBN double-grating heterostructure. Strong coupling between the WSe2 exciton and a photonic Jackiw-Rebbi state localised at the interface between two topologically distinct gratings produces upper and lower Jackiw-Rebbi polariton branches. By varying the temperature from 4.7 to 300 K, we tune the exciton across the photonic bandgap and trace the evolution and anticrossing of these branches using angle-resolved reflectance and photoluminescence spectroscopy. Power-dependent photoluminescence further reveals a pronounced nonlinear response of the confined Jackiw-Rebbi polariton, including a blueshift of up to 5 meV and correlated changes in its intensity scaling and linewidth. These results establish vdW photonic heterostructures as a versatile platform for engineering tunable and nonlinear polaritons localised at topological interfaces.

AI.tldr: 基于hBN双光栅异质结构与WSe2单层的范德华光子平台，实现了局域于拓扑界面的Jackiw-Rebbi激子极化激元，并通过温度与功率调控展示了其反交叉演化与显著非线性响应。
AI.motivation: 拓扑光子结构可通过不同拓扑相界面态实现光的局域与导引；范德华材料具备可选的光学响应、原子级平整表面及无晶格匹配限制，便于逐层构筑复杂异质结构，从而在同一结构中分别独立设计拓扑光子局域与强激子耦合，作者据此探索拓扑界面极化激元的实现与调控。
AI.method: 以图案化的低损耗介质hBN定义光子模式，以封装其中的WSe2单层提供与受限光场直接耦合的激子共振；构建一维hBN双光栅异质结构，在两种拓扑不同光栅的界面处形成Jackiw-Rebbi态；通过4.7–300 K变温调节激子穿越光子带隙，结合角分辨反射光谱与光致发光谱追踪上下极化激元支的演化与反交叉，并用功率依赖光致发光研究非线性。
AI.result: WSe2激子与局域Jackiw-Rebbi光子态发生强耦合，形成上、下两支Jackiw-Rebbi极化激元；变温扫描显示两支随激子穿越带隙的反交叉演化；功率依赖PL表现出明显的非线性，包括最高约5 meV的蓝移，以及强度标度行为和线宽的相关变化。
AI.conclusion: 范德华光子异质结构可作为实现可调、非线性且局域于拓扑界面的极化激元的通用平台。

title: ATI-OPD: Adaptive Teacher Intervention for Stable Long-Sequence On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own responses using token-level feedback from a teacher. As responses grow longer, the student's prefix can depart from the teacher's own reasoning, weakening its feedback on later tokens. Updates based on this feedback can reinforce the same deviations in later responses and destabilize training. Prior approaches such as length control and loss reweighting limit learning from problematic responses but leave their prefixes unchanged. Fixed cutoffs can also discard later reasoning. We propose \textbf{Adaptive Teacher Intervention for On-Policy Distillation (ATI-OPD)} to improve subsequent teacher guidance by revising the student's reasoning prefix. ATI-OPD replaces the earliest high-disagreement segment with a short teacher segment, then lets the student resume its own reasoning from the revised text. To handle renewed disagreement, it excludes persistently divergent suffixes from the distillation loss while retaining useful student continuation. Training diagnostics show less teacher-student disagreement, fewer gradient spikes, and fewer extremely long responses. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two teacher-student pairs, ATI-OPD improves average student-only accuracy over standard OPD.

AI.tldr: 提出ATI-OPD，在on-policy蒸馏中用教师片段改写学生最早的强分歧前缀，使后续token获得更可靠的教师反馈，并剔除持续分歧的后缀，从而稳定训练并提升数学推理准确率。
AI.motivation: OPD在自己生成的回答上用教师token级反馈训练学生。回答变长后，学生前缀偏离教师自身推理路径，导致教师对后续token的反馈失效；基于此反馈的更新会在后续回答中强化同样的偏差，甚至使训练不稳定。已有长度控制、损失重加权只能限制问题回答的学习，却不修正其前缀；固定截断还会丢弃后面的推理内容。
AI.method: ATI-OPD：定位学生推理中最早的高分歧片段，用一段简短的教师片段替换之，再让学生从改写后的文本继续自行推理，从而改善后续教师指导；对再次出现的分歧，将持续分歧的后缀排除在蒸馏损失之外，同时保留学生有用的续写内容。
AI.result: 训练诊断显示师生分歧减少、梯度尖峰减少、极长回答变少；在五个数学推理基准与两组师生模型对上，ATI-OPD相对标准OPD提升了学生独立作答的平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: 通过干预前缀而非仅削弱损失，ATI-OPD缓解了OPD中的偏差累积与训练不稳定，在不牺牲有效学生续写的前提下提升推理性能。

title: Predicting Sparse Observables in Parameterized Unsteady Flows Using Coarse-Mesh Graph Neural Networks
summary: Full-order surrogates for high-dimensional nonlinear flows are often unnecessary when applications require only selected degrees of freedom. We propose reduced-order models that bypass full-state reconstruction by deploying graph neural networks (GNNs) directly on coarse meshes. Applied to parameterized 2D/3D confined cylinder flows and an unevenly heated cavity over Reynolds/Rayleigh-number ranges, the models generalize to unseen conditions and accurately predict sparse probe locations and integrated quantities. Coarse-mesh GNNs match or outperform finer-mesh surrogates while reducing training time and memory, even for 3D chaotic dynamics. A dynamics-informed adaptive sampling strategy guided by frequency-spectrum variations reduces maximum errors by an order of magnitude versus uniform sampling at negligible cost. Coarse-mesh training also makes noise-augmented multi-step unrolling practical, improving long-horizon autoregressive predictions. The approach outperforms parametric DMD, sparse MLPs, U-Nets, and Fourier neural operators at lower cost, and enables system identification and state estimation from sparse observations. These results show that coarse-mesh representations, adaptive sampling, and noise-augmented unrolled training form an efficient framework for reduced-order modeling of parameterized unsteady flows without solver-resolution reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出直接在粗网格上部署图神经网络（GNN）的降阶模型，绕过全状态重建，结合自适应采样与噪声增强的多步展开训练，实现对参数化非定常流的高效稀疏预测。
AI.motivation: 高维非线性流的全阶代理模型在应用仅需部分自由度时往往不必要，全状态重建带来高昂的计算与存储开销。
AI.method: 在粗网格上直接训练GNN作为降阶代理；引入由频谱变化引导的动力学感知自适应采样策略；利用粗网格训练的低成本实现噪声增强的多步展开（unrolling）以改善长时自回归预测。
AI.result: 在参数化2D/3D受限圆柱绕流及非均匀加热方腔（跨Re/Ra范围，含3D混沌动力学）上泛化至未见工况，准确预测稀疏探针与积分量；粗网格GNN匹配或优于细网格代理且训练时间与内存更低；自适应采样相较均匀采样将最大误差降低一个数量级；在更低成本下优于参数化DMD、稀疏MLP、U-Net与傅里叶神经算子，并支持系统辨识与状态估计。
AI.conclusion: 粗网格表示、自适应采样与噪声增强展开训练共同构成无需求解器分辨率重建的参数化非定常流降阶建模高效框架。

title: ETA-Motion: Efficient Topology-Agnostic Motion Diffusion via Sparse Joint Learning
summary: Topology-agnostic motion generation aims to synthesize motions for diverse characters with arbitrary skeletons. Unlike conventional motion generation, which assumes a fixed skeletal template, this setting must handle diverse joint configurations and inconsistent joint semantics across characters. Existing methods address this challenge through dense full-joint modeling, which incurs substantial computational cost and hinders learning transferable motion patterns across diverse skeletal topologies. We present ETA-Motion, a topology-agnostic motion generation framework based on sparse joint learning. Instead of learning motion from all joints, our method uses a compact subset of joints to reduce redundancy and trains the motion generator on the resulting sparse skeleton. To facilitate correspondence across diverse topologies, we introduce semantic joint embeddings that combine textual and visual cues, together with topology-aware training objectives for preserving skeletal structure. Although ETA-Motion is trained only on sparse skeletal observations, it supports full-skeleton motion generation during inference. Experimental results demonstrate that ETA-Motion outperforms existing topology-agnostic baselines while significantly improving efficiency and generalization to unseen motions and unseen topologies.

AI.tldr: 提出 ETA-Motion，一个基于稀疏关节学习的拓扑无关动作生成框架。
AI.motivation: 拓扑无关动作生成需处理不同骨架的关节配置与语义不一致问题；现有方法采用密集全关节建模，计算开销大，且难以学习可跨拓扑迁移的动作模式。
AI.method: 不学习全部关节，而是选取紧凑关节子集以降低冗余，并在稀疏骨架上训练生成器；引入结合文本与视觉线索的语义关节嵌入以建立跨拓扑对应关系，并设计保持骨架结构的拓扑感知训练目标。
AI.result: 尽管仅在稀疏骨架观测上训练，推理时仍可生成全骨架动作；实验表明其优于现有拓扑无关基线，并在效率、对未见动作与未见拓扑的泛化性上有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏关节建模可有效替代密集全关节建模，在保证生成质量的同时提升计算效率与跨拓扑泛化能力。

title: Evaluating Causal Reasoning in LLMs: A Case Study in the Challenges of Procedural Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) appear to represent and reason about a large range of phenomena. In particular, recent studies have examined whether LLMs can accurately reason about causation. One of the most commonly used benchmarks for evaluating formal causal reasoning in LLMs is CLadder, a framework for procedural generation of benchmark data sets that was released in 2023. Experiments with CLadder appear to indicate that LLMs can perform formal causal reasoning in a large percentage of generated examples. In this paper, we examine what can be reliably inferred when LLMs perform well on test sets produced by CLadder. We identify several examples of superficial and highly predictive patterns that the CLadder generator embeds in data sets it generates. We find that even simple models such as random forests perform well on CLadder-generated data sets after training on a sample of generated data. We also find that the performance of many commercial LLMs on CLadder test sets is extremely brittle and that removing large sections of the text that are critical for formal causal reasoning has almost no effect on performance. Given these results, the most likely hypothesis for the strong performance of state-of-the-art LLMs on CLadder is that they are exploiting superficial patterns learned from exposure to training data from the generator. Any inference that LLMs are exhibiting more complex causal reasoning must rule out this hypothesis.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑CLadder基准对LLM形式因果推理能力的评估效度：CLadder生成数据中嵌入大量表层可预测模式，随机森林等简单模型即可表现良好，商业LLM性能高度脆弱且去除关键因果文本后几乎不降，故其高分最可能源于对生成器表层模式的利用，而非真正的因果推理。
AI.motivation: CLadder（2023年发布的程序化生成基准）被广泛用于评测LLM的形式因果推理，实验显示LLM在大量生成样本上表现优异，由此常被推断LLM具备形式因果推理能力。作者希望澄清：仅凭CLadder测试集上的高准确率究竟能可靠推断出什么，检验该结论是否存在效度威胁。
AI.method: 对CLadder生成过程进行逆向分析，识别其嵌入数据集中的若干表层且高度可预测的模式；以随机森林等简单模型在少量生成样本上训练后测试，考察能否达到良好性能；对多个商业LLM实施扰动实验——删除对形式因果推理至关重要的文本片段，观察性能是否变化，以检验其性能的脆弱性与依赖来源。
AI.result: 发现CLadder生成器嵌入多种表层捷径模式；随机森林等简单模型经少量样本训练后在CLadder数据上表现良好；多个商业LLM在CLadder测试集上性能极度脆弱，删除大量关键因果推理文本后性能几乎不受影响，表明其判断并不依赖形式因果推理所需信息。
AI.conclusion: SOTA LLM在CLadder上的强劲表现，最可能的解释是利用了从生成器训练数据分布中学到的表层模式。任何声称LLM具备更复杂因果推理的推断，都必须先排除这一捷径假设；也提示需重新审视程序化生成基准的评测效度与抗捷径设计。

title: Implementation and Validation of Mismatch-Tolerant High-Gain OTA with a Calibrated Negative Conductance Load
summary: This paper presents the circuit-level implementation of a mismatch-tolerant high-gain operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) using automatic negative-conductance calibration in 65-nm CMOS. The technique enhances OTA gain by compensating for its finite output conductance using a cross-coupled transistor pair, with an on-chip calibration loop that eliminates the need for a replica circuit or external tuning. The calibration routine increases the gain by driving the steady state error of the OTA in a unity gain feedback loop toward zero. The implementation addresses practical challenges involving comparator offset, DAC design, and subtractor gain and offset. A 6-bit capacitive DAC (CDAC)-based comparator offset calibration scheme enables reliable detection of the sub-millivolt steady state error required for high OTA gain. Post-layout Monte Carlo simulations show that the comparator offset standard deviation is reduced from 4.11 mV to 132 $μ$V, with a maximum observed post-calibration offset of 625 $μ$V. The complete calibration circuitry is implemented and evaluated through post-layout simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文在65nm CMOS中实现了一种基于自动负电导校准的、对失配容忍的高增益OTA电路级实现方案。
AI.motivation: OTA的有限输出电导限制了增益，传统增益提升依赖复制电路或外部调谐，且实际实现面临失配、比较器失调等问题。
AI.method: 采用交叉耦合晶体管对补偿输出电导以提升增益，并设计片上校准环路，通过将单位增益反馈环路的稳态误差驱动趋于零来校准；包含6位电容DAC比较器失调校准方案，兼顾DAC设计、减法器增益与失调等实际问题。
AI.result: 后布局蒙特卡洛仿真显示比较器失调标准差从4.11mV降至132μV，校准后最大失调为625μV。
AI.conclusion: 该负电导自动校准方案无需复制电路或外部调谐，可有效抑制失配并实现高增益OTA，完整校准电路经后布局仿真验证可行。

title: On the gauge-invariant orbital angular momentum of vector optical vortices in the paraxial approximation and beyond
summary: In this paper we present a gauge-invariant formalism for describing the spin and orbital angular momenta of scalar and vector optical vortices. The correction term, arising from consistent incorporation of the transverse vector potential's nonlocality, restores gauge invariance and makes it possible to separate the total angular momentum into spin and orbital components. We propose a method for calculating the orbital and spin angular momenta of multimode vector vortex fields and show that the orbital angular momentum of such beams contains two qualitatively different components. The polarization-independent contribution to the orbital angular momentum is related to the topological charge that determines the order of the phase singularity, while the polarization-dependent one is proportional to the helical topological charge that determines the spatial inhomogeneity of the polarization. We also discuss the quantization procedure for fields with spatially inhomogeneous polarization in terms of modes with a helical topological charge, and examine the limits of applicability of the proposed formalism.

AI.tldr: 提出标量与矢量光学涡旋自旋与轨道角动量的规范不变形式，通过引入横向矢量势非局域性的修正项恢复规范不变性，从而分离总角动量为自旋与轨道分量，并揭示多模矢量涡旋场轨道角动量含两个性质不同的成分。
AI.motivation: 矢量光学涡旋中自旋与轨道角动量的分离长期受规范依赖问题困扰，尤其横向矢量势的非局域性使传统分离不严格，亟需规范不变的理论框架。
AI.method: 构建规范不变形式，加入源自横向矢量势非局域性一致处理的修正项以恢复规范不变性；提出计算多模矢量涡旋场轨道与自旋角动量的方法；以螺旋拓扑荷为基讨论空间非均匀偏振场的量子化程序。
AI.result: 轨道角动量包含两个定性不同成分：与偏振无关、由决定相位奇异阶数的拓扑荷给出的成分；与偏振相关、正比于决定偏振空间非均匀性的螺旋拓扑荷的成分。
AI.conclusion: 修正项使总角动量可严格分解为自旋与轨道部分，多模矢量涡旋场的轨道角动量具有双重起源；同时界定了该形式与量子化程序的适用范围。

title: Scaling Lean Theorem Proving for Real-World Code Verification
summary: We present EasyProver, a Lean proving system built from recursive agents with isolated contexts, asynchronous search, parallel tactic probing, and an elastic elaboration service. Using an off-the-shelf frontier model with no additional training, it proves 669/672 PutnamBench problems and all six IMO 2026 formalizations and resolves 597/600 NTP4VC verification conditions and all 189 VERINA tasks by proof or refutation. Because these benchmarks are close to saturation, we also introduce Aegis, which converts competitive programming problems into much harder verification tasks over real implementations. The pipeline writes safe Rust solutions, translates them into Lean with Aeneas, generates specifications, and labels each frozen statement with a kernel-checked proof or refutation. It produces 2,045 differentially validated Rust-Lean program pairs and 11,533 candidate specifications. Unlike hand-written benchmarks, these tasks carry implementation-level obligations from fixed-width arithmetic, explicit failure, generated loops, casts, and functionalized mutation. On a stratified sample of 2,000 statements, EasyProver proves 1,054 (52.7%) within a 30-minute budget per statement. The same tasks can also be used to benchmark other provers and as rewards for reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: EasyProver：由隔离上下文递归智能体、异步搜索、并行 tactic 探测与弹性 elaboration 服务构成的 Lean 证明系统；用现成前沿模型零训练即在 PutnamBench 669/672、IMO 2026 全部 6 个形式化、NTP4VC 597/600、VERINA 189/189 上接近饱和，故提出 Aegis，将竞赛编程题转为高难度 Rust-Lean 验证任务，在 2000 条分层样本上证明/反驳 1054（52.7%）。
AI.motivation: 现有形式化数学基准（PutnamBench、IMO、NTP4VC、VERINA）已接近饱和，无法区分证明系统能力；同时缺少带有实现级证明义务（定宽算术、显式失败、生成循环、类型转换、函数化可变状态）的真实验证基准。
AI.method: 系统侧：基于现成前沿模型、无需额外训练，采用隔离上下文的递归智能体、异步搜索、并行 tactic 探测与弹性 elaboration 服务。基准侧：Aegis 流水线生成安全 Rust 解，经 Aeneas 翻译为 Lean，自动生成规约，并对冻结语句标注经内核检查的证明或反驳；产出 2,045 对经差分验证的 Rust-Lean 程序对与 11,533 条候选规约，按分层抽样取 2,000 条语句评测。
AI.result: EasyProver 证明 669/672 PutnamBench、全部 6 个 IMO 2026 形式化、597/600 NTP4VC 验证条件，并以证明或反驳解决全部 189 个 VERINA 任务；在 Aegis 的 2,000 条分层样本上，单语句 30 分钟预算内完成 1,054 条（52.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 易饱和基准上能力已近上限，Aegis 提供了更贴近真实实现的困难验证任务，可作为衡量其他证明器的基准及强化学习奖励信号。

title: Deep learning for non-transvenous ICD screening: tailored neural network architectures, extended experiments, and explainability
summary: This paper studies two non-transvenous implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs), namely the Subcutaneous ICD (S-ICD) and the Extravascular ICD (EV-ICD). Both avoid the complications of transvenous leads but are prone to oversensing, which can trigger inappropriate shocks associated with increased mortality. Oversensing risk is predicted by the ratio of T- or P-wave amplitude to R-wave amplitude (T:R, P:R), and these ratios vary over a 24-hour period. Yet S-ICD screening uses a single 10-second electrocardiogram (ECG) segment, and the EV-ICD has no formal screening protocol whatsoever. We present a 24-hour ambulatory screening framework for both devices which includes the first T:R analysis in an EV-ICD cohort and the first full evaluation of P:R prediction. We introduce AmpRatioNet, a family of 1D convolutional neural network architectures operating directly on the ECG signal, and benchmark it against the best existing approach - based on 2D phase space reconstruction images. Evaluation uses 4,605 clinician-annotated 10-second segments from 89 patients, with patient-level 10-fold cross-validation and bootstrap confidence intervals. AmpRatioNet-SE demonstrates superior performance on every metric in each setting with no device- or ratio-specific redesign. An explainability analysis against interpretable classical peak labelling algorithms shows that AmpRatioNet-SE's increase in error on oversensing-prone segments is up to 14 times smaller than theirs. Segment-level predictions are aggregated into a 24-hour timeline, extending S-ICD screening beyond 10 seconds and offering a plausible EV-ICD screening pathway pending device-level validation.

AI.tldr: 提出24小时动态筛查框架与AmpRatioNet（1D CNN，直接处理ECG信号），用于S-ICD与EV-ICD的过感知（oversensing）风险预测，性能全面优于基于2D相空间重构图像的现有方法。
AI.motivation: S-ICD与EV-ICD虽避免经静脉导线并发症，但易发生过感知并引发不恰当放电，与死亡率升高相关。过感知风险由T:R、P:R振幅比预测，而这些比值在24小时内波动；然而S-ICD筛查仅用单个10秒ECG片段，EV-ICD则完全没有正式筛查流程，现有筛查方法存在明显不足。
AI.method: 构建面向两类设备的24小时动态筛查框架，首次在EV-ICD队列中开展T:R分析，并首次对P:R预测进行完整评估。提出AmpRatioNet系列一维卷积神经网络，直接以ECG信号为输入，与基于2D相空间重构图像的最佳现有方法进行基准对比。采用89名患者、4,605段临床医生标注的10秒片段，使用患者级10折交叉验证与bootstrap置信区间；并将片段级预测聚合为24小时时间线。
AI.result: AmpRatioNet-SE在各类设置下所有指标均表现最优，且未针对特定设备或比值进行重新设计。与可解释的经典峰值标注算法相比，其在易过感知片段上的误差增幅最多小14倍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将S-ICD筛查从10秒扩展到24小时，并为EV-ICD提供了可行的筛查路径（尚待器械层面验证）；AmpRatioNet-SE作为一种通用、无需设备定制的架构，可作为非经静脉ICD过感知风险评估的有效工具。

title: TreemapMix: Dirichlet-Controlled Multi-Image Augmentation for Probability and Ordinal Supervision
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 40 pages including references, appendices, and checklist. Ejafa Bassam and Konstantin Garbers contributed equally
summary: Data augmentation improves visual recognition by exposing models to synthetic training examples that encourage generalization beyond the observed data. Mixed-sample methods extend this idea by combining multiple images. However, many common approaches either mix only pairs of images or rely on fixed small layouts, limiting control over source count, visible area proportions, and induced supervision. We propose TreemapMix, a distribution-controlled multi-image augmentation that samples source weights from a Dirichlet distribution and assigns them to area-proportional regions using a treemap partition. The resulting known region areas support two complementary objectives. TreemapMix with soft cross-entropy (SCE) treats areas as soft class-probability targets, while TreemapMix with a Plackett-Luce (PL) objective converts areas into ordinal supervision. On ImageNet-1K under matched training recipes, TreemapMix-SCE achieves substantially lower calibration error than evaluated mixed-sample baselines, while TreemapMix-PL achieves the strongest Top-1 accuracy. Transfer experiments on object detection and instance segmentation suggest that TreemapMix-pretrained features remain useful beyond classification. These results show that controlled multi-image composition can expose the same region-area information as either probability-matching or rank-matching supervision. Code is available at https://github.com/Ejafa/treemapmix.

AI.tldr: TreemapMix：用Dirichlet分布采样多图权重并以treemap划分面积成比例区域，实现分布可控的多图混合增强；区域面积可作软标签(SCE)或序数监督(PL)。
AI.motivation: 现有混合样本增强多局限于双图混合或固定小布局，难以控制源图数量、可见面积比例及相应监督信号。
AI.method: 从Dirichlet分布采样各源图权重，用treemap分区将权重映射为面积成比例的矩形区域，合成多图样本；据此提出两种目标：TreemapMix-SCE将面积作为软类概率目标，TreemapMix-PL用Plackett-Luce将面积转为序数监督。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K相同训练配方下，TreemapMix-SCE校准误差显著低于对比的混合样本基线，TreemapMix-PL取得最高Top-1精度；在目标检测与实例分割迁移实验中预训练特征仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 可控的多图组合可将同一区域面积信息分别用作概率匹配或排序匹配监督，二者互补且泛化性强。

title: AI-Driven Digital Twin Framework for Warehouse Logistics Automation Optimization
comment: ICRA 2026 Workshop Advances and Challenges in AI-Driven Automation and Robotic System Integration with Digital Twins
summary: In recent years, warehouse logistics optimization has increasingly focused on intelligent, data-driven systems to enhance operational efficiency. Conventional static product placement strategies are being progressively replaced by dynamic slotting approaches that can adapt to real-time variations in warehouse conditions. In this work, we present a novel framework that employs a reinforcement learning agent integrated within a FlexSim-based Digital Twin environment for real-time product placement optimization. The proposed agent continuously learns from streaming operational data, enabling it to reduce picking time while improving overall system throughput. The simulation environment models a four-zone warehouse layout with forklift-based material handling and leverages the Asset Administration Shell framework to ensure seamless interaction between the learning agent, physical asset, and the digital twin. Experimental evaluation demonstrates substantial performance gains, with the proposed approach achieving a 29.66\% reduction in average picking time, a 35.42\% increase in throughput, and an 18.54\% decrease in travel distance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种强化学习智能体与基于FlexSim的数字孪生环境集成的框架，用于仓库货位（slotting）的实时动态优化，显著缩短拣选时间并提升吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 传统静态货位分配策略难以适应仓库状态的实时变化，亟需智能、数据驱动的动态货位优化系统以提升运营效率。
AI.method: 构建由强化学习智能体嵌入FlexSim数字孪生组成的框架：智能体持续从实时运行数据流中学习；仿真环境建模含叉车搬运的四分区仓库布局；采用资产管理壳（Asset Administration Shell）实现学习智能体、物理资产与数字孪生间的无缝交互。
AI.result: 实验评估显示平均拣选时间降低29.66%，吞吐量提升35.42%，行走距离减少18.54%。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习与数字孪生结合的动态货位优化框架可有效提升仓库物流的拣选效率与吞吐能力，具备实际应用潜力。

title: Integrated Sensing and Communication via Channel Knowledge Maps Built from Beam Feedback Coefficients
summary: Channel knowledge maps (CKMs) support wireless localization by linking channel features to user locations. Detailed channel fingerprints, however, can require substantial storage. This paper proposes a CKM-based localization framework that uses beam feedback coefficients collected during communication. These coefficients serve as compact location fingerprints within the beam management process, without requiring full channel feedback or additional sensing measurements. Using a coarse position prior, the base station searches nearby CKM entries and refines the location estimate through local interpolation. We analyze the relationship between spatial fingerprint variation and localization accuracy, and evaluate the effect of feedback quantization. Simulations show favorable storage--accuracy trade-offs relative to dense and sparsified spectral fingerprinting in the tested multipath environments.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于信道知识地图(CKM)的无线定位框架，直接利用波束管理过程中采集的波束反馈系数作为紧凑位置指纹，结合粗位置先验与局部插值实现定位，无需完整信道反馈或额外感知测量。
AI.motivation: 详细信道指纹存储开销大，而现有CKM定位依赖高维信道特征。作者希望找到一种低存储、无需额外测量的紧凑指纹来源，波束反馈系数天然存在于波束管理流程中，因此被用作定位指纹。
