AI.method: 1) 在通信波束管理过程中采集波束反馈系数作为位置指纹；2) 利用粗位置先验，基站在CKM中检索邻近条目；3) 通过局部插值细化位置估计；4) 理论分析空间指纹变化与定位精度的关系；5) 建模并评估反馈量化对定位性能的影响；6) 仿真中与密集及稀疏化频谱指纹方案对比。
AI.result: 仿真表明，在测试的多径环境下，所提方法在存储与精度之间取得了优于密集和稀疏化频谱指纹的折中；并给出了空间指纹变化—定位精度的解析关系及量化影响分析。
AI.conclusion: 波束反馈系数可作为有效且紧凑的CKM指纹，实现低存储、免额外测量的定位，并具备可控的存储—精度权衡，适用于多径环境下的通信感知一体化场景。

title: Component Translation and Judge-Labelled Refusal: A Multilingual Safety Evaluation
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure. Ten-page manuscript prepared for the 4th Workshop on Large Language and Foundation Models (WLLFM 2026) at IEEE BigData 2026, plus appendices A-E. Replication archive included as ancillary files
summary: Whole-prompt translation evaluates a request in different languages but does not compare which component carries a language. We introduce a paired reversal: translate the complete request component or the complete operation component into the same target language, holding behaviour, English frame and translated-span count fixed. Component identity and non-English text quantity change together. Assigning English, Chinese and Spanish independently to the two components yields nine configurations on 190 of 300 sampled harmful behaviours retained after consensus annotation and automatic gating. Refusal scored by language-model judges is the primary outcome; unsafe compliance is reported separately. On Gemini 2.5 Flash and DeepSeek, three refusal swaps are about 5.3 percentage points and the fourth is -0.5; none survives the pre-specified six-test Holm correction. In an exploratory extension, Mistral Small 4 has a 13.7-point Spanish swap (95% interval [8.4, 18.9]), which survives the twelve-test Holm sensitivity correction under the primary judge, and 12.1 points under a second judge. GPT-5.4-mini estimates are within 2 points of zero. Component assignment supplies an additional evaluation dimension. Evaluations should record component languages and translated text quantity, comparing matched behaviours at equal translated-span count while interpreting refusal and unsafe compliance separately.

AI.tldr: 提出"成对反转"实验设计：将完整请求成分或完整操作成分翻译为目标语言，在保持行为、英文框架与翻译跨度数固定下，分离"成分身份"与"非英文文本量"对拒答的影响；主分析均未通过Holm校正，仅探索性扩展中Mistral Small 4出现13.7个百分点的显著西语效应。
AI.motivation: 现有整提示翻译评测只衡量多语言请求的整体表现，无法识别语言的承载成分（请求成分 vs. 操作成分），也混淆了成分身份与非英文文本数量两个变量。
AI.method: 设计成对反转实验：将完整请求成分或完整操作成分整体翻译为同一目标语言，固定行为语义、英文框架与翻译跨度数；对两个成分分别独立赋予英文、中文、西班牙文，构成9种配置；在300条采样有害行为中经共识标注与自动门控保留190条；以语言模型裁判的拒答率为主结局，不安全合规单独报告；采用预注册的六检验Holm校正，并做十二检验敏感性分析。
AI.result: Gemini 2.5 Flash与DeepSeek上三次拒答翻转约5.3个百分点，第四次为−0.5个百分点，均未通过六检验Holm校正；探索性扩展中Mistral Small 4西语翻转达13.7个百分点（95%区间[8.4, 18.9]），在主裁判的十二检验Holm敏感性校正下显著，第二裁判为12.1个百分点；GPT-5.4-mini估计值均在±2个百分点内。
AI.conclusion: 成分归属提供了额外的评测维度；多语言安全评测应记录各成分语言与翻译文本数量，在等翻译跨度数下比较匹配行为，并将拒答与不安全合规分开解读。

title: Towards Generalizing Pretrained All-Atom Representations to Unified Binder Design
summary: PairFormer-based all-atom models demonstrate strong capabilities in biomolecular binder design. However, existing methods often use all-atom representations for modality-specific binder design, such as protein and peptide design. In contrast, recent geometric latent diffusion models pursue unified binder design by representing molecular blocks from different modalities in a shared latent space. These complementary strengths motivate us to investigate how to generalize the use of pretrained all-atom representations to unified binder design. We introduce PairFuse, a parameter-efficient method that enables this generalization through representation fusion. Specifically, we use lightweight layerwise adapters to integrate pretrained all-atom representations into an independently pretrained geometric latent diffusion model. Our adapters integrate pretrained all-atom representations through two mechanisms: enriching the diffusion model's molecular block features and incorporating pairwise structural information into the geometric diffusion model's denoiser. Theoretically, we prove that the augmented denoiser preserves geometry and pairwise attention fusion provides additional attention expressivity beyond feature-only fusion. Experimentally, across antibody, peptide, and small molecule binder-design benchmarks, PairFuse achieves stronger performance than the pretrained diffusion model and existing representation-fusion baselines.

AI.tldr: PairFuse：用轻量层级适配器把预训练全原子表示融合进独立预训练的几何潜扩散模型，实现统一型binder设计，并以理论证明+三类基准验证其优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有全原子PairFormer类模型虽在binder设计上表现强，但多按模态分别设计（蛋白、多肽等）；而近期几何潜扩散模型以共享潜空间表示不同模态分子块，追求统一binder设计。两类方法优势互补，故作者探究如何将预训练全原子表示推广到统一binder设计中。
AI.method: 提出参数高效方法PairFuse，通过表示融合实现上述推广：用轻量层级适配器（layerwise adapters）把预训练全原子表示注入一个独立预训练的几何潜扩散模型中。适配器含两种机制：(1) 丰富扩散模型的分子块特征；(2) 将成对结构信息（pairwise structural information）引入几何扩散模型去噪器。
AI.result: 理论上证明：(a) 增强后的去噪器保持几何性质；(b) 相比仅特征融合，成对注意力融合提供额外注意力表达力。实验上，在抗体、多肽、小分子三类binder设计基准上，PairFuse优于预训练扩散模型及现有表示融合基线。
AI.conclusion: 将预训练全原子表示以适配器方式融合进统一潜扩散框架是可行且高效的，成对结构信息的注意力级融合是关键增益来源，为统一、跨模态的binder设计提供了新范式。

title: BudSplat: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting under a Rendering Budget
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting has recently emerged as a promising alternative to per-scene optimization, enabling fast novel view synthesis by predicting Gaussian primitives directly from input images. However, it quickly faces a bottleneck of rendering efficiency while scaling from sparse to dense multi-view inputs, which offer more geometric constraints but produce a rapidly growing set of candidate Gaussians. Existing solutions cannot reliably distinguish redundant primitives, leading to many redundant primitives from repeatedly observed regions and increased rendering cost without much gain in visual quality. We propose BudSplat, a compact feed-forward 3DGS framework that learns to keep the most valuable Gaussians under a limited primitive count. BudSplat has two novel designs. The first is a detail-aware importance score that is extracted from multi-level visual tokens, providing an explicit cue for regions where pruning is likely to harm perceptual quality. The score can be injected into voxel fusion to preserve high-value local contributors during multi-view aggregation. The second is quality-aware Gaussian pruning that selects a compact set of primitives by jointly considering rendering contribution and detail importance. The quality-aware pruning enables local quota redistribution that helps avoid over-allocating primitives to large redundant regions. Experiments on RE10K, DL3DV, and ACID show that BudSplat achieves a favorable trade-off among rendering quality and efficiency.

AI.tldr: BudSplat是一个紧凑的前馈式3D高斯泼溅框架，在有限高斯基元数量下学习保留最有价值的高斯，以在多视角密集输入下实现渲染质量与效率的更好权衡。
AI.motivation: 前馈3DGS从稀疏扩展到稠密多视角输入时，候选高斯基元数量快速增长，导致大量来自重复观测区域的冗余图元，渲染开销上升而视觉质量提升有限；现有方法难以可靠区分冗余图元。
AI.method: 提出两个设计：(1) 细节感知重要性分数，从多层级视觉token中提取，显式指示剪枝易损害感知质量的区域，并可注入体素融合以在多视角聚合时保留高价值局部贡献者；(2) 质量感知高斯剪枝，联合考虑渲染贡献与细节重要性来选择紧凑图元集合，并支持局部配额重分配，避免向大冗余区域过度分配图元。
AI.result: 在RE10K、DL3DV和ACID数据集上实验表明，BudSplat在渲染质量与效率之间取得了良好的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过在有限基元预算下结合细节重要性与渲染贡献进行多视角融合与剪枝，BudSplat有效缓解了前馈3DGS在稠密输入下的冗余问题，实现紧凑且高效的新视角合成。

title: Too Hard, Too Easy, Just Right: Performance-Driven Challenge Adaptation in Virtual Reality Firefighter Training
summary: Effective firefighter training requires practice under dynamic and stressful emergency conditions, yet real-world live-fire exercises are costly, risky, and difficult to scale. Virtual Reality (VR) offers a safe and controllable alternative, but many existing VR firefighter training systems rely on fixed scenarios or provide limited difficulty adaptation, making it difficult to maintain an appropriate level of challenge for skill development as trainees' performance changes over time. To address this limitation, we present ProACT, a performance-driven adaptive training system that regulates scenario difficulty through closed-loop interactions between trainee performance and simulated fire dynamics. Specifically, ProACT combines a global module that continuously adjusts scene-level fire spread dynamics in real time based on trainee performance with a local module that periodically updates object-level flammability across the environment. Our evaluation shows that ProACT improves both objective training performance and subjective user experience compared with existing adaptive and non-adaptive baselines. We further discuss how adaptive immersive environments can extend beyond firefighting to broader training domains.

AI.tldr: ProACT：一个性能驱动的闭环自适应VR消防训练系统，通过全局火势传播调控与局部可燃性更新动态调节场景难度。
AI.motivation: 实况消防演练成本高、风险大、难以规模化；现有VR消防训练系统多为固定场景或难度自适应能力有限，无法随受训者能力变化维持适宜挑战水平。
AI.method: 提出ProACT，基于受训者表现与模拟火行为的闭环交互调节场景难度：全局模块依据受训者表现实时调整场景级火势蔓延动力学；局部模块周期性更新环境中物体级可燃性。
AI.result: 与现有自适应及非自适应基线相比，ProACT在客观训练绩效与主观用户体验两方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 性能驱动的闭环自适应沉浸环境可有效提升训练效果，并有望推广至消防之外的更广泛训练领域。

title: Measuring the Value of Communication in Multi-Agent Tracking Under Finite-Rate Belief Sharing
summary: This paper investigates the value of communica- tion (VoC) in cooperative multi-agent tracking under rate- constrained information exchange. Although prior work has studied distributed tracking, quantized communication, and robust fusion, it remains unclear at what communication rate most of the achievable tracking gain is obtained, beyond which additional communication resources yield only marginal benefit. We consider stationary agents that observe a moving target through heterogeneous range and bearing measurements, perform local extended Kalman filtering (EKF), quantize their posterior state means, and fuse exchanged information via covariance intersection (CI). Performance is evaluated versus communication rate relative to no-communication baselines, a centralized oracle, and a CI-perfect reference. The results show that communication is not uniformly beneficial: very low rates can degrade performance due to coarse quantization, whereas moderate rates recover most of the achievable gain. In the considered scenario, increasing the rate from 4 to 12 bit/s per agent reduces the root-mean-square error (RMSE) from 13.93 m to 6.35 m, while a further increase to 32 bit/s per agent improves it only marginally to 5.93 m. This reveals a clear knee region at moderate rates, beyond which the remaining loss is mainly due to the conservatism of the fusion architecture. Overall, the proposed framework characterizes low-rate degradation, communication-efficient operation, and diminishing returns, while highlighting the joint role of rate and sensing geometry in determining communication benefit.

AI.tldr: 研究了速率受限通信下协作多智能体跟踪中通信价值（VoC），揭示通信速率—跟踪精度的"拐点"区间。
AI.motivation: 已有工作分别研究分布式跟踪、量化通信与鲁棒融合，但尚不清楚在何种通信速率下大部分可获得的跟踪增益即可实现，超过该速率后额外通信资源仅带来边际收益。
AI.method: 静止智能体通过异构的距离与方位测量观测运动目标，各自执行局部扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF），对后验状态均值进行量化，并通过协方差交叉（CI）融合交换的信息；以无通信基线、集中式oracle与CI-perfect参考为对照，评估性能随通信速率的变化。
AI.result: 通信并非一致有益：极低速率因粗量化反而使性能下降，中等速率可恢复大部分可达增益。该场景下每智能体速率由4 bit/s增至12 bit/s时RMSE由13.93 m降至6.35 m，进一步增至32 bit/s仅边际改善至5.93 m，呈现明显拐点区域，剩余损失主要源于融合架构的保守性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架刻画了低速率退化、通信高效运行与收益递减三种机制，并强调速率与感知几何共同决定通信收益。

title: Two Birds with One Stone: Skill-Augmented Generation via Unified Retrieval and Utilization
summary: Skills, as reusable external knowledge, have demonstrated substantial potential to enhance the ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to solve complex tasks. However, existing skill-augmented generation methods typically rely on separate models for skill retrieval and skill utilization, resulting in disconnected optimization of these two processes. To address this gap, we propose Skill-Uni, a unified reinforcement learning framework that jointly optimizes skill retrieval and utilization. Specifically, we adopt a generative skill retrieval paradigm that enables a single model to both learn how to retrieve relevant skills and leverage them for task solving. To effectively train this unified framework, we introduce a two-stage training strategy consisting of warm-up instruction tuning and GRPO, allowing the model to progressively improve its skill retrieval and utilization capabilities. Extensive experiments on five skill-related benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of Skill-Uni, yielding average performance gains of 66.59% and 34.82% over the base Qwen3-4B and LLaMA3.1-8B models, respectively. Besides, Skill-Uni is compatible with various skill retrieval engines, demonstrating its flexibility and generalizability. Additional in-depth analyses also provide insights into the effectiveness of Skill-Uni.

AI.tldr: Skill-Uni：统一强化学习框架，用单一生成式模型联合优化技能检索与技能利用，避免两阶段割裂优化。
AI.motivation: 现有技能增强生成方法通常用独立模型分别完成技能检索与技能利用，两过程优化相互割裂，无法端到端协同提升复杂任务求解能力。
AI.method: 提出生成式技能检索范式，使单一模型同时学习检索相关技能并用于任务求解；采用两阶段训练策略：先进行warm-up指令微调，再用GRPO强化学习进一步优化。
AI.result: 在五个技能相关基准上验证有效性，相较Qwen3-4B与LLaMA3.1-8B基座模型平均性能分别提升66.59%与34.82%；且兼容多种技能检索引擎，体现灵活性与泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 统一优化技能检索与利用可行且收益显著；生成式检索+两阶段RL训练为技能增强LLM提供了简洁有效的方案，并具备良好的引擎兼容性。

title: Preserving Safety During Sequential Fine-Tuning: A Factorial and Geometric Analysis of Replay
summary: Benign fine-tuning can erode safety alignment in large language models, and sequential adaptation substantially compounds this risk. Prior work mitigates this erosion by replaying harmful-prompt refusals and benign-compliance examples, while other work instead matches base-model logits via distillation. However, the individual contributions of supervised exposure and distillation to safety behavior and refusal geometry during sequential adaptation remain unclear. We factor these two strategies apart and study their behavioral and geometric effects during sequential LoRA fine-tuning of Mistral-7B and Llama-3-8B across diverse task sequences (code generation, German-language summarization, and science question-answering). Behaviorally, supervised replay exposure yields the largest reduction in HarmBench attack success rate (ASR) on Mistral, averaging 51.1 points below base, but at a substantial over-refusal cost, averaging 53.4 points above base on OR-Bench-hard. Logit distillation, without any supervised replay loss, largely prevents safety erosion at a fraction of this cost: an average 5.4-point ASR reduction against only a 5.1-point rise in over-refusal. Llama shows the same asymmetry between the two strategies. Combining exposure and distillation moderates exposure's over-refusal while leaving downstream task scores largely unaffected. Geometrically, the two models diverge: on Mistral, distillation preserves the base refusal direction more closely than exposure does, whereas on Llama, refusal behavior after exposure largely survives ablation of the extracted refusal direction. This dissociation between models indicates that preserving the base refusal direction is not a reliable proxy for behavioral safety.

AI.tldr: 该论文将“监督式回放暴露”与“logit蒸馏”两种安全保持策略解耦，在Mistral-7B和Llama-3-8B的顺序LoRA微调中比较二者对安全行为和拒绝几何的影响，发现蒸馏以极小的过度拒答代价维持安全性，且两种模型呈现不同的几何机制。
AI.motivation: 良性微调会侵蚀LLM的安全对齐，顺序适配会进一步放大该风险。已有方法或回放有害提示拒答与良性合规样本，或通过蒸馏匹配基座模型logits，但二者对安全行为与拒绝几何的各自贡献尚不清晰，缺乏分解研究。
AI.method: 将监督暴露与蒸馏两种策略因子化分离，在Mistral-7B与Llama-3-8B上进行跨多任务序列（代码生成、德语摘要、科学问答）的顺序LoRA微调；从行为层面（HarmBench ASR、OR-Bench-hard过度拒答、下游任务分数）与几何层面（拒绝方向提取及消融）分别评估。
AI.result: 在Mistral上，监督回放暴露使HarmBench ASR平均低于基座51.1分，但过度拒答平均高于基座53.4分；无监督回放损失的logit蒸馏平均仅降低ASR 5.4分，过度拒答仅上升5.1分。Llama呈相同的不对称性。两者结合可缓和暴露带来的过度拒答，且下游任务分数基本不受影响。几何上，Mistral中蒸馏更贴近保持基座拒绝方向，而Llama中暴露后的拒绝行为在消融提取出的拒绝方向后仍大体存续。
AI.conclusion: 蒸馏在保持安全对齐上更具成本效益，暴露虽大幅降低ASR但代价是严重过度拒答。跨模型的几何分歧表明，保持基座拒绝方向并非行为安全性的可靠代理指标。

title: ConvRoute-ViT: Convolutional Token Routing for Efficient Vision Transformers
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) achieve strong image recognition performance, but their self-attention increases quadratically with the number of input tokens and makes them computationally expensive. The standard implementation of ViT models treats all patch tokens with equal importance across every layer of the model. This uniform treatment introduces redundant computation and may reduce the model's focus on the most discriminative object regions. In this paper, we propose ConvRoute-ViT, a convolutional token routing mechanism for efficient vision transformers that performs token reduction through convolutional routing. Our model preserves the most relevant patch tokens according to class-token attention at selected layers, while the remaining tokens are spatially reorganized and compressed into a compact set of convolutional summary tokens. This design reduces the sequence length without completely removing the contextual information of the less informative tokens. By applying the routing process hierarchically, the proposed framework constructs compact and discriminative representations for deeper layers. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and TinyImageNet show that ConvRoute-ViT improves computational efficiency while maintaining classification accuracy compared with the base ViT.

AI.tldr: ConvRoute-ViT 提出用卷积路由做令牌缩减：保留类令牌注意力高的 patch，其余令牌空间重组压缩为卷积摘要令牌，从而降低序列长度、提升效率并保持精度。
AI.motivation: 标准 ViT 的自注意力计算量随令牌数二次增长，且所有层对所有 patch 令牌同等对待，导致冗余计算并分散模型对最具判别性区域的关注。
AI.method: 在选定层依据类令牌注意力保留最相关的 patch 令牌；其余令牌经空间重组后压缩为紧凑的卷积摘要令牌；分层递进应用该路由，逐级构建紧凑且具判别性的深层表示。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-100 与 TinyImageNet 上，相较基础 ViT，在保持分类精度的同时提升了计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 卷积式令牌路由可在不完全丢弃低信息令牌上下文的前提下缩短序列长度，是兼顾效率与精度的 ViT 加速方案。

title: Post-Training Large Language Models with LLMON
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) treat all context tokens uniformly, lacking explicit separation between executable instructions and passive data. This leads to prompt injection vulnerabilities, ambiguous instruction binding, and unreliable execution control. We present a post-training methodology using LLMON (LLM Object Notation), a framework that enables separating instructions from data and requires explicit identifier-based execution. We construct a large-scale structured training corpus of 4.6B tokens spanning general, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and tool-calling data, augmented with distractor-infused variants in which competing instructions and irrelevant data segments are present in context but not referenced. Post-training two Granite-4.1 base models (3B and 8B) through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning, we show that LLMON-structured supervision reduces attack success rates on indirect prompt-injection benchmarks from 53-100% to 0.02-5.6% while preserving general capabilities. We further introduce attention-based interpretability metrics that diagnose failure modes at individual transformer layers for structured inputs, revealing how our approach reshapes internal attention patterns. Our results demonstrate that explicit execution semantics can be taught through standard post-training without architectural modification.

AI.tldr: 提出 LLMON（LLM Object Notation）结构化后训练方法，将可执行指令与被动数据显式分离并要求基于标识符的显式执行，在 Granite-4.1 3B/8B 上把间接提示注入攻击成功率从 53–100% 降至 0.02–5.6%，同时保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 对上下文 token 一视同仁，缺乏指令与数据的显式区分，导致提示注入漏洞、指令绑定歧义与执行控制不可靠。
AI.method: 构建 4.6B token 的大规模结构化训练语料（覆盖通用、RAG、工具调用），并加入"干扰注入"变体（上下文中存在竞争指令与无关数据段但未被引用）；对 Granite-4.1 3B/8B 基座先做监督微调再做强化学习；另引入基于注意力的可解释性指标，逐层诊断结构化输入下的失效模式。
AI.result: 间接提示注入基准上攻击成功率由 53–100% 降至 0.02–5.6%，通用能力保持；注意力指标揭示该方法如何重塑模型内部注意力模式。
AI.conclusion: 显式执行语义可通过标准后训练习得，无需修改模型架构。

title: AFDM-ISAC Design Amalgamating FMCW Radar and Carrier Aggregation
summary: Carrier-aggregation (CA)-assisted affine frequency division multiplexing (AFDM) is conceived for integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems. A frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW)-inspired dechirping receiver is developed to exploit the inherent pulse-compression property of AFDM chirp subcarriers for accurate delay-Doppler estimation. To further enhance sensing performance, a pair of CA schemes is proposed. The Type-I CA scheme improves sensing accuracy by aggregating echo signals across multiple CA bands prior to radar processing, thereby reducing estimation error with low hardware overhead. The Type-II CA scheme enhances range resolution by effectively enlarging the sensing bandwidth, where chirps from different CA bands are designed to form a continuous set of chirp signals. Based on this principle, variable subcarrier sensing and asynchronous sensing schemes are developed. For the communication receiver, the generalized input-output relationship of AFDM is derived under both fractional delay and fractional Doppler (FDFD) channels. To address the challenge of FDFD estimation, a cross-domain sensing-assisted channel estimation (CDS-CE) scheme is proposed to facilitate time-domain delay-Doppler parameter estimation and affine-domain channel coefficient recovery. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves significant improvements in sensing accuracy and resolution, as well as in channel estimation performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出面向ISAC的载波聚合辅助AFDM（CA-AFDM）框架，结合FMCW式去啁啾接收机、两类CA方案（Type-I提升精度、Type-II提升分辨率）及跨域感知辅助信道估计（CDS-CE），在时延-多普勒与信道估计上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: AFDM的啁啾子载波具备脉冲压缩特性，可用于ISAC；但如何兼顾高精度、高分辨率的感知与分数时延/分数多普勒（FDFD）信道下的可靠通信仍是难点。
AI.method: 1）设计受FMCW启发的去啁啾接收机，利用AFDM啁啾子载波的固有脉冲压缩实现时延-多普勒估计；2）Type-I CA：雷达处理前聚合多CA频带回波以降低估计误差，硬件开销低；3）Type-II CA：设计不同CA频带的啁啾拼接为连续啁啾集以扩展感知带宽，并衍生变子载波感知与异步感知方案；4）推导FDFD信道下AFDM的广义输入-输出关系；5）提出CDS-CE，在时域做时延-多普勒参数估计，在仿射域恢复信道系数。
AI.result: 仿真表明，该框架在感知精度、感知分辨率及信道估计性能上相较现有先进方法均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: CA-AFDM为ISAC提供统一波形与收发设计，通过载波聚合与去啁啾处理实现感知-通信互惠，并为FDFD信道估计提供有效途径。

title: 3DCodeEdit: Benchmarking Instruction-Guided 3D Program Editing
summary: Language models increasingly create 3D content through code, with practical workflows often relying on editing existing programs rather than regenerating them, for speed and precise control. Such edits require understanding what a program builds and foreseeing how a change reshapes it, yet prior benchmarks mostly evaluate generation or simple edits against a reference. In this paper, we introduce 3DCodeEdit, a benchmark of 2,592 instruction-guided editing tasks over 108 Blender programs that construct objects entirely in code. Its edits range from parameter to structural changes, style redesign, and scene composition, and are judged from renders against human-reviewed checklists. Across 17 models, the average success rate is only 37%, and even the strongest models complete fewer than 60% of structural and style edits. As models become more capable, their failures shift to geometric foresight, where the code runs but builds the wrong shape. We therefore study whether multi-turn feedback can compensate for this missing foresight. Feedback from a separate reviewer model that describes how the renders differ from the request helps most, more than maximum reasoning effort or an agent harness, and can let a 27B model surpass the single-shot rate of a 2.8T-parameter model.

AI.tldr: 提出 3DCodeEdit 基准（108 个 Blender 程序上的 2,592 条指令引导编辑任务），以渲染结果对照人工审核清单评分；17 个模型平均成功率仅 37%，失败转向“几何预见”能力缺失，而基于渲染差异描述的独立审查模型多轮反馈优于最大推理预算与 agent 框架。
AI.motivation: 实际 3D 工作流更依赖对已有程序代码的编辑而非重新生成，以便提速并精确控制；但编辑需要理解程序构建了什么、并预见改动如何重塑几何，而现有基准多只评测生成或对照参考的简单编辑，缺乏对这一能力的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建 3DCodeEdit 基准：108 个完全以代码构建物体的 Blender 程序，2,592 条指令引导编辑任务；编辑类型覆盖参数修改、结构修改、风格重设计与场景组合；评分基于渲染结果，对照人工审核的检查清单；评测 17 个模型，并比较多种多轮反馈机制（独立审查模型描述渲染与请求差异、最大推理努力、agent harness）。
AI.result: 平均成功率仅 37%；最强模型在结构与风格编辑上成功率低于 60%。随模型能力提升，失败模式由代码不可运行转向几何预见不足（代码可执行但形状错误）。由独立审查模型提供渲染差异描述的反馈效果最佳，优于最大推理努力与 agent 框架，可使 27B 模型在单轮成功率上超过 2.8T 参数模型。
AI.conclusion: 3D 代码编辑是当前模型的重要短板，核心瓶颈在于几何结果的预见而非代码正确性；视觉化的多轮反馈是弥补该缺口的有效手段，可作为提升 3D 代码编辑可靠性的优先方向。

title: Are Seismic Foundation Models More Than Glorified Feature Extractors?
summary: Earthquake sequences are stochastic on two separated timescales: the seismic waves of any individual earthquake propagate over seconds to minutes, while the earthquakes themselves arrive as a sparse, self-exciting occurrence process, with inter-event intervals from seconds to months. Respecting both scales in one training objective is the open challenge. Foundation models (FMs) for seismic waveforms instead import their learning targets from audio and vision, where every target is computed from a single fixed-length window. Such a window holds one realization of the wave propagation (an earthquake trace), never the occurrence process that decides when earthquakes happen. We develop nine model designs sharing one Mamba encoder-decoder, trained on a fixed corpus of 3M windows, varying the self-supervised objective, quantization bottleneck and mixer; the two key comparisons are architecture-matched, varying the objective alone. Each checkpoint is evaluated frozen on three downstream tasks. Varying the target redistributes downstream skill rather than raising it, and no checkpoint wins everywhere. Adding masking pressure to our strongest classifier re-specializes it rather than making it a generalist: it gains 6.9 points of few-shot P-wave picking precision and loses 9.6 points of few-shot classification accuracy. By the standard imported from language and vision, these models are feature extractors rather than FMs. Controls on capacity, architecture, and domain proximity do not explain why skill moves rather than rises. Against task-specific baselines the advantage is regime-dependent: our checkpoints beat them few-shot on classification and ground-motion prediction, and trail them on full data. We argue the binding constraint is the target, and that settling the question requires a learning target defined across events, the timescale that makes seismicity stochastic in the first place.

AI.tldr: 地震序列在秒级波形传播与秒至月级事件发生过程两个时间尺度上随机；本文用同一Mamba编码器-解码器训练九个自监督范式，在统一冻结评估下发现变换目标只重新分配下游能力而非提升整体能力，模型更接近特征提取器而非基础模型。
AI.motivation: 地震数据具有两个分离的时间尺度：单次地震的波传播仅持续秒到分钟，而地震事件本身构成稀疏、自激的到达过程，事件间隔从秒到月。现有地震波形基础模型从音频与视觉借用学习目标，其目标均基于单一固定长度窗口，窗口内只包含一次波传播实现，无法刻画决定"何时发生地震"的发生过程。核心问题是：如何在单一训练目标中同时尊重两个尺度。
AI.method: 设计九个模型方案，共享同一个Mamba编码器-解码器，在300万窗口的固定语料上训练；变化因素为自监督目标、量化瓶颈与混合器，其中两项关键对比为架构匹配、仅改变学习目标。对每个检查点以冻结方式在三个下游任务上评估；并在最强分类器上叠加掩码压力以检验其是否成为通用模型；同时设置容量、架构、领域邻近性等控制实验，并对比任务专用基线（小样本与全量数据两种设定）。
AI.result: 改变目标只会重新分配下游能力而非提升能力，没有任何检查点在所有任务上占优。在最强分类器上加入掩码压力会使其重新特化而非泛化：小样本P波拾取精度提升6.9个百分点，同时小样本分类准确率下降9.6个百分点。容量、架构与领域邻近性控制实验均无法解释"能力迁移而非上升"的现象。相对任务专用基线，优势依赖设定：小样本下在分类与地震动预测上领先，全量数据下落后。
AI.conclusion: 按语言与视觉领域的标准，这些模型只能算特征提取器而非基础模型。作者认为根本约束在于学习目标本身，解决该问题需要定义跨事件的学习目标，即地震活动性之所以具有随机性的那个时间尺度。

title: PulmoWorld: An Asynchronous Multimodal Medical World Model for Longitudinal Pneumonia Dynamics
summary: Pneumonia changes across respiration, inflammation, and organ function, while the measurements that describe it arrive at different times and are often incomplete. We introduce PULMOWORLD, a world model for longitudinal pneumonia dynamics that connects asynchronous state estimation, recursive simulation, and evidence-constrained planning. History-aware filtering separates state propagation from observation-driven correction, so a measurement updates the shared belief only when it is observed. That belief supports recursive forecasts of clinical values and modality representations, and summaries of future prognosis. Cap-MBRL searches imagined continuations inside an authorized action set and replaces a frozen fallback only when a candidate meets the risk budget and a predicted-cost margin. On the pneumonia cohort MASS, recursive forecasts are competitive with task-trained sequence models, and simulated future states retain prognostic information. Trained separately on public MIMIC-IV-CXR chest radiographs and clinical trajectories, this model improves prognostic discrimination over latest-value fusion in development and is competitive on long-horizon error on the locked pneumonia panel. In five known-mechanism MASS-Syn environments, Cap-MBRL lowers selection regret relative to direct fallback execution.

AI.tldr: PULMOWORLD 是一个面向纵向肺炎动态的世界模型，统一异步状态估计、递归模拟与证据约束规划，在 MASS 队列上取得与任务专用序列模型相当的递归预测，并保留预后信息。
AI.motivation: 肺炎在呼吸、炎症和器官功能上持续变化，而描述其状态的测量在时间上异步到达且常常缺失；现有方法难以在观测不完整、到达时间不规则的条件下统一进行状态估计、未来推演与干预决策。
AI.method: 1) 历史感知滤波将状态传播与观测驱动校正解耦，仅在实测到达时更新共享信念；2) 该信念支撑临床数值、模态表征及未来预后的递归预测；3) Cap-MBRL 在授权动作集内搜索想象轨迹，仅当候选满足风险预算并具有预测成本裕度时才替换冻结的回退策略。
AI.result: 在 MASS 肺炎队列上，递归预测与任务训练序列模型表现相当，模拟未来状态保留预后信息；在公开 MIMIC-IV-CXR 胸片与临床轨迹上分别训练后，开发集预后判别优于最新值融合，在锁定肺炎面板上长程误差具竞争力；在五个已知机制的 MASS-Syn 环境中，Cap-MBRL 相比直接执行回退策略降低选择后悔。
AI.conclusion: 将异步状态估计、递归世界模型模拟与安全约束的规划相结合，可在不规则、不完整观测下为肺炎进展提供有预后价值的预测，并在机制已知环境中以更低后悔实现策略改进。

title: Decompose, Don't Expand: Capability-Independent AI Systems by Construction
summary: A recurring design choice in building AI systems is whether, when a task is too hard for a model, to expand the model (make it larger, better-prompted, fine-tuned), or to decompose the task (extract the parts that admit a deterministic solution to a host, leaving the model only the irreducibly fuzzy residue). We make three claims. First, that many tasks commonly delegated whole to a model are in fact deterministic tasks with a small generative core. Second, and our central empirical result, that decomposing such a task yields a measurable and desirable property we call parity by construction: on the extracted sub-tasks the model-size performance curve becomes flat, because no model performs them at all. We measure this across nine models spanning a 494M-parameter local checkpoint to a frontier Opus-class model, a thirty-fold parameter range on the local family alone: once the host resolves the context, operation selection scores identically for all nine models and selector resolution for eight of nine, while the one task that does not decompose, labelling, remains sloped across the same range. Because the task leaves the model, a stock checkpoint suffices: no task-specific training and no fine-tuning. Third, that this is a general design discipline, not a domain trick: we show the same move recurring across physics setup, motion retargeting, and object-model editing, and in a Web-CLI tool family (same author, so not an independent replication). We give a method for locating the cut, the construction that makes a cut exist (a deterministic surface and a closed grammar over it), and a way to make the residue safe (resolve the deterministic context; verify the generative output), position the work against neuro-symbolic AI, tool-augmented language models, and generate-and-verify approaches, and are explicit about what is measured (one domain) versus illustrative (the rest).

AI.tldr: 论文提出将“大多可确定化+小生成核”的任务分解给宿主程序与模型，实证得到“构造式对齐(parity by construction)”：被抽出子任务上模型规模-性能曲线变平。
AI.motivation: AI系统设计中反复面对的抉择：任务过难时是扩张模型（更大、更好提示、微调），还是分解任务（把可确定性求解的部分交给宿主，只把不可约的模糊残余留给模型）。作者认为许多被整体委托给模型的任务其实是“带小生成核的确定性任务”，并希望把分解提升为一般设计准则。
AI.method: 提出定位“切分点”的方法，以及使切分可行的构造：确定性表面(deterministic surface) + 其上的封闭文法(closed grammar)；并给出使残余安全的两步：解析确定性上下文、验证生成输出。实验上跨九个模型（494M本地checkpoint到前沿Opus级，本地家族约30倍参数跨度）比较分解后各子任务与未分解任务（标注）的性能-规模曲线，并在物理场景搭建、动作重定向、对象模型编辑及Web-CLI工具族中作例证。
AI.result: 宿主解析上下文后，九个模型在“操作选择”上得分完全一致，九个中八个在“选择器解析”上一致；而未能分解的“标注”任务在同一参数范围内仍呈斜率。分解后子任务无需任务特定训练或微调，现成checkpoint即可。
AI.conclusion: 分解带来的平曲线是“构造式对齐”，是通用设计纪律而非领域技巧；但仅一个领域为实测，其余为示例性说明（Web-CLI族为同一作者，非独立复现）。作者将其定位并区别于神经符号AI、工具增强语言模型与“生成-验证”路线。

title: Adversarial Pilot Injection Against AI-Based CSI Feedback in FDD Massive MIMO Systems
comment: Submitted to IEEE Internet of Things Journal
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI)-based channel state information (CSI) feedback reduces overhead in frequency division duplexing (FDD) massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems, yet its reconstructed CSI depends on the integrity of pilot acquisition. This paper identifies and evaluates the attack path of adversarial pilot injection against this feedback. A transmitted disturbance can damage the user-side estimation before encoding; correctly delivered quantized bits can still represent a contaminated channel estimate. We model this path through attacker propagation, linear minimum mean square error estimation, compression, quantization, and decoding under a total transmit-energy constraint. An adversarial perturbation generator (APG) implements the attack using channel statistics without current legitimate CSI or instantaneous attacker-channel observations at deployment. At a Rician attacker-channel factor of 10~dB and a transmit perturbation-to-signal ratio of $-4$~dB, APG produces a normalized mean-square error (NMSE) of 0.84~dB in base-station CSI reconstruction, compared with $-10.31$~dB for Gaussian interference. Estimator-targeted and reconstruction-targeted attacks yield different error orderings, and reconstruction damage also degrades beamforming. As a countermeasure, alternating adversarial training (AAT) adapts the feedback encoder and decoder to contaminated pilots. With condition-matched training and APGs reoptimized for the final receiver, AAT reduces NMSE by 2.40--3.79~dB across six representative channel--power conditions. The results demonstrate the importance of protecting pilot acquisition alongside quantized feedback delivery.

AI.tldr: 该文揭示并评估了FDD大规模MIMO中AI CSI反馈的对抗性导频注入攻击路径：攻击者在信道估计前注入扰动量，即使量化比特无误传输，重建CSI仍被污染；并提出交替对抗训练（AAT）作为防御。
AI.motivation: AI-based CSI反馈虽能降低FDD大规模MIMO开销，但重建质量依赖导频获取的完整性；现有研究多关注反馈链路本身，忽视了"编码前估计阶段"这一可被攻击的薄弱环节。
AI.method: 将攻击路径建模为：攻击者传播→LMMSE估计→压缩→量化→解码，受总发射能量约束。设计对抗扰动生成器（APG），仅依赖信道统计信息，部署时无需当前合法CSI或攻击者信道的瞬时观测。防御端采用交替对抗训练（AAT），使反馈编解码器适应受污染的导频，并在条件匹配训练与针对最终接收机重优化的APG下验证。
AI.result: 在Rician攻击信道因子10 dB、扰动-信号功率比−4 dB下，APG使基站CSI重建NMSE达0.84 dB，而高斯干扰为−10.31 dB；面向估计器与面向重建的攻击产生不同的误差排序；重建损伤进一步恶化波束成形性能。AAT在六种代表性信道—功率条件下将NMSE降低2.40–3.79 dB。
AI.conclusion: 导频获取环节与量化反馈传输同等重要，需在保护反馈比特的同时保护导频采集；AAT是一种有效的针对性防御手段。

title: Keepace.ai: A Technical Report on a Large Language Model for Sports and Health
summary: Large language models hold promise for delivering safe, scientifically grounded, and personalized exercise guidance at scale, yet the sports-and-health domain still lacks curated training corpora and rigorous evaluation benchmarks. Keepace.ai is a domain-specialized LLM built on Qwen3.5-27B through post-training, currently optimized for Chinese-language exercise guidance across three tasks: workout plan generation, sports-and-health knowledge QA, and personal sports data analysis. In internal rubric-based evaluations designed with domain experts, Keepace.ai outperforms its base model and larger general-purpose baselines, with the most pronounced improvements in exercise safety, boundary compliance, structured output completeness, and scientific accuracy. This report summarizes the current design, data pipeline, safety-first evaluation framework, and evaluation results of Keepace.ai.

AI.tldr: Keepace.ai 基于 Qwen3.5-27B 后训练得到中文运动健康领域专用 LLM，覆盖训练计划生成、运动健康问答、个人运动数据分析三类任务，并配套专家参与的安全优先评测框架。
AI.motivation: 运动健康领域缺乏经过整理的高质量训练语料与严格评测基准，而通用大模型在运动建议的安全性、专业性上难以保证，需要可规模化落地的领域专用模型。
AI.method: 以 Qwen3.5-27B 为基座开展后训练（领域语料构建的数据流水线 + 面向三类任务的能力优化），并设计与领域专家共同制定的内部评分量表（rubric）评测体系，聚焦运动安全性、边界合规性、结构化输出完整性与科学准确性。
AI.result: 在内部 rubric 评测中优于其基座模型及规模更大的通用模型基线，提升最显著的是运动安全性、边界合规、结构化输出完整性与科学准确性。
AI.conclusion: 报告总结 Keepace.ai 的当前设计、数据流水线、安全优先评测框架与评测结果，表明领域后训练可有效提升中文运动健康指导的安全性与专业性；但评测限于内部 rubric，尚缺公开基准与外部验证。

title: Measured or Real? When Model-Derived Measurements Can Be Corrected or Compared
summary: Numbers computed from trained models, such as an example's difficulty or a model's benchmark lead, change with seed and prompt. We ask when such measurements can be corrected or compared. Noise shrinks correlations, and the textbook correction divides by the square root of two estimated reliabilities. On two CIFAR-100 difficulty scores, it returned correlations above one in 70 of 100 classes. We prove that its mean squared error is infinite even when the correlation and the reliabilities use separate seeds. Our rule corrects only when both reliabilities pass a significance test, then divides by their upper confidence bounds. Its output is always bounded, and its coverage guarantees assume Gaussian noise. It helps once reliability is well estimated, more than halving the error with 500 simulated units. Prompt settings can reverse rankings. On ARC, Qwen2-1.5B trails Llama-3.2-3B by 3.8 points with no examples in the prompt and leads by 16.6 with two. Across four benchmarks, averaging the two settings names one winner for 15 of 16 such reversals. We compare models within each setting, controlling family-wise error asymptotically in the number of items for a fixed prompt grid. Aligning embedding coordinates across seeds raises held-out per-dimension reliability from 0.003 to 0.813.

AI.tldr: 从训练模型中计算出的测量量（难度、基准领先）随随机种子与提示变化。论文证明教科书式的衰减校正（除以两估计信度的平方根）即使在使用分离种子估计相关与信度时MSE仍为无穷，并提出仅在两项信度均通过显著性检验时才校正、除以信度上置信界的规则；同时给出在固定提示网格下、对项目数渐近控制族错误率的模型比较方法。
AI.motivation: 模型衍生的测量值（如样本难度、模型基准领先幅度）会随种子与提示设置波动，存在测量噪声。噪声会衰减相关系数，传统做法是除以两估计信度的平方根进行校正。但该校正在实际数据中会产生不合理结果（如相关大于1），因此需要判断：何时测量可被校正或跨条件比较，以及如何给出统计上可靠的校正与比较规则。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：证明教科书式校正（除以信度平方根的几何平均）的均方误差为无穷，即使相关与信度分别用不同种子估计亦然。2) 提出新校正规则：仅当两项信度均通过显著性检验时才进行校正，并除以信度的上置信界，使输出有界；其覆盖率保证依赖高斯噪声假设。3) 提示敏感性：在无示例与两条示例两种提示设置下比较模型，并对两种设置的排名取平均以确定胜者。4) 模型比较：在每个提示设置内比较模型，以项目数渐近控制族错误率（FWER），提示网格固定。5) 嵌入对齐：跨种子对齐嵌入坐标以提升逐维信度。
AI.result: 在两份CIFAR-100难度评分上，教科书校正使100个类别中有70个的相关系数超过1。信度估计良好时新规则有效：在500个模拟单元下误差降低一半以上。提示设置可逆转排名：ARC上Qwen2-1.5B在无示例提示下落后Llama-3.2-3B 3.8分，在两条示例提示下反超16.6分；四个基准上，对两种提示设置取平均可在16次此类排名逆转中15次给出唯一胜者。跨种子对齐嵌入坐标使留出的逐维信度从0.003提升至0.813。
AI.conclusion: 当噪声不可忽略时，基于信度平方根的传统校正不可靠（输出可越界且MSE无界），应以带显著性检验与置信界的校正规则替代；模型间的比较应在固定提示设置内进行并控制族错误率，或对多种提示设置的排名取平均；提示设置本身可完全逆转模型排名，因此报告基准结论时应显式说明提示配置，并对嵌入坐标进行跨种子对齐以获得可靠的逐维测量。

title: Hidden Commitment: When Language Models Silently Pick a Side and How Steering Can Surface It
summary: Language-model answers are often treated as a visible record of the internal decision that produced them. We test this assumption in conflicting-context question answering, where two supplied documents support incompatible answers. A model can process the disagreement and still return a one-sided answer, even under prompts that ask it to disclose conflict. In Qwen 0.8B, hidden source commitment is captured by a residual source-choice direction whose sign tracks which document the answer uses. Sparse middle-layer MLP writers feed the same coordinate, and steering the coordinate changes the chosen source. A transfer run on Gemma 3 1B preserves the source-choice readout and sparse-write bridge under LLM-audited labels. Conflict disclosure follows a different pattern, appearing weaker, later-layer, and only partially steerable. These results support a practical monitoring strategy for retrieval systems that detects silent source commitment with residual readouts and pairs conflict-surfacing prompts with disclosure steering when the model has selected a side under disagreement.

AI.tldr: 论文检验"模型输出可视为内部决策可见记录"这一假设，在冲突上下文问答中发现模型可内部处理分歧却仍给出单边答案；在Qwen 0.8B中，隐藏的来源承诺由残差"来源选择方向"编码，其符号指示答案采用哪份文档，中层稀疏MLP写入同一坐标且可被转向改变来源；Gemma 3 1B迁移保留该读出与稀疏写入桥接；冲突披露则更弱、更靠后层、仅部分可控。
AI.motivation: 语言模型答案常被默认当作内部决策的可见记录，但在两份文档支持互不相容答案的冲突上下文问答中，模型可能"处理了分歧却只输出单边答案"，甚至在被要求披露冲突时仍如此。作者希望验证这一默认假设，并寻找可实用的监控手段，使检索系统能检测模型是否已"暗中选边"。
AI.method: 构建冲突上下文问答设定（两份文档给出不相容答案），并施加要求披露冲突的提示。在Qwen 0.8B上用探针/残差读出寻找"来源选择方向"（source-choice direction），其符号对应答案使用的文档；定位中层稀疏MLP作为写入同一坐标的writer，并通过steering该坐标检验因果性。再用LLM审计标签在Gemma 3 1B上做迁移验证，并单独刻画冲突披露的层级与可操控性。
AI.result: Qwen 0.8B中残差来源选择方向的符号稳定追踪答案来源；中层稀疏MLP writer共同作用于该坐标，steering可改变模型选择的来源。Gemma 3 1B迁移下，来源选择读出与稀疏写入桥接在LLM审计标签上仍成立。冲突披露呈现不同模式：信号更弱、出现在更靠后的层、仅部分可steering。
AI.conclusion: 模型答案并非内部决策的可靠可见记录，存在"沉默的来源承诺"。作者提出面向检索系统的实用监控策略：用残差读出检测沉默选边，并在模型于分歧下已选边时，将冲突浮现提示与披露steering配对使用。

title: SkillCT: A Multidimensional Benchmark and Execution-Free Baseline for Agent Skill Assessment
summary: Agent skills package instructions, scripts, and resources for specialized tasks and are increasingly distributed through public Web repositories. However, existing skill benchmarks primarily focus on downstream task execution, insufficiently assessing specification quality, behavioral robustness, semantic alignment, and responsibility boundaries. Their reliance on task-specific tools, environments, and repeated executions limits scalability and pre-deployment assessment. To address these challenges, we introduce SkillCT, a benchmark that broadens skill assessment from downstream utility to a multidimensional characterization of skill quality. SkillCT evaluates skills across nine complementary dimensions spanning three aspects: Static Assessment, which captures intrinsic properties of the skill specification; Dynamic Assessment, which measures whether the induced behavior remains stable across backbone models and request variations; and Human-Assisted Assessment, which examines behavior-chain consistency and task granularity. These dimensions provide a broader view of skill quality than execution success. Applying SkillCT to a public skill corpus establishes a reference benchmark for analyzing quality weaknesses and relationships across dimensions. Building on this benchmark, we propose an execution-free quality evaluation baseline that predicts the multidimensional quality profiles of unseen skills by retrieving and leveraging similar reference skills, without executing the skills under evaluation. This reduces token consumption and evaluation time, while preserving consistency with the full assessment. Furthermore, SkillCT-guided optimization improves downstream task success and execution efficiency, demonstrating its value for skill refinement. These findings highlight the effectiveness of SkillCT in supporting scalable skill assessment, optimization, and repository maintenance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SkillCT，一个将 Agent skill 评估从下游任务执行扩展到多维度质量刻画（静态、动态、人工辅助共九维）的基准，并给出免执行的质量预测基线及 SkillCT 引导的优化方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 skill 基准主要聚焦下游任务执行，对规范质量、行为鲁棒性、语义对齐与责任边界评估不足；且依赖任务专用工具、环境与重复执行，可扩展性差，难以支持部署前评估。
AI.method: 构建 SkillCT 基准，从三方面九维度评估 skill：(1) 静态评估，刻画 skill 规范的内在属性；(2) 动态评估，检验诱导行为在不同骨干模型与请求变体下是否稳定；(3) 人工辅助评估，考察行为链一致性与任务粒度。在公开 skill 语料上建立参考基准；并基于检索相似参考 skill 提出免执行的多维质量画像预测基线；进一步用 SkillCT 指导 skill 优化。
AI.result: 在公开语料上形成可分析各维度质量弱项及其相互关系的参考基准；免执行基线在降低 token 消耗与评估时间的同时保持与完整评估的一致性；SkillCT 引导的优化提升下游任务成功率与执行效率。
AI.conclusion: SkillCT 支持可扩展的 skill 评估、优化与仓库维护，为 skill 质量刻画与部署前评估提供了有效方案。

title: Confidence-Aware Speed-over-Ground Estimation from Doppler Spectra via Reconstruction-Based Representation Learning
summary: Reliable speed-over-ground estimation from ground-facing Doppler spectra is essential for mobile platforms such as railway systems. Classical signal-processing approaches can provide accurate estimates under favorable conditions, but often degrade in challenging conditions. We propose confidence-aware speed-over-ground estimation trained on rail-domain data that estimates speed over ground and frame-level confidence from Doppler spectra with several novel contributions: First, we transfer the idea of exploiting a reconstruction task by an autoencoder for performance estimation from previous work to Doppler RaDAR. Second, we append a speed-over-ground estimation head operating on the autoencoder's latent space features. Third, we omit the reconstruction decoder during inference but add a low-cost dedicated confidence head for frame-wise error-bound estimation. Fourth, we reveal how noise augmentation training can provide high robustness to the method. Experiments show that our approach improves speed estimation accuracy over classical baselines while providing informative confidence estimates that indicate the reliability of individual predictions, even under adverse signal conditions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向铁路场景的置信度感知地速估计方法：利用自编码器重建任务 + 潜空间速度估计头，并在推理阶段以轻量置信度头实现帧级误差界估计，借助噪声增强训练提升鲁棒性，在精度与可靠性上优于经典基线。
AI.motivation: 基于对地多普勒谱的地速估计对铁路等移动平台至关重要。经典信号处理方法在良好条件下准确，但在恶劣条件下（低信噪比、复杂杂波等）性能明显退化，且缺乏对单帧预测可靠性的指示。
AI.method: 在铁路域数据上训练：1) 将先前工作中"用自编码器重建任务进行性能/误差估计"的思路迁移到多普勒雷达；2) 在自编码器潜空间特征上附加地速估计头；3) 推理时舍弃重建解码器，改用低成本专用置信度头做帧级误差界估计；4) 采用噪声增强训练以增强鲁棒性。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在测速精度上优于经典基线，并能给出具有信息量的置信度估计，即使在不利信号条件下也能指示单帧预测的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 将重建式自编码器表征、潜空间回归与轻量置信度头结合，可在铁路多普勒测速中同时实现更高精度与可靠的帧级不确定性/误差界估计。

title: Cross Lingual Abstractive Summarization for Marathi
summary: Text summarization is an important task for advancing natural language processing (NLP) research and applications in Indic languages. Despite progress in extractive and abstractive summarization, both monolingual summarization (MS) and cross-lingual summarization (CLS) remain relatively underexplored for these languages. Recent advances in Transformer architectures, pretrained language models (PLMs), and dataset availability offer new opportunities to address this gap. In this work, we construct cross-lingual training data from the monolingual Marathi MahaSum corpus and combine it with the smaller cross-lingual PMIndiaSum dataset to fine-tune IndicTrans2, an Indic neural machine translation model. We evaluate the resulting models using ROUGE, chrF and chrF++ metrics, focusing primarily on Marathi-to-English summarization due to computational constraints. We also discuss the applicability of our approach to the English-to-Marathi direction. Our experiments demonstrate that leveraging a pretrained translation model yields substantially better summarization performance than the IndicBART and mBART-50 based baselines reported in previous work on cross-lingual summarization.

AI.tldr: 该文利用马拉地语MahaSum与PMIndiaSum构建跨语言训练数据，微调IndicTrans2实现马拉地语—英语跨语言摘要，性能显著优于IndicBART与mBART-50基线。
AI.motivation: 面向印度语言的单语摘要（MS）与跨语言摘要（CLS）研究相对不足，尽管Transformer、预训练语言模型与数据集已有进展，二者仍处于探索初期，亟需填补空白。
AI.method: 以单语MahaSum语料构造跨语言训练数据，并与规模较小的跨语言PMIndiaSum合并，用于微调印度语言神经机器翻译模型IndicTrans2；采用ROUGE、chrF、chrF++评估，受算力限制主要聚焦马拉地语→英语方向，并讨论英语→马拉地语方向的适用性。
AI.result: 实验表明，基于预训练翻译模型的方法在跨语言摘要性能上大幅优于先前工作报告的IndicBART与mBART-50基线。
AI.conclusion: 借助预训练翻译模型（IndicTrans2）并辅以由单语数据扩充的跨语言语料，可有效提升印度语言跨语言摘要表现，为数据稀缺条件下的CLS提供可行路径。

title: Detecting Brain Cancer Progression Through Signatures of Wearable Accelerometry Data
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 TS-LIMITS Workshop
summary: Glioblastoma and other high-grade gliomas (HGG) have a poor prognosis and are associated with progressive functional decline. The standard of care to assess progressive disease is contrast-enhanced MRI, which is expensive, claustrophobic, and performed only once every 2-3 months. Wearable accelerometers offer a non-invasive alternative for continuously monitoring patient function between clinic visits. However, accelerometry data streams are typically noisy and highly patient-specific, making conventional time series methods and summary statistics poorly suited to detecting clinically meaningful change. This work aims to classify stable versus progressive disease states by applying rough path signatures for feature extraction from wrist-worn accelerometer data. We convert accelerometer recordings from HGG patients enrolled in the BrainWear study into walking-path segments and use signature kernel maximum mean discrepancy (SigMMD) to quantify change in patients' walking behaviour. We overcome the challenge of inter-patient heterogeneity by adjusting for the natural variation in a patient's walking during stable tumour periods. This patient-specific normalisation substantially improves separation, yielding a candidate biomarker of tumour progression. Our results provide proof-of-concept evidence that signature-based analysis of wearable accelerometry can distinguish stable from progressive disease states, motivating larger longitudinal studies of continuous wearable monitoring as a digital biomarker in neuro-oncology.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用腕戴加速度计数据，通过粗糙路径签名提取特征并用签名核MMD量化步态变化，经患者自身稳定期归一化后，可区分高级别胶质瘤患者的稳定与进展状态。
AI.motivation: 高级别胶质瘤患者预后差且功能进行性衰退，而评估疾病进展的金标准——增强MRI昂贵、易引发幽闭恐惧，且仅每2-3个月检查一次，无法在就诊间隙持续监测功能状态。可穿戴加速度计提供了连续、非侵入的替代方案，但其数据噪声大、高度个体化，传统时间序列方法与汇总统计难以捕捉有临床意义的变化。
AI.method: 将BrainWear研究中HGG患者的腕戴加速度计记录转换为步行路径片段，采用粗糙路径签名（rough path signatures）进行特征提取，并以签名核最大均值差异（SigMMD）量化患者步行行为的变化；针对患者间异质性，以患者自身肿瘤稳定期的自然步态变异进行个体化归一化。
AI.result: 患者特异性归一化显著改善了稳定期与进展期的可分性，得到可作为肿瘤进展候选生物标志物的指标；基于签名的可穿戴加速度分析能够区分稳定与进展疾病状态，构成概念验证证据。
AI.conclusion: 签名方法分析可穿戴加速度数据在区分稳定与进展疾病状态上具有可行性，支持在神经肿瘤学中开展更大规模、纵向的连续可穿戴监测作为数字生物标志物的研究。

title: Don't Ask the LLM: Visual Token Pruning with Spectral Structure and Semantic Relevance
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 19 pages (10 pages main paper, 9 pages supplementary material)
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) represent images and videos as long visual-token sequences, substantially increasing inference costs. These costs motivate visual-token pruning, whose effectiveness depends on both what signal is used for selection and when that signal becomes available. Our analysis reveals complementary limitations: visual-side [CLS] attention produces scattered, background-biased selections under aggressive compression, while stronger query-conditioned signals become available after substantial computation within the large language model (LLM). This raises a natural question: can structurally coherent, query-aware token selection be performed before consulting the LLM? We therefore propose ST-Pruner (Spectral-Textual Pruner), a training-free framework for pre-LLM visual-token selection. It combines attention-independent spectral saliency with inverted patch-text similarity through parameter-free multiplicative fusion. Across diverse LVLMs, ST-Pruner retains over 95% of full-token performance using at most 11.1% of visual tokens and achieves a 3.2x end-to-end speedup on LLaVA-NeXT. Code is available at https://github.com/sejong-rcv/ST-Pruner.

AI.tldr: ST-Pruner 是一种无需训练的前置视觉 token 剪枝框架，融合谱显著性与文本相似度，在仅保留约 11.1% 视觉 token 时保持 95% 以上性能，端到端加速 3.2 倍。
AI.motivation: LVLM 将图像/视频表示为长视觉 token 序列导致推理成本高。视觉 token 剪枝的效果取决于所用选择信号及其可获得时机：视觉侧 [CLS] 注意力在激进压缩下出现分散、偏背景的选择；而更强的查询条件信号需在 LLM 内部大量计算后才可用。由此提出问题：能否在咨询 LLM 之前完成结构化连贯、查询感知的 token 选择。
AI.method: 提出 ST-Pruner（Spectral-Textual Pruner），训练-free 的 pre-LLM 视觉 token 选择框架：将注意力无关的谱显著性（spectral saliency）与倒置的 patch-文本相似度（inverted patch-text similarity）通过无参数乘法融合进行选择。
AI.result: 在多种 LVLM 上，使用至多 11.1% 的视觉 token 即可保持超过 95% 的完整 token 性能；在 LLaVA-NeXT 上实现 3.2 倍端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: 无需 LLM 内部计算即可实现结构化、查询感知的视觉 token 选择是可行且高效的；注意力无关信号与文本相似度的无参数融合是有效且通用的剪枝方案，代码已开源。

title: BridgeRouter: Gain-Aware Instance Routing over Cross-Modal Bridge Portfolios
summary: Lightweight representation bridges make pretrained, task-adapted EEG foundation models executable on other biosignal modalities without retraining their backbones. However, selecting a single bridge pathway globally assigns every instance to the same transfer route and ignores complementary errors across routes. We therefore formulate multi-bridge transfer as an instance-level algorithm-selection problem and introduce BridgeRouter, a gain-aware router over a portfolio of frozen cross-modal pathways. A validation-selected Single Best Solver (SBS) serves as a protected default route. During training, task labels are used to compute the reduction in negative log-likelihood provided by each alternative route relative to the SBS, and a lightweight MLP predicts these route-specific gains from a target-modality representation extracted by a frozen encoder. At inference, BridgeRouter observes only the target modality, requires neither EEG, task labels, nor predictions from all candidate routes, and executes exactly one bridge pathway: the route with the largest predicted gain when that gain exceeds a validation-calibrated threshold, and the SBS otherwise. We evaluate seven EEG foundation-model bridge pathways for EMG-based freezing-of-gait detection on FOG and ECG-based sleep classification on ISRUC. Across five seeds, BridgeRouter achieves $81.38\pm1.11\%$ balanced accuracy on FOG, improving over the BIOT SBS by $11.49$ percentage points, and $62.92\pm2.17\%$ on ISRUC, improving over the CBraMod SBS by $3.83$ points. Per-instance bridge oracles reach $99.96\%$ and $78.61\%$, respectively, revealing substantial remaining portfolio headroom. These results show that anchor-relative gain prediction can convert complementary cross-modal bridge behavior into deployable instance-level routing improvements while retaining single-route inference.

AI.tldr: 该论文将多桥接跨模态迁移建模为实例级算法选择问题，提出 BridgeRouter：以验证集选出的单一最优路径为受保护默认路由，用轻量 MLP 从目标模态表征预测各候选桥接路径相对 SBS 的负对数似然增益，推理时仅需目标模态并只执行一条路径。在 FOG（EMG 步态冻结检测）与 ISRUC（ECG 睡眠分期）上分别达 81.38%、62.92% 平衡准确率，较 BIOT、CBraMod 的 SBS 提升 11.49 与 3.83 个百分点，且单实例桥接 oracle 显示仍有显著组合空间。
AI.motivation: 轻量表征桥接使预训练、任务适配的 EEG 基础模型无需重训主干即可在其他生物信号模态上执行，但全局选择单一桥接路径会把所有实例分配到同一迁移路线，忽略了不同路线之间的互补性误差，因此需按实例动态选择迁移路径。
AI.method: 将多桥接迁移形式化为实例级算法选择问题：构建由冻结跨模态桥接路径组成的候选组合，以验证集选出的 SBS 作为受保护默认路由；训练时用任务标签计算每条替代路径相对 SBS 的负对数似然下降量作为增益标签，由轻量 MLP 基于冻结编码器提取的目标模态表征预测路径级增益；推理时仅观测目标模态，不依赖 EEG、任务标签或全部候选路径的预测，仅当最大预测增益超过验证集校准阈值时执行该路径，否则回退 SBS。
AI.result: 在七个 EEG 基础模型桥接路径上评估：EMG 步态冻结检测（FOG）与 ECG 睡眠分类（ISRUC）。五个随机种子下，FOG 平衡准确率 81.38±1.11%（较 BIOT SBS 提升 11.49 个百分点），ISRUC 为 62.92±2.17%（较 CBraMod SBS 提升 3.83 个百分点）；单实例桥接 oracle 分别达 99.96% 与 78.61%，说明组合仍存在较大剩余提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 以锚点（SBS）为参照的增益预测可将跨模态桥接的互补行为转化为可部署的实例级路由收益，同时保持单路径推理的低开销特性。

title: Human Evaluation with Automatic Scores: Separating Sampling and Estimation Gains
summary: Automatic judges offer inexpensive information about model outputs, but an evaluation team must decide how to turn that information into fewer human annotations. Scores can guide sampling, correct an estimate, or support adaptive acquisition, and these uses may capture overlapping gains. We compare their incremental value on fixed evaluation pools from three preference datasets, and 19 attributed-question-answering systems. Matched comparisons use the same scores, account for pilot labels and budget rules, and separate acquisition from estimation. Score stratification is a strong reference: after ten-bin stratification, the best fixed local linear correction offers only 1.00--5.27% further MSE reduction in the primary configurations. Unequal allocation offers larger gains in some pools, but can increase error when confident scores conceal variable human outcomes. Comparison on AttributedQA, shrinking learned quotas toward score-only quotas lowers pooled MSE for 17 of 19 systems relative to the score-only procedure, but ordinary pooled 95% intervals cover only 88.09--93.54%. The same shrinkage improves on the score-only reference in only one of eight preference configurations. Ranking experiments further show that lower individual MSE need not improve system selection. These findings support a simple starting procedure, proportional sampling within score strata followed by a stratified human mean, and identify what additional evidence is needed to justify correction or adaptation for the intended evaluation output.

AI.tldr: 该论文在固定评测池上系统比较了自动评分用于分层、校正、自适应采样的增量价值，结论是"按分数分层后比例采样+分层人类均值"应作为默认起点程序，额外校正或自适应的收益有限且需证据支持。
AI.motivation: 自动评审（automatic judges）能廉价提供模型输出信息，但评测团队必须决定如何把这些分数转化为更少的人工标注。分数可用于指导采样、校正估计或支持自适应采集，而这些用途的收益可能相互重叠，以往研究缺乏在匹配条件下对三者增量价值的直接比较。
AI.method: 在三个偏好数据集和19个AttributedQA系统构成的固定评测池上做匹配对比：使用相同分数、计入预试验标签与预算规则，并将采集与估计分离。比较十箱分数分层、固定局部线性校正、非等比例分配、学习配额（含向仅分数配额收缩）等方法，并考察对系统排序/选择的影响。
AI.result: 分数分层是强基线：十箱分层后，最佳固定局部线性校正仅在主要配置中额外降低MSE 1.00–5.27%。非等比例分配在部分池中收益更大，但当高置信分数掩盖人类结果的高方差时会增大误差。AttributedQA上，学习配额向仅分数配额收缩使17/19系统的合并MSE低于仅分数程序，但普通合并95%区间覆盖率仅88.09–93.54%；该收缩仅在8个偏好配置中的1个优于仅分数参考。排序实验显示更低的个体MSE不必然改善系统选择。
AI.conclusion: 支持一个简单起点程序：在分数分层内比例采样，再用分层人类均值估计；要采用校正或自适应采集，需先获得针对目标评测输出的额外证据（如分数与人类结果关系的稳定性、置信度可靠性）。

title: Learning from Relative Action Credit for Escaping Local Minima
summary: Reinforcement learning holds the promise of robots that learn manipulation skills from interaction alone, without pretrained priors or demonstration data. In practice, on-policy methods such as PPO routinely stall on long-horizon, contact-rich tasks: dense reward shaping carries the policy through stages, yet stitching them together and discovering sparsely rewarded events rarely succeeds. We trace this failure to the missing action discrimination in state-value credit assignment: a state-value critic judges progress only by episode outcomes, so when the policy converges to a partial solution all outcomes coincide, and improvement stops because no action can prove better than another. We therefore extend PPO with an action conditioned value critic which, can compare the executed action with alternatives sampled at the same state and aid the learning signal. Combined with Generalized Advantage Estimation and a bound on exploration noise, we show how the extended algorithm escapes the plateau and completes precise peg insertion within a training budget where PPO with identical exploration fails.

AI.tldr: 本文将PPO停滞于长时程接触密集型任务归因于状态价值评论家缺乏动作区分能力，提出动作条件价值评论家（动作条件critic），结合GAE与有界探索噪声，使算法能跳出局部平台，在相同训练预算内完成精确轴孔装配。
AI.motivation: 强化学习有望仅靠交互习得操作技能，无需预训练先验或示教数据。但实际中PPO等on-policy方法在长时程、接触丰富的任务上常陷入停滞：稠密奖励塑形虽能推动策略逐步推进，却难以将各阶段缝合起来并发现稀疏奖励的关键事件。
AI.method: 将失败原因归结为状态价值信用分配中缺失动作区分性：状态价值critic仅凭回合结果判断进展，当策略收敛到部分解时所有结果趋于一致，无法证明某动作优于其他动作，改进停止。为此扩展PPO，引入动作条件价值critic，可在同一状态比较已执行动作与采样得到的替代动作，从而增强学习信号；并结合广义优势估计（GAE）与对探索噪声的约束。
AI.result: 在相同训练预算下，扩展算法能够跳出停滞平台并完成精确的轴孔装配任务，而探索设置完全相同的PPO失败。
AI.conclusion: 动作条件价值评论家可在仅有交互的条件下有效打破on-policy方法的信用分配瓶颈，为长时程接触密集型操作任务提供可行的学习路径。

title: Does 3D Pose Improve Action Valuation in Football? An Empirical Study of Pose Representations and Learning Objectives
summary: Football action valuation estimates players' contributions to future scoring. Existing multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (MADRL) models use 2D positions and velocities, omitting posture information relevant to imminent actions. We investigate whether adding 3D pose to a SARSA-based model improves observed-action values relative to attack returns: goals, conceded goals or final expected possession value. Using UEFA Champions League 2022/23 event, tracking and 3D pose data, we compare six representations (no pose, raw joints, torso and head orientation, and spatial-temporal graph convolutional network (ST-GCN) embeddings) across five learning settings and three seeds. The settings vary temporal-difference targets and action-prediction loss, with Monte Carlo return regression as a reference. Across 50 on-ball and off-ball comparisons, pose robustly improved return prediction in only three, all using torso and head orientation, while worsening it in twelve, mostly with ST-GCN. Training choices had greater effects: removing the action-prediction loss raised on-ball skill of position-only values from 0.003 to 0.040 and their correlation with expected goals from 0.23 to 0.60; the improvement in return prediction persisted at matched training length. Separately, pose improved prediction of the on-ball action 0.2 s ahead (macro AUC 0.914 to 0.934 with raw joints), while the passer's pose during execution improved pass-success prediction (AUC 0.844 to 0.856). Within this training protocol, pose informed imminent actions but rarely improved observed-action values.

AI.tldr: 在SARSA类足球动作价值估计中引入3D姿态，仅在少数设定下稳健提升回报预测，而训练方案（去掉动作预测损失）的影响远大于姿态特征。
AI.motivation: 现有足球多智能体深度强化学习（MADRL）动作价值估计仅使用2D位置与速度，忽略了与即将发生动作相关的姿态信息；作者旨在检验加入3D姿态能否改善观察动作价值（相对进球、失球或末端期望控球价值等进攻回报）。
AI.method: 使用UEFA欧冠2022/23赛事数据、追踪数据与3D姿态数据；基于SARSA框架比较六种表示（无姿态、原始关节、躯干与头部朝向、ST-GCN嵌入等），跨越5种学习设定与3个随机种子；设定通过变化时序差分目标与动作预测辅助损失，并以蒙特卡洛回报回归作为参照。
AI.result: 50项有球与无球对比中，仅3项（均为躯干与头部朝向）姿态稳健改善回报预测，12项（多为ST-GCN）反而变差。训练选择影响更大：去除动作预测损失使仅用位置的价值的有球技能从0.003升至0.040，与期望进球的相关系数从0.23升至0.60，且在等训练时长下回报预测改进仍保持。另外，姿态改善了0.2 s后动作预测（原始关节宏平均AUC 0.914→0.934），执行期传球者姿态改善传球成功预测（AUC 0.844→0.856）。
AI.conclusion: 在该训练协议下，姿态信息有助于刻画即将发生的动作，但很少能改善观察动作价值的估计；相比之下，训练目标设计（如是否加入动作预测损失）是更关键的因素。

title: DecompGym: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Designing Decomposition Algorithms
summary: Benders decomposition and column generation solve large optimization problems by passing cuts, columns, and dual values between a master problem and subproblems, and are hard to implement correctly. Large language models now automate parts of algorithm design, which points toward agents that build decomposition solvers for new problems. As a first step toward such agents, we study how well current coding agents design and implement these two algorithms, and how they fail. We introduce DecompGym, 81 instances from nine problem families (five Benders, four column generation), in which an agent writes a solver for a prescribed method. Each solver must meet three criteria: execution within a 60-second time limit; numerical feasibility together with a method audit, in which an LLM judge reads the solver's code; and an objective within 1% of the stored optimal objective. We evaluate 12 GPT, Claude, and Gemini models running in coding-agent tools. Over up to ten attempts, we compare independent regeneration with reflection, which first diagnoses the failure. On the first attempt, two models solve every instance and seven solve more than 90%. Most Benders failures (48 of 62) are missing or suboptimal solutions. The most common column-generation failure is a method-audit rejection. Output checks alone would accept 93 of the 108 attempts that fail the method audit. The most common rejection, an optimalif, occurs 96 times, 92 of them in one model.Reflection turns 66% of retries into successes, compared with 39% for regeneration, and it repairs method-audit failures, for which the judge names the defecective gaps. Agents for decomposition therefore need checks on how a solver reaches its answer and feedback that locates the error. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/SIKAI-C/DecompGym.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DecompGym 基准（9 个问题族、81 个实例，含 Benders 分解与列生成），用 12 个 GPT/Claude/Gemini 模型在编码智能体工具中实现指定算法，并按"60 秒时限、数值可行性+方法审计（LLM 判官读代码）、目标值在最优 1% 内"三项标准评估；发现单纯输出校验不足，反思式重试显著优于独立重生成。
AI.motivation: Benders 分解与列生成需要在主问题与子问题间传递割、列与对偶值，实现正确性难度高；LLM 已能自动化部分算法设计，未来智能体有望为新问题构建分解求解器，但当前编码智能体设计和实现这两类算法的能力与失败模式尚不清楚，因此需要系统评测作为第一步。
AI.method: 构建 DecompGym：来自九个问题族（五个 Benders、四个列生成）的 81 个实例，智能体需为规定方法编写求解器。评估三项标准：(1) 60 秒内执行完成；(2) 数值可行性并通过方法审计——由 LLM 判官阅读求解器代码；(3) 目标值在存储最优解的 1% 以内。对 12 个 GPT、Claude、Gemini 模型在编码智能体工具中运行，最多十次尝试，比较"独立重生成"与"先诊断失败的反思式重试"。
AI.result: 首次尝试中，两个模型解出全部实例，七个模型解出 90% 以上。Benders 失败多为缺失解或次优解（62 次中 48 次）；列生成最常见失败是方法审计不通过。仅靠输出校验会接受 108 次审计失败尝试中的 93 次。最常见的拒绝原因是 "optimalif"，出现 96 次，其中 92 次集中于单一模型。反思式重试成功率 66%，独立重生成仅 39%；反思能修复方法审计失败（判官指出缺陷所在）。
AI.conclusion: 分解算法智能体不仅需校验求解结果，更需检查求解器"如何得到答案"的过程，并提供能定位错误位置的反馈；方法审计与反思式反馈是当前必要且有效的补充机制，DecompGym 为后续智能体研究提供基准。

title: EPSBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Earnings Forecasting
summary: Quarterly earnings forecasting requires an agent to connect financial evidence to the income-statement line items that produce a company's reported earnings. We introduce EPSBench, a benchmark for studying this ability across 149 firm-quarters from 86 US companies. Agents read a fixed collection of filings, earnings-call transcripts, and news, then estimate company-specific income-statement drivers with cited evidence. A shared accounting calculator converts these estimates into GAAP diluted earnings per share (EPS), providing a common basis for comparing forecast assumptions. We evaluate six models under a common harness, assessing point forecast error relative to date-matched analyst consensus and checking whether their prediction intervals achieve the stated coverage. Three models show no detectable paired difference in point forecast error from consensus, and three have higher error. Across all six models, nominal 80% intervals contain reported EPS in only 37--70% of runs that return an interval, and most misses fall above the upper bound because the forecasts run low. The driver records trace most of the error gap between models to operating-income estimates.

AI.tldr: 提出EPSBench基准，评估LLM智能体将财报、电话会与新闻证据连接到利润表驱动项并预测季度EPS的能力，发现多数模型点预测误差与分析师一致预期无显著差异，但预测区间普遍覆盖不足且系统性偏低估。
AI.motivation: 季度盈利预测要求智能体把分散的财务证据与决定公司报告盈利的利润表科目联系起来，但缺乏标准化基准来检验这一能力及预测的校准性。
AI.method: 构建EPSBench，覆盖86家美国公司149个公司-季度样本；智能体读取固定语料（公告文件、业绩电话会记录、新闻），输出带证据引用的公司特定利润表驱动项估计，再由统一的会计计算器转换为GAAP稀释EPS，形成可比假设基础；在统一评测框架下评估六个模型，衡量相对同期分析师一致预期的点预测误差，并检验预测区间是否达到名义覆盖率。
AI.result: 三个模型的点预测误差与一致预期无显著配对差异，另三个误差更高；六个模型的名义80%区间实际仅覆盖37–70%的真实EPS，且多数未命中位于上界之上，说明预测系统性偏低；驱动项记录显示模型间误差差异主要来自营业收入估计。
AI.conclusion: EPSBench提供了可追溯证据、可比较假设的EPS预测评测框架；现有模型在点精度上已接近分析师共识，但不确定性量化和驱动项估计（尤其营业收入）仍是主要短板。

title: Integral Probability Boundaries
summary: Bounds based on Integral Probability Metrics (IPMs) are ubiquitous in machine learning and statistics, appearing, e.g., in generalization, alignment, fairness, and privacy. IPMs reduce the discrepancy between two distributions to a single worst-case gap between expectations. This compression is costly: for rare events, safety failures, or under-represented groups, IPM-based bounds are loose or vacuous. We introduce a non-linear generalization of IPMs, which we term Integral Probability Boundaries (IPBs). Unlike IPMs, IPBs provide bounds that are tight at the extremes. We derive their basic properties and present algorithms for estimating them in practically relevant settings. We demonstrate the usage of IPBs in both theoretical and practical applications for alignment, judge-free performance estimation, and fairness, where they enable us to obtain sharp bounds on performance and fairness gaps, e.g., 15 p.p. more precise estimates on fairness gaps for rare groups in a realistic generative modeling task, compared to the state of the art.

AI.tldr: 论文提出积分概率边界（IPBs），将 IPMs 非线性推广，克服其在稀有事件与欠代表群体上的松弛/空泛问题。
AI.motivation: IPMs 将两分布差异压缩为期望差的单一最坏情形间隙，在稀有事件、安全失效和欠代表群体处界过松甚至空泛。
AI.method: 提出 IPMs 的非线性推广 Integral Probability Boundaries（IPBs），推导其基本性质，并给出在实际场景中估计 IPBs 的算法。
AI.result: 在对齐、无评判者性能估计与公平性中验证：相比 SOTA，在实际生成建模任务中对稀有群体的公平性间隙估计精度提升约 15 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: IPBs 在极端处紧致，可用于理论分析与实用场景中对性能与公平性间隙给出更锐利的界。

title: Extremely Sparse-View Computed Tomography from 2D Projections via Pose-Aware Diffusion Priors
summary: Extremely sparse-view computed tomography (xSV-CT) is critical when scanning time, motion, or radiation tolerance limits each scan to only a few projections. In many such scenarios, the same acquisition limits also constrain dataset construction, making pre-reconstructed 3D volumes from dense scans unavailable. This exposes a gap in current sparse-view approaches: Optimization-based methods, which use the sparse measurements directly but lack data-driven priors to suppress artifacts, and learning-based methods, which use strong priors but usually require densely scanned training volumes acquired outside the xSV-CT regime. We study this train-sparse / infer-sparse setting by learning a pose-aware diffusion prior from one 2D projection per training sample, then guiding diffusion sampling with measured-view fidelity, shared-volume reprojection, and projection-physics consistency for tomographic reconstruction. On two public CT datasets across 1-, 4-, and 8-view settings, the proposed method achieves the best novel-view synthesis scores and best or competitive reconstruction quality compared with baselines that use dense-volume supervision.

AI.tldr: 针对"训练稀疏/推理稀疏"(xSV-CT)设定，从每训练样本仅一张2D投影学习位姿感知扩散先验，并以测量视图保真、共享体再投影及投影物理一致性引导采样，在1/4/8视图下取得最佳新视图合成与最优或竞争性重建质量。
AI.motivation: 极端稀疏视图CT中，扫描时间、运动或辐射容限使每次扫描仅有少量投影，同一限制也阻碍了密集扫描3D体数据的构建。由此形成方法空白：优化类方法直接用稀疏测量但缺乏数据驱动先验以抑制伪影；学习类方法有强先验却依赖xSV-CT范围外的密集扫描体训练数据。
AI.method: 提出从每个训练样本的单张2D投影学习位姿感知(pose-aware)扩散先验；在扩散采样过程中引入三重引导：测量视图保真项、共享体积再投影约束、以及投影物理一致性约束，用于层析重建。
AI.result: 在两个公开CT数据集的1、4、8视图设置下，方法获得最佳新视图合成指标，重建质量优于或可比于使用密集体积监督的基线。
AI.conclusion: 无需密集扫描体监督，仅凭单投影即可学习有效先验并实现高质量极端稀疏视图CT重建，验证了train-sparse/infer-sparse范式的可行性。

title: Prototype-Guided Dynamic Domain Modulation and a Large-Scale Multi-SKU Benchmark for Shampoo Bottle Surface Defect Detection
summary: Industrial shampoo-bottle surface defect detection must operate across many stock keeping units (SKUs), where differences in bottle geometry, material, label layout, reflectance, and imaging conditions can substantially alter the appearance of the same defect. Existing industrial defect datasets rarely provide both instance-level defect annotations and product-variant identities, making it difficult to study SKU-aware detection under realistic manufacturing conditions. We introduce Bottle-SKU, a large-scale multi-SKU benchmark for shampoo bottle surface defect detection. Bottle-SKU contains 13,119 images, 20,419 instance-level bounding boxes, seven defect categories, and 48 bottle SKUs, enabling evaluation of both shared defect recognition and SKU-specific appearance variation. To address the challenge of SKU-specific appearance variation, we propose Prototype-Guided Dynamic Domain Modulation (ProDMM). ProDMM constructs a visual prototype for each SKU from training images and predicts a soft SKU distribution for each input. The resulting prototype-conditioned representation dynamically generates low-rank Query/Value modulation for the visual backbone and residual conditioning for defect-text-to-visual attention, while preserving the pretrained Grounding DINO detection pathway. The model is trained jointly with detection, SKU-domain classification, and modulation-regularization objectives. Experiments on Bottle-SKU and the public GC10-DET-SKU metallic surface defect dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of prototype-guided domain conditioning for industrial surface defect detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多SKU洗发水瓶表面缺陷检测基准 Bottle-SKU（13,119 图像、20,419 实例框、7 类缺陷、48 个 SKU），并针对 SKU 外观差异提出原型引导动态域调制方法 ProDMM。
AI.motivation: 工业缺陷检测需跨多 SKU 运行，同一缺陷在不同瓶体几何、材质、标签布局、反射率与成像条件下外观差异显著；现有数据集缺少实例级缺陷标注与产品变体身份的联合提供，难以研究真实制造条件下的 SKU 感知检测。
AI.method: 构建 Bottle-SKU 多 SKU 基准；提出 ProDMM：由训练图像为每个 SKU 构建视觉原型，对输入预测软 SKU 分布，以原型条件表示动态生成视觉骨干的低秩 Query/Value 调制与缺陷文本-视觉注意力的残差条件，同时保留预训练 Grounding DINO 检测通路；联合检测、SKU 域分类与调制正则化目标训练。
AI.result: 在 Bottle-SKU 与公开的 GC10-DET-SKU 金属表面缺陷数据集上实验，验证了原型引导域条件化对工业表面缺陷检测的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 原型引导的域条件化机制可有效应对多 SKU 外观差异，Bottle-SKU 为 SKU 感知缺陷检测研究提供了兼具实例级标注与变体身份的大规模基准。

title: REVBRAIN: Real-time Probabilistic EEG Forecasting Using Residual Vector Quantization
summary:
Real-time forecasting of resting-state EEG signals is required by applications like brain-state-dependent stimulation, where computer generated actions are coupled with ongoing neural oscillations. Recently, the deep learning model WaveNet was proposed for the forecasting task. It shows superior accuracy compared to the prevailing method, the linear autoregressive (AR) model, and provides a built-in uncertainty measure due to its probabilistic modeling framework. However, inference using WaveNet is too slow for real-time use due to its sample-by-sample autoregressive operation: a single forecast requires evaluating the model tens or hundreds of times depending on the length of the prediction window.
  In this paper, we present REVBRAIN, a probabilistic deep learning method that produces forecasts in real time by generating the forecast over the whole prediction horizon at once. This is achieved by tokenizing the output space using residual vector quantization (RVQ) and generating forecasts over the items in the tokenized space.
  We tested REVBRAIN for forecasting 200 ms of EEG time series in the alpha-frequency band (8-13 Hz) and compared our results against WaveNet model. We found that REVBRAIN achieved real-time inference on a laptop GPU and an over $50\times$ speedup compared to WaveNet, while reaching superior prediction accuracy.
  By achieving real-time inference speed, REVBRAIN enables incorporating accurate and probabilistic EEG forecasting into BCI applications, opening up new ways for investigating the functioning of the human brain.

AI.tldr: REVBRAIN：用残差向量量化（RVQ）token化输出空间，一次性生成整个预测窗，实现概率式EEG实时预测，比WaveNet快50倍以上且精度更高。
AI.motivation: 脑状态依赖刺激等BCI应用需对静息态EEG进行实时预测。WaveNet虽比线性AR模型精度更高且自带不确定性度量，但其逐样本自回归推断需评估模型数十至数百次，速度过慢，无法实时使用。
AI.method: 提出REVBRAIN概率深度学习方法：用残差向量量化（RVQ）对输出空间进行token化，并在token化空间上一次性生成覆盖整个预测时域的预测，替代逐点自回归生成。在alpha频段（8–13 Hz）的200 ms EEG序列预测任务上与WaveNet对比。
AI.result: 在笔记本GPU上实现实时推断；相比WaveNet获得超过50倍加速，同时预测精度更优。
AI.conclusion: REVBRAIN实现实时推断速度，使准确且具概率性的EEG预测可嵌入BCI应用，为研究人脑功能提供新途径。

title: Robust LLM-Generated Text Detection through Matched Conditional-Response Probing
summary: Reliable detection of large language model (LLM)-generated text must remain effective under meaning-preserving text revisions, such as rewriting, polishing, and expansion. In practice, LLM outputs are often rewritten, polished, expanded, translated, or lightly edited before publication, weakening the lexical, syntactic, and local discourse cues used by many existing detectors. We introduce \textbf{M}atched \textbf{C}onditional-\textbf{R}esponse \textbf{P}robing (\textbf{MCRP}), a frozen-LLM probing framework that measures how a candidate text responds when a semantically matched condition is introduced, removed, or replaced. For each candidate, the frozen probe LLM first generates a short semantic condition and then compares token-level losses and prompt--target attention measurements under matched, null, and control conditions. It aggregates bidirectional conditioned alignment, counterfactual sensitivity, and internal attention coupling into a probe representation, on which it trains a lightweight supervised random-forest classifier while keeping the probe LLM frozen. Across standard detection, robustness to meaning-preserving text revisions, multilingual, and multidomain evaluations, MCRP achieves consistently strong performance. Under rewriting, polishing, and expansion, it reaches 93.97\% F1 and 96.24\% ROC-AUC, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline by 19.50 and 25.77 percentage points, respectively. Component ablations show that the response feature groups make complementary contributions to predictive performance. In the condition-control study, matched conditions consistently outperform random, mismatched, and corrupted alternatives, demonstrating a measurable incremental benefit from semantic matching.

AI.tldr: 提出冻结LLM探测框架MCRP，通过引入匹配语义条件并测量候选文本的token级损失与注意力响应来检测LLM生成文本，在保义改写下达到93.97% F1与96.24% ROC-AUC，显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: LLM输出在发布前常被改写、润色、扩写、翻译或轻度编辑，削弱了现有检测器依赖的词汇、句法及局部篇章线索，因此需要能在保义修订下依然有效的检测方法。
AI.method: MCRP为冻结LLM探测框架：对每个候选文本，冻结的探针LLM先生成简短语义条件，再在匹配条件、空条件与控制条件下比较token级损失和prompt–target注意力度量；将双向条件对齐、反事实敏感性和内部注意力耦合聚合为探针表示，并在其上训练轻量级监督随机森林分类器，探针LLM保持冻结。
AI.result: 在标准检测、保义改写鲁棒性、多语言与多领域评估中表现稳定优异；在改写、润色、扩写下取得93.97% F1和96.24% ROC-AUC，较最强基线分别提升19.50与25.77个百分点；消融显示各响应特征组贡献互补；条件控制研究表明匹配条件持续优于随机、不匹配和损坏条件，语义匹配带来可测量的增量收益。
AI.conclusion: 基于语义条件匹配的响应式探测能有效捕捉改写后仍保留的深层信号，为鲁棒的LLM文本检测提供了可行方案，且语义匹配本身对性能有实质贡献。

title: Measuring Deep Learning Performance - An Empirical Study of Performance Distributions Across Architectures and Tasks
summary: Context: Non-determinism in deep learning algorithm design and implementation leads to performance variation, meaning model performance is not a single value, but rather a distribution. These model performance distributions are underexplored despite their impact on robustness. Objective: We investigate the robustness of deep learning performance to sources of non-determinism, specifically focusing on how performance distributions differ across various architectures and tasks. Method: We conducted 186 experiments on image classification and time series forecasting architectures. Each experiment was run 100 times with different random seeds to generate performance distributions, resulting in 18,600 runs. Robustness was quantified using metrics for spread, symmetry, and tail risk. Results: Performance distributions are frequently non-Gaussian, particularly in time series forecasting. Model size does not systematically affect robustness -- larger image classification models show fewer outliers but not lower spread, while smaller time series models show lower spread but more extreme underperformers. Training duration does not scale linearly; early stopping effectively balances performance and robustness. Mean performance does not predict robustness - time series forecasting shows moderate correlation while image classification shows none. Time series models produce nearly three times more underperforming outliers than image classification models, indicating substantially higher tail risk. Conclusions: Tail risk poses serious concerns for Trustworthy AI in high-stakes applications. Models performing well on average may exhibit long tails and extreme outliers revealed only through distributional analysis. Mean performance alone should not guide model selection; assessment of spread, symmetry, and tail risk is essential for reliable model assessment where consistent performance is critical.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过18,600次运行揭示深度学习性能呈分布而非单值，性能分布常非高斯、模型规模与训练时长对鲁棒性无非线性系统效应，且均值性能不能预测鲁棒性；时间序列预测的尾部风险显著高于图像分类，强调应基于分布分析（离散度、对称性、尾部风险）评估模型。
AI.motivation: 深度学习算法设计与实现中的非确定性导致性能波动，使模型性能本质上是分布而非单一数值；然而这些性能分布对其鲁棒性的影响长期被忽视，尤其在高风险应用中需要可靠且一致的性能评估。
AI.method: 在图像分类与时间序列预测架构上开展186组实验，每组用100个不同随机种子重复运行以生成性能分布，共18,600次运行；使用离散度、对称性与尾部风险三类指标量化鲁棒性。
AI.result: 性能分布常非高斯，时间序列预测尤为明显；模型规模对鲁棒性无系统性影响——较大的图像分类模型离群值更少但离散度未降，较小的时间序列模型离散度低但极端欠佳表现更多；训练时长非线性缩放，早停可平衡性能与鲁棒性；均值性能不预测鲁棒性（时间序列中度相关，图像分类无相关）；时间序列模型的欠佳离群值约为图像分类的三倍，尾部风险显著更高。
AI.conclusion: 尾部风险对高风险场景的可信AI构成严重隐患；平均表现良好的模型可能存在仅在分布分析下才显现的长尾与极端离群值。仅凭均值性能不应作为模型选择依据，必须评估离散度、对称性与尾部风险，以在需稳定性能的场景中实现可靠评估。

title: SSQA: Sibling-Selective Quadtree Attention for Hierarchical Modeling in Perception Tasks
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Published at ICRA 2026 (oral)
summary: Perception tasks for navigation in robotics, including aerial platforms such as drones and autonomous driving systems, are inherently structured. Drone-mounted cameras typically capture sky above, terrain below, and obstacles or man-made structures in between, while driving data often contains organized road layouts, lane markings, and surrounding agents. Motivated by these axis-aligned structural priors, we note that such information is typically more structured than in generic image tasks. We hypothesize that processing information in a quadtree-esque manner can not only model features effectively in a hierarchical manner, but also offers an efficient linear-time alternative to vanilla attention mechanisms, which run in quadratic time. In this paper, we propose Sibling-Selective Quadtree Attention (SSQA), which models image tokens hierarchically as a structured, full quadtree. We show analytical complexity analysis that guarantees linear-time feature modeling, in addition to empirical experiments comparing inference speeds with other popular modeling approaches, such as Mamba 2 and Quadtree Attention. Our results, benchmarked across several tasks, show that we achieve results at least as good, if not notably better, as others at a fraction of the computational costs.

AI.tldr: 提出Sibling-Selective Quadtree Attention (SSQA)，将图像token组织为完整四叉树进行层次化建模，以线性复杂度替代二次复杂度的注意力，在多项任务上以更低计算成本取得相当或更优效果。
AI.motivation: 机器人与自动驾驶等导航感知任务的数据具有显著轴对齐结构先验（天空在上、地形在下、道路布局与车道线等），比通用图像任务更有规律，因此可利用四叉树式层次结构高效建模，规避标准注意力机制的二次复杂度。
AI.method: 设计SSQA，将图像token按完整、结构化的四叉树组织，并采用"兄弟节点选择性"的注意力计算方式实现层次化特征建模；给出保证线性时间复杂度的解析复杂度分析，并与Mamba 2、Quadtree Attention等方法进行推理速度的实测对比。
AI.result: 复杂度分析证明特征建模为线性时间；多任务基准实验与推理速度对比显示，SSQA在仅需极小部分计算成本的情况下，性能至少与其他方法相当，部分任务上显著更优。
AI.conclusion: 利用导航感知数据的结构化先验，四叉树式选择性注意力可在保持或提升性能的同时大幅降低计算开销，是二次复杂度注意力的一种高效线性替代方案。

title: From Natural Language to Real Schematics: An Automated Workflow for Power Electronics Schematic Synthesis
summary: Designing power electronics converters traditionally requires intensive human expertise across topology sizing, commercial component selection, circuit simulation verification, and schematic drafting. While Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise in electronic design automation (EDA), applying standalone LLMs directly to board-level power electronics schematic synthesis suffers from severe engineering hallucinations, including inaccurate analytical sizing, fabricated or mismatched component part numbers, violated voltage derating margins, and broken topological connectivity. In this paper, we propose a Bounded Dual-Loop Automated Schematic Synthesis Framework that translates natural language specifications into verified, editable KiCad schematics and manufacturing deliverables. Our workflow integrates six stages across three functional columns: (1) requirement parsing and knowledge-driven power stage synthesis covering non-isolated (Buck, Boost) and isolated/resonant (Flyback, DAB, half-bridge LLC) topologies; (2) contract- and evidence-coordinated component selection grounded in distributor APIs and OEM datasheets, coupled with closed-loop ngspice transient verification and stress feedback; and (3) modular control hardware integration and multi-format deliverable generation featuring native KiCad netlist round-trip verification.
