End-to-end case studies on a 24-36V to 12V,2A Buck converter (29 positions, 83 verified terminals) and an isolated 48V to 24V, 0.5A, Dual-Active Bridge (DAB) converter (87 positions, 341 verified terminals), alongside comparative evaluations against a Vanilla LLM baseline, demonstrate that our framework improves component verification coverage from 22.2 to 98.6, nominal value consistency from 0 to 97.7, and SPICE simulation pass rates from 0 to 100.

AI.tldr: 提出"有界双环"框架，将自然语言电源规格自动转化为经校验、可编辑的KiCad原理图与制造交付物，显著抑制LLM在板级电源原理图生成中的工程幻觉。
AI.motivation: 传统功率变换器设计需在拓扑定容、商用元件选型、电路仿真验证与原理图绘制等环节投入大量专家人力；独立LLM直接用于板级电源原理图综合存在严重工程幻觉：解析定容不准、器件料号虚构或不匹配、违反电压降额裕度、拓扑连通性破坏。
AI.method: 六阶段、三功能列的流水线：(1)需求解析与知识驱动功率级综合，覆盖非隔离(Buck、Boost)与隔离/谐振(Flyback、DAB、半桥LLC)拓扑；(2)基于分销商API与OEM数据手册的"契约+证据"协同选型，配合ngspice瞬态闭环验证与应力反馈；(3)模块化控制硬件集成与多格式交付物生成，含原生KiCad网表往返验证。整体构成有界双环控制结构。
AI.result: 端到端案例：24–36V转12V/2A Buck(29个位号、83个已校验端子)与隔离48V转24V/0.5A DAB(87个位号、341个已校验端子)；与Vanilla LLM基线对比，元件校验覆盖率由22.2提升至98.6，标称值一致性由0提升至97.7，SPICE仿真通过率由0提升至100。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM生成能力与显式约束边界(选型契约、证据溯源、仿真闭环、网表往返校验)耦合，可有效抑制工程幻觉，实现从规格到可制造原理图的可靠自动化综合，为LLM驱动的EDA提供可验证路径。

title: Fu-TCM: a multimodal large language model that learns traditional Chinese medicine diagnostic reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are advancing in multimodal understanding and reasoning, accelerating medical model development. Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) uses evidence from the four examinations to determine disease location and nature, differentiate syndromes and guide treatment. This diagnostic process constitutes a complete chain of reasoning. We present Fu-TCM, a multimodal TCM LLM trained on data retained after cleaning and filtering an initial collection of approximately 7.12 million examples derived from classical texts, textbooks, medical images, clinical cases and publicly available datasets. The model was further optimized using Bianzheng-Grounded Policy Optimization (BGPO), which explicitly targets syndrome differentiation through rewards for response format, intermediate TCM reasoning fields and final syndrome predictions. Fu-TCM-27B led all six benchmarks spanning TCM reasoning, text and vision, achieving a macro-average accuracy of 81.01% and surpassing the strongest reference model with complete results across all six benchmarks by 7.13 percentage points. Its largest margin was 11.90 points on Fu-bianzheng. Case-level analyses further showed a positive association between intermediate-field accuracy and final syndrome-selection accuracy in most evaluated models. These findings suggest that TCM syndrome differentiation may be computationally learnable and that structured reasoning supervision can improve performance across TCM tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态中医大模型Fu-TCM，并设计BGPO强化学习方法显式优化辨证推理，在六项基准上取得领先。
AI.motivation: 中医诊断依赖"四诊合参"确定病位病性、辨证施治，构成完整推理链；而现有多模态大模型尚未针对这一辨证推理链条进行建模与监督，因此需要构建专门的、能显式学习辨证过程的中医多模态大模型。
AI.method: 1）清洗筛选约712万条初始样本，来源涵盖古籍、教材、医学图像、临床病例及公开数据集，用于训练多模态中医模型Fu-TCM；2）采用Bianzheng-Grounded Policy Optimization（BGPO）进行强化优化，以响应格式、中间中医推理字段与最终证候预测作为奖励信号，显式对齐辨证过程。
AI.result: Fu-TCM-27B在涵盖中医推理、文本与视觉的六项基准上全面领先，宏平均准确率81.01%，较六项基准均有完整结果的最强参照模型高7.13个百分点；在Fu-bianzheng上优势最大，领先11.90分。病例级分析显示，多数被评估模型中中间字段准确率与最终证候选择准确率呈正相关。
AI.conclusion: 中医辨证或可被计算化学习，结构化推理监督能够提升跨中医任务的性能，为中医多模态模型的推理链建模提供了可行路径。

title: CADENCE: Distributional Next-Transaction Forecasting for Business Cash-Flow Underwriting
summary: Recurring cash flows are the backbone of cash-flow underwriting: they separate durable revenue from one-off deposits, expose standing obligations, and ultimately determine ability to pay. For small businesses, recurrence is both indispensable and hard to estimate, because much of their income arrives as ambiguous transfers, most payment streams are short, and schedules follow calendar conventions that frequency-domain methods treat as noise. We present CADENCE, Calendar-Aware Distributional Event Network for Cash-Flow Estimation, a compact causal Transformer that treats each transaction as a token and predicts the amount and a full, nonparametric timing distribution of every cash flow's next payment. Inheriting transaction semantics from an external labeler and a frozen text encoder keeps CADENCE compact yet general across the long tail of small-business counterparties, while predicting a calibrated distribution rather than an opaque embedding makes its outputs interpretable enough to feed existing underwriting models and power credit decisions. Ablations confirm the role of each design choice, with counterparty semantics driving recall on short histories, calendar inputs driving timing accuracy, and no-event supervision driving precision. Against the production FFT baseline, CADENCE improves one-day timing accuracy by 93.3% and next-event F1 by 6.7%, while producing calibrated distributions that serve directly as a confidence gate for downstream decisions. In an end-to-end credit evaluation on production applications, replacing FFT recurrence features with CADENCE features raises KS by 4.8%, raises the approval rate at a fixed loss rate by 18.2%, and lowers the loss rate at a fixed approval rate by 13.1%.

AI.tldr: CADENCE：一个紧凑的因果 Transformer，以每笔交易为 token，预测每类现金流的下一笔支付金额及其完整非参数时间分布，用于小企业现金流承保中的周期性识别。
AI.motivation: 经常性现金流是现金流承保的核心，用于区分可持续收入与一次性存款、揭示固定义务并判断偿付能力。但对小企业而言，周期性既必要又难估计：大量收入以语义模糊的转账形式出现、支付序列普遍很短、且支付日程遵循日历惯例，而频域（FFT）方法将这些日历规律视为噪声。
AI.method: 提出 CADENCE（Calendar-Aware Distributional Event Network）：紧凑型因果 Transformer，将每笔交易视为一个 token，预测每个现金流下一笔支付的金额以及完整的非参数时间分布；通过继承外部标注器给出的交易语义与冻结文本编码器，保持在长尾交易对手上的紧凑性与泛化性；输出校准后的分布而非不可解释的嵌入向量，可直接接入现有承保模型。监督中包含无事件（no-event）信号。
AI.result: 消融实验显示：交易对手语义主要提升短历史下的召回率，日历输入提升时序准确率，无事件监督提升精确率。相对生产环境的 FFT 基线，一日内时序准确率提升 93.3%，下一事件 F1 提升 6.7%，且分布校准良好、可直接作为下游决策的置信门控。在真实生产申请的端到端信贷评估中，以 CADENCE 特征替换 FFT 周期性特征后，KS 提升 4.8%，固定损失率下审批率提升 18.2%，固定审批率下损失率下降 13.1%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模日历结构与输出校准化时间分布，显著优于频域周期性特征，并能在实际承保流程中同时提升区分度（KS）、审批通过率与风险控制水平。

title: Knowledge-structured and evidence-aware semantic self-distillation for glomerular pathology foundation model
summary: Visual foundation models learn rich pathological morphology but lack explicit concept-level supervision. Vision--language pretraining can provide this supervision but requires costly image--text pairs. Here, we introduce GloSAGE, a semantic self-distillation framework that uses lesion profiles predicted by a pretrained visual teacher to construct structured pathology descriptions. Reliability-guided selection identifies image--text anchors, while Knowledge-Structured Pathology Text Synthesis and Evidence-Guided Negative-pair Construction account for partially observed lesions. Image--text alignment trains projection layers while retaining the frozen visual encoder; an intermediate Semantic Transfer Layer supplies features for downstream tasks. Developed on GloMillion and evaluated across seven glomerulus- and case-level cohorts, GloSAGE supported zero-shot lesion recognition, image--text retrieval, hard-negative discrimination and concept-intervention analyses. It outperformed its source visual model in most lesion-recognition tasks and improved lesion grading, while supporting competitive case-level disease classification, injury grading and baseline renal function estimation. Ablations supported the combined contributions of knowledge-structured text and evidence-guided negatives, and the intermediate transfer layer improved mean lesion-recognition ROC-AUC relative to the complete projection output. A frozen language model conditioned on GloSAGE features generated glomerular descriptions. These findings suggest that teacher-derived lesion profiles can provide annotation-efficient semantic supervision for extending a glomerular visual foundation model.

AI.tldr: GloSAGE是一个语义自蒸馏框架，利用预训练视觉教师模型预测的病灶档案构建结构化病理描述，实现无需昂贵图文对的视觉-语言预训练，为肾小球视觉基础模型提供标注高效的语义监督。
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型能学习丰富的病理形态，但缺乏显式的概念级监督；视觉-语言预训练可提供此类监督，却依赖昂贵的图像-文本配对数据。
AI.method: 以预训练视觉教师模型预测的病灶档案生成结构化病理描述；采用可靠性引导选择确定图像-文本锚点；通过"知识结构化病理文本合成"与"证据引导负样本对构建"处理部分可观测病灶；仅训练投影层并冻结视觉编码器进行图文对齐；引入中间语义迁移层为下游任务提供特征。
AI.result: 在GloMillion上开发，于七个肾小球级与病例级队列评估：支持零样本病灶识别、图文检索、难负样本判别与概念干预分析；多数病灶识别任务优于源视觉模型并改善病灶分级；在病例级疾病分类、损伤分级及基线肾功能估计上具备竞争力；消融实验验证知识结构化文本与证据引导负样本的联合贡献，且中间迁移层较完整投影输出提升了平均病灶识别ROC-AUC；以GloSAGE特征为条件的冻结语言模型可生成肾小球描述。
AI.conclusion: 教师模型衍生的病灶档案可为扩展肾小球视觉基础模型提供标注高效的语义监督。

title: GAAC: Lossless KV Compression for Bandwidth-Efficient LLM Inference on Personal Devices
summary: Weight-only, lossy quantization substantially reduces the storage and memory requirements for serving large language models (LLMs), but the growing key-value (KV) cache remains a bottleneck for long-context inference on personal devices. We present Group-Adaptive Additive Codec (GAAC), a lossless KV compression and serving system that exploits exponent redundancy to reduce storage and accelerate attention without introducing KV approximation. GAAC encodes BF16 exponents using calibrated per-channel base-plus-offset codes over contiguous ranges. GAAC adapts code widths across small groups while preserving KV values bit-for-bit. A fused attention kernel reconstructs KV tiles on the fly, avoiding full-cache decompression. Block-wise compression and fixed-capacity slots support incremental cache updates and paged serving. Across five tested models, GAAC achieves 1.405-1.407$\times$ lossless BF16 KV compression. We also study compression performance on low-precision tensors FP8 E4M3 caches ( 1.09-1.14$\times$) and E5M2 caches (1.25-1.30$\times$). On NVIDIA DGX Spark, GAAC accelerates decode attention at a 64K-token context by 1.19-1.27$\times$ and end-to-end W4A16 decode steps by 1.04-1.15$\times$. In serving, it reduces resident KV memory by approximately 26% and increases aggregate throughput by 13-29% under comparable KV-memory budgets. On Apple M4, GAAC achieves 1.02-1.25$\times$ attention speedups, demonstrating portability beyond NVIDIA GPUs.

AI.tldr: GAAC：利用BF16指数冗余实现无损KV cache压缩与在线解压的融合注意力，提升长上下文推理效率。
AI.motivation: 权重已可做有损低比特量化，但长上下文推理中KV cache持续增长成为端侧内存瓶颈；已有KV压缩方法多引入近似误差，缺少无损同时加速的方案。
AI.method: 按通道标定"基值+偏移"编码BF16指数，在连续区间上用小块自适应码宽，并对KV值逐比特无损还原；设计融合注意力kernel对KV tile在线重建，避免整缓存解压；采用块级压缩与定容slot支持增量更新与分页serving。
AI.result: 五个模型上BF16 KV无损压缩1.405–1.407×；FP8 E4M3为1.09–1.14×，E5M2为1.25–1.30×。DGX Spark上64K上下文解码注意力加速1.19–1.27×，W4A16端到端解码步1.04–1.15×；serving常驻KV内存降约26%，同等KV预算下吞吐提升13–29%；Apple M4注意力加速1.02–1.25×。
AI.conclusion: 基于指数冗余的无损KV压缩可与融合注意力、分页服务良好结合，在NVIDIA与Apple平台均获得实际收益，具备跨硬件可移植性。

title: Statutory Article Retrieval from Arabic Judicial Narratives: Family Law and Law of Evidence in Saudi Arabia
summary: Reliable legal information retrieval must ground legal reasoning in authoritative statutory sources. In Arabic judicial settings, long factual narratives must be mapped to concise articles that express abstract legal rules, creating a narrative-to-legal-rule abstraction gap. Using a benchmark of 200 synthetic Saudi Arabic judicial cases and 381 articles from the Family Law and the Law of Evidence, we compare word-level and char-4 BM25, zero-shot dense encoders, per-law retrieval, dense-sparse reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), and a proposed Decompose-and-Refine (DaR) pipeline. In DaR, a large language model splits each narrative into disputed legal issues and generates, for each issue, three retrieval channels: a statute-style paraphrase, legal keywords, and a candidate taxonomy chapter. On the whole corpus, the instructed Qwen3-Embedding-8B dense encoder reaches an MRR@10 of 0.849, the best result of any non-decomposed system. Under per-law scoring, this advantage reflects Family Law only: restricted to Evidence articles, the same encoder drops to an MRR@10 of 0.087, and fusion with BM25 raises it only to 0.207. DaR changes this picture, raising Evidence MRR@10 to 0.696 and Family MRR@10 to 0.864. Without decomposition, the two laws favor different strategies; under DaR, the same retriever achieves the best MRR@10 on both.

AI.tldr: 本文针对阿拉伯语司法场景中"叙事—法条"抽象鸿沟问题，在200个合成沙特阿拉伯语司法案例与381条家事法、证据法条文构成的基准上，比较BM25（词级/字符4-gram）、零样本稠密编码器、分法检索、稠密-稀疏RRF融合及提出的Decompose-and-Refine（DaR）流程，发现DaR能同时提升两类法律的检索表现。
AI.motivation: 可靠的法律信息检索须将法律推理锚定于权威成文法源。阿拉伯语司法场景中，冗长的事实叙事需映射到表述抽象法律规则的简明条文，存在"叙事到法律规则"的抽象鸿沟；且现有系统在不同法律门类上表现不均衡（家事法强、证据法极弱），缺乏统一有效的检索策略。
AI.method: 构建基准：200个合成沙特阿拉伯语司法案例 + 381条家事法与证据法条文。对比方法：词级与char-4 BM25、零样本稠密编码器、分法（per-law）检索、稠密-稀疏RRF融合。提出DaR流程：由大语言模型将每段叙事拆解为争议法律问题，并为每个问题生成三条检索通道——法条风格改写、法律关键词、候选分类章节。
AI.result: 全语料下，经指令化的Qwen3-Embedding-8B稠密编码器达到MRR@10=0.849，为非拆解系统中最佳。分法评分显示该优势仅来自家事法：仅限证据法条文时同一编码器MRR@10骤降至0.087，与BM25融合后也仅升至0.207。DaR显著改变局面：证据法MRR@10提升至0.696，家事法提升至0.864。
AI.conclusion: 无拆解时两类法律偏好不同检索策略，而采用DaR后同一检索器在两类法律上均取得最佳MRR@10，表明"问题拆解+多通道查询生成"能有效弥合叙事到法律规则的抽象鸿沟，是跨法律门类统一且稳健的检索方案。

title: Jailbreak Connectivity: Towards Diverse, Transferable, and Universal Multimodal Large Language Model Jailbreak
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are vulnerable to visual jailbreak attacks that bypass safety safeguards. Existing methods typically optimize isolated adversarial examples, limiting attack diversity, transferability, and generalization. We propose Jailbreak Connectivity (JC), a framework based on the observation that effective adversarial inputs can be connected through low-loss regions in image space. JC optimizes continuous adversarial paths: path sampling yields diverse jailbreak images, lightweight surrogate classifiers guide cross-model transfer, and a distribution-level objective enables universal attacks across harmful queries. On MM-SafetyBench, JC achieves average attack success rates of 84.01%, 85.77%, and 97.95% on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, InternVL3.5-8B, and Gemma-3-12B-IT, respectively, exceeding the strongest baselines by up to 68.36 percentage points. In black-box evaluations, JC improves attack success rates over FigStep by 24.69 and 27.34 percentage points on GPT-5.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, respectively. These findings reveal structured vulnerabilities in MLLM safety alignment and inform more comprehensive security evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Jailbreak Connectivity（JC）框架，利用图像空间低损失区域可连通有效对抗样本的观察，沿连续对抗路径优化，实现高多样性、可迁移、通用的多模态越狱攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型视觉越狱方法通常孤立优化单个对抗样本，导致攻击多样性、跨模型迁移性和对未见有害查询的泛化性受限。
AI.method: 基于有效对抗输入可通过图像空间低损失区域相互连通的观察，JC 优化连续对抗路径：路径采样产生多样化越狱图像，轻量替代分类器引导跨模型迁移，分布级目标实现跨有害查询的通用攻击。
AI.result: MM-SafetyBench 上对 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct、InternVL3.5-8B、Gemma-3-12B-IT 平均攻击成功率分别为 84.01%、85.77%、97.95%，最高超出最强基线 68.36 个百分点；黑盒评估中对 GPT-5.6 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro 相较 FigStep 分别提升 24.69 与 27.34 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了 MLLM 安全对齐中的结构化脆弱性，可为更全面的安全性评估提供依据。

title: Aligning Misaligned Benchmarks for Single-View Novel View Synthesis
summary: While single-view novel view synthesis methods have been dramatically enhanced recently, how to quantify their performance has yet to be standardized. In this work, we demonstrate that an important factor lies in how each method's own reference frame is aligned with the so-called ground-truth pose. Existing methods often rely on test-time optimization of target poses for this alignment, which inherently is ill-posed due to the complexity of the optimization landscape of camera poses vs render accuracy, leading to methods being evaluated at an arbitrary local optimum. Some recognize this limitation and thus rely on 3D reconstructions of entire scenes using training and test views to align poses, which may be infeasible. In this work, instead, we propose to use traditional 2D-to-2D and 2D-to-3D image matching techniques to align 3D reconstructions. We also evaluate only within co-visible regions, between different views, which is the only place where a `correct' ground truth can be defined. Our evaluations show that with proper coordinate alignment, novel-view synthesis methods that use explicit 3D Gaussians achieve the state of the art, despite being previously reported in the literature to be outperformed by pure image-based 2D methods. We further provide a simple baseline that directly utilizes an off-the-shelf video generator and a feed-forward geometry estimator. Our simple baseline is already comparable to state-of-the-art methods specifically trained for novel-view synthesis, without any task-specific training.

AI.tldr: 本文指出单视图新视角合成（NVS）评测的关键问题在于各方法自身坐标系与"真值位姿"的对齐方式，提出用传统2D-to-2D与2D-to-3D图像匹配对齐3D重建，并仅在视图间共视区域内评测。结果显示在正确坐标对齐下，显式3D Gaussian方法达到SOTA；同时给出一个由现成视频生成器与前馈几何估计器组成的简单基线，无需任务特定训练即可媲美专用SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 单视图NVS方法性能提升显著，但其评测缺乏标准化。核心症结在于评测时如何将各方法自身的参考坐标系与所谓ground-truth位姿对齐：现有做法要么在测试时优化目标位姿，而相机位姿与渲染精度的优化景观复杂使该问题本身是ill-posed的，导致方法被评价在任意的局部最优上；要么依赖用训练+测试视图对整场景做3D重建来对齐位姿，但往往不可行。
AI.method: 避免测试时位姿优化与整场景重建：采用传统2D-to-2D和2D-to-3D图像匹配技术来对齐3D重建；并且只在不同视图间的共视区域（co-visible regions）内评测——这是唯一能定义"正确"真值的地方。此外提出一个直接使用off-the-shelf视频生成器加前馈几何估计器的简单基线。
AI.result: 在正确坐标对齐下，使用显式3D Gaussians的NVS方法达到SOTA，尽管文献此前报道其被纯图像2D方法超越；所提简单基线（现成视频生成器+前馈几何估计器，无任务特定训练）已与专门训练的SOTA NVS方法相当。
AI.conclusion: NVS评测中坐标系对齐是决定性因素，不恰当的对齐会造成方法排序偏差；基于图像匹配的3D重建对齐加共视区域评测可提供更可靠的基准，并显示显式3D Gaussian表示应被重新评估。现成视频生成+前馈几何的免训练基线值得作为强基线。

title: Disparity Laundering: Consensus Without Fairness in Clinical Multi-Agent Systems
comment: 21 pages, 8 figures. Code: https://github.com/wangxiaoyang0412/disparity-laundering . Committed to EACL 2027
summary: Clinical large language models are increasingly fielded as multi-agent teams, on the assumption that deliberation averages out individual error. It does not average out bias. Across a full factorial of five model families and four aggregation topologies on 120 real MIMIC-IV emergency cases under counterfactual demographic swaps, no configuration neutralizes the disparity: all 20 cells commit the direction of their agents' independent answers, giving Black patients more acute triage. Every model has a topology that amplifies its baseline gap, but which one varies by model, so no design is reliably safe or reliably amplifying: the disparity is relocated, never removed. Late-stage fixes fail: fairness instructions and demographic masking leave the gap untouched, and per-agent self-debiasing widens it, because the bias is already encoded in the agents' ordinary clinical numbers. We call this disparity laundering; the audits now applied to clinical AI, per model, per output, per version, can certify the parts but never the committed decision. Interventions close the gap exactly when they make counterfactual versions visible inside the system and pool them, through deliberation, into the committed decision. A diverse-perspective ensemble does both while keeping the team, with no retraining or architectural change: the disparity falls by 67 to 94% where all five perspectives pool at every round, and the one topology that never pools them is the one it cannot reliably repair. Medical multi-agent systems do not filter demographic bias; they launder it into plausible decisions no single-version audit can catch, and the only defense is to make the bias visible.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示临床多智能体LLM系统中的"差异洗白"（disparity laundering）现象：多智能体协作无法通过平均消解人口统计学偏见，反而将其搬运到看似合理的最终决策中，使现有逐模型、逐输出、逐版本的审计失效。唯一有效干预是让反事实版本在系统内部可见并被汇聚进最终决策（如多样化视角集成），可使差异下降67%–94%。
AI.motivation: 临床LLM正被部署为多智能体团队，其隐含假设是"审议（deliberation）能平均掉个体错误"。作者质疑该假设：错误可被平均，偏见不会被平均。现有临床AI审计是"逐模型、逐输出、逐版本"的零件式审计，无法认证由多智能体汇聚而成的承诺性决策，因此需要检验聚合拓扑是否真正消除了人口统计学差异。
AI.method: 采用全因子实验设计：5个模型族 × 4种聚合拓扑 = 20个配置，在120个真实MIMIC-IV急诊病例上施加反事实人口统计学替换（counterfactual demographic swaps），测量分诊急性度差异的方向与幅度。同时检验三类"后期修正"手段：公平性指令、人口统计学遮蔽（masking）、逐智能体自去偏（self-debiasing）。最后提出并评估多样化视角集成方案。
AI.result: 20个配置全部沿袭其智能体独立答案的偏差方向，给黑人患者更急的分诊等级，无一配置能中和差异。每个模型都存在会放大基线差距的拓扑，但放大拓扑因模型而异，因而没有任何设计可被可靠地判定为安全或放大——差异只是被"迁移"而非消除。后期修正全部失败：公平指令与人口统计遮蔽无效，逐智能体自去偏反而扩大差距，因为偏见已编码进智能体常规的临床数值中。多样化视角集成在每轮汇聚全部五个视角时使差异下降67%–94%，且无需重训练或架构改动；唯一不汇聚视角的拓扑则无法被可靠修复。
AI.conclusion: 医疗多智能体系统并不"过滤"人口统计学偏见，而是将其洗白为可信的决策，使单版本审计无法察觉。有效干预的充要条件是：使反事实版本在系统内部可见，并通过审议将其汇聚进承诺性决策。作者主张审计范式应从"零件认证"转向对汇聚决策的可见性保障。

title: TCC-RAG: Temporal Causal Chain-Guided RAG for Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have spurred growing interest in temporal knowledge graph question answering (TKGQA). Most existing methods rely on semantic retrieval augmented generation (RAG), which suffers from fundamental limitations in complex temporal reasoning. On the one hand, semantic-based RAG methods struggle to capture the multi-hop causal knowledge required for complex temporal reasoning. On the other hand, these methods introduce excessive redundant knowledge, trapping LLMs in spurious reasoning chains that potentially result in erroneous answers. To address these problems, we propose a Temporal Causal Chain-guided RAG (TCC-RAG) to retrieve a concise yet sufficient set of causal knowledge to support complex temporal reasoning. Specifically, we reformulate the temporal knowledge graph into a multi-view causal cue graph, with causal cues inducing connections that explicitly encode temporal evolution and causal dynamics. Based on the causal cue graph, we construct a query-specific temporal causal chain to guide the retrieval process, enabling the model to focus on a concise set of causally relevant knowledge. Finally, we introduce a causal evidence filter to refine the retrieved knowledge, ensuring its causal consistency with the underlying temporal logic of the query. Experiments show that TCC-RAG achieves substantial performance gains of 10.72% and 8.40% on two TKGQA benchmarks, and delivers a remarkable 62.97% improvement for multi-step temporal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出Temporal Causal Chain-guided RAG（TCC-RAG），通过将时序知识图谱重构为多视图因果线索图，构建查询特定的时序因果链引导检索，并用因果证据过滤器精炼知识，从而以简洁且充分的因果知识支撑复杂时序推理。
AI.motivation: 现有TKGQA方法多基于语义检索增强生成（RAG），存在两点根本局限：一是难以捕捉复杂时序推理所需的多跳因果知识；二是引入大量冗余知识，使LLM陷入虚假推理链，导致错误答案。
AI.method: 1）将时序知识图谱重构为多视图因果线索图，由因果线索诱导显式编码时序演化与因果动态的连接；2）基于该图构建查询特定的时序因果链，引导检索过程聚焦于简洁的因果相关知识集；3）引入因果证据过滤器对检索知识进行精炼，确保其与查询底层时序逻辑的因果一致性。
AI.result: 在两个TKGQA基准上分别取得10.72%和8.40%的显著性能提升，多步时序推理任务上提升达62.97%。
AI.conclusion: TCC-RAG通过因果链引导的检索与证据过滤，有效缓解语义RAG的多跳因果缺失与知识冗余问题，为复杂时序推理提供了简洁且充分的知识支撑，并显著提升TKGQA性能。

title: TGTV: An Interpretable Framework for UAV Fault Detection and Traceability via Spatiotemporal Graph Learning and Large Language Models
comment: 21 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE Sensors Journal
summary: Fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles experience operating-condition transitions, asynchronous sensor sampling, and control-system compensation that can obscure fault signatures. Existing temporal detection methods have limited capacity to represent coupled faults across subsystems, track their evolution, and constrain language-model diagnoses with quantitative evidence. This paper proposes TGTV, an interpretable fault detection and traceability framework that integrates spatiotemporal graph learning with a large language model. A temporal convolutional network and a graph attention network with weighted fused adjacency extract multiscale temporal patterns and spatial dependencies among sensors. A hybrid temporal Transformer and variational autoencoder then evaluates window-level anomalies using prediction errors and reconstruction probabilities. Continuous-time Shapley attribution identifies critical sensors and high-contribution intervals while preserving the temporal continuity of fault evolution. A structured evidence package combines detection results, graph relationships, temporal attribution, sensor attribution, and operating context. An evidence-constrained diagnosis protocol uses this package to generate flight-level conclusions with traceable evidence identifiers. Cross-flight holdout experiments on the public ALFA fixed-wing flight dataset yield a window-level area under the precision-recall curve of 0.976, accuracy of 0.973, recall of 0.902, and F1 score of 0.920. Flight-level fault diagnosis achieves recall of 0.943 and an F1 score of 0.944. These results demonstrate accurate anomaly detection and quantitatively supported fault-tracing cues, providing a basis for interpretable post-flight fault review and analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出TGTV可解释故障检测与溯源框架，融合时空图学习与大语言模型，在ALFA固定翼飞行数据集上取得窗口级AUPRC 0.976、F1 0.920，飞行级诊断F1 0.944。
AI.motivation: 固定翼无人机存在工况切换、传感器异步采样及控制系统补偿，导致故障特征被掩盖；现有时序检测方法难以表征跨子系统耦合故障、追踪其演化，也难以用定量证据约束语言模型诊断。
AI.method: 时间卷积网络与加权融合邻接的图注意力网络提取多尺度时序模式与传感器空间依赖；混合时序Transformer与变分自编码器基于预测误差与重构概率评估窗口级异常；连续时间Shapley归因识别关键传感器与高贡献区间并保持故障演化时序连续性；构建结构化证据包（检测结果、图关系、时序归因、传感器归因、工况上下文），采用证据约束诊断协议生成带可溯源证据标识的飞行级结论。
AI.result: 跨飞行留出实验（ALFA公共固定翼飞行数据集）：窗口级AUPRC 0.976、准确率0.973、召回率0.902、F1 0.920；飞行级故障诊断召回率0.943、F1 0.944。
AI.conclusion: 方法可实现准确异常检测并提供定量支撑的故障溯源线索，为可解释的飞后故障复核与分析奠定基础。

title: WeVisCut: The Whole Editing Room in One Agent From Narration to Long-Form Video
summary: Producing long-form videos from narration requires interdependent decisions that remain coherent across shots. Existing agentic editors often use multi-stage workflows driven by general models, leaving the quality-cost trade-off of compact, task-adapted policies unclear. We address this gap with WeVisCut, a long-form script-to-video system that connects tool execution with policy learning. Its agent harness maintains shared production state so that tool feedback informs subsequent decisions and repairs. Because finished videos do not expose these decisions, our four-stage data pipeline combines editing inversion with verified replay to turn recovered editing intent into executable supervision. Applied to 3,750 finished videos, this pipeline yields over 130K training examples. We use this supervision to train a single 9B policy that coordinates production and recovers from failures within the same harness. Moreover, we introduce a 100-task benchmark and five metrics assessing editing quality and delivery reliability. Under a shared tool environment, WeVisCut substantially outperforms its base model and achieves comparable performance to Claude Opus 5 while using nearly 33x fewer generated tokens per successful output minute. It also outperforms task-matched native editors on our proposed metrics.

AI.tldr: WeVisCut 是一个长篇「脚本到视频」系统，将工具执行与策略学习结合：以共享生产状态的 agent harness 支撑单模型 9B 策略，并通过编辑反演+验证回放的数据流水线从成品视频中恢复可执行监督，在自建 100 任务基准上以极低 token 成本达到与强通用模型相当的质量。
AI.motivation: 长篇旁白配视频需要跨镜头保持一致的相互依赖决策；现有 agentic 编辑器多用多阶段流程、由通用大模型驱动，紧凑型任务适配策略在质量—成本权衡上的表现尚不清楚，该空白即本文动机。
AI.method: 1) agent harness 维护共享生产状态，使工具反馈能影响后续决策与修复；2) 四阶段数据流水线：编辑反演（editing inversion）+ 验证回放（verified replay），把成品视频还原出的编辑意图转为可执行监督，在 3,750 个成品视频上生成 13 万+ 训练样本；3) 用该监督训练单个 9B 策略，在同一 harness 内协调生产并处理失败恢复；4) 提出 100 任务基准与 5 项评估编辑质量与交付可靠性的指标。
AI.result: 在共享工具环境下，WeVisCut 显著优于其基座模型；与 Claude Opus 5 性能相当，但每成功输出一分钟所需生成 token 少约 33 倍；在自提指标上亦优于任务匹配的原生编辑器。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的、任务适配的单一策略配合共享状态 harness 与从成品视频反演的监督，可在长篇脚本到视频任务中实现质量与成本的良好权衡，为 agentic 视频编辑提供可复用的数据构建与评估范式。

title: Rubricon: Automated Rubric Generation and Refinement for LLM Evaluation and Training
summary: Rubrics enable reward assignment on tasks without verifiable answers, but are expensive to manually produce from scratch. We present Rubricon, a pipeline that generates discriminative rubrics without requiring human preference labels, rubric annotation, or generator-model training. Using any LLM, Rubricon samples multiple rubrics, selects the most discriminative candidate, adds criteria to capture overlooked requirements or response flaws, and prunes criteria that are misaligned or shallow. Alongside LLM self-critique and test-time scaling, Rubricon uses observed criterion pass rates on example model responses to guide refinement. Across five professional, consumer, clinical, and general-use LLM benchmarks, Rubricon produces rubrics whose scores of frontier LLM responses exhibit 9% greater alignment with labor-intensive expert-authored rubrics, compared to the best alternative synthetic rubric generation method among RRD, QSRG, OpenRubrics, and agentic generation via harnesses like Codex. On HealthBench, post-training a Qwen3.5-9B model with Rubricon rubrics yields 4.5% better performance than training with rubrics from the strongest alternative synthetic rubric generator, RRD.

AI.tldr: Rubricon：一种无需人工偏好标注、专家评分规则标注或生成模型训练的判别性评分规则（rubric）自动生成流水线，通过多候选采样、筛选最具判别力的rubric、增补遗漏标准、剪除浅层/错位标准，并以准则通过率反馈指导迭代，在5个基准上生成rubric与专家rubric的对齐度提升9%，用于后训练可使Qwen3.5-9B在HealthBench上优于最强基线RRD 4.5%。
AI.motivation: 人工从零撰写评分规则成本高昂，而评分规则是在无标准答案任务上分配奖励的关键手段；现有合成方法缺少判别力优化，且依赖偏好标签、标注或生成模型训练。
AI.method: Rubricon为免标注流水线：用任意LLM采样多个候选rubric；依据各准则在示例模型回答上的观测通过率（区分度）挑选最具判别力的候选；增补准则以覆盖被忽略的需求或回答缺陷；剪除错位或浅表的准则；结合LLM自我批评与测试时扩展（test-time scaling）迭代精炼。
AI.result: 在覆盖专业、消费、临床与通用用途的五个LLM基准上，Rubricon生成的rubric对前沿模型回答的打分与费时费力的专家rubric之间的对齐度，比RRD、QSRG、OpenRubrics及Codex类agentic生成等最优替代方法高9%；在HealthBench上，用Rubricon rubric对Qwen3.5-9B进行后训练，性能比用最强替代生成器RRD的rubric训练高4.5%。
AI.conclusion: 以准则通过率作为无需标注的判别信号进行rubric迭代精炼是可行且有效的，所得合成rubric在打分对齐与下游后训练两方面均优于现有合成rubric生成方法。

title: Pronunciation-Supervised Text-to-Speech for Irish (Gaeilge)
summary: Speech technology for Irish must be built from very little transcribed speech, yet the language's pronunciation is thoroughly documented in dictionaries and dialect descriptions. We ask whether that documentation can supervise the adaptation of a large pretrained text-to-speech model to a language it was never trained on. We adapt Qwen3-TTS to Irish using 12.8 hours of crowdsourced Common Voice speech, correcting two defects in the vendor fine-tuning script that training loss does not reveal (Appendix A), and reach character error rate (CER) 0.225 on held-out cross-corpus text, against 0.397 for an exhaustively tuned from-scratch system and 0.437 for zero-shot cloning. We then compile the Wiktionary pronunciation record into a lexicon and a phoneme critic, and use that critic as the verifier in one round of rejection fine-tuning: CER 0.159 cross-corpus and 0.067 in-domain, with the voice still anonymous across all 202 training speakers. The same critic explains why the voice cannot yet be steered to a minority dialect: 229 of 12,311 training clips lean Ulster against 8,451 Munster. Pronunciation documentation, converted into a verifier, is a practical lever for low-resource speech synthesis, and a way to measure what the available data cannot support.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究能否用词典与方言描述中的发音记录来监督大型预训练TTS模型对爱尔兰语的适应。作者用12.8小时众包Common Voice语音微调Qwen3-TTS，并修复其微调脚本中训练损失无法暴露的两个缺陷，跨语料CER达0.225（从零训练系统0.397，零样本克隆0.437）；再将Wiktionary发音记录编译为词典与音素评判器，用于一轮拒绝式微调，跨语料CER降至0.159、域内0.067，且202位说话人音色保持匿名。同一评判器也说明为何无法将音色导向少数方言：训练集12,311条中Ulster仅229条而Munster有8,451条。
AI.motivation: 爱尔兰语可用转写语音极少，难以从头构建语音合成系统；但该语言的发音在词典和方言描述中有详尽记录。作者希望验证这类文档资源能否作为监督信号，把从未见过爱尔兰语的大型预训练TTS模型有效适配到该语言，并借此衡量现有数据能支持与不能支持的能力边界。
AI.method: 以Qwen3-TTS为基座，使用12.8小时众包Common Voice爱尔兰语语音进行微调，并修正厂商微调脚本中训练损失无法揭示的两个缺陷（附录A）。随后将Wiktionary发音记录编译为发音词典和一个音素评判器，把该评判器作为验证器，执行一轮拒绝式微调（rejection fine-tuning）。
AI.result: 跨语料留出文本上CER为0.225，优于充分调参的从零训练系统（0.397）和零样本音色克隆（0.437）；加入评判器拒绝式微调后，跨语料CER为0.159、域内CER为0.067，且在全部202位训练说话人上音色仍保持匿名。同一评判器揭示方言引导失败的原因：12,311条训练音频中仅229条偏向Ulster，而Munster有8,451条，数据分布严重失衡。
AI.conclusion: 将发音文档转化为可用的验证器，是低资源语音合成的一种实用增强手段；同时该验证器也能量化现有数据无法支撑的能力（如少数方言的音色引导），从而为低资源TTS的数据与资源评估提供可操作的诊断工具。

title: A Separation Principle for Adversarial Attacks and Defense of Graph Neural Networks
summary: Adversarial attacks on graph neural networks (GNNs) have been studied as a model-centric optimization problem driven by gradients, learned policies, or meta-learning, with the graph treated as a passive substrate. This view overlooks a defining feature of GNNs: their predictions are produced by structured message passing along the graph, so their adversarial vulnerabilities are encoded as much in the geometry of the graph as in the learned weights. We develop a structure-driven framework for feature attacks in which the attack is derived from the spectral properties of the normalized adjacency operator. Its central result is a separation principle: under a natural relaxation of the attack objective, the optimal feature perturbation is rank one and factorizes into a graph-dependent component (degree-proportional spatial allocation, depending only on the graph) and a weight-dependent component (top singular vector of the composed weights, depending only on the weights). Node degree thus emerges as the fundamental graph quantity governing adversarial vulnerability to feature perturbations. The resulting attack, which we call SepAttack, requires no gradient computation, carries analytical guarantees, achieves competitive or superior performance against established baselines such as Nettack and IG-Attack with up to ${\sim}70\times$ speedup in the targeted setting, and transfers near-perfectly across architectures on continuous-feature graphs because its graph-dependent component is architecture-invariant by construction. We further derive a separation-principle adversarial training procedure (SepAT) directly from the closed-form worst-case attack and report robustness gains on binary-feature benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出结构驱动的GNN特征攻击框架：在攻击目标的一个自然松弛下，最优特征扰动为秩一矩阵，可分解为仅依赖图结构的度比例分量与仅依赖权重的顶奇异向量分量，由此得到无需梯度的SepAttack及相应的对抗训练SepAT。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN对抗攻击（梯度、强化学习策略、元学习）将图视为被动载体，忽视了GNN经图结构消息传递产生预测这一本质特征，因而漏洞同时编码在图几何与学习权重中。作者希望从归一化邻接算子的谱性质出发刻画特征攻击。
AI.method: 以归一化邻接算子的谱性质推导攻击；在攻击目标的自然松弛下证明"分离原理"：最优特征扰动为秩一，分解为图相关分量（度比例的空间分配）与权重相关分量（复合权重的顶奇异向量）。据此构造无梯度的SepAttack，并从闭式最坏情况攻击直接导出对抗训练流程SepAT。
AI.result: SepAttack无需梯度计算且具解析保证，在定向攻击设定下相较Nettack、IG-Attack等基线性能相当或更优，加速最高约70倍；由于图相关分量按构造具有架构不变性，在连续特征图上跨架构迁移近乎完美。SepAT在二值特征基准上报告了鲁棒性提升。
AI.conclusion: 节点度是支配特征扰动对抗脆弱性的核心图量；攻击的可分离结构既带来效率与迁移优势，也为对抗训练提供闭式理论依据，提示应把图几何纳入GNN鲁棒性分析。

title: Volley3D: Unified 3D Full-Sequence Reconstruction from Monocular Broadcasts
comment: 8 pages + 10 pages of supplementary. Videos available on the project webpage: noambsf.github.io/Volley3D
summary: 3D reconstruction from single-view sports broadcast is a pivotal capability for automated analytics and immersive AR/VR replays, yet notoriously ill-posed due to difficult-to-calibrate moving cameras and depth ambiguity. Unlike widely studied racket sports, team sports such as volleyball feature unpredictable multi-contact sequences and high altitude jumps. These dynamics categorically invalidate the standard planar projection assumptions relied upon by existing methods. To resolve these limitations without 3D training supervision, we propose a complete, physics-grounded pipeline tailored to monocular broadcast volleyball. First, we include a correction module to the perspective drift induced by ground-plane projection by coupling temporal jump spotting with Newtonian interpolation for 3D player placement. Second, for 3D ball trajectory estimation, we design a dedicated sub-trajectory segmentation architecture alongside a collision-matching algorithm. By anchoring physical equations to reconstructed 3D hand vertices, we lift noisy ball 2D detections into a spatiotemporally coherent 3D scene. Evaluations on multi-camera benchmarks demonstrate our approach significantly reduces 3D spatial drift compared to 2D-reprojection baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向单目排球转播视频、无需3D训练监督的物理驱动3D重建流水线：通过牛顿插值修正地平面投影的透视漂移、结合子轨迹分割与碰撞匹配恢复3D球轨迹，在多人接触、高跳等非法平面假设场景下显著降低3D空间漂移。
AI.motivation: 单视角体育转播的3D重建对自动分析及沉浸式AR/VR回放至关重要，但移动相机标定困难与深度歧义使其高度病态。现有方法多针对发球类运动并依赖平面投影假设，而排球等团队运动存在不可预测的多次接触序列与高海拔跳跃，从根本上使这些假设失效。
AI.method: 在无3D训练监督下构建物理驱动的完整流水线：(1) 加入修正模块，通过时间维度跳跃检测与牛顿插值耦合，纠正地平面投影引起的透视漂移，实现3D球员定位；(2) 针对3D球轨迹估计设计专用子轨迹分割架构与碰撞匹配算法，将物理方程锚定于重建的3D手部顶点，把含噪的2D球检测提升为时空一致的三维场景。
AI.result: 在多相机基准上的评估表明，相较2D重投影基线，本方法显著降低了3D空间漂移。
AI.conclusion: 面向单目排球转播的物理锚定重建可有效克服平面假设失效问题，无需3D监督即可获得时空连贯的球员与球的三维表示，为团队运动的自动分析与沉浸式回放提供可行路径。

title: FACTS-MAS: A Multi-Agent Architecture for Adaptive Forecasting from Heterogeneous Evidence
summary: Real-world forecasting often requires integrating heterogeneous evidence whose predictive value varies across horizons, operating regimes, and domains. We introduce FACTS-MAS, a domain-agnostic multi-agent forecasting framework that decomposes evidence into specialized channels for temporal dynamics, exogenous context, seasonality, structural information, and discrete events. Each agent generates an independently testable forecast through a common interface, while leakage-safe historical validation measures its predictive skill relative to a naive reference. These skill estimates are used to weight and combine agent forecasts, so that uninformative evidence is either removed or downweighted rather than forced to participate. A calibration procedure selects domain-specific constant means based on historical validation folds. We evaluate FACTS-MAS on weekly for-sale housing inventory from Zillow and weekly unemployment insurance claims from FRED, for 15 U.S. metropolitan areas at 4-, 8-, and 13-week forecasting horizons. Our method outperforms both a naive last-value forecast method and the TimesFM foundation model. However, a factor-adjusted exponential smoothing model performs as well as the fused forecast. The evidence therefore supports FACTS-MAS as a systematic protocol for testing, calibrating, and recomposing evidence channels before assembling them into the strongest single model for a specific application domain. Code, data, and results are available at https://github.com/Madumita24/FACTS-MAS.

AI.tldr: FACTS-MAS是一个领域无关的多智能体预测框架，将证据分解为五个专业通道，各自独立生成可检验的预测，并基于防泄漏的历史验证得到技能权重进行加权融合；在Zillow房源库存与FRED失业金申请数据上优于naive与TimesFM，但与因子调整指数平滑相当。
AI.motivation: 现实预测需整合异构证据，而证据的预测价值随预测步长、运行状态与领域而变；因此需要一种能评估、取舍证据通道而非强制融合的系统化方法。
AI.method: 提出FACTS-MAS框架：将证据分解为时序动态、外生上下文、季节性、结构信息与离散事件五个专门通道；每个智能体通过统一接口输出可独立检验的预测，并用防泄漏的历史验证相对naive基准度量其预测技能；以技能估计对智能体预测加权组合，使无信息证据被剔除或降权；再用校准程序基于历史验证折选择领域特定的常数均值。
AI.result: 在Zillow周度在售住房库存与FRED周度失业保险申领数据（15个美国大都市区，4/8/13周预测步长）上，FACTS-MAS优于naive最后值法和TimesFM基础模型；但因子调整指数平滑模型与融合预测表现相当。
AI.conclusion: FACTS-MAS更适合作为在组合成特定领域最强单一模型之前，对证据通道进行系统化检验、校准与重构的协议，而非必然更优的融合方案。

title: LLMs as Judges and Examinees for Medical Item Difficulty Prediction
summary: Predicting medical item difficulty from item text alone remains challenging. Prior work has largely relied on linguistic features or text representations derived from general-purpose and domain-specific language models, but predictive performance has remained modest. This study takes a different approach by using difficulty-related signals that emerge when open-weight large language models (LLMs) interact with test items. Using USMLE and PANCE medical licensure examination items, we examined LLMs in two roles. As judges, the models provided absolute difficulty ratings and pairwise difficulty comparisons. As simulated examinees, they generated response-based signals including correctness, keyed-option probability, response entropy, and the probability margin between the top two options. We then combined the strongest judgment and response signals with baseline item features in downstream prediction models. Pairwise difficulty judgment was the most consistent individual LLM signal across both datasets, while simulated-examinee signals and absolute judgments provided complementary information in some feature combinations. The best configurations reached a Spearman correlation of $ρ$ = .447 on USMLE, exceeding the best system in the 2024 BEA shared task ($ρ$ = .25), and $ρ$ = .494 on PANCE. These results were comparable to direct absolute judgments from the proprietary frontier model Claude Opus 5 ($ρ$ = .443 and .488, respectively). Overall, judgment and response signals from open-weight LLMs captured difficulty-related information beyond text representations. Because these models can be deployed locally, the approach offers a practical option for predicting the difficulty of unreleased or high-security test items.

AI.tldr: 利用开源权重LLM与试题交互时产生的"判断信号"（绝对难度评分、配对难度比较）和"模拟考生信号"（正确率、选项概率、响应熵、Top-2概率间隔），结合基线文本特征预测医学试题难度。
AI.motivation: 仅凭题目文本预测医学试题难度仍然困难；已有工作依赖语言特征或通用/领域语言模型的文本表征，预测性能有限（如2024 BEA共享任务最佳系统仅ρ=.25）。作者希望挖掘文本表征之外的难度相关信息。
AI.method: 使用USMLE与PANCE医学执照考试题目，将开源权重LLM置于两种角色：(1)作为评判者，给出绝对难度评分与配对难度比较；(2)作为模拟考生，生成正确性、正确答案选项概率、响应熵、前两选项概率间隔等响应信号。随后将最强的判断信号、响应信号与基线题目特征结合，输入下游预测模型。
AI.result: 配对难度判断在两数据集上是最稳定的单一LLM信号；模拟考生信号与绝对判断在某些特征组合中提供互补信息。最佳配置在USMLE上达到Spearman ρ=.447（超过BEA 2024最佳系统的ρ=.25），在PANCE上ρ=.494，与专有前沿模型Claude Opus 5的直接绝对判断（ρ=.443与.488）相当。
AI.conclusion: 开源权重LLM的判断与响应信号能捕获文本表征之外的难度相关信息；由于可本地部署，该方法为预测未发布或高保密试题的难度提供了实用方案。

title: Estimating Implicit Expected Log Density Ratios
summary: When exact probabilities cannot be computed, \emph{density ratio estimation (DRE)} is a key subroutine in the wide range of applications where density ratios appear, from experimental design to generative modelling and reinforcement learning. In this paper, we introduce the concept of an \emph{expected log density ratio (ELDR)}: log density ratios that are integrated under some third, possibly distinct measure. We show many problems with implicit densities where DRE is naïvely used are actually ELDR estimation tasks, and prove fundamental limitations on finite-sample ELDR estimation. Based on these results, we argue that the typical DRE-based approaches are unsuitable for ELDR estimation, and provide some foundational motivation towards bespoke ELDR estimators. To demonstrate, we propose a simple modification to some DRE methods that allows samples convergent to the integral distribution to appear in training data. We show through benchmarks that this can improve ELDR estimation error.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"期望对数密度比"(ELDR)概念——在第三种（可能不同的）测度下积分的对数密度比，指出许多隐式密度问题中被误用为密度比估计(DRE)的任务实为ELDR估计，证明了有限样本下ELDR估计的根本性限制，并给出改进DRE方法的简单修改以提升ELDR估计精度。
AI.motivation: 当精确概率不可计算时，DRE是实验设计、生成建模、强化学习等大量应用的关键子程序。作者发现许多隐式密度场景中直接套用DRE的做法存在错配：真正的目标是带第三测度积分的对数密度比，而非逐点的密度比，因此需要厘清二者的差异及其理论界限。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义ELDR，即log密度比在第三、可能不同的测度下的积分；2) 论证若干隐式密度问题本质上是ELDR估计任务；3) 给出有限样本ELDR估计的基本不可能/限制性结论；4) 据此说明基于DRE的典型方法不适用于ELDR；5) 提出对部分DRE方法的简单修改，使收敛到积分分布的样本可出现在训练数据中。
AI.result: 理论层面证明了有限样本ELDR估计的根本限制，说明常规DRE方法在ELDR任务上的不适用性；实验层面通过基准测试表明，所提的DRE简单修改能降低ELDR估计误差。
AI.conclusion: ELDR是与DRE不同且更契合多类隐式密度问题的估计目标；由于理论上存在根本限制，需发展专门的ELDR估计器。所提出的训练数据分布修改作为基础性动机与初步方案，可有效改善ELDR估计误差，为后续定制化估计器设计提供方向。

title: SparseTokenGS: Gaussian-based Sparse-View CBCT Reconstruction via Reusable Token Pool
comment: 10 pages, 12 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging
summary: Sparse-view cone-beam computed tomography is widely used for fast, low-dose volumetric imaging and lesion localization in dentistry and image-guided interventions, but it introduces severe artifacts. Feed-forward Gaussian methods transfer the reconstruction cost to training and decode each coordinate from projection-aligned features and neighboring anchors. However, information from the whole scan is written only when the field is constructed and cannot be retrieved during coordinate decoding, leaving the volume inconsistent within the scan. This is a common limitation of such methods: once the field is fixed, decoding uses only local features and reconstruction quality drops substantially. We propose SparseTokenGS, a Gaussian-based method for sparse-view cone-beam computed tomography reconstruction via a reusable token pool. Anchor Token Fusion and Point-Token Attention query this shared pool at the anchors and at the query coordinates, respectively. The local Gaussian prior is retained, and the volume is reconstructed in one forward pass, without per-scan optimization or a projection-domain loss. On three public chest and dental datasets, SparseTokenGS achieves the highest reconstruction performance among the compared methods. On clinical dental scans, reconstruction from only six projections reaches 29.51 decibels in peak signal-to-noise ratio and a structural similarity of 0.842 against the full-view reference, and off-the-shelf tooth-and-pulp segmentation keeps these structures separable for root-canal localization. Experiments on volcanic rock and chicken show performance after same-object adaptation. A reusable token pool gives feed-forward reconstruction a mechanism that keeps scan-wide context available through decoding and can benefit future rapid clinical lesion localization and analysis. The code is available at: https://github.com/FrankDengAI/SparseTokenGS.

AI.tldr: 提出 SparseTokenGS：用可复用 token 池（Anchor Token Fusion 与 Point-Token Attention）在解码阶段保留全扫描上下文，实现稀疏视角 CBCT 的一次前向高斯重建，临床牙科 6 视角达 PSNR 29.51 dB、SSIM 0.842。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角锥束 CT 有严重伪影；前馈高斯方法把重建代价前移到训练，但全扫描信息仅在构建场时写入，坐标解码时只能访问局部特征与相邻锚点，无法回取扫描级上下文，导致同一扫描内部体数据不一致、重建质量明显下降。这是该类方法的共性缺陷：场一旦固定，解码只剩局部特征。
AI.method: 提出基于可复用 token 池的高斯方法 SparseTokenGS。Anchor Token Fusion 在锚点处查询共享池，Point-Token Attention 在查询坐标处查询同一共享池，使扫描级上下文在解码过程中持续可用；保留局部高斯先验，单次前向完成体数据重建，无需逐扫描优化，也不需要投影域损失。
AI.result: 在三个公开胸部与牙科数据集上取得对比方法中最优重建性能；临床牙科扫描仅用 6 个投影即达 PSNR 29.51 dB、SSIM 0.842（相对全视角参考）；现成的牙齿-牙髓分割仍能保持结构可分，支持根管定位。火山岩与鸡肉实验在同物体适配后同样有效。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 可复用 token 池为前馈重建提供了在解码中保持扫描级上下文的机制，弥补了固定高斯场的局部性限制，有望服务于快速临床病灶定位与分析。

title: Verification-Guided Retrosynthesis: Reaction Feedback and Evidence Timing
summary: Retrosynthesis planning seeks synthesis routes from purchasable starting materials to a target molecule. Search over predicted reactions can connect a target to available materials, yet an infeasible reaction can invalidate the resulting route. Evaluating route quality only after search has finished cannot correct errors made during search. We introduce Verification-Guided Reflow (VGR), incorporating reaction verification as a decision action in AND/OR search. Verification results are represented as binary verdicts; queries are scheduled from the search structure, and acquired verdicts exclude reactions or adjust search priorities. We define verified solvability as the fraction of targets for which a complete route accepted stepwise by the verifier is found. On Retro190, feeding verification results into search increases verified solvability from 51.1% to 62.6% relative to route evaluation without feedback. Further controlled experiments show that earlier verification and immediate prioritization of accepted reactions each improve route discovery, yet combining them performs worse than either change alone. We therefore propose early pruning and delayed guidance: rejected reactions are pruned immediately, while accepted reactions gain search priority when processed as part of a complete candidate route. In a separate comparison with the verification scheduling rule fixed, this strategy increases verified solvability from 61.1% with immediate guidance to 71.1%, using fewer proposal calls and unique verifier queries.

AI.tldr: 提出Verification-Guided Reflow (VGR)，将反应验证作为AND/OR搜索中的决策动作，并采用"早期剪枝+延迟引导"策略，在Retro190上把已验证可解率从51.1%提升到71.1%。
AI.motivation: 逆合成搜索依赖预测反应连接目标与可购原料，但不可行反应会使路线失效；仅在搜索结束后评估路线质量无法纠正搜索过程中的错误，因此需要把验证反馈引入搜索过程本身。
AI.method: 将反应验证作为AND/OR搜索中的决策动作：验证结果为二值判定，查询由搜索结构调度，所得判定用于排除反应或调整搜索优先级。定义"已验证可解率"（找到被验证器逐步接受完整路线的目标比例）。控制实验对比早期验证与立即优先化，并提出早期剪枝（拒绝反应立即剪枝）与延迟引导（接受反应在作为完整候选路线一部分被处理时才获得优先级）的组合策略。
AI.result: Retro190上，将验证结果反馈到搜索使已验证可解率从51.1%提升至62.6%；早期验证与立即优先化各自有效，但二者结合反而劣于任一单独改动；在固定验证调度规则下，"早期剪枝+延迟引导"策略把已验证可解率从61.1%（立即引导）提升到71.1%，且使用更少的提议调用和唯一验证查询。
AI.conclusion: 验证反馈应选择性地作用于搜索：对拒绝反应即时剪枝、对接受反应延迟引导，比直接即时引导更有效，能在降低验证与提议开销的同时显著提高已验证可解率。

title: Holistic Diversity Management in LLM-Guided Evolutionary Search
summary: LLM-guided evolutionary search iteratively selects existing programs, uses LLMs as mutation operators to generate a new program, and evaluates it to guide subsequent search. To preserve diversity and reduce the risk of premature convergence, it often adopts the island model, in which groups of programs, called islands, evolve separately. However, this structure alone does not guarantee distinct search directions, as islands may start from similar programs or converge toward similar solutions during evolution. This suggests that diversity must be considered throughout the search process, from initializing islands with distinct programs to developing island trajectories and sharing discoveries across islands. To this end, we propose HoliDivEvolve , a holistic approach to establishing and effectively utilizing island diversity throughout evolutionary search. Specifically, we introduce diverse initialization to establish different initial programs, trajectory adaptive island selection to allocate computation based on current score, recent growth, and the remaining search budget, and growth adaptive migration to share alternative ideas across islands. Experiments across diverse benchmarks show that HoliDivEvolve achieves competitive performance on most evaluated tasks. We further conduct controlled analyses to examine how our design choices affect search behavior and final performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HoliDivEvolve，一种在整个进化搜索过程中建立并利用岛屿多样性的整体方法，包含多样化初始化、轨迹自适应岛屿选择与增长自适应迁移三个组件，在多个基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: LLM 引导的进化搜索常采用岛屿模型以保持多样性、降低早熟收敛风险，但仅靠该结构无法保证搜索方向彼此不同——岛屿可能从相似程序出发或在演化中趋同。因此多样性需贯穿搜索全过程：从岛屿初始化的差异、岛屿轨迹的发展到跨岛发现共享。
AI.method: HoliDivEvolve 由三个机制构成：(1) 多样化初始化，建立彼此不同的初始程序；(2) 轨迹自适应岛屿选择，依据当前得分、近期增长与剩余搜索预算分配计算资源；(3) 增长自适应迁移，在岛屿间共享替代性思路。
AI.result: 在多样化基准上的实验表明，HoliDivEvolve 在多数评测任务上取得有竞争力的性能；作者进一步通过受控分析考察各设计选择对搜索行为与最终性能的影响。
AI.conclusion: 岛屿多样性需作为贯穿初始化、资源分配与迁移的整体设计问题来处理；HoliDivEvolve 验证了这种整体式多样性管理在 LLM 引导进化搜索中的有效性。

title: MASS: Multi-mask Selective Self-Distillation for Leakage-Resilient Reasoning
summary: On-policy self-distillation enables the same model to act as student and teacher, with dense token-level supervision obtained by the teacher being given access to privileged information. However, conditioning the teacher on a single reference can concentrate its predictions on one reasoning trajectory and limit transfer to the student. We propose Multi-Mask Selective Self-Distillation (MASS), which approximates the unavailable marginal over diverse reference realizations using multiple independently masked views of one verified solution. MASS aggregates these complementary teacher predictions, selectively transfers reliable token-level corrections, and adaptively focuses masking on influential reference spans. Across mathematical reasoning benchmarks and model families, MASS consistently outperforms strong self-distillation baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出MASS（Multi-Mask Selective Self-Distillation），通过对已验证解进行多视角独立掩码近似"多样参考实现上的边缘分布"，聚合并选择性迁移可靠的token级教师修正、自适应聚焦高影响掩码区间，在数学推理基准与多个模型族上稳定优于强自蒸馏基线。
AI.motivation: On-policy自蒸馏中，同一模型兼任学生与教师，教师可访问特权信息从而提供稠密的token级监督。但教师仅以单一参考为条件时，预测会坍缩到某一条推理轨迹上，限制向学生的迁移；而真正理想的监督应是对多样参考实现的边缘分布，该分布实际不可得。
AI.method: MASS用同一已验证解的多份独立掩码视图来近似不可得的边缘分布：聚合这些互补的教师预测，只选择性迁移可靠的token级修正，并自适应地把掩码集中在有影响力的参考片段上。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准与多个模型族上，MASS一致优于强自蒸馏基线。
AI.conclusion: 多视图掩码近似边缘分布可缓解单参考条件导致的轨迹集中问题，配合选择性蒸馏与自适应掩码，是一种有效且通用的on-policy自蒸馏改进方案。

title: Visually Irrelevant Hallucinations in Medical Vision-Language Models
summary: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) show strong performance in radiology report generation (RRG) and medical visual question answering (Med-VQA), producing free-form clinical descriptions and answers from medical images. However, they may generate clinically meaningful statements that lack visual evidence or contradict image content. We refer to these errors as visually irrelevant hallucinations and investigate them at the phrase level. We propose CLEAR (Counterfactual Localized Evaluation of Alignment and Response), a model-agnostic post-hoc framework for phrase-level hallucination risk estimation. CLEAR decomposes generated responses into visually assessable clinical phrases. For each phrase, phrase-conditioned grounding identifies a candidate visual region, which is selectively perturbed by a localized counterfactual intervention. CLEAR characterizes the intervention using two complementary auditing cues: response cues, capturing semantic and clinically meaningful changes in the generated response, and alignment cues, measuring changes in image-phrase compatibility. These cues are normalized and jointly modeled to estimate phrase-level hallucination risk. Across four datasets spanning RRG and Med-VQA, CLEAR outperforms state-of-the-art hallucination detection baselines across multiple medical and general-purpose VLMs. On MIMIC-CXR, CLEAR improves AUPRC from 85.10% to 90.23%. Its effectiveness is further validated on a GT-derived controlled VIH benchmark. These results establish visually irrelevant hallucination as an important fine-grained reliability failure mode in medical VLMs and demonstrate the value of model-agnostic visual-support auditing for more trustworthy multimodal clinical generation.

AI.tldr: 提出模型无关的事后框架CLEAR，在短语级别估计医学视觉语言模型"视觉无关幻觉"风险，通过短语条件定位的局部反事实扰动与双线索（响应、对齐）联合建模实现检测。
AI.motivation: 医学VLM在放射报告生成与医学VQA中表现优异，但会产生"看似临床有意义却缺乏视觉证据或与图像矛盾"的输出，作者将其定义为视觉无关幻觉（visually irrelevant hallucinations），现有方法缺乏对此类错误的细粒度（短语级）、模型无关的检测手段。
AI.method: CLEAR为模型无关的事后框架：(1) 将生成回答分解为可视觉评估的临床短语；(2) 对每个短语做短语条件grounding定位候选视觉区域，并施加局部反事实扰动；(3) 提取两类审计线索——响应线索（生成响应中语义与临床意义的改变）与对齐线索（图文-短语兼容性变化）；(4) 归一化后联合建模，输出短语级幻觉风险分数。
AI.result: 在覆盖RRG与Med-VQA的四个数据集上，跨多种医学与通用VLM，CLEAR均优于SOTA幻觉检测基线；MIMIC-CXR上AUPRC由85.10%提升至90.23%；并在基于GT构建的受控VIH基准上进一步验证有效。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉无关幻觉确立为医学VLM一种重要的细粒度可靠性失效模式，证明了模型无关的视觉支撑审计对更可信的多模态临床生成具有价值。

title: Inner-Learning: From Hand-Coded Beliefs to Declarative Knowledge in Trick-Taking Games
summary: We present a declarative approach to belief-state modeling in trick-taking card games. Starting from a state-of-the-art Skat player, we automatically extract its hand-coded inference rules into a domain-specific language built on the primitive $\neg\mathsf{holds}(P,C)$, denoting that player $P$ cannot hold any card in set $C$. Round-trip code generation verifies that the extracted rules reproduce the original engine's intended behavior, up to three audited bugs in the original that the declarative engine corrects. We then grow the rule base through symmetric derivation and annotation of an expert strategy document---unifying code, symmetry, and expertise in one representation. We extend the knowledge representation with \emph{cardinality constraints}: at-most-$k$ and at-least-$k$ bounds on the cards a player holds from a named group, expressed in the same declarative language and enforced at world-generation time. Confidence parameters connect symbolic rules to probabilistic belief updates. Self-play evaluation shows the declarative engine measurably improving winning percentage and score over the original hand-coded engine, with the extracted rules, the human-annotated rules, and the cardinality constraints each contributing to the effect.

AI.tldr: 本文将Skat（一种诈叫类纸牌游戏）的信念状态建模改写为声明式方法：以基本谓词¬holds(P,C)构建DSL，从现有引擎自动抽取手写推理规则，经往返代码生成验证（并修正了原引擎三处已审计的bug），再通过对称推导与专家策略文档标注扩充规则库，加入基数约束（至多/至少k张）并在世界生成时执行，用置信度参数连接符号规则与概率信念更新；自对弈显示声明式引擎的胜率与得分均有可测提升。
AI.motivation: 传统trick-taking类纸牌游戏的信念状态推理规则多为手工硬编码，规则分散、难以验证、不易扩展，且符号知识与概率信念更新缺少统一表示；作者希望以声明式方式统一代码、对称性与专家知识，从而提升推理引擎的性能与可维护性。
AI.method: 1) 定义基于原始谓词¬holds(P,C)（玩家P不可能持有集合C中任意牌）的领域特定语言；2) 从state-of-the-art Skat引擎自动抽取其手写推理规则，并通过往返代码生成验证抽取规则复现原有行为（仅三处经审计的原引擎bug被修正）；3) 通过对称推导和对专家策略文档的标注扩充规则库；4) 引入基数约束（对命名牌组"至多k张/至少k张"），以同一声明式语言表达并在世界生成阶段强制执行；5) 用置信度参数将符号规则与概率信念更新相连；6) 通过自对弈评估各组成部分的贡献。
AI.result: 往返验证证明抽取规则可复现原引擎的预期行为，并纠正了三处已审计bug；自对弈实验表明声明式引擎在胜率和得分上均显著优于原始手写引擎，且抽取规则、人工标注规则和基数约束三部分均有独立贡献。
AI.conclusion: 声明式DSL能够将代码、对称性与专家知识统一于单一表示，配合基数约束与置信度参数有效改进Skat信念状态建模与决策性能，为其他不完全信息纸牌游戏的规则抽取与知识工程提供了可推广范式。

title: Deeper Backpropagation or More Updates? Training Looped Language Models Across Budgets
summary: Repeating transformer layers can improve language model performance without adding parameters. However, the added computational depth increases both forward and backward computation costs during training. Training such models requires choosing a backward window that controls how many final layer repetitions retain gradients during backpropagation. Longer windows improve per-token learning efficiency but increase per-update cost, while shorter windows reduce per-update cost but sacrifice per-token efficiency. Understanding which window performs better requires examining different training budgets. Prior work compares backward windows across computational budgets. When training budgets increase, it remains unclear whether the same window continues to perform best. We measure how the relative performance of two windows shifts as training budgets grow. Our method isolates per-token efficiency by training both windows on identical data, and compares complete training recipes at approximately equal training time at each budget. Results show that shorter windows lose much of their advantage as budgets grow. Controlled experiments show that both benefits decrease at larger budgets, with a greater decline in the benefit of extended training. Backward window comparisons depend on the available budget, and the preferred window among the tested candidates can change as the budget grows.

AI.tldr: 重复Transformer层可在不增加参数的情况下提升性能，但训练时需选择反向窗口；实验表明较短窗口的优势随训练预算增大而明显衰减，最优窗口会随预算变化。
AI.motivation: 重复层增加的计算深度抬高了训练的前向与反向开销，需用反向窗口控制保留梯度的层重复数。长窗口提升单token学习效率但增加单次更新成本，短窗口反之。已有工作仅比较同一预算下的窗口，预算增大后最优窗口是否改变尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在相同数据上分别训练两种窗口以隔离单token效率，并在各预算下以约等训练时间比较完整训练配方；进一步用受控实验分解两种窗口的收益来源。
AI.result: 随预算增长，较短窗口的大部分优势消失；两种收益在大预算下均下降，其中延长训练带来的收益下降更明显。
AI.conclusion: 反向窗口比较依赖可用预算，所测候选中最优窗口会随预算增长而改变，因此窗口选择应结合具体训练预算而非固定采用短窗口。

title: Floor It, Then Fill It: Simulating Creator Ecosystems for Fair Video-Content Recommendation Systems at Billion User Scale
summary: Engagement-optimized content recommendation systems exhibit a well-documented rich-get-richer dynamic that structurally disadvantages emerging creators on large-scale platforms. Evaluating debiasing interventions at scale demands faithful simulation of creator-viewer ecosystems, yet the fidelity, diversity, and validity of such simulators remain underexplored. We present a grounded user-simulation framework that models a heterogeneous population of ${\sim}42$K creators and their coupled viewer interactions over 12~weeks, and use it to evaluate equitable view-allocation policies formulated as a budgeted multi-armed bandit (MAB). The simulator captures three behavioral dimensions: (i)~\textbf{creator diversity}, modeled via a clustering approach grounded in real platform creator-level distributions; (ii)~\textbf{behavioral fidelity}, captured through coupled creator-content state machines that represent growth trajectories, engagement accumulation, and graduation dynamics; and (iii)~\textbf{population-level validity}, measured by calibration against observed platform metrics. We evaluate simulative-configurations that vary content-viewership target definitions, reward functions, and a small-creator reserve lever to maximize creator-content recommendation equity. A floor-protected per content-view-target with a view-parity-gap reward guarantees 90\% of view targets being met by creators every week, grows small-creator organic reach ${\sim}{+}33\%$ per week, and achieves high distribution stability (set of creators with funded-views Jaccard $= 0.819$). We analyze the Sim2Real gap and propose validation protocols, contributing evidence for when simulation-derived fairness conclusions can be trusted.

AI.tldr: 提出一个"接地"的用户模拟框架，对约4.2万创作者与观看者耦合交互进行12周仿真，并以预算化多臂老虎机(formulated as budgeted MAB)评估公平分配观看量的政策；实验表明带下限保护的内容-观看目标+观看均衡差距(view-parity-gap)奖励可使90%创作者每周达成观看目标、小创作者自然触达每周增长约33%、分配稳定性Jaccard=0.819。
AI.motivation: 参与度优化的推荐系统存在"富者愈富"动态，结构性不利于新兴创作者。大规模评估去偏干预需要高保真的创作者-观看者生态模拟器，但此类模拟器的保真度、多样性与有效性尚缺乏系统检验。
AI.method: 构建接地(grounded)用户模拟框架，建模约42K异质创作者与观看者耦合交互，时长12周；三维度建模：(i) 创作者多样性——基于真实平台创作者级分布的聚类方法；(ii) 行为保真——耦合的创作者-内容状态机，刻画成长轨迹、互动累积与"毕业"动态；(iii) 群体有效性——对平台观测指标进行校准。将公平观看分配政策形式化为预算化多臂老虎机，并扫描不同内容观看目标定义、奖励函数与小创作者预留杠杆等配置。
AI.result: "下限保护的内容级观看目标 + 观看均衡差距奖励"配置下：90%创作者每周达成观看目标；小创作者自然触达每周约+33%；高分配稳定性（获得资助观看的创作者集合Jaccard=0.819）。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一套可校准、可评估公平政策的创作者-观看者模拟框架，并通过对Sim2Real差距的分析提出验证协议，为判断"何时可信任由仿真得出的公平性结论"提供证据。

title: Structure-retained low-rank adapters for weather synthesis
summary: Real-world deployment of computer vision models, particularly in outdoor scenarios, is often limited by environmental interferences, such as adverse weather. Improving model robustness across weather conditions is thus critical for reliability. However, sourcing high-quality data relevant to isolated weather effects is a significant challenge. Most datasets include changes in dynamic elements across observations of the same scene: subjects such as pedestrians and vehicles change between shots, while camera viewpoints vary. These aspects make it difficult to decouple solely weather-induced distribution shifts from the scene. In this work, we address this with a novel weather synthesis framework that utilizes structure-retaining Low-Rank Adapters (LoRA). We analyze the attention blocks in Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL) and identify where relevant structural information is mostly processed during image-to-image translation. Through an architectural analysis of SDXL, we learn structural LoRA matrices for the corresponding blocks and then leverage them for weather synthesis, eliminating the need for external conditioning such as ControlNet. Experimental results demonstrate that our method improves upon existing synthesis approaches, achieving greater realism while preserving structure. This provides a robust pipeline for generating high-fidelity training and evaluation data for outdoor computer vision applications.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于结构保持LoRA的天气合成框架，利用SDXL中负责结构信息的注意力模块学习结构化LoRA矩阵，无需ControlNet等外部条件即可生成高保真、保结构的天气图像，以缓解户外视觉模型在恶劣天气下缺乏高质量配对数据的问题。
AI.motivation: 真实世界部署户外计算机视觉模型时受恶劣天气等环境干扰限制，跨天气鲁棒性至关重要；但获取仅含孤立天气变化的高质量数据困难——现有数据集在同一场景的不同观测间存在行人、车辆等动态元素变化及相机视角变化，难以将天气引起的分布偏移与场景本身的差异解耦。
AI.method: 提出基于结构保持低秩适配器（LoRA）的天气合成框架：分析SDXL在图像到图像翻译中注意力模块对结构信息的处理位置，定位主要承载结构信息的block；通过架构分析为对应block学习结构化LoRA矩阵，并将其用于天气合成，从而摆脱对ControlNet等外部条件输入的依赖。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法优于现有合成方法，在保持场景结构的同时实现更高的真实感，为户外计算机视觉应用生成高保真的训练与评估数据提供了稳健的流水线。
AI.conclusion: 通过在SDXL特定注意力模块中注入结构化LoRA实现结构保持的天气合成，可在无需外部条件控制的情况下兼顾结构一致性与真实感，为构建天气鲁棒的户外视觉模型的数据生成提供可行方案。

title: Game-Theoretic Foundations for Undiscounted Bisimulation Metrics
summary: Bisimulation metrics offer a principled notion of task-relevant state similarity in reinforcement learning, but existing constructions and methods are largely confined to discounted MDPs, where contraction arguments ensure well-defined fixed points and downstream guarantees. We develop a unified foundation for bisimulation metrics in undiscounted settings, that is total- and average-reward problems, by replacing the standard operator-centric view with a game-centric one: we interpret prior metric operators as Bellman-Shapley operators of zero-sum turn-based games and define metrics as the corresponding game value functions, yielding unique definitions even when $γ=1$. This game-theoretic foundation facilitates transfer of dynamic-programming theory and algorithms. We also use this game-centric perspective to characterize how metric finiteness depends on structural properties of the underlying MDP and motivate certain directed metrics that remain finite in weakly communicating MDPs. We further introduce an abstract framework for modifying the games' action spaces, allowing general transition coupling sets, that recovers many existing metrics and guides new constructions. Finally, we prove that these metrics bound total-reward and, when the optimal gain is state-independent, optimal relative value differences. We also provide error and suboptimality guarantees for aggregation-based planning in total- and average-reward settings.

AI.tldr: 将双模拟度量从折扣MDP推广到无折扣（总回报与平均回报）设定：用零和回合制博弈的Bellman-Shapley算子统一刻画，度量即博弈值函数，即使γ=1也唯一；并给出有限性条件、动作空间修改框架及规划误差界。
AI.motivation: 现有双模拟度量的构造与算法基本局限于折扣MDP，依赖压缩映射论证来保证不动点与下游理论保证；在总回报和平均回报等无折扣问题中，压缩性失效，度量定义与性质缺乏统一基础。
AI.method: 将以算子为中心的观点改为以博弈为中心：把已有度量算子解释为零和回合制博弈的Bellman-Shapley算子，把度量定义为对应的博弈值函数，从而在γ=1时仍获得唯一性。借由该基础迁移动态规划理论与算法；分析度量有限性与底层MDP结构性质（如弱连通）之间的关系，提出在弱连通MDP中仍有限的有向度量；引入修改博弈动作空间的抽象框架，支持一般转移耦合集，以还原多种已有度量并指导新构造。
AI.result: 证明所提出的度量给出总回报的界；当最优增益与状态无关时，给出最优相对价值差的界；并为总回报与平均回报设定下基于聚合的规划提供误差与次优性保证。
AI.conclusion: 博弈论视角为无折扣强化学习中的状态相似性提供了严谨且统一的度量理论，兼具唯一性、结构性刻画、构造灵活性以及聚合规划的定量保证。

title: Does Chain-of-Thought Reliance Follow a Scaling Law?Larger Models Follow Their Steps More, Independent of Post-Training
comment: 15 pages,5 figures, code and data in https://github.com/ethxin0011/cot-scale-reliance.cl
summary: Monitoring a model's chain of thought (CoT) is useful for safety only if the final answer depends on the written steps. Prior measurements use natural tasks where true reasoning is unknown. We measure it against an exact ground truth on a synthetic box-swap task where every intermediate state is known. We replace one step inside a model's own chain with a wrong but valid state and check whether the answer follows the edit. We evaluate 25 open-weight models--Qwen3 (0.6B-14B, base and post-trained), Gemma 3 (1B-12B), Llama 3 (1B-8B), and 8 OLMo 2 checkpoints--on 7,200 items each. We find five results: (1) Reliance rises with size and saturates. In Qwen3, answer reliance rises from 16-18% at 0.6B to 97-100% at 14B; a logistic in log N fits well (R^2 = 0.89), and Gemma 3 and Llama 3 follow this trend. (2) Capability is the main driver. Across all models, reliance and step accuracy correlate at r = 0.99; equally capable models are equally reliant, regardless of family. (3) Size still matters at matched correctness. On problems solved correctly before the edit, reliance increases with size among capable models (rho = 0.80, p = 0.002). (4) Post-training does not change reliance. Base and post-trained Qwen3 differ by at most 0.03 from 4B upward; a large gap at 1.7B matches a large capability gap. (5) No model up to 14B solves the task internally. Without written steps, every capable model is at chance once a problem has four or more swaps. OLMo 2 checkpoints never become capable, making the training-token axis a limitation. On tasks requiring step-by-step computation, scale makes the chain of thought more load-bearing, supporting CoT monitoring in this regime.

AI.tldr: 在合成的盒子交换任务上，用精确的中间状态真值测量25个开源模型对思维链（CoT）的依赖程度，发现规模是主导因素：依赖率随规模上升并饱和，与步骤准确率高度相关（r=0.99），后训练基本不改变依赖程度，且14B以下模型无法在无书面步骤时内部完成任务。
AI.motivation: 监控模型的思维链对安全有意义的前提是最终答案确实依赖于写出的步骤。但以往测量都基于真实自然任务，无法获知真实的推理过程，缺乏明确的真值参照。作者希望在每一步中间状态都已知的合成任务上，用精确真值来量化"答案是否跟随被篡改的步骤"。
AI.method: 构建合成的box-swap任务（每个中间状态均可确知），在模型自身的思维链中替换一步为错误但合法的状态，检验最终答案是否跟随该编辑。评估25个开放权重模型：Qwen3（0.6B–14B，base与后训练）、Gemma 3（1B–12B）、Llama 3（1B–8B）以及8个OLMo 2检查点，每个模型7200条样本。
AI.result: 五点结果：(1) 依赖率随规模上升并趋于饱和，Qwen3从0.6B的16–18%升至14B的97–100%，对数逻辑斯蒂模型拟合良好（R²=0.89），Gemma 3与Llama 3遵循同一趋势；(2) 能力是主要驱动因素，全模型范围内依赖率与步骤准确率相关r=0.99，同等能力者依赖度相同，与模型家族无关；(3) 在匹配正确性后规模仍有影响，对编辑前已正确解答的问题，能力较强的模型中依赖率随规模增加（rho=0.80, p=0.002）；(4) 后训练不改变依赖率，Qwen3的base与后训练版本在4B以上差异不超过0.03，1.7B处较大差距对应较大的能力差距；(5) 14B及以下没有模型能在内部完成任务，无书面步骤时，问题含四个及以上交换时所有具备能力的模型均处于随机水平；OLMo 2检查点始终未具备能力，构成训练token轴上的局限。
AI.conclusion: 在需要逐步计算的任务上，规模使思维链更具"承重性"（load-bearing），从而在该情形下支持CoT监控作为有效的安全手段；同时也指出训练token轴与更大规模模型的验证仍是局限。

title: Replaying the Same Gradients at a Different $\varepsilon$: A Registered Test of the Fixed-Trajectory Account of Adam's $\varepsilon$ for One Rare Row
summary:
Adam divides every update by the square root of a running average of squared gradients plus a small constant, epsilon. For an output-embedding row whose token is rare, which we call the probe row, raising epsilon can be read as shrinking that row's steps by arithmetic alone. We test that reading directly. While a training run proceeds, we also divide the probe row's update by a different epsilon, using the run's own moment estimates; this replay is exact arithmetic on the gradients the run actually saw, so it holds the run's trajectory fixed. A rule for when the replay counts as wrong was written down before the runs.
  We train a small causal transformer in a standard configuration. When epsilon rises by four orders of magnitude, the replay counts as wrong on each of the three seeds registered for the test: the probe row keeps 8.9--11.4 times more of its displacement than predicted with the main, sampled-negative head, and 5.0--7.7 times more with a full-softmax head scored as a second instrument. At three orders of magnitude, tested with the main head only, it does not, by narrow margins; a further two seeds, registered after this result had been committed and scored on their own, follow the same pattern. In separate real runs, raising epsilon on the probe row alone is enough to reproduce the row's change and raising it on every other parameter alone also moves the row part of the way --- readings about the runs that do not rescue the replay; scaling the row's learning rate instead, with the denominator untouched, is mispredicted by the replay in the same direction.
  This is one embedding row of one model family on one corpus; we make no claim about rates, about rows in general (other rows were read only as a panel on one trajectory) or about how the effect changes with model size.

AI.tldr: 通过"重放"实验检验Adam中ε对输出嵌入稀有行更新的算术解释：当ε升高四个数量级时，重放预测与实际训练轨迹在三个种子上一律失效。
AI.motivation: Adam将每次更新除以梯度平方滑动平均的平方根加小常数ε。作者想直接检验"提高ε等同于按算术缩小稀有token输出嵌入行（探针行）步长"这一解读是否成立。
AI.method: 训练一个小型因果Transformer；在训练进行时用同一运行的真实矩估计，以不同ε对探针行的更新做精确算术重放，保持原轨迹固定；实验前预先写下"重放判为错误"的判定规则，并在多个注册种子上测试；辅以仅对探针行调ε、仅对其他参数调ε、以及改学习率而分母不变的对照实验。
AI.result: ε升高四个数量级时，三个种子均判为错误：探针行保留的位移比预测多8.9–11.4倍（采样式负样本主头），全softmax头为5.0–7.7倍；三个数量级时主头下未判错，但裕度很窄，另两个后注册种子呈同样模式。真实运行中单独提高探针行ε即可复现该行的变化，单独提高其余参数ε也能部分带动该行；缩放该行学习率（分母不动）时重放同方向误判。
AI.conclusion: ε缩小探针行更新的纯算术解读在较大ε下不成立；结论限于单一模型族的单个嵌入行与单一语料，不对变化率、一般行或模型规模依赖作任何主张。

title: IntReal: A Real-World Dataset and Benchmark for Multimodal Interleaved Generation
summary: Humans routinely consume multimodal content, where textual and visual information is naturally interleaved. Although Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) can jointly generate text and images, multimodal interleaved generation remains largely underexplored. Progress in this area is hindered by two key limitations: (1) the lack of well-defined interleaved generation tasks and corresponding training data, and (2) the absence of fine-grained evaluation protocols that can reliably diagnose model performance across different capability dimensions. To this end, we present IntReal, comprising two complementary components: IntReal-100K, a real-world dataset of multimodal interleaved samples spanning four major categories, and the IntReal Evaluation Suite, which evaluates model performance across seven complementary dimensions using specialized expert models, enabling coarse-to-fine diagnosis. Extensive experiments validate our evaluation suite through low inter-metric redundancy (max pairwise absolute Spearman's $ρ\leq 0.42$ ), high agreement with human judgments (83.3% accuracy), and strong consistency across different expert evaluators (Spearman's $ρ> 0.9$ ), supporting the complementarity and reliability of our metrics. By benchmarking four families of UMMs, we show that IntReal Evaluation Suite reveals distinct strengths and weaknesses across models. Post-training experiments demonstrate the utility of IntReal-100K for improving interleaved generation and further show that training unimodal generation can also benefit interleaved generation. These findings suggest that interleaved generation can benefit from modality-specific optimization, rather than requiring joint text-image training at every stage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 IntReal，包含面向真实场景的多模态交错生成数据集 IntReal-100K（覆盖四大类别）与 IntReal 评测套件（基于专家模型、覆盖七个互补维度的由粗到细诊断），并通过实验验证评测的可靠性及数据集对训练的价值。
AI.motivation: 人类消费的多模态内容天然是图文交错的，但统一多模态模型（UMMs）的交错生成研究仍不充分，主要受限于两点：(1) 缺乏明确定义的交错生成任务与配套训练数据；(2) 缺乏可跨能力维度可靠诊断模型表现的细粒度评测协议。
AI.method: 构建 IntReal 双组件：(a) IntReal-100K，真实世界多模态交错样本数据集，涵盖四大类别；(b) IntReal Evaluation Suite，借助专用专家模型在七个互补维度上评估，实现由粗到细的诊断；并对四个 UMM 系列进行基准测试及后训练实验。
AI.result: 评测套件指标间冗余低（最大成对绝对 Spearman ρ≤0.42）、与人类判断一致率高（83.3%）、不同专家评估器间一致性高（ρ>0.9）；基准测试揭示不同模型在交错生成上的差异化优劣；后训练实验表明 IntReal-100K 可提升交错生成，且单模态生成训练亦能迁移受益。
AI.conclusion: 交错生成可从模态特定优化中获益，并非每个阶段都需要联合文本-图像训练。

title: CHORD: Cross-Model Hallucination Detection via Relational Graph Discrimination
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 as a Spotlight paper. 64 pages, 14 figures, 7 tables
summary: Hallucination detection is critical for deploying large language models (LLMs) in real-world applications. Due to strong empirical performance, internal representation-based methods have emerged as the prevailing direction for detecting hallucinations, yet they remain largely model-specific and often fail to generalize to unseen LLMs. In this paper, we study an important yet underexplored problem, termed cross-model hallucination detection (CMHD), which aims to train hallucination detectors on source LLMs while ensuring performance on unseen target LLMs. The core challenge of CMHD lies in cross-model representation heterogeneity: hidden states from different LLMs exhibit severe semantic inconsistency, which limits the transferability of classical representation-based detectors. Through analysis and empirical validation, we show that relational structures over layers, tokens, and features capture transferable detection signals despite semantic inconsistency. Based on this observation, we propose cross-model hallucination detection via heterogeneity-oriented relational discrimination (CHORD), a relational graph discrimination framework that represents hidden states as joint relational graphs over layers, tokens, and features. It feeds these graphs into relation-aware attention to obtain structure-aware features, and uses meta-learning to shape these features toward transferable detection signals. Extensive experiments show that CHORD outperforms representative detection methods in cross-model generalization. Code is available at https://github.com/MiracleworkerD/CHORD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨模型幻觉检测（CMHD）问题，并给出基于关系图判别的方法CHORD，通过在层、token、特征上构建联合关系图并结合关系感知注意力与元学习，实现从源LLM到未见目标LLM的幻觉检测器迁移。
AI.motivation: 基于内部表示的幻觉检测方法虽经验表现强，但高度依赖特定模型，难以泛化到未见LLM。作者将这一尚未充分探索的问题形式化为跨模型幻觉检测（CMHD），其核心挑战是跨模型表示异质性：不同LLM的隐状态存在严重语义不一致，导致经典表示型检测器迁移性受限。
AI.method: 通过分析与实证发现：尽管语义不一致，层间、token间、特征间的"关系结构"蕴含可迁移的检测信号。据此提出CHORD（Heterogeneity-Oriented Relational Discrimination），将隐状态表示为层、token、特征上的联合关系图；用关系感知注意力（relation-aware attention）从图中提取结构感知特征；再用元学习（meta-learning）将这些特征塑造成可迁移的检测信号。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，CHORD在跨模型泛化性能上优于代表性幻觉检测方法。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型表示异质性下的可迁移信号来源于关系结构而非语义表示本身；以关系图判别+元学习的框架可有效缓解CMHD问题，为模型无关的幻觉检测提供新路径（代码已开源）。

title: RoleFUZZER: User-Behaviour Fuzzing for Role-Specification Adherence in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are often conditioned into specific roles such as tutors, interviewers, or agents acting for an organisation, through system prompts that specify how they should behave. The extent to which they can actually adhere to these role specifications under multi-turn interactions with realistic and potentially problematic users is understudied. To address this, we propose user behaviour fuzzing, a guided search over plausible user behaviours that can lead a model to violate its role specification, and introduce RoleFUZZER, a framework that adapts coverage-guided fuzzing from software testing to operationalise the search. RoleFUZZER constructs scenarios guided by a user-behaviour coverage grid that crosses a grounded taxonomy of user interaction types and the role specification of the model under test i.e. what is under pressure. With RoleFUZZER, we evaluate LLMs across five role specifications, including tutor, financial advisor, AI interviewer, antagonistic roleplay character, and web agent under organisational policies. Across simulated and validated conversations in 15 campaigns, the framework reaches >= 89% coverage of the 64-cell behaviour grid for every model and role tested, and surfaces specification-grounded failure patterns. At an equal budget of conversations, removing the RoleFUZZER grid and asking an LLM to generate specification targeting users free-form lowers coverage to 39-69% with fewer kinds of violations. The same specification can also fail in opposite directions. For e.g., on the antagonist, open-weight target models override the player's safety signals, while Claude Haiku 4.5 breaks character instead. RoleFUZZER offers a tractable way to uncover vulnerabilities in LLMs across role specifications by testing diverse user behaviours that are likely to violate them.

AI.tldr: 提出用户行为模糊测试（user behaviour fuzzing）与RoleFUZZER框架，将覆盖率引导的模糊测试从软件测试迁移到LLM角色规格遵循性测试，在多轮交互中系统性搜索触发角色规范违背的用户行为。
AI.motivation: LLM常通过系统提示被设定为导师、面试官、机构代理等特定角色，但其在多轮交互中面对真实且可能带有问题意图的用户时，能否真正遵守角色规格尚缺乏研究。现有评估缺少对"何种用户行为会导致角色失守"的系统性搜索手段。
AI.method: 提出用户行为模糊测试，将覆盖率引导的模糊测试（coverage-guided fuzzing）适配到该问题上。RoleFUZZER构建"用户行为覆盖网格"：横轴为经锚定的用户交互类型分类体系（grounded taxonomy），纵轴为被测模型的角色规格（即"受到压力的是什么"），据此生成场景并引导搜索。在五种角色规格（导师、理财顾问、AI面试官、对抗性角色扮演角色、受组织政策约束的网页代理）与多个模型上进行15轮campaign的模拟与验证对话评估，并与移除网格、由LLM自由生成定向用户的基线在相同对话预算下对比。
AI.result: 对每个被测模型与角色，框架在64格行为网格上均达到≥89%覆盖率，并揭示出基于规格的失效模式。相同预算下，移除RoleFUZZER网格、让LLM自由生成定向用户的基线覆盖率降至39-69%，且违规类型更少。同一角色规格的失效方向可相反：在对抗性角色上，开放权重目标模型会覆盖/无视玩家的安全信号，而Claude Haiku 4.5则出戏（break character）。
AI.conclusion: RoleFUZZER提供了一条可行路径，通过测试多样化、易触发违规的用户行为来发现跨角色规格的LLM脆弱性；结构化覆盖网格相较自由生成式对抗测试更高效、更多样。

title: B2P-Corr: Batch-to-Population Gradient Estimators for Non-Decomposable Correlation Losses
summary: Correlation metrics such as the Pearson Correlation Coefficient (PCC) and Concordance Correlation Coefficient (CCC) are standard regression metrics and learning objectives, but their non-decomposable nature poses a challenge for stochastic optimization. Since these metrics depend on dataset-level moments (mean, variance, covariance), naive mini-batch training with local statistics yields biased, high-variance gradients whose expectation does not align with the population gradient. To bridge this ``batch-to-population'' (B2P) gap, we propose \textbf{B2P-Corr}, a novel framework that transforms correlation objectives into decomposable pseudo-losses driven by lightweight global ``moment sketches''. We introduce two efficient variants: \textbf{B2P-EMA}, which utilizes exponential moving averages and stop-gradient operators to ensure asymptotic gradient tracking with $O(B)$ cost ($B$ is batch size); and \textbf{B2P-U}, which uses sampled cross-batch U-statistic estimators and a reservoir-based stabilization with an $O(B)$ implementation. Theoretically, we quantify the $O(B^{-1})$ bias of naive mini-batch optimization, prove a moving-target tracking result for B2P-EMA under a fast-sketch / slow-parameter regime, and provide an idealized control-variate analysis for B2P-U. Experiments on two synthetic and three real-world datasets demonstrate B2P-Corr achieves stable optimization and higher correlation than naive mini-batch optimization with negligible overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出B2P-Corr框架，用轻量全局"矩草图"将PCC/CCC等不可分解的相关性目标转化为可分解伪损失，消除小批量与总体梯度间的偏差，给出两个O(B)复杂度变体并完成理论与实证验证。
AI.motivation: PCC、CCC等相关性指标依赖数据集级矩（均值、方差、协方差），属于不可分解目标，无法直接用于随机优化。直接用mini-batch局部统计量估计会产生有偏、高方差的梯度，其期望与总体梯度不一致，形成"batch-to-population"（B2P）差距，导致优化不稳定、相关性指标次优。
AI.method: 提出B2P-Corr框架，借助轻量级全局"矩草图"（moment sketches）将相关性目标改写为可分解的伪损失。两个变体：(1) B2P-EMA，使用指数移动平均与stop-gradient算子，实现渐近梯度跟踪，成本O(B)；(2) B2P-U，使用跨批次采样的U统计量估计器，配合基于蓄水池（reservoir）的稳定化，实现O(B)复杂度。
AI.result: 理论：量化了朴素小批量优化的O(B^{-1})偏差；证明B2P-EMA在"快草图/慢参数"机制下的移动目标跟踪（moving-target tracking）结果；给出B2P-U的理想化控制变量分析。实验：在2个合成数据集和3个真实数据集上，B2P-Corr实现稳定优化，相关性高于朴素小批量优化，且额外开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 通过全局矩草图将不可分解的相关性目标可分解化，B2P-Corr在理论上有偏差校正与收敛保证，在实践中以O(B)低开销显著提升PCC/CCC优化的稳定性与最终相关性表现，为相关性指标的随机优化提供了通用且高效的方案。

title: Automatic Iconographic Annotation of Medieval Illuminations: Comparing Generative Vision-Language Models and Supervised Discriminative Classifiers
summary: The large-scale digitisation of medieval manuscripts creates a growing need for automated iconographic indexing. We evaluate two complementary paradigms for this task on 9,735 full-folio images annotated with 2,333 TIMEL concepts: generative Vision-Language Models (VLM) and supervised discriminative classifiers (SDC). The VLM experiments evaluate fine-tuning, structured JSON decoding, taxonomybased candidates generation, and deterministic reranking. The discriminative experiments evaluate flat, hierarchy-aware, and patch-attention heads over a frozen DINOv3 encoder. Our results highlight key functional differences: ML-Decoder (SDC) achieves the strongest overall retrieval performance (precision@1 of 0.696, MRR of 0.806), with loss calibration (Asymmetric Loss) serving as the primary performance lever. While SDCs provide superior precision and reliability within a closed vocabulary, VLMs offer strong semantic generalization and broad taxonomic coverage, particularly through structured JSON targets and verify-calibrate reranking (hierarchical F1 of 0.559).
