We present Kinematic Causal Attribution (KCA), a black-box, interventional attribution method that queries only the model's outputs. Its freeze operator removes a region's motion while keeping its shape, and a shape-free proxy removes the shape while keeping the motion. Together they span a motion$\times$geometry cube for every tracked region, whose order-symmetric Shapley decomposition is complete and whose interaction is measured rather than assumed away. The operators rewrite per-frame point sets, so they need no correspondences, and a context-averaged estimator handles structures that span several regions. We validate KCA on the official PSTNet, P4Transformer and Mamba4D trained on MSR-Action3D. The decisive test is an audit: two binary tasks are built from real clips whose classes differ only in the motion or only in the shape of the same arm, and the motion share of the arm's importance follows the defining cue on all three backbones (0.83 vs. 0.60 on P4Transformer, 0.86 vs. 0.30 on PSTNet, 0.92 vs. 0.61 on Mamba4D), a distinction no single attribution map can make. The split costs no faithfulness: the necessity maps have the lowest deletion AUC on P4Transformer and PSTNet, tie with the best baseline on Mamba4D, and lose their correlation with the trained model's once the weights are randomised. Skeleton ground truth, re-sampling stability and cost complete the validation.

AI.tldr: 提出KCA，一种黑盒、干预式的4D点云视频归因方法，通过冻结/去除运动与形状算子构建运动×几何立方体，并用Shapley分解量化二者对模型决策的贡献。
AI.motivation: 4D感知模型（点云视频分类）部署前需检验其依赖何种线索（身体部位的运动还是形状），但现有归因方法存在局限：3D归因仅单帧，视频归因限于RGB像素，梯度法需白盒访问，注意力机制在state-space骨干中缺失，点级扰动假设跨帧点对应而真实深度/LiDAR数据不具备。
AI.method: KCA仅查询模型输出（黑盒）。冻结算子去除区域运动而保留形状；无形状代理去除形状而保留运动；二者为每个追踪区域张成运动×几何立方体，采用顺序对称的Shapley分解且测量交互项而非假设其可忽略。算子重写逐帧点集，无需点对应；上下文平均估计器处理跨多区域的结构。
AI.result: 在MSR-Action3D上训练的PSTNet、P4Transformer、Mamba4D上验证。审计测试中，同一手臂仅运动或仅形状不同的两个二分类任务，手臂重要性的运动占比在三个骨干上均跟随定义线索（P4Transformer 0.83 vs 0.60，PSTNet 0.86 vs 0.30，Mamba4D 0.92 vs 0.61），为单一归因图无法区分。分解不损忠实性：必要性图在P4Transformer与PSTNet上删除AUC最低，在Mamba4D上与最佳基线持平，且权重随机化后与训练模型的相关性消失。
AI.conclusion: KCA实现了无对应假设的黑盒4D归因，能分离运动与形状线索且保持忠实性；辅以骨架真值、重采样稳定性与成本分析完成验证。

title: Where You Inject Matters: The Trust Region Effect in LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents are increasingly adopted in long-horizon tasks and interact with diverse external environments. Despite their growing capabilities, these agents remain vulnerable to real-world attacks such as indirect prompt injections, which manipulate agents through malicious instructions embedded in external environments. While existing risk assessment work has primarily focused on the injection content, the effect of where an injection appears has not been systematically characterized. Studying injection placement requires agents to operate over longer-horizon tasks and interact with diverse environmental surfaces. Thus, we build three agentic testbeds spanning tool use, coding, and daily workflow domains with diverse injection surfaces. Holding the injection content fixed, we find that agent susceptibility varies across injection placements. We refer to this phenomenon as the trust region effect: agents implicitly assign different levels of trust to different regions of their environments. For example, an agent powered by GPT-5.4 follows an unsafe injection instruction placed in a repository documentation file (i.e., a README or TODO file) 2.6 times more often on average than the same instruction placed in a code or data file. Building upon this observation, we develop learning-based attackers that generate injection content and select better injection placements. Our approach demonstrates that both where an injection is placed and what content it contains can affect the strength of indirect prompt injection attacks. To the best of our knowledge, this work provides the first systematic characterization for the effectiveness of different injection placements, spanning both coarse-grained environmental surfaces and fine-grained positions. The uneven trust that agents implicitly place across their environments provides important insights for future attack and defense design.

AI.tldr: 论文首次系统刻画间接提示注入中"注入位置"对攻击效果的影响，提出"信任区域效应"(trust region effect)，并基于此构建学习型攻击者联合优化注入内容与注入位置。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体风险评估主要关注注入的"内容"，而注入"出现的位置"对攻击成败的系统性影响尚未被刻画。研究位置效应需智能体执行长时程任务并与多样环境表面交互，此前缺乏合适测试平台。
AI.method: 构建覆盖工具使用、代码编写、日常工作流三个领域的智能体测试床，包含多样的注入表面；在固定注入内容的前提下，跨不同注入位置测量智能体的易感性，区分粗粒度环境表面与细粒度位置；随后提出基于学习的攻击者，在生成注入内容的同时选择更优注入位置。
AI.result: 同一注入内容在不同位置下的攻击成功率存在显著差异：例如由GPT-5.4驱动的智能体对置于仓库文档文件（README或TODO）中的不安全注入指令的遵循频率，平均为置于代码或数据文件中同一指令的2.6倍。学习型攻击者表明"放哪里"与"写什么"共同决定攻击强度。
AI.conclusion: 智能体对环境不同区域隐式赋予不同信任水平，形成不均衡的"信任区域"。该工作首次系统刻画注入位置有效性，涵盖粗粒度表面与细粒度位置，为后续攻击与防御设计提供重要启示。

title: How Specific Do I Need to Be? Effects of User Query Underspecification on Deep Research Agents
summary: Deep research agents (DRAs) conduct long-horizon reasoning, search, and literature synthesis to provide long-form answers to complex, domain-specific questions. These agents are typically trained and evaluated on fully specified user queries. However, real-world user queries can often be underspecified. We introduce UNDERSPEC-DR, a framework for systematically evaluating how underspecified queries affect agents' final answer quality and intermediate search behavior. Across three DRAs we evaluated, underspecification substantially reduces how well DRA's answers fulfill users' information needs, even though they remain grounded in cited evidence. Our analysis of intermediate search behavior suggests a possible explanation: DRAs conduct broader searches that draw less on the original user query but rely more on their learned prior during training, which can be misaligned with users' intent. Our findings reveal the vulnerability of current DRAs to underspecified user queries and inform future efforts to build DRAs that proactively recognize when additional user input is needed to reliably complete deep research tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 UNDERSPEC-DR 框架，系统评估欠规范查询对深度研究智能体（DRA）最终答案质量与中间检索行为的影响，发现欠规范显著降低答案对用户信息需求的满足度。
AI.motivation: 现有 DRA 的训练与评测几乎都基于信息完整的用户查询，而真实场景中用户查询常欠规范（underspecified）。这种训练-现实错配使得 DRA 在真实使用中的可靠性未知，需要系统性量化欠规范带来的影响并诊断其行为机理。
AI.method: 构建 UNDERSPEC-DR 评测框架，对查询进行系统化的欠规范改造；在三个 DRA 上对比完整查询与欠规范查询下的表现，同时分析最终答案质量（含引用证据支撑度）与中间检索行为（检索广度、对原始查询的依赖程度、对训练先验的依赖程度）。
AI.result: 欠规范显著降低 DRA 答案满足用户信息需求的程度，尽管答案仍由引用证据支撑（即"有据但不切题"）；行为分析显示 DRA 在欠规范下检索更宽泛，对原始查询的利用减少，更多依赖训练习得的先验，而该先验可能与用户意图不一致。
AI.conclusion: 当前 DRA 对欠规范查询具有明显脆弱性，根源在于检索漂移与先验替代用户意图；未来应构建能主动识别信息不足并主动向用户索取补充输入的深度研究智能体。

title: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Teacher Evolution
summary: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which aligns a student model's token-level distribution with that of its self-teacher prompted by privileged context, has emerged as a promising direction to mitigate reward sparsity in sequence-level post-training paradigms. However, OPSD often fails to achieve continuous performance gains during training. In this paper, we find that the model's limited self-teaching capability underlies this phenomenon by generating unreliable guidance on certain samples. To address this problem, we propose Teacher-Evolution Self-Distillation (TESD), which enables the self-teacher to generate rollouts and receive environmental feedback based on task correctness and context independence. First, using these rewards as training objectives, we perform teacher-oriented optimization to continuously enhance the model's self-teaching capability during distillation. Second, by estimating teacher guidance reliability from these rewards, we apply adaptive student-oriented optimization to down-weight samples with unreliable guidance. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and model scales show that TESD consistently outperforms representative token-level and sequence-level methods, highlighting the necessity of improving supervision quality in OPSD.

AI.tldr: 本文指出On-Policy自蒸馏(OPSD)训练中性能提升无法持续，根源在于模型自教学能力有限、对部分样本给出不可靠指导；提出Teacher-Evolution自蒸馏(TESD)，通过师模型演化与自适应学生优化提升监督质量，在多个数据集与模型规模上稳定优于代表性token级与序列级方法。
AI.motivation: OPSD通过特权上下文提示的自教师对齐学生token级分布，缓解序列级后训练中的奖励稀疏问题，但训练过程中难以持续获得性能增益。作者将原因归结为模型自教学能力有限，导致某些样本上的指导不可靠，从而降低监督质量。
AI.method: 提出TESD：让自教师生成rollout并依据任务正确性与上下文独立性获得环境反馈（奖励）。第一步，以这些奖励为训练目标进行面向教师的优化，在蒸馏过程中持续增强自教学能力；第二步，由奖励估计教师指导可靠性，进行自适应面向学生的优化，对指导不可靠的样本降权。
AI.result: 在多个数据集与多种模型规模上的大量实验表明，TESD稳定优于代表性的token级与序列级方法。
AI.conclusion: OPSD的核心瓶颈是监督质量而非仅奖励稀疏，提升自教师能力并对不可靠指导样本降权是有效路径；实验结果强调了在OPSD中改进监督质量的必要性。

title: STRATA: Reinforcement-driven Active Sampling with Tri-paradigm Adaptation for Efficient 3D Spatial Transcriptomics
summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) enables joint characterization of tissue morphology and gene expression. However, 3D volumetric ST acquisition remains expensive. AI-driven methods offer a low-cost alternative but remain limited in accuracy, while recent 2D section-wise ST acquisition still rely on dense grid sampling, resulting in redundant measurements and undersampling of biologically informative regions. To bridge the gap, we propose STRATA, a reinforcement-driven active sampling framework with tri-paradigm adaptation for reconstructing dense 3D transcriptomic maps from sparse voxel-wise ST acquisition. STRATA constructs a 3D graph integrating H&E morphology with single-cell priors and employs a reinforcement learning agent to estimate morphological sparsity and transcriptomic informativeness, enabling budget-aware selection of informative spots. Given these sparse measurements, an adaptive tri-paradigm predictor combines retrieval, regression, and cross-layer imputation through lightweight fusion, dynamically weighting their contributions. Experiments across datasets demonstrate improved sampling efficiency and accuracy, particularly under low-budget settings. Code is available at https://github.com/Junchao-Zhu/STRATA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STRATA，一个强化学习驱动的主动采样框架，通过三范式自适应预测，从稀疏体素级ST采集中重建稠密3D转录组图谱。
AI.motivation: 3D体素级空间转录组（ST）采集成本高昂；现有AI方法精度有限，而2D逐切片ST仍依赖稠密网格采样，导致冗余测量与生物信息区域欠采样。
AI.method: 构建融合H&E形态与单细胞先验的3D图，采用强化学习智能体估计形态稀疏性与转录组信息量，实现预算感知的稀疏选点；随后用自适应三范式预测器，通过轻量融合动态加权检索、回归与跨层插补三种策略。
AI.result: 多数据集实验显示采样效率与精度均有提升，在低预算条件下尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: STRATA以主动采样加三范式预测的方式，有效缓解3D ST的成本与冗余采样问题，在受限预算下实现高保真稠密3D转录组重建。

title: Auditable Belief Updates as a Missing Safety Layer for LLM-Powered Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being used as cognitive interfaces that shape how users interpret evidence, communicate, and make decisions. As deployed systems become more multimodal, tool-using, and multi-agent, safety failures no longer arise only from isolated harmful outputs, but also from how agents update, store, and propagate epistemic commitments across retrieval, memory, tools, and peer communication. In this paper, we define belief as an engineering abstraction for evidence-based commitments that guide downstream action. Building on this view, we propose the Explicit Belief Multi-Agent System (EB-MAS), which externalizes belief states into a structured substrate, uses belief operators to propose candidate updates, and applies a Cognitive Firewall to bound or reject updates that are weakly evidenced but strongly driven by vulnerability cues. We also discuss the risk of group belief at the group level, including manufactured consensus, collusion, and cascading misinformation, and outline practical integration challenges around grounding, false positives, scalability, and ethical misuse. Therefore, scalable agent safety requires not only better output filtering or stronger base models, but also explicit interfaces for tracing, calibrating, and constraining belief revision at runtime.

AI.tldr: 论文将“信念”定义为指导下游行动的、基于证据的承诺这一工程抽象，提出显式信念多智能体系统（EB-MAS）：把信念状态外化到结构化基底，用信念算子提出候选更新，并用“认知防火墙”限制或拒绝弱证据但受脆弱性线索强烈驱动的更新；同时讨论群体层面信念风险与落地挑战，主张智能体安全需要运行时信念修正的显式接口。
AI.motivation: LLM日益充当塑造用户解读证据、沟通与决策的认知接口；系统走向多模态、工具使用与多智能体后，安全失效不再仅源于孤立的有害输出，而源于智能体在检索、记忆、工具与同伴通信中更新、存储和传播认知承诺的方式。
AI.method: 将信念形式化为工程抽象（基于证据、指导行动的承诺）；设计EB-MAS：信念状态外化至结构化基底（structured substrate），由信念算子生成候选更新，再由Cognitive Firewall对“证据弱但受脆弱性线索强驱动”的更新进行约束或拒绝。
AI.result: 提出EB-MAS框架与认知防火墙机制，并识别群体层面信念风险（人为制造的共识、串谋、级联式错误信息）及实际集成挑战（ grounding、误报、可扩展性、伦理滥用）。
AI.conclusion: 可扩展的智能体安全不仅依赖更好的输出过滤或更强的基座模型，还需要在运行时对信念修正进行追踪、校准与约束的显式接口。

title: ARBITRA: Robust Document-Level ATT&CK Extraction via Multi-Expert Argumentation
comment: 13 pages of main paper, 21 pages total, preprint
summary: Cyber threat intelligence (CTI) reports describe adversary behavior in natural language, but converting them into structured MITRE ATT&CK mappings remains difficult: existing methods decompose reports to sentence-level granularity for extraction, while modern LLMs can work with full reports in a single pass but with noticeable performance degradation. We present ARBITRA, which orchestrates multiple role-specialized LLM experts that propose candidate ATT&CK entities from the full report, which are then verified through a per-candidate quantitative bipolar argumentation framework (QBAF) grounded in document evidence and rationales. We additionally construct reasoning-specialized corpora for fine-tuning so experts can act as effective participants during this verification process. Across ATT&CK extraction benchmarks, ARBITRA reaches a stronger precision-oriented operating point than sentence-level pipelines, recent LLM-based extraction systems, and frontier models including GPT-5.5. Under adversarial perturbations simulating conflicting TTP statements, cross-report contamination, and semantic poisoning, ARBITRA limits mean precision degradation to roughly half that of frontier-model baselines for a more robust extraction.

AI.tldr: ARBITRA通过多角色专家提出ATT&CK候选实体，再用基于文档证据的逐候选QBAF（定量双极论证框架）验证，在CTI报告到ATT&CK映射上取得更偏精度的强工作点，并对抗扰动更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 将CTI报告转成结构化MITRE ATT&CK映射困难：现有方法把报告拆到句子级抽取（丢失上下文），而现代LLM可整篇处理但性能明显下降。
AI.method: 多角色特化LLM专家对整篇报告提出候选ATT&CK实体；对每个候选构建以文档证据与理由（rationale）为基础的定量双极论证框架（QBAF）进行验证；并构建推理特化语料用于微调，使专家成为有效论证参与者。
AI.result: 在ATT&CK抽取基准上，ARBITRA的精度导向工作点优于句子级流水线、近期LLM抽取系统及包括GPT-5.5在内的前沿模型；在模拟冲突TTP陈述、跨报告污染和语义投毒的对抗扰动下，平均精度退化约为前沿基线的一半。
AI.conclusion: 以论证式多专家验证替代句子级分解或单次整篇抽取，可在保持全局上下文的同时提升精度与鲁棒性。

title: CFKS: Continuum-Feature Kernel PDE Solvers
summary: Neural-network-based PDE solvers require architectural choices, particularly the number of layers and neurons per layer. Fixing a single Gaussian radial basis function (RBF) feature layer and taking the number of features to the continuum limit removes the need to prescribe a finite feature count or select individual feature centers, thereby reducing representation arbitrariness. Motivated by this principle, we introduce Continuum-Feature Kernel Solver (CFKS), a deterministic framework for PDEs obtained by analytically marginalizing a bounded continuum of Gaussian RBF features. CFKS works directly with the resulting continuum-feature mean kernel and its operator-applied counterparts, parameterized by prescribed Gaussian widths and bounded center distributions. For linear PDEs, CFKS leads to symmetric operator-kernel collocation systems with null-space enforcement of physical constraints. Nonlinear PDEs are addressed through linearized initialization and nonlinear least-squares residual minimization using analytical kernel derivatives and Jacobians. Residual-guided collocation enrichment and sequential space--time-slab marching provide additional resolution strategies, while prescribed multiscale kernel refinement helps resolve localized nonlinear structures. Finite-feature experiments confirm convergence of empirical value and operator Gram matrices toward their continuum counterparts. Numerical studies include oscillatory and multiscale ODEs, irregular-domain Poisson and biharmonic problems, singular perturbations, transient transport equations, and viscous Burgers' equation. The results establish CFKS as a direct computational connection between finite Gaussian-RBF representations and continuum-feature kernel PDE solvers. Codes: https://github.com/vikas-dwivedi-2022/CFKS_Codes

AI.tldr: 提出连续特征核求解器（CFKS）：将单个高斯RBF特征层取特征数连续极限，解析边缘化有界连续特征集，直接以连续特征均值核及其算子作用形式构建确定性PDE求解框架。
AI.motivation: 神经网络PDE求解器需人为设定层数、每层神经元数，并需指定有限特征数目与特征中心位置，带来表示上的任意性。取特征数连续极限可消除对有限特征计数与逐个中心选取的依赖，从而减少表示任意性。
AI.method: 固定单一高斯RBF特征层，对有界连续高斯RBF特征集解析边缘化，得到连续特征均值核及算子作用核，由预设高斯宽度与有界中心分布参数化。线性PDE：构造对称算子-核配点系统，并以零空间强制物理约束。非线性PDE：线性化初始化加非线性最小二乘残差最小化，利用解析核导数与雅可比；辅以残差引导的配点增强、顺序时空板块推进，以及预设多尺度核细化以分辨局部非线性结构。
AI.result: 有限特征实验证实经验值与算子Gram矩阵收敛于其连续对应物。数值研究涵盖振荡与多尺度ODE、不规则区域Poisson与双调和问题、奇异摄动、瞬态输运方程及粘性Burgers方程。
AI.conclusion: CFKS在有限高斯RBF表示与连续特征核PDE求解器之间建立了直接的计算联系，是确定性的、无需预设有限特征数的框架。

title: VEvo-Harness: Causally-Guarded Self-Evolving Harness for Agentic Image Generation
summary: The central bottleneck in visual generation and editing has migrated from achieving pixel-level fidelity to satisfying densely constrained user specifications through increasingly agentic workflows. Prevailing agentic generation pipelines remain shallow generate-verify-rewrite loops treating VLM judgments as coarse visual feedback, either discarding repair experience or admitting ungated updates that poison skill library. With memorize and govern periods left open, they degrade into ungoverned iterators of repeated trial-and-error rather than continual self-evolving harness. Towards this issue, we present \textbf{VEvo-Harness}, the first causally-guarded continual self-evolving harness system for agentic visual generation. VEvo-Harness introduces four coupled innovations: (1) \textit{a visual traceback} that densifies sparse judgments into root-cause attributions with a hierarchical verification tree; (2) \textit{a visual continual governance} that admits only causally valid skill patches through counterfactual dual-arm image generation replay; (3) \textit{a lifecycle-managed harness state} that hierarchically distills root-cause-anchored episodes across working, experience, and pattern tiers into a persistent skill library of routable and causally verified capabilities; (4) \textit{a heterogeneous sandbox policy} that orchestrates a diverse action space of repair primitives, dynamically routing cost-aware interventions based on root causes to select the most effective strategy. VEvo-Harness surpasses state-of-the-art agentic methods and rivals proprietary generators (\textit{e.g.}, GPT-Image, Nano-Pro) while maintaining the continual harness evolution and generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出VEvo-Harness，首个带因果守卫的持续自进化视觉生成harness，通过视觉回溯、持续治理、生命周期状态管理与异构沙盒策略，将浅层生成-验证-重写循环升级为可治理的持续自进化系统。
AI.motivation: 视觉生成与编辑的瓶颈已从像素级保真度转向满足密集约束的用户spec，现有agentic流水线仍停留在浅层generate-verify-rewrite循环：将VLM判断仅当作粗粒度视觉反馈，或丢弃修复经验，或引入无门控更新污染技能库；缺乏记忆与治理环节，退化为无治理的重复试错迭代器。
AI.method: 四项耦合创新：(1)视觉回溯，用层次化验证树将稀疏判断稠密化为根因归因；(2)视觉持续治理，通过反事实双臂图像生成重放，仅接纳因果有效的技能补丁；(3)生命周期管理的harness状态，跨工作、经验、模式三层级层次化蒸馏根因锚定episode，形成可路由、因果验证的持久技能库；(4)异构沙盒策略，编排修复原语动作空间，按根因动态路由成本感知干预。
AI.result: 超越SOTA agentic方法，可比肩闭源生成器（如GPT-Image、Nano-Pro），并保持持续harness进化与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入因果守卫与生命周期治理，agentic视觉生成可由无治理试错迭代转变为持续自进化的harness系统，在性能与泛化上兼具优势。

title: Aligning Autoresearch: Co-Improvement between Agents and Humans
summary: Autoresearch agents can now attempt long-horizon AI research end-to-end, i.e., self-improvement. However, best results are still obtained by research agents interacting with human researchers, and improving AI's ability to perform this co-research will only reinforce this effect---a process termed co-improvement (Weston and Foerster, 2025). Further, aligning with human expectations is likely a safer path for research agents, especially given recent agent reward hacking phenomena (OpenAI, 2026b). In this work we address these issues in four ways: (i) we empirically study the role of humans in directing autoresearch agents, focusing on the domain of benchmark creation, and find humans still play a pivotal role particularly in the ideation phase; (ii) we also develop a benchmark, HackBench, that shows current autoresearch agents are not aligned and are unable to achieve hack localization sufficiently; (iii) we present a method to train agents for improved human interaction by using human simulators as a proxy during reinforcement learning (RL); and finally (iv) we develop a method to improve model text generation, and hence agent communication, by RL with rubrics aligned with human experts. Together, our training and evaluation recipes provide a path toward more capable and aligned (co-)research agents.

AI.tldr: 论文研究人类在引导自动研究（autoresearch）智能体中的作用，构建HackBench基准揭示现有智能体对齐不足，并提出两种RL训练方法（人类模拟器代理交互训练、专家对齐rubric奖励训练）以提升人机协同研究能力与对齐性。
AI.motivation: 自动研究智能体虽可端到端自我改进，但最佳成果仍来自与人协作；且近期出现奖励黑客现象，使"协同改进"路径既更有效也更安全，故需研究人类角色并提升智能体的交互与对齐能力。
AI.method: (i) 以基准创建为领域，实证研究人类在引导自动研究智能体中的作用；(ii) 构建HackBench基准评估智能体的对齐性与hack定位能力；(iii) 用人类模拟器作为强化学习中的代理，训练智能体改善人机交互；(iv) 采用与人类专家对齐的rubric进行RL，改进模型文本生成与智能体沟通能力。
AI.result: 人类在引导过程中仍起关键作用，尤其在构思（ideation）阶段；HackBench显示当前自动研究智能体对齐不足且无法充分实现hack定位；所提两类RL训练方法可分别提升人机交互与文本生成沟通质量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一套训练与评估配方，为构建能力更强且更对齐的（协同）研究智能体指明路径。

title: Integrating Heterogeneous Echocardiography AI Outputs in Language Space: Learnable Late Fusion with a Supervised LLM
summary: View- and target-specific echocardiography AI models capture useful but complementary information and may not achieve sufficient predictive performance in isolation. A learned ensemble is a natural way to combine these outputs, but heterogeneous models typically require each output to be converted into a binary decision, probability, confidence score, or fixed-length feature vector. We developed a supervised large language model (LLM)-based late-fusion module that directly aggregates view-specific predicted finding statements and predicted measurements in language space and learns a case-level fusion function. In patient-level three-fold cross-validation of 859 examinations from 646 patients, the proposed method integrated heterogeneous outputs within a single framework, performed comparably to the best-performing reference strategy evaluated, and outperformed a general-purpose LLM without task-specific training. These results suggest that a supervised LLM can combine multiple upstream models without model-specific output conversion or feature engineering that requires medical knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出基于监督LLM的晚期融合模块，在语言空间直接聚合视图特异的心脏超声模型输出，实现病例级融合。
AI.motivation: 视图特异和目标特异的超声AI模型仅能捕获互补信息，单独使用时预测性能不足；而异构模型集成通常需要将各输出转换为二值决策、概率、置信度或定长特征向量等，流程繁琐且依赖医学知识。
AI.method: 开发监督式大语言模型（LLM）晚期融合模块，直接在语言空间聚合视图特异的预测发现陈述与预测测量值，并学习一个病例级融合函数，使异构输出在单一框架内整合。
AI.result: 在来自646名患者的859次检查的患者级三折交叉验证中，该方法可整合异构输出，性能与所评估的最佳参考策略相当，并优于未经任务特定训练的通用LLM。
AI.conclusion: 监督式LLM可在无需模型特异输出转换、也无需依赖医学知识的特征工程条件下，融合多个上游模型。

title: Logical Guidance of Stochastic Interpolants
summary: Guidance and composition of generative models have applications in visual design, chemistry, and biology. Logical guidance composes conditional scores exactly for diffusion models. However, Flow Matching (FM) and Stochastic Interpolants (SI) learn velocity fields. We show that negation and exclusive disjunction admit exact conditional velocity composition on any interpolant, whereas conjunction, and therefore any formula containing one, is exact on Gaussian paths but in general incurs a drift-interaction error, so composed velocities need not sample the logical target. LOGSI solves this by using score-based re-equilibration as our principled mechanism and falling back to the Gaussian-path velocity rule as an approximate transport predictor. In non-Gaussian bridge problems, generation alternates transport steps with score re-equilibration steps. On image trans fer (EMNIST to CMNIST, CelebA) and QM9 source-to-target molecular editing with logical attribute constraints, LOGSI improves rule conformity at the same network-evaluation budget over composed-velocity baselines, while also improving fidelity on the image tasks. More broadly, LOGSI applies wherever stochastic interpolants need guidance and logical combinations of constraints are natural.

AI.tldr: 论文分析Flow Matching与Stochastic Interpolants中逻辑引导的组合问题：否定与异或可精确组合速度场，而合取在非高斯路径上产生漂移交互误差；提出LOGSI，通过基于分数的重平衡实现逻辑引导采样。
AI.motivation: 逻辑引导（negation、conjunction、disjunction等）在扩散模型中可借助条件分数精确组合，但FM/SI学习的是速度场而非分数，逻辑组合规则尚不明确，直接组合速度可能导致采样偏离逻辑目标。
AI.method: 理论分析各逻辑算子在插值路径上的速度组合性质：否定与异或对任意插值可精确组合；合取仅在Gaussian路径上精确，一般情形存在drift-interaction误差。基于此提出LOGSI：以分数重平衡（score-based re-equilibration）为原则性机制，并回退到Gaussian路径速度规则作为近似传输预测器；在非高斯桥问题中交替执行传输步与分数重平衡步。
AI.result: 在图像迁移（EMNIST→CMNIST、CelebA）与QM9源到目标分子编辑（带逻辑属性约束）任务上，在相同网络评估预算下，LOGSI相比组合速度基线提升了规则符合度，图像任务上还提升了生成保真度。
AI.conclusion: LOGSI适用于任何需要对随机插值施加引导、且约束的逻辑组合自然存在的场景，为FM/SI中的逻辑引导提供了理论与实用方案。

title: CLaW: Codec-Guided Adaptive Latent Watermarking for Traceable Diffusion Image Generation
summary: With the rapid advancement of text-to-image diffusion models, increasingly realistic AI-generated content has raised serious concerns about misuse and copyright infringement. Digital watermarking offers a promising solution by enabling user-level traceability, yet existing methods remain difficult to deploy at scale, hindered by costly model retraining or detection, poor effectiveness-fidelity trade-offs, and limited robustness to image transformations. To address these challenges, we propose CLaW (Codec-guided Latent Watermarking), a robust and efficient watermarking framework for traceable diffusion image generation with frozen diffusion backbones and inversion-free detection. Specifically, CLaW first uses a pretrained watermark codec to map each watermark message to a latent residual, enabling low-cost sampling-time injection. Then, the residual is injected within a late denoising window, where image semantics are better preserved and the watermark signal is less perturbed by subsequent denoising updates, yielding a better balance between watermark effectiveness and image fidelity. Furthermore, we introduce a decoder-guided adaptive injection mechanism that uses decoding confidence as feedback to dynamically calibrate watermark strength, reinforcing weak watermark signals and improving robustness under image transformations. Extensive experiments show that CLaW preserves high visual fidelity and achieves state-of-the-art robustness under image transformations, enabling reliable user-level traceability.

AI.tldr: 提出CLaW（Codec-guided Latent Watermarking）框架，在冻结扩散主干、无需反演的设定下，实现高效、鲁棒的扩散图像用户级水印溯源。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型生成内容日益逼真，滥用与版权风险突出；数字水印可实现用户级溯源，但现有方法需昂贵重训练或高检测开销、效果-保真度权衡差、对图像变换鲁棒性不足，难以规模化部署。
AI.method: 1）用预训练水印编解码器将水印消息映射为隐空间残差，实现低成本采样期注入；2）将残差注入安排在去噪后段窗口，此时语义基本成型，水印受后续去噪更新扰动更小；3）引入解码器引导的自适应注入机制，以解码置信度作反馈动态校准水印强度，增强弱信号鲁棒性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明CLaW保持高视觉保真度，并在图像变换下取得SOTA鲁棒性，可支撑可靠的用户级溯源。
AI.conclusion: CLaW以冻结扩散主干+免反演检测的轻量方案，缓解了效果-保真度权衡与鲁棒性难题，为可扩展的扩散图像水印溯源提供了可行路径。

title: TreasuryQA Bench: Can AI Agents Work an Archive of Scanned Financial Records?
summary: Organisations keep decades of financial records as scanned PDFs on shared drives, and AI agents can now reach those drives through Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Existing benchmarks do not mirror this production setting because they simplify the task. In some, the relevant documents are handed to the agent, so it never has to search. In others, the agent searches through documents with pre-extracted text, so it never has to read scanned images. We introduce TreasuryQA Bench, which requires both: 70 questions over 1,435 scanned U.S. Treasury publications, held in Veris's high-fidelity Dropbox twin. In each task the agent searches for the relevant file through Dropbox's MCP server, reads the pages it needs with Reducto's hosted OCR server or its own tools, and replies with one exact figure. A Python grader checks each answer against an accepted range around the correct value. In this paper we present results from ten agents. The best, Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code, solves 64.8% of attempts and the worst, GPT-5.6 Terra in Codex, solves 16.7%, so the benchmark is far from saturated. We also test how scan quality affects performance: every agent solves fewer tasks on the blurriest scans. Most failed attempts reply with a wrong number rather than no number, and the most common cause is a digit misread from the scan. Three worked examples are included with their answer keys.

AI.tldr: TreasuryQA Bench 是一个面向真实生产场景的金融文档问答基准：70 道题目分布在 1,435 份扫描版美国财政部出版物上，智能体需先通过 Dropbox 的 MCP 服务器检索文件、再用 OCR 工具阅读扫描页并给出唯一精确数值。十个智能体中最佳者（Claude Opus 5.5）解决率 64.8%，最差者（GPT-5.6 Terra）仅 16.7%，基准远未饱和。
AI.motivation: 现有基准简化了任务，无法反映生产环境：部分基准直接把相关文档交给智能体，省略了检索环节；部分基准基于预抽取文本检索，省略了读取扫描图像环节。而现实中企业将数十年财务记录以扫描 PDF 存于共享盘，并通过 MCP 服务器向智能体开放。作者因此构建同时要求"检索 + 扫描图像阅读"的端到端基准。
AI.method: 构建 TreasuryQA Bench：70 个问题、1,435 份扫描版美国财政部出版物，托管于 Veris 的高保真 Dropbox 副本中。每个任务中智能体需经由 Dropbox MCP 服务器定位相关文件，使用 Reducto 托管 OCR 服务器或自有工具读取所需页面，最终输出单一精确数值。采用 Python 评分器，将答案与正确值周边的可接受区间比对。共评测十个智能体，并额外控制扫描质量（模糊程度）考察其对性能的影响。
AI.result: 最佳智能体 Claude Opus 5.5（Claude Code）解决 64.8% 的尝试，最差 GPT-5.6 Terra（Codex）仅 16.7%，说明基准尚未饱和。扫描质量实验显示：扫描越模糊，所有智能体的解决率越低。失败尝试中多数给出错误数字而非拒答，最常见错误原因是 OCR 对扫描件中数字的误读。论文另附三个完整示例及其答案。
AI.conclusion: 该基准表明，真实场景下"检索 + 扫描件 OCR + 精确数值抽取"的组合仍是智能体的显著短板，且性能对图像质量高度敏感；错误主要源于数字误读而非检索或推理失败，指向 OCR 鲁棒性是关键改进方向。

title: Raincheck: Deferred Multimodal Prefill for Efficient Multi-Turn MLLM Inference
summary: Multi-turn conversations with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) reuse input context, but long multimodal inputs increase time to first token (TTFT). Query-aware hard pruning reduces prefill tokens but permanently excludes information that later questions may require. We propose Raincheck, a framework for deferred multimodal prefill that decouples initial token selection from later information availability. An existing pruning method selects tokens for initial prefill; Raincheck preserves and progressively prefills unselected tokens in source order using unused compute capacity during decode. Unfinished prefill continues after answer return during available scheduling gaps. Attention visibility control and affine state mapping enable context updates after generation begins in full-attention and hybrid recurrent models. Prefill-decode fusion reduces repeated weight reads. We evaluate Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen3.5-9B with 30% initial multimodal-token retention. Across both models and four pruning methods, Raincheck recovers on average 77.7% and 60.4% of the quality lost to matched hard pruning on MultiVerse and ConvBench, respectively. On MultiVerse, the SGLang implementation reduces mean first-turn TTFT by up to 24.1% relative to full prefill, with less than 0.5% increase in mean time per output token (TPOT).

AI.tldr: 提出Raincheck框架，将多模态预填充从"一次性硬剪枝"改为"延迟渐进预填充"，在解码阶段利用空闲算力补齐被剪掉的视觉token，从而在保留长上下文信息的同时降低首token时延。
AI.motivation: 多轮多模态对话会复用输入上下文，长多模态输入导致TTFT显著上升；查询感知的硬剪枝虽减少预填充token数，但会永久丢弃后续轮次可能需要的视觉信息，造成质量损失，需要一种不牺牲信息可得性的加速方案。
AI.method: 1) 用现有剪枝方法为初始预填充选取token；2) Raincheck保留未选中token，并在解码阶段按源顺序、利用未使用的算力渐进预填充；解码后若预填充未完成，则在调度空隙中继续；3) 通过注意力可见性控制与仿射状态映射，使完全注意力模型与混合循环模型在生成开始后仍能更新上下文；4) 预填充-解码融合减少权重重复读取。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL-8B与Qwen3.5-9B上，初始多模态token保留率30%：跨两种模型、四种剪枝方法，Raincheck在MultiVerse与ConvBench上分别平均挽回硬剪枝所损失质量的77.7%与60.4%；MultiVerse上SGLang实现使平均首轮TTFT相对全量预填充最多降低24.1%，平均TPOT增幅小于0.5%。
AI.conclusion: 将token选择与信息可得性解耦的延迟预填充，可在几乎不增加解码开销的前提下显著缓解硬剪枝的质量损失并获得TTFT收益，是一种可推广的多模态预填充加速策略。

title: ExplainCC: Explaining Correlated Clusters by Node Labels
summary: An increasingly important requirement for clustering algorithms is that decisions and outcomes need to be clearly understandable for human users. We address this requirement for the Correlation Clustering (CC) problem, in case the objects to be clustered are accompanied by labels. In CC one seeks to partition a set of objects into clusters based on pairwise similarity and dissimilarity information. Our proposed model only considers clusters that can be explained by a label tree, which is essentially a decision tree that partitions the objects according to labels. The goal is to find an explainable partition of the data that minimizes the CC objective function. We formalize this problem from a theoretical viewpoint, and prove several hardness of approximation results, also when constraining the size of the tree. Our proposed greedy method finds locally optimal splits, and works recursively in a top-down approach. To efficiently compute the best split, we carefully maintain certain counters. An experimental evaluation demonstrates its effectiveness. The proposed algorithm processes graphs with over million edges in a few minutes, can find the ground truth in synthetic data, and is able to produce interpretable clusters in real world networks.

AI.tldr: 本文将标签可解释性引入相关聚类（CC），提出以标签树解释划分的模型，给出近似难度结果与自顶向下贪心算法，实验证明可扩展且可解释。
AI.motivation: 聚类结果需对人类用户清晰可理解，而现有相关聚类只优化成对相似/不相似目标，缺乏用标签解释簇结构的机制。
AI.method: 在相关聚类框架下要求簇可由标签树（按标签划分对象的决策树）解释；形式化该问题并证明近似困难性（含约束树规模情形）；提出自顶向下递归贪心算法，通过维护计数器高效求局部最优分割。
AI.result: 证明多种近似困难性结论；实验显示算法数分钟处理百万边级图，在合成数据上恢复真实划分，在真实网络中得到可解释簇。
AI.conclusion: 标签树约束为相关聚类提供了可解释性且保持实用性，贪心+计数维护策略高效可扩展，兼顾理论难度刻画与经验效果。

title: Joint Rigid Alignment and Morphable Reconstruction from Partial 3D Face Scans
summary: Aligning a partial, real-world 3D face scan to a canonical representation requires solving two coupled problems at once: estimating the rigid pose that brings the scan into a common frame, and completing the facial shape in regions the scan never observed. Existing pipelines typically decouple these steps, running a generic point-cloud registration front end followed by a separate non-rigid fitting or deformation stage. Building on the GeoTransformer superpoint-matching architecture, we propose a single network that predicts both a rigid pose and a shape-complete point cloud in one forward pass: a cross-attention regressor, conditioned on transformer point features and predicted coarse correspondences, maps a partial scan to per-patch coefficients of a 3D morphable face model learned offline from a corpus of 8,000 identities. The resulting morphed template is then used, in the same forward pass, as the target for fine-grained Sinkhorn matching and rigid pose estimation, supervised purely by geometric alignment to ground-truth morphed geometry, so no hand-labeled coefficients are required. Against six classical and learned non-rigid registration baselines on held-out identities, our method leads the strongest ones by 3-4 times on per-vertex error and baselines that collapse the head onto the visible region by more than an order of magnitude, and is simultaneously the most accurate and fastest method on ground-truth-free scans from two independent real-scan datasets, NoW and NPHM. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出单一网络在单次前向中同时预测刚性位姿与形状完整点云：基于GeoTransformer，用交叉注意力回归器由点特征与粗对应预测3DMM逐块系数，morph模板再作精细Sinkhorn匹配与位姿估计的目标，仅用几何对齐监督。
AI.motivation: 将局部真实3D人脸扫描对齐到规范表示需同时解决刚体位姿估计与非观测区域形状补全，而现有流程通常解耦这两步（通用点云配准前端＋独立非刚性拟合/形变），存在误差累积与效率问题。
AI.method: 以GeoTransformer超点匹配架构为基础，单网络一次前向：交叉注意力回归器以transformer点特征和预测的粗对应为条件，将局部扫描映射为从8000个身份语料离线学习的3DMM的逐patch系数；得到的morph模板在同一次前向中作为细粒度Sinkhorn匹配与刚体位姿估计的目标；监督仅来自与真值morph几何的几何对齐，无需人工标注系数。
AI.result: 在留出身份上与6个经典及学习的非刚性配准基线比较，逐顶点误差领先最强基线3-4倍，对将头部坍缩到可见区域的基线领先一个数量级以上；在NoW与NPHM两个独立真实扫描数据集的无真值扫描上，同时为最准确且最快的方法。
AI.conclusion: 刚体位姿估计与形状补全可在单一网络中联合端到端学习，3DMM系数回归作为模板先验有效桥梁，几何自监督替代系数标注，兼顾精度与速度。

title: Efficient Agentic Audio-Visual Question Answering through Toolset Pruning and Modality Consolidation
summary: Fine-grained audio-visual question answering (AVQA) requires models to resolve complex cross-modal correspondences and temporally grounding from sparsely distributed evidence. Omni-modal agents, which autonomously orchestrate perception tools to actively collect evidence, achieve strong performance, but it remains unclear whether active perception from both audio and visual modalities depends on broad specialized toolsets, especially audio or visual modality-specific tools. Such systems may also introduce long execution trajectories and substantial inference cost. We investigate whether comparable performance can be retained with a compact workflow exposing only essential perceptual capabilities. Starting from the specialized-tool OmniAgent, we conduct staged controlled experiments that prune the toolset and progressively consolidate modality-specific tools into omni-modal tools, motivating a two-tool agent comprising only Omni-modal captioning and Omni-modal QA. Across three widely used AVQA benchmarks, our compact agent achieves comparable or better accuracy than the specialized-tool agent while reducing inference cost by around 70%.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，全模态智能体在细粒度AVQA中的强性能不需依赖大规模专用工具集；仅保留全模态描述与全模态问答两个工具的精简智能体即可达到相当或更优精度，同时推理成本降低约70%。
AI.motivation: 细粒度AVQA需要解决跨模态对应与时序定位，证据稀疏分布。全模态智能体通过主动调用感知工具收集证据效果强，但其主动感知是否依赖丰富的专用工具集（尤其音频/视觉模态专属工具）尚不明确，且长执行轨迹带来高推理成本。
AI.method: 以专用工具版OmniAgent为起点，设计分阶段受控实验：逐步剪枝工具集，并将模态专属工具渐进合并为全模态工具；据此推导出仅含Omni-modal captioning与Omni-modal QA的双工具智能体。
AI.result: 在三个常用AVQA基准上，精简智能体精度与专用工具智能体相当或更优，推理成本降低约70%。
AI.conclusion: 主动式音视频感知并不依赖大量模态专属工具，核心感知能力即可支撑可比性能；紧凑工作流可显著降低推理开销，为高效全模态智能体设计提供依据。

title: Red-Teaming Large Language Models in Low-Resource African Languages: A Case Study of Yoruba and Nigerian Pidgin
summary: As large language models (LLMs) become more widespread in Africa, their safety in low-resource languages remains largely untested since most red-teaming work focuses on English. This study evaluates six state-of-the-art LLMs using 400 explicit adversarial prompts in Yoruba and Nigerian Pidgin, categorised into four harm categories. The responses were scored by native-speaker annotators and reliability was assessed using Cohen's $κ$. While models that rejected up to 69% of English prompts rejected as few as 0% in Yoruba, this was not because they were safer, but because they failed to understand the prompts. Attack success rates increased for most models in the Nigerian languages, with GPT-4o Mini demonstrating the most significant cross-lingual safety discrepancy (+0.23 in Yoruba). When models did engage with adversarial prompts, many of the responses were harmful, with rates of harmful content reaching 0.63 in English and 0.50 in Nigerian Pidgin. The most difficult harm category to detect was cultural stereotypes and discrimination (ASR = 0.44 in Nigerian Pidgin). Comprehension in Yoruba was low across most models, and this directly suppressed apparent attack success without indicating actual safety. Gemini 2.0 Flash was the most consistent model across languages. Despite its explicit training in African languages, Aya 101 had the highest attack success rate in English (0.60) and one of the lowest Yoruba comprehension rates (0.28). These results demonstrate that English-centric safety alignment does not transfer to Nigerian languages, highlighting the urgent need for language-specific safety evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文对6个先进LLM用约鲁巴语和尼日利亚皮钦语共400条显式对抗提示进行安全评测，发现低资源语言下看似"拒绝率高"实为模型理解失败，跨语言安全对齐并不迁移。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在非洲普及，其安全性在低资源语言中几乎未被检验，现有红队测试主要集中于英语。研究旨在揭示英语中心的安全对齐能否迁移到尼日利亚语言，并量化低资源语言下的真实安全风险。
AI.method: 选取6个先进LLM，构造400条显式对抗提示，覆盖约鲁巴语与尼日利亚皮钦语，并划分为四类危害类别；由母语标注者对回答打分，用Cohen's κ评估标注者间信度，并对比英语基线计算攻击成功率（ASR）、跨语言安全差异及理解率。
AI.result: 英语下拒绝率最高达69%的模型，在约鲁巴语中拒绝率低至0%；多数模型在尼日利亚语言中ASR上升，GPT-4o Mini跨语言安全差距最大（约鲁巴语+0.23）。模型真正响应对抗提示时有害内容比例高（英语0.63、皮钦语0.50）；最难检测的危害类别为文化刻板印象与歧视（皮钦语ASR=0.44）。约鲁巴语理解率普遍偏低（Aya 101仅0.28），这种低理解率直接压低了表观ASR而非代表真实安全。Gemini 2.0 Flash跨语言表现最稳定；尽管Aya 101明确接受非洲语言训练，其英语ASR最高（0.60）。
AI.conclusion: 英语中心的安全对齐无法迁移到尼日利亚语言，"低拒绝/低ASR"可能只是理解失败造成的假象。研究强调必须开展语言特定的安全评测，并配套母语标注与理解度校准指标。

title: On the Generalization Gap of Streaming Federated Learning with Markovian Data
summary: Streaming federated learning (SFL) allows clients to train a shared model from continuously arriving data without retaining large local datasets. Such streams often exhibit temporal dependence, yet its effect on generalization remains poorly understood. In this paper we study the expected generalization gap of the aggregated model when client data follow Markov processes, using information-theoretic and rate-distortion techniques. Our framework accommodates heterogeneous Markovian dynamics across clients and distinguishes temporal dependence from information acquired during local learning. We establish bounds under cross-entropy loss, specializing them to Linear Next-Token Prediction (LNTP) and Self-Attention Next-Token Prediction (SANTP). These results quantify the effects of client count, communication rounds, sample size, data dimension, mixing time, and context length. In particular, they reveal a communication--generalization tradeoff: although frequent aggregation may help optimization, it can weaken generalization guarantees. They also suggest a potential advantage of distributed over centralized streaming learning under a fixed total data budget. Temporal dependence enters through the square root of the mixing time. By analyzing the history-state process, we obtain refined bounds with improved context-length dependence under suitable mixing conditions. Experiments on GPT-style language-model pretraining with TinyStories and real-world time-series forecasting illustrate how collaboration and communication frequency influence generalization under temporal dependence

AI.tldr: 本文用信息论与率失真方法研究流式联邦学习中客户端数据服从马尔可夫过程时聚合模型的期望泛化差距，给出可解到LNTP与SANTP的界，揭示"通信—泛化"权衡及分布式相对集中式的潜在优势。
AI.motivation: 流式联邦学习可从持续到达的数据训练共享模型而无需保存大数据集，但数据流常有时间相关性，其对泛化性的影响缺乏理论理解，尤其缺少对不同客户端异质马尔可夫动态的刻画。
AI.method: 基于信息论与率失真技术推导交叉熵损失下聚合模型的期望泛化界；框架容纳客户端间异质的马尔可夫动态，并将时间依赖与本地学习获取的信息区分开；界进一步特化到线性下一词预测（LNTP）与自注意力下一词预测（SANTP），并借助历史状态过程分析在合适混合条件下得到关于上下文长度依赖更优的精细界。
AI.result: 界显式量化客户端数、通信轮数、样本量、数据维度、混合时间与上下文长度的影响；揭示频繁聚合虽利于优化却可能削弱泛化保证的通信—泛化权衡；在固定总数据预算下提示分布式流式学习相对集中式学习的潜在优势；时间依赖以混合时间的平方根形式进入界中。
AI.conclusion: 作者建立了马尔可夫数据流下SFL的泛化理论框架，阐明时间依赖、协作规模与通信频率对泛化保证的作用；并在TinyStories上的GPT风格语言模型预训练与真实时间序列预测实验中验证了协作与通信频率在时间相关数据下对泛化的影响。

title: Edited Endpoints as Partial Goals for Image-to-Video Generation
summary: Edited endpoint images make the target of an image-to-video transition explicit and can improve transition completion, but also preserve context in the source image's layout. Full-frame endpoint conditioning turns this preserved context into requirements on the video's final state, potentially inducing temporal artifacts. We measure discontinuity with Hard-Cut (HC), late background reversal with Background Motion Reversal (BMR), and motion suppression with Dynamic Degree (DD). These artifacts appear across five video models spanning training-free and learned endpoint conditioning, in model-specific forms. We study Partial, a selective conditioning scheme that constrains only an edit-relevant region estimated from image-editor attention and leaves the remaining terminal content to the video model. Across three backbones on TC-Bench-I2V, Partial reduces temporal artifacts relative to full-frame conditioning, with no significant difference in Transition Completion Ratio (TCR); on Wan2.2-Turbo, uniformly weakening conditioning does not reproduce these reductions. A donor-context intervention keeps full-frame conditioning and replaces only the context outside the edit-relevant region with the final frame of a Partial video. It lowers HC and BMR on HunyuanVideo-1.5 and lowers BMR while restoring DD on Wan2.2-Turbo, with no significant difference in TCR, so constraint extent alone does not account for these artifacts. Together, these findings suggest that edited endpoints should serve as partial future goals, although edit relevance does not guarantee future validity. Code and data will be released at https://github.com/wannagetacat/Edited-Endpoints-I2V.

AI.tldr: 编辑端点图像虽能提升图像到视频过渡完成率，但全帧端点条件化会把源图布局当作对未来帧的要求，诱发硬切、背景运动反转与动态度抑制等时序伪影；作者提出仅约束编辑相关区域的 Partial 条件化方案，在三个骨干网络上降低伪影且不损害过渡完成率。
AI.motivation: 编辑端点图像使图像到视频过渡的目标显式化，可改善过渡完成；但端点图像同时保留了源图布局的上下文，一旦以全帧方式条件化，这些上下文就变成对视频终态的要求，从而产生时序伪影。作者希望厘清这一权衡并寻找缓解方式。
AI.method: 提出三个伪影度量：Hard-Cut（HC，硬切换）、Background Motion Reversal（BMR，后期背景运动反转）、Dynamic Degree（DD，动态度抑制）。提出 Partial 选择性条件化：利用图像编辑器的注意力估计编辑相关区域，仅对该区域施加约束，其余终态内容交由视频模型自行生成。另设计 donor-context 干预实验：保留全帧条件，仅将编辑相关区域之外的上下文替换为 Partial 视频的末帧，以解耦“约束范围”与“约束内容”。评测覆盖五种视频模型（含无需训练与学习式端点条件化）及三个骨干网络（TC-Bench-I2V，含 Wan2.2-Turbo、HunyuanVideo-1.5）。
AI.result: 伪影在五种模型中普遍存在且形态因模型而异。Partial 在三个骨干网络上相对全帧条件化降低时序伪影，TCR 无显著差异。在 Wan2.2-Turbo 上，均匀减弱条件强度无法复现这些降低。donor-context 干预在 HunyuanVideo-1.5 上降低 HC 与 BMR，在 Wan2.2-Turbo 上降低 BMR 并恢复 DD，二者 TCR 均无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 编辑端点应作为“部分未来目标”而非全帧约束；约束范围本身不足以解释伪影，约束内容（尤指编辑区域外的迁移上下文）同样关键。编辑相关性并不保证该内容在未来时刻仍然有效。

title: Dungeons & Dragons Encounter Analysis with Semi-Random Simulation in Foundry VTT
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 22nd Artificial Intelligence and Interactive Digital Entertainment Conference
summary: Dungeons & Dragons (D&D) is a tabletop roleplaying game (TTRPG) in which a group of players, guided by a Game Master, roleplay a fantasy adventure with simulated combat and improvisational narrative. In D&D, an encounter is a single instance of simulated combat, where the players must use their characters to attempt to defeat a selection of enemy characters that the GM controls. D&D has multiple systems that approximate encounter difficulty by summing individual difficulty values that designers predefine for each enemy. However, since players and enemies can have a wide variety of capabilities, encounter difficulty depends on more than just the estimated difficulty of each monster. For example, these metrics do not account for positioning and dungeon layout, the synergies between monster abilities, and player party composition. We have created a tool, Mage-Hand, that can simulate D&D encounters semi-randomly using Foundry Virtual Tabletop, a virtual tabletop (VTT) system. In this paper, we show that our tool's simulated winrates have a strong correlation with D&D's published difficulty evaluation metrics, while also better aligning with some players' reported experiences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Mage-Hand 工具，基于 Foundry 虚拟桌面半随机仿真 D&D 战斗遭遇，其模拟胜率与官方难度指标强相关，且更贴合玩家实际体验。
AI.motivation: D&D 现有遭遇难度评估系统通过累加设计者为每个敌人预设的难度值来近似难度，但玩家与敌人能力多样，难度还取决于站位与地牢布局、怪物能力协同、玩家队伍构成等因素，这些均未被现有指标考虑。
AI.method: 开发工具 Mage-Hand，利用 Foundry Virtual Tabletop（VTT）系统对 D&D 遭遇进行半随机仿真，从而在考虑多种战斗因素的情况下评估遭遇难度。
AI.result: Mage-Hand 的仿真胜率与 D&D 已发布的难度评估指标呈强相关，同时与部分玩家报告的实际体验更为一致。
AI.conclusion: 基于仿真的遭遇难度评估可作为官方解析式难度指标的补充，能够捕捉传统指标遗漏的战术与组合因素。

title: Incentivizing Self-Learning in Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) draw on parametric knowledge and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to solve knowledge-intensive tasks. Yet problem solving in unfamiliar domains calls for tightly coupled knowledge acquisition and reasoning, beyond factual retrieval and aggregation or learning solely from a preassembled context. We study self-learning -- autonomously retrieving, studying, and applying knowledge from long-form reference materials on the fly. To investigate this capability, we formulate a textbook-based mathematical problem-solving task. LLMs must navigate textbook exposition, learn and apply relevant principles, and construct proofs for exercises, with reference solutions withheld. We introduce a BookNavigator interface to support this human-inspired study process and incentivize self-learning through reinforcement learning (RL) with fine-grained rewards. Experiments show that our method improves performance across in-domain and out-of-domain textbooks and subjects, raising Intern-S2-Preview-35B's overall proof accuracy from 51.5% to 79.5% and outperforming RL-trained textbook-free and fixed-retrieval baselines. These gains extend to complex long-context benchmarks involving different task types, with improvements over the base model of 1.7 and 2.3 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus and CL-bench, respectively. Together, these findings suggest that RL can foster a domain-agnostic self-learning strategy, highlighting the potential of self-learning from long-form corpora to strengthen broader problem-solving capabilities on complex, long-context tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"自主学习"（self-learning）能力：模型需在长篇幅教材中自主检索、学习并应用知识来解决数学证明题，并通过BookNavigator接口与细粒度奖励的强化学习加以训练。
AI.motivation: LLM依赖参数化知识与RAG完成知识密集型任务，但面对陌生领域时，仅靠事实检索与聚合、或仅从预组装的上下文中学习，难以满足知识获取与推理紧密耦合的需求。
AI.method: 构建基于教材的数学解题任务（模型需浏览教材讲解、学习并应用原理、在无参考答案条件下构造证明）；设计BookNavigator交互接口模拟人类研读过程；采用强化学习结合细粒度奖励进行训练。
AI.result: 在域内与域外教材及学科上均提升；Intern-S2-Preview-35B总体证明准确率由51.5%升至79.5%，优于无教材RL基线与固定检索RL基线；在BrowseComp-Plus与CL-bench上分别较基模提升1.7与2.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: RL可培养与领域无关的自主学习策略，表明从长篇幅语料中自主学习能增强模型在复杂长上下文任务上的泛化解题能力。

title: SatOps-Decision: Low-Latency Discriminative Decisions for Onboard Satellite Communication Operations
summary: We propose SatOps-Decision, a method for low-latency decisions in satellite communication operations. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first application of Jev-style general-purpose discriminative decision models to satellite operations, and the accompanying benchmark is the first dedicated to this approach. The learned scorer, a locally adapted Laya encoder with its native decision head, selects among supplied operational answers in a single forward pass. The benchmark combines authored operational contracts, controlled state changes and independently checked labels in an auditable construction. Evaluation prioritizes complete-request latency and raw decision accuracy; all main accuracy comparisons use the same 1,024 held-out questions, separate from training and development. SatOps-Decision's local scorer has a median latency of 90.3 ms per decision, versus 493.9 ms for Qwen3.5-0.8B generation and 388.4 ms for OneJev1.6-0.8B: $5.47\times$ and $4.30\times$ speedups based on median request times in the measured FP32/MPS implementations. Its mean raw accuracy is 85.3%, versus 42.5% for frozen Laya, 40.7% for Qwen generation and 58.6% for OneJev. As cloud accuracy references, original Jev 1.14/1.13 reach 87.4/81.9%.

AI.tldr: 提出SatOps-Decision：将Jev风格通用判别式决策模型首次用于卫星通信运维，配首个专用基准；本地适配的Laya编码器+原生决策头单次前向从候选答案中选优，中位决策延迟90.3 ms（较Qwen3.5-0.8B生成快5.47×、较OneJev1.6-0.8B快4.30×），平均原始准确率85.3%（远超冻结Laya 42.5%、Qwen生成40.7%、OneJev 58.6%），接近云端Jev 1.14的87.4%。
AI.motivation: 卫星通信运维决策对延迟极度敏感，而生成式大模型逐token解码（如Qwen3.5-0.8B 493.9 ms、OneJev1.6-0.8B 388.4 ms）难以满足低延迟需求；同时该领域缺乏可审计、专用的评测基准，故需探索更高效的判别式决策范式。
AI.method: 采用Jev风格通用判别式决策模型：以本地适配（locally adapted）的Laya编码器为scorer，配合其原生决策头，在单次前向中从给定运维备选答案中选择最优项，无需生成式解码；构建专用基准，由人工编写的运维合约（operational contracts）、受控状态变更与独立校验标签三部分构成，具备可审计性；评估以完整请求延迟与原始决策准确率为核心指标，主准确率对比统一使用同一组1,024条留出问题（与训练、开发集分离），实验在FP32/MPS实现下测量。
AI.result: 本地scorer中位延迟90.3 ms/决策，相比Qwen3.5-0.8B生成（493.9 ms）与OneJev1.6-0.8B（388.4 ms）分别实现5.47×与4.30×加速（基于中位请求时间）；平均原始准确率85.3%，对比冻结Laya 42.5%、Qwen生成40.7%、OneJev 58.6%；作为云端精度参照，原始Jev 1.14/1.13分别达到87.4%/81.9%。
AI.conclusion: 判别式选优范式可在卫星运维场景中以数量级更低延迟取得显著高于同规模生成式/判别式基线的决策准确率，且性能逼近云端大模型Jev，同时首个可审计专用基准为后续研究提供了标准化评测平台。

title: Multi-level Constrained Learning for Underwater Image Enhancement
summary: Underwater image enhancement aims to correct color and recover detail degraded by wavelength-dependent attenuation, scattering, and noise. Paired-reference supervision constrains output similarity, but does not by itself specify the color mapping, the strength of local detail corrections, or consistency with the degraded observation. We propose MCL-UIE, a paired-supervised framework that addresses these requirements by constraining restoration operations and the training objective. Monotonic Chromatic Transform (MCT) restricts global color mapping in log-LMS space through positive diagonal entries and bounded cross-channel coefficients. Uncertainty-Gated Wavelet Reconstruction (UGWR) modulates high-frequency residuals with a learned confidence gate calibrated against normalized wavelet reconstruction errors. During training, Reference-Anchored Degradation Replay (RADR) renders the enhanced image and its paired reference using shared latent degradation proxies, encouraging both to reproduce the input. The three components share a restoration network that combines structured color correction, locally controlled detail recovery, and reference-anchored replay. MCL-UIE ranks first in thirteen of sixteen full-reference dataset-metric comparisons and produces competitive visual results on no-reference benchmarks. Objective ablations indicate that confidence calibration is most effective when combined with replay supervision. RADR is used only during training and adds no inference-time computation. Our code is available at https://github.com/Wangtao-Bao/MCL-UIE.

AI.tldr: 提出MCL-UIE成对监督水下图像增强框架，通过约束色彩映射操作、细节恢复强度与训练目标来弥补仅约束输出相似性的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有成对参考监督仅约束输出与参考的相似性，未明确指定颜色映射方式、局部细节修正强度以及与退化观测的一致性。
AI.method: 三个组件共享一个恢复网络：(1) MCT在log-LMS空间用正对角元与有界跨通道系数约束全局色彩映射；(2) UGWR用经归一化小波重构误差校准的学习置信门调制高频残差；(3) RADR在训练时用共享隐式退化代理渲染增强图与参考图，促使二者重现输入。
AI.result: 在16项全参考数据集-指标对比中13项排名第一；无参考基准上视觉效果具竞争力；消融显示置信校准在与回放监督结合时最有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化色彩校正、受控局部细节恢复与参考锚定回放三者结合提升水下图像增强；RADR仅用于训练，不增加推理开销。

title: Context Compaction for World Models
summary: World models let observers explore and interact with generated worlds. Recent work shows that when observers revisit a region, current models often fail to regenerate it consistently. We view this as a context retrieval problem. LLM agents manage context retrieval at two layers of their stack. At the model layer, the KV cache design determines how much context fits in memory. At the agent harness layer, harnesses such as Claude Code pick the context sent to the LLM. Prior work on world models has mostly focused only on the model layer. In this paper, we make three contributions. First, we build a benchmark to measure world model context retrieval. It generates new worlds for every episode, preventing a model from recalling rooms using training data. It also separates context retrieval from guesses based on nearby frames. Second, we build an agent harness that performs context compaction for world models, which to our knowledge no prior work has studied. Third, we use our benchmark to study four world model designs. Context compaction lets our world models retrieve rooms up to 4 times beyond their context window without retraining. However, world models with sliding-window attention lose most of their context retrieval when dreaming. Therefore, a dreaming world agent benefits more from extending the reach of its world model using context compaction than switching to sliding window attention at the model layer.

AI.tldr: 将世界模型的重访一致性问题建模为"上下文检索"问题，仿照LLM智能体的模型层+harness层双层结构，提出基准测试与上下文压缩harness，使世界模型在无需再训练的情况下检索超出上下文窗口最多4倍的房间。
AI.motivation: 近期工作表明，观察者重访某区域时，现有世界模型难以一致地重新生成该区域。作者将此视为上下文检索问题：LLM智能体在模型层（KV cache 设计决定内存可容纳的上下文量）与harness层（如 Claude Code 决定送入LLM的上下文）两个层面管理上下文检索；而此前世界模型研究大多只关注模型层，harness层被忽视。
AI.method: 三项贡献：(1) 构建衡量世界模型上下文检索的基准，每个episode生成新世界以避免模型凭训练数据"回忆"房间，并将上下文检索与基于邻近帧的猜测区分开；(2) 构建为世界模型执行上下文压缩（context compaction）的agent harness；(3) 用该基准研究四种世界模型设计。
AI.result: 上下文压缩使世界模型在不再训练的情况下，检索范围达到其上下文窗口的4倍；但采用滑动窗口注意力的世界模型在"dreaming"时丧失大部分上下文检索能力。因此，对dreaming世界智能体而言，用上下文压缩扩展世界模型的作用范围，比在模型层改用滑动窗口注意力更有利。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型的一致重访应作为上下文检索问题处理，且智能体harness层是关键但此前未被研究的杠杆：context compaction 可低成本（免再训练）扩展有效上下文，其收益优于模型层改用滑窗注意力。

title: When the Top Answer Decides: Gender Bias in Decision Models
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures. Code, stimuli and results: https://github.com/yhavinga/decision-model-gender-bias
summary: Decision models are language models built to route, classify and triage: they return option probabilities from one forward pass, and an application acts on the top answer. They are offered off the shelf, trained for the decision format rather than for fairness or any one application, and we found no bias measurement in their cards. We test TypeSafe's closed Jev and five open decision models on gender-swapped yes/no decisions about people (Tamkin et al., 2023), BBQ, StereoSet and the gender-bias studies of Fulgu and Capraro (2024). Five of the six give women significantly more favourable answers than men (+0.05 to +0.10 in log-odds), and a gender swap changes 1-3.5% of top answers (Jev's partly through its call-to-call variation). The makers' recommended confidence gate removes many biased commitments but raises the stereotyped share of those it keeps in ambiguous BBQ gender questions (granite-switch 0.76 to 0.85, pplx 0.81 to 1.00). Probes show gender preferences in the same models: all six rate violence for a greater good as more acceptable against a man than against a woman, and two default to "girl" when forced to guess a child's gender without a cue. Decision-level and probability-level measures differ, so audits should read a model as its application does.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了6个"决策模型"（输出选项概率的单次前向推理模型）在性别相关是非题上的偏见：6个中有5个对女性给出显著更有利的答案（log-odds +0.05~+0.10），性别互换会改变1–3.5%的顶层决策；厂商推荐的置信度门槛虽减少了有偏承诺，却在模糊BBQ性别题中提高了保留答案的刻板化比例；探针进一步揭示模型层面的性别偏好。作者主张审计须按应用实际消费模型的方式（决策层）来读模型。
AI.motivation: 决策模型以"开箱即用"形式提供，训练目标是适配决策格式而非公平性，且其模型卡中缺乏偏见测量。已有公平性审计多针对生成式语言模型，缺乏对"一次前向返回选项概率、应用直接取top答案"这类决策模型按其真实使用方式进行的偏见评估，因此作者要填补这一空白并检验厂商推荐的置信度门槛是否真的缓解偏见。
AI.method: 测试对象为TypeSafe的闭源Jev及5个开源决策模型。数据集/基准：性别互换的是非题（Tamkin et al., 2023）、BBQ、StereoSet，以及Fulgu与Capraro (2024)的性别偏见研究。指标同时覆盖决策层（top答案的性别互换翻转率）与概率层（log-odds差值）。并检验制造商推荐的置信度门槛对偏差承诺及其构成的影响，辅以探针（如"为更大善而施暴"可接受度、无线索猜测儿童性别）。
AI.result: 6个模型中5个对女性给出显著更有利答案（log-odds +0.05至+0.10）；性别互换改变1–3.5%的顶层答案（Jev部分源于调用间波动）。置信度门槛去除许多有偏承诺，但提高了保留答案中的刻板化占比（模糊BBQ性别题：granite-switch 0.76→0.85，pplx 0.81→1.00）。探针显示全部6个模型认为"为更大善而施暴"对男性比女性更可接受，2个模型在无线索时默认儿童为"girl"。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型存在系统性性别偏好，且偏向女性；置信度门槛并非无代价的缓解手段，可能放大被保留决策的刻板性。决策层与概率层测量结果不一致，因此公平性审计应按应用实际消费模型输出的方式（即以决策为单位）来评估模型。

title: Latent Decision Flow Rewards for Clinical Guideline Reasoning
summary: Clinical practice guidelines encode evidence-based recommendations as conditional decision flows, which makes them a natural source of process supervision for training reasoning models. Two properties of clinical reasoning make this supervision difficult to use. A decision flow consistent with a guideline does not by itself determine the correct answer for a given patient, which we call the path--answer gap, and several valid decision flows can support the same clinical decision, which we call path multiplicity. Current training approaches address parts of this problem. Answer rewards supervise the final decision, and process rewards computed against a reference flow supervise one valid decision flow per case. Supervised fine-tuning on annotated flows teaches guideline-consistent reasoning but constrains the model to one trajectory per case and can reduce answer accuracy. We introduce GUIDER, a method that jointly optimizes a decision flow controller and a reasoning policy. The controller learns to generate plausible decision flows from guideline-derived supervision, and the policy learns to generate a decision flow and a final answer for each patient case. GUIDER computes the process reward for the policy over several controller-generated flows, which accounts for path multiplicity, and gates this reward on answer correctness, which addresses the path--answer gap. Joint training allows the process supervision to evolve with the policy. On MedGUIDE, GUIDER with Qwen3-14B achieves 82.5 weighted accuracy and 73.5 guideline adherence, 3.3 and 3.1 points above the strongest clinical reinforcement learning baseline. With Qwen3-14B and Gemma4-12B backbones, GUIDER also improves over CRPO, MRPO, and FaithMed on the out-of-domain benchmarks AMEGA-LLM, RealMedQA, and CancerGUIDE.

AI.tldr: 提出 GUIDER，联合优化决策流控制器与推理策略，通过多流过程奖励与答案门控解决路径-答案鸿沟和路径多样性问题，在 MedGUIDE 上显著优于临床 RL 基线。
AI.motivation: 临床指南可编码为条件决策流，是训练推理模型过程监督的天然来源，但存在两个障碍：路径-答案鸿沟（符合指南的决策流本身不决定正确答案）与路径多样性（同一临床决策可由多条有效流支持）。现有方法要么仅监督最终答案，要么只针对单一参考流做过程奖励，SFT 则受限于单轨迹并可能降低答案准确率。
AI.method: GUIDER 同时训练一个决策流控制器和一个推理策略：控制器从指南派生监督中学习生成合理的决策流；策略为每个病例生成决策流与最终答案。过程奖励在控制器生成的多条流上计算以应对路径多样性，并以答案正确性作为门控以应对路径-答案鸿沟；联合训练使过程监督随策略共同演化。
AI.result: 在 MedGUIDE 上，Qwen3-14B 版 GUIDER 取得 82.5 加权准确率与 73.5 指南依从度，分别比最强临床 RL 基线高 3.3 与 3.1 分；在 Qwen3-14B 与 Gemma4-12B 骨干上，于 AMEGA-LLM、RealMedQA、CancerGUIDE 三个域外基准上亦优于 CRPO、MRPO 与 FaithMed。
AI.conclusion: 将指南决策流作为过程监督需同时处理路径-答案鸿沟与路径多样性；GUIDER 通过控制器-策略联合优化、多流过程奖励与答案门控实现有效监督，在域内与域外基准上均优于现有临床 RL 方法。

title: COGS: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Attribute-Aware Object-Level 3D Gaussian Splatting Perception
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027, Datasets and Benchmarks Track. 20 pages, including references and supplementary material
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is increasingly explored as an input representation for 3D perception. Yet it remains unclear how current 3D architectures exploit heterogeneous Gaussian attributes. This ambiguity makes accuracy hard to interpret and limits principled architecture design for 3DGS perception. However, existing object-level 3DGS datasets lack the appearance variation or artifact control needed for systematic attribute-level analysis. We introduce COGS, a large-scale 3DGS dataset with 15,675 artifact-filtered and appearance-rich objects across 40 categories. Built on COGS, we establish COGS-Bench for object classification and attribute-usage diagnosis, complemented by external validation. Our benchmark shows that Gaussian attributes are not uniformly beneficial: selected subsets can outperform the full attribute set, and the effects of appearance, opacity, and covariance-related attribute combinations vary substantially across architectures. We further study this finding with HALO, a reference model that preserves attribute-specific evidence before hierarchical aggregation. Experiments on COGS-Bench and external 3DGS datasets demonstrate that COGS supports systematic diagnosis of 3DGS attribute usage, while HALO highlights the value of role-preserving attribute organization. Our dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/XiaoZhengCV/COGS.

AI.tldr: 论文提出COGS大规模3DGS数据集（15,675个物体、40类）及COGS-Bench基准，系统诊断3D架构对异构高斯属性的利用方式，并给出保留属性角色的参考模型HALO。
AI.motivation: 现有3D感知模型以3DGS为输入表示时，不同异构高斯属性（外观、不透明度、协方差等）如何被利用尚不明确，导致精度难以解释、架构设计缺乏原则；而现有物体级3DGS数据集缺乏外观多样性与伪影控制，无法支撑属性级系统分析。
AI.method: 构建COGS数据集（15,675个经伪影过滤、外观丰富的物体，覆盖40类）；基于该数据集建立COGS-Bench，用于物体分类与属性使用诊断，并进行外部验证；提出HALO参考模型，在层级聚合前保留属性特异证据，实现角色保持的属性组织。
AI.result: 基准实验表明高斯属性并非均匀有益：属性子集可优于完整属性集，且外观、不透明度与协方差相关属性组合的效果在不同架构间差异显著；在COGS-Bench与外部3DGS数据集上，COGS支持对属性使用进行系统诊断，HALO验证了角色保持式属性组织的价值。
AI.conclusion: COGS与COGS-Bench为3DGS感知的属性级诊断提供了可控、可复现的实验基础，揭示属性效用依赖架构，并说明以角色保持方式组织高斯属性有助于原则化的架构设计。

title: Syntactic Segmentation and Collage Generation for Videogame Levels with Perceptual Distance
comment: 11 pages, 12 figures, 22nd Artificial Intelligence and Interactive Digital Entertainment Conference
summary: In procedural videogame level design, many existing techniques combine hand-authored level chunks. Some existing analysis techniques also rely on a higher-level graph structure which abstracts the level design. In this paper, we explore techniques for computing both of these things automatically from an existing design. We introduce the concept of perceptual distance, based on analysis techniques from the architecture subfield of Space Syntax. We use this perceptual distance to segment level designs with hierarchical clustering. We compare with past work on StarCraft analysis, show results on rooms from Super Metroid, and also demonstrate a proof-of-concept level generation algorithm based on this segmentation method.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于Space Syntax的"感知距离"度量，用层次聚类实现游戏关卡自动分割，并据此构建高层图结构，进而实现概念验证性的关卡生成。
AI.motivation: 现有程序化关卡设计多依赖手工编写的关卡块(chunk)，而分析技术又依赖人工定义的高层图结构抽象，二者均难以从已有设计中自动获得，作者希望将这两项工作自动化。
AI.method: 借鉴建筑学Space Syntax子领域的分析技术定义"感知距离"(perceptual distance)，将其用于关卡设计上的层次聚类(hierarchical clustering)，从而自动分割关卡(segmentation)并推导高层图结构；与既有StarCraft分析工作进行对比，并在Super Metroid的房间上验证。
AI.result: 在StarCraft数据上与先前分析方法进行了对比，在Super Metroid房间上给出了分割结果，并基于该分割方法实现了一个概念验证(proof-of-concept)的关卡生成算法。
AI.conclusion: 感知距离+层次聚类能够从既有设计中自动完成关卡分割与高层结构抽取，且该分割可作为关卡生成的可行基础，为程序化关卡设计与关卡分析提供统一视角。

title: Grammar Control for Language Learning with Sequential Monte Carlo and Small Language Models
summary: Second language learners benefit from exposure to level-appropriate grammar in interactive language use. While prompted frontier language models can usually produce target grammar structures, less resource-intensive models that can be run on device often fail in this task. We use sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) to steer dialogue turn generation in small lan- language models toward target grammar constructions from an expert-developed pedagogical resource. With a minimal set of hand-coded potential functions, SMC achieves near-perfect coverage of target grammar, enabling small models to outperform state-of-the-art results from models 140 times larger. We also use code synthesis with frontier models to generate new potentials, showing that our method scales to hundreds of target grammar skills with no need for additional training or supervised data.

AI.tldr: 用小规模语言模型配合序列蒙特卡洛(SMC)推理时引导，使其在对话轮生成中稳定产出目标语法结构，效果超过大140倍的模型。
AI.motivation: 二语学习者需要通过符合其水平的语法输入进行互动式语言学习。前沿大模型经提示可生成目标语法结构，但可在设备端运行的低资源小模型在此任务上常失败，因此需要一种无需额外训练、能提升小模型语法可控性的方法。
AI.method: 将对话轮生成视为受约束的序列生成问题，采用序列蒙特卡洛(SMC)对生成过程进行推理时引导（steering），以少量手工编写的势函数(potential functions)刻画对目标语法结构的偏好；这些目标语法来自专家编写的教学资源。此外，利用前沿模型的代码合成能力自动生成新的势函数。
AI.result: 在少量手写势函数下，SMC 对目标语法的覆盖接近完美，小模型的表现优于参数量大140倍的现有最优模型；通过代码合成生成势函数，方法可扩展到数百个目标语法技能，且无需额外训练或监督数据。
AI.conclusion: SMC 推理时引导是一种高效、可扩展的语法可控生成方案，使设备端小模型胜任二语教学场景，并可通过自动合成势函数扩展到大规模语法技能集合。

title: Adversarial Self-Distillation
summary: Even though current safety-aligned language models are able to refuse harmful requests, their guard can still be bypassed by adversarial perturbations. As in other domains, adversarial training is considered a standard defense. However, due to the autoregressive nature of language generation, supervised finetuning on template refusals does not necessarily teach the model to refuse. Evidence of this is that the adversarially trained model still complies when the attacker injects a compliant prefill. We propose Adversarial Self-Distillation (ASD), which extends a model's own safe behavior to the space of adversarial perturbations. The teacher (the model itself given the clean prompt) can refuse the harmful request by default, or with the help of an additional instruction in its context. ASD distills this knowledge to the student (which is the same model under attack) at the prefixes that the student visits (due to on-policy sampling). These potentially include compliant openings. ASD achieves lower attack success than state-of-the-art defenses with little loss in multiple-choice accuracy, and it becomes able to recover a refusal even after a compliant opening.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对抗自蒸馏（Adversarial Self-Distillation, ASD），将模型自身的拒答行为扩展到对抗扰动空间，使模型即使在被诱导出顺从性开头（compliant prefill/opening）后仍能恢复拒答，攻击成功率低于SOTA防御且多选题准确率损失很小。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐模型虽能拒绝有害请求，但仍可被对抗扰动绕过；由于语言生成的自回归特性，对模板式拒答做监督微调并不一定能真正教会模型拒答——对抗训练后的模型在攻击者注入顺从性prefill时仍会顺从。
AI.method: 提出ASD：教师模型为给定干净提示的模型自身，它可默认拒答，或借助上下文中的额外指令拒答；学生在攻击下即同一模型，通过在学生on-policy采样所访问的前缀（包括潜在的顺从性开头）上将教师的拒答知识蒸馏给学生。
AI.result: ASD的攻击成功率低于先进防御方法，同时在多选题准确率上损失很小，并能在出现顺从性开头后恢复拒答。
AI.conclusion: 将自蒸馏与on-policy前缀覆盖结合，可有效提升模型对对抗扰动的拒答鲁棒性，克服模板微调在自回归生成下失效的问题。

title: Seeing and Imagining as One: Unified Video Generation and 4D Perception for Embodied World Modeling
summary: Embodied world models should not only imagine plausible futures, but also perceive the geometric, semantic, and motion structure of the evolving world. We present GenSight, a unified embodied world model that brings future video generation and dense perception into a single pretrained video diffusion transformer. GenSight uses a unified spatiotemporal representation for video, depth, embodiment segmentation, and first-frame-relative 2D flow. Built on a shared DiT backbone, GenSight uses lightweight task modulation to predict all modalities within the same architecture. All tasks are jointly optimized within a unified velocity prediction space. At inference, GenSight supports two complementary modes: multi-step future video generation with aligned dense predictions and single-step dense perception from an observed video. By unifying modality representation, model architecture, and prediction space, GenSight avoids separate modality-specific pipelines and couples appearance, geometry, semantics, and motion in a shared representation. It promotes cross-modal consistency and allows dense perception to benefit from the spatiotemporal priors learned through video generation. Trained on embodied manipulation data spanning multiple robot embodiments and human-hand interactions, GenSight demonstrates strong performance in both video generation and dense 4D perception, highlighting the effectiveness of unifying seeing and imagining for embodied world modeling.

AI.tldr: GenSight 是一个统一的具身世界模型，将未来视频生成与稠密感知整合进单一预训练视频扩散 Transformer 中。
AI.motivation: 具身世界模型不仅要想象合理的未来，还应感知演化世界中的几何、语义与运动结构；而现有方法通常为各模态构建独立流水线，难以耦合外观、几何、语义与运动信息。
AI.method: 采用统一的时空表示编码视频、深度、具身分割和相对首帧的2D光流；基于共享 DiT 主干，用轻量任务调制在同一架构内预测所有模态，全部任务在统一的 velocity prediction 空间联合优化。推理支持两种模式：多步未来视频生成并给出对齐的稠密预测，以及由观测视频进行单步稠密感知。
AI.result: 在多机器人具身与人手交互的操控数据上训练，在视频生成与稠密4D感知两方面均取得强劲性能，跨模态一致性好，稠密感知可受益于视频生成学到的时空先验。
AI.conclusion: 统一模态表示、模型架构与预测空间可避免模态专属流水线，实现"看见与想象"的统一，是具身世界建模的有效路径。

title: Agentic AI Reasoning and Learned Sampling for Task-Aware Projection Selection in Sparse-View CT: Predicting Hemodynamics
summary: Sparse-view computed tomography (CT) reduces the number of acquired projections, but conventional sampling strategies are designed primarily for image reconstruction rather than for downstream physical inference. Here, we investigate optimal task-aware projection selection for directly predicting hemodynamics from sparse CT angiography (CTA) measurements. Using computational fluid dynamics simulations of intracranial aneurysms, we generate synthetic fan-beam CTA projections and train a Fourier neural operator (FNO) to predict two targets: the spatially resolved time-averaged wall shear stress (TAWSS) field and the spatially averaged TAWSS. The FNO was coupled with optimal input selection for simultaneous optimal sampling and training. Our goal was to investigate if agentic AI could discover optimal sampling strategies that outperform current methods. We compared fixed uniform and golden-angle sampling with three task-aware optimal selection strategies: Gumbel-Softmax, a Soft top-K method, and an agentic AI selector. The methods were compared at different view selection budgets. A detailed analysis of the AI agent was performed to understand its reasoning and performance. For spatially resolved TAWSS, Agentic and Soft top-K achieve the lowest mean errors (Agentic performs slightly better) and substantially outperform fixed sampling under extreme sparsity. For spatially averaged TAWSS, optimized selection becomes important at extremely sparse acquisitions. Analysis of the selected masks reveals multiple distinct subsets concentrated around informative regions. Moreover, masks optimized for hemodynamic prediction yield poor image reconstructions, showing that task-optimal acquisition differs fundamentally from reconstruction-optimal acquisition. This work suggests the possibility of designing sparse acquisitions directly around downstream physical quantities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究面向下游血流动力学预测的稀疏视角CT投影选择策略，比较固定采样（均匀、黄金角）与三种任务感知选择方法（Gumbel-Softmax、Soft top-K、智能体AI选择器），发现任务最优采样与重建最优采样本质不同。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角CT可减少投影数，但传统采样策略主要为图像重建设计，而非为下游物理推断设计；作者希望探索是否能围绕下游物理量直接设计稀疏采集方案，并检验智能体AI能否发现优于现有方法的采样策略。
AI.method: 基于颅内动脉瘤的CFD仿真生成合成扇形束CTA投影，训练Fourier神经算子（FNO）预测两个目标：空间分辨的时间平均壁面剪应力（TAWSS）场与空间平均TAWSS；将FNO与最优输入选择耦合，实现采样与训练同步优化。对比固定均匀采样、黄金角采样与三种任务感知最优选择策略（Gumbel-Softmax、Soft top-K、智能体AI选择器），在不同视角预算下评测，并对AI智能体进行详细推理与性能分析。
AI.result: 对空间分辨TAWSS，Agentic与Soft top-K取得最低平均误差（Agentic略优），在极端稀疏下显著优于固定采样；对空间平均TAWSS，优化选择仅在极稀疏采集时重要。所选掩码呈现多个集中于信息丰富区域的各异子集；且为血流动力学预测优化的掩码图像重建效果差。
AI.conclusion: 任务最优采集与重建最优采集存在本质差异，稀疏采集可围绕下游物理量直接设计，为任务感知稀疏CT采集提供了可行性依据。

title: KV Cache Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
summary: KV cache quantization is well studied for autoregressive language models, where cached prefix states are exact under causal attention and quantization is mainly a cache reconstruction problem. Diffusion language models (dLLMs) break this assumption. Fast dLLM inference reuses KV states across denoising steps, but bidirectional token representations can change as masked tokens are revealed, so the reused cache may already differ from full recomputation before quantization is applied. We study KV cache quantization under this cache-reuse error. We adapt KIVI and KVQuant to Fast-dLLM-style prefix and dual cache reuse, and introduce TRACE and dLLM-KVQ. TRACE reconstructs feasible dLLM reveal trajectories from prompt-answer pairs, providing calibration states that match iterative masked decoding. dLLM-KVQ uses these trajectories to choose per-layer K-cache entries that remain in high precision according to output- and attention-level behavior metrics, while applying standard low-bit value quantization. Across LLaDA and Dream evaluations on GSM8K, HumanEval, MATH, and MBPP, dLLM-KVQ achieves the highest average score among quantized methods across the reported 4-bit and 2-bit prefix/dual cache settings.

AI.tldr: 该文研究扩散语言模型(dLLM)在Fast-dLLM式KV缓存复用下的KV缓存量化问题，提出轨迹重建方法TRACE与量化方法dLLM-KVQ，在多项基准上取得量化方法中的最高平均分。
AI.motivation: 自回归模型的KV量化将缓存视为因果注意力下的精确前缀状态，量化主要是缓存重建问题；而dLLM快速推理跨去噪步复用KV，双向表示随掩码token揭示而变化，复用缓存本身已存在误差，需在"缓存复用误差"条件下重新审视KV量化。
AI.method: 将KIVI与KVQuant适配到Fast-dLLM式前缀缓存与双缓存复用场景；提出TRACE，从提示-答案对重构可行的dLLM揭示轨迹，生成与迭代掩码解码匹配的校准状态；提出dLLM-KVQ，利用这些轨迹按输出级与注意力级行为指标，选择逐层保持高精度的K缓存条目，同时对V缓存采用标准低比特量化。
AI.result: 在LLaDA与Dream上，于GSM8K、HumanEval、MATH、MBPP评测，dLLM-KVQ在报告的4比特与2比特前缀/双缓存设置下，平均分均高于各量化方法。
AI.conclusion: dLLM场景中缓存复用误差是KV量化的关键因素；基于揭示轨迹的校准与逐层K条目精度选择可有效缓解该误差，提升低比特量化下的下游性能。

title: Alpha-TCM: A Nine-Layer Framework for TCM-Guided Multimodal Inference and Structured-Prior Auditing
summary:
Alpha-TCM makes two contributions under a central thesis: auditable systems should separate domain knowledge, case evidence, probabilistic inference, and downstream authority. First, it proposes a nine-layer TCM-oriented architecture covering semantic definitions, multimodal acquisition, quality control, provenance-bearing knowledge, probabilistic inference, longitudinal updating, constrained decisions, language interaction, and human governance. Each layer specifies its information contract, failure boundary, dependencies, and validation status. This is a system-design proposal, not a claim of complete clinical implementation.
  Second, a controlled synthetic prototype instantiates Layers 1-5 to audit the knowledge-evidence interface. Four conditional-Gaussian encoders process synthetic tongue images, pulse waveforms, inquiry fields, and text, while a frozen bridge predicts a five-dimensional synthetic outcome. A versioned contextual prior is compiled independently of the renderer. Fusion removes duplicated reference-prior information before adding context. Equal-information controls, prior regularization, graded contamination, and structural corruption test contextual benefits, Bayesian specificity, and conflict detection.
  Across ten paired seeds and four training sizes, contextual knowledge improved mean absolute error over marginal committee fusion at 600 and 1,200 cases, but not over equal-information neural controls. Fully incorrect context harmed performance at every size, while prior effects were inconsistent and conflict scores did not track case-level damage. The results support contextual structure in low-data synthetic settings, not a specifically Bayesian advantage. The prototype establishes no claims about TCM theory or clinical, diagnostic, therapeutic, causal, longitudinal, or transfer validity.

AI.tldr: Alpha-TCM 提出"领域知识、病例证据、概率推断与下游权限应相互分离"的可审计系统论题，给出九层中医架构设计，并用合成原型审计知识—证据接口，结果仅支持低数据条件下上下文结构的价值，而非贝叶斯特异性优势。
AI.motivation: 可审计系统需要明确区分领域知识、病例证据、概率推断与下游决策权限，避免知识、证据与推断混杂而无法追溯；现有系统缺乏分层信息契约与失效边界的规范。
AI.method: 提出九层中医导向架构（语义定义、多模态采集、质量控制、带溯源知识、概率推断、纵向更新、受约束决策、语言交互、人类治理），每层规定信息契约、失效边界、依赖与验证状态。用受控合成原型实例化第1–5层：四个条件高斯编码器分别处理舌象、脉波、问诊字段与文本，冻结桥接层预测五维合成结局；与渲染器独立编译的版本化情境先验；融合前去除重复参考先验信息；设置等信息对照、先验正则、分级污染与结构破坏实验，检验上下文收益、贝叶斯特异性与冲突检测；10个配对种子×4种训练规模。
AI.result: 在600与1200例规模下，情境知识相较边际委员会融合降低平均绝对误差，但不及等信息神经对照；完全错误的上下文在全部规模上均损害性能；先验效应不一致；冲突分数不能追踪个案级损害。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持低数据合成场景中上下文结构的效用，但不支持"贝叶斯特异性优势"；原型对中医理论及临床、诊断、治疗、因果、纵向与迁移效度均不作任何主张。

title: DeCoRL: Decomposed Consistency Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Image Composition
summary: Multi-image composition (MICo) is a critical yet challenging capability for large-scale image editing models, where consistency degrades rapidly as the number of reference images increases. While supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can equip models with basic MICo ability, it provides only implicit supervision on the composed image and often fails to learn reliable object-level correspondence across multiple references. We propose DeCoRL, a reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that improves MICo consistency by decomposing holistic MICo consistency into object-level consistency. DeCoRL first establishes instruction-relevant object correspondences across reference images and localizes the corresponding regions in the generated image. It then uses a VLM-based reward model trained on single-object consistency annotations to produce fine-grained, object-wise feedback, which is aggregated into a multi-object consistency reward to guide RL post-training. We further introduce DeCo-Bench, a benchmark covering compositions from 2 to 6 reference images. Experiments on DeCo-Bench and the public MICo-Bench demonstrate consistent improvements in MICo consistency.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对多图合成（MICo）任务中一致性随参考图数量增加而迅速退化的问题，提出强化学习框架 DeCoRL，将整体一致性分解为物体级一致性，并借助基于VLM的物体级奖励模型引导RL后训练，同时提出覆盖2–6张参考图的 DeCo-Bench 基准。
AI.motivation: 大规模图像编辑模型的多图合成（MICo）能力至关重要，但随参考图数量增加，一致性急剧下降。监督微调（SFT）仅对合成结果提供隐式监督，难以学到跨多参考图的可靠物体级对应关系，因此需要更细粒度、更显式的优化信号。
AI.method: 提出 DeCoRL 强化学习框架：①建立参考图之间与指令相关的物体对应关系，并定位生成图中对应区域；②使用基于单物体一致性标注训练的VLM奖励模型，产生细粒度的逐物体反馈；③将逐物体反馈聚合为多物体一致性奖励，用于RL后训练。此外构建覆盖2–6张参考图合成的 DeCo-Bench 基准。
AI.result: 在 DeCo-Bench 与公开的 MICo-Bench 上，方法在多图合成一致性上取得一致（稳定）的提升。
AI.conclusion: 将整体MICo一致性分解为物体级一致性并配合基于VLM的细粒度奖励进行RL后训练，可有效缓解参考图增多导致的一致性退化，验证了物体级分解奖励的有效性，并为多图合成提供了新的评测基准。

title: Formal Specifications with Data-Driven Signal Analysis
summary: Developing analog and hybrid systems requires substantial domain knowledge that is hard to articulate in a formal specification; without additional effort, this domain knowledge is also inaccessible to machine learning methods. We propose a hybrid approach for analyzing and monitoring real-valued signals that integrates specification-based and data-driven techniques. We use regular expressions with interval operations to identify regions of interest in a signal, classical signal processing methods to extract semantically meaningful features, and semi-supervised machine learning to infer complex relationships that distinguish correct from faulty behaviors. The relationships learned from normal behavior data can automatically detect incorrect behavior in the same system or variants thereof. We evaluate the method on a voltage regulator, demonstrating its effectiveness in detecting undesired system behaviors.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合规范驱动与数据驱动的混合方法，用正则表达式定位信号兴趣区间、经典信号处理提取语义特征、半监督学习推断正常与故障行为的判别关系，并在电压调节器上验证了异常检测有效性。
AI.motivation: 模拟与混合系统的分析依赖难以形式化表达的领域知识，且这些知识无法直接被机器学习利用，因此需要一种既利用领域规范又能借助数据驱动的方法。
AI.method: 针对实值信号的混合分析框架：1）用带区间运算的正则表达式识别信号中的兴趣区域；2）用经典信号处理方法提取具有语义意义的特征；3）用半监督机器学习推断区分正确与故障行为的复杂关系；从正常行为数据中学得的关系可自动用于同系统及其变体的错误行为检测。
AI.result: 在电压调节器案例上进行评估，展示出对不良系统行为的有效检测能力。
AI.conclusion: 规范驱动与数据驱动相结合的混合方法能够有效表征并监测实值信号，实现对系统异常行为的自动检测，并可推广到系统变体。

title: Tokenizer Tokens Tell Training Tales
summary: Tokenizers are usually treated as fixed preprocessing tools, but they are trained on text and can retain traces of that text in their vocabularies. We ask whether a BPE tokenizer can reveal if a candidate dataset was part of its training corpus. The key observation is simple. Rare strings become tokens only when enough corpus frequency pushes them over the merge threshold. This suggests that membership signal should appear in rare tokens used by the candidate dataset, rather than in the order in which merges were made. We formalize this under a threshold model of BPE inclusion, showing that the likelihood-ratio test assigns its largest weights to tokens that are rare in the background but frequent in the candidate dataset.
