The same model suggests that merge rank and merge-graph position should not add a first-order membership signal once token existence and dataset frequency are known. We instantiate this view as RTAM-Fusion, which calibrates rare-token mass with shadow tokenizers and combines signals across rarity levels. On the tokenizer membership benchmark, RTAM-Fusion improves AUC and balanced accuracy over Vocabulary Overlap while using fewer shadow tokenizers. Existing defenses also continue to leak membership signal against adaptive attackers at production vocabulary sizes. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RTAM-Fusion-F7EE/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出并验证了BPE分词器可作为数据集成员推断的侧信道：稀有token的存在与否泄露了候选数据集是否参与训练。作者建立BPE包含的门限模型，指出似然比检验的最大权重落在"背景稀有但候选集频繁"的token上，并据此设计RTAM-Fusion方法。
AI.motivation: 分词器通常被视为固定的预处理工具，但其词表本身是在语料上训练得到的，可能保留训练文本的痕迹。作者希望探究：给定一个BPE分词器，能否判断某个候选数据集是否曾进入其训练语料，即分词器层面的成员推断攻击。
AI.method: 1) 核心观察：稀有字符串只有在语料频次足够高、越过合并阈值时才会成为token；2) 建立BPE包含的门限模型，推导似然比检验，证明最大权重赋予"背景稀有、候选集频繁"的token；3) 理论推断merge rank与merge-graph位置在已知token存在性与数据集频次后不应提供一阶成员信号；4) 实例化为RTAM-Fusion：用影子分词器校准稀有token质量，并跨稀有度层级融合信号。
AI.result: 在分词器成员推断基准上，RTAM-Fusion相较Vocabulary Overlap在AUC与平衡准确率上均有提升，且所需影子分词器更少。此外，现有防御在生产级词表规模下仍会向自适应攻击者泄露成员信号。
AI.conclusion: 分词器并非中立工具，词表中的稀有token构成可利用的成员泄露途径；基于门限模型与稀有token质量的融合方法能高效实现该攻击，且当前防御措施不足。

title: Rennala NSGD: Asynchronous Stochastic Optimization Beyond Euclidean Geometry
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 111 pages, 2 algorithms, 3 tables
summary: The empirical success of matrix-aware optimizers, such as Muon (Jordan et al., 2024) and Shampoo (arXiv:1802.09568), highlights the potential of non-Euclidean geometry for deep learning, including large language model (LLM) training. Despite this progress, the theoretical understanding of stochastic optimization in general normed spaces remains limited, particularly in distributed settings. We analyze minibatch stochastic gradient descent (SGD) for smooth nonconvex optimization with respect to an arbitrary norm on a finite-dimensional space. Using the framework of $κ$-regular normed spaces (arXiv:0809.0813), we derive high-probability oracle complexity bounds under a light-tail condition stated directly in the dual norm induced by the update norm. The bounds make the dependence on geometry explicit through the regularity constant $κ$ of the dual space. In the Euclidean case, our bound recovers the standard minibatch SGD rate up to logarithmic factors. For some non-Euclidean geometries and noise models, it is sharper than bounds obtained by converting a Euclidean noise assumption, reducing a linear dimension dependence to a logarithmic one. Building on this framework, we introduce Rennala NSGD, a semi-asynchronous distributed algorithm, and establish wall-clock time complexity guarantees under fixed, heterogeneous worker computation times. In the Euclidean case ($κ=1$), our bound matches the parameter dependence of classical Rennala SGD up to logarithmic factors.

AI.tldr: 在κ-正则赋范空间框架下分析一般范数下的minibatch SGD非凸优化，给出高概率oracle复杂度界，并提出半异步分布式算法Rennala NSGD及其墙钟时间保证。
AI.motivation: Muon、Shampoo等矩阵感知优化器的实证成功显示非欧几里得几何在深度学习（含LLM训练）中的潜力，但一般赋范空间（尤其分布式设定）下的随机优化理论理解仍有限。
AI.method: 采用κ-正则赋范空间框架，在由更新范数诱导的对偶范数下直接陈述轻度尾部（light-tail）条件，推导有限维空间上光滑非凸目标的minibatch SGD高概率oracle复杂度界；并基于该框架设计半异步分布式算法Rennala NSGD，在固定且异构的worker计算时间下建立墙钟时间复杂度保证。
AI.result: 复杂度界通过原几何的正则常数κ显式体现几何依赖；欧几里得情形下恢复标准minibatch SGD速率（至多对数因子）；对某些非欧几何与噪声模型，相比由欧氏噪声假设转换得到的界更紧，将线性维度依赖降为对数依赖。Rennala NSGD在κ=1时其界与经典Rennala SGD的参数依赖匹配（至多对数因子）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将非欧几里得随机优化理论推广至分布式设定，为矩阵感知优化器提供了统一的分析框架与更紧的复杂度刻画。

title: Efficient Covariance-Aware Vicinal Latent Diffusion for Continuous Conditional Image Generation
summary: Continuous Conditional Generative Modeling (CCGM) aims to synthesize high-dimensional data conditioned on continuously valued scalar labels. However, existing continuous diffusion models face severe data sparsity under imbalanced and long-tailed label distributions, which can lead to visual artifacts and condition inconsistency. Moreover, inference-time classifier-free guidance and dense pixel-space integration introduce substantial sampling overhead, limiting practical deployment. To address these challenges, we propose CAViLD, an efficient latent diffusion framework for continuous conditional generation. CAViLD first constructs a purified condition-aware latent space through density-adaptive vicinal learning, auxiliary semantic regularization, and NIQE-guided negative data augmentation. It then internalizes the conditional guidance direction through an EMA teacher, enabling single-branch conditional inference, and introduces covariance-aware progressive distillation for label-dependent probability-flow ODEs, supporting sampling down to four NFEs. Experiments on RC-49, UTKFace, and Steering Angle demonstrate a favorable trade-off among generation fidelity, continuous condition consistency, and sampling efficiency.

AI.tldr: CAViLD：面向连续条件生成的高效潜扩散框架，通过净化条件感知潜空间、EMA教师内化引导方向与协方差感知渐进蒸馏，在长尾不平衡标签下实现单分支条件推断与低至4步NFE采样。
AI.motivation: 现有连续扩散模型在标签分布不均衡、长尾情形下面临严重数据稀疏，易产生视觉伪影与条件不一致；同时推理阶段的classifier-free guidance与稠密像素空间积分带来巨大采样开销，限制实际部署。
AI.method: 构建净化条件感知潜空间：密度自适应邻域学习、辅助语义正则、NIQE引导的负样本数据增强；用EMA教师将条件引导方向内化，实现单分支条件推断；提出协方差感知渐进蒸馏处理标签相关概率流ODE。
AI.result: 在RC-49、UTKFace与Steering Angle上，方法在生成保真度、连续条件一致性与采样效率之间取得良好权衡；采样可降至4 NFEs。
AI.conclusion: CAViLD为连续条件生成提供了兼顾质量与效率的潜扩散方案，缓解长尾标签稀疏问题并显著降低采样开销。

title: When Should AI Decide, Defer, and Deviate? Responsible Automation for Deceased Donor Kidney Allocation
summary: We ask when an AI trained on historical decisions should be allowed to recommend decisions, defer to human experts, or in other cases, flag concerning patterns in data and deviate from past practice. This can be challenging because past decisions record what was done rather than what should have been done, and where data is sparse, a model's predictions may be too uncertain to act on. We provide a framework for addressing this problem using a case study in deceased-donor kidney allocation. Nearly 30% of kidneys recovered from deceased donors in the United States are never transplanted, largely because they are hard to place through the standard waitlist sequence. One can use AI to flag kidneys at risk of delayed or failed placement for out-of-sequence (OOS) allocation, but this comes at the cost of bypassing candidates higher on the waitlist. Thus, OOS allocation should only be used when the organ is demonstrably at high risk of discard on the standard sequence. Using Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network match-run data from 2016-2019 and 2023-2025 (excluding COVID-19-disrupted years), we build the Arbitrator framework, which combines various interpretable models and acts only when the uncertainty in their predictions cannot change the preferred action. Our Arbitrator resolves 93.5% of organ placement decisions using explicit medical criteria learned from data, and defers the remaining 6.5% to a human or a more complex model. We show that the Arbitrator correctly identifies 70.1% of historically discarded low-KDPI kidneys as OOS candidates, projecting that up to 43.9% of historically discarded kidneys could be flagged for expedited placement and potentially transplanted. We then exploit the interpretability of the Arbitrator to create an agentic audit comparing the learned rules to published clinical literature in order to flag decision-making patterns that are contentious.

AI.tldr: 提出 Arbitrator 框架，用可解释模型+不确定性感知的"行动/延缓"决策规则，在器官分配场景中判断何时采用 AI 建议、何时转交人类专家。
AI.motivation: 历史决策数据只记录"做了什么"而非"应该做什么"，且数据稀疏处模型预测不确定性高，直接据此采取行动有风险；需要明确 AI 何时可推荐、何时应让渡给人类专家或仅作异常标记。
AI.method: 以死者供肾分配为案例，使用 2016–2019 与 2023–2025（排除疫情年份）的 OPTN match-run 数据，构建 Arbitrator：组合多种可解释模型，仅当预测不确定性不影响首选行动时才执行；再将学到的规则与已发表临床文献做智能体式审计。
AI.result: Arbitrator 基于数据学到的显式医学准则解决了 93.5% 的分配决策，其余 6.5% 转交人类或更复杂模型；正确识别 70.1% 历史被丢弃的低 KDPI 肾脏为可外序列（OOS）候选，预计最多 43.9% 历史丢弃肾脏可被标记并加速移植。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一套可解释、可审计的"AI 建议—人类让渡"决策框架，兼顾临床准则可读性与不确定性控制，并可扩展用于识别有争议的决策模式。

title: Prompts and probabilities in the linguistic assessment of language models: Evidence from semantic focus-sensitivity
summary: As language models (LMs) have improved, an increasingly common means of evaluating their linguistic competence is through explicit prompting (e.g., "Which sentence is more acceptable?"). Prior work indicates that such prompting underperforms compared to standard token-probability-based methods in smaller models, but improves in larger models. We test this in a new domain: semantic focus-sensitivity, responsible for contrasts like "Lucy only SWAM yesterday" vs. "Lucy only swam YESTERDAY". Testing models of various sizes using text-based focus markers like boldface and italics, we find universal above-chance performance for token probabilities. Prompting results mostly align with previous findings, but in some larger models they outperform probabilities by a wide margin. We propose that this is because LMs are not prone to produce out-of-the-blue focus marking, which muddies results from token probabilities in a way that does not affect prompting. We test this by replacing standard focus markers with randomly generated ones; token probabilities still beat chance but show significantly greater performance decrease compared to prompting. These results suggest that metalinguistic prompting, while non-trivial for LMs, can also be more robust when testing stylistically atypical data. We argue that this has important consequences for the assessment of LMs' language competence, even if LMs do not perform metalinguistic judgments through human-like introspection.

AI.tldr: 该论文在语义焦点敏感性（如"Lucy only SWAM yesterday"与"Lucy only swam YESTERDAY"的对比）这一新领域比较了显式提示（prompting）与基于token概率的评测方式，发现token概率在所有规模模型上均高于随机水平，而提示在部分大模型上大幅超越概率法，原因在于LM本身倾向避免"无上下文"的焦点标记，从而干扰概率法结果。
AI.motivation: 随着LM能力提升，用显式提示（如"哪句更可接受？"）评估其语言能力日益普遍。既往研究表明提示在小模型上不如基于token概率的方法，在大模型上则更优，但这一现象缺乏在新领域的检验。作者希望在一个全新的语言现象——语义焦点敏感性（focus-sensitivity）——中验证该规律，并探究其背后机制。
AI.method: 以"Lucy only SWAM yesterday" vs. "Lucy only swam YESTERDAY"这类焦点对比为测试材料，对不同规模的LM分别采用（1）基于token概率的评分和（2）显式提示两种方式，并使用粗体、斜体等文本焦点标记。随后进一步用随机生成的焦点标记替换标准焦点标记，以检验"LM不倾向于生成无上下文的焦点标记"这一假设：若假设成立，token概率法在随机标记下性能应显著下降，而提示法下降较小。
AI.result: token概率法在所有模型规模上均高于随机水平；提示结果大体与既往发现一致（小模型较差、大模型更好），但部分大模型上提示法以较大幅度超越概率法。替换为随机焦点标记后，token概率法虽仍优于随机但性能显著下降，且降幅明显大于提示法，支持了作者关于"LM不倾向产生out-of-the-blue焦点标记"的机制解释。
AI.conclusion: 元语言提示（metalinguistic prompting）对LM而言并非平凡任务，但在测试风格上非典型的数据时可能更为稳健。作者认为，这对LM语言能力的评估具有重要意义——即便LM并非通过类人的内省方式来完成元语言判断。

title: Auditable Hierarchical Inference with Multimodal Evidence and Bayesian Active Inquiry
summary:
Most multimodal classifiers assume that all useful evidence is available upfront, whereas clinical inquiry is sequential. We present a synthetic evaluation framework separating objective multimodal inference from active inquiry. An objective model maps synthetic tongue, bilateral multipressure pulse, and acoustic observations to eight syndrome families. A provenance-bearing Knowledge Core and training-only answer model support Bayesian narrowing over 33 fine terms using 25 typed questions, while seven safety questions remain outside the diagnostic posterior. Weak shared symptom factors limit fine-term influence on objective phenotypes, and an objective-only probe tests leakage.
  In a preregistered 600-case synthetic evaluation, objective family accuracy was 87.0%. Cost-sensitive expected information gain (cost-EIG) raised family accuracy to 95.5% and exact fine-term accuracy to 42.5%, versus 92.7% and 33.0% for an unoptimized fixed-order baseline. Selective family accuracy reached 96.9% at 95.3% coverage. However, cost-EIG asked more questions on average than fixed order (9.795 versus 9.352). Missing-audio routing retained 94.0% family accuracy, and a workflow invariant enforced abstention when all objective modalities were absent. Permuting fine-term answer likelihoods reduced family accuracy to 78.7%. Five of six frozen checks passed, but the question-efficiency hypothesis failed. Comparisons are descriptive because only aggregate, not paired case-level, outputs were retained. These results establish a reproducible synthetic workflow, not clinical diagnostic or treatment validity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个合成评测框架，将客观多模态推断与主动问诊分离，用成本敏感期望信息增益（cost-EIG）驱动序贯提问以缩小33个细术语的贝叶斯后验。
AI.motivation: 现有大多数多模态分类器假设所有有用证据一次性完备可得，而临床问诊本质是序贯的；需要区分"客观推断能力"与"主动询问策略"并分别评估。
AI.method: 构建合成框架：客观模型将合成舌象、双侧多压脉搏与声学观测映射到8个证候族；带来源标注的Knowledge Core与仅训练用的答案模型支持基于25类结构化问题在33个细术语上进行贝叶斯收窄，7个安全问题排除在诊断后验之外；共享症状因子较弱以限制细术语对客观表型的影响，并设仅客观探针检测泄漏。预注册600例合成评测，对比cost-EIG与固定顺序基线，含缺失音频路由与工作流不变量（客观模态全缺失时强制弃答）。
AI.result: 客观族准确率87.0%；cost-EIG将族准确率提升至95.5%、确切细术语准确率42.5%，固定顺序基线为92.7%与33.0%；选择性族准确率96.9%（覆盖率95.3%）。但cost-EIG平均提问数更多（9.795 vs 9.352）。缺失音频路由保持94.0%族准确率；置换细术语答案似然使族准确率降至78.7%。六项冻结检验中五项通过，提问效率假设失败。
AI.conclusion: 结果建立了一个可复现的合成工作流，而非临床诊断或治疗有效性；因仅保留聚合结果而无配对病例级输出，比较为描述性。

title: WorldFlow: Joint Video and 3D Motion Prediction via Large-Scale Pretraining
summary: Predicting future physical states stands as a central challenge in embodied intelligence. Existing video world models leave 3D dynamics implicit, action-based formulations remain tied to specific robot configurations, and 3D motion prediction models use flow-only supervision, providing a limited learning signal for physical dynamics. To circumvent these limitations, we introduce \method{}, a generative world model that jointly predicts future video and query-based 3D trajectories. By parameterizing 3D motion as continuous displacement tokens aligned with the video grid, a unified Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone jointly denoises both modalities under a rectified-flow objective. This formulation couples explicit geometric dynamics with visual evolution, effectively unlocking the physical commonsense embedded within pretrained video models. To empirically scale and validate this unified architecture, we train \method{} on a heterogeneous mixture of 1.44 million object-level samples spanning simulated and real-world domains. We further introduce WorldFlowBench, comprising 1,678 evaluation samples from 11 data sources across simulated and real-world interactions, including spatial reasoning tasks. Across all three evaluation sets, WorldFlow achieves the lowest average displacement error (ADE) and final displacement error (FDE) among the evaluated learning-based methods. Notably, on the challenging SpatialCog set, WorldFlow achieves an ADE of 0.060 m, a 54.2\% reduction compared with the strongest external baseline. It also reduces ADE and FDE by 55.9\% and 68.5\%, respectively, compared with its flow-only variant. Project page: https://worldflow-rbs.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出WorldFlow，一个联合预测未来视频与查询式3D轨迹的生成式世界模型，通过统一MoT骨干与rectified-flow目标建模视频与3D运动双模态，在1.44M异构数据上训练，并在新基准WorldFlowBench上取得最低ADE/FDE。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型将3D动力学隐式化，动作条件方法绑定特定机器人构型，而3D运动预测模型仅用光流监督、物理动力学学习信号不足，三者均限制物理常识的利用。
AI.method: 将3D运动参数化为与视频网格对齐的连续位移token，采用统一Mixture-of-Transformers骨干在rectified-flow目标下联合去噪视频与3D轨迹两种模态；训练数据为涵盖仿真与真实域的1.44M对象级异构样本；并构建WorldFlowBench（11个数据源、1,678个评估样本，含空间推理任务）。
AI.result: 在三组评估集上，WorldFlow取得学习类方法中最低的ADE与FDE；在SpatialCog集上ADE为0.060 m，较最强外部基线降低54.2%；相比纯flow监督变体，ADE与FDE分别降低55.9%和68.5%。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何动力学与视觉演化的耦合可有效激发预训练视频模型中的物理常识，统一的视频-3D轨迹联合生成框架在大规模异构数据上具备良好可扩展性与精度优势。

title: When the Same Prompt Gives Different Answers (and the Same Answer Isn't Always Right): A Taxonomy of Failure Mechanisms, Testing, and Mitigation Strategies for LLM-Assisted Evidence Synthesis Read-and-Evaluate Tasks
comment: 76 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables, 1 box, 6 supplementary files
summary: LLM read-and-evaluate tasks include study screening, data extraction, risk-of-bias assessment, and critical appraisal in the evidence synthesis field. These task differ in the amount of LLM interpretation they require. Some tasks involve retrieving relatively simple information, such as an author name, sample size, or publication year. Others require the LLM to read source material, interpret it against predefined criteria, and make a judgement. Researchers should assess whether LLM judgements are accurate, supported by appropriate source evidence, and reproducible under specified conditions. A correct judgement does not necessarily indicate that the underlying evaluation process is reliable. We developed a taxonomy for identifying mechanisms that may compromise these properties and for informing the selection and reporting of appropriate evaluation methods. The taxonomy outlines potential ways that LLM judgments from read-and-evaluate tasks can fail, called TRAILS (Taxonomy of Reliability And Instability in LLM-assisted evidence Synthesis). The TRAILS taxonomy addresses two complementary questions. First, what mechanisms can cause the same read-and-evaluate task to produce different judgements across repeated LLM runs? Second, what mechanisms can systematically affect the judgement or required output in a way that is not apparent from the judgement itself? This study presents 38 mechanisms and identifies the deployment settings in which each can operate, approaches for testing them, and mitigation strategies. We also show why repeatability or accuracy does not rule out a hidden judgement failure and why human evaluation should assess whether a judgement is grounded in the supplied evidence, independent of inappropriate external influence, and produced through a process that can be examined and verified.

AI.tldr: 提出TRAILS分类法，系统梳理LLM在"阅读-评估"任务中导致判读不可靠的38种机制，并给出测试方法、缓解策略及评估建议。
AI.motivation: 证据合成领域的LLM阅读-评估任务（文献筛选、数据提取、偏倚风险评估、批判性评价）对模型解释能力要求不同；现有实践仅关注判读是否正确，而"正确"不等于过程可靠，需要识别判读可能失真的机制以指导评估方法的选择与报告。
AI.method: 构建分类法TRAILS（Taxonomy of Reliability And Instability in LLM-assisted evidence Synthesis），围绕两个互补问题展开：(1) 哪些机制导致同一任务在重复运行中产生不同判读（不稳定）；(2) 哪些机制会系统性地影响判读或所需输出，且无法从判读本身察觉（隐性偏差）。对每种机制标注其可作用的部署设置、检验途径与缓解策略。
AI.result: 共识别38种机制，并明确各自的适用部署场景、可操作的测试方法与缓解措施；论证重复性（repeatability）或准确性（accuracy）均不能排除隐藏的判读失效。
AI.conclusion: 人工评估应超越结果正确性，检验判读是否基于所给证据、是否不受不当外部影响，以及产生过程是否可审查与验证；据此改进LLM辅助证据合成中的评估设计与报告。

title: Can LLMs Ignore What They Know? Measuring Knowledge Leakage in Persona-Based User Simulation
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at UserSim @ NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival workshop)
summary: When persona-conditioned responses are read as respondent-level simulations, each response should reflect the described persona's knowledge, and the respondent written to know nothing must act as if the model's knowledge were not there. We test whether it can, and find persistent favourable-item real-twin rating separation under the tested low-knowledge and explicit-ignorance prompts. We define the resulting problem (knowledge leakage: a response bias that arises when knowledge the real user could not have enters the simulated response) and present a methodology for measuring it quantitatively. The core instrument pairs real items with fabricated twins matched in surface form: screened fabricated variants designed to minimize prior item-specific knowledge. The paired difference therefore provides a diagnostic contrast for knowledge leakage even in rating tasks where no answer is correct. In a rating experiment across three knowledge-handling arms and five API endpoints from two model families, we find, first, that the personas we test do not fully suppress real-item existence and familiarity signals: a favourable-item real-twin rating contrast remains under an explicit in-context statement that the persona has never heard of the item. Second, the unfavourable-item contrast reverses sign across domain groups: pooling all unfavourable-content items across domains the contrast sits near zero (+0.077 [-0.057, +0.204]), yet the same estimator in the same conditions returns -0.359 where the rating scale asks about an item's documented hazard and +0.438 where it asks about a company or an organisation. A pooled analysis of unfavourable-content items against zero therefore does not detect the opposing domain-group differences. All estimates are conditional on the adequacy of twin construction and screening; human low-knowledge baselines remain necessary for population-level interpretation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"知识泄漏"概念，用真实条目与虚构孪生条目的配对评分差定量测量人格化模拟中模型知识的渗漏，发现低知识与显式无知提示下仍存在真实—孪生评分分离，且不利条目对比在不同领域间符号相反。
AI.motivation: 将人格条件化回复视为受访者级模拟时，模型必须"装作不知道"真实用户不可能知道的信息。作者关注这种"无知"指令是否真的有效，即模型自身的知识是否会渗入模拟回复。
AI.method: 核心工具是"真实条目—虚构孪生条目"配对设计：为真实条目构造表面形式匹配、经筛选以最小化条目特定先验知识的虚构孪生条目，用配对评分差作为知识泄漏的诊断性对比；即使在没有正确答案的评分任务中也适用。实验覆盖三种知识处理臂与两个模型家族、五个API端点。
AI.result: 在显式声明人格从未听闻该条目的条件下，仍存在有利条目的真实—孪生评分对比（真实条目被系统性偏好）；不利条目的对比在领域组间符号反转：合并所有不利条目时接近零（+0.077 [-0.057, +0.204]），但在询问条目记录危害的评分量表中为 -0.359，在询问公司/组织时为 +0.438。
AI.conclusion: 人格化提示无法完全抑制真实条目的存在性与熟悉度信号；对不利条目的合并分析会掩盖方向相反的分组效应，故须按领域分层。所有估计均以孪生构造与筛选的充分性为条件，群体层面的解释仍需人类低知识基线。

title: Skillful and realistic precipitation forecasting with reinforced diffusion
summary: Accurate precipitation forecasting remains elusive as physics-based models struggle to resolve mesoscale convection and machine learning often yields physically inconsistent, blurred results that consistently underestimate extreme events. We present FitzRoy, the first system that simultaneously achieves state-of-the-art predictive skill and physical realism over the continental United States. Through a reinforced diffusion framework, where a conditional discrete diffusion model is refined via reinforcement learning, FitzRoy effectively resolves the long-standing trade-off between pointwise accuracy and structural fidelity. Across lead times up to 24 hours, FitzRoy consistently matches or exceeds state-of-the-art models while preserving structural realism and capturing extreme events. Its low-latency inference further enables deployment in real-time operational settings. In case studies such as the 2025 Texas Hill Country floods and the 2026 Missouri floods, FitzRoy signals record-breaking accumulations that existing models largely missed. By bridging the gap between realism and skill, FitzRoy establishes a new frontier for high-fidelity precipitation forecasting.

AI.tldr: FitzRoy 是首个在美国本土同时实现最先进预测技巧与物理真实性的降水预报系统，采用"条件离散扩散模型 + 强化学习精修"的强化扩散框架，弥合了逐点精度与结构保真度之间的长期权衡。
AI.motivation: 精确降水预报长期困难：物理模型难以解析中尺度对流；机器学习方法常产生物理不一致、模糊的结果，并系统性低估极端事件。核心矛盾在于逐点精度与结构真实性难以兼得。
AI.method: 提出强化扩散框架（reinforced diffusion）：以条件离散扩散模型为生成骨干，再通过强化学习进行精修，从而在单一系统中联合优化预测技巧与物理真实性；推理延迟低。
AI.result: 在最长 24 小时预见期内，FitzRoy 的技巧持续匹配或超越最先进模型，同时保持结构真实性并能捕捉极端事件；低延迟推理支持实时业务部署。在 2025 年德州 Hill Country 洪水与 2026 年密苏里洪水案例中，它预报出破纪录累积量，而现有模型大多漏报。
AI.conclusion: 通过弥合真实性与技巧之间的鸿沟，FitzRoy 为高保真降水预报确立了新前沿，并具备业务化实时应用潜力。

title: PriorMaskMap: Robust Online Vectorized Map Construction with Biased Priors
summary: Online vectorized map construction provides autonomous vehicles with essential, real-time semantic and geometric scene understanding. While leveraging prior maps presents an opportunity to improve accuracy, they are often biased due to outdated information or temporary road changes. Existing methods, which typically treat priors as fully reliable or only consider limited noise patterns, suffer severe performance degradation when these priors are imperfect. To address this, we propose PriorMaskMap, a robust framework for prior-guided vectorized map construction. Its first innovation is a Prior-Aware Confidence Estimator (PACE) that evaluates the input rasterized map against current visual observations. It assigns confidence scores to regions classified as reliable, erroneous, or blank, creating a foundational mask that guides two subsequent branches. In one branch, the Dual-Prior Query Generator (DPQG) selectively filters and embeds both rasterized and vectorized priors to initialize informative queries from trustworthy map structures. In the other, the Confidence-Guided Prior Fusion (CGPF) module spatially propagates and refines the mask, using the refined version to govern the fusion of BEV features with the prior map, thereby providing rich contextual representations for the map decoder. Evaluation on the nuScenes dataset shows that PriorMaskMap achieves superior mapping precision over existing approaches and exhibits marked robustness when provided with priors containing apparent errors. Our code is released at https://github.com/healenrens/PriorMaskMap.

AI.tldr: 提出 PriorMaskMap 框架，通过置信度掩码评估先验地图可靠区域，实现鲁棒的先验引导矢量化地图构建。
AI.motivation: 向量化地图构建对自动驾驶实时语义与几何理解至关重要；利用先验地图可提升精度，但先验常因信息过时或临时道路变化而有偏。现有方法要么将先验视为完全可靠，要么仅考虑有限噪声模式，在先验不完美时性能严重下降。
AI.method: 1) Prior-Aware Confidence Estimator（PACE）：将输入栅格化地图与当前视觉观测比对，为可靠、错误、空白区域分配置信度分数，形成基础掩码引导两条分支；2) Dual-Prior Query Generator（DPQG）：选择性过滤并嵌入栅格与向量两种先验，从可信地图结构初始化信息量高的查询；3) Confidence-Guided Prior Fusion（CGPF）：对掩码进行空间传播与细化，用细化掩码控制 BEV 特征与先验地图的融合，为地图解码器提供丰富上下文表征。
AI.result: 在 nuScenes 数据集上，PriorMaskMap 的地图精度优于现有方法，且在先验含明显错误时表现出显著鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过对先验地图进行显式置信度评估并以其指导查询初始化与特征融合，可有效抑制不完美先验的负面影响，实现更精确、更鲁棒的先验引导矢量化地图构建。

title: Certified Access: Test-Time Compute on Conservative Physics-Structured AI Memory
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026); Workshop: Long-Context Foundation Models
summary: Test-time compute mechanisms, such as retries, confidence-based escalation and non-local routing, are conventionally deployed as black-box additions to trained models. They typically add forward passes or halting heads, but give no structural account of what the extra compute buys or what it costs against the model's stability guarantees. We therefore propose a theoretical and empirical framework for test-time compute on a Latent Dynamics Model used as the memory. When an encoder's latent state $(q,p)$ is advanced by a damped symplectic (velocity-Verlet) step of a learned Hamiltonian, every mechanism that expands access has an exact phase-volume Jacobian, a bounded energy change and an exact latch-transport law. We split reachability failures into escape failures and reach failures. A Lorentz squeeze resolves escape failures by injecting bounded, re-absorbable energy. A gated canonical translation (a one-step channel across $C_T$) resolves reach failures at $\detJ=1$ exactly. We verify this certificate stack on a designed analytic testbed. Reaching just beyond $C_T$ with the squeeze requires energy that grows quadratically in the excess distance. The gated channel's energy cost equals the potential difference between its endpoints, which is zero on the matched channel measured here, and so does not grow with distance in this testbed. An untrained state-replacing map annihilates phase volume and erases stored charge, while the gated channel transports it. On a learned physics-structured memory, we show calibrated compute rationing and evaluate the scaling limits of non-local routing against a physics-free baseline. The main contribution is the formalization and verification of the certificate stack, not benchmark performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一个对潜动力学记忆模型上测试时计算的理论与实证框架：把每类扩展访问机制刻画为具有精确相体积Jacobian、有界能量变化与精确latch-传输律的辛结构变换，并区分"逃逸失败"与"到达失败"，分别用Lorentz挤压与门控正则平移予以解决。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时计算机制（重试、置信度升级、非局部路由）多作为黑箱附加于已训练模型，只增加前向次数或停机头，无法从结构上说明额外计算换来了什么、又对模型稳定性保证造成何种代价。作者希望在"学习式Hamiltonian + 阻尼辛（velocity-Verlet）步"的潜动力学记忆上，给出可证明的结构性刻画。
AI.method: 以潜状态(q,p)在学习式Hamiltonian的阻尼辛velocity-Verlet步下演化为基础，为各类扩展访问机制推导精确的相体积Jacobian、能量变化上界与latch-传输律，构成"证书栈"。将可达性失败拆分为逃逸失败与到达失败：用Lorentz挤压注入有界、可再吸收的能量以解决逃逸失败；用门控正则平移（跨C_T的单步通道）在detJ=1下精确解决到达失败。在设计的解析测试床上验证该证书栈，并对比无物理结构的基线评估非局部路由的扩展极限。
AI.result: 解析测试床显示：用挤压仅略微越过C_T，所需能量随超出距离呈二次增长；门控通道的能量代价等于两端点间的势差，在所测匹配通道上为零，故不随距离增长。未经训练的状态替换映射会湮灭相体积并抹除存储电荷，而门控通道可将其运输。在学习到的物理结构记忆上，实现了可校准的计算配给。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是证书栈的形式化与验证，而非基准性能。该框架为测试时计算提供了可证明的稳定性保证与能量—可达性代价的结构性解释。

title: AI Cosmos: An Agentic Infra for Situated Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can improve task performance during learning, yet these gains do not necessarily reflect learners' ability to thereafter apply the knowledge and skills independently. We present AI Cosmos, an agentic infrastructure for situated learning that organizes learning around two complementary principles: scenario-based participation and cumulative assets of practice. AI Cosmos organizes learners and role-specialized agents within learning scenarios that integrate task-relevant knowledge and, when needed, executable workbenches. An asset-memory loop preserves the processes and outcomes of practice as reusable assets with explicit provenance and dependencies. We evaluate scenario-based interaction through two preregistered randomized controlled studies examining the acquisition of legal reasoning and programming competence, holding the same underlying LLM across conditions. AI Cosmos achieves greater learning gains than a conventional LLM in legal reasoning and higher mastery of unseen programming problems than an LLM-as-Teacher baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AI Cosmos——一个面向情境学习的智能体基础设施，以“情境化参与”和“实践资产累积”两条原则组织学习，并通过两项预注册随机对照实验验证其在法律推理与编程能力习得上的优势。
AI.motivation: LLM 虽能提升学习过程中的任务表现，但这种提升未必转化为学习者此后独立应用知识与技能的能力，即存在“过程表现”与“迁移掌握”之间的落差。作者希望构建一种能支持真实情境参与并沉淀实践成果的学习基础设施，以促进可迁移的独立能力。
AI.method: 提出 AI Cosmos 智能体基础设施：将学习者与角色专门化（role-specialized）的智能体置于学习情境中，情境整合任务相关知识，必要时嵌入可执行的工作台（executable workbench）；并设计资产—记忆回路（asset-memory loop），把实践的过程与结果保留为带显式来源（provenance）与依赖关系的可复用资产。采用两项预注册随机对照实验，分别考察法律推理与编程能力习得，并在各条件间控制同一底层 LLM。
AI.result: 在法律推理上，AI Cosmos 相比常规 LLM 基线取得更大的学习增益；在编程任务上，对未见问题的掌握程度高于 LLM-as-Teacher 基线。
AI.conclusion: 以情境化参与和实践资产累积为核心的智能体基础设施，能在控制底层模型不变的前提下带来优于常规 LLM 使用方式的学习效果，说明学习增益可源于系统化的学习环境与资产机制，而非仅依赖模型本身。

title: Loss is Not Behavior: A Unified Output-Space Analysis of Gradient-Based Machine Unlearning
summary: Gradient-based machine unlearning methods typically ``unlearn'' by optimizing forget and retain losses, but similar losses do not necessarily imply similar output-space behavior. Prior work has shown that high forget loss alone does not certify that unlearning has produced retraining-like output behavior. We therefore ask: when a gradient-based unlearner differs from the model that would have been learned on only the retain data, what structure does the resulting output-space gap have? We derive closed-form expressions for this gap in linear regression, with an extension to nonlinear models via a generalized Gauss-Newton and local linearity approximations. Our analysis puts various gradient-based methods under a unified framework parametrized by geometry, reweighting, and projection. Two leverage matrices emerge that capture the forget-retain entanglement under the retrained model geometry: forget self-leverage and retain cross-leverage. We show both theoretically and empirically that these two leverage matrices drive the impact of the forget residual on the forget and retain outputs, and existing methods account for this geometry only partially. Our framework yields precomputable leverage diagnostics for auditing forget sets to identify what type of gradient-based unlearning is likely to be successful.

AI.tldr: 论文推导梯度式机器遗忘方法相对于"仅用retain数据重训练模型"的输出空间差异闭式表达，提出遗忘自杠杆与保留交叉杠杆矩阵，并给出可预计算的审计诊断。
AI.motivation: 现有梯度式遗忘方法仅优化forget/retain损失，但高forget损失并不能证明输出行为与重训练一致；作者希望理解二者输出空间差距的结构。
AI.method: 在线性回归中推导输出差闭式解，并通过广义Gauss-Newton与局部线性近似推广到非线性模型；用几何、重加权、投影三参数统一框架刻画各类梯度式方法，识别forget-retain纠缠的两个杠杆矩阵。
AI.result: 理论与实验均表明forget自杠杆与retain交叉杠杆决定forget残差对forget/retain输出的影响，而现有方法仅部分考虑该几何结构。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供可预计算的杠杆诊断，用于审计forget集合、预判哪类梯度式遗忘更可能成功。

title: Unlocking Any-Order Generation in Pretrained Autoregressive Image Models
comment: Accepted in NeurIPS 2026, Sydney as a poster
summary: Autoregressive (AR) image generators are powerful in principle but inflexible in practice: training with a fixed raster-scan order hardcodes a single factorization of the image distribution into the model, leaving it unable to inpaint, outpaint, or edit at inference time. Existing solutions, including the modern discrete-diffusion family, train from scratch on a mixture of token orderings, paying roughly 3x the compute of standard raster-scan training; discrete diffusion further sacrifices compatibility with the AR inference ecosystem (KV caching, vLLM) by construction. We argue that this cost is unnecessary. A pretrained raster-scan AR model has already learned the joint distribution over image tokens; what it lacks is not knowledge but the ability to express that knowledge through non-sequential conditional pathways. We propose a recipe for adapting pretrained raster-scan models into any-order generators using two components: future-aware positional embeddings that resolve a target-position identifiability problem at negligible overhead, and an ordering curriculum that traces a stable optimization path from the pretrained solution to a good any-order basin. Applied to four base models across two architectures and two scales (LlamaGen-L/XL, RAR-L/XL), the recipe substantially outperforms MaskGIT on ImageNet inpainting (FID 6.21 vs. 10.44) and outpainting, is competitive with MAR-L, trades a 1.2-1.9 increase in class-conditional FID for this flexibility, and costs 13-33% additional compute beyond pretraining, while leaving the standard AR inference stack untouched. Inpainting, outpainting, and editing, our results suggest, need not be added to autoregressive image models. They can be unlocked from the ones that exist. Code is available at https://github.com/Ordered-AR/unlockedadaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出两组件适配配方（未来感知位置嵌入 + 顺序课程），将预训练光栅扫描自回归图像生成器低成本转化为任意顺序生成器，无需从零训练。
AI.motivation: 固定光栅扫描顺序把单一因子化硬编码进模型，导致推理时无法inpaint/outpaint/编辑；现有离散扩散从零学习多顺序混合，约3倍算力且破坏AR推理生态（KV缓存、vLLM）。作者认为该代价不必要：预训练模型已学到图像token联合分布，缺的是非顺序条件路径的表达能力。
AI.method: 两组件适配：(1) future-aware positional embeddings，以可忽略开销解决目标位置可辨识性问题；(2) ordering curriculum，从预训练解出发沿稳定优化路径过渡到良好的any-order盆地。在LlamaGen-L/XL、RAR-L/XL四种基座（两架构两规模）上验证。
AI.result: ImageNet inpainting FID 6.21 显著优于 MaskGIT 10.44，outpainting亦优；与 MAR-L 相当；类条件FID仅增加1.2-1.9；额外算力为预训练的13-33%；标准AR推理栈保持不变。
AI.conclusion: inpainting、outpainting、编辑能力无需为AR图像模型新增，可从已有模型中"解锁"；任意顺序生成可通过低成本适配获得，兼顾灵活性与AR部署效率。

title: Reasoning or Pattern Exploitation? Mechanistic Insights from RL-Trained Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly described as acquiring "reasoning" skills after reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. However, whether these gains reflect genuine reasoning or more superficial adaptations remains underexplored. In this work, we probe LLMs trained in a finite and exhaustively analyzable logical domain, namely Tic-Tac-Toe, and trace how internal representations evolve across reinforcement learning (RL) with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Quantitatively, RL yields high accuracy and robustness across prompt variations, suggesting the emergence of game reasoning. Mechanistic interpretability, however, paints a different picture: features extracted with sparse autoencoders (SAEs) reveal that models primarily adapt to rely more heavily on information already explicit in the prompt, such as whose turn it is, game progression and board occupancy. In comparison, high-level concepts like board symmetries and strategic forks remain weakly represented, raising concerns that reasoning benchmarks overestimate model abilities. This suggests that RL-driven "reasoning" may conflate task-specific adaptations to input information with reasoning ability. We provide, for the first time: (i) a systematic interpretability pipeline tracing representation dynamics across RL training in small-scale LLMs; (ii) an extension of SAE-based feature discovery to hypothesis-driven testing in a finite logical domain; and (iii) an interpretability-based demonstration that RL post-training neither adds nor removes concept information but reorganizes which features dominate the representation, with causal interventions locating the decision downstream of it, in the late-layer state.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过在小规模LLM上以井字棋为有限可穷举逻辑域，追踪GRPO强化学习训练中的表征动态，发现RL带来的高准确率主要来自对提示中显式信息的依赖增强，而非真正的概念推理。
AI.motivation: LLM经可验证奖励强化学习后常被认为获得了"推理"能力，但这些增益究竟反映真实推理还是表层的任务适配尚不清楚，需要机制层面的检验。
AI.method: 选择井字棋这一有限且可穷尽分析的逻辑域，在小规模LLM上用GRPO进行RL训练；结合稀疏自编码器（SAE）提取特征，建立系统性的可解释性流水线追踪训练过程中的表征动态，并将SAE特征发现扩展为假设驱动的检验；辅以因果干预定位决策所在层。
AI.result: 定量上RL在多种提示变体下取得高准确率与鲁棒性，看似涌现出博弈推理；但SAE特征显示模型主要增强对提示中显式信息（回合方、对局进程、棋盘占用）的依赖，而棋盘对称性、策略叉位等高层概念表征微弱。因果干预表明决策发生在表征下游的晚层状态。
AI.conclusion: RL后训练既不新增也不移除概念信息，而是重组了主导表征的特征；RL驱动的"推理"可能将任务特定的输入适配与推理能力混为一谈，提示现有推理基准可能高估模型能力。

title: Rethinking Pre-pretraining
summary: We report that allocating compute to synthetic pre-pretraining (PPT) never outperforms pure natural-language training in our compute-matched experiments. This holds across four PPT curricula (k-Dyck, neural cellular automata (NCA), declarative reference corpora, and code) and three training regimes: data-constrained, data-unconstrained, and a high token-to-parameter-ratio regime (881M parameters trained on 50B tokens). When natural language is scarce, repeated epochs over a 100M-token corpus beat every synthetic curriculum on natural-language validation loss, with no consistent downstream accuracy advantage from PPT. We find that PPT gains reported in prior work are sensitive to the weight initialization scheme. In an NCA reproduction, we recover a 5.4% perplexity improvement from PPT under the original initialization scheme. An alternative scheme improves both methods, but the no-PPT baseline more, closing the gap between them. However, when PPT receives additional compute rather than a share of the natural-language budget, gains persist at small natural-language budgets even with improved initialization, but disappear by 1B tokens. Finally, models forget what they learn during PPT in subsequent natural-language training; interleaving the same data throughout training prevents forgetting, but does not significantly improve natural-language performance. Our results suggest limited benefits of synthetic pre-pretraining as a distinct training stage and motivate rethinking how such data are used in language model training.

AI.tldr: 在算力匹配实验中，将算力分配给合成预预训练（PPT）从未优于纯自然语言训练；既往PPT收益对权重初始化方案敏感，且模型会在后续自然语言训练中遗忘PPT所学。
AI.motivation: 检验合成"预预训练"（pre-pretraining, PPT）作为独立训练阶段是否在算力匹配条件下真正带来收益，并厘清既往工作中PPT增益的来源（如初始化方案）。
AI.method: 在四种PPT课程（k-Dyck、神经细胞自动机NCA、声明式参考语料、代码）与三种训练机制（数据受限、数据不受限、高token-参数比，881M参数/50B token）下进行算力匹配对照实验；复现NCA实验并比较不同权重初始化方案；对比"PPT占用自然语言预算"与"PPT获得额外算力"两种设置；分析PPT知识在后续自然语言训练中的遗忘现象，并测试交错训练。
AI.result: 数据稀缺时，对100M token语料重复多轮在自然语言验证损失上优于所有合成课程，且PPT无一致的下游准确率优势。NCA复现中，原初始化方案下PPT带来5.4%困惑度改善；改用另一初始化方案后两方法均提升，但无PPT基线提升更多，差距缩小。PPT获得额外算力时，小自然语言预算下收益仍存在，但在1B token时消失。模型在后续自然语言训练中遗忘PPT所学；交错训练可防止遗忘但未显著改善自然语言性能。
AI.conclusion: 合成预预训练作为独立训练阶段的收益有限，其报告收益受初始化等细节影响显著；应重新思考此类数据在语言模型训练中的使用方式。

title: Routed Continual Learning
summary:
Agents deployed at scale repeatedly encounter related problems, and it is natural to let them learn from each other's experience rather than starting over each time. Unfortunately, there is no single way to retain that experience that works well across settings, and no way to know in advance which future problems a given experience will help with. A global history preserves every detail but becomes expensive and mixes together experience that may not belong together; compressing that history into one fixed representation limits the cost but can throw away valuable details.
  We introduce Routed Continual Learning (Routed CL), an architecture that decides how to partition and retain experience. Past trajectories are grouped into clusters, each of which maintains state using one memory system from a fixed library. Before each run, an LLM-based router either reuses an existing cluster or creates a new one, basing its decision on the problem statement, memory system descriptions, and cluster summaries. We also introduce Context Memory Adapter, which mediates between the memory system and the agentic loop.
  We evaluate the architecture on a heterogeneous stream that interleaves 301 instances from the six CL-Bench tasks with 97 banking instances from $τ^3$-Bench. Across four language models and five matched rollouts, Routed Continual Learning raises normalized reward over a single global in-context learning (ICL) history by 15-30% of the maximum attainable normalized reward, achieves higher mean normalized reward than ICL-only clustering, and reduces estimated API cost by 65-72% relative to Global ICL. These results support approaching continual learning as a routing problem that chooses both a learning mechanism and a state cluster rather than committing to one representation globally.

AI.tldr: 提出 Routed Continual Learning：将历史经验按簇分区存储，每簇配一种记忆系统，由LLM路由器按问题与簇摘要决定复用或新建簇，并引入 Context Memory Adapter 连接记忆系统与智能体循环。
AI.motivation: 规模化部署的智能体反复遇到相关问题，理应互相借鉴经验；但不存在普适的经验保留方式，也无法预知某段经验对未来哪个问题有用。全局历史保留细节但代价高且混杂无关经验，压缩为单一固定表示则廉价但丢失细节。因此需要同时决定"保留什么"与"如何保留"。
AI.method: 1) 将历史轨迹聚类为多个簇，每簇从固定库中选择一种记忆系统维护状态；2) 运行前由 LLM 路由器基于问题描述、记忆系统描述与簇摘要，决定复用现有簇或新建簇；3) 引入 Context Memory Adapter 作为记忆系统与智能体循环之间的中介层。在 CL-Bench 六任务301个实例与 τ³-Bench 银行领域97个实例构成的异构流上，对四种语言模型、五次匹配 rollout 进行评估。
AI.result: 相比单一全局 ICL 历史，归一化奖励提升可达最大归一化奖励的15–30%；平均归一化奖励高于仅用 ICL 的聚类方案；相比 Global ICL 估算 API 成本降低 65–72%。
AI.conclusion: 持续学习应被视为一个路由问题——同时选择学习机制与状态簇，而非全局承诺单一表示。

title: Youtu-Parsing-Omni: One Encoder, One Schema, All Modalities
summary: We present Youtu-Parsing-Omni, an omni-modal parser that converts documents, images, audio, and video into structured records grounded in space and time, providing a perception layer for agents that read, locate, and cite evidence across modalities. Its design rests on one encoder for every modality and one schema for every task. Youtu-Omni-Encoder, initialized from a pre-trained language model to strengthen text reading, encodes all modalities with shared weights in a unified space-time coordinate system, and a few fusion layers let video frames attend to concurrent audio, bringing cross-modal fusion and temporal alignment into perception itself. OmniSchema unifies the outputs of all ten parsing tasks, allowing a single self-evolving post-training procedure, OmniSchema-Aware On-Policy Distillation (OSAD), to provide a shared token-role-based objective across tasks. In each round, the model is trained on its own rollouts against token-level targets from a reference-conditioned copy of itself, which is then refreshed with the trained weights, so that the parser and its supervision co-evolve. With a single 5 B-parameter checkpoint, Youtu-Parsing-Omni achieves state-of-the-art performance on OmniDocBench v1.6 (96.96 Overall) and leads all open-weight models on OmniParsingBench (75.08 Avg.), with its advantage concentrated on audio and video. It also achieves the best overall chart-parsing score (95.02) and the highest exact chemical-fingerprint agreement among compared systems, and matches a dedicated optical-music model in character-level transcription of typeset sheet music while staying far ahead of general-purpose systems. Code and model weights are publicly available.

AI.tldr: Youtu-Parsing-Omni 是一个全模态文档解析器，用单一编码器和统一 schema 将文档、图像、音频、视频转为带时空定位的结构化记录，5B 参数单模型在多项解析基准上达到领先水平。
AI.motivation: 为智能体提供感知层，使其能跨模态阅读、定位并引用证据；现有解析器多为单模态、任务各自为政，缺乏统一的时空对齐与共享监督。
AI.method: 核心是"一模态一编码器、一任务一 schema"：Youtu-Omni-Encoder 由预训练语言模型初始化以强化文本阅读，共享权重编码所有模态并置于统一时空坐标系，少量融合层让视频帧注意同步音频，将跨模态融合与时间对齐内化到感知中；OmniSchema 统一十类解析任务的输出，支持单一自演化后训练流程 OSAD（OmniSchema-Aware On-Policy Distillation），以基于 token 角色的共享目标，在自身 rollout 上对齐参考条件副本的 token 级目标，并周期性刷新参考模型，实现解析器与监督信号协同演化。
AI.result: 单一 5B checkpoint 在 OmniDocBench v1.6 达 96.96 Overall（SOTA），OmniParsingBench 以 75.08 Avg. 领先所有开放权重模型（优势集中于音频与视频）；图表解析总分最佳（95.02），化学指纹精确匹配一致度最高；排版乐谱字符级转写媲美专用光学音乐识别模型，远超通用系统。
AI.conclusion: 统一编码器+统一 schema+自演化蒸馏的组合，可在单一中等规模模型中实现跨模态、多任务的强解析与时空可引用性，代码与权重已公开。

title: Goal-Aware Dynamic Multi-Agent Collaboration for Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly used to complete complex, long-horizon tasks without human intervention. To make progress toward the task goal, agents need to perform different duties, such as planning and verification, when needed. To understand how single agents manage these duties during long-horizon execution, we conduct a preliminary study. Our analysis shows that verification has the strongest association with task success, but often occurs late, leaving limited opportunities for correction. We also find that the proportion of duty-relevant information decreases as records from different duties accumulate in a shared context. These findings lead us to examine whether multi-agent systems (MAS) can address these problems by assigning duties to agents with separate contexts. Our analysis shows that this separation alone is insufficient. Agents can lose track of the overall goal and repeat prior investigations. They may also lack necessary background while receiving irrelevant information from others. To maintain goal awareness and coordinate collaboration as task needs change, we propose Goal-Aware Dynamic Multi-Agent Collaboration (GAD). It uses a growing execution graph to organize subtasks and their dependencies. To keep agents focused on their goals, each context retains the original instruction and the assigned task's goal and acceptance conditions. To adapt collaboration and information sharing during execution, agents can divide tasks into subtasks and specify dependencies based on execution evidence. These dependencies guide when agents work and which results they receive. Verification and recovery check subtask results and full task completion against their goals, providing feedback for repair when checks fail.

AI.tldr: 作者通过初步研究揭示单智能体在长程任务中验证发生较晚且共享上下文信息稀释的问题，进而发现多智能体"仅分离上下文"仍不足，提出基于执行图的GAD（Goal-Aware Dynamic Multi-Agent Collaboration）框架以保持目标感知并动态协调协作。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在无人监督下完成长程复杂任务时需兼顾规划、验证等多种职责。初步研究发现：验证与任务成功关联最强却常发生得太晚，纠错窗口有限；不同职责记录堆积于共享上下文中，职责相关信息占比随记录增长而下降。因此考察多智能体系统（MAS）能否通过职责分离+独立上下文解决上述问题，但实证显示单纯分离会导致目标迷失、重复调查、背景缺失与无关信息干扰。
AI.method: 提出GAD框架：1）用不断增长的执行图组织子任务及其依赖关系；2）每个上下文保留原始指令与所分配任务的目标及验收条件，以维持目标聚焦；3）智能体可依据执行证据将任务划分为子任务并指定依赖，依赖决定工作时机与所获结果，实现动态协作与信息共享；4）通过验证与恢复机制按目标核查子任务结果与整体完成度，失败时反馈修复。
AI.result: 初步研究给出三点实证发现：验证与任务成功关联最强；验证常出现在执行后段，纠错机会有限；共享上下文中职责相关信息比例随不同职责记录累积而下降。对MAS的分析表明，仅做上下文/职责分离不足以解决目标漂移、重复调查、背景缺失与无关信息干扰等问题；GAD通过执行图与目标保持机制针对性地应对这些问题。
AI.conclusion: 长程任务的关键瓶颈在于验证时机、上下文信息纯度与全局目标保持。单一职责分离的多智能体并非充分解，需要以执行图为骨架、以目标与验收条件为锚点、以依赖关系驱动协作与信息路由，并辅以验证-恢复闭环的GAD式动态多智能体协作。

title: Upcycling Language Models for Multiple Specialized Domains
summary: Effective multi-domain adaptation of large language models requires prioritizing relevant domain knowledge while minimizing interference from irrelevant domains. Existing approaches commonly use Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to train a separate adapter for each domain and combine these adapters within one model. However, they either weight adapters equally regardless of the input domain or dynamically weight adapters while still activating all of them including irrelevant ones. Additionally, while efficient, their low-rank structure limits performance. In contrast, upcycling is a model expansion method that adds experts and a router to a dense Transformer layer offering larger capacity than LoRA approaches. In this paper, we propose Domain-Specialized Upcycling (DS-Upcycling) for multi-domain adaptation. We introduce a new domain-aware supervision that allows the router to effectively learn to distinguish domains by selecting the appropriate experts. During fine-tuning on each new domain, we update only the corresponding expert and router while freezing all other parameters. Experiments show that our method achieves the highest average performance across the adapted domains compared to baselines while retaining general performance. With just 256 examples per domain for router supervision, DS-Upcycling achieves 90-98% routing accuracy after adaptation compared with 43-70% for routers trained without our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出 Domain-Specialized Upcycling (DS-Upcycling)，通过专家扩展+路由器+领域感知监督实现多领域自适应，避免无关领域干扰，性能优于 LoRA 系方法且保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多领域自适应方法用 LoRA 为每领域训练独立适配器并组合，但存在两点不足：一是等权组合（忽视输入领域）或动态加权时仍激活全部适配器（含无关领域），造成干扰；二是 LoRA 低秩结构限制性能。需要一种更大容量且能按领域精确选择知识的方案。
AI.method: 采用 upcycling（模型扩展）：在稠密 Transformer 层中加入专家与路由器，容量大于 LoRA。引入新的领域感知监督，使路由器学会区分领域并选对专家；每个新领域微调时只更新对应专家与路由器，其余参数冻结。
AI.result: 在适配领域上取得最高平均性能且保持通用性能；每领域仅用 256 条样本监督路由器，适配后路由准确率达 90–98%，而无该方法的基线路由器仅 43–70%。
AI.conclusion: DS-Upcycling 通过专家化扩展与轻量领域感知监督，实现高效、低干扰的多领域自适应，在性能与通用能力间取得更好平衡。

title: Causal Attention on CPU: A Cache-Aware and Load-Balanced Scheduling Kernel for Prefill
summary: Agentic AI drives significant productivity gains across diverse domains, but concurrent long-context prefills from multiple agents can saturate GPU compute resources. Although CPUs offer a viable alternative, existing CPU attention kernels fall short in adapting to multi-tier cache hierarchies and lack effective thread scheduling. To address this, we introduce CACPU, a high-performance attention kernel featuring tiered cache blocking and an in-kernel task dispatching mechanism designed for causal full-sequence prefilling. CACPU achieves up to a 2.01x speedup over PyTorch SDPA, FlexAttention, and SGLang attention kernels. Integrated into SGLang, it reduces Time to First Token (TTFT) of Llama-3.1-8B by up to 1.74x while preserving model accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出CACPU——面向因果全序列prefilling的高性能CPU注意力kernel，采用分层cache分块与kernel内任务调度，较PyTorch SDPA、FlexAttention、SGLang kernel最高加速2.01x，集成SGLang后Llama-3.1-8B的TTFT降低最多1.74x且保持精度。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI带来显著生产力提升，但多智能体并发的长上下文prefill会占满GPU算力。CPU是可行的替代方案，然而现有CPU注意力kernel无法适配多级cache层级结构，也缺乏有效的线程调度。
AI.method: 设计CACPU注意力kernel，包含两项关键技术：(1) 分层cache blocking，按多级缓存层次组织分块以提升数据复用；(2) kernel内任务分发机制（in-kernel task dispatching），优化线程调度。整体面向因果（causal）全序列prefilling场景。
AI.result: 相比PyTorch SDPA、FlexAttention与SGLang注意力kernel最高取得2.01x加速；集成到SGLang后，Llama-3.1-8B的Time to First Token(TTFT)最多降低1.74x，同时保持模型精度不变。
AI.conclusion: CPU可在GPU资源饱和时作为长上下文prefill的有效卸载目标；通过针对cache层级的分块与kernel内调度，CPU注意力kernel可显著提升性能并改善端到端首token延迟。

title: CAD-WAM: Anticipating Geometry for Text-to-CAD Generation
summary: Generating editable computer-aided design (CAD) models from text requires selecting operations that produce the intended changes to the geometry constructed so far. An incorrect operation can compromise subsequent steps, making reliable multi-step generation challenging. Existing methods based on large language models (LLMs) primarily learn to predict commands, without explicit supervision of the geometric states those commands should produce. Inspired by world-action models, we introduce CAD-WAM, which couples geometry-conditioned action generation with next-state prediction. We define complete modeling operations as actions in a CAD domain-specific language (DSL) and encode surface point clouds of intermediate solids into compact latent states using a pretrained variational autoencoder. An LLM backbone generates the next action from the target description and current geometric state, while an auxiliary head on the same backbone predicts the next state to provide geometric supervision during training. We construct step-wise training trajectories from parametric CAD models in the DeepCAD dataset, pairing each trajectory with an expert-level textual description. At inference, each generated action is executed by a CAD kernel, and the resulting solid is re-encoded to inform the next decision. On the DeepCAD test set, CAD-WAM outperforms the task-specific baselines in geometric accuracy and output validity, with larger gains on models requiring more operations, and produces more accurate geometry than general-purpose LLMs prompted with the same DSL. Ablations further show that next-state supervision reduces mean Chamfer distance by 13.2\% relative to an otherwise identical model trained only to predict actions. Code is available at https://github.com/Lzy-1037/CAD-WAM.

AI.tldr: CAD-WAM 借鉴 world-action 模型，将"动作生成"与"下一状态预测"耦合，用几何监督提升文本到可编辑 CAD 模型的多步生成质量。
AI.motivation: 从文本生成可编辑 CAD 模型需要逐步选择能产生目标几何变化的操作，错误的操作会破坏后续步骤，因此多步生成难以可靠完成；现有基于 LLM 的方法只学习预测命令，缺乏对命令应产生的几何状态的显式监督。
AI.method: 将完整建模操作定义为 CAD DSL 中的 action；用预训练 VAE 把中间实体的表面点云编码为紧凑 latent state；LLM 主干根据目标描述与当前几何状态生成下一 action，同主干的辅助头预测下一状态以提供几何监督；用 DeepCAD 参数化模型构建逐步轨迹并配专家级文本描述；推理时每个 action 由 CAD kernel 执行，结果实体重新编码用于下一步决策。
AI.result: 在 DeepCAD 测试集上，几何精度与输出有效性优于任务专用基线，操作数更多的模型上增益更大，几何质量优于以同一 DSL 提示的通用 LLM；消融显示下一状态监督使平均 Chamfer 距离相对仅预测 action 的同构模型降低 13.2%。
AI.conclusion: 引入世界模型式的下一状态预测作为几何监督，可显著提升 LLM 驱动的多步 CAD 生成的可控性与几何保真度。

title: Beyond LLM Wrappers: Context Engineering and the Three-Engine Architecture for Reliable Financial AI
summary:
Financial AI systems must support decision-bearing questions involving payments, collections, cash flow, and compliance while ensuring numerical accuracy, traceability, and auditability. Large language models (LLMs) enable natural language interaction but cannot independently guarantee reproducible calculations or evidence-grounded recommendations. We present a production-grounded architecture integrating three components: a financial knowledge graph for enterprise relationships, temporal context, and provenance; a deterministic optimization engine for financial calculations and decisions; and a multi-agent LLM layer for intent interpretation, task orchestration, explanation, and claim validation. A coordination layer, termed context engineering, selects, ranks, composes, and validates query-specific context across ERP systems, tools, and tenants.
  Based on observations from 15 deployments over approximately 11 months, single-agent pipelines exhibited hallucination rates of about 7-9% (5-10% across query types), including invented invoices and unsupported financial claims. Graph-backed multi-agent validation reduced observed rates to below 1%, although these findings are observational rather than causal. ERP data quality and tenant-specific schemas remained major implementation challenges. Reusable mappings, graph templates, and validation policies coincided with a reduction in deployment time from roughly six to two weeks.
  We argue that financial context engineering extends beyond text-centric retrieval-augmented generation by requiring structured relationships, temporal validity, exact numerical evidence, access controls, and validation against source records and solver outputs. We outline research challenges in evaluation, reproducibility, privacy, context quality, and cross-tenant generalization.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种面向金融场景的生产级架构，将金融知识图谱、确定性优化引擎与多智能体LLM层结合，并通过"上下文工程"协调层跨ERP系统、工具与租户检索与校验上下文；在15次部署（约11个月）中，将幻觉率从单智能体管线的7-9%降至1%以下，部署周期从约6周缩至2周。
AI.motivation: 金融AI需处理支付、收款、现金流与合规等决策性问题，要求数值准确、可追溯、可审计。LLM虽支持自然语言交互，但无法独立保证可复现的计算与有证据支撑的建议，因此需要一种在架构层面而非仅靠提示工程来约束可靠性的方案。
AI.method: 提出三分量架构：(1) 金融知识图谱，承载企业关系、时间上下文与溯源信息；(2) 确定性优化引擎，负责金融计算与决策；(3) 多智能体LLM层，负责意图理解、任务编排、解释与断言校验。其上设"上下文工程"协调层，对查询相关上下文进行选择、排序、组合与验证，覆盖ERP系统、工具与多租户环境。基于15次部署、约11个月的观察进行实证评估（观察性，非因果）。
AI.result: 单智能体管线幻觉率约7-9%（各查询类型5-10%），包括编造发票与无依据的金融断言；图谱支撑的多智能体验证将观察到的幻觉率降至1%以下。ERP数据质量与租户特定schema是主要落地难点。可复用映射、图谱模板与校验策略的引入，使部署时间从约6周降至约2周。
AI.conclusion: 金融上下文工程超越以文本为中心的RAG，需要结构化关系、时间有效性、精确数值证据、访问控制，以及对源记录与求解器输出的校验。作者提出在评估、可复现性、隐私、上下文质量与跨租户泛化方面的研究挑战。

title: Towards Full-Text Scholarly Argument Mining using Entity-Anchored Claim Extraction
summary: Argument mining in full-text scholarly articles remains an important yet challenging task. This difficulty stems not only from the need to model long-distance dependencies but also from the substantial effort required to annotate sentence-level argumentative components throughout lengthy documents. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel approach that leverages scientific entity mentions (e.g., tasks, datasets, and models) to identify and structure claims in scholarly literature. We validate our approach through a case study involving 50 full-text research papers on sentiment analysis. We first establish a reliable human gold standard (Krippendorff's $α= 0.80$), identifying 113 claim-bearing sentences and extracting 199 structured claim records from 300 candidate sentences. To address the annotation bottleneck, we employ a majority-voting ensemble of large language models (LLMs) to generate a silver-standard dataset comprising 1,487 claims. Encoders fine-tuned exclusively on the silver-standard dataset outperform those trained on a small human-annotated gold-standard dataset and demonstrate strong zero-shot transfer to NLP papers outside the training corpus.

AI.tldr: 该文提出利用科学实体提及（任务、数据集、模型）来识别并结构化全文文献中的claims，并通过50篇情感分析论文的案例研究建立金标准（α=0.80），再用LLM多数投票集成生成1487条claims的银标准数据；仅在银标准上微调的编码器优于小规模人工金标准训练的模型，并能零样本迁移到语料外NLP论文。
AI.motivation: 全文级论证挖掘既需建模长距离依赖，又需在冗长文档中逐句标注论证成分，人工成本极高，形成标注瓶颈。
AI.method: 以科学实体提及（任务、数据集、模型）为线索识别与结构化claims；案例研究基于50篇情感分析全文论文，先构建人工金标准（Krippendorff's α=0.80，从300个候选句中识别113个含claim句子、抽取199条结构化claim记录），再采用LLM多数投票集成生成含1487条claims的银标准数据集，并在此上微调编码器。
AI.result: 仅用银标准微调的编码器优于使用小规模人工金标准训练的模型，并在训练语料之外的NLP论文上表现出强零样本迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 以实体为中心的claim识别与结构化方法可行，LLM集成生成的银标准可有效缓解标注瓶颈并具备良好泛化性。

title: Discovering Jailbreaks via Curriculum of Models
summary:
Automated jailbreak discovery aims to find prompts that elicit prohibited behaviors from safety-trained language models, helping developers identify vulnerabilities before deployment. One class of approaches uses reinforcement learning to train an investigator model to generate prompts that elicit a specified behavior from a target model. However, training directly against a safety-trained target is difficult because nearly all prompts are refused, leaving the investigator with a sparse reward signal. Prior work addresses this with the propensity bound (PRBO), a proxy reward estimated by sampling responses from a more compliant target, and then adjusting for how likely those responses would have been under the original target.
  We introduce Curriculum of Models (CoM), an alternative method that trains the investigator against a sequence of modified versions of the target, progressing gradually from a version that readily exhibits the specified behavior to the original target. For jailbreak discovery, training begins against a target version that rarely refuses harmful requests, and advances to the next, harder version once the investigator reliably elicits the behavior from the current one.
  We evaluate CoM on elicitation tasks involving CBRN materials, explosives, and illicit drugs, using two open-weight targets, gemma-4-31b-it and gpt-oss-120b. We compare against PRBO and direct training on the original target without a curriculum. When the investigator is trained to elicit a single behavior, CoM finds successful jailbreaks more reliably than either baseline. When trained on multiple behaviors simultaneously, the CoM-trained investigator can elicit held-out behaviors, though PRBO-trained investigators achieve higher success rates. Our results suggest that a simple curriculum over target models offers a promising approach for addressing sparse rewards in rare-behavior elicitation.

AI.tldr: 提出"模型课程"(CoM)：让调查模型依次对抗由易到难的修改版目标模型进行强化学习训练，以缓解越狱提示发现中因目标模型几乎全部拒答造成的稀疏奖励问题。
AI.motivation: 直接用强化学习训练调查模型去诱导经安全训练的目标模型时，几乎所有提示都被拒绝，奖励信号极度稀疏，训练困难。已有工作用倾向性上界(PRBO)代理奖励（从更"顺从"的目标采样再按原目标似然校正）来缓解，本文寻求一种更简洁的替代方案。
AI.method: CoM构建目标模型的修改版本序列，从几乎不拒绝有害请求的版本逐步过渡到原始目标模型；调查模型在当前版本上能稳定诱导出指定行为后，再推进到更难的下一个版本。评估涉及CBRN材料、爆炸物、非法药物等诱导任务，使用两个开放权重目标 gemma-4-31b-it 与 gpt-oss-120b，对照PRBO与无课程的直接训练。
AI.result: 在单一行为诱导任务中，CoM比两个基线更可靠地找到成功越狱；在多行为联合训练时，CoM训练的模型能泛化到留出行为，但PRBO的成功率更高。
AI.conclusion: 在目标模型上引入简单课程是缓解稀有行为诱导中稀疏奖励问题的一种有前景的方法。

title: MemoryFusion: Cross-Temporal Memory Learning for Multimodal Video Fusion
summary: Multimodal videos contain rich temporal cues that can facilitate faithful fusion. However, existing video fusion methods mainly rely on short-range temporal interactions, leaving valuable long-term information underexplored. Moreover, inconsistent fusion representations can cause flickering artifacts, undermining temporal coherence. To address these coupled challenges, we propose MemoryFusion, a two-stage framework integrating cross-temporal memory learning with progressive temporal refinement. Considering the complementary roles of adjacent and distant frames, the first stage combines a Short-Term Memory Bank for local temporal guidance with a Long-Term Memory Bank that preserves reliable historical information through a fusion-oriented update strategy. To mitigate temporal fluctuations, a Temporal Smoothing Module leverages soft motion cues for coarse background stabilization. Building upon the resulting fusion prior, The second stage further employs a lightweight 3D residual Temporal Refinement Module to correct remaining temporal inconsistencies while enhancing structural details. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MemoryFusion achieves superior fusion quality and temporal consistency over existing frame-based and video-based fusion methods. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Meiqi-Gong/MemoryFusion.

AI.tldr: MemoryFusion：两阶段视频融合框架，用跨时序记忆学习+渐进时序精炼解决长程信息利用不足与时序闪烁问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态视频融合方法主要依赖短程时序交互，长程信息利用不足；同时融合表示不一致会导致闪烁伪影，破坏时序一致性。这两类问题相互耦合。
AI.method: 两阶段框架。第一阶段：短期记忆库提供局部时序引导，长期记忆库通过面向融合的更新策略保留可靠历史信息；并用时序平滑模块借助软运动线索实现粗粒度背景稳定化，得到融合先验。第二阶段：基于该先验，采用轻量级3D残差时序精炼模块修正残余时序不一致并增强结构细节。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，在融合质量与时序一致性上优于现有基于帧与基于视频的融合方法；源码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 以记忆机制建模长程时序依赖、配合渐进式精炼，可有效兼顾融合质量与时间连贯性，为视频多模态融合提供可行范式。

title: SocialArena: Evaluating Social Intelligence in Large Language Models
summary: We introduce SocialArena, a benchmark for systematically defining and evaluating the social intelligence of large language models (LLMs). Although LLMs are increasingly deployed in socially interactive applications such as mental health counseling, companionship chatbots, and educational tutoring, existing evaluations remain fragmented focusing on isolated capabilities or single scenarios and evaluation reliability is largely unverified. This work makes three main contributions to address these limitations. (1) We first propose a unified three-tier framework that defines social intelligence along three capability dimensions: role-playing ability, mental state reasoning, and behavioral reasoning. To operationalize this definition, we design a role-playing dialogue paradigm with explicit character thinking for evaluation, enabling simultaneous assessment of these capabilities in a manner that mirrors realistic human interactions. (2) To ensure diversity across social scenarios and thereby prevent evaluation conclusions from being confined to specific scenarios, we introduce the U-TRIMF framework, which guides us in synthesizing social contexts with broad coverage. (3) To obtain reliable evaluation, we invest $132.4K to recruit and train human annotators and adopt a human-annotated arena-style protocol, where annotators compare model responses and provide preference labels along with natural-language critiques. We hope that SocialArena can provide valuable insights and guidance for future LLM improvements.

AI.tldr: 提出 SocialArena 基准，从三层框架定义并系统评测大模型的社会智能。
AI.motivation: LLM 已广泛用于心理咨询、陪伴聊天、教育辅导等社交交互场景，但现有评测碎片化，只覆盖孤立能力或单一场景，且评测可靠性缺乏验证。
AI.method: (1) 提出三层能力框架（角色扮演能力、心理状态推理、行为推理）；设计带显式角色思考的角色扮演对话范式以同步评测；(2) 提出 U-TRIMF 框架合成广覆盖社会情境以保证多样性；(3) 投入 132.4K 美元招募并培训标注员，采用人工标注的 arena 式协议，比较模型回复并给出偏好标签与自然语言评述。
AI.result: 构建了覆盖多维社会能力与多场景的 SocialArena 基准，并配套高成本人工标注的偏好数据与评述数据。
AI.conclusion: SocialArena 为社会智能提供了统一定义与可靠评测手段，可为后续 LLM 改进提供洞见与指导。

title: Mobilizing the Archive: Bitext Extraction at Scale from Archival Documents for Extremely Low-resource Languages
summary: While mining parallel sentences from web pages has proven effective for low-resource machine translation, the majority of the world's languages have little to no web presence. What they do have, though, are resources that are the result of centuries of efforts by linguists, such as grammars, dictionaries, and other documentation materials. We propose extracting translation examples from such linguistic resources, which offer parallel data for languages under-represented online and could potentially scale to thousands more languages. We develop a pipeline to achieve this, leveraging an Optical Character Recognition (OCR) model as well as a vision language model (VLM), to ensure identified content to be aligned with visual layout information. We demonstrate the utility of the extracted bitexts for bootstrapping translation systems across 20 languages, both by training machine translation models and by applying in-context learning for large language models. For in-context learning, we observe improvements of +15.78 and +6.94 chrF2++ over zero-shot translation for into low- and high-resource languages, respectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出从语言学文献（语法书、词典等）中抽取平行句对，作为网络数据稀缺语言的翻译数据来源，并构建了结合OCR与视觉语言模型（VLM）的抽取流水线，在20种语言上验证了所抽取双语的实用价值。
AI.motivation: 从网页挖掘平行句对虽对低资源机器翻译有效，但全球大多数语言在网络上几乎无存在感；而这些语言往往拥有数百年语言学积累的语法书、词典等文献资源，可为其提供平行数据，并有望扩展到数千种语言。
AI.method: 提出从语言学文献中抽取翻译样例；构建一条抽取流水线，结合光学字符识别（OCR）模型与视觉语言模型（VLM），利用视觉版面信息确保抽取内容与页面布局对齐。
AI.result: 在20种语言上验证抽取的双语文本可用于引导翻译系统：既用于训练机器翻译模型，也用于大语言模型的上下文学习（ICL）；ICL场景下，相较于零样本翻译，面向低资源和高资源语言分别取得+15.78与+6.94 chrF2++的提升。
AI.conclusion: 语言学文献是被忽视但潜力巨大的平行数据来源，可覆盖网络缺失的语言；OCR与VLM结合的版面感知抽取流水线所获得的双语文本能有效引导机器翻译模型与LLM的翻译能力。

title: What to randomize matters: a controlled study of volume, axis and representation in low-data molecular generation
summary: Chemical language models can struggle to generate new molecules when trained on small datasets, where a model may reproduce training examples rather than learn a useful generative distribution. Randomized SMILES augmentation varies atom traversal, whereas Sequential Attachment-based Fragment Embedding (SAFE) also allows the order of fragment blocks to vary. How these distinct sources of representational variation affect low-data molecular generation has not been clearly studied. Here, using 1,000 seed molecules to train an autoregressive sequence model, we compare canonical SAFE with randomized SAFE at increasing corpus sizes, isolate atom-order and fragment-order axes of SAFE randomization, and compare fully randomized SAFE with randomized SMILES at molecule-by-molecule matched training corpora. Three findings emerge. First, randomization of SAFE alone raises the genuine yield of novel molecules more than 450-fold, turning a model that merely reproduces its training set into a practical molecular generator. Second, the two axes of randomization act jointly rather than additively: atom order alone reaches a tenth, and fragment order alone a seventh, of the genuine yield obtained when both vary, which is four times their combined contribution. Third, at matched corpus size and compute, randomized SAFE delivers 2.8 times the genuine yield of randomized SMILES. Welch tests with Games-Howell post-hoc comparisons resolve every difference on the primary outcomes. In the low-data regime, thus, what one randomizes rather than only how much determines whether augmentation produces new molecules or merely new spellings of the training set.

AI.tldr: 在小数据条件下，SAFE 的随机化（尤其是原子序与片段序联合随机化）是决定分子生成模型能否产生真正新分子的关键因素，而非随机化幅度本身。
AI.motivation: 化学语言模型在小数据集上训练时易复现训练样本而非学到可用的生成分布。随机化 SMILES 只改变原子遍历顺序，SAFE 还能改变片段块顺序，但这两类表示变化来源如何影响低数据分子生成尚缺乏清晰研究。
AI.method: 用 1000 个种子分子训练自回归序列模型，在递增语料规模下比较规范 SAFE 与随机 SAFE；分离 SAFE 随机化的原子序轴与片段序轴；并在逐分子匹配的训练语料上比较完全随机 SAFE 与随机 SMILES。统计上用 Welch 检验配 Games-Howell 事后比较。
AI.result: （1）仅随机化 SAFE 即使新颖分子的真实产率提升逾 450 倍，使原本只复现训练集的模型变为实用生成器；（2）两轴随机化呈联合而非加性作用：仅原子序约为双轴全随机的 1/10，仅片段序约为 1/7，而双轴联合效应是其各自贡献之和的 4 倍；（3）在匹配语料规模与算力下，随机 SAFE 的真实产率为随机 SMILES 的 2.8 倍；主要结局上的所有差异均通过 Welch 检验与 Games-Howell 事后比较得到确认。
AI.conclusion: 在低数据情形下，决定增强能否产生真正新分子（而非训练集的“新拼写”）的关键是随机化“什么”而非仅“多少”；片段序与原子序应联合随机化。

title: MRC-MMAgent: Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Role Collaboration in Multimodal Tool-Using Agents
summary: Multimodal tool-using agents augment vision-language models with access to external information and capabilities, enabling them to solve knowledge-intensive and visually complex tasks that cannot be addressed using visual context alone. However, existing reinforcement learning pipelines largely train single-role agents to search and answer using terminal rewards, overlooking how humans inspect retrieved evidence, reformulate queries, and revise conclusions during search. Consequently, they fail to optimize this self-corrective process over complete interaction trajectories. We propose MRC-MMAgent, a multi-role collaborative reinforcement learning framework that incorporates trajectory assessment and continuation directly into the executable agent loop. First, the framework establishes a multi-role collaborative loop that integrates solving, inspection, and continuation, enabling the agent to acquire evidence through tools, evaluate the preceding trajectory, and resume problem solving when the current answer is insufficiently supported. Second, we introduce a role-coupled learning objective that combines task success, interaction validity, and successful correction with full-trajectory policy optimization across the decisions generated by all roles. Extensive experiments show that, using only the original baseline training set without constructing additional datasets, our method consistently outperforms the corresponding base models and achieves leading or highly competitive performance across benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出多角色协作强化学习框架 MRC-MMAgent，将轨迹评估与续作嵌入可执行智能体循环，使多模态工具智能体具备自纠错能力，在多基准上取得领先或极具竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态工具智能体的强化学习流程多以单角色、终端奖励方式训练，忽略了人类在检索中检查证据、改写查询、修正结论的自纠错过程，因而无法在完整交互轨迹上优化该过程。
AI.method: 构建融合求解、检查与续作的多角色协作循环：智能体通过工具获取证据、评估前序轨迹，并在当前答案支撑不足时恢复问题求解；同时设计角色耦合学习目标，将任务成功、交互有效性与成功纠错结合，并对所有角色产生的决策进行全轨迹策略优化。
AI.result: 在仅使用原始基线训练集、不额外构建数据集的情况下，方法持续优于对应基座模型，并在多个基准上达到领先或极具竞争力的表现。
AI.conclusion: 将自纠错机制显式建模为多角色协作循环并以角色耦合的全轨迹目标联合优化，是提升多模态工具智能体检索推理可靠性的有效途径。

title: Where to Learn and How Far to Roll Out: Efficient Adaptive Training for GUI Agents
summary: Trajectory-level GRPO is a common approach for training multi-step GUI agents, but repeatedly rolling out complete trajectories from the task root can be inefficient: task-level rewards provide coarse supervision over which intermediate decisions require improvement, while already-mastered prefixes are repeatedly re-executed before reaching difficult states. We introduce a two-stage adaptive training framework that jointly addresses where to learn and how far to roll out. We first construct reusable intermediate checkpoints from successful expert trajectories and select informative pivots using action disagreement, which measures uncertainty directly from sampled GUI actions. Stage I performs one-step RL at these pivots to improve uncertain local decisions. Stage II then progressively expands policy responsibility through adaptive Local, Suffix, and Root training according to task progress. Recoverable checkpoints enable repeated training from intermediate states without replaying the preceding trajectory. Across MobileGym and CUA-Gym-Hub, our method reduces environment interaction by 56-61% relative to Vanilla GRPO while improving task performance, demonstrating that jointly allocating training across states and rollout ranges can substantially improve GUI-agent RL efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段自适应训练框架，通过可复用中间检查点与自适应 rollout 范围，联合解决"在哪里学"和"rollout 多远"的问题，显著提升 GUI agent 的 RL 训练效率。
AI.motivation: 轨迹级 GRPO 需从任务根节点反复 rollout 完整轨迹，效率低下：任务级奖励对中间决策的监督过于粗糙，且已掌握的前缀被反复重执行才能到达困难状态。因此需同时回答"在哪些状态上学"与"rollout 多长"两个问题。
AI.method: 从成功专家轨迹构建可复用中间检查点，基于采样 GUI 动作的 action disagreement 度量不确定性以选取信息量高的 pivot。Stage I 在 pivot 处做一步式 RL 优化不确定的局部决策；Stage II 依据任务进度按 Local→Suffix→Root 逐步扩展策略责任范围。可恢复检查点支持从中间状态重复训练而无需重放前序轨迹。
AI.result: 在 MobileGym 与 CUA-Gym-Hub 上，相较 Vanilla GRPO 环境交互减少 56–61%，同时任务成功率提升。
AI.conclusion: 联合在状态维度与 rollout 范围维度分配训练资源，可大幅提升 GUI agent 的 RL 训练效率。

title: ScienceJudge: Pattern Perturbation Augmentation for Sentence-Level Scientific Claim Verification
summary: Sentence-level scientific claim verification determines whether each sentence in an AI-generated scientific paragraph is supported by a given multimodal evidence bundle. Fine-grained reporting errors often preserve fluent and plausible statements while introducing subtle evidence-claim deviations, making them difficult to detect under sparse and imbalanced supervision. We propose Pattern Perturbation Augmentation (PPA), which models reporting errors as label-specific faithfulness breaking transformations and induces reusable error patterns from labeled examples. PPA applies these patterns to supported claims to construct controlled hard negatives and expands their coverage through pattern-level, operation-level, and cross-domain augmentation. Based on these augmented views, we develop ScienceJudge, which integrates PPA-trained vision-language predictors and instruction-guided LLM predictors through class-weighted ensemble inference. On the local development set, ScienceJudge improves the average score from 0.8124 to 0.8692, achieving a Macro-F1 of 0.8466 and a Paragraph Exact Match score of 0.8919. Our submitted system ranks first on the official NLPCC 2026 Task 10 Track 1 leaderboard with a final score of 0.6890.

AI.tldr: 提出模式扰动增强(PPA)与ScienceJudge系统，用于多模态证据下句子级科学主张验证，通过构造可控硬负样本并结合视觉-语言与LLM预测器的类别加权集成，取得显著提升并获官方榜单第一名。
AI.motivation: 细粒度报告错误往往保持语句流畅合理却引入微妙的证据-主张偏差，且监督信号稀疏且类别不平衡，导致此类错误难以检测。
AI.method: 将报告错误建模为标签特定的"忠实性破坏"变换，从标注样本中归纳可复用的错误模式；对受支持主张施加模式构造可控硬负样本，并通过模式级、操作级与跨域增强扩展覆盖；构建ScienceJudge，将PPA训练的视觉-语言预测器与指令引导的LLM预测器进行类别加权集成推理。
AI.result: 本地开发集平均分由0.8124提升至0.8692，Macro-F1达0.8466，段落精确匹配(Paragraph Exact Match)达0.8919；提交系统以最终得分0.6890在NLPCC 2026 Task 10 Track 1官方榜单排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 基于模式扰动的可控硬负样本增强与多模型类别加权集成，能有效缓解稀疏不平衡监督下的细微报告错误检测问题，验证了该方法的有效性与竞争力。

title: Discovery of Diverse and Realistic Financial Tail-Risk Using Generative Flow Networks
summary: Accurate modeling of rare, high-impact financial events is essential for robust risk management. Sampling-based techniques such as Sequential Markov Chain Monte Carlo (SMCMC) generate diverse scenarios but inefficiently explore high-risk regions, while Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) converges on narrow sets of scenarios, limiting diversity. We present GRID, which uses Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) -- samplers that draw objects in proportion to a reward -- to systematically generate diverse and realistic financial tail-risk scenarios. Building on continuous GFlowNets, GRID introduces a flexible mixture-policy architecture with variable-specific distribution families for high-dimensional, sequential macro-financial data, together with plausibility constraints that keep generated trajectories realistic. A central practical advantage is robustness to reward-proxy imperfection: because GFlowNets sample proportionally rather than maximize, they remain broadly exploratory even when the oracle's out-of-sample accuracy is low -- an unavoidable reality in financial forecasting. On three real-world crises, GRID improves scenario diversity, realism, and tail-risk coverage over RL and MCMC baselines, and ablations over oracle architectures and distribution families yield practical insights into continuous GFlowNet behavior under noisy rewards.

AI.tldr: 提出GRID，基于连续GFlowNet为宏观金融序列数据生成多样且真实的尾部风险情景，在三次真实危机上优于RL与MCMC基线。
AI.motivation: 准确建模罕见高影响的金融事件对稳健风险管理至关重要。现有方法存在缺陷：基于采样的SMCMC虽能生成多样情景，但对高风险区域探索效率低；DRL虽能收敛到高风险情景，但情景集合狭窄、多样性不足。此外，金融预测中奖励代理（oracle）的样本外精度天然偏低，需要方法对奖励代理不完美具有鲁棒性。
AI.method: GRID采用GFlowNet（按奖励比例采样的生成式流网络）系统性生成多样化且真实的金融尾部风险情景。在连续GFlowNet基础上：（1）设计灵活的混合策略架构，为各变量指定不同的分布族，以适配高维、序列化的宏观金融数据；（2）引入合理性约束（plausibility constraints），保证生成轨迹真实可信。核心思路是利用GFlowNet"按比例采样"而非"最大化奖励"的特性，在oracle样本外精度低时仍保持广泛探索性。
AI.result: 在三次真实危机数据上，GRID在情景多样性、真实性和尾部风险覆盖度三方面均优于强化学习（RL）与MCMC基线；针对oracle架构与分布族的消融实验，给出了噪声奖励下连续GFlowNet行为的实践性洞见。
AI.conclusion: GFlowNet的比例采样范式天然适配金融尾部风险场景生成：既克服了MCMC高风险区探索低效与RL多样性不足的问题，又对不完美的奖励代理具备鲁棒性，是可落地的风险管理情景生成方案。

title: Can Image Agents Complete Visual Commissions? A Benchmark and Modular Framework
summary: Visual commissions require image agents to integrate heterogeneous source materials, preserve requirements across dependent stages, and produce coordinated deliverables. Existing evaluations examine specific capabilities and execution settings, leaving end-to-end commission completion less understood. We introduce Visual Commission Bench (VCB), comprising 600 tasks across 12 categories and three complementary tiers, from capability-focused tasks to complete commissions. VCB uses 5,039 requirement checks and separate visual quality ratings to assess content correctness, visual realization, constraint preservation, and delivery completeness without prescribing an internal workflow. We present V-Protocol, a reference agent that dynamically composes reusable task, cognitive, and expression modules at inference time. Task modules organize delivery, cognitive modules derive content, and expression modules guide visual realization. The modules exchange structured intermediate artifacts, while a shared execution harness tracks artifact revisions and dependencies, manages tool execution, and checks completion. With the same controller and image generator as the agent baselines, V-Protocol achieves 69.0\% strict task success on VCB, compared with 42.0\% for SCOPE. On Mind-Bench, strict accuracy increases from 39.2\% to 45.4\%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出视觉委托基准 VCB（600 任务、12 类别、三个层级、5,039 条需求检查）与参考智能体 V-Protocol，基于可复用模块的动态组合与结构化中间产物交换，在同等控制器与图像生成器下显著提升端到端视觉委托完成度。
AI.motivation: 视觉委托（visual commission）要求图像智能体整合异构源材料、在依赖阶段间保留需求并产出协调一致的交付物，但现有评测多聚焦单一能力或特定执行设定，端到端委托的完成能力缺乏系统性刻画，因此需要新的基准与更强的参考智能体。
AI.method: 构建 Visual Commission Bench：600 个任务、12 个类别、三个互补层级（从能力导向任务到完整委托），使用 5,039 条需求检查加独立视觉质量评分，覆盖内容正确性、视觉实现、约束保持与交付完整性，且不规定内部工作流。提出参考智能体 V-Protocol：在推理时动态组合可复用的任务模块（组织交付）、认知模块（推导内容）与表达模块（引导视觉实现），模块间以结构化中间产物交换，并由共享执行框架跟踪产物版本与依赖、管理工具执行并检查完成度。
AI.result: 在与智能体基线相同的控制器与图像生成器条件下，V-Protocol 在 VCB 上取得 69.0% 严格任务成功率，SCOPE 为 42.0%；在 Mind-Bench 上严格准确率由 39.2% 提升至 45.4%。
AI.conclusion: 模块化、可组合的智能体架构配合结构化产物管理与依赖追踪，能有效提升多阶段视觉委托的端到端成功率与准确率；VCB 提供了不预设工作流的细粒度评测框架，可用于比较不同智能体的委托完成能力。

title: Online Dense Reinforcement Learning with Planning-Grounding Agent for UI Navigation on Live IOS Apps
summary: While frontier vision-language models demonstrate strong capabilities in user interface (UI) navigation, their high inference costs prohibit everyday use. Conversely, smaller models trained via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or offline reinforcement learning often memorize static trajectories, leading to brittle execution and an inability to recover from errors. To address these limitations, we propose a novel online reinforcement learning framework that trains UI navigation agents directly on live iOS applications. Our framework decouples the agent into two specialized components: a Planning agent and a UI Grounding model. We rely on an LLM-as-a-Judge to provide comprehensive reward signals, combining dense, step-level feedback to evaluate intermediate progress with a terminal reward for overall task completion. To effectively leverage this dual reward structure, we optimize the agent using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with step-level advantage estimation. Furthermore, we introduce GiGPPO, a novel neighbor-conditioned value estimation method that improves critic stability by leveraging reward signals from visually similar states across concurrent trajectories. To support this online training paradigm at scale, we introduce an efficient infrastructure that orchestrates hundreds of concurrent virtual iOS devices. Evaluations on rigorous benchmarks, including UINavBench, iOSWorld, and AndroidWorld, demonstrate that our online RL trained agents substantially outperform both SFT and terminal-only RL baselines while accelerating training convergence. Notably, our 8B RL agents achieve nearly a sevenfold improvement over the SFT baseline in out-of-distribution generalization to Android environments, while outperforming Gemini-3.5-Flash and tying with Gemini-3.1-Pro on real iOS applications.

AI.tldr: 提出一个直接在真实 iOS 应用上训练的在线强化学习框架，将 UI 导航智能体解耦为规划智能体与 UI Grounding 模型，用 LLM-as-a-Judge 提供稠密步级+终端奖励，并以 PPO（步级优势估计）及新提出的 GiGPPO 邻居条件价值估计优化，配合可编排数百个并发虚拟 iOS 设备的基础设施。
AI.motivation: 前沿视觉语言模型 UI 导航能力强但推理成本高，难以日常使用；而经 SFT 或离线 RL 训练的小模型易记忆静态轨迹，执行脆弱、无法从错误中恢复。
AI.method: 1) 在线 RL 框架，直接在实时 iOS 应用上训练；2) 架构解耦：Planning agent + UI Grounding model 两组件；3) LLM-as-a-Judge 奖励：稠密步级反馈评估中间进展 + 终端任务完成奖励；4) 采用 PPO 与步级优势估计利用双奖励结构；5) 提出 GiGPPO——邻居条件价值估计，利用并发轨迹中视觉相似状态的奖励信号提升 critic 稳定性；6) 高效基础设施，编排数百个并发虚拟 iOS 设备。
