This paper presents IndicIPR-QA1, an extractive QA benchmark for Indian IPR laws. The proposed dataset contains 4,462 QA pairs from 1,116 statutory contexts across seven Acts. Questions and answers are generated using GPT-4o and validated through nine automatic quality checks, single and multi-model LLM evaluations, and a 200-pair human audit. Section-level partitioning prevents source-context overlap across the training, validation, and test sets. Further analysis examines answer span length, lexical overlap, and multi-clause structure across the corpus and individual Acts. BM25 achieves a token-level F1 score of 20.21, while fine-tuned InLegalBERT reaches 85.02 under a unified sliding-window inference protocol. The large performance gap between BM25 (20.21 F1) and InLegalBERT (85.02 F1) shows that simple word matching is not enough to answer these legal questions. Performance also varies across the seven Acts, indicating substantial differences in answer-extraction performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 IndicIPR-QA，首个覆盖印度全部七部知识产权法案的抽取式问答数据集，含 4,462 条 QA 对，并给出 BM25 与 InLegalBERT 的基线对比。
AI.motivation: 法律问答需要精确且以法条为依据的答案，而低资源法域（如印度知识产权法）缺乏提供法条原文精确答案跨度的抽取式 QA 基准，尚无覆盖七部 IPR 法案的同类数据集。
AI.method: 构建 4,462 条 QA 对、来自 1,116 个法条上下文的七部法案语料；QA 由 GPT-4o 生成，经九项自动质量检查、单模型与多模型 LLM 评估及 200 对人工审核验证；按章节级划分训练/验证/测试集以避免上下文重叠；分析答案跨度长度、词汇重叠度与多子句结构；以 BM25 与微调 InLegalBERT 在统一滑窗推理协议下建立基线。
AI.result: BM25 的 token 级 F1 为 20.21，微调 InLegalBERT 达 85.02；两者差距显著，说明单纯词面匹配不足以应对该类法律问题；且七个法案间性能差异明显，答案抽取难度不均。
AI.conclusion: IndicIPR-QA 填补了印度 IPR 法域抽取式 QA 基准的空白，为法条原文接地（grounded）的问答研究提供高质量、可复现的评测资源，并揭示跨法案迁移与领域适配仍是关键挑战。

title: Rethinking GFlowNet Training: Negative Reinforce Dynamics
summary: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) are models that learn to sample discrete objects proportional to a target reward. They are trained by minimizing balance errors over sampled trajectories, which inherently ties correctness to exploration: if a region is not visited, balance cannot be enforced there. Adaptive exploration is therefore crucial, yet standard training relies on a semi-gradient update that treats the sampling distribution as fixed at each optimization step. On the other hand, the full gradient reveals a second mechanism that reduces the observed errors in an anti-exploratory manner. In this paper, we establish a connection between the full gradient and min-min dynamics between the GFlowNet and a decoupled sampler, showing that the sampler reduces observed violations by avoiding high-error regions. This insight motivates a bridge between two-player games and single-policy dynamics, which underpins the design of our proposed method, Negative Reinforce Dynamics (NRD). By tying the parameters of an adversarial game together, we recover a single-policy dynamic that extends exploration while maintaining correctness. In standard benchmarks, our method outperforms existing approaches in both convergence speed and exploration efficiency, without training a separate teacher or auxiliary exploration policy.

AI.tldr: 本文将GFlowNet的全梯度更新解释为GFlowNet与解耦采样器之间的min-min博弈，揭示全梯度通过“避开高误差区域”产生反探索效应；据此提出负强化动力学（NRD），将两玩家博弈参数绑定为单一策略动力学，在不需独立教师策略的前提下同时提升探索与正确性。
AI.motivation: GFlowNet通过最小化采样轨迹上的balance误差训练，正确性依赖探索：未访问区域无法施加balance约束。自适应探索至关重要，但标准训练采用半梯度更新，将采样分布视为固定；而全梯度虽然能减小观测误差，却是以反探索方式实现（采样器避开高误差区域）。本文旨在厘清全梯度的这一机理并设计兼顾探索与正确性的训练动力学。
AI.method: 首先建立全梯度与GFlowNet–解耦采样器之间min-min动力学的联系，说明采样器通过规避高误差区域降低观测到的balance违背；基于该洞察，桥接两玩家博弈与单策略动力学，提出Negative Reinforce Dynamics（NRD）：将对抗博弈双方的参数绑定，恢复出扩展探索同时保持正确性的单策略更新，且无需单独训练教师或辅助探索策略。
AI.result: 在标准基准上，NRD在收敛速度与探索效率两方面均优于现有方法，且无需额外的教师模型或辅助探索策略。
AI.conclusion: 全梯度的反探索特性源于采样器对高误差区域的规避，可用min-min博弈刻画；将两玩家博弈参数绑定得到的NRD是一种简洁有效的单策略训练动力学，实现了探索与正确性的统一，为GFlowNet的自适应探索提供了理论驱动的解决方案。

title: FDSML: Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning with Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 24 pages (11 main + 13 supplementary). Project page: https://shineiarakawa.github.io/fdsml/
summary: Formula-Driven Supervised Learning (FDSL) enables vision pre-training without real images, but existing methods cast pre-training as classification on discretized labels, discarding continuity in the generative process. We propose Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning (FDSML), which derives relational supervision from image-generation parameters beyond discrete class labels. FDSML combines FineFractalDB, our refined fractal dataset with higher intra-class variation and more stable structures, with a Parameter-Aware Triplet (PA-Triplet) Loss that assigns positives and negatives according to distances in the underlying Iterated Function System parameter space. This objective trains embeddings to respect parameter-derived relative similarity orderings. Experiments show that FDSML improves transferability to image retrieval while remaining competitive on downstream classification and improving robustness under several corruption settings. On ResNet-50, Recall@1 improves from 65.6% to 74.0% on Stanford Online Products and from 56.2% to 78.4% on Stanford Cars over FDSL pre-training. These results suggest that parameter-derived relational supervision provides a stronger synthetic pre-training signal than label-based classification for transfer beyond recognition.

AI.tldr: 提出公式驱动的监督度量学习（FDSML），从图像生成参数中导出关系监督（PA-Triplet Loss），配合改进的 FineFractalDB 数据集实现无真实图像的预训练，显著提升图像检索迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 FDSL 将预训练建模为对离散化标签的分类任务，丢弃了生成过程中的连续性信息，导致监督信号受限、迁移能力（尤其检索任务）不足。
AI.method: 构建 FineFractalDB（类内差异更大、结构更稳定的分形数据集）；设计参数感知三元组损失 PA-Triplet Loss，依据迭代函数系统（IFS）参数空间中的距离分配正负样本，使嵌入遵循参数导出的相对相似性排序。
AI.result: ResNet-50 上，Stanford Online Products Recall@1 由 65.6% 提升至 74.0%，Stanford Cars 由 56.2% 提升至 78.4%（相对 FDSL 预训练）；下游分类保持竞争力，多种损坏设置下鲁棒性提升。
AI.conclusion: 参数导出的关系监督比基于标签的分类提供更强的合成预训练信号，可有效迁移至识别以外的任务（如检索）。

title: ATLAS-Bench: An Agentic Tool-Use Benchmark for Local Area Search
summary: Reliable local search is essential for LLM agents to support everyday decisions and longer plans by finding places that meet users' needs at given times and locations. Yet existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of whether search results satisfy mandatory requirements, account for preferences, and ground factual and experiential judgments in place attributes and reviews. We introduce ATLAS-Bench, a benchmark of 1,200 queries across three regions, expanded from real search events using place attributes, reviews, and existing user profiles from the platform. Each query distinguishes mandatory requirements from preferences and factual conditions from subjective judgments, with supporting evidence and criteria for checking each requirement. Queries are validated through iterative assertion checks and cross-model review. We also introduce ATLASBox, a standardized evaluation environment with search tools and a fixed point-of-interest (POI) knowledge base. Given a query, timestamp, and location, an agent searches place attributes and reviews to recommend evidence-supported options or report that no place meets all mandatory requirements. We evaluate answer quality, trajectory quality, and execution cost. Across 14 configurations of 11 models, GPT-6-Luna achieves the highest constraint satisfaction rate among returned recommendations (71.5%) and factual accuracy (95.6%). However, it returns at least one acceptable recommendation for fewer satisfiable queries than GLM-5.3 (67.3% versus 85.3%). These results highlight the challenge of satisfying individual requirements while providing usable recommendations across queries.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ATLAS-Bench基准与ATLASBox评测环境，用于评估LLM智能体在本地搜索中区分硬性要求与偏好、事实与主观判断的能力，并揭示现有模型在"满足个体约束"与"整体可用推荐覆盖率"之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 可靠的本地搜索对LLM智能体的日常决策与长程规划至关重要，但现有基准覆盖不足：无法判断搜索结果是否满足强制性要求、是否考虑用户偏好，也无法将事实性与体验性判断扎根于场所属性和评论证据。
AI.method: 构建ATLAS-Bench，包含三个区域共1200条查询，由真实搜索事件扩展而来，融合场所属性、评论与平台现有用户画像；每条查询区分强制性要求与偏好、事实条件与主观判断，并附带支撑证据与逐条核查标准，通过迭代断言检查与跨模型评审验证。同时提出ATLASBox标准化评测环境，提供搜索工具与固定POI知识库；给定查询、时间戳与位置，智能体需检索属性与评论，给出有证据支持的推荐，或在无场所满足全部硬性要求时如实报告。评测涵盖答案质量、轨迹质量与执行成本。
AI.result: 在11个模型的14种配置中，GPT-6-Luna在返回推荐的约束满足率（71.5%）与事实准确率（95.6%）上最高；但对可满足查询至少给出一个可接受推荐的比例低于GLM-5.3（67.3% 对 85.3%）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在严格满足个体要求与跨查询提供可用推荐之间存在显著张力，是LLM智能体本地搜索的核心挑战。该基准为细粒度、证据可核查的智能体搜索评测提供了标准化基础。

title: Homebrewed SLMs: Autoregressive and Masked Diffusion Language Models Built at Home for Portuguese
comment: 34 pages, 14 figures, 13 tables. Code and notebooks: https://github.com/pcbrom/homebrewed-slms
summary: Building a language model of one's own no longer requires a data centre. This tutorial trains one from scratch, tokenizer included, on one consumer GPU, and shows how to tell whether it is good for the tasks of a specialist domain. It proposes no new method. It releases a tested Python package and two notebooks in Brazilian Portuguese with autoregressive and masked diffusion generation on one network, a preregistered comparison protocol, legal tasks built from text alone with a Kneser-Ney floor and public yardsticks, reference numbers for models of 11 to 12M parameters, and a catalogue of defects that only measurement revealed. On Brazilian prose and federal laws, at minutes per run, the autoregressive mode peaks at 64 epochs over the same text and then memorises it, while masked diffusion improves up to 256. At their best points on test, the diffusion bound exceeds the autoregressive likelihood by 0.06 bits per byte, within the preregistered minimum effect. On held-out laws and on acts published after training, the model ties a 6-gram floor in likelihood on the same windows, and it loses to the floor at continuing those acts. It beats the floor at detecting tampered text, and fills cross-references more often than the floor and public models of 160M and 630M parameters, only in decrees, a genre absent from training, where those scorers stay near or below chance, and in filling the blank only when each group weighs the same, since per item it ties the 630M model. On laws, the public models, trained with about 5x10^2 to 10^5 times its compute, lead in tampered text and continuation. The blind human reading is preregistered and not part of this version.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇面向专业领域小模型（11–12M参数）的实践型教程：在单张消费级GPU上从零训练语言模型（含分词器），并给出了判定其在法律领域任务上是否有用的测量协议与基准数字。
AI.motivation: 自建领域语言模型已不再需要数据中心，但缺乏对"小模型在专业领域是否够用"的可复现评判方法；作者希望提供一套可测量、可预注册的对齐协议与参考基线，而非提出新方法。
AI.method: 训练单个网络同时支持自回归与掩码扩散两种生成模式；发布已测试的Python包与两份葡萄牙语notebook；构建仅基于文本的法律任务，使用Kneser-Ney n-gram下界与公开模型作为对照标尺；采用预注册的比较协议，并记录只有通过测量才暴露的缺陷清单。
AI.result: 在巴西散文与联邦法律上，自回归模式在同一文本上于64个epoch达到峰值后转为记忆，掩码扩散则持续提升至256个epoch；各自最佳测试点上，扩散的对数似然上界比自回归高0.06 bits/byte，落在预注册的最小效应范围内。在留出法律与训练后颁布的法案上，模型似然与6-gram下界持平，但在续写上劣于下界；在篡改文本检测上优于下界；在法令（训练中未出现的体裁）的交叉引用填空上，其表现优于下界及160M、630M公开模型，而后者在此接近或低于随机水平，在空位填空上仅在各类权重相同时占优，逐项统计则与630M模型持平。对于法律任务，计算量约高出5×10²至10⁵倍的公开模型在篡改检测与续写上领先。
AI.conclusion: 本文并未提出新方法，而是提供了一个可复现的领域小模型训练与评测工具箱：小模型在特定低资源体裁（如法令）上可超越大型公开模型，但在常规法律任务上落后于大算力模型；盲测人工阅读已预注册，但未纳入本版本。

title: Fed-IGTD: A federated learning-based framework for tabular-to-image encoding
summary: Tabular-to-image encoding methods, which transform tabular data into image-like representations, have shown promising results in predictive tasks. Despite their benefits, these methods follow a centralized paradigm, in which the data are collected and models are trained on a central device. This raises privacy and security concerns, particularly the risk of data leakage, unauthorized data collection and access to users' private information. Federated Learning (FL) provides a decentralized framework in which multiple clients jointly optimize a shared model without directly sharing training data. We introduce Fed-IGTD, a horizontal FL-based approach in which clients share a common feature space and upload only local statistics, from which the server reconstructs the global correlation matrix and obtains a feature-to-pixel mapping to train a convolutional neural network via Federated Averaging (FedAvg). We studied two differential privacy (DP) mechanisms: (i) a one-shot Gaussian mechanism protecting the correlation-aggregation step; and (ii) a client-level DP-FedAvg variant protecting the training with privacy loss composed via a Renyi-DP accountant. We evaluated Fed-IGTD on five datasets under a systematic sweep of non-IID severity and privacy budgets. Privacy protection applied to the mapping-construction step has little impact on predictive performance. By contrast, DP-FedAvg substantially degrades utility at moderate privacy budgets with a small client cohort (K=5). Ablation study indicates that this degradation is driven mainly by the injected noise rather than by uniform averaging or update clipping. Macro-F1 exhibits sensitivity to performance degradation than accuracy under non-IID heterogeneity and class imbalance.

AI.tldr: Fed-IGTD将表格到图像编码（IGTD）与横向联邦学习结合：客户端仅上传局部统计量，服务器重建全局相关矩阵并生成特征-像素映射，用FedAvg训练CNN；研究两种差分隐私机制，发现保护映射构建步骤几乎不损性能，而DP-FedAvg在中等隐私预算、小客户端规模（K=5）下显著降低效用，且退化主要源于注入噪声。
AI.motivation: 表格-图像编码方法虽有效，但采用集中式范式，需汇集数据并在中心设备训练，带来隐私与安全风险（数据泄露、未授权收集与访问）。因此作者希望在去中心化的联邦学习框架下实现同类编码与预测，兼顾隐私保护。
AI.method: 提出Fed-IGTD：横向FL设定下客户端共享同一特征空间，仅上传局部统计量；服务器据此重建全局相关矩阵，得到特征到像素的映射，再以FedAvg联合训练CNN。评估两种DP机制：(i) 一次性高斯机制保护相关矩阵聚合步骤；(ii) 客户端级DP-FedAvg变体保护训练过程，隐私损失用Rényi-DP会计组合。在五个数据集上系统扫描非IID严重程度与隐私预算，并做消融分析。
AI.result: 在映射构建步骤施加隐私保护对预测性能影响很小；而DP-FedAvg在小客户端规模（K=5）、中等隐私预算下会显著降低效用；消融表明该退化主要来自注入的噪声，而非均匀平均或更新裁剪。非IID异质性与类别不平衡下，Macro-F1比准确率对性能退化更敏感。
AI.conclusion: Fed-IGTD证明表格-图像编码可在联邦范式下实现，且对映射构建阶段加噪的隐私代价很低；主要隐私-效用权衡来自训练阶段的DP-FedAvg，需在客户端规模与预算间权衡；Macro-F1更适合作为异质与非平衡场景下衡量退化的指标。

title: PathCowork: Learning from real-world pathology practice to build AI copilots
comment: 56 pages, including supplementary information. Code, models and demonstration videos: https://github.com/zhihuanglab/PathCowork
summary: Medical AI learns from the answers doctors record, but rarely from how they interpret the evidence to reach them. Here we introduce PathCowork, a framework that turns pathologists' narrated examinations into supervision for visual grounding and procedures that guide diagnostic AI agents. Synchronized gaze, narration and navigation link visual findings to the process of interpreting them. Across 48 sessions from 16 pathologists, the platform captured 1,028 minutes of slide review. Using these data, we trained PathCowork-1T for server deployment and PathCowork-27B for local deployment, with improved visual grounding. Across five organ-specific evaluations, agents combining this grounding with recorded diagnostic procedures achieved primary task scores averaging 17.9 and 24.1 percentage points higher than Claude Code and Codex, respectively, with shorter processing times and lower inference costs. Compared to the state-of-the-art multiple-instance learning AIs, the PathCowork agent-proposed regions achieved higher prostate-grading scores with limited slide labels. PathCowork can also help construct pathology AI benchmarks where questions derived from the recordings identified difficulties in recognizing viewing context and rejecting inapplicable premises. In summary, PathCowork proposes a new paradigm to scale up the data collection and train pathology AI through transparent reasoning from diagnostic sessions, opening a path towards systems that learn directly from routine clinical practice.

AI.tldr: PathCowork 将病理医生的注视、口述与操作导航同步采集，转化为视觉定位与诊断流程的监督信号，训练出服务器端 PathCowork-1T 与本地端 PathCowork-27B 两个诊断智能体，在五类器官评估中显著优于 Claude Code 与 Codex，并以更少标注超越多示例学习 AI。
AI.motivation: 现有医学 AI 只学习医生记录的"答案"，而忽略了医生如何解读证据、定位病变并推理得出结论的过程，导致监督信号贫乏、视觉定位能力弱、推理过程不透明。
AI.method: 构建 PathCowork 框架，在阅片过程中同步记录并时间对齐眼动注视、口述叙述与视野导航，将视觉发现与其解读过程关联，形成视觉定位监督和可复用的诊断流程；基于 16 名病理医生、48 场次、共 1,028 分钟阅片数据训练两个规模模型（1T 服务器端、27B 本地端）。
AI.result: 在五个器官专项评估中，结合视觉定位与记录诊断流程的智能体主任务得分分别比 Claude Code 和 Codex 高 17.9 与 24.1 个百分点，且处理时间更短、推理成本更低；相比 SOTA 多示例学习模型，在有限切片标注下前列腺分级得分更高；所生成的问题还可用于构建病理 AI 基准，揭示模型在识别观察上下文与拒绝不适用前提方面的困难。
AI.conclusion: PathCowork 提出了一种从常规诊断会话中透明推理、规模化采集数据并训练病理 AI 的新范式，为直接从日常临床实践中学习的系统开辟了路径。

title: Timbre: Reliability-aware harmonic consensus for label-free multimodal test-time rexinforcement learning
summary: Label-free test-time reinforcement learning adapts vision--language models using rewards derived from their own predictions. However, misinterpreted visual evidence and sensitivity to textual formulation can produce a consistent but incorrect consensus that majority voting reinforces. Cross-view aggregation can expose such errors, but image and text transformations may themselves degrade task-relevant evidence to different extents. We introduce \method, a reliability-aware harmonic consensus framework for multimodal test-time reinforcement learning. \method constructs a $2\times2$ grid combining original and perturbed images with direct-solving and reframing modes, selects pseudo-labels through weighted harmonic aggregation, and adapts modality-level weights using batch-averaged, temporally smoothed shifts in pseudo-label confidence as a heuristic reliability signal. We formulate consensus as a weighted $χ^2$-barycenter problem whose unique minimizer is the normalized weighted harmonic aggregate, without requiring correct-answer invariance. An exact support--dispersion decomposition characterizes when harmonic aggregation preserves or corrects arithmetic rankings, while a sensitivity analysis establishes how modality reweighting changes pairwise ranking margins, informing interpretation of the heuristic updates. Across six benchmarks and three Qwen3-VL model scales, \method outperforms TTRV in 16 of 18 benchmark--model settings on adaptation instances and 17 of 18 settings on held-out instances under matched estimation and optimization rollout counts. These results demonstrate improved target-task adaptation and transfer to unseen instances without further updates.

AI.tldr: 该文提出可靠性感知的调和共识框架（\method），通过2×2多视图网格与加权调和聚合、以伪标签置信度的批平均时序平滑变化作为模态可靠性信号自适应调整权重，在18个基准-模型设置中16个(适配实例)和17个(留出实例)优于TTRV。
AI.motivation: 无标签测试时强化学习依赖模型自身预测构造奖励，但视觉证据误读与文本表述敏感性会导致"一致但错误"的共识，被多数投票强化；跨视图聚合可暴露此类错误，然而图像与文本变换对任务相关证据的破坏程度不同，需要区分模态可靠性。
AI.method: 构建由原始/扰动图像与直接求解/重构表述模式组成的2×2网格；以加权调和聚合选取伪标签；用批平均、时序平滑的伪标签置信度漂移作为启发式可靠性信号更新模态级权重；将共识表述为加权χ²重心问题，证明其唯一极小点为归一化加权调和聚合，无需正确答案不变性。
AI.result: 给出精确的支撑-离散度分解，刻画调和聚合何时保持或纠正算术排序；敏感性分析刻画模态重加权对成对排序间隔的影响；在六个基准、三种Qwen3-VL规模下，于匹配估计与优化 rollout 次数时，适配实例16/18、留出实例17/18优于TTRV。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性加权的调和共识能缓解自洽错误共识，提升目标任务的测试时适配能力，并可迁移到未见实例而无需进一步更新。

title: Every Token Needs Its Own Teacher: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-distillation
summary: On-policy Self-distillation (OPSD) has proven effective for post-training large language models by constructing a teacher conditioned on privileged references. However, existing approaches keep the teacher fixed either throughout training by consistently exposing it to the full reference, or within each response by adaptively varying partial reference exposure only across responses. In this paper, we argue that neither of them is sufficient. Instead, every token needs its own teacher, as the teacher preference can vary token by token within the same response. Through a teacher-intervention pilot study, we validate that the teacher preference differs across tokens, and reveal that a preferred teacher can be identified for each token through majority voting and KL-based selection. Motivated by these findings, we propose Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-Distillation (MTA-OPSD), the first token-level adaptive OPSD method. Our method constructs a multi-teacher pool consisting of candidate teachers, and enables every token to adaptively select its preferred teacher during training. Experiments with Qwen3 models on mathematical reasoning tasks show that MTA-OPSD consistently outperforms existing OPSD approaches with an average gain of up to $+5.9$ over the base model, highlighting the importance of adapting teacher supervision at the token level. The code is available at https://github.com/xingzhejun/MTA-OPSD.

AI.tldr: 提出MTA-OPSD，首个token级自适应on-policy自蒸馏方法，为每个token从多教师池中选择偏好教师。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy自蒸馏的教师要么全局固定使用完整参考，要么仅在response级别自适应调整部分参考暴露，均忽略了同一response内教师偏好可能随token变化。
AI.method: 通过教师干预试点实验验证教师偏好在token间存在差异，并发现可用多数投票与KL选择为每个token确定偏好教师；据此构建候选教师池，训练中每个token自适应选择其偏好教师进行监督。
AI.result: 在Qwen3模型的数学推理任务上，MTA-OPSD一致优于现有OPSD方法，相对基座模型平均提升最高达+5.9。
AI.conclusion: token级自适应教师监督对on-policy自蒸馏至关重要；未来可扩展到更多任务与教师池构造策略。

title: Assessing feature scorer results on high-dimensional datasets with t-SNE
summary: While vast literature on high-dimensional data visualization is available, there are not many works regarding the visualization of feature scorers and their results. Feature scorers are algorithms that assign numerical importance to each feature of multi-dimensional datasets. These importance scores can be used in several applications, such as feature selection, knowledge discovery, and machine learning interpretability. There are several feature scorers to choose from, and often no single metric or ground truth is available to guarantee the quality of their results. In this scenario, visualization can become valuable to support the decision of which method to choose and how good its results are. For this goal, this work presents "weighted t-SNE." It modifies the relationship between data points in the embedded 2D space to reflect the importance of each dimension of the original datasets as assessed by a feature scorer. This research discusses how to implement weighted t-SNE, proposes the silhouette coefficient as a numerical evaluation of the results, and shows several examples of its use in practice. Synthetic and real-world tabular datasets are used in the experiments together with nine feature scorers, ranging from Mutual Information to neural networks. Each feature scorer produces unique visualizations, and weighted t-SNE can be used to compare and choose the one that better suits a given dataset and task. Weighted t-SNE can also visually show the importance of features learned by machine learning models and help us see how they are organizing the data, increasing their interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出加权 t-SNE，通过将特征重要性分数嵌入 2D 空间的距离关系，实现特征评分器（feature scorer）及其结果的可视化与比较，并提出轮廓系数作为数值评价指标，在合成与真实表格数据集上配合 9 种评分器验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 高维数据可视化文献丰富，但针对特征评分器及其结果的可视化工作较少。特征评分器为各特征赋予数值重要性，广泛用于特征选择、知识发现与模型可解释性；然而评分器众多，且往往缺乏单一度量或真值来保证结果质量，因此需要可视化来支持"选择哪种方法"和"其结果有多好"的判断。
AI.method: 对 t-SNE 进行改造，依据特征评分器给出的各原始维度重要性，调整嵌入 2D 空间中数据点之间的关系（加权距离），使嵌入结果反映特征重要性；论文讨论了加权 t-SNE 的实现方式，并提出以轮廓系数（silhouette coefficient）作为结果的数值评估手段，同时给出多个实践应用示例。
AI.result: 在合成数据集与真实表格数据集上，结合从互信息到神经网络的 9 种特征评分器开展实验。结果表明每个评分器产生独特的可视化结果，加权 t-SNE 可用于比较并选择更适合特定数据集与任务的方法；同时可直观展示机器学习模型所学特征的重要性，揭示其组织数据的方式，从而提升可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 加权 t-SNE 为特征评分器结果提供了有效的可视化分析与比较工具，兼具定性可视化与定量（轮廓系数）评估能力，可辅助方法选择并增强机器学习模型的可解释性。

title: Calibrating Attention-Based Token Pruning for Efficient Multi-Image Synthesis in UMMs
summary: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) enable powerful multi-image synthesis but incur substantial computation from long visual contexts. While token pruning offers a direct route to accelerating inference, existing methods are primarily adapted from understanding tasks, suffering from insufficient reference image exploration, confused conditional guidance, and pooling-induced ambiguity that degrades generation quality. To address these issues, we propose CATP, the first training-free context-compression method tailored to UMM generation, which \textbf{C}alibrates the discrepancies of general \textbf{A}ttention-based \textbf{T}oken \textbf{P}runing for better quality-efficiency trade-off. Concretely, building on independent layer-wise pruning during denoising, we introduce Guidance-Consistent Pruning (GCP) to synchronize pruning decisions across conditioning branches, and a Taylor-Calibrated Attention Metric (TCAM) that derives a theoretically grounded second-order correction for pooling-induced bias. In addition, a Fast Scoring Operator (FSO) fuses the calibration into tiled online Softmax to reduce pruning cost. Extensive experiments across representative UMMs and benchmarks demonstrate that CATP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art token-reduction methods, achieving up to 2.09$\times$ attention-core speedup.

AI.tldr: 提出CATP，首个面向统一多模态模型（UMM）图像生成的免训练上下文压缩方法，通过校准注意力token剪枝解决参考图探索不足、条件引导混乱与池化歧义问题，实现最高2.09×注意力核心加速。
AI.motivation: UMM支持强大的多图合成，但长视觉上下文带来巨大计算开销。现有token剪枝方法多移植自理解任务，存在参考图像探索不充分、条件引导混乱、池化引起歧义等问题，导致生成质量下降。
AI.method: CATP为免训练方法，基于去噪过程中逐层独立剪枝：1）Guidance-Consistent Pruning（GCP）在条件分支间同步剪枝决策；2）Taylor-Calibrated Attention Metric（TCAM）基于泰勒展开推导二阶校正，修正池化引入的偏差；3）Fast Scoring Operator（FSO）将校正融合进分块在线Softmax以降低剪枝成本。
AI.result: 在代表性UMM与基准上的大量实验表明，CATP持续优于当前最优token缩减方法，注意力核心加速最高达2.09×。
AI.conclusion: CATP作为首个针对UMM生成的免训练上下文压缩方法，通过针对生成任务特性的注意力剪枝校准，在生成质量与效率之间取得了更优权衡。

title: Kairos: Semantics-Aware Orchestration of Planning Engines across Classical, Numeric, Temporal and Hybrid PDDL
comment: 32 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Submitted to the Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research. Code: https://github.com/PlanSys2/kairos ; benchmark, scripts and results: https://github.com/PlanSys2/kairos-benchmarks
summary: Planning at run time, as in robots that re-plan while they act, needs a planner that reads the PDDL its users write (durative actions, numeric resources, time windows, continuous change), answers quickly, and delivers only validated plans. Specialised planners are strong on individual fragments of PDDL, but they differ in coverage, latency and in what their failures mean. We study whether selecting heterogeneous engines from the semantics of each task can give broad coverage of PDDL, from STRIPS to PDDL+, while remaining competitive with specialised planners and making explicit what each answer guarantees. Kairos profiles each task to decide which of five engines apply (ground heuristic search, compressed and snap-action temporal search, time steps for hybrid dynamics, lifted search) and schedules them under one budget of time and memory. Every candidate plan is checked by a validator independent of the planner's transformations, and "unsolvable" is reported only when a search whose exhaustion is a proof exhausts its space. On 1,756 tasks from nine comparative suites, Kairos solves more tasks at the full limits than the strongest evaluated planner of each suite, with the largest differences on numeric, temporal, PDDL3 and PDDL+ planning, and it also solves the most tasks at 100 ms and 1 s. Resampling over domains, the gain is above zero in six of the nine suites, while on classical planning against LAMA it is within the noise. A further 450 feature-oriented tasks and 26 one-feature probes show that Kairos handles all seventeen features probed, where no other planner evaluated handles more than eight. Ablations identify compressed temporal search and the novelty fallback as major contributors, and a comparison with VAL traces every disagreement to a PDDL+ convention or to a documented VAL defect. Planner and benchmark are open source.

AI.tldr: 提出 Kairos：从任务语义出发选择五种异构规划引擎并在统一时空预算下调度，配合独立验证器与可证伪的"不可解"判定，实现从 STRIPS 到 PDDL+ 的广覆盖且保持与专用规划器相当的竞争力。
AI.motivation: 运行时重规划场景需要能读取用户实际书写的 PDDL（durative actions、numeric resources、time windows、连续变化）、快速响应并只输出经验证计划的规划器。专用规划器虽在 PDDL 的个别片段上很强，但覆盖范围、延迟与失败语义不一致，因此需要一种能覆盖全 PDDL 谱系、并明确每次回答保证的通用方案。
AI.method: Kairos 对每个任务做 profiling（特征剖析），据此决定五种引擎中哪些适用：grounded 启发式搜索、压缩与 snap-action 时序搜索、面向混合动力学的 time steps、lifted 搜索；在单一时间与内存预算下调度。所有候选计划由独立于规划器转换的验证器检查，"不可解"仅在搜索空间耗尽即构成证明时报告。
AI.result: 在九个对比套件的 1,756 个任务上，满载限制下求解数超过各套件最强被评估规划器，差距最大见于 numeric、temporal、PDDL3 与 PDDL+；在 100 ms 与 1 s 预算下求解数也最高。按域重采样时九个套件中六个增益显著为正，经典规划对 LAMA 在噪声范围内。额外 450 个特征导向任务与 26 个单特征探针显示 Kairos 覆盖全部 17 个被探测特征，其他规划器最多覆盖 8 个。消融显示压缩时序搜索与 novelty fallback 为主要贡献；与 VAL 的对比中所有分歧均归于 PDDL+ 约定或已记录的 VAL 缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 基于语义的异构引擎选择与统一预算调度可在保持专用规划器竞争力的同时显著拓展 PDDL 覆盖并明确回答保证；规划器与基准开源。

title: PIVOT: Progressive Intervention via Online Teacher Correction
comment: 19 pages, 9 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://zhihaoyang30.github.io/PIVOT/
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) is limited by sparse outcome-level feedback on hard reasoning tasks: when all rollouts in a group fail, rewards provide no learning signal. Stronger teachers can provide additional guidance, but this raises a central question: how can such signals be incorporated into RLVR to support successful rollouts while remaining learnable for the student? We distinguish two complementary mechanisms: trajectory-level intervention, which improves access to reward-bearing trajectories, and token-level supervision, which provides dense targets to guide student learning. Our controlled experiments show that either mechanism alone can remain insufficient, motivating their combination. We therefore introduce PIVOT, which inserts teacher-generated corrections into student rollouts and applies token-level KL supervision to these segments alongside the RLVR objective. Beyond their combination, we systematically analyze where to intervene and how to supervise, yielding a recipe for effective guidance. Across hard logic games and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, PIVOT consistently outperforms existing methods, nearly doubling mean avg@8 on logic games from 19.5% for the best-performing baseline to 35.6%.

AI.tldr: 提出 PIVOT，将教师纠正片段插入学生轨迹并对这些片段施加 token 级 KL 监督，与 RLVR 目标联合训练，在困难逻辑游戏与数学推理任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: RLVR 依赖稀疏的结果级奖励，在困难推理任务中若一组 rollout 全部失败则无学习信号；虽有更强教师可提供额外指导，但如何将此类信号融入 RLVR、既保证成功轨迹又保持对学生可学习性，仍缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 区分两类互补机制：轨迹级干预（提高获得带奖励轨迹的概率）与 token 级监督（提供稠密目标）。控制实验表明单独使用任一机制均不充分，故提出 PIVOT：在学生 rollout 中插入教师生成的纠正片段，并对这些片段施加 token 级 KL 监督，同时保留 RLVR 目标；并系统分析干预位置与监督方式，形成有效指导配方。
AI.result: 在困难逻辑游戏与数学推理基准上 PIVOT 一致优于现有方法，逻辑游戏平均 avg@8 从最佳基线 19.5% 提升至 35.6%，接近翻倍。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级干预与 token 级稠密监督需结合使用方能在稀疏奖励场景下有效；PIVOT 的干预—监督设计准则可作为引入教师信号增强 RLVR 的通用配方。

title: Representation Complexity Along Learning Trajectories: Trading Width for Precision and Time
summary: What computational role does overparameterisation play during learning? Information-plane analyses suggest that neural networks can traverse representations substantially more complex than those required by their final predictors. We explore when this transient complexity serves a computational purpose by comparing the representation complexity needed for prediction with that needed to make an unknown target statistically visible through gradient feedback. We introduce an oracle model of neural network learning and use Kolmogorov \(n\)-widths to quantify effective representation complexity. Our main technical result transfers complexity bounds from the forward representation to the corresponding gradient-query features. Combined with statistical-query lower bounds, this gives a task-agnostic lower bound on the initial effective width required for target-dependent gradient information to become detectable. For \(k\)-sparse parity in \(D\) dimensions, a known target admits an \(O(k)\)-width representation, while the general bound already implies a polynomial separation between representation and discovery. We then exploit parity's invariance under coordinatewise sign reflections to identify a sharper unsigned effective width, which removes sign distinctions invisible to the parity information channel. At a transfer-compatible measurement resolution, its critical scale is \(\widetildeΘ_k\left( D^{k-1}τ^2 \right)\), up to logarithmic factors. Thus, the representation resources required to discover a predictor can substantially exceed those required to represent it once learned. Interpreting precision through accumulation over fresh samples yields a corresponding width-time frontier. Experiments support the predicted dimension dependence and examine how optimisation and generalisation depart from this idealised frontier.

AI.tldr: 论文通过比较"预测所需表示复杂度"与"使未知目标经梯度反馈变得可统计可见所需复杂度"，提出oracle学习模型与Kolmogorov n-width度量，证明了表示复杂度界可从前向表示传递到梯度查询特征，并给出任务无关的初始有效宽度下界；对k-稀疏奇偶问题得到临界尺度Θ̃_k(D^{k-1}τ²)，表明"发现预测器"所需资源可远超"表示预测器"所需资源。
AI.motivation: 过参数化网络在学习过程中会经过比最终预测器所需更复杂的表示（信息平面分析已观察到该现象），但这种瞬态复杂性是否具有计算功能尚不明确。作者希望区分两种复杂度需求：一是表示（预测）所需的复杂度，二是让未知目标通过梯度反馈变得在统计上"可见"所需的复杂度，从而解释过参数化在学习过程中的计算作用。
AI.method: 1) 引入神经网络的oracle学习模型，区分前向表示与梯度查询特征；2) 用Kolmogorov n-width量化有效表示复杂度；3) 主要技术结果：将复杂度界从前向表示转移到对应梯度查询特征，并结合统计查询（statistical query）下界，导出目标相关梯度信息可被检测所需的初始有效宽度的任务无关下界；4) 以D维k-稀疏奇偶（parity）为案例，利用其对坐标符号反射的不变性定义无符号有效宽度，去除奇偶信息通道不可见的符号区分，得到临界尺度。
AI.result: 对k-稀疏奇偶，已知目标可由O(k)-width表示，而一般性下界已蕴含表示与"发现"之间的多项式分离；在传输兼容的测量分辨率下，无符号有效宽度的临界尺度为Θ̃_k(D^{k-1}τ²)（忽略对数因子）。将精度解释为对新鲜样本的累积可得到相应的宽度—时间前沿。实验验证了预测的维度依赖性，并考察优化与泛化如何偏离这一理想化前沿。
AI.conclusion: 发现一个预测器所需的表示资源可以显著超过学会后表示它所需的资源；瞬态表示复杂度的计算作用在于使目标相关的梯度信息变得可检测。过参数化的作用由此获得任务无关的定量刻画，并为宽度—时间前沿及优化/泛化偏离提供了理论基准。

title: Regional Anchor Routing for Multi-Object Motion Transfer
summary: Compositional motion transfer requires a model to extract motions from multiple reference videos, and apply each motion to a user-specified object in one target scene. Existing methods normally struggle to reliably assign different reference motions to the correct target objects, thus a motion intended for one object may affect another. Meanwhile, some motion-specific tuning approaches are still facing another issue: they must run a new optimization whenever the reference video changes, making repeated transfers inefficient. To address these limitations, we propose RART, a framework that unifies object-wise motion extraction, target-region anchoring, and frame-aligned injection into a frozen video Diffusion Transformer for multi-object motion transfer. For each reference motion, RART extracts temporally ordered features from the masked reference video, and then conditions them on the target first-frame mask to form mask-anchored motion tokens. Frame-aligned motion cross-attention allows each generated frame to read only the motion tokens at the corresponding time slots, composing all object motions in one denoising process. During training, a motion-attention routing loss encourages each target region to attend to its corresponding motion tokens and reduces interference between objects. Therefore, RART can handle novel reference-target combinations without per-video optimization. Experiments show that RART achieves accurate motion preservation, efficient inference, and strong compositional generalization.

AI.tldr: RART将对象级运动提取、目标区域锚定与帧对齐注入统一到冻结的视频Diffusion Transformer中，实现多对象组合式运动迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有组合式运动迁移方法难以可靠地把不同参考视频中的运动分配给正确的目标对象，导致运动串扰；同时部分运动特化微调方法在参考视频变化时需重新优化，重复迁移效率低。
AI.method: 对每个参考运动，从掩码参考视频中提取时序有序特征，并结合目标首帧掩码构建掩码锚定运动token；采用帧对齐运动交叉注意力，使每个生成帧只读取对应时间槽的运动token，在单次去噪过程中组合所有对象运动；训练时引入运动注意力路由损失，促进各目标区域关注其对应运动token并抑制对象间干扰。
AI.result: 实验表明RART实现了准确的运动保持、高效的推理以及较强的组合泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: RART无需逐视频优化即可处理新的参考-目标组合，为多对象组合式运动迁移提供了统一且高效的框架。

title: Does Federated Training Degrade Explainability? A Comparative Analysis of Grad-CAM Faithfulness in Centralized vs. Federated Deepfake Detection
comment: 10 Pages, 3 figures, Muhammad Uzair Shahid and Muhammad Zabil Mehboob contributed equally to this work
summary: Automated detection has become the essential safeguard against realistic synthetic media, but deploying it at scale requires training on sensitive data from multiple organizations, putting privacy and the transparency demanded by forensic review in direct conflict. Federated learning resolves the privacy side by sharing only model updates rather than raw data, but whether this comes at the cost of trustworthy gradient-based explanations, which analysts rely on to decide whether or not to trust a flagged clip, has not been studied. We present the systematic study of Grad-CAM explanation faithfulness under federated deepfake detection, evaluating an EfficientNet-B4 detector on FaceForensics++ across five federated clients under varying degrees of data heterogeneity. We find that the relationship between federation and explanation quality is non-monotonic: at near-IID (Independent and Identically Distributed Data) and moderate heterogeneity, federated models match or exceed the faithfulness of a centralized baseline, but at extreme heterogeneity, explanations break down entirely, becoming spatially incoherent and, on average, causally misleading. This degradation is not a general cost of federated training but a threshold effect tied to client heterogeneity, and we offer practical guidance for identifying when privacy-preserving deepfake detection can be deployed safely and when its explanations can no longer be trusted. Code and data partitions are available for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究了联邦深度伪造检测中Grad-CAM解释的忠实度，发现联邦与解释质量呈非单调关系：近IID和中等异构下联邦模型解释忠实度可持平或超过集中式基线，但在极端异构下解释彻底失效。
AI.motivation: 大规模部署合成媒体检测需跨机构训练敏感数据，隐私与取证审查所要求的透明度存在冲突；联邦学习虽以共享模型更新而非原始数据解决隐私问题，但其对分析人员依赖的梯度解释（Grad-CAM）可信度的影响尚未被研究。
AI.method: 在FaceForensics++上训练EfficientNet-B4深度伪造检测器，设置五个联邦客户端并在不同数据异构程度下，系统评估Grad-CAM解释的忠实度，并与集中式基线对比。
AI.result: 联邦与解释质量的关系呈非单调：近IID与中等异构时联邦模型解释忠实度持平或超过集中式基线；极端异构时解释完全崩溃，空间上不连贯且平均而言因果误导。
AI.conclusion: 该退化并非联邦训练的普遍代价，而是与客户端异构性相关的阈值效应；作者给出实践指导，用于判断隐私保护型深度伪造检测何时可安全部署、何时其解释不再可信，并公开代码与数据划分以保证可复现。

title: Multi-View MoE: Letting Every Router Shape Expert Computation
summary: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models expand parameter capacity by activating a small subset of experts per token. Expert selection directly affects model capabilities under a fixed active-expert budget. Dense evaluation of all experts reveals weak agreement between single-router rankings and expert-utility evaluation rankings, especially in middle and deep layers. Richer signals for selection and computation incur additional cost: selection based on internal expert activations requires preliminary computation, while processing multiple full representations separately through the same expert repeats its computation. We propose Multi-View MoE to improve expert selection with multiple routers and reuse their preferences to modulate expert computation under a fixed expert budget. Its Multi-Router submodule aggregates sigmoid scores from independently initialized routers. These routers develop highly differentiated expert preferences during training, allowing experts strongly favored by one router or jointly supported by several routers to be selected. Multi-View further uses each selected expert's relative scores across routers to mix learned latent views into its input, reusing routing preferences for both selection and computation. Each selected expert executes one forward pass, preserving the active-expert count, expert FLOPs, and all-to-all communication volume. On a 24-layer 10B-A1B model trained on 708B tokens, full Multi-View MoE improves the nine-task downstream mean by 1.18 percentage points over the baseline. Multi-Router alone yields a 0.6-percentage-point gain and improves the rank correlation between router scores and evaluated expert utility, with relative increases of 8.1% globally and approximately 58% in the layer with the lowest single-router alignment. Controlled mixing interventions show the model uses input differences that depend on both the expert and the token.

AI.tldr: 提出 Multi-View MoE：用多路由器聚合偏好改进专家选择，并复用路由偏好调制专家输入，在不增加激活专家数、专家 FLOPs 与全对全通信量的前提下提升 MoE 效果。
AI.motivation: 稀疏 MoE 中专家选择在固定激活预算下决定模型能力，但单路由器排序与专家效用评估排序一致性较差（中层与深层尤甚）；而更丰富的选择信号需额外计算或重复专家前向，代价高。
AI.method: Multi-Router 子模块聚合多个独立初始化路由器的 sigmoid 分数，训练中形成差异化偏好，可选出被单一路由器强偏好或被多路由器共同支持的专家；并用被选专家在各路由器上的相对分数将可学习隐视图混合进其输入，实现路由偏好在选择与计算间的复用。每个被选专家仅执行一次前向。
AI.result: 24 层 10B-A1B 模型、708B token 训练下，完整方法使九任务下游均值较基线提升 1.18 个百分点；仅 Multi-Router 提升 0.6 个百分点，并使路由分数与专家效用评估的秩相关全局相对提升 8.1%、单路由器对齐最差层约 58%。
AI.conclusion: 多视图路由可在零额外激活/计算/通信开销下改善专家选择质量与效用一致性，且受控混合实验表明模型利用的是同时依赖专家与 token 的输入差异。

title: FairSplit: Decomposing the Embedding Space for Fair Classification
summary: Fair classification faces a twofold challenge: maintaining high classification accuracy while limiting reliance on sensitive information. Our method FairSplit achieves this by learning a decomposition of the embedding space into a Fair Space used for prediction and a Sensitive Space that isolates sensitive information. During training, the model must simultaneously learn the classification task and separate fair from sensitive information. The Sensitive Space gives sensitive attributes a destination, so the Fair Space can be used for prediction without relying on them. This decomposition is guided via a learnable mask and the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) as a measure of statistical dependence. We provide theoretical guarantees showing that the demographic parity gap is upper-bounded by both (i) the learned dimensionality of the Fair Space and (ii) the HSIC between the Fair Space and sensitive attributes. FairSplit effectively handles multiclass tasks and non-binary sensitive attributes, overcoming key limitations of existing fair classification methods. Experiments on established fairness benchmarks show that FairSplit achieves competitive accuracy-fairness trade-offs. Code is available at https://github.com/shkabrii/fairsplit.

AI.tldr: FairSplit通过将嵌入空间分解为用于预测的Fair Space与隔离敏感信息的Sensitive Space，并借助可学习掩码与HSIC约束二者独立，在理论上证明人口统计均等差距受Fair Space维度与HSIC上界约束，在多类与非二值敏感属性任务上取得有竞争力的准确率-公平性权衡。
AI.motivation: 公平分类需同时保持高准确率并限制对敏感信息的依赖；现有方法在多分类任务与非二值敏感属性上存在明显局限。
AI.method: 学习嵌入空间的正交式分解：Fair Space用于预测，Sensitive Space作为敏感属性的"容器"；训练中同时学习分类任务与分离公平/敏感信息；以可学习掩码引导分解，并用Hilbert-Schmidt独立性准则（HSIC）度量统计依赖性。
AI.result: 理论上证明人口统计均等（demographic parity）差距同时被(i) Fair Space的学习维度与(ii) Fair Space与敏感属性间的HSIC所上界约束；在标准公平性基准实验上取得有竞争力的准确率-公平性权衡。
AI.conclusion: FairSplit通过空间分解与HSIC正则化有效缓解敏感信息泄漏，可处理多类任务与非二值敏感属性，克服现有公平分类方法的关键限制。

title: Agent-Wise Test-Time Normalization for Camera-Based Cooperative Perception with Corrupted Collaborators
summary: Intermediate-fusion cooperative perception lets a vehicle detect objects beyond its own field of view by fusing features shared by nearby agents. When only a collaborator's cameras are degraded by fog, motion blur or exposure errors, the features it shares drift away from the training distribution while the ego input stays clean, and cooperation can become worse than not cooperating at all. Test-time batch-normalization adaptation, the standard training-free remedy, estimates statistics over the pooled batch of all agents and therefore normalizes both the clean ego and the corrupted collaborator with a mixture of two distributions. We show that this mixing harms even the clean ego: when the ego shares BN statistics with a corrupted collaborator, its detection from its own features drops by 3.58 to 6.68 AP@0.5 points although its cameras are untouched. We propose AgentNorm, an agent-wise test-time normalization that i) estimates the normalization statistics of every collaborator from its own current observation and ii) anchors the ego to its source statistics, so that the ego path remains exactly the original model. AgentNorm has no learnable parameters, needs no gradients or labels, is independent of the order of test frames, and runs locally on each agent without changing the transmitted features. On camera-based OPV2V with four fusion checkpoints and collaborator-only corruptions, AgentNorm raises AP@0.5 under severity-5 fog from 29.42-37.25 to 43.32-58.86 and outperforms pooled normalization by 5.53-12.94 points under fog and motion blur, at an extra latency of 2.3 ms per frame. On the real-world DAIR-V2X-C dataset, it outperforms pooled normalization in all ten infrastructure-corruption settings. We also report the cases it does not fix: occlusion, which removes image content rather than shifting feature statistics, and the case in which all agents share the same shift.

AI.tldr: 提出AgentNorm：面向中间融合协同感知的"逐智能体"测试时归一化，解决协同者相机退化时批归一化统计量混合导致干净自车也受损的问题，无需参数、梯度与标签，单帧额外延迟2.3ms。
AI.motivation: 中间融合协同感知中，当仅协同者相机受雾、运动模糊或曝光误差影响时，其共享特征偏离训练分布，而自车输入保持干净，协同可能比不协同更差。标准免训练方案Test-time BN在全体智能体混合批次上估计统计量，用两种分布的混合去归一化干净自车与受损协同者，作者指出这种混合本身会损害自车——实验显示自车检测在其自身特征上下降3.58–6.68 AP@0.5。
AI.method: AgentNorm包含两点：(i) 每个协同者仅依据其自身当前观测估计归一化统计量；(ii) 将自车锚定到其源统计量，使自车通路严格保持原模型行为。该方法无可学习参数，无需梯度与标签，与测试帧顺序无关，在各智能体本地运行且不改变传输的特征。
AI.result: 在相机版OPV2V、4个融合检查点、仅协同者受腐蚀设置下，severity-5雾天将AP@0.5从29.42–37.25提升至43.32–58.86，在雾与运动模糊下比池化归一化高5.53–12.94点，每帧额外延迟2.3ms。在真实DAIR-V2X-C数据集上，全部10种基础设施腐蚀设置均优于池化归一化。
AI.conclusion: 逐智能体归一化优于全体池化归一化，验证了统计量混合是协同感知失效的关键原因之一。方法存在明确边界：对遮挡（移除图像内容而非偏移特征统计）无效，且当所有智能体共享同一分布偏移时亦不适用。

title: Does Scaling Toward AGI Depend on What System-1 Lets System-2 Execute?
summary: Progress toward artificial general intelligence (AGI) has largely relied on scaling a resource-intensive executive, System-2, through larger models, more data and compute, longer reasoning, and more agents. We ask whether the next stage may come instead from co-designing it with System-1, a lightweight, semantically aware predictor that evaluates candidate interactions before execution, so that System-2 acts only on those worth their cost. Our answer is a qualified yes. We study \textit{conditional interaction}, a predict--gate--execute--update loop: System-1 estimates each candidate's utility, System-2 executes those admitted by an adaptive threshold, and the outcomes update System-1. The loop spans training, test-time reasoning, adaptive decision-making, and agentic tool use, with utility and cost defined by the application. Under ideal screening and equal execution costs, execution compute falls by a factor approaching $1/ρ_u$, where $ρ_u$ is the density of utility-relevant interactions (cost-weighted when costs differ); prediction errors, exploration, and distribution shift reduce the saving. We bound selection regret by predictor error and the utility margin. These results motivate our central hypothesis: $ρ_u$ is a measurable coordinate of scaling efficiency and makes informative compute a better description of scaling than total compute.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"条件交互"(conditional interaction)框架，将轻量、语义感知的System-1预测器与重量级System-2执行器协同设计：System-1预估候选交互的效用，经自适应阈值门控后仅由System-2执行高价值候选，执行结果再回传更新System-1；理论上执行算力可按效用相关交互密度ρ_u的倒数比例下降，并将选择遗憾界定于预测误差与效用间隔。
AI.motivation: 当前通往AGI的路径主要依赖对System-2执行器的资源密集式扩展（更大模型、更多数据与算力、更长推理、更多智能体），效率提升有限。作者质疑下一阶段是否应转向与System-1（轻量、语义感知的预测器）协同设计，使System-2只为"值得其成本"的交互付出计算。
AI.method: 提出"预测—门控—执行—更新"循环（predict–gate–execute–update）：System-1估计每个候选交互的效用；System-2仅执行被自适应阈值准入的候选；执行结果用于更新System-1。该循环贯穿训练、测试时推理、自适应决策与智能体工具调用，效用与成本由具体应用定义；并从理论上分析理想筛选下的算力节省与选择遗憾上界。
AI.result: 在理想筛选且执行成本相等的条件下，执行算力下降因子趋近1/ρ_u（ρ_u为效用相关交互密度，成本不等时按成本加权）；预测误差、探索与分布漂移会削弱节省幅度；选择遗憾可由预测器误差与效用间隔给出上界。
AI.conclusion: 支持"有条件成立"的肯定结论。核心假设是：ρ_u可作为衡量扩展效率的可测坐标，"有效信息算力"(informative compute)比总算力更能刻画扩展规律。

title: When to Assist and What to Suggest: Joint Gating and Memory-Grounded Hint Generation in One Compact Decoder
comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 13 tables; supplementary material included (Sections S1-S8)
summary: Proactive assistants offer short, memory-grounded hints during a conversation, deciding when to assist and what to suggest. Current systems split this between a gate and a larger generator; we evaluate both together on 28,058 decision points. Stage-wise generation scores are oracle-gate ceilings: behind a real gate, end-to-end exact match is 0.2619 against a ceiling of 0.2971, and end-to-end precision is 0.2387, leaving substantial headroom. A gate pays off through precision and compute, whose saving falls from 4.39x with an 8B generator to 1.38x with a 1B one. The memory profile drives hint quality: removing it costs 24.7 exact-match points (rescaled BERTScore 0.57 to 0.35), while retrieval and a larger generator add nothing on exact match. One 1B decoder can do both, gating from an intermediate layer and generating in the same pass. At its final checkpoint it matches or exceeds the two-model pipelines on automatic end-to-end measures with 1.31-1.76x less wall-clock time than the matched 1B pipeline; across three seeds, its deeper exit ties the separate gate. A human evaluation (1,144 ratings over 32 dialogues) supports the memory effect and rates the single model level with the matched 1B pipeline and below the 8B one. Graded metrics and LlamaPIE's native judge track human ratings more closely than exact match, which we report as a strict lower bound.

AI.tldr: 该论文在28,058个决策点上端到端联合评估"门控+生成"的主动式助手，发现真实门控下精确匹配仅0.2619（oracle上限0.2971），记忆画像决定提示质量，并证明单一1B解码器可同时完成门控与生成。
AI.motivation: 现有主动式助手系统将"何时干预"（门控）与"提示什么"（生成）拆分为两个模型，缺乏端到端联合评估，无法判断门控的真实收益、记忆的作用及各组件贡献。
AI.method: 在28,058个决策点上联合评估门控与生成；对比stage-wise生成（oracle门控）与真实门控的端到端表现；消融记忆画像、检索、生成器规模；提出单一1B解码器从中间层门控、同一前向pass内生成的双出口架构。
AI.result: 端到端精确匹配0.2619（上限0.2971），精确率0.2387，仍有较大提升空间；门控带来的算力节省随生成器从8B降至1B由4.39x降至1.38x；去除记忆画像损失24.7个精确匹配点（BERTScore 0.57→0.35），检索与更大生成器对精确匹配无增益；单模型在自动端到端指标上持平或超越双模型流水线，墙钟时间少1.31–1.76x，三个随机种子下深层出口与独立门控持平；人工评估（1,144条评分/32段对话）支持记忆效应，单模型与匹配1B流水线相当、低于8B。
AI.conclusion: 门控的价值主要在精确率与算力而非精度上限；记忆画像是提示质量的关键驱动因素；单一小模型的双出口设计可替代双模型流水线；分级指标与LlamaPIE原生评判比精确匹配更贴近人类评分，精确匹配应视为严格下界。

title: Exponential-Nemytskii Neural Operators: Learning Field Evolution Across Step Sizes
summary: In variable-step operator learning, agreement at observed step sizes does not by itself determine predictions at other temporal resolutions. We propose an operator whose step-size dependence is prescribed by a first-order Duhamel approximation of semilinear dynamics. It combines exact linear propagation with a local nonlinear function of the field and its derivatives, allowing evaluation below the observation interval without supervision densely sampled across step sizes. Under suitable conditions and at fixed spatial resolution, we prove that agreement between models at two step sizes controls their prediction differences throughout a prescribed range. We also give conditions for local identifiability of both components from two step sizes, supporting interpretation of the learned structure. A latent extension applies the same construction to learned fields. We evaluate the base model on two synthetic problems and the extension on two real datasets against several baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种步长依赖由半线性动力学的Duhamel一阶近似规定的算子，实现跨时间分辨率（含观测间隔以下）的可预测演化，并给出步长间一致性控制预测误差的定理与局部可辨识性条件。
AI.motivation: 变步长算子学习中，仅在观测步长上一致并不能决定模型在其他时间分辨率下的预测，缺乏对步长依赖结构的明确约束与理论保证。
AI.method: 构造由半线性动力学Duhamel一阶近似确定的算子：精确线性传播 + 关于场及其导数的局部非线性函数；无需跨步长稠密监督即可在观测间隔以下求值；给出潜在（latent）扩展以作用于学习到的场表示。
AI.result: 在固定空间分辨率与适当条件下证明：两个步长上的模型一致性可控制其在给定步长范围内的预测差异；给出两分量由两个步长局部可辨识的条件；基础模型在两个合成问题上、扩展在两个真实数据集上与多个基线对比评估。
AI.conclusion: 显式规定步长依赖结构可在稀疏步长监督下获得跨分辨率泛化并提供可解释性与理论可控性，潜在扩展可迁移至真实数据场景。

title: Robust LIDAR Sensor-to-Sensor Domain Generalization via Accumulated-Point Scene Completion
summary:
We study domain generalization for LIDAR semantic segmentation. Deep neural networks achieve strong performance on 3D point clouds, yet real-world LIDAR exhibits sensor-specific sampling patterns that hinder transfer across datasets. In many applications, performance on completely unseen sensors is crucial. A model should preferably work on a new setup without prior access to its data or labels. To this end, we introduce a source-only training scheme that adds an occupancy prediction auxiliary objective. We aggregate source-domain scans into a simple world model and use it as the supervision signal, replacing single-scan standard segmentation training.
  A key property of our approach is that it does not alter the input scan. During training and testing the network consumes the same single-frame LIDAR input, only the supervision signal is enriched via the occupancy objective. At deployment, there is no runtime overhead as the auxiliary head can be dropped for pure segmentation, or kept to obtain scene completion alongside semantic segmentation. In an experimental evaluation across distinct LIDAR datasets, we demonstrate that a model's generalization to new domains can be significantly affected by how it is supervised. In certain setups, performance on unseen domains improves without any explicit domain adaptation (no target scans, no target labels, no sensor priors) and without prediction refinement. At the same time, our method maintains competitive source-domain segmentation performance and incurs no additional inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅用源域训练的LIDAR语义分割域泛化方法：引入占用预测辅助目标，用聚合多帧扫描构建的简单世界模型作为监督信号，替代单帧标准分割训练；输入不改变、推理无额外开销，在未见传感器上可显著提升泛化。
AI.motivation: 真实LIDAR数据存在传感器特有的采样模式，导致模型跨数据集迁移困难；许多应用要求模型在完全未见的传感器上工作，且无目标数据、无标签、无传感器先验。作者希望在不改变输入、不引入推理开销的前提下提升域泛化。
AI.method: 源域-only训练框架：将源域多帧扫描聚合为简单世界模型（world model），以此作为监督信号构造占用预测（occupancy prediction）辅助任务，替代单扫描的标准分割监督。训练与测试时网络始终接收相同的单帧LIDAR输入，仅监督信号被丰富；辅助头在部署时可丢弃（纯分割）或保留（同时输出场景补全）。
AI.result: 在多个不同LIDAR数据集上的实验表明，监督方式显著影响模型在新域上的泛化：在部分设置下，无需任何显式域适应（无目标扫描、无目标标签、无传感器先验）、也无需预测后处理，未见域性能即获提升，同时保持有竞争力的源域分割性能且无额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 监督信号的设计本身即可作为提升LIDAR语义分割域泛化的有效手段；所提源域-only、输入不变、推理零开销的方案为面向未见传感器的鲁棒部署提供了实用路径。

title: Integrated Feature Selection for classification and Representation Learning with Group-Lasso Siamese Networks
summary: The Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (Lasso) has been widely employed for feature selection in linear models and has also been extended to multi-layer perceptron (MLP) networks for both feature and group feature selection. Group-Lasso has also been used in feature selection using feed-forward neural networks. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to incorporate the Group-Lasso principle into a Siamese network architecture for feature selection. Unlike existing approaches that primarily optimize classification accuracy, the proposed method aims to identify a compact subset of features that simultaneously preserves the intrinsic representation of the input data (the goal of Siamese network) and is expected to achieve high classification performance. Two variants of the proposed framework are developed: one based on the Euclidean distance and the other on a modified Jaccard similarity measure for real-valued vectors. The latter is specifically designed to improve feature selection for high?dimensional sparse data. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is demonstrated on 12 benchmark datasets with feature dimensions ranging from 6 to 7070 using eight different classifiers. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed Siamese Lasso framework consistently identifies compact and discriminative feature subsets maintaining competitive or superior classification performance, although the loss function used explicitly did not consider any regularizer to learn classification. In addition, the quality of the embeddings produced by these networks is assessed using manifold learning techniques such as UMAP and t-SNE.

AI.tldr: 该文首次将Group-Lasso原理引入Siamese网络实现特征选择，提出基于欧氏距离与改进Jaccard相似度的两种变体，在12个基准数据集（维度6–7070）、8种分类器上验证其能选出紧凑且具判别性的特征子集。
AI.motivation: 现有Lasso/Group-Lasso特征选择（含MLP、前馈网络）多以分类精度为优化目标；作者希望选出的特征子集既能保持输入数据的内在表征（Siamese网络的目标），又能获得高分类性能。
AI.method: 将Group-Lasso正则原则嵌入Siamese网络架构用于特征选择，构建两个变体：一种基于欧氏距离，另一种针对实值向量采用改进的Jaccard相似度（面向高维稀疏数据）；分类器不在损失函数中显式建模。
AI.result: 在12个基准数据集（特征维度6至7070）上用8种分类器评测：所提Siamese Lasso框架稳定地选出紧凑且有判别性的特征子集，分类性能具竞争力或更优，尽管损失函数未含分类正则项；并用UMAP、t-SNE等流形学习技术评估嵌入质量。
AI.conclusion: Group-Lasso与Siamese网络的结合可作为有效的无监督表征驱动特征选择框架，尤其改进Jaccard变体适合高维稀疏数据；特征选择质量可通过嵌入的流形结构加以印证。

title: Testimony from Timelines: Evidence-Grounded Significance Testing of Temporal Clinical Hypotheses
summary: Ask a language model whether sales tend to dip after a product recall, or whether one side effect tends to follow another after a vaccine, and it answers in a fluent sentence that reads like a finding, with no test behind it. Assertions about how events unfold across many cases fill the Web, and each is a temporal hypothesis that only a significance test over the right records can settle. The verifier must specify the null, select the test and decide which records bear on the hypothesis, and any of these choices can go wrong while the conclusion still comes out right. Yet benchmarks for language-model data analysis grade only the conclusion, with the relevant data handed over. We study the problem in health, where a wrong verdict is costly, and present STRATA, a benchmark that grades every decision on the way to a verdict: 8,735 hypotheses over the clinical timelines of vaccine adverse-event reports, with gold plans, evidence sets, p-values and verdicts derived under a released codebook and reproduced by a deterministic oracle. We also propose ART (articulate, retrieve, test), a staged paradigm that exposes each decision as an inspectable output. Extensive experiments with five model configurations show that systems fail mostly at choosing which records count, a verdict-evidence gap that accuracy alone conceals. ART closes most of this gap and brings a 31B open model to within 0.01 of the frontier models under the same paradigm; the frontier models succeed once given the codebook.

AI.tldr: 提出STRATA基准与ART范式，将"语言模型是否会发生事件"的分析拆解为可核查的多阶段决策并逐项评分，揭示模型主要失败于证据选择环节。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型数据分析基准只评判最终结论，且直接给出相关数据；而真实场景中验证"事件间时序假设"需要正确设定原假设、选择检验方法、确定哪些记录与假设相关，任一环节出错都会影响结论的可信度。在健康领域错误判断代价高昂，因此需要面向全过程决策的评测。
AI.method: 构建STRATA基准：基于疫苗不良事件报告的临床时间序列，包含8,735条时序假设，配有金标准分析计划、证据集合、p值与结论，均依据公开代码本推导并由确定性oracle复现；同时提出ART（articulate, retrieve, test）分阶段范式，将每项决策暴露为可检查的输出。
AI.result: 五种模型配置的实验显示，系统主要在"确定哪些记录计入分析"环节失败，存在仅由准确率掩盖的"结论—证据鸿沟"；ART显著缩小该鸿沟，使31B开源模型在相同范式下与前沿模型差距缩小至0.01以内；前沿模型在提供代码本后即可成功。
AI.conclusion: 评测应覆盖从假设形式化到统计检验的全过程决策，而非仅看最终结论；分阶段可解释范式能有效提升小模型表现并暴露其真实短板。

title: Reinforcement Learning for the Game of Balatro: A Fast Simulator and Two-Policy Training Approach
comment: Accepted at EXAG 2026 (AIIDE Workshop on Experimental AI in Games)
summary: Balatro, a 2024 roguelike deckbuilder, presents three difficulties that have historically derailed reinforcement learning methods: a 3,000-action state-dependent action space, horizons of several hundred decisions with sparse rewards, and pervasive stochasticity in both card draws and shop generation. Published RL results on the game remain scarce. We introduce an end-to-end pipeline comprising (i) a high-throughput Rust simulator that is automatically state-diffed against the live game client via BalatroBot, (ii) a condensed observation-action interface with dynamic per-step masking of legal moves, and (iii) a multi-agent PPO architecture that decomposes play into a tactical blind policy and a strategic shop policy that share the full game state but act in disjoint phases. Long-horizon credit assignment is partially addressed by per-agent reward routing with explicit cross-agent credit. On the main joint run, training metrics show a sharp phase transition in which the first-blind clear rate converges above 99% and mean episode return increases by roughly an order of magnitude, plateauing at a mean maximum ante of 3 out of 8; single-agent baselines under identical rewards oscillated between greedy and hoarding failure modes and did not stably clear the first blind. These results establish the two-policy decomposition as a strong reactive baseline for Balatro and localise the remaining gap to long-horizon strategic planning rather than tactical blind play.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Balatro的三大RL难点（3000动作的动态动作空间、数百步稀疏奖励、普遍随机性），构建了Rust高速模拟器（经BalatroBot与游戏客户端状态对拍）、带合法动作动态掩码的精简观测-动作接口，以及按战术盲注阶段与战略商店阶段分解的双策略多智能体PPO，并配合逐智能体奖励路由与显式跨智能体信用分配。联合训练中首次盲注通关率收敛至99%以上，回报提升约一个数量级，平均最大底注平台期为3/8；单智能体基线则出现贪心与囤积振荡、无法稳定通过首盲。结论是双策略分解可作为强反应式基线，剩余差距主要在长程战略规划。
AI.motivation: Balatro具有三类历来使RL方法失效的困难特征：数千规模且依赖状态的动态动作空间、数百步决策的稀疏奖励长视界、抽牌与商店生成的普遍随机性；公开的RL结果仍很稀少，因此需要一套完整可复现的端到端方案并把性能瓶颈定位清楚。
AI.method: (1) 用Rust编写高吞吐模拟器，并通过BalatroBot与真实游戏客户端做自动状态差分校验以保证保真度；(2) 设计精简的观测-动作接口，对每一步的合法动作做动态掩码；(3) 采用多智能体PPO，将决策分解为战术性盲注策略与战略性商店策略，两者共享完整游戏状态但在不相交的阶段行动；用逐智能体奖励路由加显式跨智能体信用分配部分缓解长视界信用分配问题。
AI.result: 主联合训练出现急剧相变：首盲通关率收敛到99%以上，平均回合回报提升约一个数量级，并在平均最大底注3/8处进入平台期。相同奖励设定下的单智能体基线在贪心与囤积两种失败模式间振荡，无法稳定通过首盲。
AI.conclusion: 双策略分解为Balatro提供了强反应式基线，并把剩余性能差距定位到长程战略规划而非战术性盲注操作；表明当前瓶颈在于战略层，而非底层操作能力。

title: FFAI: Flow Matching with Feedback Training and Adaptive Initialization for CT Reconstruction
summary: Although low-dose, sparse-view, and limited-angle CT involve distinct degradation mechanisms, all three pose reconstruction challenges due to limited measurement information and can therefore be addressed within a unified framework. In iterative image restoration with flow matching, prediction errors may cause inference states to deviate from the prescribed training path, while a fixed initialization may be unsuitable for inputs with varying degradation severity. We propose a unified conditional flow matching method that conditions on the initial reconstruction and combines feedback-aware training with degradation-adaptive initialization. During training, a teacher network simulates inference updates to generate shifted states, from which a student network learns to recover high-quality reference images, improving its ability to handle prediction errors. During inference, the starting time is selected based on the noise level or extent of missing projection data, and the noise added to the initial state is adjusted accordingly to adapt the starting point to the input. Experiments on public benchmark datasets show that the proposed method achieves better quantitative results than the compared methods across all three reconstruction tasks, effectively suppressing noise and artifacts while preserving anatomical structures and details.

AI.tldr: 提出统一条件流匹配方法，结合反馈感知训练与退化自适应初始化，统一处理低剂量、稀疏视角与有限角度CT重建。
AI.motivation: 低剂量、稀疏视角与有限角度CT虽退化机理不同，但均因测量信息受限而构成重建难题，可纳入统一框架；同时迭代式流匹配图像复原中预测误差会使推理状态偏离训练轨迹，且固定初始化不适配不同退化程度输入。
AI.method: 统一条件流匹配方法，以初始重建为条件；训练阶段用教师网络模拟推理更新以生成偏移状态，学生网络由此学习恢复高质量参考图像（反馈感知训练）；推理阶段依据噪声水平或缺投影数据范围选择起始时刻，并相应调整初始状态所加噪声，实现退化自适应初始化。
AI.result: 在公开基准数据集上，三类重建任务的定量指标均优于对比方法，有效抑制噪声与伪影，并保留解剖结构与细节。
AI.conclusion: 反馈感知训练与退化自适应初始化可增强流匹配对推理误差与退化差异的鲁棒性，验证了多类CT退化问题统一求解框架的可行性。

title: What Breaks When Facts Become Stories? The Distortions Source-Agreement Metrics Miss When Models Retell Real Events
comment: 14 pages, 7 figures, 11 tables. Accepted at the Trust-AI-Eval (TAE) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Data and code: https://github.com/Retold2K/retold2k
summary: Language models are now widely used to turn recorded facts into media for public consumption, yet evaluation of such output still assumes agreement with the source as its measure of success. In reconstruction, where departing from the source can itself be the goal, this criterion measures the wrong construct: applied as is, it counts intended departures as errors; withheld, it lets real distortion through. We had three model families rewrite 2,000 news articles as summaries and as stories, measured what changed on every axis of the five Ws and how, and asked of each detected distortion whether the assigned perspective warranted it, which set a third of them aside. Time and manner were not lost but replaced, while place and causation lost the expressions that carry them. Accountability distortion behaved otherwise. Barely present in summaries, it rose up to sevenfold in stories, and of those whose direction could be determined, two in three lightened the perpetrator's responsibility. Such distortions survive claim-level fact checking and leave the retelling grammatically cleaner than its source. Where our judges disagreed, three authors relabeling the same cases converged on whether a distortion had occurred but not on whether it was warranted, a boundary contested rather than merely hard to detect. To support work on detecting and reducing them, we release ReTold-2k, a reconstructable corpus with the scoring protocol and per-judge baselines kept unaggregated.(https://github.com/Retold2K/retold2k).

AI.tldr: 本文批评以"与原文一致"为成功标准的重构评估范式，提出以"五W+方式"为轴的失真测量与"视角合理性"裁判协议，发现时间与方式被替换、地点与因果被剥离、问责失真在故事化改写中激增，并发布ReTold-2k语料与未聚合的评分协议。
AI.motivation: 语言模型被广泛用于将记录事实转化为面向公众的媒介内容，但现有评估仍默认"与信源一致"即成功。在重构（reconstruction）任务中，偏离信源本身可能就是目标，该标准测错了构念：直接套用会把有意的偏离计为错误，弃之不用又会让真正的扭曲漏过。因此需要一个既能识别失真、又能判断偏离是否被既定视角所正当化的评估框架。
AI.method: 三个模型家族将2,000篇新闻改写为摘要与故事两种体裁；在五个W（who/what/when/where/why）及方式（how）的每个轴上量化变化内容与变化方式；对每处检测到的失真判断其是否被指定视角（perspective）所正当化，约三分之一因此被排除；并采用多位裁判标注、记录裁判间分歧，由三位作者对同一批分歧案例重标注以检验一致性的来源。
AI.result: 时间与方式并非丢失而是被替换；地点与因果则丢失了承载它们的表述。问责（accountability）失真行为不同：在摘要中几乎不出现，在故事中最高上升约七倍，且其中方向可判定的案例里三分之二减轻了施事者的责任。这类失真能通过claim级事实核查，且改写文本在语法上比原文更"干净"。裁判分歧显示：重标注者在"是否发生失真"上趋于一致，但在"是否被正当化"上不一致，说明该边界是受争议的规范边界而非单纯的检测难度。
AI.conclusion: 重构评估应从"与原文一致"转向"视角正当性+多维失真定位"的协议；问责失真构成一类被现有核查漏检的独立风险。作者发布ReTold-2k可重构语料，附评分协议与各裁判的基线结果（保持未聚合），以支持后续的失真检测与缓解研究。

title: ShallowDefend: Harnessing Shallow Safety Alignment for Multi-Turn Defender
summary: Safety alignment has enabled large language models to reliably refuse harmful requests directly, yet the same request distributed across a multi-turn conversation still succeeds far too often. This brittleness has a mechanistic root: Alignment is shallow, with safety behavior concentrated in a model's first few output tokens, and existing defenses inherit the weakness, supervising the surface form of the response without ever giving the model an explicit safety decision to learn. We take the opposite view of shallowness: if a short span determines the trajectory of an entire response, that span is the highest-leverage place to intervene, and the defender can occupy it first. We propose Assess $\to$ Decide $\to$ Respond, a framework in which the defender assesses the user's intent, commits to an explicit, parseable safety decision, and only then generates a reply conditioned on it, with the commitment trained by reinforcement learning at the payload turn. Because the decision is a token span, the reward can be a rule: a self-verified reward checks the committed label against the conversation's known nature, requiring no judge and no annotation, while the same format also supports an LLM-as-judge reward over a graded decision space with safe redirection. Across two model families and fourteen benchmarks spanning safety, utility, and helpfulness, our defenders achieve the strongest multi-turn safety in a controlled comparison, maintaining their lead in safety while preserving utility at a modest cost to helpfulness. A per-token KL analysis and interventional probes confirm why this works: training concentrates its effect on the brief deliberation that sets a response's trajectory, and the decision committed there is a causal control point. The very shallowness attackers exploit becomes the mechanism of defense.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“Assess → Decide → Respond”框架，让模型先显式评估用户意图并承诺一个可解析的安全决策，再据此生成回答，并用强化学习在该决策位置训练；利用“安全行为集中在开头少量token”这一浅层性，把攻击者所利用的脆弱点转化为防御的因果控制点。
AI.motivation: 安全对齐使大模型能直接拒绝有害请求，但同一请求分散到多轮对话中仍常成功。作者指出其机理根源是“对齐浅层化”：安全行为集中在模型最初几个输出token上，现有防御也只在响应表层形式上做监督，未给模型一个显式的安全决策去学习。作者反向利用这种浅层性——既然短跨度决定整段响应走向，那就是最高杠杆的干预点，防御者应先行占据。
AI.method: 提出Assess → Decide → Respond三阶段框架：模型先评估用户意图，再输出一个显式、可解析的安全决策（token跨度），最后以其为条件生成回复；在payload turn处以强化学习训练该决策承诺。奖励可为规则式自验证奖励（将承诺标签与对话已知性质比对，无需judge与标注），同一格式也支持基于分级决策空间与安全重定向的LLM-as-judge奖励。在两类模型家族、14个覆盖安全性/实用性/有用性的基准上评估，并进行per-token KL分析与干预性探针。
AI.result: 在受控对比中取得最强的多轮安全性，并在保持安全领先的同时维持实用性，仅以适度有用性代价换取；per-token KL分析显示训练效应集中于设定响应走向的短暂“ deliberation”段，干预探针证实该处承诺的决策是因果控制点。
AI.conclusion: 攻击者所利用的“浅层性”本身可成为防御机制：通过在轨迹决定性的短跨度上强制显式安全决策并加以RL训练，可显著提升多轮对话鲁棒性，且决策承诺构成可干预的因果控制点。

title: BASILISC: Bayesian Alignment of Siamese-Integrated Latents for Inferring Single-cell Correspondence
comment: 12 pages main text, 3 figures, 1 table; supplementary material with 10 figures and 10 tables (38 pages total). Code to be released on publication. Currently under review
summary: Single-cell assays study the genome one cell at a time. Unimodal assays measure one molecular layer, the newer multimodal assays measure several. Most data are single-modality, so integrating them relies on models trained on multimodal assays, where the cell correspondence across modalities is known. These models return a matching, but rarely a confidence measure. We present BASILISC (Bayesian Alignment of Siamese-Integrated Latents for Inferring Single-cell Correspondence), a framework for matching single-cell representations with uncertainty on the correspondence itself. A BASILISC model is a probabilistic siamese network over the two modalities with a predictive distribution over the correspondence for a cross-modal pair of cells. We instantiate it at two levels: at the cell-type level the question is whether two cells share a cell type, at the cell level which cell is the partner in the other modality. To our knowledge, this is the first uncertainty score on a learned cross-modal correspondence evaluated against a known ground-truth pairing. BASILISC learns a similarity across modalities that reflects cell lineage: an unseen cell type is matched to its lineage relative, matching still works on such held-out types (balanced accuracy 0.86 on unseen against 0.93 on seen types), and the predictive uncertainty rises on these out-of-distribution cells. The uncertainty score also selects high-quality matches for downstream analysis: discarding the least certain fifth of the pairs raises accuracy from 0.93 to 0.98. At the cell level, a deep ensemble of the deterministic matcher reaches 0.062 matching accuracy on the benchmark test set, above the competition winner; on the Bayesian matcher's assignment, the posterior flags the wrong matches that cross a cell-type boundary better than a deterministic read of the same scores (AUROC 0.68 against 0.64).

AI.tldr: 提出BASILISC，一种贝叶斯孪生网络框架，为跨模态单细胞对应关系给出不确定性分数，首次在已知真值配对下评估学习到的对应不确定性；可提升下游匹配质量，细胞级匹配准确率超竞赛冠军。
AI.motivation: 多数单细胞数据为单模态，整合依赖在多模态数据上训练的模型，而这些模型只输出匹配结果，缺少对匹配本身的置信度度量。
AI.method: BASILISC（Bayesian Alignment of Siamese-Integrated Latents for Inferring Single-cell Correspondence）：在两种模态上构建概率孪生网络，对跨模态细胞对给出对应关系的预测分布；分两个层级实例化——细胞类型级（判断是否同类）与细胞级（确定配对对象）；细胞级采用确定性匹配器的深度集成。
AI.result: 学习到的跨模态相似度反映细胞谱系，未见类型可匹配到谱系近亲（未见类型平衡准确率0.86，已见0.93），且预测不确定性在分布外细胞上升高；丢弃最不确定的1/5配对使准确率由0.93升至0.98；细胞级深度集成在基准测试集达0.062匹配准确率，超过竞赛冠军；贝叶斯匹配器后验识别跨细胞类型错误匹配优于确定性解读（AUROC 0.68 vs 0.64）。
AI.conclusion: 为学习到的跨模态单细胞对应提供首个经真值验证的不确定性评分，既能标定分布外/不可靠匹配，又能作为筛选手段提升下游分析质量。

title: BRIDGE: Learning Brain-Gut Metabolic Evidence for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis
summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis may benefit from gut metabolic information associated with brain-gut interactions, yet existing models largely analyze cerebral glucose metabolism alone. Although whole-body fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography (FDG-PET) can provide paired brain-gut observations, routine brain examinations rarely include gut imaging, limiting direct use of this information for diagnosis. In this paper, we present BRIDGE (Brain and Gut Representation Integration via Distribution-Guided Enhancement), a two-stage framework for transferring brain-gut metabolic knowledge to brain-only diagnosis. Specifically, BRIDGE integrates a conditional brain-to-gut latent transport module and a disease-evidence-guided cerebral pathway to capture subject-specific cross-organ correspondence and disease-relevant cerebral representations. For the cerebral pathway, a large language model (LLM) helps organize literature-derived descriptors into human-approved semantic anchors that guide feature learning. Additionally, we introduce a counterfactual-guided residual fusion mechanism, which uses matched and non-matched virtual-gut evidence to supervise a confidence gate and dynamically regulate the contribution of transported cross-organ information. At inference, BRIDGE exploits complementary gut-related context using brain PET alone, without measured gut PET. Extensive experiments across public and private cohorts demonstrate that BRIDGE outperforms brain-only and cross-organ baselines, achieving AUC gains of 6.0% and 5.2% over its brain-only counterpart for CN/MCI and CN/AD diagnosis, respectively. Notably, its ability to transfer complementary brain-gut metabolic context while preserving brain PET as the sole inference input highlights its potential for clinically practical diagnosis. Our code is available at https://github.com/CUHK-AIM-Group/BRIDGE.

AI.tldr: 提出BRIDGE两阶段框架，将脑-肠代谢配对知识迁移到仅需脑PET的AD诊断，在CN/MCI与CN/AD任务上较纯脑基线AUC提升6.0%与5.2%。
AI.motivation: AD诊断可受益于脑-肠相互作用相关的肠道代谢信息，但现有模型多仅分析脑葡萄糖代谢；全身FDG-PET虽能提供脑-肠配对观测，常规脑检查却很少包含肠道成像，导致该信息难以直接用于诊断。
AI.method: 两阶段框架BRIDGE：（1）条件脑-肠隐空间传输模块，捕捉个体化跨器官对应；（2）疾病证据引导的脑通路，借助LLM将文献描述符组织为经人工审核的语义锚点以指导特征学习；（3）反事实引导的残差融合机制，用匹配/非匹配虚拟肠道证据监督置信门控，动态调节迁移信息的贡献。推理阶段仅用脑PET即可利用互补的肠道相关上下文。
AI.result: 在公开与私有队列上优于纯脑与跨器官基线；相较纯脑对照模型，CN/MCI与CN/AD诊断AUC分别提升6.0%和5.2%。
AI.conclusion: BRIDGE可在推理时保持脑PET为唯一输入的前提下迁移互补的脑-肠代谢上下文，具备临床实用诊断潜力；代码已开源。

title: Compile Away Uncertainty: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Programmatic Compilation
summary: Self-evolving agent skills enable AI agents to accumulate and refine reusable procedural knowledge from interaction experience without updating model parameters. However, since such skills are typically represented as textual documents and executed through LLM reasoning, even previously learned procedures must be repeatedly interpreted and regenerated, introducing avoidable uncertainty into every execution. In contrast, program execution is deterministic and independently verifiable. Intuitively, transforming well-specified operations into executable programs can reduce reliance on LLM reasoning and, consequently, reduce execution uncertainty. Motivated by this intuition, we introduce SKillCompiler, a self-evolving skill framework that integrates programmatic compilation into the skill evolution process. Specifically, SkillCompiler adopts an executability-aware skill compilation strategy that decomposes skills into fine-grained operations, analyzes their executability, and constructs hybrid skill skeletons that retain LLM reasoning for context-dependent operations while compiling well-specified ones into validated programs. To avoid redundant program synthesis and enable executable knowledge to accumulate across evolving skills, we further design a program asset reuse mechanism that organizes validated programs as reusable assets, retrieves existing implementations whenever applicable, and synthesizes and verifies new programs only when necessary. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks and six model families demonstrate that SkillCompiler consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving up to 32.33\% improvement in task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SkillCompiler，将程序化编译引入智能体技能自演化流程：把技能拆解为细粒度操作，对可良好定义的操作编译为可验证程序，难以形式化的部分保留 LLM 推理，并复用已验证程序资产，从而降低执行不确定性并提升任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有自演化智能体技能多以文本形式表示并依赖 LLM 推理执行，即使已学过的流程也需反复解释与重生成，带来可避免的执行不确定性；相较之下程序执行具有确定性与可独立验证性。因此作者希望将规范明确的操作转为可执行程序，以减少对 LLM 推理的依赖并降低执行不确定性。
AI.method: 1) 可执行性感知的技能编译策略：将技能分解为细粒度操作，分析各操作的可执行性，构造混合式技能骨架——依赖上下文的部分保留 LLM 推理，规范明确的部分编译为经验证的程序；2) 程序资产复用机制：将验证通过的程序组织为可复用资产，适用时检索既有实现，仅在必要时合成并验证新程序，避免重复程序合成，使可执行知识在技能演化中持续积累。
AI.result: 在五个基准和六个模型家族上的大量实验表明，SkillCompiler 持续优于当前最优方法，任务性能最高提升 32.33%。
AI.conclusion: 将程序化编译与程序资产复用融入技能自演化，可在不更新模型参数的前提下有效积累可执行知识、降低执行不确定性，并显著提升智能体任务表现。

title: Elucidating the Design Space of LM Data Attribution
summary: Data attribution methods for Language Models (LMs) are typically evaluated using downstream tasks like fact retrieval. However, existing evaluations vary multiple dataset properties simultaneously, making it impossible to isolate exactly why an attribution algorithm fails. To diagnose these failures, we explore the design space of LLM data attribution, with a primary focus on evaluation. We introduce the Controlled Attribution Benchmark (CATT) for fact tracing, in which we fine-tune LLMs on entirely fictitious knowledge, providing unambiguous ground truth for attribution. This synthetic setup allows us to systematically alter one dataset configuration at a time, such as document redundancy and lexical distractors. With this configurable evaluation, we demonstrate that redundancy and distractors consistently degrade attribution performance. Rather than proposing a new estimator, we examine two design choices that are underexplored: the loss used to compute gradients and how per-token attribution scores are aggregated into a document score. We find that the true causal evidence within a training document is highly localized, but standard methods dilute this evidence into noise by averaging attribution scores across the entire document. We find that replacing standard cross-entropy loss gradients with the negative log-odds gradients surfaces the critical tokens from other uninformative ones. We can then aggregate only the top token scores to improve ground truth recall by 35 to 72 percentage points across multiple baselines on our diagnostic benchmark. The negative log-odds correction also generalizes to FTRACE-TREX, improving counterfactual retraining performance for every method we test, by up to 4.9x.

AI.tldr: 提出受控归因基准CATT（用虚构知识微调LLM以获得无歧义真值），揭示冗余与词汇干扰项会稳定降低归因性能；并发现用负对数几率梯度替代交叉熵梯度、仅聚合Top token分数，可将真值召回率提升35–72个百分点，且可泛化到FTRACE-TREX。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型数据归因评测依赖事实检索等下游任务，同时变动多个数据属性，无法隔离归因算法失败的具体原因；且标准做法对整篇文档的per-token归因分数取平均，可能把稀疏的因果证据稀释成噪声。
AI.method: 构建Controlled Attribution Benchmark (CATT)：在完全虚构的知识上微调LLM，提供明确无歧义的真值标注，从而可一次只改变一个数据集配置（文档冗余度、词汇干扰项等）。不提出新估计器，而是考察两个被忽视的设计选择：(1) 计算梯度所用的损失函数；(2) per-token归因分数聚合成文档分数的聚合方式。
AI.result: 冗余与干扰项会持续削弱归因性能；训练文档中的真实因果证据高度局部化，而全文档平均会将其淹没；以负对数几率梯度替换交叉熵梯度可凸显关键token，仅聚合Top token分数即在诊断基准上使多基线真值召回提升35–72个百分点；该修正可泛化到FTRACE-TREX，对每个被测方法都提升反事实重训练效果，最高达4.9倍。
AI.conclusion: 归因失败部分源于评测设计与后处理（损失梯度选择与聚合方式），而非仅估计器本身；可控合成评测能有效诊断失败成因，负对数几率梯度+Top-token聚合是一种简单且可泛化的改进。

title: When Does Closed-Loop Curriculum Adaptation Help GRPO? An Analysis on Countdown
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, Accepted at IEEE ICTAI 2026
summary: Reinforcement fine-tuning has become an effective post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning ability of large language models, but it remains sample-inefficient when the training distribution is mismatched to the model's current capability. In group-relative objectives such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), problems that are too hard often produce uniformly failed rollouts, while problems that are too easy provide little useful advantage signal. In this work, we introduce CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN, a lightweight adaptive curriculum method for efficient reinforcement fine-tuning on ordered reasoning tasks. Instead of following a fixed easy-to-hard schedule, CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN preserves the structure of an Easy-to-Hard Gaussian sampler while dynamically adjusting its pace and spread using periodic probe estimates of per-difficulty accuracy. The controller accelerates training when the model is ahead of a reference curriculum, slows down when the model falls behind, and broadens sampling when earlier difficulties regress. This feedback mechanism keeps training focused on tasks that are challenging but still learnable, without changing the reward function, model architecture, or underlying GRPO optimizer. Experiments on symbolic arithmetic reasoning task show that CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN improves exact-match accuracy over vanilla GRPO and fixed open-loop curricula, with the strongest gains in intermediate-difficulty regimes where group-relative learning signals are most informative. Codes are available at https://github.com/yuvrajpant56/Closed_Loop_Curriculum.

AI.tldr: 提出 CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN——一种基于闭环反馈的自适应课程方法，用于有序推理任务的强化微调，动态调节按难度采样的高斯分布的速度与宽度，提升样本效率与准确率。
AI.motivation: 强化微调（如 GRPO）在训练分布与模型当前能力不匹配时样本效率低：过难问题导致整组 rollout 全部失败（优势信号为零），过易问题则几乎无优势信号，固定 easy-to-hard 课程无法自适应调整。
AI.method: 保留 Easy-to-Hard 高斯采样器的结构，通过周期性探针估计各难度层的准确率，闭环动态调整课程推进速度与采样散布宽度：模型领先参考课程时加速，落后时减速，若先前难度出现回退则扩大采样范围。不修改奖励函数、模型架构与 GRPO 优化器。
AI.result: 在符号算术推理任务上，exact-match 准确率优于 vanilla GRPO 与固定开环课程，且在中等难度区间增益最显著——该区间正是组相对学习信号最具信息量的区域。
AI.conclusion: 难度自适应的闭环课程控制可在不改变优化目标的前提下，将训练集中在“有挑战但可学习”的任务上，是一种轻量、即插即用的强化微调样本效率改进方案。

title: MorphSIG: Subject-Driven Image Generation via Decoupled Anchoring and Feature Transport
summary: We propose MorphSIG, a training-free framework that reformulates subject-driven image generation (SIG) as pseudo-video feature transport. MorphSIG contains two core modules: Progressive Decoupled Anchoring, which uses frequency-domain decoupling and structural scrambling during early denoising to break structural locking and enable a gradual transition from free composition to identity alignment; and Pseudo-flow Guided Feature Transport, which constructs a latent-space pseudo-flow field to mimic Image-to-Video temporal coherence and transport subject semantics precisely. To address stylistic homogeneity and the lack of ground truth in existing benchmarks, we further introduce a benchmark with diverse stylized subjects.
