Extensive experiments show that MorphSIG significantly improves pose diversity and subject fidelity over baselines without additional training. Overall, MorphSIG bridges static generation and dynamic propagation, providing a cost-effective paradigm for high-fidelity subject consistency.

AI.tldr: MorphSIG：将主体驱动图像生成重构为伪视频特征传输的无训练框架
AI.motivation: 现有主体驱动图像生成（SIG）方法存在姿态多样性不足、结构锁定（构图被参考图束缚）以及风格同质化和评测基准缺乏真值的问题。
AI.method: 提出 MorphSIG 无训练框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) 渐进解耦锚定（Progressive Decoupled Anchoring），在去噪早期利用频域解耦与结构扰乱打破结构锁定，实现从自由构图到身份对齐的渐进过渡；(2) 伪光流引导特征传输（Pseudo-flow Guided Feature Transport），在潜空间构建伪光流场以模拟图像到视频的时序一致性，并精确传输主体语义。此外构建含多样风格化主体的新评测基准。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，在无需额外训练的情况下，MorphSIG 相比基线显著提升了姿态多样性与主体保真度。
AI.conclusion: MorphSIG 弥合了静态生成与动态传播之间的鸿沟，为高保真主体一致性提供了一种低成本的范式。

title: DEG: Diffusion-Enhanced GFlowNet for Solving Vehicle Routing Problems
summary: Traditional neural solvers for solving vehicle routing problems (VRPs) often suffer from limited solution diversity, motivating the development of Generative Flow Network (GFlowNet)-based models. However, the effectiveness of these models is frequently constrained by insufficient flow expansion in high-reward regions, limiting their ability to distribute probability across promising solution routes. Deeper exploration could yield superior results. Diffusion models, in contrast, provide stronger structural guidance for exploration. These two paradigms are naturally complementary: GFlowNet can supply edge-level signals for diffusion to embed, while diffusion can guide broader exploration. Leveraging this synergy, we propose Diffusion-Enhanced GFlowNet (DEG), a novel framework that integrates GFlowNet with a diffusion model to encourage richer flow expansion toward high-reward regions and derive higher-quality solutions. Specifically, DEG exploits GFlowNet's inherent diversity to generate edge-specific backward signals, applies the stochastic noise schedule of diffusion to perturb these signals, and then denoises them within the GFlowNet paradigm. To further improve scalability, we introduce a specialized decoder capable of dynamically adapting to diverse problem scales. Extensive experimental evaluations on synthetic and real-world datasets, including instances with up to 10,000 nodes, demonstrate that DEG consistently achieves favorable performance compared to baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 提出扩散增强的GFlowNet框架DEG，将GFlowNet与扩散模型互补结合，用于车辆路径问题（VRP）求解，提升高奖励区域流量扩展与解的多样性，并在万节点规模上取得优于基线的表现。
AI.motivation: 传统神经求解器解多样性不足，GFlowNet类模型虽能生成多样解，但在高奖励区域流量扩展不充分，难以在优质路径上分配足够概率；而扩散模型具备更强结构性引导能力，两者天然互补。
AI.method: DEG利用GFlowNet固有的多样性生成边级后向信号，借助扩散模型的随机噪声调度对这些信号施加扰动，再在GFlowNet范式内进行去噪，从而增强向高奖励区域的流量扩展；同时设计可动态适配不同问题规模的专用解码器以提升可扩展性。
AI.result: 在合成数据与真实数据集（含多达10,000个节点的算例）上，DEG相较基线方法稳定取得更优性能。
AI.conclusion: GFlowNet与扩散模型的互补融合可有效改善高奖励区域探索与解质量，配合自适应解码器可扩展到大规模VRP实例。

title: Closed Gates Leak: Decomposing Adjacent-Layer Cancellation in Gated Language Models
summary: In transformer language models with gated multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), adjacent layers write partly against each other into the residual stream. Previous work interpreted this cancellation as layers proposing features and the next layer selectively rejecting the inappropriate ones. We decompose the cancellation by removing the previous layer's write from the input of the next MLP: what the next layer writes along that write splits into what it writes anyway and how much less its MLP writes because the write is present, which we call the damping, and we trace the damping to the neurons that carry it. In gated MLPs the damping is carried by neurons whose gates are closed. SiLU and GELU are slightly negative below zero, so a closed gate still passes a small negative multiple of what the neuron reads, and a neuron whose output weight points along its input weight then subtracts a fraction of the direction it read. Summed over such neurons, closed gates contract the average direction a gated MLP reads, and the previous layer's write is not singled out: the same layer's write at another token is damped as much or more, and the eigenvalue signature from which that work concluded that the correction is selective appears for another token's write as well. Over training the damping grows while what the next layer writes anyway stays flat, and cancellation begins when the damping overtakes it; annealing the negative side of the gate activation away in continued pretraining removes the damping and the cancellation. Adjacent-layer cancellation is therefore weak evidence about which features a model rejects: it is produced by a contraction that gated MLPs apply, on average over directions, to whatever they read.

AI.tldr: 该文将相邻层写入的抵消分解为"照常写入"与"阻尼"两部分，指出阻尼由门控MLP中关闭的门神经元（SiLU/GELU负值区）导致的平均收缩产生，并非对上一层特征的"选择性拒绝"。
AI.motivation: 已有工作将门控MLP相邻层写入残差流的相互抵消，解释为"下一层选择性拒绝上一层提出的不当特征"，并将其作为模型特征拒绝的证据。作者质疑这一解释，试图厘清抵消的实际机制来源。
AI.method: 从下一层MLP的输入中移除上一层的写入，将其沿该写入方向的分量拆解为"照常写入"与因该写入存在而减少的量（即damping）；将阻尼追溯到具体神经元；分析门控激活负值区（SiLU/GELU在零下略负）下闭门神经元如何以负比例减去其读入方向；考察跨token泛化性、特征值签名、训练中演化及将激活负值侧退火去除的实验。
AI.result: 阻尼由门关闭的神经元承载：输出权重与输入权重同向的闭门神经元会减去其读入方向的一部分，累加后使门控MLP对读入的平均方向产生收缩。该收缩并不针对上一层写入——同一层在另一token处的写入被阻尼的程度相同甚至更大，原先支持"选择性修正"的特征值签名在另一token写入上同样出现。训练中阻尼持续增大而照常写入保持平稳，抵消在阻尼超过照常写入时出现；对门激活负值侧退火可消除阻尼，抵消随之消失。
AI.conclusion: 相邻层抵消是门控MLP对任意读入方向平均施加的收缩所致，因此作为"模型拒绝哪些特征"的证据是薄弱的。

title: MOSAIC-Flow: Orthogonal-Axis and Status-Conditioned Fusion for Missing-Sequence Completion in Brain Tumor MRI
summary: Missing-sequence completion is important for comprehensive brain tumor characterization, but cross-modal fusion can obscure sequence-specific contrast and lose fine-grained three-dimensional tumor detail. To address this challenge, we introduce Modality-aware Orthogonal-axis Status-conditioned Attentive Integration for Completion (MOSAIC-Flow), a unified framework for missing-sequence completion that learns a target-conditioned velocity field while keeping the seven acquired volumes fixed throughout the transport. Specifically, modality-aware stems independently encode each sequence, and orthogonal-axis refinement captures axial, coronal, and sagittal dependencies while retaining the three-dimensional representation. Status-conditioned prototype fusion uses compact modality and availability tokens to route and modulate pooled queries from the fused visual representation, enabling target-adaptive conditioning without dense voxel-to-voxel attention. A conditional flow matching objective transports target-channel noise toward the single missing sequence, while four Heun trajectories are averaged to produce the completion. Evaluation across structural, diffusion, and contrast-enhanced MRI in UCSF-PDGM demonstrates consistent whole-brain and tumor-region fidelity across all eight single-target completion tasks, with the strongest performance on structural sequences. Code is available at https://github.com/CUHK-AIM-Group/MOSAIC-FLOW.

AI.tldr: 提出MOSAIC-Flow统一框架，用于脑肿瘤MRI缺失序列补全：模态感知编码+正交轴精化+状态条件原型融合，并用条件流匹配生成目标序列。
AI.motivation: 跨模态融合易模糊序列特异性对比度，且易丢失三维肿瘤细节；需在保留七个已获取体数据不变的前提下针对单一缺失序列做条件化补全。
AI.method: 模态感知stem独立编码各序列；正交轴精化捕获轴位/冠状/矢状依赖并保持3D表示；状态条件原型融合用紧凑的模态与可获得性token，对融合视觉表示的池化查询进行路由与调制，实现目标自适应条件化而无需稠密体素级注意力；以条件流匹配目标将目标通道噪声输运至缺失序列，并对四条Heun轨迹平均。
AI.result: 在UCSF-PDGM的结构、弥散与增强MRI上，八个单目标补全任务的全脑与肿瘤区域保真度均稳定，结构序列表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架可实现统一、目标自适应的缺失序列补全，兼顾序列特异对比度与三维细节，代码已开源。

title: Category-Anchored Large Language Models for Next POI Recommendation
comment: Accepted by the 43rd IEEE International Conference on Data Engineering (ICDE 2027)
summary: Next point-of-interest (POI) recommendation aims to predict a user's next destination from spatio-temporal check-in data, and serves as the foundation for many location-based services. Recent advances incorporate large language models (LLMs) into this task by textualizing user trajectories to exploit their semantic reasoning ability. However, directly generating POI identifiers with such models is unreliable: POIs are sparse, localized, and long-tailed entities with weak natural-language semantics, which creates a semantic-to-entity gap between high-level mobility intent and concrete POI prediction. To bridge this gap, we propose ANCHOR, a category-anchored framework for semantic-to-entity grounding in next POI recommendation. Specifically, ANCHOR first estimates category-level mobility intent in a compact and stable semantic space, rather than predicting concrete POI entities directly. The inferred intent is then grounded into a candidate set by integrating three complementary sources of mobility evidence: category anchors, historical visit memory, and user preferences. Finally, a history-aware reranker selects the target POI by matching each candidate with the user's historical mobility patterns and current context. Experiments on three real-world check-in datasets show that ANCHOR consistently outperforms representative traditional, structure-enhanced, and LLM-based baselines on the reported metrics. Further analyses validate the effectiveness of semantic-to-entity grounding and show favorable trade-offs among candidate coverage, ranking quality, and inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出 ANCHOR——类别锚定的语义到实体落地框架，将下一 POI 推荐由直接生成 POI 转为先推断类别级移动意图，再落地为候选集并重排序。
AI.motivation: LLM 被用于将轨迹文本化以利用语义推理，但直接生成 POI 标识不可靠：POI 稀疏、局部化、长尾且自然语言语义薄弱，导致高层移动意图与具体 POI 预测之间存在语义—实体鸿沟。
AI.method: 三阶段：(1) 在紧凑稳定的语义空间中估计类别级移动意图，而非直接预测 POI 实体；(2) 融合类别锚点、历史访问记忆与用户偏好三类互补移动证据，将意图落地为候选集；(3) 历史感知重排序器按用户历史移动模式与当前上下文匹配候选，选出目标 POI。
AI.result: 在三个真实签到数据集上，ANCHOR 在报告指标上持续优于传统、结构增强及 LLM 基线；进一步分析验证了语义到实体落地的有效性，并显示候选覆盖率、排序质量与推理效率之间具有良好权衡。
AI.conclusion: 以类别为语义锚点分解"意图推断—候选落地—重排序"可有效弥合语义—实体鸿沟，兼顾准确性、覆盖与效率，为 LLM 驱动的 POI 推荐提供可行范式。

title: Generating Critic-Guided Synthetic Experience in Latent World Models
summary: Learning from offline datasets is limited in scalability, as collecting new experience is often costly or unsafe in the real world. World models offer an alternative way to generate new experience through a learned dynamics model, yet learning policies in latent space is limited due to compounding errors in imagined rollouts. To this end, we propose using the world model as a local transition generator, leveraging critic guidance to choose actions inside that model to generate synthetic experiences. We study action refinement methodologies, introducing Critic-Guided Synthetic Experience (CGSE) generation in world models. Specifically, CGSE augments an existing offline dataset by sampling candidate actions using an offline policy and refining each to maximize a first-order approximation of the $Q$-function within a trust region. We then use a frozen latent world model to imagine the future state given each updated action, and use the critic to choose the best one, appending this synthetic transition to the replay buffer. Our method requires no additional real-environment interaction or test-time planner, as it generates synthetic experience offline using the world model. On three OGBench manipulation tasks, CGSE improves an offline policy by a relative improvement of $7.1\%$ on the average success rate.

AI.tldr: 提出Critic-Guided Synthetic Experience (CGSE)，将世界模型作为局部转移生成器，用critic引导在信任域内精化动作并合成经验，离线增强数据集，在三个OGBench操作任务上平均成功率相对提升7.1%。
AI.motivation: 离线数据可扩展性受限（采集新经验成本高或不安全）；世界模型虽可生成新经验，但在潜空间中学习策略会因想象rollout的复合误差而受限。
AI.method: CGSE沿用离线策略采样候选动作，在信任域内以Q函数一阶近似为目标对每个动作进行精化；随后用冻结的潜空间世界模型预测更新动作后的未来状态，借助critic选出最优动作，将该合成转移加入回放缓冲区。方法无需额外真实交互或测试时规划器。
AI.result: 在三个OGBench操作任务上，CGSE使离线策略平均成功率相对提升7.1%。
AI.conclusion: 将世界模型定位为局部转移生成器并结合critic引导的动作精化，可有效合成离线经验以提升现有离线策略，避免复合误差与在线交互开销。

title: ROAD: Modern Adversarial Training for Simple One-Step Distillation at Scale
summary: One-step distillation turns pretrained diffusion models into fast generators, but strong results often require substantial training machinery and compute. Pure adversarial distillation offers a simpler route, yet has struggled at modern text-to-image scale. To address this limitation, we propose ROAD (Representation-grounded One-step Adversarial Distillation), a one-stage framework that distills text-to-image models with one adversarial objective and a lightweight representation-space critic. First, we replace the classical convolutional head with a Lipschitz-controlled Transformer head with token-level text conditioning, which matches the semantic tokens of modern visual encoders. Second, we observed a fixed random feature mixing leads to long-horizon degradation. We attribute it to generator-critic co-adaptation around one realization-specific view, and periodically re-draw the mixing to keep the randomization effective. Third, for our dense and vector-valued logits, we introduce Jacobian R1 which penalizes the full input-logit Jacobian, overcoming pooled R1's limitation of neglecting most of logit sensitivities. A single adversarial objective then suffices: in one step, ROAD reaches 11.03 FID on SDXL and 13.73 on SD3.5-M on COCO-10K, surpassing the multi-step teachers at a fraction of distribution matching's training compute.

AI.tldr: 提出ROAD——一个基于表示空间判别器的单阶段对抗蒸馏框架，将SDXL/SD3.5一步蒸馏，COCO-10K上FID分别为11.03和13.73，超过多步教师模型且训练算力远低于分布匹配方法。
AI.motivation: 一步蒸馏可将扩散模型变为快速生成器，但高质量结果往往依赖庞大训练机制与算力；纯对抗蒸馏虽简单，却难以扩展到现代文生图规模。因此需要一个更简单、可扩展的单阶段对抗蒸馏方案。
AI.method: ROAD采用单一对抗目标+轻量表示空间判别器：1）用Lipschitz受控的Transformer判别头替换传统卷积头，并引入token级文本条件以匹配现代视觉编码器的语义token；2）发现固定随机特征混合导致长程训练退化，归因于生成器-判别器围绕单一实现视图的共同适应，故周期性重采样混合以保持随机化有效；3）针对稠密向量化logits，提出Jacobian R1，惩罚完整输入-对数雅可比，克服池化R1忽略大部分logit敏感性的问题。
AI.result: 单步生成在COCO-10K上SDXL达到11.03 FID，SD3.5-M达到13.73 FID，超越多步教师模型，且训练算力仅为分布匹配方法的一小部分。
AI.conclusion: 单一对抗目标配合表示空间判别器、Lipschitz控制的Transformer头、周期性特征混合重采样与Jacobian R1正则，足以实现现代文生图模型的高质量一步蒸馏，兼顾简洁性与可扩展性。

title: Non-Zero Radius: The Missing Component of Neural Networks
summary: Inspired by the analogy between the all-or-none activation of biological neurons and the true-false of logic circuits, McCulloch and Pitts proposed a mathematical model of the biological neuron in 1943 with the aim of simulating logical reasoning. Although Norbert Wiener considered the model overly simplistic at the time, it later became a building block of modern neural networks, including large language models. Despite their remarkable empirical success, however, conventional neural networks remain largely black-box systems and struggle with reliable symbolic reasoning. Viewing vectors as spheres of zero radius, we relax the zero-radius constraint and represent concepts as spheres with non-zero radii. We argue that sphere-based representations can capture additional features of biological cognition, including representing spatial concepts as regions and reasoning through model construction and inspection. Building on sphere embeddings, we introduce Sphere Neural Networks (SphNNs), which use a transition map to achieve symbolic-level Aristotelian syllogistic reasoning without training data, thereby taking an initial step toward the original goal of McCulloch and Pitts. We suggest that the zero-radius constraint may reflect an aspect of the oversimplification identified by Wiener and may limit conventional neural networks' capacity for symbolic-level logical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该文将向量视为零半径球体并放宽为零半径以上的“球体表示”，据此提出 Sphere Neural Networks (SphNNs)，通过转移映射在无训练数据条件下实现亚里士多德三段论式的符号级推理，旨在向 McCulloch-Pitts 的原始目标迈出一步。
AI.motivation: 受生物神经元全或无激活与逻辑电路真/假类比启发，McCulloch 与 Pitts 于1943年提出神经元数学模型以模拟逻辑推理；尽管 Wiener 认为其过于简化，该模型仍成为现代神经网络（含大语言模型）的构件。然而传统神经网络经验成功显著却基本是黑箱，且难以进行可靠的符号推理。作者据此推测，零半径约束可能是 Wiener 所指“过度简化”的一个侧面，并限制了符号级逻辑推理能力。
AI.method: 将向量视为零半径球体，放松零半径约束，把概念表示为具有非零半径的球体（空间概念表示为区域）；在球体嵌入基础上构建 Sphere Neural Networks，利用一个转移映射（transition map）完成推理，并通过模型的构造与检视（model construction and inspection）实现推理过程。
AI.result: 球体表示能够刻画生物认知的额外特征，包括将空间概念表示为区域、以及通过模型构造与检视进行推理；SphNNs 在无需训练数据的条件下实现了符号级的亚里士多德三段论推理。摘要未给出定量实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 零半径约束可能反映了 Wiener 所指过度简化的一个方面，并可能限制传统神经网络的符号级逻辑推理能力；球体嵌入与 SphNNs 为回归 McCulloch-Pitts 最初目标提供了初步路径。

title: From Local Recovery to Unified Generation: Discovering Triple Set in Knowledge Graphs via Observation-Anchored Latent Diffusion
summary: Triple set prediction (TSP) is to recover missing relational triples in a knowledge graph by predicting the triple set instead of isolated links. Existing approaches predominantly rely on the subgraph-based completion paradigm, where the original graph is first partitioned into local subgraphs which are then independently completed. Such a paradigm suffers from fragmented structural reasoning, limited cross subgraph dependency modeling, and missing predictions across subgraphs. This paper proposes LatentDiff, a novel unified latent generative framework for TSP, which reformulates knowledge graph completion as latent space graph generation. LatentDiff first learns a compact latent representation using a relation-aware residual-quantized knowledge graph autoencoder, which encodes the whole graph into relation-aware latent embeddings, quantizes them with chunked residual codebooks, and reconstructs triples through a factorized decoder. On top of this latent space, we introduce an observation-anchored latent graph diffusion model, where the target latent graph representation is perturbed toward the observed latent. The reverse process recovers missing triples through progressive latent denoising. Experiments on three benchmark datasets show that LatentDiff outperforms the SOTA in terms of F_{tsp} by 5.4 percentage points on average. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LKGDiff-44A5.

AI.tldr: LatentDiff 将三元组集合预测（TSP）重构为潜在空间图生成：用关系感知残差量化自编码器把整张知识图谱编码为紧凑潜在表示，再在该潜在空间上做观测锚定的扩散去噪，从而全局完成缺失三元组，F_tsp 平均超越 SOTA 5.4 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有 TSP 方法依赖"子图划分—独立完成"范式，导致结构推理碎片化、跨子图依赖难以建模、跨子图缺失三元组无法预测。作者希望以全局视角统一建模整个知识图谱的补全过程。
AI.method: 1）关系感知残差量化 KG 自编码器：将整图编码为关系感知潜在嵌入，用分块残差码本（chunked residual codebooks）量化，并通过因子化解码器重建三元组；2）观测锚定潜在图扩散模型：以观测到的潜在表示为锚，将目标潜在图表示向观测潜在扰动，反向过程通过渐进式潜在去噪恢复缺失三元组。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上，F_tsp 指标平均优于当前 SOTA 5.4 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明在紧凑潜在空间中对整图进行生成式建模，可有效替代子图范式，缓解结构碎片化与跨子图依赖问题，为知识图谱三元组集合预测提供了统一且高效的生成框架。

title: Comprehensive empirical evaluation of feature extractors in computer vision
summary: Feature detection and matching are fundamental components in computer vision, underpinning a broad spectrum of applications. This study offers a comprehensive evaluation of traditional feature detections and descriptors, analyzing methods such as Scale Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT), Speeded-Up Robust Features (SURF), Binary Robust Independent Elementary Features (BRIEF), Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF (ORB), Binary Robust Invariant Scalable Keypoints (BRISK), KAZE, Accelerated KAZE (AKAZE), Fast Retina Keypoint (FREAK), Dense and Accurate Invariant Scalable descriptor for Yale (DAISY), Features from Accelerated Segment Test (FAST), and STAR. Each feature extractor was assessed based on its architectural design and complexity, focusing on how these factors influence computational efficiency and robustness under various transformations. Utilizing the Image Matching Challenge Photo Tourism 2020 dataset, which includes over 1.5 million images, the study identifies the FAST algorithm as the most efficient detector when paired with the ORB descriptor and Brute-Force (BF) matcher, offering the fastest feature extraction and matching process. ORB is notably effective on affine transformed and brightened images, while AKAZE excels in conditions involving blurring, fisheye distortion, image rotation, and perspective distortions. Through more than 2 million comparisons, the study highlights the feature extractors that demonstrate superior resilience across various conditions, including rotation, scaling, blurring, brightening, affine transformations, perspective distortions, fisheye distortion, and salt-and-pepper noise

AI.tldr: 本文对11种传统特征检测器与描述子进行大规模评测，认为FAST+ORB+BF最快，ORB擅长仿射/增亮，AKAZE在模糊、鱼眼、旋转和透视畸变下最优。
AI.motivation: 特征检测与匹配是计算机视觉的基础组件，但其架构设计与复杂度如何影响计算效率和鲁棒性缺乏系统性、大样本的统一评测，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 对SIFT、SURF、BRIEF、ORB、BRISK、KAZE、AKAZE、FREAK、DAISY、FAST、STAR等方法，从架构设计与复杂度角度分析其对效率与鲁棒性的影响，并基于Image Matching Challenge Photo Tourism 2020数据集（超150万张图像）在旋转、缩放、模糊、增亮、仿射变换、透视畸变、鱼眼畸变和椒盐噪声等条件下进行超过200万次对比实验。
AI.result: FAST检测器搭配ORB描述子与Brute-Force匹配器实现最快提取与匹配；ORB在仿射变换与增亮图像上表现突出；AKAZE在模糊、鱼眼畸变、旋转和透视畸变条件下最优。
AI.conclusion: 不同特征方法在效率与鲁棒性上各有优势，应根据具体变换条件选择检测器—描述子—匹配器组合；研究给出了各方法在多种图像退化条件下的适用性结论。

title: From Intent to Improvement: Agentic Dataset Search for Better Model Training
summary: Finding training data in million-scale machine learning repositories is a Web search problem where text relevance is not enough. A query couples a semantic training goal with constraints such as task, license, and training stage, and the metadata that would verify them are often missing. Text retrieval ranks dataset cards by similarity but cannot enforce hard constraints or follow the relations that reach a sparsely described dataset. Free-form tool-calling agents are more flexible, but the same model that picks a dataset also declares it a match, and nothing checks that the query's constraints are actually met. Neither approach establishes that the data it returns will improve model training. To address it, we propose AgenticDS, a contract-governed agentic framework in which every language model decision instantiates a typed object before deterministic code consumes it. The framework compiles a query into a typed search plan, executes it through admissible deterministic operators over hybrid retrieval and bounded graph expansion, and verifies the provenance-grounded evidence before accepting a ranking or emitting a typed diagnosis that permits only local repairs. On HuDS-Bench, a new benchmark of 200 queries with 24,908 graded judgments pooled over 15 systems, AgenticDS improves NDCG@10 by 25.7\% over the strongest dense--sparse hybrid and by 18.9\% over a commercial LLM agent. A controlled search-to-train study further shows that the datasets it retrieves give the best downstream accuracy in mathematics, code, and medicine. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/nju-websoft/AgenticDS.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgenticDS：一种契约治理的智能体框架，将查询编译为类型化搜索计划，由确定性算子执行并做证据溯源校验，在百万级数据仓库中检索真正能提升训练的数据集。
AI.motivation: 百万规模机器学习仓库中寻找训练数据是 Web 检索问题，纯文本相关性不足：查询同时耦合语义训练目标与任务、许可、训练阶段等硬约束，而用于验证这些约束的元数据常常缺失。文本检索按相似度排序无法强制执行硬约束，也难以沿关系到达描述稀疏的数据集；自由形式的工具调用智能体能选数据集又自我判定匹配，缺乏对约束是否满足的校验。两类方法都无法保证返回数据能改进模型训练。
AI.method: AgenticDS 采用"契约治理"设计：每个语言模型决策先实例化为类型化对象，再由确定性代码消费。流程为：(1) 将查询编译为类型化搜索计划；(2) 通过可接受的确定性算子在混合检索与有界图扩展上执行；(3) 在接受排序结果前验证基于溯源的证据；(4) 若验证失败，输出类型化诊断，仅允许局部修复。
AI.result: 构建 HuDS-Bench：200 条查询、覆盖 15 个系统的 24,908 条分级判断。AgenticDS 的 NDCG@10 相比最强稠密—稀疏混合检索提升 25.7%，相比商业 LLM 智能体提升 18.9%。受控的"检索到训练"实验表明，其检索的数据集在数学、代码、医学三个领域取得最佳下游准确率。
AI.conclusion: 以类型化契约约束 LLM 决策、以确定性算子与溯源证据校验替代模型自证匹配，可显著提升训练数据检索质量，并能切实转化为下游训练收益。

title: Uncertainty-Guided Cross-Modal Alignment for Diffusion-Based IoT Intrusion Detection
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS DynaFront 2026
summary: Diffusion models evolve noisy states toward a learned data distribution, so their sampling behavior depends on the geometry of the representation in which denoising occurs. This dependence is especially important for multimodal data: independently trained encoders can map synchronized views to incompatible latent regions, while uniform alignment can let an uncertain view distort the shared geometry. To address this gap, we introduce a novel reliability-guided alignment rule that uses normalized VAE posterior variance to control directional cross-modal influence before diffusion training. We study this issue in minority-attack generation for imbalanced Internet-of-Things intrusion detection. Tabular flow attributes, a DeepInsight image, and a packet sequence are encoded by modality-specific variational autoencoders. Per-modality normalized VAE posterior variances provide bounded, sample-specific weighting signals in an asymmetric stop-gradient alignment objective. We use these quantities as heuristic encoder-derived reliability proxies rather than calibrated probabilistic uncertainties. The full modality-specific latent means obtained after alignment fine-tuning are standardized and modeled jointly by a class-conditional EDM; a second-order sampler then generates paired attack-conditioned latent blocks for the three decoders. In controlled experiments on TON-IoT, uncertainty-aware alignment obtains the highest mean precision, recall, density, and coverage among three diffusion variants. Augmenting only the training split yields ROC-AUC 0.9515, PR-AUC 0.8954, balanced accuracy 0.8395, and attack-class F1 0.7940 on an untouched real test set. Among the two variants with matched alignment fine-tuning, posterior-variance-based weighting improves both tabular generative fidelity and downstream detection relative to uniform weighting.

AI.tldr: 提出以归一化VAE后验方差为可靠性权重的跨模态对齐规则，在扩散训练前控制方向性跨模态影响，用于不平衡IoT入侵检测中的少数类攻击样本生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型采样行为依赖去噪所发生的表示几何结构；多模态场景下，独立训练的编码器会把同步视图映射到不兼容的潜空间区域，而均匀对齐又会让不确定视图扭曲共享几何，因此需要在扩散训练前引入可靠性引导的对齐。
AI.method: 对表格流特征、DeepInsight图像与数据包序列分别用模态专属VAE编码；以各模态归一化后验方差作为有界的样本级可靠性代理，构建非对称stop-gradient对齐目标；对齐微调后将完整潜变量均值标准化，由类条件EDM联合建模，再用二阶采样器生成成对攻击条件潜变量块供三个解码器使用。
AI.result: 在TON-IoT受控实验中，不确定性感知对齐在三种扩散变体中获得最高平均precision、recall、density与coverage；仅扩增训练集，在未触碰的真实测试集上达到ROC-AUC 0.9515、PR-AUC 0.8954、平衡准确率0.8395、攻击类F1 0.7940；在对齐微调匹配的两个变体中，后验方差加权相较均匀加权同时提升表格生成保真度与下游检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 归一化VAE后验方差可作为有效的启发式可靠性信号用于跨模态对齐加权，改善多模态扩散生成质量与少数类攻击检测，但其为编码器导出的启发式代理而非标定概率不确定性。

title: BEACON: Distilled Begin/End-Aware Structured Decoding for Continuous Sign Language Segmentation
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027. 12 pages, 4 figures, including supplementary material
summary: In segmentation-based continuous sign language recognition, an untrimmed video is first partitioned into lexical units; segmentation is therefore a means to an end---downstream recognition. However, segmenters are usually judged by local boundary detection rather than by the quality of the lexical segments and the recognition they enable. We present BEACON, a begin/end-aware segmenter that combines four-class Outside/Begin/Inside/End (BIOE) labeling, constrained Viterbi decoding over eight legal transitions, and boundary knowledge distilled from a binary teacher into a shared student. Under strict no-cut evaluation with validation-based model selection, BEACON improves segment-F1 by 14.58/14.59 points and boundary-F1 by 2.17/1.22 points, and reduces the downstream word error rate (WER) by 9.10/4.15 points relative to the state-of-the-art in the PHOENIX-14/BSL Corpus. To examine which segmentation metric better reflects downstream recognition, we evaluated five distinct architecture families. Segment-F1 aligns more consistently with lower WER than boundary-F1 in both corpora (Spearman $ρ=-1.0/-0.9$ versus $-0.9/-0.8$). These results support evaluating sign language segmentation in terms of segment quality and downstream recognition utility rather than local boundary accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: 提出BEACON分段器（BIOE四类标注+八种合法转移的约束Viterbi解码+从二分类教师蒸馏边界知识），在严格无切分评测下大幅提升分段质量并降低下游WER；并论证Segment-F1比Boundary-F1更贴合下游识别性能。
AI.motivation: 基于分段的连续手语识别中，分段是服务于下游识别的手段，但现有分段器多以局部边界检测（boundary-F1）衡量，而非词法片段质量及其对识别的作用，评价指标与最终目标脱节。
AI.method: BEACON：1）Outside/Begin/Inside/End（BIOE）四类标注；2）在八种合法转移上施加约束的Viterbi解码；3）将二分类教师模型的边界知识蒸馏至共享学生模型。评测采用严格无切分（no-cut）设置与基于验证集的模型选择；并对比五类不同架构族，用Spearman相关分析分段指标与WER的一致性。
AI.result: 相对SOTA，在PHOENIX-14/BSL Corpus上segment-F1提升14.58/14.59点，boundary-F1提升2.17/1.22点，下游WER降低9.10/4.15点。Segment-F1与更低WER的一致性优于boundary-F1（Spearman ρ=-1.0/-0.9 对 -0.9/-0.8）。
AI.conclusion: 手语分段应以片段质量与下游识别效用为评价依据，而非仅看局部边界准确率；BEACON在分段与识别上均显著优于SOTA，且Segment-F1是更可靠的下游性能代理指标。

title: Emergence of the transformer architecture as the score of entropic laws of random measures
summary: We show that the transformer architecture emerges as the score of last-token laws in a natural statistical model of language, where sentences are empirical measures of tokens, a language is a law on $P(S^d)$, and our prior belief is that sentences carry no structure at all. By the maximum-entropy principle, we select the law closest to this prior in relative entropy among those reproducing an observed sentence-level statistic. We discuss the relevance of the statistic in the posterior interaction between tokens and we build a statistic, able to capture that interaction, with Luce's choice axiom truncated at the lowest relational order. This procedure gives the softmax choice rule, with the attention cross-moment as its mean parameter. The query--key matrix is then the Lagrange multiplier of a maximum-entropy problem inside each sentence, and the value matrix the multiplier of the constraint over the language, so that the two are untied. Under the optimal entropic law we then show that a transformer head appears in the score of the last-token law. For ordered sentences, causal masking follows from the masked reference choice rule, and with a next-token cross-moment the score equals one causally masked attention head. We also discuss multi-head attention, weight-tied unembedding, and a heuristic reading of residual blocks as projected Langevin steps.

AI.tldr: 从语言的自然统计模型出发，用最大熵原理推导出 transformer 结构：softmax 注意力等价于截断 Luce 选择公理下的选择规则，查询-键矩阵与值矩阵分别是对句内与语言级约束的拉格朗日乘子（因而解耦），并在因果掩码与下一词交叉矩下，得分等价于一个因果掩码注意力头。
AI.motivation: 现有 transformer 多为经验设计，缺乏第一性原理的统计解释。作者希望说明注意力机制不是凭空构造，而是某个自然语言统计模型（句子为经验测度、语言为 P(S^d) 上的律）在最大熵/相对熵最小化下的必然产物。
AI.method: 以"句子无结构"为先验，在复现某句级统计量的约束下按最大熵原则选取相对熵最小的律；用截断到最低关系阶的 Luce 选择公理构造能刻画词间交互的统计量；将所得最大熵问题的拉格朗日乘子识别为查询-键矩阵（句内约束）与值矩阵（语言级约束），从而二者解耦；再对有序句子引入掩码参考选择规则得到因果掩码，并用下一词交叉矩把得分等同于一个因果掩码注意力头；最后讨论多头、权重绑定 unembedding 与残差块的朗之万步启发式解读。
AI.result: 在该熵最优律下，末词律的得分中出现一个 transformer 头；softmax 选择规则的均值参数即注意力交叉矩；因果掩码由掩码参考选择规则自然导出，配合下一词交叉矩时得分恰为一个因果掩码注意力头；查询-键与值矩阵作为不同约束的乘子而相互解耦。
AI.conclusion: transformer 架构可被理解为自然语言统计模型下最大熵推断的得分函数，注意力、因果掩码、多头及残差块均有对应的统计/概率解释，为架构设计提供了原理性依据。

title: Clean Sheets and Checkpoints: Evidence Complexity for Certifying Sequential Agent Risk
summary: Dangerous-capability evaluations often test an AI agent from prepared states at ordered milestones. A clean sheet records no successes. What it certifies about a campaign of $B$ attempts depends on what a failed attempt erases. We model the task as a chain of $k$ milestones divided into checkpoint segments and ask how many zero audit responses certify, at level $α$, a completion probability of at most $ε$. For segments chosen before the audit, counting possible completion windows gives a certificate for any specified budget. The bound also covers adaptive deployment processes that follow the chain's transitions, provided their success probabilities after every complete history are capped by the corresponding audit success probabilities. The audit does not test this transport assumption. In rare-risk phase interiors, each segment is either rarely completed within the budget (active) or nearly always completed (free). The minimum expected number of zero responses is asymptotic to $\log(1/α)\,(B^a/(a!\,ε))^{1/K_A}$, where the $a$ active segments contain $K_A$ milestones and are those at least as long as a budget-dependent threshold. The certificate attains this constant. Every asymptotically optimal evaluator must divide its expected response count equally among active milestones in the limit, with a vanishing share elsewhere. Where a single segment passes from active to free, each of its milestones receives a smaller limiting share than an active milestone; a crossover-aware certificate attains the optimal constant. For selected segments with known or unqueried prefix steps, counting failed cycles can sharpen the certificate.

AI.tldr: 该文将危险能力评估建模为k个里程碑组成的链被划分为检查点段，研究"零成功记录"（clean sheet）在预算B次尝试下能以水平α认证完成概率不超过ε所需的最小零响应数，并刻画其渐近最优常数与最优评估器结构。
AI.motivation: 危险能力评估常从预备状态出发，在有序里程碑上测试AI agent；一份"干净记录"（无成功）能认证的内容取决于一次失败尝试会抹去何种进展。作者希望量化：在审计前选定的检查点分段结构下，需要多少条零审计响应才能在显著性水平α下认证整个B次尝试campaign的完成概率上界为ε，并揭示该证明负担的最优分配规律。
AI.method: 把任务建模为k个里程碑的链，按检查点段切分；统计"可能的完成窗口"（completion windows）得到对任意指定预算有效的证书。证书同时覆盖沿链转移、服从状态转移的适应性部署过程，前提是其任意完整历史后的成功概率被相应审计成功概率所界定（该"传输假设"审计本身并不检验）。引入稀有风险相内部（phase interiors）的段分类：段内预算完成概率极低者为"活跃段"（active），几乎必成者为"free"；推导最小期望零响应数的渐近表达式，并给出达到最优常数的证书及crossover（活跃/自由切换）感知证书，还讨论已知或未查询前缀步下通过计数失败循环来收紧证书。
AI.result: 最小期望零响应数渐近等价于 log(1/α)·(B^a/(a!·ε))^{1/K_A}，其中a为活跃段数，K_A为活跃段所含里程碑总数，活跃段即长度不小于某个依赖预算的阈值者；所给证书达到该常数。渐近最优评估器必须（极限下）将期望响应数在活跃里程碑间均分，其余处占比趋于零。当某一段由active转为free（crossover）时，该段每个里程碑得到的极限份额小于活跃里程碑；crossover感知证书仍达到最优常数。对选定段若前缀步已知或未被查询，计数失败循环可进一步收紧证书。
AI.conclusion: 零审计响应数存在精确的渐近下界与可实现的匹配上界，其常数由活跃段结构与预算-ε-α共同决定；最优审计策略应把响应预算集中均摊于活跃里程碑，并对crossover段施以更小的分配；证书在适应性部署过程下只是条件性地成立，且审计无法检验该传输假设。

title: DOSE: Dominance-Guided Ordinal Severity Estimation from Sparse Relative Annotations
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 8 pages, 4 figures. Adjust the counts if you add the supplementary material
summary: Medical severity estimation commonly relies on absolute grade annotations, which are fundamentally ordinal, yet existing methods often treat the grades as independent categories. Learning-to-rank methods, which can be trained using relative annotations based on severity comparisons of image pairs, can provide continuous severity rankings but cannot directly predict discrete severity grades. We propose Dominance-guided Ordinal Severity Estimation from Sparse Relative Annotations (DOSE), a framework for learning ordinal medical severity from sparse pairwise comparisons without using absolute annotations. DOSE aggregates the observed comparisons through a global comparison graph to estimate a dominance score for each image. Differences between dominance scores set cumulative margins in the embedding space, so that pairs with larger estimated severity differences are separated more strongly, and also generate pseudo-pairs that supervise a scalar severity head alongside the observed comparisons. The learned continuous severity axis is converted into discrete grades via label-free score calibration, with tie-anchored segmentation as the main calibration method. In the experiment, DOSE consistently outperformed pairwise-ranking baselines on ACNE04, IDRiD, and LIMUC under different pair budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/TushirSahu/DOSE

AI.tldr: DOSE 提出一种仅用稀疏成对比较标注学习有序医学严重程度等级的框架：用全局比较图估计优势分数（dominance score），以其差值为嵌入空间设定累积间隔，并生成伪样本监督标量严重度头，再通过无标签分数校准（以并列锚定分割为主）将连续严重度轴离散化为等级。
AI.motivation: 医学严重程度等级本质是有序变量，但现有方法多将其当作独立类别处理；learning-to-rank 方法可用基于图像对严重度比较的相对标注训练，给出连续排序，却无法直接预测离散等级。因此需要一种不使用绝对标注、能从稀疏成对比较中同时获得连续严重度与离散等级的方法。
AI.method: (1) 通过全局比较图聚合观测到的成对比较，为每张图像估计优势分数；(2) 以优势分数差值在嵌入空间中设定累积间隔（margin），使严重度差异越大的图像对分离越强；(3) 由优势分数差生成伪样本（pseudo-pairs），与观测比较共同监督一个标量严重度头；(4) 采用无标签分数校准把连续严重度轴映射为离散等级，主校准方法为并列锚定分割（tie-anchored segmentation）。
AI.result: 在 ACNE04、IDRiD 和 LIMUC 三个数据集上，DOSE 在不同成对标注预算下均持续优于成对排序（pairwise-ranking）基线。
AI.conclusion: DOSE 表明仅凭稀疏相对比较即可联合学习有序严重度的连续表示与离散等级预测，无需绝对等级标注，并且性能稳定优于纯排序基线；代码已公开。

title: Letting AI Formulate the Research Question: Autonomous Research Agents
summary: Systems such as The AI Scientist have shown that AI agents can carry out and write up research, but in those demonstrations humans chose the research area and selected the outputs to show. We study letting the AI formulate the research question itself, and we report every run. Our system gives an off-the-shelf coding agent an instruction document and two skills: one for formulating the question, in which the agent diverges from recent technologies into problems of other fields, screens its candidates for known failure modes and obtains a critique from a different model; and one for peer review, in which a reviewer from another model family reruns the study from its records before the agent revises the paper. Over 13 development runs, changes to the one or two sentences that set the research area coincided with large shifts in what the candidate questions and the chosen papers were about, which led us to the area of a new technology applied to a societal problem. We froze the system after a pilot run and report five consecutive runs: the pilot, counted by a disclosed amendment to the pre-registration, and four pre-registered runs. All five runs went from question formulation to a revised, re-computable paper, with local computation on a laptop and no research input from humans, and external AI reviewers reading only the papers judged them at or near workshop level. We release the system, the five papers and the records needed to reproduce them.

AI.tldr: 该文让现成编码智能体自主完成从研究选题到撰写可复算论文的全流程，并对全部运行进行报告。
AI.motivation: 已有AI科研系统（如The AI Scientist）中，研究领域仍由人类选定、输出由人类挑选展示，缺乏对"AI自主提出研究问题"及"无选择报告"的考察。
AI.method: 给现成编码智能体一份指令文档和两项技能：选题技能——从近期技术发散迁移至其他领域问题，对候选问题筛查已知失效模式，并由另一模型提供批评；评审技能——由不同模型家族的评审者依据研究记录重跑研究，之后智能体再修订论文。经13次开发运行，冻结系统后进行1次试点（按披露的预注册修正案计入）加4次预注册运行。
AI.result: 研究领域设定的仅一两句话改动会显著改变候选问题与被选论文的主题方向；五次连续运行均从选题走到修订后可复算的论文，全部在笔记本本地计算完成、无人类研究输入；外部AI评审仅阅读论文即判定其达到或接近研讨会（workshop）水平。
AI.conclusion: 现成编码智能体在无人类研究输入、仅本地算力的条件下可实现端到端自主科研并产出可复算论文；研究领域表述对选题方向影响巨大，提示需谨慎设计指令并完整披露全部运行。

title: A Novel Approach to Evaluating Evaluation Metrics for Multi-Output Structured Prediction
comment: Extended version of the AAAI 2026 paper, including the technical appendix. 18 pages, 8 figures. Code: https://github.com/akshay25vyas/invariants-metric-eval
summary: In multi-output structured prediction tasks, while only one ground truth label may be provided in the training data, multiple equally valid outputs may be possible, making reliable evaluation a persistent challenge. We postulate that human evaluators implicitly use task-specific invariants, e.g., object boundaries in colorized images or named entities in translations, to judge if an output is acceptable. Under this assumption, we introduce a notion of approximate task-specific invariants and use them as diagnostic tools to evaluate a variety of existing metrics for vision and language tasks. We use these task invariants as part of a framework to systematically test metric reliability by encouraging domain-relevant invariants in model outputs via an augmented loss function. In our experiments, we observe that enforcing invariants with an augmented loss yields substantial improvements in popular distributional metrics while more traditional metrics change only marginally. Through this invariants-driven evaluation, we expose where standard metrics fail to detect meaningful differences, and we highlight the conditions under which distributional metrics succeed or still fall short.

AI.tldr: 提出用"任务特定不变量"作为诊断工具，检验多输出结构化预测中各类指标（尤其分布型指标）的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 多输出结构化预测中训练数据仅给单一标签，但存在多个同等有效的输出，使可靠评估长期困难。作者假设人类评估者依赖任务特定不变量（如图像上色中的物体边界、翻译中的命名实体）判断输出是否可接受。
AI.method: 引入"近似任务特定不变量"概念，将其用作诊断工具评估视觉与语言任务的多种现有指标；并构建框架，通过增广损失函数在模型输出中强化领域相关不变量，从而系统测试指标可靠性。
AI.result: 用增广损失强制不变量后，主流分布型指标出现显著改善，而传统指标仅轻微变化；据此暴露标准指标无法检测有意义差异之处，并厘清分布型指标成功或仍不足的条件。
AI.conclusion: 任务特定不变量可作为有效的指标诊断与评估手段，揭示现有度量在多输出场景下的失效边界。

title: TactoHand: Learning Geometry-Based Dense Hand-Surface Interaction Fields from Video
summary: Understanding how humans interact with the world requires a representation of physical interactions at the hand surface. Tactile sensing captures these interactions, but collecting tactile data at scale requires specialized hardware. We introduce TactoHand, a model that predicts three dense hand-surface interaction fields---contact, proximity, and 3D force---from monocular video. We derive geometry-based contact and proximity labels and motion-derived force labels from eligible training data within a curated collection spanning approximately 50 million source frames. TactoHand uses a temporal transformer to aggregate visual evidence across frames, while three learned queries decode the corresponding hand-surface fields. A differentiable physics layer further constrains force predictions using observed object motion. Across in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks, TactoHand improves contact and proximity estimation over prior methods. In addition, physics supervision reduces position and rotation errors in motion rollouts, and the predicted contact and proximity fields improve downstream hand-object reconstruction. Together, these results show a scalable, low-cost path to learning hand-surface interaction fields without collecting tactile measurements. Code will be released at https://github.com/zhenqis123/Tactohand.

AI.tldr: TactoHand：从单目视频预测手-表面交互场（接触、接近度、3D力），无需触觉硬件
AI.motivation: 研究人类与世界的交互需要手表面的物理交互表征；触觉传感可捕获此类信息，但大规模采集触觉数据依赖专用硬件，成本高、难以规模化。
AI.method: 构建约5000万源帧的筛选数据集；基于几何推导接触与接近度标签，基于运动推导力标签；模型采用时间Transformer跨帧聚合视觉证据，用三个可学习查询解码对应手-表面场；引入可微物理层，以观测到的物体运动约束力预测。
AI.result: 在域内与域外基准上，接触与接近度估计优于先前方法；物理监督降低运动rollout的位置与旋转误差；预测的接触与接近度场提升下游手-物体重建效果。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明可在不采集触觉测量的前提下，以可扩展、低成本的方式学习手-表面交互场。

title: The Real Cost of Context: Predicting Compute Time and Energy Consumption in LLM Prefill and Decode Phases
summary: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into agentic architectures has substantially increased token consumption, raising concerns about their energy footprint. Yet, estimating the energy consumption of proprietary API-based models remains challenging, and existing approaches focus primarily on generated output tokens while overlooking the impact of the large input contexts characteristic of agentic workflows. To address this gap, we systematically profile compute time and energy consumption across a wide range of prefill (input) and decode (output) token lengths. Using generalized linear models, we show that decode compute time and energy scale linearly with output length, whereas prefill compute time and energy exhibit both linear and quadratic scaling with input length. These findings demonstrate that input context becomes a relevant factor for large-context workloads. Furthermore, we show that compute time serves as a reliable proxy for energy consumption when direct energy measurements are unavailable. Our mapping framework enables precise energy estimation and supports more sustainable deployment decisions for agentic AI.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统刻画了大语言模型（LLM）在prefill（输入）与decode（输出）两阶段的计算时间与能耗随token长度的缩放规律，发现decode阶段呈线性缩放，而prefill阶段随输入长度呈线性加二次混合缩放，并证明计算时间可作为能耗的可靠代理指标。
AI.motivation: LLM被集成到智能体（agentic）架构后token消耗显著增加，引发能耗担忧。但专有API模型的能耗难以直接测量，且现有方法主要关注输出token，忽视了智能体工作流中典型的大规模输入上下文所带来的影响。
AI.method: 在广泛的prefill（输入）与decode（输出）token长度范围内系统性地测量计算时间与能耗；采用广义线性模型（GLM）对二者的缩放关系进行拟合与建模，并检验计算时间作为能耗代理的有效性。
AI.result: decode阶段的计算时间与能耗随输出长度线性缩放；prefill阶段的计算时间与能耗随输入长度同时呈现线性与二次缩放规律，说明输入上下文在大上下文负载下是不可忽视的因素；计算时间可作为能耗的可靠代理指标。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的映射框架可实现精确的能耗估计，支持面向智能体AI的更可持续的部署决策。

title: ACAM-J-MARS: Multi-Atlas Riemannian Spectral Representations for Decoding Advanced Meditation States from fMRI
summary: Inferring jhana-type advanced concentration absorption meditation (ACAM-J) states from fMRI data is challenging due to the spatially distributed nature of meditation-related effects, substantial inter-individual variability that can exceed within-subject state differences, and limited sample sizes. Conventional machine-learning approaches often formulate this problem as unimodal, Euclidean, atlas-based classification, thereby neglecting the non-Euclidean geometry of functional connectivity matrices and underrepresenting temporal information in functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI); these limitations can lead to suboptimal classification performance. We propose ACAM-J-MARS (\textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{A}tlas \textbf{R}iemannian \textbf{S}pectral representation), which computes functional connectivity using multiple atlases, represents symmetric positive definite (SPD) connectivity matrices on a Riemannian manifold, projects them into a log-Euclidean tangent space, and augments connectivity-derived features with low-frequency BOLD spectral energy to better resolve subtle state differences under heterogeneous variability. Evaluated on 204 segments from 22 practitioners, ACAM-J-MARS improves performance across multiple backbone models, achieving a balanced accuracy of 0.757 for early versus late ACAM-J classification and 0.545 for three-class classification, corresponding to a 10.8-point absolute improvement over the strongest baseline. These findings suggest that the proposed representation improves the decoding of advanced meditative brain states and may enable downstream applications such as closed-loop neurofeedback and real-time psychophysiological brain-computer interfaces.

AI.tldr: 提出ACAM-J-MARS表征方法，结合多图谱功能连接、SPD矩阵的Riemannian流形建模与log-Euclidean切空间投影，并融合低频BOLD谱能量，提升fMRI对高级禅定吸收状态（ACAM-J）的解码性能。
AI.motivation: 从fMRI推断ACAM-J状态困难，原因包括：冥想效应在空间上分布广泛、个体间差异甚至超过个体内状态差异、样本量有限。传统机器学习将其视为单模态、欧氏、基于脑图谱的分类问题，忽略了功能连接矩阵的非欧几何结构，且对fMRI时序信息表征不足，导致分类性能次优。
AI.method: ACAM-J-MARS（多图谱Riemannian谱表征）：(1) 使用多个脑图谱计算功能连接；(2) 将对称正定（SPD）连接矩阵表征于Riemannian流形上；(3) 投影到log-Euclidean切空间；(4) 在连接特征基础上增补低频BOLD谱能量，以在异质变异性下更好分辨细微状态差异。
AI.result: 在22名练习者的204个数据段上评估，ACAM-J-MARS在多种骨干模型上均带来性能提升：早期vs晚期ACAM-J二分类平衡准确率0.757，三分类为0.545，相较最强基线绝对提升10.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 所提表征可改善高级冥想脑状态的解码，并有望支撑闭环神经反馈与实时心理生理脑机接口等下游应用。

title: Operator-Aware Posterior Sampling for Multivariate Weather Downscaling
summary: Statistical downscaling is the task of reconstructing high-resolution meteorological fields from coarse inputs. A principled approach formulates downscaling as a Bayesian inverse problem, using a diffusion prior over high-resolution fields and incorporating the coarse field only at inference through a likelihood. This decouples the prior from the coarse source, allowing one pretrained model to adapt to different sources. However, two challenges limit this flexibility: (1) when coarse and target fields come from different reanalysis systems, no fixed coarsening operator can capture their relationship; and (2) guidance gradients can differ by orders of magnitude across variables, making a single guidance strength ineffective. This paper addresses both challenges within the guidance loop, leaving the prior unchanged. We learn the forward operator from paired data and normalize the gradient per channel. We show that this normalization corresponds to steepest descent under a block-max norm, allowing a single guidance strength across variables. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/CarloSaccardi/operator-aware-weather-downscaling.

AI.tldr: 本文在扩散先验的贝叶斯逆问题框架下做统计降尺度，学习前向算子并按通道归一化引导梯度，使单一引导强度可跨变量通用。
AI.motivation: 现有方法把降尺度建模为贝叶斯逆问题，用高分辨率场的扩散先验、仅在推理时通过似然引入粗场，从而解耦先验与粗源、支持一个预训练模型适配不同源。但存在两个问题：(1) 当粗场与目标场来自不同再分析系统时，不存在固定的粗化算子能刻画二者关系；(2) 引导梯度在不同变量间量级相差数个数量级，单一引导强度失效。
AI.method: 在引导回路内解决两个问题且保持先验不变：利用配对数据学习前向算子；对引导梯度按通道进行归一化，并证明该归一化等价于块最大范数下的最速下降，从而支持单一引导强度跨变量使用。
AI.result: 学习到的前向算子可刻画跨再分析系统的粗-细关系；逐通道梯度归一化使单一引导强度在多个变量上同时有效，避免按变量调参。
AI.conclusion: 将前向算子学习与块最大范数下的逐通道梯度归一化引入扩散引导回路，可在不改动先验的前提下提升降尺度框架对不同粗源与多变量的灵活性与通用性。代码已开源。

title: MoLRSI: A Recursive Self-Improving AI agent for Molecular Discovery
summary: Molecular discovery requires navigating vast combinatorial search spaces while balancing competing biological objectives. AI agents can automate expert-defined molecular design protocols, but automation alone does not address how to optimize workflows for new tasks or improve their development through experience. Here we introduce MoLRSI, an AI agent that combines systematic optimization of workflows and model architectures with persistent cross-task memory to recursively improve its search policy for molecular discovery. Workflow performance, refinement outcomes, and execution feedback guide subsequent searches, allowing the agent to improve both its workflows and its strategy for developing them. We evaluate MoLRSI in two challenging molecular discovery settings that require balancing competing properties. In antibiotic discovery, MoLRSI developed a screening workflow balancing antibacterial activity, cytotoxicity and structural novelty, achieving an experimental hit rate of 15.9%, compared with 8.7% for a previous expert-led workflow using the same training data and screening library. In de novo peptide-MHC binder design, MoLRSI developed workflows that jointly consider target binding and specificity, producing eight experimentally validated hits against MART-1 and SARS-CoV-1 pMHCs with preferential binding over tested off-targets while Claude Science completely failed. These findings demonstrate how experience-guided workflow optimization can address competing discovery objectives while improving the search strategies used in subsequent campaigns.

AI.tldr: 提出MoLRSI——一种将工作流/模型架构的系统优化与跨任务持久记忆相结合的AI智能体，通过递归改进搜索策略，在抗生素发现与pMHC结合肽设计中显著超越专家工作流与Claude Science。
AI.motivation: 分子发现需在庞大组合搜索空间中平衡多个相互竞争的生物学目标。现有AI智能体虽可自动化专家定义的设计流程，但无法针对新任务优化工作流，也难以通过经验积累改进自身开发策略。
AI.method: MoLRSI智能体：将工作流与模型架构的系统性优化同持久化跨任务记忆相结合，利用工作流表现、改进结果与执行反馈指导后续搜索，递归地提升其搜索策略及"开发工作流"的元策略。
AI.result: 抗生素发现中，MoLRSI构建兼顾抗菌活性、细胞毒性与结构新颖性的筛选流程，实验命中率15.9%（同训练数据与筛选库下，此前专家主导流程为8.7%）；de novo 肽-MHC结合物设计中，同时优化靶点结合与特异性，获得8个经实验验证的MART-1与SARS-CoV-1 pMHC结合物，且对测试的脱靶具有优先结合性，而Claude Science完全失败。
AI.conclusion: 经验引导的工作流优化可有效应对相互竞争的发现目标，并同步提升后续campaign中所用搜索策略的性能，表明"可自我改进的智能体"在分子发现中具备实用价值。

title: Analyzing Condensation on Patterned Surfaces via Deep Learning
summary: Dropwise condensation is key to power and water systems. State-of-the-art condensation surfaces are often inhomogeneous, either patterned by design or random defects. Inhomogeneous surface features dictate the rates of each stage of dropwise condensation-nucleation, growth, coalescence, and shedding. Characterizing these rates requires the precise detection of thousands of droplets. Yet, existing segmentation methods are unable to detect droplets on inhomogeneous surfaces. We developed TileSAM3, a universal droplet segmentation tool built on the Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3). Hierarchical tiling with per-tile inference followed by post-processing extended SAM3's detection cap and raised the effective resolution of small droplets. We created two datasets: High Quality Droplet Dataset (N=365,826; HQDD) with homogeneous surfaces and Low Quality Droplet Dataset (N=63,577; LQDD) with patterned, defect-laden surfaces under adverse lighting. TileSAM3 closely reproduced thresholding annotations on HQDD, surpassed it over sixfold on LQDD (Average Precision 0.57 versus 0.088), and outperformed other deep learning models on all metrics evaluated. Combined with KD-tree tracking, TileSAM3 identified localized nucleation and coalescence in narrow active bands on a stiffness-patterned surface. TileSAM3 enables analysis of understudied inhomogeneous substrates with poor lighting and videography which facilitates faster, lower cost research of condensation materials.

AI.tldr: TileSAM3：基于SAM3的分层切片通用液滴分割工具，可精准分割非均匀表面上的液滴。
AI.motivation: 滴状冷凝的四个阶段速率受非均匀表面特征支配，需精确检测数千液滴才能表征，但现有分割方法无法在非均匀表面上检测液滴。
AI.method: 基于Segment Anything Model 3构建TileSAM3，采用分层切片+逐片推理+后处理以扩展检测上限、提升小液滴有效分辨率；并构建两个数据集HQDD（N=365,826，均匀表面）与LQDD（N=63,577，图案化、含缺陷且光照恶劣）。
AI.result: 在HQDD上接近阈值法标注；在LQDD上平均精度0.57 vs 0.088，提升逾六倍；在所有评估指标上优于其他深度学习模型；结合KD-tree跟踪在刚度图案化表面窄活性带中识别出局域化成核与并合。
AI.conclusion: TileSAM3可分析光照与成像条件较差的非均匀基底，助力更快速低成本的冷凝材料研究。

title: Evaluating Cultural Knowledge Editing in Vision-Language Models
summary: Current Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently fail to recognize culture-specific concepts, especially from underrepresented regions. Effectively injecting this long-tail knowledge into existing models remains a challenge. In this work, we investigate knowledge editing as a targeted alternative by introducing CulturalBind, a benchmark comprising 3.2K images of 1K concepts from 6 domains, designed to evaluate culture-aware cross-modal knowledge as well as concept-level knowledge editing in VLMs. Pre-edit evaluation reveals that textual and visual knowledge is decoupled: models often demonstrate text-based knowledge of cultural concepts but fail to identify them from images. We then evaluate editing methods in single and sequential scenarios. Although current methods successfully correct individual visual recognition errors, they exhibit low cross-modal portability, failing to integrate edits into the model's broader parametric knowledge. Furthermore, performance degrades rapidly under sequential editing, highlighting the need for comprehensive adaptation approaches that better consolidate multimodal knowledge over time.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CulturalBind 基准（3.2K 图像、1K 概念、6 个领域），用于评估 VLM 的文化感知跨模态知识及概念级知识编辑；发现文本与视觉知识解耦、现有编辑方法跨模态可迁移性低、顺序编辑下性能快速退化。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型（VLM）难以识别文化特定概念，尤其来自代表性不足地区的长尾知识；如何将这类知识有效注入现有模型仍是难题，作者探索以知识编辑作为有针对性的替代方案。
AI.method: 构建 CulturalBind 基准，覆盖 1K 概念、3.2K 图像、6 个领域，同时评测文化感知的跨模态知识与概念级知识编辑；先做编辑前评估考察文本—视觉知识关系，再在单次与顺序（sequential）两种编辑场景下评测现有编辑方法。
AI.result: 编辑前评估显示文本知识与视觉知识解耦：模型常具备基于文本的文化概念知识，却无法从图像中识别该概念。编辑方法虽能纠正单个视觉识别错误，但跨模态可迁移性低，未能将编辑整合进模型更广泛的参数化知识；顺序编辑下性能迅速下降。
AI.conclusion: 现有知识编辑方法不足以支撑 VLM 的多模态文化知识注入，亟需能随时间更好地巩固多模态知识的综合适配方法。

title: Bank-World: A Benchmark for Evaluating Agents on Banking Workflows
comment: 43 pages, 3 figures, including appendices. Ancillary files contain the task ID mapping, reward specifications, and single-turn check-authority mapping
summary: Bank-World is a benchmark of 50 banking tasks across two simulated institutions. Completing banking work requires more than producing the right calculation: agents must reconcile records, obtain permission, execute transactions, and keep instructions and status reports consistent as circumstances change. Bank-World tests these requirements through single-turn assignments and multi-turn interactions with simulated employees who supply information, approve actions, and revise instructions. Grading combines executable checks of recorded actions and state with model judgments of task requirements, including whether valid alternative solutions satisfy them. Across 1,600 attempts by four models, we find that correct decisions often fail to become completed work. Agents charge fees twice, distribute the correct total in incorrect amounts among the recipients, and execute payments while approval is pending. Their strengths also differ: Sol leads single-turn completion, Opus has the highest observed multi-turn completion rate, and Grok succeeds across more multi-turn tasks but less consistently. Bank-World makes these differences inspectable through task-level results and worked examples connecting source evidence, agent decisions, and simulated consequences. We retain the task environments, executable graders, and full trajectories privately to reduce contamination and preserve the benchmark for future evaluations.

AI.tldr: Bank-World 是一个包含 50 项银行任务的基准，跨两个模拟机构，同时考察单轮任务与多轮交互（与模拟员工沟通、审批、修改指令）。评测结合可执行检查（记录的动作与状态）与模型判断（任务要求是否满足，含合理替代解）。1600 次尝试显示：正确决策常未转化为完成的工作，智能体重复收费、金额分配错误、在审批未通过时执行支付；不同模型在单轮/多轮完成率上各有强弱。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多只考核计算或问答正确性，难以反映真实银行工作的要求：需要对账、获取授权、执行交易，并在情况变化时保持指令与状态报告一致。论文希望检验"正确决策"能否真正落地为"完成的工作"，并让不同模型的行为差异可被检视。
AI.method: 构建 Bank-World：50 项银行任务、两个模拟机构；任务形式包括单轮作业与多轮交互（模拟员工提供信息、批准操作、修改指令）；评分采用双重机制——对记录动作与状态的执行式检查，以及模型对任务要求满足度的判断（含对合法替代方案的认可）。对四个模型共 1600 次尝试进行评估，并保留任务环境、执行式评分器与完整轨迹（私有保存以降低污染）。
AI.result: 正确决策常无法转化为完成的工作；典型失败包括重复收费、总额正确但收款人分配金额错误、审批尚未通过即执行支付。模型能力呈现分化：Sol 单轮完成率领先，Opus 观测到的多轮完成率最高，Grok 能成功的多轮任务种类更多但稳定性较差。任务级结果与工作示例可追溯源证据—决策—模拟后果的链条。
AI.conclusion: 银行类任务的核心瓶颈不在计算，而在流程执行与状态一致性；单一"答案正确"指标不足以衡量智能体能力。Bank-World 通过可执行的流程级评分与可检视的轨迹，提供了区分模型长处的细粒度评测框架，并为后续评测保留未公开环境以抑制数据污染。

title: Sparse Autoencoders as Implicit Diversification Regularisers for Cross-Sectional Cryptocurrency Returns
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the 7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF '26)
summary: Factor models are central to asset pricing and portfolio construction, but neural factors are often difficult to interpret, and their effect on portfolio risk is unclear. A sparse autoencoder (SAE) may address both concerns by describing daily returns across many assets with only a few active features. We ask whether this sparse representation produces stable financial factors and better-diversified portfolios. We study cryptocurrency returns, use equities as a secondary test, and compare the SAE with common benchmarks in a time-ordered evaluation. We find consistently lower volatility in SAE portfolios and link this result to lower correlations among the selected assets. However, the SAE does not outperform a simple contrarian strategy on risk-adjusted return, and its factor identities are not stable across training runs. Our contribution is to show that sparse coding can support portfolio diversification, while clearly separating this risk effect from claims about alpha or stable factor identities.

AI.tldr: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）用少量活跃特征刻画多资产日收益，可降低组合波动并改善分散化，但不带来超额收益，因子身份也不稳定。
AI.motivation: 因子模型在资产定价与组合构建中处于核心地位，但神经因子往往缺乏可解释性，且其对组合风险的影响不明确。作者希望检验稀疏自编码器能否同时缓解这两点：以极少数活跃特征描述多资产收益，并考察其是否产生稳定的金融因子与更分散的组合。
AI.method: 采用稀疏自编码器（SAE）对高维资产日收益做稀疏编码，主实验为加密货币收益，股票数据作为次级检验；在严格时间顺序（样本外滚动）评估框架下，将SAE与常见基准（含简单逆向策略）进行对比，并考察组合波动率、所选资产间相关性、风险调整后收益及跨训练随机种子的因子身份稳定性。
AI.result: SAE组合的波动率一致性地更低，该效应可归因于所选资产之间的相关性更低，即实现了更好的分散化；但在风险调整后收益上，SAE未能战胜简单的逆向（contrarian）策略；且因子身份在不同训练运行之间不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏编码可以支撑组合分散化，从而降低风险；但这一风险效应须与关于alpha和稳定因子身份的宣称严格区分。论文的贡献在于清晰界定SAE式稀疏表示的实际价值边界：风险与分散化收益成立，超额收益与可解释性稳定性不成立。

title: DiFuse: Fusing Native Diffusion Representations for Spatial Reasoning in Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) jointly support visual understanding and image generation, yet information flow between these two capabilities remains largely asymmetric: understanding representations routinely condition generation, whereas generative representations are rarely reused for multimodal reasoning. In this work, we investigate whether intermediate representations from a UMM's native diffusion branch can enhance spatial reasoning without compromising general multimodal understanding. We propose DiFuse, which selectively incorporates intermediate diffusion representations into the understanding pathway of UMMs. Through systematic layer-wise analysis, we identify which diffusion representations are most informative and where they can be integrated with minimal interference to semantic processing. Guided by these findings, DiFuse spatially aligns diffusion features with visual tokens and injects them into selected multimodal decoder layers via residual fusion. Extensive experiments on UniWorld-V1 show that, DiFuse consistently improves spatial reasoning over a matched SFT baseline while maintaining broadly comparable performance on general multimodal benchmarks. Further analyses show that these gains depend critically on the choice of diffusion representations, injection positions, and the preservation of spatial correspondence between diffusion features and visual tokens. Results on OmniGen2 further demonstrate the transferability of DiFuse across unified multimodal architectures. Overall, our findings show that native diffusion representations can provide complementary spatial cues for multimodal reasoning when selectively integrated in a structure-preserving manner.

AI.tldr: 提出DiFuse，将统一多模态模型扩散分支的中间表示选择性注入理解通路，以增强空间推理而不损害通用理解。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型中，理解表示普遍用于条件生成，而生成表示很少被复用于多模态推理，信息流呈不对称性；作者希望探究扩散分支中间表示能否在不牺牲通用理解的前提下增强空间推理。
AI.method: 逐层分析确定最具信息量的扩散表示及其最小干扰的注入位置；将扩散特征与视觉token进行空间对齐，并通过残差融合注入选定的多模态解码器层。
AI.result: 在UniWorld-V1上，DiFuse相对匹配的SFT基线稳定提升空间推理，同时通用多模态基准性能大体可比；消融显示增益依赖扩散表示选择、注入位置及空间对应关系保持；在OmniGen2上验证了跨架构可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 以结构保持方式选择性整合原生扩散表示，可为多模态推理提供互补的空间线索。

title: From the Transformer to a Formal Semantics of Coordinated Transformations
comment: v1: 28 pages, 9 sections, this version incorporates revisions made after the first round of peer review
summary: We develop a formal semantics for a general class of coordinated systems of parameterized transformations, taking the Transformer as a paradigmatic starting point but abstracting from its particular mathematical instantiation. Representational vectors receive both extensional reference and ordered intensional interpretations, while parameter structures acquire relative, second-level interpretations that determine how argument properties are preserved, replaced, or combined. This yields the notion of a transforming concept: a parameterized transformation whose numerical action is coordinated with a corresponding property-level map. We then distinguish the common algebraic-semantic core of these systems from their architecture-specific functional organization, allowing different mathematical instantiations and mechanical realizations of the same abstract system type. The framework is applied to attention heads and residual connections, providing semantic explanations that depend only on the shared algebraic-semantic core and their local functional organization and therefore generalize beyond the standard Transformer. These analyses also reveal the modularity of the framework: complex architectures can be decomposed into simpler semantically coordinated subsystems whose organization may recur across different abstract system types.

AI.tldr: 该文为参数化变换的协调系统建立形式语义框架，以Transformer为范例但抽象于具体数学实现，提出"变换概念"概念并应用于注意力头与残差连接。
AI.motivation: 现有对Transformer等系统的分析多依赖其特定数学实现，缺乏能刻画一类协调变换系统的通用语义理论，难以说明语义解释为何可跨不同实现与架构推广。
AI.method: 为表示向量同时赋予外延指称与有序内涵解释；为参数结构赋予相对的二级解释，规定论元属性如何被保持、替换或组合。由此定义"变换概念"——数值作用与属性层面映射相协调的参数化变换。进而区分系统的公共代数-语义内核与架构特定的功能组织，使同一抽象系统类型可有不同数学实例化与机械实现。框架应用于注意力头与残差连接。
AI.result: 给出仅依赖共享代数-语义内核与局部功能组织的语义解释，因而可推广至标准Transformer之外；并揭示框架的模块性：复杂架构可分解为更简单的语义协调子系统，其组织方式可跨不同抽象系统类型复现。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一种实现无关的变换系统形式语义，将语义分析与具体机制解耦，为架构的模块化分解与跨实现推广奠定基础。

title: Where Position Matters: Profiling-Guided Layer-Wise RoPE Allocation in Transformers
summary: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) typically uses uniform coverage across Transformer layers despite heterogeneous positional requirements. Phase-off interventions reveal non-uniform, model-specific rotary-phase dependence, while coverage interventions relate it to coverage-upgrade benefits. We propose profiling-guided layer-wise RoPE allocation, assigning high/low coverage under a fixed budget using early coverage-benefit profiles. The framework supports fixed-width query/key representations and physical rotary-dimension allocation in Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA). Normalized-depth mapping transfers profiles within model families, enabling small-model measurements to guide larger-model allocations before pretraining. A brief analysis relates selection and transfer to score calibration and inter-layer interactions. From-scratch experiments demonstrate validation-loss improvements over available budget-matched baselines, while analytical resource accounting identifies favorable quality--storage--compute trade-offs for physical MLA. These results connect positional demand to transferable, efficient architecture design.

AI.tldr: 提出基于剖析（profiling）的逐层 RoPE 分配框架，按固定预算为不同层分配高/低旋转位置编码覆盖度，并支持在 MLA 中的物理旋转维度分配与跨模型迁移。
AI.motivation: RoPE 通常在所有层采用统一的覆盖度，但不同层对位置信息的需求并不相同；相位干预实验显示存在非均匀、与具体模型相关的旋转相位依赖，覆盖度干预则表明覆盖度提升能带来增益，因此统一配置可能并非最优。
AI.method: 1) 通过相位偏移与覆盖度干预做剖析，刻画逐层位置需求；2) 用早期覆盖度收益剖析，在固定预算下确定各层高/低覆盖度分配；3) 支持固定宽度 query/key 表示，以及在 MLA 中按物理旋转维度分配；4) 采用归一化深度映射，把同族小模型的剖析结果迁移到大模型，在预训练前指导分配；5) 对选择与迁移机制从分数校准和层间交互角度做简要分析。
AI.result: 从零训练实验中，相比预算匹配的基线取得了验证损失改进；解析式资源核算显示，物理 MLA 方案在质量—存储—计算之间具有有利的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 将位置需求显式刻画并转化为可迁移的逐层 RoPE 分配，可连接位置需求与高效架构设计，实现可迁移且资源友好的位置编码配置。

title: UniTele: Learning Device-Conditioned Degradations for Unified Smartphone Telephoto Super-Resolution
summary: Super-telephoto imaging on mobile phones suffers from complex, device-dependent degradations that are poorly captured by conventional handcrafted pipelines. Collecting large-scale aligned training pairs across different phones and diverse scenes, however, is both costly and difficult to scale. We therefore study whether device-specific degradations can be learned from only a small number of physical captures and transferred for training a unified super-resolution (SR) model. Our key idea is to factor degradation learning into two learnable components: one captures the device-specific imaging characteristics under well-resolved conditions, while the other captures the additional information loss and artifacts that arise in super-telephoto imaging. We build a paired benchmark across three phone brands (Huawei, Apple, and vivo) by photographing the same content at two display sizes and zoom settings. The larger displayed image is captured at the phone's maximum optical zoom setting, while the smaller image is photographed directly at the phone's highest native zoom setting through the phone's native imaging pipeline. The benchmark contains 519 training and 60 held-out pairs. We use the benchmark to learn device-specific degradation, then apply it to external images to synthesize thousands of additional pairs to train our UniTele SR model. Relative to the pretrained Qwen and FLUX backbones before adaptation, the full UniTele training recipe substantially improves paired restoration fidelity and perceptual similarity on the held-out benchmark and yields markedly more stable and visually faithful restorations.

AI.tldr: 提出将手机超远摄退化分解为"设备成像特性"与"超远摄附加损失"两个可学习分量，用少量真实拍摄（519训练/60测试对，覆盖华为、苹果、vivo）学到设备相关退化并迁移合成大规模数据，训练统一的 UniTele 超分辨率模型。
AI.motivation: 手机超远摄成像的退化复杂且强依赖具体设备，手工设计的退化管线难以刻画；而跨机型、跨场景采集大规模对齐训练对成本高、难扩展。因此希望仅用少量真实拍摄学习设备相关退化，并迁移用于训练统一的 SR 模型。
AI.method: 构建跨三品牌手机的对齐基准：同一内容以两种显示尺寸与变焦设置拍摄，大图在手机最大光学变焦下摄取，小图直接以最高原生变焦经原生成像管线拍摄。将退化学习解耦为两个可学习分量：一个刻画良好解析条件下的设备成像特性，另一个刻画超远摄条件下的额外信息损失与伪影。用该基准学习设备退化，再作用于外部图像合成数千对数据，训练 UniTele SR 模型。
AI.result: 相对适配前的预训练 Qwen 与 FLUX 骨干，完整 UniTele 训练方案在留出基准上显著提升成对复原保真度与感知相似度，复原结果更稳定、视觉更真实。
AI.conclusion: 少量真实拍摄足以学到可迁移的设备相关退化，用于合成大规模训练数据并训练统一超远摄 SR 模型，是低成本、可扩展的方案。

title: PAPERBENCHX: Can AI Reproduce Science Across Disciplines?
summary: Before AI can be trusted to discover new science, it should be able to reproduce what science already knows. Reproduction provides a rigorous checkpoint for an AI scientist: the target claim is known, yet recovering it still requires translating an incomplete scientific description into an executable experiment and producing evidence that can be independently verified. Existing research-reproduction benchmarks largely focus on AI and machine learning, where experiments share relatively homogeneous software stacks. Extending this capability across scientific disciplines introduces a different challenge: agents must operate domain-specific scientific software, make physical and numerical choices, diagnose long-running computations, and distinguish valid evidence from merely plausible outputs. We introduce PAPERBENCHX, a benchmark of 93 expert-constructed paper-reproduction tasks spanning 12 research areas across electromagnetics, photonics, chemistry, materials science, biology, and robotics. Each task provides the source paper, a public task specification, and a domain-native scientific environment involving specialized scientific software. Agents must reconstruct a key experiment, execute and diagnose it, and deliver a runnable workflow that supports the target scientific claim. To evaluate scientific validity rather than surface-level agreement, we replay every submission from scratch and score only regenerated evidence against expert-validated criteria. Across 10 frontier agent configurations, the best configuration fully reproduces only 14% tasks under the 90% threshold. Meanwhile, mean rubric scores range from 27.53% to 59.08%, indicating that substantial partial progress rarely translates into complete scientific reproduction. These results reveal a large gap between paper understanding and reliably producing reproducible scientific evidence.

AI.tldr: PAPERBENCHX：跨12个研究领域、93个专家构建的论文复现基准，要求智能体在领域原生科学软件环境中重建实验并交付可运行工作流；最佳配置在90%阈值下仅完全复现14%任务。
AI.motivation: 现有复现基准集中于AI/ML领域，实验软件栈相对同质；跨学科复现要求智能体操作领域专用科学软件、做出物理与数值选择、诊断长时间计算，并区分有效证据与仅看似合理的输出，这一能力尚缺乏严格检验。
AI.method: 构建93个专家撰写的复现任务，覆盖电磁、光子、化学、材料、生物、机器人等12个研究领域；每任务提供源论文、公开任务说明与含专用科学软件的领域原生环境。评估时从零重放每份提交，仅对重新生成的证据依据专家验证标准评分，以检验科学有效性而非表面一致。
AI.result: 在10种前沿智能体配置中，最佳配置在90%阈值下仅完全复现14%的任务；平均rubric得分介于27.53%至59.08%，表明大量部分进展很少转化为完整科学复现。
AI.conclusion: 论文理解与可靠产出可复现科学证据之间存在显著鸿沟；复现可作为AI科学家的严格检查点，PAPERBENCHX为跨学科科学智能体能力提供了标准化评测手段。

title: IMRouter: Imbalance-aware Temporal Pattern Routing for LLM-based Time Series Forecasting
summary: Accurate time series forecasting (TSF) is essential for Web applications, such as traffic monitoring and online resource management. Recent advances in leveraging pre-trained large language models (LLMs) have shown promising performance in TSF. However, existing LLM-based TSF methods largely optimize the overall forecasting objective while overlooking temporal pattern imbalance (TPI), where different temporal patterns occur at highly unequal frequencies. Our empirical analysis reveals that TPI is prevalent across widely used TSF benchmarks, with substantially higher forecasting errors on less frequent patterns. To address this issue, we propose IMRouter (Imbalance-aware Temporal Pattern Routing), a novel framework that mitigates TPI-induced biases in both temporal representation learning and cross-modal alignment. Specifically, IMRouter introduces Pattern-Adaptive Temporal Representation Learning (PATR), which leverages gradient conflict and local gradient density to guide expert specialization. By penalizing incompatible expert assignments with density-aware weighting, PATR reduces the dominance of frequent optimization signals in router training. Furthermore, Routing-Guided Semantic Alignment (RGSA) transfers the pattern-specific knowledge learned by the router to cross-modal alignment through mutual information maximization, preserving distinctive temporal information across different patterns. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of IMRouter, particularly in improving forecasting performance on less frequent temporal patterns.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM基时间序列预测中"时序模式不平衡(TPI)"问题，提出IMRouter框架，通过梯度冲突/局部梯度密度引导专家 specialization，并用互信息最大化将路由知识迁移到跨模态对齐，提升低频模式预测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于预训练大语言模型的时间序列预测方法主要优化整体预测目标，忽略了时序模式不平衡(TPI)——不同时序模式出现频率高度不均。实证分析表明TPI在常用TSF基准中普遍存在，且低频模式误差显著更高，导致模型偏向高频模式。
AI.method: IMRouter包含两部分：(1) PATR（模式自适应时序表示学习）：利用梯度冲突与局部梯度密度指导专家(专家路由)的特化，通过密度感知加权惩罚不兼容的专家分配，抑制高频优化信号在路由器训练中的主导地位；(2) RGSA（路由引导的语义对齐）：通过互信息最大化将路由器学到的模式特定知识迁移至跨模态对齐，保留不同模式的独特时序信息。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验验证了IMRouter的有效性，尤其在提升低频时序模式的预测性能方面表现突出。
AI.conclusion: TPI是LLM基TSF中被忽视的关键偏差来源；通过不平衡感知的专家路由与路由引导的跨模态语义对齐，可有效缓解TPI引起的偏差，显著改善低频模式预测表现，为频率不均衡场景下的时间序列预测提供了新思路。

title: FutureWorld: A Plug-and-Play Causal Next-State Predictor for Interactive Video World Exploration
summary: Interactive video world models aim to follow user actions while maintaining scene consistency over extended interactions. History-based methods reuse generated latents to preserve scene content, but three limitations of this reuse contribute to error recirculation. 1) The latent generated at each interaction is retained as history, potentially containing blurred details, geometric distortions, or semantic drift. 2) Although retrieved historical content matches the current scene, it can still contain errors that are carried into the next chunk. 3) New outputs then become history for later interactions, potentially reinforcing the same errors through repeated reuse. To limit this cycle, we aim to predict the future scene state from the current generated latent and the next action before generating the next interaction's video chunk. This future-state prior provides guidance for the next chunk, with the aim of reducing the errors carried forward from history. To this end, we propose a plug-and-play Causal Next-Chunk Predictor (C-NCP) with cross-model adaptability and prediction-guided modulation. We integrate C-NCP into four base generators and evaluate the augmented models across three benchmarks for interactive long-video generation and action-conditioned world modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate reduced error accumulation and improved long-horizon consistency across diverse generation settings. The project page is at https://GuangYuanKK.github.io/futureworld.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用的因果下一分块预测器C-NCP，通过从当前潜变量与下一动作预测未来场景状态作为先验，缓解交互式视频世界模型中的误差再循环，提升长时一致性。
AI.motivation: 历史复用方法依赖生成的潜变量保留场景内容，但存在三重局限导致误差再循环：(1)每步交互生成的潜变量直接作为历史，可能含模糊细节、几何畸变和语义漂移；(2)检索到的历史内容即便与当前场景匹配，其自身误差仍会被带入下一分块；(3)新输出又成为后续历史，重复复用会强化同一误差。
AI.method: 在生成下一交互视频分块之前，先由当前生成潜变量与下一动作预测未来场景状态，形成未来状态先验以引导下一分块生成。据此设计即插即用的Causal Next-Chunk Predictor（C-NCP），具备跨模型适配性与预测引导调制机制，可接入不同基底生成器。
AI.result: 将C-NCP集成到四个基底生成器，在三个基准上评估交互式长视频生成与动作条件世界建模，实验显示误差累积降低、长时一致性提升，且在不同生成设置下均有效。
AI.conclusion: 以预测未来状态先验替代单纯历史复用，可有效切断误差再循环链条；C-NCP的即插即用与跨模型适配性使其具备较好通用性。

title: Finding Is Not Returning, Returning Is Not Reconstructing: A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation of Agent Social Re-entry
summary: As Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly participate in persistent social environments, understanding their long-term social interaction capabilities becomes increasingly important. While existing research has advanced long-term memory and conversational context retrieval, less attention has been paid to whether agents can autonomously re-engage with previously inactive conversations. In particular, remembering a past interaction does not necessarily mean that an agent can identify when to revisit it, decide to return, or reconstruct the context needed for a coherent continuation. To investigate this gap, we introduce agent social re-entry as a multi- dimensional evaluation problem, distinguishing three complementary capabilities: Finding, Returning, and Reconstructing. We develop a shared-snapshot evaluation framework that measures these dimensions independently, allowing us to examine how conversational resurfacing and persistent memory relate to different aspects of social re-entry. Evaluations across six LLM configurations show that resurfacing substantially improves target conversation identification, while persistent memory is associated with higher rates of autonomous target-directed replying. However, neither improvement is accompanied by consistent gains in contextual reconstruction. These results highlight the distinction between accessing previous conversations, choosing to re-engage, and maintaining conversational continuity. Our framework provides a way to evaluate these capabilities separately rather than relying on memory retrieval or conversational response quality alone.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"智能体社交重入"（social re-entry）这一多维评估问题，区分Finding、Returning、Reconstructing三种能力，并设计共享快照评估框架独立度量各维度；实验表明对话重现与持久记忆分别改善目标对话识别与自主定向回复，但均未带来上下文重建的一致提升。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体日益参与持久性社交环境，其长期社交互动能力愈发重要。现有研究多关注长期记忆与对话上下文检索，但较少考察智能体能否自主重新参与既往不活跃的对话。记住过往交互并不等于能识别何时回访、决定返回并重建连贯续接所需上下文，这一空白需要专门评估。
AI.method: 将社交重入形式化为多维评估问题，拆分为Finding（找到目标对话）、Returning（决定并主动返回）与Reconstructing（重建续接所需上下文）三项互补能力；构建共享快照（shared-snapshot）评估框架，在同一快照基础上独立测量各维度，从而分离考察对话重现（resurfacing）与持久记忆对社交重入不同方面的作用；在六种LLM配置上开展评估。
AI.result: 对话重现显著提升目标对话识别能力；持久记忆与更高的自主目标定向回复率相关；但两项改进均未伴随上下文重建能力的一致提升。这表明"访问既往对话""选择重新参与""维持对话连续性"三者相互分离。
AI.conclusion: 社交重入是一个需分维度评估的独立能力问题，不能仅凭记忆检索效果或对话回复质量来推断。所提框架可分别评估Finding、Returning、Reconstructing，为智能体长期社交互动能力提供更细粒度的诊断工具。

title: Strongly Adaptive Online Learning Achieves Uniform Discounted Regret
summary: Discounted regret measures the performance of an online learner by assigning exponentially decaying weights to past losses, reflecting the greater importance of recent losses in non-stationary online learning. While previous work obtains uniform discounted regret bounds over a continuous range of discount factors using a specialized meta-algorithm, its results are limited to convex functions. In this paper, we demonstrate that strongly adaptive regret bounds can directly imply uniform discounted regret guarantees for convex, strongly convex, and exp-concave loss functions. Our key observation is that discounted regret against a fixed comparator admits an exact decomposition into a convex combination of interval regrets. For convex functions, this reduction yields an $O(\sqrt{\log T/(1-λ)})$ discounted regret bound for all discount factors $λ\in(0,1)$, matching the previous rate over a broader range of discount factors. For strongly convex and exp-concave functions, we provide regret bounds of $O\left(\log T\left(1+\log\frac{1}{1-λ}\right)\right)$.

AI.tldr: 本文证明强自适应遗憾界可直接导出凸、强凸与指数凹损失在任意折扣因子下的一致折扣遗憾保证，通过将固定比较器的折扣遗憾精确分解为区间遗憾的凸组合。
AI.motivation: 已有工作借助专门元算法在连续折扣因子范围内获得一致的折扣遗憾界，但仅适用于凸函数，无法覆盖强凸与指数凹情形。
AI.method: 核心观察是固定比较器的折扣遗憾可精确分解为区间遗憾的凸组合；据此将强自适应遗憾界转化为对全部折扣因子 λ∈(0,1) 一致成立的折扣遗憾界。
AI.result: 凸函数得到 O(√(log T/(1−λ))) 的界，与先前速率持平但覆盖更广的折扣因子范围；强凸与指数凹函数得到 O(log T(1+log(1/(1−λ)))) 的界。
AI.conclusion: 强自适应遗憾是导出统一折扣遗憾保证的充分工具，且该归约可自然扩展到强凸与指数凹函数，无需专用元算法。

title: Intrinsic Distribution Matching
summary: One-step and few-step text-to-image generation must accurately render the details specified in the prompt despite limited opportunities for refinement. Distribution matching distillation (DMD) uses score differences to bring the generated distribution closer to a reference distribution. Following prior work, we estimate this difference with internal velocity branches, avoiding a separate fake-score network. We ask whether an explicit moment constraint improves this learned score supervision. A decomposition of the reverse-KL field into a Gaussian moment component and a non-Gaussian residual identifies statistics that can be constrained explicitly. We introduce Intrinsic Distribution Matching (IDM), which retains the full DMD correction and matches feature means and per-coordinate standard deviations using the generator's exponential-moving-average (EMA) copy, requiring no external feature encoder. Experiments use full-parameter and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) tuning on Z-Image-Turbo 6B and Qwen-Image 20B. At two network evaluations, IDM reaches 94.25% and 90.20% on Chinese and English LongText-Bench, the highest scores among the compared methods at this budget. Controlled ablations show gains from the added moment loss, while generator EMA features perform competitively with an external DINOv2 encoder across the five reported metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/inclusionAI/IDM.

AI.tldr: 提出Intrinsic Distribution Matching (IDM)，在DMD的完整校正基础上显式约束特征均值与逐坐标标准差（用生成器EMA副本，无需外部编码器），在两步少步文生图生成中取得领先结果。
AI.motivation: 一步/少步文生图缺少迭代修正机会，须一次准确渲染提示细节；DMD用内部分支估计分数差以对齐参考分布，作者想验证在此弱监督之外显式加入矩约束是否能改进分数监督。
AI.method: 将reverse-KL场分解为高斯矩分量与非高斯残差，识别可显式约束的统计量；IDM保留完整DMD校正，并利用生成器EMA副本匹配特征均值与逐坐标标准差，避免外部特征编码器；在Z-Image-Turbo 6B与Qwen-Image 20B上进行全参数与LoRA微调。
AI.result: 两次网络评估下，IDM在中文与英文LongText-Bench分别达到94.25%与90.20%，为该预算下对比方法最优；消融显示矩损失带来增益，且生成器EMA特征在五项指标上与外部DINOv2编码器表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 显式矩约束可作为DMD分数监督的有效补充，且无需外部编码器的内在特征即可实现竞争性性能，为少步生成蒸馏提供了轻量改进路径。

title: Long-Term Agent Memory through Complementary Curation and Consolidation
summary: Long-horizon dialogue agents require effective memory systems to recall facts, events, and relationships from interaction histories. In this work, we propose a hybrid-memory architecture comprising episodic memories and structured relational memories and a consolidation mechanism which preserves efficiency. We conduct an empirical study across two benchmarks: LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S. Our experiments demonstrate that the two memory types are consistently complementary, combining both outperform state-of-the-art memory frameworks and achieves 90.2% accuracy on LoCoMo and 85.5% on LongMemEval-S.

AI.tldr: 提出一种由情景记忆与结构化关系记忆组成的混合记忆架构及保持效率的记忆巩固机制，在LoCoMo与LongMemEval-S上两类记忆互补，组合后分别达到90.2%与85.5%准确率，优于现有SOTA记忆框架。
AI.motivation: 长时程对话智能体需要有效记忆系统以召回交互历史中的事实、事件与关系，现有单一记忆形式难以同时覆盖这些需求，且需兼顾效率。
AI.method: 设计混合记忆架构：情景记忆＋结构化关系记忆，并配以记忆巩固（consolidation）机制以保持效率；在LoCoMo与LongMemEval-S两个基准上开展实证研究。
AI.result: 两类记忆在不同基准上持续表现出互补性；二者结合优于SOTA记忆框架，LoCoMo准确率90.2%，LongMemEval-S准确率85.5%。
AI.conclusion: 情景记忆与关系记忆的互补组合是长时程对话记忆的有效方案，巩固机制可在不牺牲效率的前提下提升整体召回与准确率。

title: There Is No Free Lunch in RLVR: Every pass@1 Gain Has a pass@k Price
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures. Code and verification package (34/34 automated checks): https://github.com/yliusci/no-free-lunch-rlvr
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) makes a language model solve more problems on the first try and fewer when given many tries: it raises pass@1 while the base model overtakes it at large sampling budget k. Is this a failure of RL to add reasoning, or a transient that more training removes? We settle the question with a theorem. The reversal is a price, and we compute its exact rate.
