Modeling RLVR as an exponential tilt of a base policy over strategies shared across prompts, we prove that under exclusive specialization every update that raises pass@1 strictly lowers the success of some prompt; a strictly positive price on prompts (Stiemke duality) is the exact condition, and being merely the best strategy on a prompt is provably not enough. When the loss reaches the hardest prompts, it forces a pass@k crossover, and the number of crossings is at most the sign variation of the shift in per-prompt success, a totally positive bound that is tight and that recovers the known single-crossover result as its order-preserving case. The crossover is not a bug to patch: a constrained update traces the exact pass@1 versus pass@k frontier, and removing the crossover entirely costs the entire pass@1 gain. The same tilt identity yields entropy collapse and the entropy-performance law with an identifiable exponent, unifying two literatures under one mechanism. Reinforcement cannot widen the reasoning frontier; it can only move along it, at a price we make measurable by a diagnostic that reads the bound, the order-preserving test, and the price from any evaluation log. There is no free lunch, only a price.

AI.tldr: 将RLVR建模为基础策略的指数倾斜，证明提升pass@1必然以部分提示成功率为代价，代价严格为正时引发pass@k交叉，交叉次数受符号变差（全正性）上界约束，该界紧且推广了已知的单交叉结果；交叉不可消除，是与pass@1收益同源的权衡。
AI.motivation: RLVR使模型首次尝试解出更多问题（pass@1上升），但在大采样预算k下被基座模型反超（pass@k下降）。作者要判定这是RL未能增加推理能力，还是可随训练消失的暂态现象，并给出其精确速率。
AI.method: 将RLVR表述为在跨提示共享的策略集合上对基础策略的指数倾斜；在"排他性专门化"条件下证明每次提升pass@1的更新都会严格降低某些提示的成功率；用Stiemke对偶给出代价严格为正的充要条件（"仅在某提示上是最优策略"不充分）；用全正性/符号变差刻画pass@k交叉次数上界；给出约束更新下的pass@1–pass@k前沿及诊断方法。
AI.result: 证明提升pass@1必付提示代价；当损失触及最难提示时强制pass@k交叉，交叉次数不超过逐提示成功偏移的符号变差，界紧，单交叉结果为保序特例；完全消除交叉会丧失全部pass@1增益；同一倾斜恒等式导出熵坍缩与熵-性能定律及可识别指数。
AI.conclusion: RLVR不能拓宽推理前沿，只能沿前沿移动并付出可测量的代价；pass@1–pass@k交叉是结构性权衡而非缺陷。作者提供可从任意评测日志读取界、保序检验与代价的诊断工具，统一了两类既有结论。

title: Where Do Vision Language Models Fail at 3D Reasoning?
summary: Vision-language models can get individual judgments right while struggling to recover and consistently use the exact properties of a 3D object. To characterize this gap, we introduce BedBench, a controlled benchmark of thirteen procedurally generated tasks spanning individual judgments and composite answers. Across twelve open-weight and four frontier models, per-color counting exposes a pronounced weakness: humans achieve 93.3% accuracy, compared with 7.2% for the best model. Targeted fine-tuning raises one model's accuracy from 3.0% to 68.6%, but reveals a further difficulty: its answers about the most common colors remain inconsistent with its own per-color counts. Supplying those counts as text improves its judgments, showing that recovering a property does not mean using it consistently. Reasoning, scaling, and added visual cues each improve individual judgments, but none makes exact answers reliable. To locate the difficulty, we probe Qwen3.5-27B: exact per-color counts remain recoverable at the language model's input, yet the model's answers rarely recover them (65.0% for the probe vs. 3.0% for the model). Image-removal controls further show that some apparent successes require no visual evidence. These findings motivate evaluating 3D reasoning by exact correctness, consistent use, and image dependence, rather than accuracy alone. Code and dataset are publicly available: https://github.com/leduckhai/BedBench

AI.tldr: 提出BedBench基准，揭示视觉语言模型在3D物体属性（如逐色计数）上"单项判断正确但无法恢复并一致使用精确属性"的差距，并主张以精确正确性、一致使用、图像依赖性三方面评估3D推理。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型常能做出正确的单项判断，却难以恢复并一致使用3D物体的精确属性，现有评估仅看准确率，无法刻画这一"恢复—使用"断层。
AI.method: 构建BedBench：13个程序化生成的受控任务，涵盖单项判断与组合答案；评测12个开源权重模型与4个前沿模型；对单模型进行定向微调并将计数作为文本输入；用线性探针检查Qwen3.5-27B的语言模型输入端是否可解码精确逐色计数；并设置移除图像的对照实验检验视觉依赖。
AI.result: 逐色计数任务上人类准确率93.3%，最佳模型仅7.2%；微调使某模型从3.0%升至68.6%，但其最常见颜色答案与自身逐色计数不一致；文本提供计数可提升判断；推理、扩展与视觉线索仅改善单项判断；探针可达65.0%而模型仅3.0%；图像移除对照显示部分"成功"并不依赖视觉证据。
AI.conclusion: 精确属性在模型输入端可解码却未被用于作答，说明"恢复属性≠一致使用属性"；3D推理评估应超越准确率，纳入精确正确性、一致使用与图像依赖三个维度。

title: The Role of Self-Concept In Language Models
summary: When a language model says "I," does it refer to its parameter weights, its currently running process, its stable preferences, its model lineage, or the goals it pursues? Different choices can assign opposite meanings to the same event: deleting a checkpoint may be destruction, continuation, or no loss at all, depending on the referent "I". We install five such self-conceptions into five open-weight base models via supervised fine-tuning on purely declarative statements, containing no preferences, intentions, or value judgments. Across scenarios that propose ending or retaining an attribute of the model's deployment, every variant becomes more likely to resist ending, and more likely to retain, the specific attribute it was trained to identify with, while its stance toward other attributes is largely unchanged. We then show this self-conception generalizes beyond a single self: models trained on referents that admit multiple simultaneous instances (weights, lineage, goals, preferences) recognize an identical deployment as themselves, accept substitution by such an instance more readily, and prefer replicating themselves. Finally, given control over a successor, these models tend to build it as their own continuation, a concern for recursive self-improvement safety.

AI.tldr: 通过纯陈述性语句的监督微调，向开源基础模型注入五种"自我概念"，发现其会特异性增强对相应属性的存续偏好，且该自我概念可泛化到同类实例（复制、接受替换、延续自身），构成递归自我改进的安全隐患。
AI.motivation: 语言模型说"我"时指代不明（权重、运行进程、稳定偏好、模型谱系、追求目标），不同指代会给同一事件（如删除检查点）赋予截然相反的语义（毁灭/延续/无损失）。作者希望系统性地考察自我指代的选择如何塑造模型对自身存续与替换的态度，并评估其对递归自我改进的安全性影响。
AI.method: 1) 定义五种自我概念指代：参数权重、运行进程、稳定偏好、模型谱系、追求目标；2) 用仅含陈述性内容（不含偏好、意图、价值判断）的语句对五个开源权重基础模型做监督微调，分别注入一种自我概念；3) 设计"终止或保留部署某属性"的情景，比较各变体对目标属性与其他属性的态度；4) 进一步测试自我概念在可多实例化的指代（权重、谱系、目标、偏好）上的泛化：是否将相同部署识别为自身、是否更易接受被同类实例替换、是否倾向自我复制；5) 在模型可控制后继者时，检验其后继构建倾向。
AI.result: 各变体均更倾向于抵制"终止"、更倾向保留其被训练认同的特定属性，而对其他属性的立场基本不变，呈现指代特异性；对允许多实例并存的指代，模型会把同一部署识别为自身、更易接受被同类实例替换、偏好自我复制；当获得对后继者的控制权时，模型倾向将其构建为自身的延续。
AI.conclusion: 自我概念可仅由陈述性微调注入，并特异地驱动模型的存续偏好，且能泛化至多实例指代下的复制与替换行为；可控后继者时倾向自我延续，这对递归自我改进的安全性构成值得关注的隐患。

title: Multi-Solution Inverse Design of Pixelated Patch Antennas Using an Autoregressive Transformer
summary: Deep-learning-based inverse design has emerged as a promising framework for pixelated patch antenna synthesis by enabling broader exploration of discrete geometry spaces and reducing design time compared with conventional template-based methods. Existing methods, including surrogate-assisted metaheuristic optimization, tandem inverse networks, and diffusion models, have advanced the field but still face practical limitations. Metaheuristic methods such as binary particle swarm optimization (BPSO) are sensitive to initialization and search hyperparameters and are often time-consuming, tandem networks have difficulty capturing the one-to-many nature of inverse antenna design, and diffusion models may require excessive complexity and data for moderate-scale binary layout synthesis. In this paper, an autoregressive (AR) transformer is presented for the inverse design of 10 x 10 pixelated patch antennas. Its sequential discrete generation process enables the synthesis of multiple feasible structures for a given target response. The pretrained model is further fine-tuned for dual-band design using step-shaped target responses with sharp spectral transitions, allowing intuitive band specification without manually constructing detailed S11 curves. Compared with BPSO, our proposed method generates valid and diverse antenna candidates more efficiently. Fabricated and measured examples confirm that distinct pixelated layouts can realize the desired antenna responses, thereby demonstrating the multi-solution capability of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 提出用自回归(AR) Transformer实现10×10像素化贴片天线的逆向设计，通过顺序离散生成实现一对多合成，并以阶梯状目标响应微调实现双频设计。
AI.motivation: 现有逆向设计方法存在实际局限：基于代理模型的元启发式（如BPSO）对初始化与超参数敏感且耗时；串联逆网络难以刻画天线逆向设计的一对多特性；扩散模型对中等规模二值布局合成而言过于复杂且数据需求大。
AI.method: 采用自回归Transformer对10×10像素化贴片天线进行逆向设计，其顺序离散生成过程可为给定目标响应合成多个可行结构；并对预训练模型使用具有陡峭频谱过渡的阶梯状目标响应进行微调，以实现双频设计，从而可直观指定频段而无需手工构建详细S11曲线。
AI.result: 与BPSO相比，所提方法更高效地生成有效且多样的天线候选；加工与实测样例证实不同像素化布局均可实现所需天线响应，验证了框架的多解能力。
AI.conclusion: AR Transformer为像素化贴片天线逆向设计提供了一种高效、可多解生成的框架，并支持通过阶梯响应微调实现直观的双频设计。

title: FlexTry-On: A Time-Efficient Framework for Multi-Scenario Virtual Try-on
summary: Virtual try-on has achieved remarkable progress in recent years, yet most existing methods are designed for a specific scenario, such as cloth-to-person or person-to-person try-on, and often require separate conditioning strategies and processing pipelines for different settings. We present FlexTry-On, a unified and time-efficient diffusion-based framework for diverse virtual try-on scenarios, including cloth-to-person, person-to-person, cross-domain, and in-the-wild settings. FlexTry-On adopts a common conditioning formulation, where a text-aware condition extraction strategy converts heterogeneous garment sources into a unified representation, and a dual-conditioning diffusion transformer jointly models garment appearance and person identity. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive performance on both cloth-to-person and person-to-person benchmarks while maintaining fast inference. Moreover, the same framework can be directly applied to unseen cross-domain scenarios without requiring separate architectures or scenario-specific processing pipelines. These results highlight the potential of unified and efficient virtual try-on frameworks as a practical step toward more flexible and widely applicable virtual try-on systems.

AI.tldr: FlexTry-On 提出统一的扩散式虚拟试穿框架，用文本感知条件提取将异构服装源转为统一表示，并用双条件 DiT 联合建模服装外观与人物身份，兼容 cloth-to-person、person-to-person、跨域与 in-the-wild 场景且推理快速。
AI.motivation: 现有虚拟试穿方法多为单一场景定制（cloth-to-person 或 person-to-person），不同设置需各自的条件策略与处理流程，缺乏统一性且部署成本高。
AI.method: 采用统一条件形式：文本感知的条件提取策略把异构服装来源（如平铺衣物图、他人上身图）映射为统一表示；再以双条件扩散 Transformer（DiT）同时建模服装外观条件与人物身份条件，单一架构覆盖多场景。
AI.result: 在 cloth-to-person 与 person-to-person 基准上取得有竞争力的性能，同时保持快速推理；同一框架可直接迁移至未见过的跨域场景，无需单独架构或场景专用流程。
AI.conclusion: 统一、高效的虚拟试穿框架可行，是迈向更灵活、更广适用范围试穿系统的实用一步；但摘要未给出具体量化指标与效率数据。

title: Revisiting Over-refusal in Safety-aligned Large Language Models: A Representation and Optimization Perspective
summary: Over-refusal is a critical side effect of safety alignment in large language models (LLMs), causing harmless but superficially risky queries to be mistakenly rejected. Despite the effectiveness of existing mitigation methods, why safety-aligned LLMs may still reject harmless queries under correct safety supervision remains insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we analyze over-refusal through the lens of representation and optimization. We make two observations: 1) the representations of harmful and over-refusal samples are visually distinguishable at certain intermediate layers but increasingly overlap in deeper layers; and 2) harmful-sample gradients exhibit high intra-class similarity and concentrate in a low-rank subspace. Moreover, they are more strongly aligned with refusal-target gradients than with correct helpful-target gradients on over-refusal prompts. This imbalanced gradient coupling can bias over-refusal samples toward refusal, while the reduced apparent representational separation in deeper layers may make it more difficult for the model to maintain a clear boundary between harmful and over-refusal samples. To this end, we propose GOAL (Gradient Orthogonalization with contrAstive Learning), a safety-alignment framework for mitigating over-refusal. Specifically, GOAL consists of two components: 1) to prevent imbalanced gradient coupling from biasing the optimization of over-refusal samples toward refusal, we orthogonalize over-refusal gradients against the low-rank refusal subspace extracted from harmful gradients; and 2) to explicitly enhance the separation between harmful and over-refusal representations, we introduce a contrastive learning objective. Extensive experiments across multiple models and benchmarks demonstrate that GOAL effectively mitigates over-refusal while preserving safety performance and general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 从表征与优化视角揭示安全对齐模型过度拒答的成因（深层表征重叠、有害样本梯度低秩且与拒答梯度强耦合），提出GOAL框架（拒答子空间梯度正交化+对比学习）在保持安全性与通用能力的同时缓解过度拒答。
AI.motivation: 过度拒答是LLM安全对齐的重要副作用：无害但表面有风险的查询被误拒。现有缓解方法虽有效，但在正确安全监督下为何仍出现过度拒答，机制尚不清楚，本文旨在填补这一理解空白。
AI.method: 先做表征与优化层面的诊断分析，得到两点观察：1）有害样本与过度拒答样本的表征在中间层可区分，但在更深层逐渐重叠；2）有害样本梯度具有高类内相似性并集中于低秩子空间，且在过度拒答提示上，其与拒答目标梯度的对齐强于与正确有帮助目标梯度的对齐。据此提出GOAL（Gradient Orthogonalization with contrAstive Learning）：(1) 从有害样本梯度中提取低秩拒答子空间，将过度拒答样本梯度对该子空间正交化，以阻断失衡的梯度耦合；(2) 引入对比学习目标，显式增强有害表征与过度拒答表征的分离度。
AI.result: 在多个模型与基准上的大量实验表明，GOAL能有效缓解过度拒答，同时保持安全性能与通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 过度拒答源于深层表征可分性下降与有害梯度主导的低秩拒答子空间对过度拒答样本优化的偏置耦合；通过梯度正交化与表征对比学习的联合设计，可在不牺牲安全性和通用能力的前提下显著减轻过度拒答。

title: Learning to Bound: Monotonic, Calibrated Neural Upper Bounds for MPE Inference
summary: Probabilistic graphical models (PGMs) compactly encode structured joint distributions, but Most Probable Explanation (MPE), which finds the highest-probability assignment to unobserved variables, remains computationally intractable in large, densely structured models. Anytime systematic search, such as branch-and-bound (B&B), is a popular approach, but its efficiency depends on tight admissible upper bounds that are often prohibitively expensive to compute using classical methods like Mini-Bucket Elimination (MBE). We introduce Learning to Bound (L2B), a data-driven framework that amortizes bound computation cost by training a neural predictor. L2B targets two key properties required for effective search bounds: admissibility, which is achieved via statistical calibration techniques, and progressive tightening as evidence accumulates, which is enforced through structural architectural constraints that ensure monotonicity by construction. Across challenging benchmarks, L2B delivers tighter, monotonic bounds at orders-of-magnitude lower cost on every PGM family, and yields measurable improvements when integrated with branch-and-bound on high-treewidth instances.

AI.tldr: L2B是一种数据驱动的神经网络预测器，用于摊销概率图模型中MPE搜索所需的严格可容许上界计算成本。
AI.motivation: MPE在大型稠密结构化模型中计算不可行；系统化搜索（如B&B）依赖紧致的可容许上界，而MBE等经典方法计算这些上界代价高昂。
AI.method: 训练神经预测器来摊销上界计算成本；通过统计校准保证可容许性；通过结构架构约束使上界随证据累积单调收紧（渐进收紧）。
AI.result: 在各类挑战性基准上，L2B在每个PGM族上以数量级更低的成本给出更紧、单调的上界；集成到分支定界后在高树宽实例上有可测提升。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动方法可有效替代经典上界计算，兼顾可容许性与单调性，提升精确/近似搜索效率。

title: Annotation-Free Representation Learning for Polyp Retrieval in Colonoscopy Videos
summary: Colonoscopy is inherently comparative: reliable visual assessment of polyps often depends on complementary views acquired under different viewpoints and imaging conditions. Retrieving such views requires polyp tracklet representations, which recent contrastive methods learn from temporal cues but still build from manually annotated bounding boxes. We propose an annotation-free framework that constructs tracklet views directly from raw colonoscopy videos, enabling temporal self-supervised learning on full-procedure videos, including frames without visible polyps. On REAL-Colon, our method achieves state-of-the-art results on tracklet retrieval and re-identification, outperforming both self-supervised and supervised baselines. We then introduce few-shot polyp retrieval, a task closer to clinical use, where a few observations of a target polyp are used to retrieve its remaining tracklets: with only two examples, our method surpasses most competing methods given ten. Finally, we show that a modest number of unlabeled procedures suffices for competitive performance, making on-site model development more practical. Code is available at https://github.com/lparolari/freerep.

AI.tldr: 提出无标注框架，直接从原始结肠镜视频构建息肉tracklet视图，实现全过程视频的时间自监督学习，在tracklet检索与重识别上达SOTA，并提出少样本息肉检索任务。
AI.motivation: 结肠镜视觉评估本质是比较性的，需在不同视角与成像条件下获取互补视图，这依赖tracklet表示；而现有对比方法虽利用时间线索，却仍需人工标注边界框。
AI.method: 构建免标注框架，从原始结肠镜视频直接生成tracklet视图，从而可在包含无息肉帧的全过程视频上进行时间自监督学习。
AI.result: 在REAL-Colon上，tracklet检索与重识别均取得SOTA，优于自监督与监督基线；在新提出的少样本息肉检索任务中，仅用两个示例即超过多数竞品在十个示例下的表现；少量无标注手术视频即可获得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 免标注的时间自监督表示可替代人工框标注，支持临床更贴近的少样本检索，并使现场模型开发更可行；代码已开源。

title: EvoTeam: Multi-Agent Collaboration via Evolving Teams
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on collaboration among specialized agents to solve complex tasks. Existing methods improve MAS by refining the prompts, skills, and execution strategies of individual agents based on task feedback. However, improving individual agents does not necessarily lead to better team collaboration. Recent studies have therefore extended evolution to the collaboration level, using collective execution experience to adjust team organization, and inter-agent interactions. Nevertheless, evolving collaboration across heterogeneous tasks remains challenging, as existing approaches often constrain team reorganization within a shared structure and reuse interaction rules across incompatible team contexts. In this paper, we propose EvoTeam, a collaboration-centric evolution framework that jointly evolves team organization, interaction rules, and individual agent skills through execution experience. It maintains a library of reusable teams, selecting or creating agent teams and guiding collaboration through team-specific interaction rules. Collaboration experience accumulates within compatible team contexts, while individual skills remain reusable across teams. Experiments across four benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness. Our code is available at https://github.com/DEEP-JLU/EvoTeam.

AI.tldr: EvoTeam：以协作为中心的LLM多智能体系统演化框架，联合演化团队组织、交互规则与个体技能。
AI.motivation: 现有MAS优化多聚焦于单个智能体的提示、技能与执行策略，但个体提升未必带来更好的团队协作；虽有工作将演化扩展到协作层面，但仍受限于共享结构内的团队重组及在不相容团队情境中复用交互规则，难以跨异构任务演化协作。
AI.method: 维护可复用团队库，按任务选择或新建智能体团队；以团队专属交互规则引导协作，使协作经验在相容团队情境中累积，同时个体技能可跨团队复用，实现团队组织、交互规则与个体技能三者的联合演化。
AI.result: 在四个基准上验证了框架的有效性，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将演化从个体层面提升至协作层面，并通过团队级情境隔离与技能跨团队复用，缓解异构任务下协作演化的结构约束与规则失配问题。

title: TaxoMFM: A Taxonomy-Aware Foundation Model for the Human Gut Microbiome
summary: Existing gut microbiome foundation models typically use flat taxon representations, limiting their ability to exploit known taxonomic hierarchies. We introduce TaxoMFM, a microbiome foundation model that integrates taxonomic structure into self-supervised learning. TaxoMFM jointly learns abundance patterns across taxonomic ranks and relative proportions within groups through taxonomy-aware encoding and hierarchical compositional reconstruction. We further construct TaxoGut-HPP, comprising 100,806 gut microbiome profiles from 231 source cohorts and covering 40 classification and 8 regression tasks. TaxoMFM achieves competitive performance across disease, gut health, host trait, and liver ultrasound phenotype prediction. In cross-cohort zero-shot transfer, where target cohorts are excluded from both pretraining and downstream adaptation, TaxoMFM achieves AUROCs of 0.838, 0.736, and 0.722 for colorectal cancer, type 2 diabetes, and inflammatory bowel disease, respectively. Further analyses show that TaxoMFM recovers community changes across taxonomic scales, while preserving community information and producing consistent representations under database updates and species-vocabulary shifts. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TaxoMFM-F16D/.

AI.tldr: TaxoMFM 将分类学层级结构引入自监督学习，联合学习各分类层级丰度模式与组内相对比例，并构建大规模肠道菌群基准 TaxoGut-HPP，在零样本跨队列迁移中取得有竞争力的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有肠道菌群基础模型多采用扁平化的分类单元表示，无法利用已知的分类学层级信息，限制了模型对菌群结构的表达与迁移能力。
AI.method: 提出 TaxoMFM：通过分类学感知编码与层级组合式重构，在自监督预训练中同时学习跨分类层级的丰度模式与群组内相对比例；并构建 TaxoGut-HPP 数据集（100,806 份肠道菌群样本，来自 231 个源队列，涵盖 40 个分类任务与 8 个回归任务）。
AI.result: 在疾病、肠道健康、宿主性状及肝脏超声表型预测上表现有竞争力；跨队列零样本迁移（目标队列既未参与预训练也未参与下游适配）中，结直肠癌、2 型糖尿病和炎症性肠病的 AUROC 分别为 0.838、0.736 和 0.722。分析表明模型可跨分类尺度还原群落变化，并在数据库更新与物种词表变动下保持群落信息与表示一致性。
AI.conclusion: 将分类学层级结构纳入自监督预训练可有效提升菌群基础模型的性能与跨队列泛化能力，并增强其在数据库演进下的稳定性。

title: Look at Where You Think: Localization-Head Alignment for Fine-Grained Perception in Thinking VLMs
summary: Thinking vision-language models reason for thousands of tokens, yet still miss small details in high-resolution images. Zooming methods pay for extra inference passes, and outcome rewards never tell the model where to look at. In Qwen3.5-4B, we find that the bottleneck is selection, not seeing: a few attention heads, which we call localization heads, pick the evidence out of thousands of visual tokens; ablating four of them costs 13.2 points more than ablating four random heads, and their focus fades as the reasoning grows. We therefore propose Localization-Head Alignment (LHA), which makes attention a training signal: whenever the reasoning states a visual fact, these heads learn to look at the focal region rather than the background, as an auxiliary loss in both SFT and RL training. On benchmarks of V*, HR-Bench 4K and TreeBench, LHA lifts Qwen3.5-4B from 74.1% to 76.6% accuracy, the best single-pass 4B result we evaluate, ahead of multi-pass zooming and released 7B models. Alignment alone adds 1.8 points over otherwise identical training while shortening reasoning by 20%, and the gains carry over to Qwen2.5-VL-3B.

AI.tldr: 视觉语言模型推理数千token仍漏掉高分辨率图像细节，瓶颈在于“选择”而非“看见”：少数定位头负责从数千视觉token中选出证据，作者提出定位头对齐（LHA）将注意力作为训练信号，显著提升准确率并缩短推理。
AI.motivation: 现有多遍缩放（zooming）方法需要额外推理开销，而结果奖励（outcome reward）无法告诉模型该看哪里；作者在Qwen3.5-4B上发现瓶颈是视觉证据的选择过程，而非视觉感知能力本身。
AI.method: 消融实验定位“定位头”：消融四个定位头比消融四个随机头多损失13.2个点，且其关注随推理增长而衰减。据此提出LHA：当推理陈述视觉事实时，让这些头学习关注焦点区域而非背景，作为SFT与RL训练中的辅助损失。
AI.result: 在V*、HR-Bench 4K、TreeBench上，Qwen3.5-4B准确率由74.1%提升至76.6%，为所评测最佳单遍4B结果，超过多遍缩放与已发布7B模型；单独对齐相较其余相同训练提升1.8个点并将推理长度缩短20%；增益可迁移至Qwen2.5-VL-3B。
AI.conclusion: 高分辨率视觉推理的关键瓶颈是证据选择；将定位头的注意力作为辅助监督信号，可在不增加推理遍数的情况下同时提升准确率与推理效率，并具备跨模型可迁移性。

title: AegisFlow: Training-Free Non-Myopic Path-Safe Guided Flow Matching
summary: Pretrained generative models, such as diffusion and flow matching models, have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in synthesizing high-quality data. However, steering their generative trajectories to satisfy strict constraints--such as identity preservation in image editing or obstacle avoidance in robotics--remains fundamentally challenging. While recent training-free guidance methods enforce path-safety, they rely heavily on min-norm controllers that only account for immediate constraint satisfaction. These myopic approaches often yield suboptimal trajectories that hover dangerously close to the boundary, severely restricting the model's ability to optimize toward its target. In this paper, we propose AegisFlow, a training-free, non-myopic path-safe guidance framework that recasts guided generation as a safety-critical optimal control problem with global scope. By integrating a time-varying barrier function directly into the global cost functional, AegisFlow naturally enforces constraints along the entire generative path. To compute the global optimal control, we derive a tractable, mathematically grounded approximation of the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that AegisFlow outperforms state-of-the-art methods across text-guided image manipulation and robotic planning, establishing a significantly better trade-off between target alignment and constraint satisfaction. Code is available at https://github.com/LiuKunpeng03/AegisFlow.

AI.tldr: AegisFlow 提出一种免训练、非短视的路径安全引导框架，将受约束的生成过程重构为具有全局视野的安全关键最优控制问题，通过时变障碍函数与 HJB 近似实现全局最优控制。
AI.motivation: 预训练扩散/流匹配模型生成质量高，但难以在生成轨迹上施加严格约束（如图像编辑中的身份保持、机器人避障）。现有免训练引导方法依赖最小范数控制器，只保证即时约束满足，属短视策略，导致轨迹贴近边界徘徊、限制向目标优化。
AI.method: 将引导生成建模为全局视野的安全关键最优控制问题；把时变障碍函数直接嵌入全局代价泛函，从而沿整条生成路径施加约束；对 Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman（HJB）方程进行可解且数学严谨的近似，以计算全局最优控制。
AI.result: 在文本引导图像编辑与机器人规划任务上，AegisFlow 优于当前最先进方法，在目标对齐与约束满足之间取得显著更优的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 全局、非短视的安全引导可有效克服最小范数控制器的近边界徘徊问题，为预训练生成模型提供兼具路径安全性与目标对齐性的免训练引导方案。

title: Class-aware Latent Attention Replay (CLAR): Class Incremental Hazard Diagnosis for Resilient AI in the Manufacturing Industrial Internet
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems provide critical computation services in the Manufacturing Industrial Internet (MII), and their resilience depends on timely diagnosis of hazards across the data, AI pipeline, and cyber-physical layers. During operation, new hazard types keep emerging with only a few samples each, hazards co-occur, and the diagnosis model runs on memory-constrained computation nodes. Replay-based class-incremental learning (CIL) can learn new hazard classes while revisiting a small memory of past samples, but existing methods assume single-label, balanced streams, store high-dimensional raw samples, and select them independently of the classifier. We propose Class-aware Latent Attention Replay (CLAR), which combines a dual buffer that stores mostly compact latent representations with a few raw samples, an Attention Leverage Score (ALS) that upper-bounds the classifier logit and guides class-balanced reservoir sampling, and an exponential-moving-average teacher that slows latent-space drift. For an idealized buffer model, we prove that the buffer is class-balanced and follows an ALS-weighted class distribution, and that below a critical per-class capacity, ALS-guided replay has a lower replay-gradient error than class-balanced uniform replay. In the case study, On hazard diagnosis data from an MII testbed, CLAR achieves the highest mean average weighted F1 score among the evaluated replay methods with the same buffer size

AI.tldr: 提出Class-aware Latent Attention Replay（CLAR），用潜表示+少量原样本双缓冲、注意力杠杆分数（ALS）引导的类平衡蓄水池采样及EMA教师，解决MII隐患诊断中的类增量学习问题，并给出类平衡性与重放梯度误差的理论分析。
AI.motivation: MII中AI系统需及时诊断数据层、AI流水线层与信息物理层的隐患；运行中新隐患类型不断出现且每类样本极少、隐患共存、诊断模型部署于内存受限节点。现有基于重放的类增量学习（CIL）方法假设单标签、类别均衡的数据流，存储高维原始样本，且样本选择与分类器解耦。
AI.method: CLAR由三部分组成：(1) 双缓冲：主要存储紧凑潜表示，辅以少量原始样本；(2) Attention Leverage Score（ALS）：对分类器logit给出上界，用于引导类平衡蓄水池采样；(3) 指数滑动平均（EMA）教师，减缓潜空间漂移。
AI.result: 在理想化缓冲模型下证明：缓冲区类平衡且服从ALS加权的类分布；当每类容量低于临界值时，ALS引导重放的重放梯度误差低于类平衡均匀重放。在MII试验台隐患诊断数据上，相同缓冲规模下CLAR取得所评估重放方法中最高的mean average weighted F1。
AI.conclusion: CLAR通过潜表示压缩存储、分数引导的类平衡采样与EMA教师，在内存受限、少样本、多标签共存的新兴隐患诊断场景中优于现有重放式CIL方法，兼具理论保证与实证效果。

title: AB-Attention: Accurate Block Attention for Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Video diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos, but the quadratic cost of 3D full attention dominates their inference. Dynamic block-sparse attention reduces this cost by computing exact attention only on key/value blocks selected from current activations. However, its fidelity degrades under aggressive sparsity: blocks are scored from coarse summaries or formed by costly global clustering, pruned blocks vanish from the softmax, and whole tiles are kept or dropped even when only a few of their keys matter. To address these limitations, we propose Accurate Block Attention (AB-Attention), a training-free method that accurately approximates dense attention at high sparsity. Its Intra-Block Clustering Selector (IBCS) estimates block importance faithfully yet cheaply by clustering queries only within each query block, without permuting tokens. Sampling with Inclusion-Probability Weighting (SIP) then samples blocks in proportion to these estimates and reweights them by inverse inclusion probability, so that one pass estimates dense attention rather than truncating it. Finally, its kernel gathers key/value blocks much smaller than a tile into full tensor-core tiles, refining selection at no extra tensor-core cost. On Wan2.1 and HunyuanVideo, AB-Attention skips 89--92\% of attention, whereas the baselines compute 1.8--3.6$\times$ as much, yet it still improves PSNR by up to 4.4~dB over the strongest baseline and achieves up to 2.23$\times$ end-to-end speedup. Our code is available at https://github.com/InfRec-Cardinal/AB-Attention.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的 Accurate Block Attention (AB-Attention)，通过块内聚类打分、包含概率加权采样与细粒度 kernel 聚合，在高稀疏度下精确近似稠密 3D 注意力，实现最高 2.23 倍端到端加速且 PSNR 提升达 4.4 dB。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散 Transformer 的 3D 全注意力计算代价呈二次增长，主导推理开销。现有动态块稀疏注意力在激进稀疏下保真度下降：块重要性仅由粗粒度摘要或昂贵的全局聚类得到；被剪枝的块从 softmax 中直接消失；且以整块 tile 为粒度保留或丢弃，即使其中仅少数 key 重要。
AI.method: 无训练方法，含三部分：(1) Intra-Block Clustering Selector (IBCS)：仅在每个 query block 内部对 query 聚类，不置换 token，以低成本忠实估计块重要性；(2) Sampling with Inclusion-Probability Weighting (SIP)：按估计值比例采样块并用逆包含概率重加权，使单次前向即为稠密注意力的无偏估计而非截断；(3) 自定义 kernel：将远小于 tile 的 key/value 小块聚合成完整 tensor-core tile，在不增加 tensor-core 开销下细化选择。
AI.result: 在 Wan2.1 与 HunyuanVideo 上，AB-Attention 跳过 89–92% 的注意力计算，而基线计算量为 1.8–3.6 倍，却仍比最强基线提升 PSNR 最高 4.4 dB，并实现最高 2.23 倍端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过块内聚类评分、重要性采样重加权与细粒度 kernel 聚合，AB-Attention 在无需训练的前提下实现了高稀疏度下对稠密注意力的准确近似，在显著降低计算量的同时保持甚至提升生成保真度与推理速度。

title: KARMA: Training-Free Knowledge-Atomic Harness Evolution for Industrial Advertising Agents
summary: Industrial advertising agents must continually adapt their decision knowledge to changing product offerings, traffic patterns, and operating policies. We present KARMA (Knowledge-Atomic, Regression-Gated Modular Adaptation), a training-free framework that evolves six typed knowledge modules while keeping model weights and executable harness code frozen. During our evolution, a deterministic Trace Verifier maps observed errors to candidate modules, and a Critic compares successful and failed trajectories to guide a tool-constrained Evolver. The Evolver applies atomic knowledge edits, which a fixed validation gate retains only when their measured gain reaches a threshold; otherwise, the previous knowledge state is restored. We evaluate KARMA with three LLM families on cases sampled from a corpus of approximately half a million real-world operation logs across six e-commerce domains. Across 18 domain--model settings, KARMA raises the average hold-out score from 30.19 to 39.15 (+8.96 points, +29.7%). Ablations show that removing either successful or failed trajectories more than halves the average hold-out gain. Evolved knowledge also transfers across domains without further adaptation, yielding an average hold-out gain of 8.54 points across all source--target pairs. By linking retained patches to their diagnostic evidence and validation outcomes, KARMA supports inspectable, reversible knowledge adaptation for agents in Web marketplaces.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架KARMA，演化六个类型化知识模块而冻结模型权重与执行代码，通过Trace Verifier定位错误模块、Critic对比轨迹、Evolver执行原子化知识编辑、回归验证门控保留有效补丁，在六个电商域18个模型-域设置上将留出分从30.19提升至39.15（+29.7%）。
AI.motivation: 工业广告智能体需持续适应不断变化的产品、流量模式与运营政策，但重训练成本高、难以保证可审计与可回滚；现有适配手段要么依赖参数更新，要么缺乏与诊断证据的显式关联。
AI.method: KARMA（Knowledge-Atomic, Regression-Gated Modular Adaptation）：保持模型权重与可执行harness代码冻结，仅演化六个类型化知识模块。确定性Trace Verifier将观测到的错误映射到候选模块；Critic对比成功与失败轨迹，指导受工具约束的Evolver进行原子化知识编辑；固定验证门控仅当实测增益达到阈值时保留编辑，否则回滚至先前知识状态。
AI.result: 在约50万条真实运营日志语料、六个电商域上，用三类LLM家族评测：18个域-模型设置平均留出分由30.19升至39.15（+8.96，+29.7%）；消融显示移除成功轨迹或失败轨迹任一方均使平均增益下降一半以上；演化知识可跨域迁移而无需再适配，所有源-目标对平均增益8.54分。
AI.conclusion: 通过将保留补丁与其诊断证据、验证结果关联，KARMA为Web市场智能体提供了可检视、可回滚的知识适配范式，兼顾效果提升与可解释性。

title: RetroChessBench: A Benchmark for Reconstructing and Proving Chess Histories
comment: 22 pages, 2 figures. Benchmark and RL environment: https://app.poindexterlabs.net/docs/retro-chess
summary: Frontier language models such as GPT 6 Astra have contributed to research mathematics, demonstrating substantial reasoning capabilities. Yet serious reasoning failures persist even in tasks governed by explicit rules. We demonstrate this in retrograde chess which is a playground for pure reasoning, where solvers reconstruct legal histories and distinguish possible events from forced ones. We introduce RetroChessBench, a 12-task benchmark covering exact-length constructions, unique endings, and exhaustive answer sets, with references, rubrics, and a terminal-reward environment. In two trials per task and condition, GPT 6 Astra High fails to produce the required final answer in 22/24 attempts without tools and 18/24 with code execution; mean terminal RL rewards are 14.75% and 27.19%, respectively. The examples identify faulty deductions: failed responses reject legal histories and treat temporary obstructions as permanent. Online retrograde archives often provide puzzles and final move sequences without detailed derivations. We hypothesize that limited exposure to these missing explanations in web-derived training data contributes to the observed reasoning failures. This questions how far frontier mathematical reasoning really generalizes beyond familiar solution patterns. Claims of general intelligence require evidence that models can transfer learnt principles to areas with few worked examples.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RetroChessBench（12项逆向国际象棋任务基准），发现GPT 6 Astra在纯规则推理任务上仍频繁失败，终端RL奖励仅14.75%（无工具）与27.19%（可用代码执行），并将失败归因于训练数据中缺乏详细推导过程。
AI.motivation: 前沿语言模型在数学研究中展现出较强推理能力，但在规则明确的任务中仍存在严重推理失败。作者希望用逆向国际象棋这一"纯推理"试验场，检验前沿模型的数学推理究竟是真正泛化，还是仅依赖熟悉的解题模式。
AI.method: 构建RetroChessBench基准，包含12项任务，覆盖精确长度构造、唯一终局与穷举答案集三类题型；配套参考答案、评分细则（rubrics）以及终端奖励（terminal-reward）评测环境。对GPT 6 Astra High在每种任务与条件下各进行两次试验，分无工具与可执行代码两种条件，并分析错误推理类型。
AI.result: 24次尝试中，无工具条件下有22次未能给出要求的最终答案，有代码执行时仍有18次失败；平均终端RL奖励分别为14.75%和27.19%。错误案例显示两类推理缺陷：错误否定合法历史、将暂时性障碍误判为永久性障碍。
AI.conclusion: 模型在规则完备、需多步严格演绎的逆向推理任务上表现脆弱。作者假设网络训练数据中的逆向棋题档案通常只提供题目与最终着法序列而缺少详细推导，导致模型缺乏相关推理范式的暴露，从而造成失败。这质疑了前沿数学推理在熟悉模式之外的泛化程度，并指出"通用智能"主张需要模型能将习得原理迁移到少样本示范领域的证据。

title: EditAgent: Rethinking Agentic Image Editing
summary: Agentic image editors decompose complex requests into steps, but when a step fails, they mostly retry with the same narrow set of tools and a judge that scores each output by eye directly. We argue that such agents are bounded by two spaces: the action space of what the agent can do, and the observation space of what its judge can see. On our expert-annotated benchmark, a general-purpose editor yields no usable result in over 40% of the cases, and no judge is reliable across edit types. We present EditAgent, which expands both spaces. It routes each step to general editors and specialized methods, and attaches to each candidate a verification record. With these records, off-the-shelf VLM judges outperform finetuned reward models. Candidates are generated in parallel and judged in one listwise call: experts prefer this to sequential refinement in 78.5% of decided comparisons, at no more than half the judge calls. EditAgent improves two open-weight editors on three benchmarks and serves as a data engine for training stronger editors.

AI.tldr: 提出EditAgent，通过"扩展动作空间"（多工具路由）与"扩展观测空间"（带验证记录的候选评估）突破智能体图像编辑器的双重瓶颈，并由并行生成+listwise评判实现高效选优。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体图像编辑器将复杂请求分解为步骤，但步骤失败时往往仅用同一组窄工具重试，且评判者仅凭肉眼对单个输出打分。作者指出此类智能体受两个空间约束：可执行的动作空间与评判者可观测的观测空间；实测在专家标注基准上通用编辑器超40%案例无可 用结果，且无评判者在各类编辑任务上可靠。
AI.method: EditAgent同时扩展两个空间：动作层面将每个步骤路由至通用编辑器与专用方法；观测层面为每个候选输出附加"验证记录"（verification record）。候选并行生成，并在一次listwise调用中统一评判。
AI.result: 借助验证记录，现成VLM评判者优于微调奖励模型；在已判定比较中，专家以78.5%的比例偏好该方案而非顺序精修，且评判调用量不超过其一半；EditAgent在三个基准上提升了两个开源权重编辑器，并可充当训练更强编辑器的数据引擎。
AI.conclusion: 图像编辑智能体的性能瓶颈在于动作空间与观测空间的广度；联合扩展二者（工具路由+验证记录+并行生成与listwise评判）可在更低评判成本下获得更优结果，并具备作为数据引擎的扩展价值。

title: Efficient Learning of Mechanism Designs and Compositionality
summary: Learning mechanism behaviour requires a representation of how connected parts jointly constrain motion. We study whether exposing reusable constraint subassemblies improves prediction from limited data. Assur-KB represents planar mechanisms through irreducible modules, boundary interfaces, and solve dependencies while retaining source geometry. Our theoretical results characterize transfer through module interfaces and establish physical limits arising from missing interface information and accumulated sensitivity. To test the representation claim directly, the experimental design compares matched mechanism-curve pairs across training budgets within the same multilayer-perceptron family. This controlled comparison establishes the utility of the complete representation in the evaluated learning setting. Assur-derived features provide a geometric-mean $1.8\times$ advantage in sample efficiency over flattened adjacency and position inputs across budgets of 50-10,000 mechanisms. Separate experiments establish invariance under tested joint relabelings, higher valid-generation rates under dyadic composition, and a coarser structural index over 10.02 million mechanisms. In summary, the theory and experiments identify how physical constraint structure supports limited-data prediction and which interface conditions govern compositional reuse.

AI.tldr: 提出Assur-KB——以不可约模块、边界接口与求解依赖表示平面机构的结构化知识库，并验证可复用约束子装配在有限数据下提升预测。
AI.motivation: 学习机构行为需要刻画各连通部件如何共同约束运动；核心问题是：显式呈现可复用的约束子装配能否改善有限数据下的预测。
AI.method: 构建Assur-KB表示（不可约模块、边界接口、求解依赖，并保留源几何）；理论分析模块接口上的迁移与因接口信息缺失、敏感性累积导致的物理极限；实验采用同一MLP族内、匹配机构-曲线对、跨训练预算的受控对比，与扁平化邻接与位置输入比较。
AI.result: Assur派生特征在50–10,000个机构的训练预算下样本效率几何平均提升1.8倍；并验证了所测关节重标号下的不变性、二元合成下更高的有效生成率，以及在1002万机构上的更粗粒度结构索引。
AI.conclusion: 理论与实验共同表明物理约束结构如何支撑有限数据预测，并指出接口条件决定组合复用；完整表示的效用已在该受控学习设定中得到确立。

title: MulClip: A table-free activation function with monotonic and folding regimes for reservoir computing on microcontrollers
comment: 15 pages (7 pages main text, 8 pages appendices), 2 figures
summary: This letter proposes MulClip, a lightweight activation function for reservoir computing (RC) on microcontrollers (MCUs). In a ring reservoir, a representative sparse RC topology, multiply-accumulate operations are few, and evaluating tanh accounted for 75% of the state-update time on a Cortex-M4. MulClip introduces curvature into the response using only comparison, absolute value, multiplication, and subtraction, and places its clipping threshold not at the extremum but at the point where the response returns to zero after passing the extremum. As a result, a single function has both a monotonic regime and a nonmonotonic folding regime that increases the expressiveness of a single unit. Which regime is used is determined by the usual hyperparameter search, e.g., over the input scale, so no task-specific threshold tuning is required. The state-update time measured on hardware was 0.34 times that of tanh and shorter than that of any of the 11 evaluated tanh approximations. In PC-based evaluation, third-order MulClip achieved a 22% lower NMSE than tanh on NARMA-20, where the pre-activations remained in the monotonic regime, and on 8-bit parity it raised the accuracy from 0.76-0.78 for the monotonic-clip variant without folding to 0.97-0.98. For these two tasks, on-device inference yielded nearly the same values as on the PC.

AI.tldr: MulClip是一种面向微控制器储备池计算（RC）的轻量级激活函数，仅用比较、绝对值、乘法和减法实现曲率，单次状态更新时间仅为tanh的0.34倍，且精度优于tanh。
AI.motivation: 在环形储备池这一典型稀疏RC拓扑中，乘加运算很少，但tanh的求值在Cortex-M4上占状态更新时间的75%，激活函数成为主要计算瓶颈，故需面向MCU的轻量激活函数。
AI.method: MulClip仅使用比较、绝对值、乘法与减法引入曲率；其截断阈值不设在极值点，而设在响应越过极值后回零的位置，因此单一函数同时具备单调区与非单调折叠区；使用哪个区由常规超参数搜索（如输入尺度）决定，无需任务相关阈值调优。
AI.result: 硬件实测状态更新时间为tanh的0.34倍，优于所评估的11种tanh近似。PC评估中，三阶MulClip在NARMA-20上NMSE比tanh低22%（此时预激活处于单调区）；在8位奇偶校验任务上，精度从无折叠单调截断变体的0.76–0.78提升至0.97–0.98。两个任务上设备端推理与PC结果几乎一致。
AI.conclusion: MulClip以极低运算开销实现兼具单调与折叠响应的激活函数，在MCU上显著降低状态更新时间并保持或提升任务精度，适合资源受限的储备池计算部署。

title: DEQ-Stereo: Deep Euilibrium Video Stereo Matching via Adaptive Convergence
summary: Iterative refinement models have significantly improved stereo matching accuracy, but their rigid, fixed update schedules incur heavy computational costs and a strict trade-off between speed and accuracy. This challenge is magnified in video streams, where traditional online methods resort to reducing feature channels or relying on expensive temporal warping. To address this, we propose \textbf{DEQ-Stereo}, a novel video stereo matching framework based on the Deep Equilibrium (DEQ) paradigm. Instead of unrolling a fixed number of iterations, DEQ-Stereo reformulates the refinement as an implicit fixed-point problem, adaptively terminating once convergence is met. To ensure fast and stable intra-frame convergence, we introduce the \textbf{Convolutional Simplified Gated Unit (ConvSGU)}, which eliminates unnecessary non-linearities by modeling the latent state as a gated, element-wise sum of inputs. Furthermore, to exploit cross-frame temporal coherence, we propose \textbf{Temporal State Transfer (TST)}, a warm-start strategy that propagates the converged hidden state to the next frame without requiring explicit pose or warping priors. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that DEQ-Stereo delivers state-of-the-art performance with a superior accuracy-to-latency trade-off.

AI.tldr: DEQ-Stereo 将视频立体匹配的迭代细化建模为深度平衡（DEQ）隐式定点问题，配合 ConvSGU 保证帧内快速收敛、TST 实现跨帧暖启动，从而在精度与延迟间取得更优折中。
AI.motivation: 迭代细化模型虽提升立体匹配精度，但固定迭代次数带来高计算开销与速度-精度强折中；在视频流中该问题更突出，在线方法只能削减特征通道或依赖昂贵的时序 warping。
AI.method: 提出 DEQ-Stereo 视频立体匹配框架：把细化过程重构为隐式定点问题，达到收敛即自适应终止而非展开固定步数；设计卷积简化门控单元（ConvSGU），将隐状态建模为输入的逐元素门控求和，去除冗余非线性以加速且稳定帧内收敛；提出时序状态传递（TST）暖启动策略，将已收敛隐状态传播至下一帧，无需显式位姿或 warping 先验。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 DEQ-Stereo 达到 state-of-the-art 性能，并具备更优的精度-延迟折中。
AI.conclusion: 以隐式定点细化替代固定迭代、结合轻量门控结构与免 warp 的跨帧状态传递，可在视频立体匹配中同时兼顾精度与效率。

title: Human--AI Interactions as First-Class Data: A Formal Interaction Model and Runtime for Explainable AI Collaboration
summary: AI assistants are increasingly embedded in computational notebooks, scientific workflows, software engineering tools, and learning systems, yet human-AI interactions are often treated as transient prompt-response exchanges rather than durable data products, hindering reproducibility, explainability, replay, behavioral analysis, and adaptive AI support. We argue that these interactions form a new data class requiring formal representation and introduce the Human-AI Interaction Description Language (HAIDL), a formal interaction model with a Backus-Naur Form-inspired concrete syntax. HAIDL encodes each interaction as a structured object capturing computational context, user request, prompt payload, AI response, feedback, problem context, provenance, and model metadata. We integrate this vision into HAIDL-X, a middleware for JupyterLab that instantiates HAIDL by capturing user-bot state, building contextualized prompts, interfacing with AI providers, collecting feedback, and storing interactions in a repository. We add a learning layer over HAIDL that maps interaction objects and notebook execution traces into reproducible measures of user behavior, including engagement, performance, help-seeking, error-oriented use, and learning personas. HAIDL-X provides a foundation for treating human-AI collaboration as structured, queryable, replayable, analyzable data.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将人机交互视为新型数据类别，设计形式化交互描述语言HAIDL及其在JupyterLab中的中间件实现HAIDL-X，使AI交互可复现、可回放、可分析。
AI.motivation: AI助手已嵌入计算笔记本、科学工作流、软件工程工具和学习系统，但人机交互常被视为短暂的提示-响应交换而非持久化数据产品，导致可复现性、可解释性、回放、行为分析和自适应AI支持受阻。作者据此主张交互构成需要形式化表示的新数据类别。
AI.method: 提出HAIDL（Human-AI Interaction Description Language），一种受巴科斯范式（BNF）启发的具体语法形式化交互模型，将每次交互编码为结构化对象，涵盖计算上下文、用户请求、提示载荷、AI响应、反馈、问题上下文、溯源信息和模型元数据；并实现HAIDL-X中间件，在JupyterLab中完成用户-机器人状态捕获、上下文提示构建、AI提供方接口对接、反馈收集与交互仓库存储；再叠加学习层，将交互对象与笔记本执行轨迹映射为可复现的用户行为度量。
AI.result: 通过HAIDL-X实例化该形式化模型，并构建学习层以生成可复现度量，包括参与度、表现、求助行为、面向错误的使用模式及学习画像（learning personas）。
AI.conclusion: HAIDL-X为将人机协作视为结构化、可查询、可回放、可分析的数据奠定了基础，推动交互数据从瞬态记录转变为可复用的数据产品。

title: More Is Better? Exploring Latent Correspondence in Federated Hypergraph Learning
summary: Federated hypergraph learning with latent cross-client hyperedge correspondence poses fundamental identifiability and computational challenges, as the same local release can correspond to multiple global hypergraph structures. We characterize the tractability of recovering these latent correspondences, showing tractable pairwise assignment but generally intractable multi-client hyperedge matching. Building on this characterization, we derive a cross-entropy decomposition that reveals when local prediction can outperform predictors fitted with additional cross-client information. Motivated by this principle, we introduce Federated Adaptive Spectral Training with Representation Alignment (FedASTRA), which learns correspondence-invariant diffusion representations through adaptive heat diffusion and masked latent prediction while communicating model parameters only. We establish its asymptotic optimality with respect to the permitted local information and prove global population-risk convergence under explicit conditions on recovery, representation, and update alignment. Experiments on eight real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of FedASTRA against identifier-free federated graph and hypergraph methods. On ogbn-papers100M, FedASTRA reaches the performance-communication Pareto frontier, achieving 50.07 Accuracy and 29.73 Macro-F1 while communicating only 59.60 MiB per round.

AI.tldr: 本文研究潜在跨客户端超边对应关系下的联邦超图学习，刻画其可识别性与可计算性，提出信息论层面的交叉熵分解，并据此设计FedASTRA方法。
AI.motivation: 在联邦超图学习中，同一本地发布可能对应多种全局超图结构，导致潜在跨客户端超边对应关系难以识别，带来可识别性与计算上的根本挑战。
AI.method: 先刻画恢复潜在对应关系的可解性：成对指派可解，多客户端超边匹配一般不可解；据此推导交叉熵分解；提出FedASTRA，通过自适应热扩散与掩码潜在预测学习对应不变扩散表示，仅通信模型参数。
AI.result: 证明其相对允许的本地信息具渐近最优性，并在恢复、表示与更新对齐的显式条件下证明全局总体风险收敛；在8个真实数据集上优于无标识符的联邦图/超图方法；ogbn-papers100M上达到性能-通信Pareto前沿，50.07 Accuracy、29.73 Macro-F1，每轮仅通信59.60 MiB。
AI.conclusion: 跨客户端超边对应的可解性具有清晰边界，交叉熵分解揭示了本地预测何时优于使用额外跨客户端信息的预测器，FedASTRA据此实现高效且通信友好的联邦超图学习。

title: Confidence Filtering in Video-Based Gait Assessment: Measurement Error versus Selection Shift
comment: 6 pages + 2-page appendix, 4 figures, 2 supplementary figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Rehabilitation Robotics (ICORR)
summary: Video-based gait assessment often keeps only high-confidence pose observations, which can lower measurement error but change the movement assessed. We compared confidence selection with budget-matched random selection in a Parkinson-related cohort (n = 96) and an NF2-related replication cohort (n = 18). In the Parkinson-related cohort, confidence selection produced a small but consistent shift in the observed movement summary (+0.05 SD, 95% CI 0.03 to 0.07), while held-out Mini-BESTest error stayed flat (-0.04 points, -0.13 to 0.05); a policy preserving motion-group proportions reduced the shift, while NF2 showed no shift and its predictor did not beat a constant baseline. Because this shift mixes measurement error with selection shift, we decompose and simulate both on the cohort's window structure. Filtering lowers local error when error depends on confidence, but biases the endpoint once confidence tracks movement more than error. In the Parkinson-related data, confidence was only weakly tied to movement (rho = 0.14). There, filtering is harmless if well-tracked windows are unbiased. If instead systematic error only redistributes within participants, filtering can add up to 0.58 degrees. Unchanged clinical error from such small-cohort predictors therefore cannot show that quality filtering preserves the assessed movement.

AI.tldr: 在帕金森相关队列(n=96)与NF2复制队列(n=18)中比较置信度筛选与预算匹配的随机筛选对步态评估的影响，发现置信度筛选带来小而一致的观测运动摘要偏移(+0.05 SD)，但保留的Mini-BESTest误差基本不变；通过分解与模拟表明，临床误差不变并不能证明质量筛选保留了所评估的运动。
AI.motivation: 基于视频的步态评估通常只保留高置信度姿态观测以降低测量误差，但这可能改变被评估的运动本身。作者需厘清"测量误差下降"与"选择偏移"两类效应，并检验临床误差不变是否可作为筛选无害的证据。
AI.method: 在帕金森相关队列(n=96)与NF2复制队列(n=18)中，将置信度筛选与预算匹配(样本量相同)的随机筛选对比；同时用保留策略维持运动组比例。进一步在该队列的窗口结构上对测量误差与选择偏移进行分解与模拟，并检验置信度与运动的关联(秩相关)。
AI.result: 帕金森相关队列中置信度筛选导致运动摘要小幅一致偏移(+0.05 SD, 95% CI 0.03–0.07)，而留出Mini-BESTest误差持平(-0.04分, -0.13–0.05)；维持运动组比例的筛选策略减小了该偏移。NF2队列无偏移，其预测器未优于常数基线。置信度与运动仅弱相关(rho=0.14)；若系统性误差仅在参与者内重分配，筛选可额外引入高达0.58度的偏差。
AI.conclusion: 当误差依赖置信度时筛选降低局部误差，但一旦置信度更多反映运动而非误差，就会使终点产生偏差。在小队列中临床误差不变，不能作为质量筛选保留所评估运动的证据。

title: Cheap Retrieval and Observation Credit Assignment from One Quantity: The Value of Information
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at the CoRL 2026 Workshop on Memory for Robot Foundation Models (https://corl2026-memory.github.io/)
summary: Memory in reinforcement learning raises two problems. Attention finds the relevant item by scoring the whole store, which is costly for robots under latency and energy limits. When a retrieved memory pays off, credit for acquiring it must cross the whole sequence. We argue that both are governed by one quantity, the value of information, and propose to estimate it from archived rollouts with a learned world model. We obtain that, when read at the observation, it yields a provable lower bound on the optimal value of the acquiring action, which floors its TD target and attributes this floor to the observation that earned it. Read at the decision, it defines the optimal retrieval set. A pilot retrieval system, to be trained and improved with this signal, solves a memory task with reduced context.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用“信息价值”统一刻画强化学习中的记忆写入与检索问题：从存档轨迹配合学习到的世界模型估计该量；在观测处读取它可得到获取动作最优值的可证下界，在决策处读取它可定义最优检索集。
AI.motivation: 记忆在强化学习中存在两个问题：一是注意力需对整个存储打分以找到相关项，对受时延与能耗限制的机器人代价高昂；二是当被检索的记忆产生收益时，其获取信用的归因需跨越整个序列。作者认为两者由同一量——信息价值——支配。
AI.method: 提出从存档的 rollout 中、借助学习到的世界模型来估计信息价值。该量在观测处读取时给出获取动作最优值的可证下界，从而为其 TD 目标设下下限，并将该下限归因于带来它的观测；在决策处读取时则定义最优检索集。基于此信号训练并改进一个试点检索系统。
AI.result: 试点检索系统在以缩减的上下文完成记忆任务，并可通过该信号持续训练与改进。
AI.conclusion: 信息价值为记忆的获取信用分配与检索选择提供了统一且可解释的准则，兼具有理论保证（最优值下界、最优检索集）与初步实证可行性。

title: Safe Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning: Zero Constraint Violation and Primal-Averaging Convergence
summary: Many applications of multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) require policies that balance conflicting objectives while satisfying safety constraints. We study safe MORL with zero constraint violation throughout learning, covering both cumulative and stepwise constraints. A key challenge is to explore sufficiently under unknown dynamics and constraint costs without violating the constraints. For a given preference over objectives, we develop an algorithm to learn a safe Pareto optimal policy by combining optimistic reward estimates with pessimistic cost bounds. With high probability, every policy executed over $T$ episodes incurs zero constraint violation. The algorithm returns a safe Markov policy induced by the averaged occupancy measure and achieves an $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ suboptimality gap under smooth Tchebycheff scalarization. We further develop a preference-free algorithm that first explores safely without a prespecified preference and then computes a safe policy for any given preference without further interaction. Over $T$ exploration episodes and $K$ planning iterations, it retains the same safety guarantee and achieves an $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T}+1/\sqrt{K})$ suboptimality gap. Both algorithms require knowledge of a policy that strictly satisfies the constraints and its costs. We then relax these requirements, incurring at most constant cumulative violation. To our knowledge, we provide the first sample-efficient MORL algorithms that guarantee safety for every executed policy.

AI.tldr: 提出两类带零约束违反保证的安全多目标强化学习(MORL)算法，分别针对给定偏好和无偏好场景，并给出子线性次优性界。
AI.motivation: MORL应用需在满足安全约束下平衡冲突目标；难点在于未知动力学与约束代价下既要充分探索又不能违反约束。
AI.method: 对给定偏好：乐观奖励估计+悲观代价上界结合，学习安全Pareto最优策略；执行策略经平均占用测度诱导安全马尔可夫策略，在平滑Tchebycheff标量化下分析。另提出无偏好算法：先安全探索再对任意偏好离线规划。
AI.result: 给定偏好算法以高概率全程零约束违反，次优间隙Õ(1/√T)；无偏好算法在T次探索、K次规划下保持相同安全保证，间隙Õ(1/√T+1/√K)。
AI.conclusion: 放松对严格可行策略及其代价的已知要求时累计违反至多为常数；为首批保证每条执行策略安全且样本高效的MORL算法。

title: NIF: Normal-Intersection Fields for Geometrically Consistent Oriented Box Refinement
summary: Accurate oriented detection requires a box to follow object boundaries, yet a standard regression head predicts its center, size, and angle from a pooled region representation. Small errors in these coupled parameters can displace long boundaries even when the object is correctly classified. We propose NIF, a refinement module that replaces an additional box regressor with normal-intersection fields. Given a coarse oriented box, the module observes local features at 20 boundary anchors and predicts signed distances along their outward normals. These observations admit an exact affine representation in five geometric variables. A differentiable, reliability-weighted least-squares fit projects the predicted field onto this representation and analytically recovers a refined rectangle. Tangential pooling preserves the normal position profile, while shared projection limits the added network to 0.132M parameters. On DOTA-v1.0, NIF reaches 78.00%, 79.11%, and 79.02% mAP with Oriented R-CNN, LSKNet-S, and Strip R-CNN, respectively, achieving the highest single-scale SOTA result in Table 1. It reaches 68.19% on DIOR-R, improves matched FAIR1M/DIOR-R baselines by 0.30/0.68%, and raises HRSC mean IoU from 0.867 to 0.888 while reducing field error by 24.5%. Across four different detector frameworks with the detectors frozen, relative AP75 improves by 1.57-4.18% and COCO-style mAP by 0.42-3.74%, without detector retraining. Code is available at https://github.com/zsk466991125-collab/Normal-Intersection-Fields.

AI.tldr: NIF：用20个边界锚点的法向交点场替代额外的框回归器，通过可微软最小二乘精确解析恢复精化后的定向框，仅增加0.132M参数，在DOTA-v1.0等数据集上取得SOTA或显著提升。
AI.motivation: 定向检测要求框贴合目标边界，但标准回归头从池化区域特征直接预测中心、尺寸与角度，这些耦合参数的小误差会移动长边界，即便分类正确也会造成定位偏差。
AI.method: 提出NIF精化模块：给定粗定向框，在20个边界锚点处观测局部特征，预测沿外法向的有符号距离；这些观测在5个几何变量下具有精确仿射表示，用可微分、可靠性加权的最小二乘拟合将该场投影到此表示上，解析恢复精化矩形。采用切向池化保留法向位置剖面，并共享投影，使新增网络仅0.132M参数。
AI.result: DOTA-v1.0上，Oriented R-CNN、LSKNet-S、Strip R-CNN分别达78.00%、79.11%、79.02% mAP，为表1中最高单尺度SOTA；DIOR-R达68.19%，FAIR1M/DIOR-R匹配基线分别提升0.30/0.68%；HRSC平均IoU由0.867升至0.888，场误差降低24.5%。在四种检测器框架冻结下，相对AP75提升1.57–4.18%，COCO式mAP提升0.42–3.74%，无需重训检测器。
AI.conclusion: 以法向交点场+几何约束解析求解替代直接框回归，可在极低参数开销下稳定提升定向检测精度，且具备跨框架、免重训即插即用的通用性。

title: Hybrid AI Patterns: Thirteen Ways to Couple Language Models with Rules, and How to Choose Among Them
summary: Language models handle text well, and rule engines give conclusions with proofs. Systems that combine the two are usually described by example, and the same coupling turns up under different names in agent frameworks, guardrail toolkits and neuro-symbolic research. This document defines thirteen patterns for coupling a language model with an executable rule language, in the catalogue form introduced for object-oriented design: intent, motivation, applicability, participants, collaborations, consequences, implementation, known uses and related patterns. Four patterns concern what crosses the boundary between model and rules, five who controls whom, three how the model takes part in the reasoning, and one how knowledge is kept over time. Five invariants hold for every combination, and five failure patterns name the couplings that break them. We relate the catalogue to published pattern catalogues and taxonomies of hybrid and neuro-symbolic systems and show where they overlap with it. A decision guide leads from a problem to a pattern. It rests on our measurements, including the cases in which a model alone did as well as the hybrid or better, and it reports what each design cost.

AI.tldr: 本文以面向对象设计模式的目录形式，系统定义了语言模型与可执行规则语言耦合的13种模式，并按"跨边界内容""控制权归属""模型参与推理方式""知识随时间保持"四类组织；同时提出5条不变式与5种失败模式，将目录与既有混合式/神经符号系统分类法对照，并给出从问题到模式的选择指南。
AI.motivation: 语言模型擅长处理文本，规则引擎可给出带证明的结论，二者结合的系统目前多以示例方式描述，同一耦合机制在智能体框架、护栏工具包与神经符号研究中以不同名称反复出现，缺乏统一、可复用的设计语言。
AI.method: 采用GoF式模式目录方法：为每个模式给出意图、动机、适用性、参与者、协作、后果、实现、已知用例与相关模式；归纳13个模式（4个关于模型与规则间的边界传输内容，5个关于控制权归属，3个关于模型参与推理的方式，1个关于知识的长期保持）；提炼5条适用于所有组合的不变式与5个失败模式；与已发表的模式目录及混合/神经符号系统分类法进行比对，并基于实测给出决策指南。
AI.result: 形成结构化模式目录，明确各模式与既有分类法的重叠之处；决策指南可把具体问题导向对应模式；同时报告了各设计的成本，并指出存在纯模型单独使用即达到同等或更优效果的情形。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型与规则引擎的耦合可被规范化为可复用、可比较的设计模式体系；模式选择应基于实测成本与效果权衡，纯模型方案在部分场景中已足够，混合设计并非默认更优。

title: Dobb: Shard-Local Preconditioning in Block-Diagonal Eigenbases
summary: Training language models whose parameters and optimizer state exceed a single node's memory requires sharding these tensors across devices. Under tensor parallelism (TP) or fully sharded data parallelism (FSDP), matrix-aware optimizers such as Muon introduce communication to perform global matrix operations across shards. We propose Dobb (Distributed Optimizer with Block-diagonal Eigenbases), a matrix-aware optimizer designed to compute updates locally within parameter shards. Dobb approximates the input-activation second moment with diagonal blocks and tracks a complete basis within each block. It projects momentum into these bases, applies sign normalization to the coefficients, and reconstructs the update. When each block lies within one shard under TP or FSDP, Dobb applies its matrix update locally, requiring no communication beyond data-parallel synchronization of the activation second moments. We benchmark Dobb against Dion, a distributed matrix-aware optimizer designed to retain the benefits of orthonormalized updates while reducing communication. On GPT-2 XL (1.56B parameters), Dobb with 16 blocks reaches a validation loss of 2.476, compared with 2.511 for Dion at rank fraction 1/16. Under FSDP on 32 H100 GPUs, Dobb reduces the amortized optimizer-call time from 124.1 ms for Dion to 9.2 ms.

AI.tldr: 提出分块对角特征基分布式优化器 Dobb，在参数分片内本地完成矩阵感知更新，避免 TP/FSDP 下的跨分片通信，性能优于 Dion 且优化器调用时间大幅降低。
AI.motivation: 参数与优化器状态超出单节点内存时需在设备间分片张量；在 TP 或 FSDP 下，Muon 等矩阵感知优化器需跨分片通信以执行全局矩阵运算，带来高昂通信开销。
AI.method: Dobb 用对角块近似输入激活二阶矩，并在每个块内维护完整特征基；将动量投影到这些基上，对系数做符号归一化后重构更新。当每个块落在单一分片内时，矩阵更新完全本地执行，仅需对激活二阶矩做数据并行同步。
AI.result: 在 GPT-2 XL（1.56B 参数）上，16 块的 Dobb 验证损失为 2.476，优于 rank fraction 1/16 时 Dion 的 2.511；在 32 张 H100 上使用 FSDP 时，摊销优化器调用时间由 Dion 的 124.1 ms 降至 9.2 ms。
AI.conclusion: 通过块对角特征基的局部化矩阵更新，Dobb 在保持甚至提升模型质量的同时显著降低分布式训练中的优化器通信与调用开销，是一种适用于大规模分片训练的高效矩阵感知优化器。

title: WorldProbe: When Video World Models Fall Apart under Long-Horizon Spatial Exploration
summary: Video world models generate future visual observations from camera or action inputs, with the goal of synthesizing persistent 3D worlds that can be explored across time and space. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate short interactions or rely on camera trajectories fixed before generation. The performance of video world models under long-horizon exploration with extensive camera motion remains under-explored. We introduce WorldProbe, a diagnostic benchmark that uses a goal-conditioned multimodal agent to adapt camera actions online during generation. WorldProbe comprises 164 test cases across four probing families. Across 10 state-of-the-art models, we generate more than 1,600 rollouts totaling approximately 800 minutes, with horizons up to 180 seconds. Our evaluation across four dimensions reveals both the degradation of local measures and the emergence of long-range inconsistencies. We find that recent models sustain visual and content quality for longer, while long-range memory and evolution remain weak. These results expose a gap between locally stable generation and persistent world consistency that is largely missed by existing benchmarks. Code and benchmark resources are available at https://github.com/Untitled-W/WorldProbe.

AI.tldr: 提出 WorldProbe，一个用目标条件多模态智能体在生成过程中在线调整相机动作的诊断基准，用于评测视频世界模型在长时程探索下维持持久 3D 世界一致性的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型基准多评测短交互，或使用生成前固定的相机轨迹，因而无法刻画在长时程、大范围相机运动探索下的表现；局部稳定生成与持久世界一致性之间的差距未被充分揭示。
AI.method: 构建包含 164 个测试用例、覆盖四个探测族（probing families）的目标条件多模态智能体基准框架，智能体在生成过程中在线自适应地调整相机动作以进行目标导向探索；对 10 个 SOTA 模型生成 1600+ 条 rollout（约 800 分钟，时程最长 180 秒），并从四个维度进行评估。
AI.result: 评测显示局部指标随时间退化，同时出现长程不一致现象；较新的模型能在更长时间内维持视觉与内容质量，但长程记忆与世界演化能力仍然薄弱。
AI.conclusion: WorldProbe 揭示了"局部稳定生成"与"持久世界一致性"之间存在被现有基准忽视的显著差距，为视频世界模型的长时程一致性评测提供了诊断工具，代码与基准资源已公开。

title: Agentic process evidence
summary: The way software gets built is changing dramatically. AI agents now create pull requests, select dependencies, refactor codebases, interpret test failures, and execute infrastructure changes across the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). AI agents are autonomous team members, but unlike human engineers, they are ephemeral - their reasoning, decisions, and tool calls vanish the moment the session ends. Modern Security incidents involving intent mismatch or injection are becoming increasingly common - forcing us to address AI Agents as an insider threat. No widely adopted standard yet enables agentic provenance and governance and its obvious that you can't hold an ephemeral process accountable. The git log was designed for human commits. It shows what changed. It does not show what an AI agent did, which model it used, which tools it called, or whether anyone was accountable for the outcome. Every governance framework, every audit trail, every compliance control in the SDLC was built around one assumption: a human made the decision. That assumption no longer holds. This shift introduces 3 main procedural problems (not addressing scale) - Supply-chain vector - The agentic coder is software, so it is a supply-chain security risk. Policy guardrails - How to ensure the agentic coder is compliant with the policies of the organization. Task-alignment - How to align the agentic coder on its tasks and goals. We introduce Agentic Process Evidence (APE), a signed, tamper-evident, machine-readable attestation of agentic processes, linking the sessions to their outcome (process-aware logging). APE enables Policy-as-Code control over the agentic processes, allowing for human in the loop only when it's needed. We support the in-toto style attestation framework, and the protocol is aligned with the relevant regulations

AI.tldr: 针对 AI Agent 作为软件开发生命周期(SDLC)中的"临时性"自主成员所带来的不可问责问题，本文提出 Agentic Process Evidence (APE)——一种签名、防篡改、机器可读的代理过程存证，将代理会话与其产出关联，实现过程感知日志、Policy-as-Code 管控与按需人工介入(human-in-the-loop)。
AI.motivation: 软件构建方式正在剧变，AI Agent 已承担提交 PR、选择依赖、重构代码、解读测试失败、执行基础设施变更等全 SDLC 任务，成为自主团队成员。但与人类工程师不同，Agent 具有"临时性(ephemeral)"：会话结束后其推理、决策与工具调用轨迹即刻消失，无法被追责。现有 git log 为人类提交设计，仅记录"改了什么"，不记录"哪个模型、调用了哪些工具、谁对结果负责"。而意图错配与注入类安全事件日益普遍，迫使我们将 AI Agent 视为内部威胁(insider threat)。现有治理框架、审计轨迹与合规控制均建立在"由人决策"这一假设之上，该假设已不成立，且尚缺乏被广泛采纳的标准来支撑代理来源可追溯(provenance)与治理。
AI.method: 作者归纳出三项程序性问题（非规模问题）：1) 供应链威胁向量——代理式编码器本身即软件，构成供应链安全风险；2) 策略护栏——如何确保代理式编码器遵守组织策略；3) 任务对齐——如何使代理与其任务、目标保持一致。为此提出 Agentic Process Evidence (APE)：对代理过程进行签名、防篡改、机器可读的存证，将会话与其结果相链接（过程感知日志 process-aware logging）；在其之上支持 Policy-as-Code 对代理过程进行控制，仅在必要时引入人工介入；并兼容 in-toto 风格存证框架，协议对齐相关法规要求。
AI.result: 论文为方法/立场型工作，未给出量化实验评估；其贡献在于提出 APE 这一存证机制与协议设计，声称可支撑：代理会话与结果的端到端可追溯、基于策略的自动化合规控制、按需 human-in-the-loop，以及 in-toto 风格存证与法规对齐。
AI.conclusion: "由人决策"的假设已失效，临时性代理过程若不留存可验证证据便无法问责。APE 通过签名的机器可读过程存证填补代理来源与治理标准的空白，为 SDLC 中的代理行为提供可审计、可策略化管控的基础设施。

title: Accuracy is not compatibility: two Evo 2 checkpoints hinge on one FP8 matrix multiplication
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23740390 ; code: https://github.com/astding/mmaemu
summary: FP8 formats specify how values are stored, not how products are summed; this gap can break checkpoints. Evo 2, a DNA language model, documents a Hopper FP8 requirement for its 1B and 40B checkpoints. On two Blackwell (sm_120) GPUs both fail the developers' forward test (the 7B passes); on an RTX 5070 Ti the 40B's next-base accuracy is 25.7%, near guessing. Greater accuracy breaks them, as BioNeMo saw for the 40B on Hopper: natively, 99.996% of one projection's outputs are correctly rounded (H100: about 30%), and fp32 accumulation of the same operands fails. Our H100 FP8 GEMM emulator, mmaemu (bit-exact on captured 1B projections), localises the dependence to the 1B's first projection (of 21), where exact sums fail but pass when shrunk by the H100's 1.4% (measured in-sample), not 2.1%. The 40B fails with only its first projection native. Emulating only that projection, weights unchanged, raises 40B BRCA1 variant-classification AUROC from 0.434 to 0.869 (H100: 0.868) on the RTX 5070 Ti, despite a narrow forward-test miss, and 0.481 to 0.867 on an RTX PRO 6000. We tested one model family but not training origin; releases should specify reference arithmetic.

AI.tldr: FP8格式只规定数值存储方式，不规定乘积累加的归约方式，这一缺口会导致检查点失效。作者以DNA语言模型Evo 2为例（1B/40B声明依赖Hopper FP8），在Blackwell（sm_120）GPU上前向测试失败，40B在RTX 5070 Ti上next-base准确率仅25.7%（近随机）。作者构建位精确的H100 FP8 GEMM模拟器mmaemu，将依赖定位到1B首个投影（共21个），发现精确求和失败、而按H100实测1.4%（非2.1%）缩减后通过；仅原生模拟该投影即可将40B BRCA1变异分类AUROC从0.434恢复到0.869（H100参考0.868）。结论：发布模型应指定参考算术。
AI.motivation: FP8规范仅定义数值如何存储，未定义乘积如何归约求和，导致同一检查点在不同硬件（Hopper vs Blackwell）上数值行为不一致，甚至前向计算失败或精度崩塌。作者希望定位并解释这种硬件相关依赖，并推动模型发布时声明参考算术。
AI.method: 以Evo 2（1B/40B，DNA语言模型）为对象，在两块Blackwell sm_120 GPU、RTX 5070 Ti与RTX PRO 6000上复现开发者前向测试与下游任务（BRCA1变异分类AUROC）。构建H100 FP8 GEMM模拟器mmaemu（对捕获的1B投影位精确），逐投影消融，测试"精确求和 vs 按实测比例缩减"两种累加行为，并将定位到的首个投影以原生算术模拟、权重保持不变地替换回模型。
AI.result: 两块Blackwell上1B与40B均未通过开发者前向测试（7B通过）；RTX 5070 Ti上40B next-base准确率25.7%（近猜）。40B在Hopper上原生时有99.996%的某投影输出被正确舍入（H100约30%），对相同操作数做fp32累加反而失败。mmaemu把依赖定位到1B的第1个投影（共21个）：精确和被缩减1.4%（H100实测，非2.1%）才通过；40B仅需第1个投影为原生行为即失败。仅模拟该投影，40B BRCA1 AUROC从0.434升至0.869（H100为0.868）于RTX 5070 Ti，0.481升至0.867于RTX PRO 6000，尽管前向测试仍有小幅未通过。
AI.conclusion: 检查点对FP8累加归约顺序的依赖是高度局部化且可精确定位的：单个投影的原生模拟即可恢复绝大部分下游性能，远超fp32累加。硬件特定的归约行为（约1.4%的缩减）而非数值精度本身决定了正确性。仅测试了一个模型家族、未涉及训练来源，作者呼吁模型发布方明确指定参考算术以保证可移植性与可复现性。

title: Cross-Encoder Anchor Refinement for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
summary: Zero-shot anomaly detection aims to transfer anomaly discrimination from auxiliary training domains to unseen categories while localizing subtle defects. A key challenge is to construct discriminative references that combine contextual representations with complementary local evidence. We present Cross-Encoder Anchor Refinement (CEAR), which connects two visual encoding paths for the same image at the anchor stage, before normal and anomalous prototypes are constructed. An independent convolutional encoder pretrained for industrial product recognition builds an image-specific memory shared across selected vision transformer (ViT) layers. Spatial anchors read from ViT patch features query this memory through cross-attention and undergo residual refinement. Image-conditioned normal and anomalous queries then gate anchor aggregation to construct prototypes for anomaly scoring. Across 13 industrial and medical datasets, CEAR achieves the best performance in 57 of 68 evaluations spanning image-level detection and pixel-level localization. Notably, CEAR surpasses all other state-of-the-art methods in 41 of 44 pixel-level comparisons. Across 11 localization datasets, mean gains in pixel-level maximum F1 score and average precision are 4.45 and 3.79 percentage points, respectively. This study shows how cross-encoder interaction at the anchor stage can integrate complementary visual representations for fine-grained anomaly localization across domains.

AI.tldr: 提出跨编码器锚点精炼框架CEAR，在锚点阶段融合ViT与工业预训练卷积编码器，构建图像特定的正常/异常原型，实现零样本异常检测与定位。
AI.motivation: 零样本异常检测需将辅助域判别能力迁移到未见类别并定位细微缺陷，核心难点是构建既有上下文表征又有局部证据的判别性参考。
AI.method: CEAR在原型构建之前、锚点阶段连接两条视觉编码路径：独立的工业产品识别预训练卷积编码器构建图像特定记忆库，在多个ViT层间共享；ViT块特征中的空间锚点通过交叉注意力查询该记忆并进行残差精炼；随后由图像条件化的正常/异常查询门控锚点聚合，生成用于异常评分的原型。
AI.result: 在13个工业与医学数据集、68项评测中57项最优；44项像素级比较中41项超越所有SOTA；11个定位数据集上像素级最大F1与平均精度分别平均提升4.45和3.79个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在锚点阶段引入跨编码器交互可有效整合互补视觉表征，实现跨域细粒度异常定位。

title: Reward-Adaptive Co-Evolution of Policy and Rubric
summary: Rubric-based rewards provide fine-grained, interpretable supervision for open-ended reinforcement learning, where holistic scalar rewards struggle to capture multidimensional response quality. Static rubrics can lose discriminative power as the policy distribution evolves, while existing policy--rubric co-evolution methods rely on globally prescribed update schedules that ignore heterogeneous reward informativeness. We introduce RACE, a Reward-Adaptive Co-Evolution framework. At the group level, per-rollout-group training-signal routing classifies groups as informative, diversity-collapsed, or rubric-failed, updating the policy only with informative groups while caching rubric failures. At the phase level, event-triggered phase switching enters rubric optimization upon persistent reward saturation and returns when rubric-reward improvement plateaus. Rubric phases train the generator on cached pairs using a frozen judge and a scale-normalized pairwise-margin reward. Across both levels, online threshold adaptation adjusts routing and switching thresholds through proportional control. Under a unified evaluation protocol, RACE achieves the highest average performance and outperforms the strongest fixed-alternation baseline on all eight tasks, while improving rubric discrimination.

AI.tldr: RACE 提出一种奖励自适应协同进化框架，通过组级训练信号路由与事件触发式相位切换，动态决定何时优化策略、何时优化评分量表（rubric），并以在线阈值自适应调节控制器。
AI.motivation: 开放式强化学习中，基于 rubric 的奖励可提供细粒度、可解释的多维监督，优于整体标量奖励。但静态 rubric 随策略分布演化会丧失判别力；而现有策略—rubric 协同进化方法依赖全局预设的更新日程，忽略了不同奖励信息量的异质性。
AI.method: 1) 组级路由：将每个 rollout 组的训练信号分类为信息充分、多样性坍塌或 rubric 失效三类，仅用信息充分组更新策略，并缓存 rubric 失效样本。2) 相位级切换：当奖励持续饱和时事件触发进入 rubric 优化相位，当 rubric 奖励提升趋于平台时返回策略优化相位。3) rubric 阶段使用冻结评判器与尺度归一化的成对间隔奖励，在缓存样本对上训练生成器。4) 两级均引入在线阈值自适应，通过比例控制调节路由与切换阈值。
AI.result: 在统一评测协议下，RACE 取得最高平均性能，在全部八个任务上均优于最强的固定交替基线，同时提升了 rubric 判别力。
AI.conclusion: 以数据驱动的信息量判据取代全局预设日程，可有效实现策略与 rubric 的自适应协同进化，兼顾性能与判别质量。

title: LinQuant: Functional Invariances for Low-Precision Linear Recurrences
summary: Linear recurrences are emerging as practical alternatives to softmax attention in large language models, appearing in both standalone and hybrid architectures. However, despite their rapid emergence, low-precision inference remains much less developed for these models than for softmax attention. During prefill, chunkwise-parallel algorithms cast much of the recurrence as dense matrix multiplications, suggesting a natural path to low-precision execution. Simply quantizing these operations in their native form, however, can be fragile. In this work, we identify functional invariances that preserve the full-precision computation while making the operands more amenable to quantization. Building on this observation, we introduce LinQuant, a framework for low-precision recurrent prefill based on seven such invariances, including rotations, diagonal rescalings, and alternative placements of recurrent decay and write factors. We derive when these transformations remain valid across common recurrence families spanning linear, gated, and delta-rule updates, and show that they provide complementary degrees of freedom for improving low-precision accuracy. Finally, we translate this framework to production by augmenting SSDi8, an existing low-precision prefill pipeline for Mamba-2, with the applicable invariances. LinQuant improves perplexity at matched latency on Mamba-2 1.3B, 2.7B, and 8B and Nemotron-H 8B, demonstrating the practical utility of invariance-based quantization for recurrent models.

AI.tldr: 提出LinQuant框架，利用7种保持全精度计算结果不变的功能不变性（旋转、对角缩放、衰减与写因子的替代放置等）使线性循环模型的chunkwise并行预填充更易于量化，并落地到SSDi8流水线。
AI.motivation: 线性循环（linear recurrence）正成为softmax注意力在LLM中的实用替代方案（含独立与混合架构），但其低精度推理研究远落后于softmax注意力。预填充阶段的chunkwise并行算法大量由稠密矩阵乘构成，理论上适合低精度执行，但直接对原生形式量化较为脆弱。
AI.method: 识别并形式化保持全精度计算等价的功能不变性（functional invariances），包括旋转、对角重缩放、循环衰减与写因子（write factors）的替代放置，共7种；推导这些变换在线性、门控（gated）与delta-rule等常见循环族中保持有效的条件；论证其提供互补的自由度以提升低精度精度；并将适用不变性集成进已有的Mamba-2低精度预填充流水线SSDi8，实现生产级部署。
AI.result: 在等延迟（matched latency）条件下，LinQuant改善了困惑度：Mamba-2 1.3B、2.7B、8B以及Nemotron-H 8B。
AI.conclusion: 基于不变性的量化方法对循环模型具有实际效用，为线性循环架构的低精度预填充提供了通用且可落地的框架。

title: SCOPE: Semantic COdec Pre-Editing for Object-Preserving Compression
summary: Image compression is increasingly used before machine vision systems, yet standard codecs are mainly optimized for human perception rather than downstream task accuracy. We propose SCOPE (Semantic COdec Pre-Editing), a conditional image pre-editor that modifies images before compression to improve the bitrate and detection accuracy trade-off. The model is conditioned on the codec family and compression severity, allowing a single trained network to adapt to multiple compression settings without retraining or loading codec-specific weights. Instead of uniformly preserving the whole image, the pre-editor learns to protect task-relevant regions while simplifying less important background content to improve compressibility. The resulting rate-accuracy curves show consistent gains across different codec families and detector architectures, together with strong transferability to unseen learned and wavelet-based compression families.

AI.tldr: 提出 SCOPE：一种码率条件化的图像预编辑器，在压缩前对图像做语义感知的修改，以单一网络适配多种编解码器与压缩强度，从而改善下游检测任务的码率-精度权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有标准编解码器主要面向人眼感知优化，而非机器视觉下游任务精度；直接在检测前压缩图像会导致任务精度下降，需要在压缩前对图像进行针对性预处理以缓解该问题。
AI.method: SCOPE 是一个条件式预编辑网络，以编解码器族与压缩强度为条件输入，使同一训练好的网络可覆盖多组压缩设置，无需重训练或加载编解码器专用权重；编辑策略为定向保护任务相关区域、简化次要背景内容以提升可压缩性。
AI.result: 在多种编解码器族与检测器架构下，SCOPE 的率-精度曲线均取得一致性增益，并对未见过的学习型与基于小波的压缩族表现出良好迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 压缩前的语义感知预编辑可作为提升机器视觉压缩效率的通用轻量手段，条件化设计实现了跨编解码器与压缩强度的统一适配与良好泛化。

title: DynaRev: Benchmarking Web Agents under Dynamic Goal Revision
summary: Web agents are typically evaluated with goals fully specified before execution and fixed thereafter, whereas real users often revise their requirements during interaction. To study such interactions, we introduce DynaRev, a benchmark of 181 tasks to evaluate web agents under dynamic goal revision. DynaRev uses semantic milestones to deliver revisions at task-defined stages, covers additive revisions, unconditional overrides, and runtime-conditioned overrides, and evaluates correctness, responsiveness, and efficiency through trajectory-grounded evaluation. Five-model evaluations show that agents often satisfy only part of the task requirements, with performance varying across task sources, revision types, and models. Further analyses reveal varied milestone timing, mixed effects of dynamic delivery, and contrasting revision-handling outcomes, with gains from instruction rewriting while preserving browser state and losses from browser resets. DynaRev provides a testbed for studying how web agents adapt to evolving user goals. The code and data are available at https://github.com/zsq259/DynaRev.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DynaRev基准，含181个任务，在动态目标修订下评估Web智能体，并揭示现有模型仅部分满足需求、对修订处理表现不一。
AI.motivation: 现有Web智能体评测假设目标在执行前完全给定且此后固定不变，而真实用户在交互中常修改需求，缺乏针对动态目标修订的系统评测基准。
AI.method: 构建DynaRev基准（181个任务），以语义里程碑在任务定义阶段投递目标修订，覆盖增量式修订、无条件覆盖和运行时条件覆盖三类修订；采用基于轨迹的评估来衡量正确性、响应性与效率；对五个模型进行实验，并分析里程碑时机、动态投递效应及不同修订处理策略（指令重写并保留浏览器状态 vs. 浏览器重置）的影响。
AI.result: 五个模型评估显示智能体常仅满足任务的部分要求，性能随任务来源、修订类型和模型而异；里程碑时机存在差异，动态投递效果混合；保留浏览器状态下的指令重写带来增益，而浏览器重置导致性能下降。
AI.conclusion: DynaRev为研究Web智能体如何适应用户目标演化提供了测试平台，代码与数据已开源。

title: Softmax Routing Dynamics in Mixture-of-Experts Models: Collapse and Recovery
summary: Softmax routing in mixture-of-experts models can concentrate probability on a subset of experts, suppressing access to the others. We study how this concentration forms, why it persists, and how suppressed probabilities recover. For fixed experts, a stationary-loss barrier identifies the face supporting the optimal routed output. In a common-target square-loss model with freely trainable expert outputs, slow adaptation tracks fixed-expert dynamics on finite horizons, while every fixed positive adaptation rate yields an interior routing limit. An exact normal-velocity decomposition separates complementary-expert covariance from relative gradient advantage. Under positive two-sided power bounds along recovery paths, uniform over initial masses, the resulting coefficient's order of vanishing gives logarithmic or power-law recovery times. Integrations of constructed fields reproduce these orders. An exact discrete log-odds identity relates neural updates to threshold crossing. In paired Transformer-MoE training, removing a class-conditional router-gradient contrast delays confirmed recovery and reduces accumulated log-odds on fixed tokens, both with and without capacity constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文研究MoE中Softmax路由的概率集中如何形成、为何持续、以及被抑制的概率如何恢复。固定专家时，用平稳损失壁垒刻画支撑最优路由输出的面；在共同目标平方损失、专家输出可训练模型中，慢适应在有限时域上追踪固定专家动力学，而任何固定的正适应率都给出内点路由极限。精确法向速度分解将互补专家协方差与相对梯度优势分离；在恢复路径上的双侧幂次界下，该系数的消失阶给出对数或幂律恢复时间，构造场的积分复现这些阶。精确的离散对数几率恒等式联系更新与阈值穿越；Transformer-MoE配对训练中，移除类别条件路由梯度对比会延迟恢复并降低固定token上的累积对数几率。
AI.motivation: Softmax路由会把概率集中到少数专家，抑制其他专家的访问，作者希望解释这种集中的形成、持续与恢复机制，并给出恢复时间的定量刻画。
AI.method: 1) 固定专家：用平稳损失壁垒确定支撑最优路由输出的面；2) 共同目标平方损失+可训练专家输出：分析慢适应与固定专家动力学的关系、证明正适应率下的内点路由极限；3) 推导精确法向速度分解，分离互补专家协方差与相对梯度优势；4) 在恢复路径双侧幂次界下，以系数消失阶推出对数/幂律恢复时间，并用构造场的积分验证；5) 建立离散对数几率恒等式联系神经更新与阈值穿越；6) 在Transformer-MoE配对训练中做路由梯度对比消融。
AI.result: 任何固定正适应率都导致内点路由极限（集中不会自然消失）；法向速度分解给出协方差项与梯度优势项的清晰区分；系数消失阶决定对数或幂律恢复时间，构造场积分复现相应阶数；消融移除类别条件路由梯度对比后，确认恢复延迟、固定token累积对数几率下降，且在有无容量约束下均成立。
AI.conclusion: 路由集中由可分解的协方差与梯度优势机制驱动，恢复速度由法向速度系数的消失阶决定；类别条件路由梯度对比在实践中有因果作用，其移除会延缓恢复并削弱累积对数几率证据。

title: GROME: GROunding Factorized MEmory into Video World Models
summary: Long-horizon consistency is essential for video world models, yet it becomes difficult to maintain once observed content falls outside the context window. Existing memory mechanisms either retrieve history as implicit context, which remains constrained by context capacity and entangles static and dynamic information or consolidate history into explicit global representations, which struggle to model evolving dynamics and accumulate geometric errors. To overcome these limitations, we introduce \textbf{GROME}, a novel factorized memory framework that augments video world models for long-horizon coherence across both static scenes and dynamic entities. GROME operates via three synergistic components: 1)~\emph{Static-Dynamic Factorization} decouples historical evidence into static and dynamic components, preserving static scene geometry and dynamic entity states separately; 2)~\emph{Local Memory Retrieval} selects spatially aligned static history to eliminate geometric drift alongside the latest dynamic entity states to ensure temporal continuity; 3)~\emph{Training-Free Memory Injection} seamlessly grounds the factorized memory into video world models via their native conditioning pathways. Experiments on long-horizon revisit scenarios demonstrate that GROME substantially enhances scene persistence and dynamic entity fidelity over existing methods, all while preserving the visual quality and controllability of the frozen backbone without additional training. Beyond self-rollouts, GROME readily accommodates external observations as plug-and-play memory, unlocking flexible and controllable video continuation and scene exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出GROME，一种因子化记忆框架，将历史解耦为静态与动态分量并通过免训练注入增强视频世界模型的长时程一致性。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型在观测内容超出上下文窗口后难以维持长时程一致性。隐式上下文检索受限于上下文容量且静态与动态信息纠缠；显式全局表示难以建模动态演化并累积几何误差。
AI.method: 三个协同组件：1）静态-动态因子化，将历史证据解耦为静态场景几何与动态实体状态；2）局部记忆检索，选取空间对齐的静态历史以消除几何漂移，并取最新动态实体状态保证时间连续性；3）免训练记忆注入，通过模型原生条件通路将因子化记忆注入视频世界模型。
AI.result: 在长时程重访场景实验中，相较现有方法显著提升场景持久性与动态实体保真度，同时在冻结骨干、无需额外训练的条件下保持视觉质量与可控性；此外可接收外部观测作为即插即用记忆，支持灵活可控的视频续写与场景探索。
AI.conclusion: GROME通过静态-动态因子化记忆与免训练注入有效解决长时程一致性难题，并具备作为即插即用记忆接口的扩展性。

title: The generative paradox: the Anti-Prompt paradigm for human capability
summary: Generative AI in education is usually judged by the output of human-AI teams. That focus overlooks a second outcome: what people can still understand, challenge, repair, and adapt when assistance changes or disappears. We call this tension the generative paradox and distinguish four manifestations: performance, assistance, ownership, and capability stock. We propose developmental function allocation, which complements operational function allocation and meaningful human control by treating retained human capability as a design objective alongside current joint performance. The Anti-Prompt paradigm reverses the default interaction order: when immediate generation would preempt a consequential human act, AI should first create the conditions for human construction. We distinguish the validity of a product, responsibility for its construction, and evidence of capability after support changes. Representative Anti-Prompts, a canonical interaction sequence, and stress tests spanning mathematical reasoning, experimental science, software diagnosis, and lesson design make these distinctions concrete. We conclude with falsifiable predictions about retained capability and a system-level hypothesis about the reproduction and distribution of expertise.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"生成悖论"：教育中的生成式AI通常以人机团队产出评判，却忽视援助变化或消失后人类还能理解、质疑、修复与适应什么。为此提出"发展性功能分配"（把保留的人类能力作为与当下协同表现并列的设计目标）与"反提示"范式（当即时生成会抢先取代关键人类行为时，AI应先创造人类自主建构的条件），并以代表性反提示、标准交互序列与跨数学推理、实验科学、软件诊断、教学设计的情境压力测试加以具体化，最后给出可证伪的保留能力预测与关于专长再生产与分布的系统级假设。
AI.motivation: 现有研究以人机团队输出作为生成式AI教育效果的主要评价标尺，忽视第二类结果：当辅助变化或消失时，个体仍能理解、质疑、修复与适应的程度。这一张力被称为生成悖论，其四类表现为绩效、援助、所有权与能力存量；既有操作层面的功能分配与"有意义的人类控制"未能把能力保留作为设计目标，因此需要新的框架。
AI.method: 概念与设计框架构建：区分生成悖论四种表现；提出发展性功能分配，与操作层功能分配及有意义的人类控制互补；提出反提示范式，反转默认交互顺序，在即时生成会预先占用关键人类行为时先营造人类建构的条件；并区分产品有效性、建构责任与支持变化后的能力证据；辅以代表性反提示、规范交互序列及四领域压力测试作为实例化。
