AI.result: 通过数学推理、实验科学、软件诊断与教学设计四类压力测试，将生成悖论四表现、有效性—责任—能力证据三分与反提示交互序列具体化，展示该框架如何区分产品有效性与能力证据，并给出关于保留能力的可证伪预测。
AI.conclusion: 应以保留的人类能力作为生成式AI教育的并列设计目标而非附属产出，推动从操作层功能分配走向发展性功能分配；反提示提供可操作的交互设计路径；并提出关于专长再生产与分布的系统级假设，以待可证伪检验。

title: End-to-End Guarantees for Masked Diffusion Models under Conditional Mixing
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Diffusion Language Models: Foundations, Efficiency, and Reasoning (DiffuLM). 26 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables
summary: Masked diffusion models train a denoiser on masked cross-entropy and generate by unmasking many positions in parallel. Existing MDM sampling bounds assume an exact denoiser or leave its error uncontrolled while training bounds cover only the masking distribution on which the model was trained. We present an end-to-end guarantee for a learned denoiser under conditional mixing (CM): stationary sources (e.g. floored order-$r$ Markov and two-sided-Doeblin hidden-Markov sources) for which revealing distant visible tokens moves a masked token's posterior on average exponentially little in the distance with correlation length $τ_c$. We show the empirical risk minimizer trained under any masking distribution attains per-token excess $\varepsilon'$ on that distribution from $\varepsilon'^{-\mathcal{O}(τ_c\log|\mathcal{V}|)}$ training sequences, independent of sequence length $N$ -- one sample budget serves every decoding schedule when each schedule's denoiser is trained under its own weighting. We further show that the exponent's order $Θ(τ_c\log|\mathcal{V}|)$ is minimax-optimal up to constants; more efficient rates require added structure. With this, we bound the end-to-end KL as $\mathrm{KL}(π\Vert p_{\mathrm{alg}})\leq \varepsilon+N\varepsilon'$ under a dilated schedule of $T=\mathcal{O}(τ_c\log(N|\mathcal{V}|/\varepsilon))$ denoising steps versus $Ω(N)$ steps for a fixed random order on an explicit CM source. Finally, we show that block-autoregressive samplers chain across blocks with no added error and that a $Λ$-looped order-$r$ message-passing class on order-$r$ sources achieves polynomial sample complexity, with approximation error improving per loop until saturation at $Λr\approx τ_c\log(1/\varepsilon')$. Experiments on released and retrained models support our results' qualitative predictions.

AI.tldr: 该论文为学习型去噪器下的掩码扩散模型（MDM）采样建立了端到端保证：在条件混合（CM）源上给出与序列长度无关的样本复杂度，证明指数Θ(τ_c log|V|)的极小极大最优性，并给出T=O(τ_c log(N|V|/ε))步的膨胀调度使端到端KL≤ε+Nε'。
AI.motivation: 现有MDM采样界假设去噪器精确或未控制其误差，而训练界仅覆盖训练时的掩码分布，缺乏对学习型去噪器与最终采样质量之间关系的端到端刻画。论文旨在填补采样-训练之间的理论空白，为学习型去噪器提供可解释的采样保证。
AI.method: 定义条件混合（CM）源类别（如floored order-r Markov源与双边Doeblin隐马尔可夫源），其揭示远端可见token对掩码token后验的平均影响随距离以相关长度τ_c指数衰减。在任意掩码分布下训练经验风险最小化去噪器，分析其逐token超额风险ε'所需的训练序列数；用该界推导端到端KL(π‖p_alg)≤ε+Nε'，并采用膨胀（dilated）去噪调度。进一步分析块自回归采样器的误差传播，以及Λ-loop、order-r消息传递类的近似误差随循环数下降至Λr≈τ_c log(1/ε')饱和。
AI.result: 在CM源上，任意掩码分布训练的经验风险最小化器达到逐token超额ε'仅需ε'^{-O(τ_c log|V|)}条序列，与序列长度N无关，且同一预算可服务于各自加权训练的各解码调度；该指数阶Θ(τ_c log|V|)在常数因子内是极小极大最优的。膨胀调度以T=O(τ_c log(N|V|/ε))步实现KL(π‖p_alg)≤ε+Nε'，而固定随机顺序在显式CM源上需Ω(N)步。块自回归采样器跨块链接无额外误差；Λ-loop order-r消息传递类在order-r源上具多项式样本复杂度，近似误差逐循环改善并在Λr≈τ_c log(1/ε')饱和。实验（已发布与重训模型）支持这些定性预测。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出了学习型去噪器下MDM的端到端采样-训练联合保证：样本复杂度与N无关、指数极小极大最优、膨胀调度显著优于固定随机顺序，并刻画了块自回归与循环消息传递结构的误差行为。结果表明更高效的速率需额外结构假设，为架构与调度设计提供了理论依据。

title: Aligning Medical Vision Language Models at the Capability Boundary with Entropy Adaptive Rubric Grounding
comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia Asia 2026 (MMAsia 2026). 10 pages, 4 figures
summary: Medical diagnostic reasoning requires verifiable links between visual evidence and clinical knowledge, yet current medical vision language models are aligned with objectives that reward the wrong behavior. Uniform supervised fine tuning lets easy cases dominate updates while clinically critical boundary cases saturate prematurely. Sparse rewards based only on final-answer correctness cannot assess anatomical grounding or clinical logic, inviting reward hacking through answer shortcuts. We propose MedCBR, a two-stage alignment framework coupling boundary-aware preference optimization with rubric-grounded reinforcement learning. First, we construct counterfactual boundary preferences at the model's capability frontier using empirical pass rates and preference pairs that share reasoning prefixes but diverge at decisive diagnostic branches. Difficulty Weighted Boundary Preference Optimization (DBPO) concentrates learning on this calibrated boundary region. Second, we distill reusable clinical rubrics from boundary trajectories and activate them according to prediction entropy. Entropy Gated Grounded Policy Optimization (EGPO) rewards answer correctness, anatomical grounding, and reasoning fidelity while suppressing rubric noise on reliable samples. A reference policy anchored to the boundary-aligned model couples population-level boundary priors with instance-level uncertainty, making diagnostic reasoning more accurate and clinically grounded. Experiments on six medical benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong general, specialized, and reinforcement learning baselines, reaching 61.2% average accuracy with the largest gains on challenging differential diagnosis tasks. Ablations show super-additive gains: combining the two stages exceeds the sum of their individual improvements.

AI.tldr: 提出MedCBR两阶段对齐框架：先用难度加权边界偏好优化（DBPO）将学习集中在能力前沿的校准边界区，再用熵门控接地策略优化（EGPO）以临床评分细则奖励答案正确性、解剖接地与推理保真度，六项医学基准平均准确率61.2%，两阶段增益呈超加性。
AI.motivation: 现有医学视觉语言模型的对齐目标奖励了错误行为：统一监督微调使简单样本主导更新、关键边界病例过早饱和；仅基于最终答案正确性的稀疏奖励无法评估解剖接地与临床逻辑，易被答案捷径型奖励黑客利用。
AI.method: 两阶段对齐框架。阶段一：基于经验通过率在模型能力前沿构造反事实边界偏好对（共享推理前缀、在决定性诊断分支处分叉），用难度加权边界偏好优化DBPO聚焦校准边界区。阶段二：从边界轨迹中蒸馏可复用临床评分细则，按预测熵激活；熵门控接地策略优化EGPO奖励答案正确性、解剖接地与推理保真度，并在高置信样本上抑制细则噪声；参考策略锚定于边界对齐模型，耦合群体级边界先验与实例级不确定性。
AI.result: 在六个医学基准上一致优于通用、专用及强化学习强基线，平均准确率61.2%，在困难的鉴别诊断任务上增益最大；消融显示两阶段组合增益超加性，大于各自独立增益之和。
AI.conclusion: 将边界感知偏好优化与评分细则接地的强化学习耦合，可使医学诊断推理更准确且更具临床可验证的接地性；边界先验与不确定性门控的联合设计是增益超加性的关键。

title: A Negotiation-Aware Hybrid LLM Framework for Intent Interpretation and Service Discovery
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Accepted at the 24th International Conference on Service-Oriented Computing (ICSOC 2026)
summary: Increasingly, users express their needs as natural-language intents rather than structured requests. These intents may be incomplete, high-level, or internally conflicting. A conflicting intent either violates fundamental properties of the cloud paradigm or states mutually inconsistent requirements. Classical composition approaches are designed for structured, low-level, and complete requests. They cannot interpret such intents, discover suitable services from provider catalogs, or negotiate conflicting requirements with users. To address this gap, we propose a negotiation-aware framework for intent interpretation and service discovery. The framework first refines the natural-language intent and dynamically detects conflicts. It then structures the intent into a provider-independent TOSCA template. For each specification, it retrieves candidate service offers through deterministic matching grounded in cloud provider offerings. Some conflicts arise during interpretation. Other requirements prove unsatisfiable during discovery. Both are resolved through iterative natural-language negotiation with the user. We evaluate the framework on 70 diverse intents against single-shot and enhanced-prompting baselines. It improves recall and F1 for both conflict detection and service discovery. It also eliminates hallucinated offers and resolves conflicts at a cost proportional to their number.

AI.tldr: 提出一个面向自然语言意图的“协商感知”框架，将用户意图精化为提供商无关的 TOSCA 模板，动态检测冲突，并基于云厂商目录做确定性匹配以发现候选服务，对解释阶段与发现阶段出现的冲突均通过迭代式自然语言协商解决；在 70 个意图上与单次调用及增强提示基线对比，冲突检测与服务发现的召回率与 F1 均提升，消除幻觉性报价，冲突解决成本与其数量成正比。
AI.motivation: 用户越来越多以自然语言意图表达需求，此类意图可能不完整、过于高层或内部相互冲突（违反云范式基本属性或提出互斥要求）。经典的服务组合方法面向结构化、低层、完整的请求，无法解释这类意图、无法从提供商目录中发现合适服务，也无法就冲突需求与用户协商，因此存在方法空白。
AI.method: 框架分为三步：首先对自然语言意图进行精化并动态检测冲突；其次将意图结构化为提供商无关的 TOSCA 模板；随后针对每个规格，基于云厂商供给进行确定性匹配，检索候选服务报价；解释阶段产生的冲突与发现阶段判定不可满足的需求，统一通过迭代式的自然语言协商与用户解决。评估采用 70 个多样化意图，与单次（single-shot）及增强提示（enhanced-prompting）基线对比。
AI.result: 相较单次与增强提示基线，框架在冲突检测与服务发现两项任务上均提升了召回率与 F1；消除了幻觉性服务报价（即不存在的候选服务）；冲突解决成本与其数量成正比。
AI.conclusion: 协商感知的意图解释与服务发现框架能够弥补经典组合方法在处理不完整、高层、冲突性自然语言意图上的不足，通过结构化 TOSCA 表示与确定性匹配保证发现结果的可靠性并抑制幻觉，同时以迭代协商显式处理冲突；代价随冲突数线性增长，具备可扩展性。

title: Smooth Action Chunking Via Movement-Primitive Representations for Imitation Learning
summary: Imitation learning has become a widely adopted approach for vision-based robot policies, owing to its conceptual simplicity, scalability, and ability to leverage large-scale datasets. As these policies have grown more capable, action chunking has become their standard interface. At each decision step the policy outputs several future actions at once. Backbones from diffusion policies to large vision-language-action models all share it. Whatever backbone produces the chunk, its temporal structure is learned only implicitly. The commanded trajectory is therefore jerky both within a chunk and between successive chunks. On real hardware this appears as visible vibration and as repeated saturation of the follower's velocity limit. We address this issue by incorporating a movement-primitive-based trajectory representation into action chunking. Specifically, a trajectory segment is represented as a linear combination of smooth basis functions, yielding smooth trajectories by construction while leaving the policy architecture, training objective, and inference procedure unchanged. The same representation also yields a closed-form, inference-time correction for the second source of jerk. We condition the predicted coefficients so that the new chunk passes through a via-point at the previous chunk's last commanded action. This correction needs no retraining and, unlike asynchronous Real-Time Chunking, applies to policies queried in one shot. We instantiate it on a one-shot (ACT) and an iterative (DiT) backbone and evaluate in simulation and on a real bimanual ALOHA platform. The representation lowers within-chunk jerk by an order of magnitude on the one-shot backbone and by 2.4 times on the iterative one, with task success statistically non-inferior. The conditioning then removes 73-84% of the boundary discontinuity, at negligible per-step cost.

AI.tldr: 将动作分块（action chunking）中的轨迹段表示为平滑基函数的线性组合，从构造上保证轨迹平滑；并在推理时对系数做闭式条件化使新chunk通过上一chunk末动作这一via-point，从而同时消除块内与块间抖动，无需重训练，在ACT与DiT骨干及真实双臂ALOHA平台上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习策略普遍采用动作分块接口（一次输出多步动作），但chunk的时间结构仅被隐式学习，导致块内与块间轨迹不平滑；实机上表现为可见振动与从动端速度限幅反复饱和。
AI.method: 把轨迹段表示为平滑基函数（运动基元）的线性组合，使平滑性由构造保证，同时不改变策略架构、训练目标与推理流程；再对预测系数进行条件化，使新chunk通过上一chunk最后一条指令动作处的via-point，得到闭式、推理期校正，无需重训练，且适用于一次性（one-shot）查询的策略（区别于异步RTC）。在one-shot骨干ACT与迭代骨干DiT上实现，并在仿真与真实双臂ALOHA平台评测。
AI.result: 块内jerk在one-shot骨干上降低一个数量级，在迭代骨干上降低2.4倍，任务成功率统计上非劣；条件化去除73–84%的块间边界不连续，每步开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入基于运动基元的平滑轨迹表示并对chunk边界做闭式条件化，可在不修改策略与不重训练的前提下显著提升动作分块的时间平滑性，且不损失任务性能，具有工程实用性。

title: LiDAR-SHIELD: A Fully Dockerized Adversarial Robustness Assessment Framework for LiDAR-Based 3D Perception Models
summary: LiDAR-based 3D perception underpins autonomous driving and robotics, yet deploying these models safely requires stress-testing them against adversarial inputs before real-world use. Although state-of-the-art adversarial attacks exist, their implementations are often fragmented across individual repositories, each tied to a specific architecture or task and requiring manual environment reconstruction and model-specific integration code. We present LIDARSHIELD, a unified and fully Dockerized framework that reverses this workflow: rather than installing the target model inside the toolkit, LIDARSHIELD exposes any model through three lightweight HTTP endpoints, namely /info, /forward, and /gradient As a result, connecting a new model or dataset requires only a single loader function or adapter. The framework supports both 3D semantic segmentation and 3D object detection through the same engine-service protocol, integrating a task-aware suite of state-of-the-art attacks, including PGD and Square Attack for segmentation, and point perturbation, point removal, point injection, and LiDAttack for detection. This enables systematic exposure of corner cases and vulnerabilities across heterogeneous LiDAR backbones. The LiDAR-Shield codebase is publicly available at https://github.com/alexandrosgk/LiDAR-shield.

AI.tldr: LiDARSHIELD 是一个统一且完全 Docker 化的框架，通过三个轻量 HTTP 端点（/info、/forward、/gradient）将任意 3D 感知模型接入对抗攻击测试流程，统一支持语义分割与目标检测的多种先进攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有 LiDAR 对抗攻击实现分散于各自仓库，与特定架构或任务绑定，需手动重建环境并编写模型专用集成代码，缺乏统一、可复用的安全压力测试工具。
AI.method: 反转传统工作流：不在工具包内安装目标模型，而是以引擎—服务协议通过 /info、/forward、/gradient 三个 HTTP 端点暴露任意模型；接入新模型或数据集仅需一个加载函数或适配器。同一引擎协议下集成任务感知的攻击套件：分割任务采用 PGD 与 Square Attack，检测任务采用点扰动、点移除、点注入与 LiDAttack。
AI.result: 通过统一协议在异构 LiDAR 骨干网络上系统性地暴露边界案例与脆弱性，实现跨模型、跨任务的对抗鲁棒性评估，且部署与集成成本极低。
AI.conclusion: LiDARSHIELD 以解耦的端点式设计降低了对抗攻击评测的工程门槛，为 LiDAR 3D 感知模型提供了可扩展、易复用的安全测试基准，代码已开源。

title: Locating and Closing Information Gaps in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-step Web tasks often require several LLM agents to gather and combine evidence. The communication graph of a fixed workflow restricts which agents can read each other's outputs: evidence retrieved by one agent may never reach the agent that needs it, leaving an information gap and an incomplete or incorrect answer. Adding a connection can deliver the missing evidence, but can also lead the receiver to adopt an incorrect upstream conclusion that displaces a correct answer; the final output alone does not separate the two. We propose Selective Probing and Link Insertion for Closing information gaps in multi-agent Execution (SPLICE), which locates information gaps per query and decides what to adopt after adding an edge. After the original workflow runs, SPLICE uses the query and node outputs to locate a possible gap, adds one directed edge from a source to a receiver to deliver the relevant evidence, and re-executes the receiver and affected downstream nodes, producing a candidate answer. The adoption decision reads both the final answers of the two runs and the process changes the edit caused inside the workflow: how far the receiver moved, where its new content came from, and whether the change reached the final answer. A selector trained on these process features chooses between adopting the candidate answer and retaining the original. On five benchmarks, SPLICE raises the task score on Web tool use by 8.0% and the mean score on four reasoning and planning benchmarks by 5.7% relative to the static skeleton, at 1.25 to 1.44$\times$ the skeleton's cost, and transfers zero-shot to four unseen backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出SPLICE方法，通过逐查询定位多智能体工作流中的信息缺口并插入定向边，再依据过程特征选择是否采纳新候选答案，从而提升多步Web任务与推理规划任务的表现。
AI.motivation: 多步Web任务依赖多个LLM智能体汇集并组合证据，固定工作流的通信图限制了智能体间可读取的输出，导致某智能体检索的证据无法到达真正需要它的智能体，形成信息缺口并产生不完整或错误的答案。然而单纯增加连接虽可传递缺失证据，也可能使接收方采纳错误的上游结论，反而用错误答案取代原本正确的答案，且仅看最终输出无法区分这两种情况。
AI.method: SPLICE先运行原始工作流，利用查询与各节点输出定位潜在信息缺口；插入一条从源到接收方的有向边以传递相关证据，并重执行接收方及受影响的下游节点，得到候选答案。采纳决策同时读取两次运行的最终答案与编辑带来的过程变化，即接收方偏移程度、新内容来源、变化是否传导至最终答案；基于这些过程特征训练选择器，在采纳候选答案与保留原始答案间做决策。
AI.result: 在五个基准上，相比静态骨架，SPLICE在Web工具使用任务上提升8.0%，在四个推理与规划基准上平均提升5.7%，成本为骨架的1.25–1.44倍，并可零样本迁移到四个未见过的骨干模型。
AI.conclusion: SPLICE表明，对多智能体工作流通信图进行有针对性的、查询级的边插入，并辅以基于过程特征的采纳判定，能够在不显著增加成本的前提下有效弥补信息缺口、稳健提升任务表现，且具备良好的跨骨干泛化性。

title: Event-SAMA: Language-Grounded Video Object Segmentation on Neuromorphic Event Streams
summary: Event cameras offer microsecond temporal resolution, high dynamic range and no motion blur, but referring video object segmentation (RVOS) lacks event-stream datasets and models. We introduce Event-SAMA-239K, a synthetic-event conversion of the SAMA-239K grounded video-chat corpus and all additional SAMA training data: 30,650 video clips and 392,162 images. Optical-flow, FILM or saccade upsampling followed by a linear event generator preserves all mask, referring-expression and dialogue annotations. We also introduce Event-SAMA, adapting SAMA-4B with a two-channel polarity patch embedding initialised from pretrained RGB weights and a zero-initialised event adapter. End-to-end training yields 24.37 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ on MeViS valid_u and 22.33 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ on the converted ReVOS valid subset, establishing the first event-native RVOS baseline (RGB SAMA-4B: 55.4 on MeViS). Frozen RGB SAMA-4B with pseudo-RGB renderings or E2VID reconstructions of the same events scores 13.23 and 15.94 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$. Without retraining, Event-SAMA works on real event-camera recordings when the accumulation window matches their event density. A seed-controlled ablation with a measured noise floor of 0.47 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ finds gains from diverse training sources over MeViS alone (+4.99), RGB-mean event-stem initialisation (+4.33), and a trainable SAM2 mask decoder (+2.76); the event adapter, partial ViT unfreezing and event polarity are within noise at this budget. An earlier, partially converted corpus snapshot trained with the identical recipe scores 1.38 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ higher on MeViS and 1.12 higher on ReVOS. Both are single runs that also differ in schedule length, so we draw no conclusion about corpus scale.

AI.tldr: 首个事件相机原生RVOS基线：构建Event-SAMA-239K合成事件数据集并改造SAMA-4B为Event-SAMA，MeViS valid_u达24.37 𝒥&ℱ。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具备微秒级时间分辨率、高动态范围与无运动模糊优势，但RVOS缺乏事件流数据集与模型。作者希望建立首个事件原生RVOS基线，填补该空白。
AI.method: 将SAMA-239K grounding video-chat语料及全部SAMA训练数据（30,650视频片段、392,162图像）通过光流/FILM/扫视上采样加线性事件生成器转换为合成事件，完整保留掩码、指代表达与对话标注，得到Event-SAMA-239K。模型Event-SAMA在SAMA-4B基础上引入两通道极性patch embedding（由预训练RGB权重初始化）与零初始化事件适配器，端到端训练；冻结RGB SAMA-4B配合伪RGB渲染或E2VID重建作为对照。
AI.result: 端到端训练在MeViS valid_u达24.37 𝒥&ℱ，转换ReVOS valid子集达22.33 𝒥&ℱ（RGB SAMA-4B在MeViS为55.4）；冻结RGB SAMA-4B配伪RGB渲染/E2VID重建仅13.23与15.94。不经重训练，在累积窗口匹配事件密度时可迁移至真实事件相机录像。种子控制消融（噪声底0.47）显示：多源训练数据较仅MeViS增益+4.99、RGB均值event-stem初始化+4.33、可训练SAM2掩码解码器+2.76；事件适配器、部分ViT解冻与事件极性在该预算下处于噪声范围内。早期部分转换语料快照同配方在MeViS高1.38、ReVOS高1.12。
AI.conclusion: Event-SAMA确立了首个事件原生RVOS基线，验证了合成事件用于RVOS的可行性及跨域迁移潜力，但性能仍显著低于RGB基线。由于语料规模对比为单次运行且训练调度长度不同，作者不对语料规模效应下结论。

title: Sparse Fine-Tuning for Parameter-Efficient Adversarial Training
summary: Deep neural networks achieve strong performance across many tasks but remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. Adversarial training (AT) is one of the most effective defenses, yet it suffers from high memory cost on large models and the persistent clean-robust accuracy trade-off. Recent work introduces parameter-efficient fine-tuning, such as LoRA, into AT, but this constraint induces a notable robustness gap relative to full-parameter AT. In this work, we revisit parameter-efficient adversarial fine-tuning from a parameter space perspective. Through gradient analysis, we find that adversarial optimization is highly concentrated on a small subset of parameters, which we call Robustness-Critical Parameters (RCPs), suggesting that robustness is encoded in a sparse subspace. Building on this observation, we propose Sparse Adversarial Fine-Tuning (SAFT), which identifies RCPs via adversarial gradient saliency and performs AT by updating only these parameters while freezing the rest. Across architectures and datasets, SAFT outperforms LoRA-based methods in both clean and robust accuracy with fewer trainable parameters, and approaches or surpasses full parameter AT in robustness while updating only about 5\% of parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文从参数空间视角重新审视参数高效对抗微调，发现对抗优化高度集中于少量"鲁棒性关键参数"(RCPs)，据此提出SAFT——通过对抗梯度显著性识别RCPs并仅更新这些参数完成对抗训练，以约5%可训练参数达到接近甚至超越全参数对抗训练的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 对抗训练(AT)是有效防御但内存开销大且存在干净-鲁棒精度权衡；将LoRA等参数高效微调引入AT后，相比全参数AT仍有明显鲁棒性差距。作者希望探究这一差距的根源并加以消除。
AI.method: 从参数空间出发进行梯度分析，发现对抗优化高度集中于一小部分参数(Robustness-Critical Parameters, RCPs)，表明鲁棒性编码于稀疏子空间；进而提出SAFT(Sparse Adversarial Fine-Tuning)：利用对抗梯度显著性识别RCPs，在对抗训练中只更新这些参数、冻结其余参数。
AI.result: 在多种网络架构与数据集上，SAFT在干净精度与鲁棒精度上均优于基于LoRA的方法，且可训练参数更少；仅更新约5%参数即可在所有对比中接近甚至超过全参数AT的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒性可由稀疏参数子空间承载，基于梯度显著性选择RCPs的稀疏对抗微调是兼顾鲁棒性、精度与训练成本的有效方案，优于低秩结构约束式的参数高效对抗微调。

title: Open-set multi-view seahorse re-identification from underwater photograph sequences
summary: Automated animal re-identification from photograph sequences can facilitate minimally invasive Capture-Mark-Recapture studies at scale. Yet, photographs taken during an observation session can vary greatly in quality, not always providing the necessary information for accurate re-identification. In this paper, we present new methods for taxonomic classification, sex determination, and open-set re-identification from image sequences. We train and evaluate our models on a dataset of 35,914 photographs of 474 individual seahorses observed in the wild. We demonstrate that our approach, by combining information from multiple photographs, yields state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出面向图像序列的海马分类、性别判定与开集重识别方法，在35,914张、474尾野生海马数据集上验证，通过融合多张照片信息达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 自动化动物重识别可支撑大规模、微创的捕获-标记-重捕研究；但同一次观测中的照片质量差异大，单张图常不足以支撑准确重识别，因此需要利用图像序列。
AI.method: 基于图像序列的新方法：分类学分类（物种）、性别判定与开集重识别（open-set re-identification），通过整合同一观测会话中多张照片的信息进行建模；在野生海马图像数据集上训练与评估。
AI.result: 在35,914张照片、474个个体海马的数据集上，多图信息融合策略取得当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: 多照片序列融合能有效缓解图像质量波动带来的信息不足，使自动化海马识别具备支撑大规模、微创CMR研究的可行性。

title: Bridging Semantics and Structure: A Theoretically Grounded Framework for Link Prediction on TAGs
comment: 33 pages. Accepted for publication in ACM Transactions on Knowledge Discovery from Data (TKDD)
summary: Link prediction on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) is a fundamental problem with applications in knowledge discovery, recommendation and beyond. Recent progress has highlighted the promise of combining Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) with Language Models (LMs) in order to leverage the complementary structural and semantic signals. However, due to the distinct inductive biases of GNNs and LMs, the design of an optimal fusion strategy remains an open research question. In this work, we present Bridge-LP, an intuitive, simple, efficient and theoretically grounded framework that unifies graph and language representations. It is built around three theoretically-justified design components: (D1) jumping connection of textual proximity, which enables robust LM training; (D2) compressed embedding, which encodes neighborhood information long exploited by classical link prediction heuristics, thereby enriching structural signals in a learnable way; and (D3) cache embedding training strategy, which reduces computational complexity. Together, these mechanisms establish an end-to-end cross-modal framework that scales to large graphs while capturing richer graph-text interactions. We conduct an extensive empirical evaluation, comparing against 40 existing models across 9 diverse datasets. Experiments show that Bridge-LP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, delivering up to a 43.06% improvement in Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) and setting a new benchmark for language-graph integration.

AI.tldr: 提出Bridge-LP，一个简洁高效的图-语言统一框架，通过三个理论支撑的设计组件融合GNN与LM实现文本属性图上的链接预测，在9个数据集上超越40个基线模型。
AI.motivation: 文本属性图(TAGs)上的链接预测在知识发现、推荐等场景中很重要。GNN与LM结合可利用结构与语义互补信号，但二者归纳偏置不同，如何设计最优融合策略仍是开放问题。
AI.method: Bridge-LP包含三个理论支撑组件：(D1)文本邻近性的跳跃连接，支持稳健的LM训练；(D2)压缩嵌入，以可学习方式编码经典链接预测启发式利用的邻域信息，丰富结构信号；(D3)缓存嵌入训练策略，降低计算复杂度。三者构成端到端跨模态框架。
AI.result: 在9个多样化数据集上与40个现有模型对比，Bridge-LP持续优于SOTA，MRR最高提升43.06%，树立语言-图集成新基准。
AI.conclusion: Bridge-LP以直观、高效且理论完备的方式统一图与语言表示，可扩展至大图并捕捉更丰富的图-文本交互，为TAG链接预测提供新基准。

title: Achieving Minimax-Optimal First-Order and Best-of-Both-Worlds Regret Simultaneously in Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: We study first-order and best-of-both-worlds regret guarantees in multi-armed bandits. Pogodin and Lattimore (2019) proposed an algorithm that combines minimax-optimal worst-case regret with a first-order guarantee whose loss-dependent term is $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{K L^\star}\log T)$, where $T$ denotes the horizon, $L^\star$ denotes the smallest expected cumulative loss among fixed arms, and $K$ denotes the number of arms. However, a logarithmic gap remains between this loss-dependent term and the optimal first-order scale. In this paper, we remove this logarithmic factor by proposing an efficient and parameter-free algorithm that achieves the minimax optimal first-order regret guarantee $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{K L^\star})$. Technically, our algorithm is built upon FTRL with a Tsallis entropy regularizer (Zimmert and Seldin,2021), with a learning rate adapted to the learner's cumulative loss and a sampling distribution determined by a scalar fixed point. This construction controls the combined estimation and stability cost in terms of the learner's loss. Moreover, we show that the same algorithm achieves a best-of-both-worlds guarantee, with $\mathcal{O}(\sum_{i\ne i^\star}\frac{\log T}{Δ_i})$ regret for i.i.d. losses with a unique best arm $i^\star$, where $Δ_i$ denotes the suboptimality gap of arm $i$.

AI.tldr: 本文去除Pogodin与Lattimore(2019)算法一阶遗憾中损失相关项的log T因子，提出高效、无参数算法，达到极小极大最优的一阶遗憾O(√(K L*))，并同时具备最优世界-最差世界(best-of-both-worlds)保证。
AI.motivation: 现有一阶后悔界中损失相关项为O(√(K L*) log T)，与最优的一阶尺度O(√(K L*))之间仍存在对数间隙，作者希望消除该间隙，同时兼顾最优情形(随机损失)与最差情形(对抗损失)的保证。
AI.method: 基于带Tsallis熵正则项的FTRL框架(Zimmert与Seldin, 2021)：学习率依据学习者的累积损失自适应调整，采样分布由一个标量不动点确定；该构造以学习者损失为尺度控制估计误差与稳定性代价之和。
AI.result: 算法达到极小极大最优的一阶后悔界O(√(K L*))，并对具有唯一最优臂i*的独立同分布损失达到O(∑_{i≠i*} log T / Δ_i)的后悔。
AI.conclusion: 所提算法参数无关且高效，同时实现最优一阶后悔与best-of-both-worlds保证，统一了对对抗与随机两种损失环境的理论刻画。

authors: Udaya Sampath K. Perera Miriya Thanthrige
title: M-PFT: Angular Margin for Calibrated Prompt-Tuning of Fine-Tuned Vision-Language Models
summary: Prompt-tuning has emerged as a parameter-efficient technique for adapting large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) to downstream tasks while keeping the pre-trained weights frozen. However, prompt-tuned VLMs often suffer from a base-to-novel dual miscalibration problem, where models typically show underconfidence on base classes and overconfidence on novel classes. Current VLM calibration approaches address this dual miscalibration either separately or jointly, but lack a geometric understanding of the hyperspherical embedding space and thus fail to exploit angular discriminative properties to adjust distorted decision boundaries. To address this, we propose M-PFT, a novel angular-margin approach for prompt tuning that introduces two complementary objectives to promote class discriminability and semantic anchoring. This enlarges the angular margin by 1) minimizing the maximum cosine similarity between tunable class embeddings to reduce embedding collapse and 2) minimizing the angular distance between each tunable embedding and its corresponding zero-shot embedding to preserve semantic geometry. Extensive experiments across 9 prompt-tuning methods with various backbones on 15 diverse datasets show that our approach reduces the average calibration error on novel classes, while remaining competitive on base classes and maintaining comparable accuracy. Further analyses reveal that M-PFT effectively adjusts distorted decision boundaries induced by prompt tuning while preserving the pre-trained embedding space, improving calibration with negligible computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出M-PFT，一种基于角度间隔的prompt tuning方法，通过最大化可学习类嵌入间余弦相似度的最小值与对齐零样本嵌入的角度距离来扩大角度间隔，缓解base-to-novel双重校准失配，在15个数据集、9种prompt tuning方法上降低novel类校准误差且保持精度。
AI.motivation: prompt-tuned VLM存在base-to-novel双重误校准：base类欠自信、novel类过自信。现有校准方法或将二者分开处理或联合处理，但缺乏对超球嵌入空间的几何理解，无法利用角度判别性质调整扭曲的决策边界。
AI.method: 提出M-PFT角度间隔框架，引入两个互补目标以扩大角度间隔：(1) 最小化可学习类嵌入之间的最大余弦相似度，抑制嵌入塌缩；(2) 最小化每个可学习嵌入与其对应零样本嵌入之间的角度距离，保持语义几何结构。预训练权重保持冻结。
AI.result: 在15个数据集、多种backbone、9种prompt tuning方法上开展实验：novel类平均校准误差下降，base类保持竞争力，精度相当。进一步分析表明M-PFT有效调整prompt tuning造成的扭曲决策边界，同时保留预训练嵌入空间，计算开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 从角度几何视角出发，M-PFT以极低开销同时改善novel类校准、保持base类校准与精度，为prompt-tuned VLM的校准问题提供了有效的几何化解决方案。

title: EpiAgent: Epistemic Self-Play for LLM Agents
summary: Epistemic game theory explains an agent's strategic behavior via the beliefs it holds about others and how these beliefs are updated as the interactions unfold. Modern LLM-based agents, however, often lack an explicit mechanism for learning and updating such beliefs to guide decisions under incomplete information. To bridge this gap, we propose EpiAgent, a framework that equips LLM-based agents with an explicit, learnable epistemic layer, which maintains beliefs over others' private information and combines these beliefs with the agent's available information into an epistemic state for action selection. Concretely, the agent's policy is decomposed into two coupled stages: Epistemic Update, which updates these beliefs from interaction histories, and Action Planning, which selects actions conditioned on the updated epistemic state. By formulating their dependency as a bi-level optimization problem, we introduce Epistemic Self-Play, an algorithm that alternately optimizes the two stages through self-play, utilizing an intrinsic prediction reward to evaluate how well inferred beliefs predict subsequent observations. Empirical results across both mixed and competitive scenarios show that EpiAgent consistently outperforms prompting-based and RL-based baselines. Further analyses reveal the benefits of dedicated epistemic training, improvements in belief inference accuracy, and the contribution of learned beliefs to action planning. These results demonstrate the value of an explicit, learnable epistemic layer for effective multi-agent interactions.

AI.tldr: 提出 EpiAgent，为 LLM 智能体引入显式、可学习的认知（epistemic）层，维护对他人私有信息的信念并结合自身信息形成认知状态用于决策；通过双层优化与 Epistemic Self-Play 交替训练信念更新与动作规划，在混合与合作/竞争场景中优于 prompting 与 RL 基线。
AI.motivation: 认知博弈论通过智能体对他人持有的信念及信念随交互的更新来解释策略行为；但现有基于 LLM 的智能体缺乏显式机制来学习和更新此类信念，难以在不完全信息下指导决策。作者希望弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 将策略分解为两个耦合阶段：Epistemic Update（从交互历史更新对他人私有信息的信念）与 Action Planning（以更新后的认知状态为条件选择动作）；将二者依赖建模为双层优化问题，提出 Epistemic Self-Play 算法，借助自博弈交替优化两阶段，并使用内在预测奖励评估推断信念对后续观测的预测能力。
AI.result: 在混合与竞争场景中，EpiAgent 稳定优于基于 prompting 和基于 RL 的基线；分析显示专门的认知训练带来收益，信念推断准确率提升，且学习到的信念对动作规划有实际贡献。
AI.conclusion: 显式、可学习的认知层对有效的多智能体交互具有明确价值，为 LLM 智能体在不完全信息博弈中的信念建模提供了可行范式。

title: CBE: A Complexity-adaptive Boundary-aware Ensemble Method for Imbalanced Data
summary: In many real-world classification tasks, datasets exhibit class imbalance, which can degrade the generalization performance of conventional learning algorithms. Data complexity has recently been recognized as a more objective indicator of learning difficulty than the imbalance ratio alone, because class overlap and complex decision boundaries often impair classifiers more severely than imbalance itself. Samples near the decision boundary are inherently difficult to classify, which has motivated many researchers to focus on such instances to improve classifier performance. However, most under-sampling approaches fail to differentiate their sampling of boundary samples across datasets of varying complexity. To overcome this limitation, we propose a complexity-adaptive boundary-aware ensemble (CBE) framework that links the sampling weight distribution to data complexity and dynamically adjusts the boundary preference of under-sampling accordingly. We also introduce an overall complexity measure that combines metrics at multiple levels and use it to divide imbalanced datasets into three categories. Extensive experiments on 24 benchmark datasets from UCI and KEEL show that the proposed method outperforms many existing methods in terms of F-measure and G-mean on Easy and Median datasets, without degrading performance on hard cases.

AI.tldr: 提出复杂度自适应边界感知集成框架CBE，将采样权重分布与数据复杂度关联，动态调整欠采样对边界样本的偏好；并用多层级综合复杂度度量将不平衡数据集分为三类，在24个基准数据集上取得更好F-measure与G-mean。
AI.motivation: 类别不平衡数据集中，仅用不平衡比不足以刻画学习难度，类重叠与复杂决策边界往往比不平衡本身危害更大；而现有大多数欠采样方法在不同复杂度数据集上对边界样本的采样策略一成不变，缺乏自适应性。
AI.method: 1) 定义多层级指标组合的"整体复杂度度量"，据此把不平衡数据集划分为Easy、Median、Hard三类；2) 构建复杂度自适应边界感知集成框架(CBE)，使采样权重分布与数据复杂度挂钩，按复杂度动态调节欠采样的边界偏好；3) 以集成方式结合多个基分类器。
AI.result: 在UCI与KEEL共24个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，CBE在Easy与Median数据集上的F-measure和G-mean优于多种现有方法，且在Hard数据集上性能不下降。
AI.conclusion: 将数据复杂度作为先验来驱动边界感知欠采样的自适应调节是有效且稳健的：可在易/中等复杂度不平衡数据上显著提升少数类识别性能，同时保持高复杂度场景下的性能，体现了复杂度感知采样策略的合理性与泛化性。

title: Parametric Gaussian Noise Mixer (PGNM): Unified Synthesis of Camera Noise and Film Grain
comment: Technical report. 49 pages: 9-page main paper and 40-page supplementary material; 29 figures, 33 tables
summary: Noise synthesis is commonly approached through physical models of image formation or neural networks trained to generate noisy images. We explore a middle ground: an explicit statistical model fitted directly from paired clean and noisy images. A normalized convolution correlates a Gaussian field across pixels and color channels, and a lookup maps each Gaussian value to a residual given the clean intensity. Because the field stays standard Gaussian, the two components are fitted separately, without reproducing the physical process or training a neural generator. With one formulation for camera noise from SIDD and simulated film grain from Newson, the model has the lowest average distribution and correlation errors on SIDD among the evaluated methods and remains competitive on film grain. A denoiser trained on its noise comes closest to one trained on real noise, and a 1080p frame renders in 10 ms on GPU.

AI.tldr: 提出一种由配对干净/噪声图像直接拟合的显式统计噪声合成模型：归一化卷积将高斯场在像素与颜色通道间相关化，查表将高斯值依干净强度映射为残差；因场保持标准高斯，两部分可分别拟合。
AI.motivation: 现有噪声合成多依赖成像物理模型或训练神经网络生成噪声图像，前者需复现物理过程，后者需训练生成器；作者试图在两者之间寻找折中，即直接从真实配对数据拟合一个显式统计模型。
AI.method: 显式统计模型：用归一化卷积（normalized convolution）对高斯场做跨像素与跨颜色通道的相关化，再用查表（lookup）依据干净图像的强度值将每个高斯值映射为残差。由于场始终保持标准高斯分布，相关结构与强度-残差映射两个组件可解耦、分别拟合，无需复现物理成像过程也无需训练神经生成器。同一形式化同时适用于 SIDD 相机噪声与 Newson 模拟胶片颗粒。
AI.result: 在 SIDD 上，该方法在所评估方法中平均分布误差与相关性误差最低；在胶片颗粒数据上保持竞争力。用其合成噪声训练的去噪器性能最接近用真实噪声训练的去噪器；1080p 帧在 GPU 上渲染约 10 ms。
AI.conclusion: 以显式、可解耦、轻量的统计建模替代物理模型与神经生成器，可在相机噪声与胶片颗粒上获得高保真且高效的噪声合成，并对下游去噪训练具有实用价值。

title: EnvOS: Auditing Computer-Use Agents When the World Moves On : Phenomenon-Based Task Construction, Certification, and Evidence-Based Evaluation
comment: 74 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshops (AABA4ET and CL4FMAgents)
summary: Computer-use agents built on large language models (LLMs) work in software that can change while they act: an appointment moves, a policy is revised, a record is updated. Testing agents under such changes is harder than it looks. When an agent fails, the cause may be the agent, but it may also be a change that did not fire as intended, an update the agent never received, or a grader that scored the episode wrongly. We introduce EnvOS, a framework for building and certifying environments that change mid-task. Before any agent runs, EnvOS checks that each change fires correctly, that the task remains solvable, and that the grader separates correct from incorrect behavior; after each run, separate code re-checks the verdict from archived evidence. We apply it to stale information, where a value the agent has already seen changes before the agent acts on it. In clinic booking, Claude Opus 5 succeeds on 0/16 tasks when nothing extra is shown, 2/16 when reminded to re-check the source, and 15/16 when the updated value is shown; the gain over the reminder holds after correcting for all tests (p = 0.00293). In insurance-claim approval, Opus 5 re-checks on its own and succeeds on 10/10, whereas Claude Sonnet 5 rises from 1/10 to 9/10 when the current policy is shown again, a gain significant in its pre-registered test but not after correcting for all tests. Whether an agent caught a change thus varied with the model and the interface. We also stress-test the grading itself: on corrupted episodes designed blind from the rules, the EnvOS pipeline accepted none of 26 as clean, and on an externally generated set it caught 25 of 39, against 4 for simple log checks. Because every EnvOS environment is generated from a seed and graded by an audited automatic verifier, the same environments are natural candidates for training agents with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards.

AI.tldr: EnvOS是一个用于构建与认证"任务中途发生变更"环境的框架，在agent运行前验证变更正确触发、任务仍可解、评分器能区分正误，运行后由独立代码基于存档证据复核判定，并用于研究陈旧信息场景。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用型LLM agent在会变化的软件中工作（预约改期、政策修订、记录更新）。此类动态环境下测试agent的归因困难：失败可能源于agent本身，也可能源于变更未按预期触发、agent未收到更新、或评分器误判。因此需要可信的环境与评分。
AI.method: 提出EnvOS框架：运行前做三项认证——变更是否按预期触发、任务是否仍可解、评分器能否区分正确与错误行为；运行后由独立代码基于存档证据复核结论。应用于"陈旧信息"场景（agent已见数值在其行动前发生变化），包括诊所预约与保险理赔审批两个任务，并对比不同提示/界面条件。同时对评分本身做压力测试：使用盲设计规则构造的污染episode及外部生成数据集，与简单日志检查对比。
AI.result: 诊所预约：Claude Opus 5在无额外提示时0/16，提醒重新核对来源2/16，直接展示更新后数值15/16；相对提醒的提升在多重检验校正后仍显著（p=0.00293）。保险理赔：Opus 5自主复查，10/10成功；Claude Sonnet 5在重新展示当前政策后由1/10升至9/10，该提升在预注册检验中显著但多重校正后不显著。评分压力测试：污染episode中EnvOS流水线对26个均未判定为干净；外部生成集39个中检出25个，而简单日志检查仅4个。
AI.conclusion: agent是否察觉变更随模型与界面而异，说明环境与界面设计对评测结论有实质影响。EnvOS环境由种子生成、由经审计的自动验证器评分，因而天然适合作为基于可验证奖励的强化学习训练环境。

title: Surprise Alone Learns Lies: Evidence-Gated Continual Learning for LLMs from Streaming Claims
summary: Continual learning methods for large language models increasingly decide what to learn by surprise, keeping the inputs the model finds least predictable. This rule is unsafe when the stream contains lies. A planted falsehood about something the model knows has low probability under the model's belief, so it is highly surprising by construction, and a surprise-driven learner absorbs nearly every such lie, at a rate similar to random selection with the same budget. We study the problem with LoRA-adapted students (Qwen2.5-1.5B, Qwen2.5-3B and Llama-3.2-3B) that learn from a stream of true and false claims about invented people and real CounterFact facts. We report four findings. (1) A verifier key, a judge that must approve each claim, removes lies to the extent that its verifier is accurate; real LLM judges are cautious and reject unsourced truths and even source-backed updates. (2) Calibrated regression tests on unrelated knowledge slow learning down without filtering out lies. (3) The original model's own prior flags claims that contradict what it knows, without a judge. It separates lies about known facts from true new facts (AUC 0.78-0.83 across three models) but not from legitimate updates of the same kind of fact (AUC 0.53). It saves 43% of judge calls, but an attacker with access to the model can choose lies that pass it. (4) If trusted sources exist that an attacker cannot plant, routing contradicted claims to evidence recovers legitimate updates and the combined system has the lowest poison rate among learned claims; when an attacker plants matching sources for 30% of the lies, the system ends up worse than the judge alone. The acceptance signals answer different questions, and none of them decides on its own whether a claim is true.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"惊奇度驱动"的持续学习在含虚假信息数据流中不安全：模型基于低概率（高惊奇度）选择学习内容时，几乎会吸收所有"被植入的谎言"。作者用LoRA微调Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B与Llama-3.2-3B，在虚构人物与CounterFact事实上测试四种"接受信号"（验证者门控、校准回归测试、模型自身先验、可信源路由），发现各信号回答不同问题，没有任何单一信号能独立判定真伪。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM持续学习方法普遍用"惊奇度（surprise）"决定学什么，即保留模型最不可预测的输入。该规则在数据流含谎言时存在结构性缺陷：关于模型已知事实的植入性谎言按构造就是高惊奇度的，因而惊奇驱动学习器会几乎全部吸收。作者希望系统评估这一问题，并考察若干替代性"接受信号"能否安全地过滤谎言。
AI.method: 以LoRA适配的Qwen2.5-1.5B、Qwen2.5-3B、Llama-3.2-3B为学习器，训练数据流由关于虚构人物的真/假陈述与真实CounterFact事实构成。对比四类接受信号：(1)验证者门控——由LLM裁判批准每条声明；(2)对无关知识的校准回归测试；(3)原始模型自身先验（标记与已知事实矛盾的声明，无需裁判）；(4)可信源路由——将受矛盾声明导向不可被攻击者植入的证据源。以随机选择为同等预算基线，度量谎言吸收率/中毒率。
AI.result: 四项发现：(1)验证者门控按验证器准确度去除谎言，但真实LLM裁判过于谨慎，会拒收无来源的真实陈述乃至有来源的真更新；(2)校准回归测试只是减慢学习，并不滤除谎言；(3)模型自身先验无需裁判即可标记矛盾声明，区分"关于已知事实的谎言"与"真实新事实"AUC 0.78–0.83（三模型），但与同类型事实的合法更新区分仅AUC 0.53；可节省43%裁判调用，但能访问模型的攻击者可构造绕过它的谎言；(4)若存在攻击者无法植入的可信源，路由可使合法更新被恢复，组合系统在"已学习声明"中中毒率最低；然而当攻击者为30%的谎言配好匹配来源时，系统劣于单用裁判。惊奇驱动学习对谎言的吸收率接近同预算随机选择。
AI.conclusion: 惊奇度作为"该学什么"的准则在对抗性数据流中不安全。各类接受信号（裁判、回归测试、自先验、来源路由）各自回答不同问题（如"是否有来源""是否与已知矛盾"），没有任何单一信号能独立判定声明真伪；可靠的安全依赖于多个信号互补，且前提是可信源不可被伪造。

title: Topology Survives Shuffling: Robust Long-Context Memory Access Prediction for Graph Analytics
summary: Graph analytics generates irregular, topology-dependent memory-access streams via indirect traversals, limiting data prefetching. Accurate prediction enables timely prefetches that hide memory latency. However, ML predictors couple short histories with fixed horizons, fitting the training trace's node layout rather than learning transferable graph patterns. We propose LoCoMAP, a long-context representation-learning framework for memory-access prediction with independently controlled observation history and prediction horizon. We evaluate Connected Components (CC), PageRank (PR), and Single-Source Shortest Paths (SSSP) on six synthetic graph families, with Erdos-Renyi (ER) and Grid as random and deterministic controls. We test two interventions: same-family regeneration changes connectivity, while node shuffling disrupts layout but preserves connectivity. Across 18 graph-workload pairs, extending history from 8 to 128 accesses improves F1 by 7.8%, while extending prediction horizon from 8 to 512 improves F1 by 88.3%. For CC, regeneration is less disruptive than shuffling: without retraining, long context retains 95.4% of original F1 and outperforms short context in six families. Under full shuffle, long context improves CC F1 by 33.6% across ER, Barabasi-Albert, Copying Model, and Stochastic Block Model (SBM), with a 2.06x gain on SBM, but not on Watts-Strogatz or Grid, where near-zero delta mass shifts into heavy tails beyond the predictor's range. Long context outperforms short context on six real-world CC graphs. At full shuffle, long-context PR retains 57.6% of original F1 and averages 11.0% above short context. Both SSSP models retain about 30% of original F1 under full shuffle as distance updates access vertex data in a new order. Within these bounds, long-context predictors are robust across related graphs and layouts without retraining, enabling a generalizable graph prefetcher.

AI.tldr: 提出LoCoMAP，一种解耦观测历史长度与预测视野的长上下文表示学习框架，用于图分析访存预测；长历史与长视野分别带来7.8%与88.3%的F1提升，且在布局扰动与同族图再生下保持较强泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 图分析（CC、PR、SSSP）通过间接遍历产生不规则、依赖拓扑的访存流，使预取困难。已有机器学习预测器将短历史与固定预测视野耦合，实质是在拟合训练轨迹的节点布局，而非学习可迁移的图结构模式，导致跨图、跨布局泛化差。
AI.method: LoCoMAP将观测历史与预测视野独立控制，采用长上下文表示学习。实验覆盖6类合成图族（含ER随机对照与Grid确定性对照）及真实图，评测CC、PR、SSSP共18个图-工作负载组合；设置两种干预：同族图再生（改变连通性）与节点重排（破坏布局但保留连通性），并比较8→128访问历史、8→512预测视野的影响。
AI.result: 历史由8增至128使F1提升7.8%，视野由8增至512使F1提升88.3%（视野扩展收益更显著）。CC下，再生扰动弱于重排：不重训练时长上下文保留95.4%原始F1，并在6个图族上优于短上下文；完全重排下，长上下文在ER、BA、Copying、SBM上将CC F1提升33.6%（SBM达2.06倍），但在WS与Grid上无收益——其近零增量质量在重排后移入预测器范围外的高重尾。真实CC图上长上下文均优于短上下文。完全重排下PR保留57.6%原始F1，平均高于短上下文11.0%；SSSP两模型仅保留约30%，因距离更新以新顺序访问顶点数据。
AI.conclusion: 在给定边界内，长上下文预测器无需重训练即可在同族图与不同布局间保持鲁棒性，为可泛化的图预取器提供了依据；其主要局限在于重尾/低增量分布（WS、Grid）与SSSP类重排序访问模式。

title: What Survives Label Downsampling? Exact Region Survival for Coarse Segmentation Targets
summary: Segmentation networks that predict at an output stride are trained against label maps downsampled by strided sampling, nearest-neighbor resampling or majority pooling. These methods label each coarse grid cell on its own, so a region that wins no cell is absent from the target and receives no positive label. We present MatchDown, which builds the coarse target from a minimum-cost matching between regions and the grid cells they occupy. It keeps as many regions as any one-region-per-cell target can, certifies how many losses are unavoidable, and with priority tiers (MatchDown-P) keeps every evaluated region (a region that a metric scores) of at least one cell's area. On COCO, Cityscapes and BBBC038 at factors 2 to 16, MatchDown-P loses exactly the minimum number of regions, whereas the downsampling used by StarDist, nnU-Net and connectomics pyramids loses four to five times as many on COCO at factor 8. Keeping a region in the target and reconstructing its shape are different problems: we show that no region lost by majority pooling can be reconstructed above IoU 0.5 by upsampling any coarse target, yet on BBBC038 a star-convex head trained on MatchDown targets segments 35% of the nuclei that majority pooling loses above IoU 0.5, against 15% when trained on majority targets and 24% on StarDist's strided target. On two nucleus datasets, with thresholds cross-validated for count error, this head has instance accuracy at IoU 0.5 (Acc50) 2.6 to 4.2 points above the strided target and at most 2.8 points below cell-center sampling, and a lower count error than the strided and cell-center targets on BBBC039. On BBBC039, an affinity head, which outputs one label per cell, lowers count error relative to majority targets by 9.3 nuclei per image at 7.2 points lower Acc50. MatchDown runs once, before training, in place of the label-downsampling step.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MatchDown：用区域与网格单元的最小费用匹配构建分割网络的粗粒度标签，并给出不可避损失认证与优先分层（MatchDown-P）；在多数据集上显著减少区域丢失并提升实例分割与计数表现。
AI.motivation: 现有输出步长下的分割训练使用降采样标签（跨步采样、最近邻重采样或多数池化），逐单元独立打标签，导致未"赢得"任何单元的细小区域从目标中消失、得不到正标签。
AI.method: 将粗标签生成建模为区域与所占网格单元之间的最小费用匹配（MatchDown），保证保留的连通区域数达到"一单元一区域"目标的上界，并认证最少不可避免的损失数；加入优先级分层（MatchDown-P），确保面积不小于一个单元的每个被评估区域都被保留。方法在训练前一次性替代标签降采样步骤。
AI.result: COCO、Cityscapes、BBBC038 在 2–16 倍因子下，MatchDown-P 恰好只丢失最少数量区域，而 StarDist/nnU-Net/连接组金字塔的降采样在 COCO 因子 8 下多丢 4–5 倍；BBBC038 上星凸头配合 MatchDown 目标可分割出 35% 被多数池化丢失的核（IoU>0.5），优于多数目标 15% 与跨步目标 24%；两个核数据集上 Acc50 比跨步目标高 2.6–4.2 点，BBBC039 计数误差更低；仿射头则计数误差降 9.3 个/图但 Acc50 低 7.2 点。
AI.conclusion: 标签"保留区域"与"重建形状"是两个不同问题：任何上采样都无法恢复多数池化丢失的区域（IoU>0.5）；MatchDown 作为训练前的标签构建步骤可无损保留可保留区域，并带来更好的实例精度与计数表现。

title: Reaction precedents extend retrosynthetic prediction beyond training coverage
summary: Reaction precedents guide retrosynthesis, but how far they can compensate for gaps in task-specific training coverage remains unclear. Using 2.71 million reactions, we restricted training and retrieval coverage by transformation or time, then expanded only the retrieval corpus with model parameters fixed. For transformations excluded from training, mean Top-1 accuracy increased from 13.0% to 58.0% on a historical test set and from 4.9% to 23.1% on a temporally held-out test set. For temporal coverage gaps, retrieval expansion enabled a model trained on records before 2017 to match or exceed a non-retrieval model trained on records before 2025 on both test sets. Without task-specific fine-tuning, precedents improved all 14 representative general-purpose models on both test sets and USPTO-50K; the strongest with precedents surpassed all eight representative specialized models. These findings show that inference-time reaction precedents can extend retrosynthetic prediction beyond task-specific training coverage without parameter updates.

AI.tldr: 本文系统量化了推理阶段"反应先例检索"对逆合成预测的补偿作用：在训练参数固定的前提下，仅扩充检索语料即可显著提升未覆盖转化与时间外推场景的Top-1准确率，使早期模型追平甚至超越用更新数据训练的模型，并且无需任务微调即可普适地增强通用大模型。
AI.motivation: 逆合成常依赖反应先例作为参考，但当任务特定训练覆盖存在缺口（某些反应类型未见于训练集、或训练数据时间滞后）时，先例检索究竟能补偿多少尚不清楚。作者希望分离"参数化知识"与"检索式先例"两种信息来源，明确检索在训练覆盖不足时的边际价值。
AI.method: 基于271万条反应数据，分别按反应类型（transformation）和时间（time）人为限制训练与检索覆盖；随后保持模型参数冻结，仅扩充检索语料，构造"有/无检索"的对照实验。评测采用历史测试集与时间留出测试集，并在14个代表性通用模型及USPTO-50K上与8个代表性专用模型对比。
AI.result: 对被排除于训练的转化，平均Top-1准确率由13.0%升至58.0%（历史测试集）、由4.9%升至23.1%（时间留出测试集）。对时间覆盖缺口，检索扩充使仅用2017年前数据训练的模型在两个测试集上达到或超过用2025年前数据训练的无检索模型。在无任务特定微调下，先例使全部14个通用模型在两个测试集及USPTO-50K上均获提升，且带先例的最强通用模型超过全部8个专用模型。
AI.conclusion: 推理时引入反应先例可在不更新参数的情况下，将逆合成预测能力扩展到任务特定训练覆盖之外，是一种低成本、模型无关的知识注入手段，可部分替代对更新训练数据与专用模型的依赖。

title: Attention, Dynamic Wave and Hybrid Sequence Mixers in Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on Multi-Head Attention (MHA) for sequence modeling, but scaling to long contexts is constrained by the quadratic cost of attention, motivating sub-quadratic recurrent alternatives. This paper formalizes a Dynamic Wave recurrent layer, based on input-dependent exponential damping and cosine phase modulation, and evaluates three 10.94M-parameter configurations (Pure Transformer, Pure Wave, and Hybrid Wave-Attention) on TinyStories under perplexity, latency, throughput and peak VRAM profiling up to 4096 tokens. The Hybrid configuration reaches the best perplexity, 5.95 on the full held-out split against 6.93 for the Transformer and 7.26 for Pure Wave. The efficiency picture, however, is governed by implementation rather than by architecture. Against an unfused attention baseline, Pure Wave uses 78.7% less peak VRAM at a 4096-token context (1404.3 MB vs. 6601.6 MB); against a fused scaled-dot-product attention kernel the same comparison yields no advantage at all (1404.3 MB vs. 1403.6 MB), and in training mode Pure Wave is 8.3% more expensive than the Transformer. Likewise, hoisting elementwise terms out of the recurrence loop speeds the layer up 2.53-fold with no custom kernel, reducing its latency gap to attention from 2.48-fold to 1.12-fold. A hybrid stack is found to inherit the cost of its more expensive mixer rather than the advantage of its cheaper one, its peak VRAM matching the Pure Transformer to within 0.1%. A closed-form memory model reproduces these measurements and predicts the context length beyond which attention overtakes the vocabulary projection. The findings indicate that reported efficiency gains for recurrent attention replacements must be stated relative to a named attention backend and a named implementation, and that hybridization is best justified on quality grounds.

AI.tldr: Dynamic Wave循环层在TinyStories上以混合架构取得最优困惑度（5.95），但其显存与延迟优势完全取决于注意力后端与实现细节，而非架构本身。
AI.motivation: LLMs依赖MHA，长上下文受二次注意力成本限制，需要亚二次复杂度的循环替代方案；同时需厘清效率收益究竟来自架构还是实现。
AI.method: 形式化提出Dynamic Wave循环层（输入相关的指数衰减+余弦相位调制）；在TinyStories上以10.94M参数规模对比Pure Transformer、Pure Wave、Hybrid Wave-Attention三种配置，评测困惑度、延迟、吞吐与峰值显存（至4096 token）。
AI.result: Hybrid取得最佳困惑度5.95（Transformer 6.93，Pure Wave 7.26）。效率取决于实现：相对未融合注意力基线，Pure Wave在4096 token下峰值显存降低78.7%（1404.3 MB vs 6601.6 MB）；相对融合SDPA内核则无优势（1404.3 MB vs 1403.6 MB），训练模式下Pure Wave反比Transformer贵8.3%。将逐元素项移出循环体（无自定义内核）使该层加速2.53倍，延迟差距由2.48倍降至1.12倍。混合栈继承较贵混合器的成本而非较便宜者的优势，峰值显存与Pure Transformer相差在0.1%以内。闭式内存模型可复现测量，并预测注意力超过词表投影的上下文长度阈值。
AI.conclusion: 循环注意力替代方案的效率收益必须相对于指定的注意力后端与具体实现来报告；混合化应主要基于质量（困惑度）而非效率理由。

title: Interpretable by Design Tabular Prediction via In-Context Local Linear Learning
summary: In-context learning (ICL) lets tabular foundation models make predictions without dataset-specific training or fine-tuning. These models achieve strong predictive accuracy, but interpreting how individual features contribute to the prediction remains difficult. In biology, for example, feature contributions can help identify biomarkers or risk genes. Post-hoc interpretability methods assign feature importance scores, but these scores do not indicate what the model actually uses and can lead to explanation errors. We introduce TICL$^3$ (Tabular In-Context Local Linear Learning), an interpretable-by-design predictor that uses a tabular foundation model to guide a simple linear prediction rule. TICL$^3$ first learns a shared linear model to capture dataset-level feature effects. Then, for each query, it retrieves similar training samples using representations from the foundation model and fits a second linear model to the residuals in that neighborhood. The shared model captures broad effects, while the local model corrects errors among similar samples. Their combined coefficients determine each feature contribution to the final query-specific linear score, so the same model makes and explains the prediction. Across 386 classification benchmark-dataset evaluations, TICL$^3$ trails TabICLv2 by 1.1 percentage points and outperforms CatBoost in 266 evaluations. It improves average support F1 over MAPLE by 4.7 points and achieves the best performance on both real-data selected-feature utility metrics.

AI.tldr: TICL$^3$ 是一种"设计即可解释"的表格预测器：用表格基础模型的表示引导一个"数据集级共享线性模型 + 查询级局部线性残差模型"，使模型在做预测的同时直接给出各特征的贡献。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型的上下文学习（ICL）预测精度高，但难以解释单个特征对预测的贡献；在生物医学等场景，特征贡献有助于识别生物标志物或风险基因。事后可解释方法给出的重要性分数并不代表模型实际使用的信息，可能产生解释错误。
AI.method: TICL$^3$（Tabular In-Context Local Linear Learning）采用两阶段线性结构：1）先学习一个共享线性模型，刻画数据集层面的整体特征效应；2）对每个查询样本，利用基础模型的表示检索相似训练样本，并在该邻域内对残差拟合第二个线性模型以修正误差。共享模型捕捉广义效应，局部模型纠正相似样本间的偏差，两者系数相加即给出该查询特有的线性打分及各特征贡献。
AI.result: 在 386 项分类基准-数据集评测中，TICL$^3$ 比 TabICLv2 低 1.1 个百分点，并在 266 项评测中优于 CatBoost；相对 MAPLE 的平均 support F1 提升 4.7 个百分点，且在两项真实数据"选定特征效用"指标上均取得最佳表现。
AI.conclusion: TICL$^3$ 在几乎不牺牲精度的前提下实现了内生可解释性——预测与解释由同一模型产生，特征贡献即模型实际使用的线性系数，是事后解释方法的有力替代方案。

title: sDMD: Sinkhorn Distribution Matching Distillation
summary: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) distills multi-step diffusion models into few-step generators by minimizing reverse KL divergence. Despite its strong performance, DMD guides samples by local density alone, which introduces two limitations: teacher scores can be unreliable in regions of low teacher density, and the mode-seeking behavior of reverse KL can collapse the student onto a subset of the teacher modes. We first connect DMD to Wasserstein gradient flow, showing that its gradient follows from a fixed-point formulation with integral KL (IKL) as the energy functional. This perspective motivates augmenting IKL with an optimal transport term that addresses these limitations by guiding outlier samples toward the target and promoting mode coverage. We realize this term using Sinkhorn divergence estimated from finite batches. In practice, however, errors in the estimated Sinkhorn velocity can perturb in-domain samples for which IKL guidance is already accurate. To this end, we introduce sDMD, which adaptively activates the Sinkhorn correction based on discriminator outputs, focusing on outlier samples where IKL may be unreliable. With 2--4 sampling steps on FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image-20B, and Wan2.1-14B, sDMD outperforms distillation baselines on GenEval, DPG, WISE, and VBench while improving sample diversity over DMD2.

AI.tldr: sDMD 将 DMD 与 Wasserstein 梯度流建立联系，在积分KL能量泛函上引入最优传输（Sinkhorn）正则项，并用判别器输出自适应激活该修正项，以解决低密度区教师分数不可靠与模式坍塌问题，在 FLUX.1-dev 等模型上2–4步采样超越基线。
AI.motivation: DMD 通过最小化反向 KL 蒸馏多步扩散模型，但其仅依赖局部密度引导样本，存在两点缺陷：(1) 教师密度低的区域教师分数不可靠；(2) 反向 KL 的模式寻求特性会使学生塌缩到教师部分模式上，导致多样性不足。
AI.method: 首先将 DMD 与 Wasserstein 梯度流关联，证明其梯度来自以积分KL（IKL）为能量泛函的不动点形式；据此在 IKL 上增加最优传输项，引导离群样本趋向目标分布并促进模式覆盖，该一项目前以有限批次估计的 Sinkhorn 散度实现。由于估计的 Sinkhorn 速度存在误差、会扰动 IKL 引导已准确的内点样本，进一步提出 sDMD：依据判别器输出自适应激活 Sinkhorn 修正，仅作用于 IKL 可能不可靠的离群样本。
AI.result: 在 FLUX.1-dev、Qwen-Image-20B 与 Wan2.1-14B 上采用 2–4 步采样，sDMD 在 GenEval、DPG、WISE 和 VBench 上优于蒸馏基线，同时相比 DMD2 提升了样本多样性。
AI.conclusion: 以 Wasserstein 梯度流视角重构 DMD，可自然导出 IKL+最优传输的复合能量泛函；结合判别器门控的自适应 Sinkhorn 修正，能在少步蒸馏中兼顾生成质量与模式覆盖。

title: Distributional Reward Calibration and Budget-Neutral Credit Assignment for Multimodal RLVR
summary: We revisit advantage estimation in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and observe that any token-level advantage admits a two-stage factorization: a \emph{sample-level baselining} step that converts scalar verifier rewards into a comparable sequence-level signal, and a \emph{token-level credit assignment} step that distributes that signal over the trajectory. Existing estimators typically address only one of these stages: affine baselines preserve the shape of each task's reward law, so heavy tails and binary cliffs propagate into the gradient, while token-level credit rules tie the size of each token's update to raw confidence scales and need not conserve the total credit issued by the verifier. We propose \textbf{TACE} (Two-stage Advantage and Credit Estimation), a two-stage estimator that addresses both stages. At stage~(S1), we replace linear standardization with a one-dimensional optimal-transport map to a standard normal, which gives a common population reward law across tasks and caps finite-sample outliers deterministically. At stage~(S2), we rank-calibrate a stop-gradient evidence contrast within each trajectory and renormalize the clipped token weights to have mean one, so credit is redistributed across tokens while its total mass and sign are conserved. We prove population-level inter-task moment equity, a deterministic tail bound, and mass-conservation, boundedness, and sign-anchoring properties that affine baselines and unnormalized token weights do not satisfy. On a multimodal reasoning suite, TACE obtains the strongest results on a majority of the benchmarks but does not dominate every setting.

AI.tldr: 该文将GRPO中的token级优势分解为"样本级基线化"与"token级信用分配"两阶段，提出TACE估计器：S1用一维最优传输映射将奖励标准化为标准正态，S2对停止梯度的证据对比做秩校准并将裁剪后的token权重归一化为均值1，在保持总信用质量与符号的前提下重分配信用。
AI.motivation: 现有GRPO优势估计器通常只处理两阶段中的一阶段：仿射基线保持各任务奖励分布形状，导致重尾与二值悬崖传入梯度；token级信用规则将更新幅度绑定于原始置信度尺度，且不保证总信用守恒。因此需要同时处理样本级基线与token级信用分配的联合估计器。
AI.method: 提出TACE两阶段估计器。阶段S1：用一维最优传输将标量验证器奖励映射到标准正态，替代线性标准化，使跨任务具有共同总体奖励分布并确定性截断有限样本离群值。阶段S2：在每条轨迹内对停止梯度的证据对比做秩校准，并将裁剪后的token权重重新归一化至均值为1，实现信用在token间重分配且总量与符号守恒。
AI.result: 理论证明总体层面的跨任务矩公平性、确定性尾部界，以及质量守恒、有界性和符号锚定等仿射基线与未归一化token权重不具备的性质。在多模态推理基准套件上，TACE在多数基准取得最佳结果，但并非在所有设置上全面占优。
AI.conclusion: 两阶段视角为GRPO优势估计提供了统一框架，TACE在理论上具备更稳健的分布与信用性质，并在多数多模态推理基准上取得最优表现，但优势并非普遍，其适用范围与局限仍需进一步刻画。

title: One Vector or Many? Clustered Optimal-Transport Steering under Quantization
summary:
Activation steering changes what a language model generates by editing its hidden states at inference time. Its most common form adds one vector, the difference of class means (DiM), to every hidden state. CHaRS (concept heterogeneity-aware representation steering) uses optimal transport instead: an entropic plan pairs the clusters of the two classes, and each hidden state moves along a mixture of the cluster displacements, weighted toward its nearest clusters. We study this family of clustered optimal-transport maps for toxicity mitigation in Gemma-2-2B and Granite-3.1-2B, and ask what the plan adds to DiM and whether that survives INT8 and NF4 quantization.
  We prove an identity: whatever the plan, the displacements averaged with the cluster sizes as weights equal DiM, so a clustered map can differ from DiM only for tokens whose routing weights depart from the cluster sizes. In the CHaRS protocol they stay close, and CHaRS is statistically equivalent to Mean-AcT, which adds DiM at every layer, in all eight pre-specified equivalence tests. A variant fitted on individual tokens, which routes each token mainly to its nearest clusters, leaves 37-39% less toxicity than DiM on Gemma and 51-61% less on Granite at steering strength 3 (toxic-bert), where DiM already removes 76-85% of it. Two other toxicity classifiers confirm the gain on Granite, but on Gemma only one does. At equal strength the variant has somewhat higher perplexity, but at matched toxicity it is slightly more fluent than DiM. Yet a nearly constant map from the same clusters also leaves about 30% less toxicity, so the role of treating tokens differently remains open.
  Under INT8 and NF4 the variant still leaves less toxicity than DiM, and transferring it from full precision to the NF4 model instead of refitting it adds no significant toxicity after correction for multiple tests.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了CHaRS这类基于聚类最优传输的激活引导方法：证明其聚类位移按簇大小加权平均恰等于DiM，故其增益仅来自偏离簇大小的路由权重；从头拟合的逐token变体显著优于DiM，但在INT8/NF4下与消融对照下增益的可归因性仍存疑。
AI.motivation: 激活引导最常见的做法是把类均值差(DiM)向量加到每个隐藏状态上。CHaRS改用熵正则最优传输，先将两类簇配对，再让每个隐藏状态沿簇位移的加权混合移动。作者希望厘清：(1) 这样的传输计划相较DiM究竟增加了什么；(2) 该增益在INT8、NF4量化后是否仍然保持。
AI.method: 在Gemma-2-2B与Granite-3.1-2B上做去毒任务。理论上推导恒等式：无论计划如何，以簇大小为权对位移取平均即得DiM，故聚类映射只在路由权重偏离簇大小时才不同于DiM。实验包括与Mean-AcT的八项预设等价检验、逐token拟合的变体(主要路由到最近簇)、近常数映射消融、与DiM在等强度/等毒性下的困惑度对比，以及INT8/NF4量化与跨精度迁移(免重拟合)评估。
AI.result: CHaRS协议下路由权重与簇大小接近，CHaRS与逐层加DiM的Mean-AcT在全部八项预设等价检验中统计等价。逐token变体在强度3、toxic-bert下，Gemma毒性比DiM低37-39%，Granite低51-61%(此时DiM已消除76-85%毒性)；另两个毒性分类器在Granite上确认增益，Gemma上仅一个确认。等强度下变体困惑度略高，等毒性下略优于DiM。但来自同一簇的近常数映射也降低约30%毒性。量化后变体仍优于DiM，且全精度到NF4的迁移在多重检验校正后无显著毒性退化。
AI.conclusion: 聚类最优传输本身并不超越DiM——其均值被恒等式锁定为DiM，实际增益来自逐token路由；该增益在量化下稳健并可免重拟合迁移，但近常数映射消融显示增益可能并非源于"差异化处理token"，其机制仍待澄清。

title: Last-Iterate Convergence for Constrained MDPs: From Dual Descent to Primal-Dual
summary: We study policy optimization for infinite-horizon, discounted constrained Markov decision processes. While primal-dual ($\texttt{PD}$) methods are widely used in practice, their theoretical guarantees typically hold for an impractical mixture policy. In contrast, dual descent ($\texttt{DD}$) methods output a single policy ("last iterate") with guarantees on its performance. However, such methods require iteratively solving entropy-regularized MDPs in an inner-loop, limiting their practical effectiveness. Moreover, existing analyses rely on strong coverage assumptions that are difficult to satisfy in practice. Consequently, we first provide a new analysis of $\texttt{DD}$ methods that does not require coverage assumptions. We then employ entropy-regularized natural policy gradient and dual regularization to eliminate the inner loop, resulting in an efficient $\texttt{PD}$ algorithm. We develop a novel tracking analysis which shows that, compared to existing methods, the proposed algorithm achieves improved last-iterate convergence guarantees. Furthermore, our theoretical framework allows us to analyze a truncated bilevel method that interpolates between $\texttt{DD}$ and $\texttt{PD}$ methods. Finally, we generalize our analysis to handle linear function approximation. Compared to prior last-iterate methods, we prove stronger guarantees under less restrictive assumptions.

AI.tldr: 针对无限时域折扣约束MDP，本文给出无需覆盖假设的对偶下降(DD)新分析，并用熵正则自然策略梯度与对偶正则消除内层循环，提出高效原始-对偶算法，获得更强的last-iterate收敛保证，并推广到线性函数逼近。
AI.motivation: 原始-对偶(PD)方法虽常用，但其理论保证通常针对不实用的混合策略；对偶下降(DD)方法虽输出单一"last iterate"策略，却需在内层迭代求解熵正则MDP，实用性受限，且现有分析依赖难以满足的强覆盖假设。
AI.method: 1) 提出不依赖覆盖假设的DD方法新分析；2) 结合熵正则自然策略梯度与对偶正则化消除内层循环，构造高效PD算法；3) 建立新的tracking分析框架；4) 用该框架分析在DD与PD之间插值的截断双层方法；5) 推广至线性函数逼近。
AI.result: 相较现有方法，所提算法在last-iterate收敛性上获得改进保证；统一框架同时覆盖DD、PD及其插值形式；在线性函数逼近下，以更弱的假设证明了强于先前last-iterate方法的保证。
AI.conclusion: 本文为约束策略优化提供了无需覆盖假设的统一理论与更高效、更具实用性的算法，弥合了PD与DD方法在理论与实践间的差距。

title: TokenRepel: Generating Diverse Image Sets Without Compromising Quality
summary: We present an inference-time approach that enhances the visual diversity of image sets generated by text-to-image models, without compromising the average image quality. Our method leverages the intrinsic geometry of hidden representations in pretrained models to diversify images generated from the same prompt. First, we introduce a token repulsion mechanism that increases the angle between feature tokens across samples. It takes a negative Riemannian gradient step on a von Mises-Fisher mixture distribution of tokens on the unit hypersphere. Second, to preserve the quality of each output image, we propose a token density preservation mechanism that projects the repulsion-induced prediction change onto a half-space aligned with the model's score direction. This encourages the updates to remain within the high-density regions learned by the generative model. We further extend this mechanism to the output of each intermediate layer, enabling finer-grained iterative guidance. We evaluate our method on three types of pretrained text-to-image models. Experiments show substantial gains in visual diversity under identical prompts, while maintaining a comparable level of image fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出一种推理时方法，利用预训练文本到图像模型隐表示的几何结构，在不损失平均图像质量的前提下提升同一提示生成图像集的视觉多样性。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像模型对同一提示生成的图像缺乏多样性，现有方法往往以牺牲图像保真度为代价。
AI.method: 两阶段机制：1) token 排斥机制——在单位超球面上对 token 的 von Mises-Fisher 混合分布取负黎曼梯度步，增大跨样本特征 token 间夹角；2) token 密度保持机制——将排斥引起的预测变化投影到与模型 score 方向对齐的半空间，使更新保留在模型学习的高密度区域；并将该机制扩展到各中间层输出以实现更细粒度的迭代引导。
AI.result: 在三类预训练文本到图像模型上评估，相同提示下视觉多样性显著提升，图像保真度保持可比水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过隐空间几何约束可在推理阶段解耦多样性与保真度，实现无需重训练的多样性增强。

title: Neighborhood Elites: Quality-Diversity Search for Uncertainty Quantification in Question Answering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly capable, yet they produce wrong answers indistinguishable from correct ones. In question answering (QA), such an error propagates unnoticed into downstream tasks. Perturbation-based uncertainty quantification (UQ) addresses this by probing a model over a set of input rewrites and reading uncertainty from how much its predictions vary. Yet this set is usually built generically, by free paraphrasing, token-level perturbation, or adversarial search. Such rewrites leave two things uncontrolled that matter in QA: what kind of change is made to the context, and how explicitly the context supports the answer. When neither is controlled, the composition of the set is determined by the generator rather than by design, and the estimate inherits whatever that generator happens to produce. Quality-diversity (QD) search is built to cover a predefined exploration space, so we recast input perturbation as a QD problem and propose \emph{neighborhood elites (NE)}, a neighborhood constructor that spreads answer-preserving rewrites across two axes, the kind of edit and the explicitness of support. We compare NE against three other neighborhood constructors, holding the editor, QA model, uncertainty measure and search objective fixed, and against three scores read from the original context. Across five extractive-QA datasets and five instruction-tuned LLMs, NE improves failure detection against every other constructor in at least 24 of the 25 dataset-model pairs, reaching 0.726 AUROC and 0.211 AUPRC lift over the base rate. Additionally, NE detects failure better than semantic entropy computed over decoder samples, by 0.074 AUROC and 0.062 AUPRC lift, and this advantage widens as the neighborhood grows.

AI.tldr: 该文将输入扰动式不确定性量化重构为质量-多样性（QD）搜索问题，提出"邻域精英（NE）"构造函数，沿"编辑类型"与"支持显式度"两个轴铺开保答案改写，从而在抽取式QA中更有效地检测LLM错误。
AI.motivation: LLM的错误答案与正确答案难以区分，在QA中会被下游任务无察觉地继承。基于扰动的不确定性量化通过在一组输入改写上探测模型、依据预测波动读取不确定性，但改写集通常由自由复述、token级扰动或对抗搜索泛化生成，导致两个对QA至关重要的因素不受控：对上下文所做改动的类型、上下文对答案支持的显式程度。二者不受控时，集合构成由生成器决定而非由设计决定，估计结果继承生成器的偶然产物。
AI.method: 将输入扰动重构为质量-多样性（QD）搜索问题，提出邻域精英（NE）：一种邻域构造函数，把保答案改写沿两条轴分布——（1）编辑类型，（2）支持显式度。实验控制编辑器、QA模型、不确定性度量与搜索目标不变，将NE与另外三种邻域构造函数对比，并与直接读取原始上下文得到的三种分数对比。
AI.result: 在五个抽取式QA数据集与五个指令微调LLM上，NE在25个数据集-模型对中至少24对上优于其他所有构造函数，AUROC达0.726，AUPRC较基率提升0.211；相较基于解码器采样的语义熵，NE在AUROC上高出0.074、AUPRC提升0.062，且该优势随邻域扩大而增大。
AI.conclusion: 通过QD搜索显式控制改写的编辑类型与支持显式度，可使扰动式UQ的估计摆脱生成器偶然性的影响，稳定提升QA失败检测性能，且优于语义熵等采样式基线，并在更大搜索预算下获益更多。

title: It Takes Two to Probe, Thousands to Retrieve: Putting Vision--Language Probes to the Retrieval Test
summary: Vision--language models (VLMs) are tested for fine-grained understanding with image--text matching probes, a model must prefer the correct image or caption over handcrafted negative. In retrieval, the correct item must beat thousands of alternatives. We measure how these two evaluation methods relate by using two probing benchmarks, \svo{} and SugarCrepe, for retrieval tasks. For 100 image and caption queries we judge the top-10 retrievals from full dataset of six VLMs, with human annotators and an LLM assessor. We than compare how well models rank pool of items on the same queries, while changing only where the negatives comes from: the benchmark, a random draw, or the judged-incorrect retrievals of other models. On \svo{} the accuracy of retrieving a positive over handcrafted negatives is significantly higher than for retrieved ones (the correct item is preferred in 85\% against 77\% of the time). Using pool of ten retrieved negatives leads to same accuracy as when one uses pool of 200 to 430 random negatives. On SugarCrepe the order is reversed: its handcrafted negatives are harder than the retrieved ones. Incomplete relevance labels explain most of the low retrieval scores on \svo{}, where the top-ranked item is correct for 54--90\% of the queries under human labels against 6--21\% under the benchmark's labels. However, we detect no association between passing the probe for a query and retrieving a correct item first. The LLM assessor o3 agrees with individual annotators ($κ$ 0.57--0.61) slightly less than they agree with each other (0.64--0.68).

AI.tldr: 论文比较了"细粒度图文匹配探针"与"检索评测"两种评测方式的关系，发现探针准确率与检索准确率在SVO上差异显著、在SugarCrepe上反转，且SVO的检索低分主要源于标注不完整。
AI.motivation: VLMs常以人工构造负例的图文匹配探针评估细粒度理解，但实际检索需在数千候选中胜出。两种评测是否一致、探针通过是否预示检索成功，尚缺乏直接测量。
AI.method: 将两个探针基准（SVO、SugarCrePE）转为检索任务：对100个图文查询，用6个VLM在完整数据集上取top-10检索结果，由人工标注员与LLM评估器(o3)判定；在相同查询下仅改变负例来源（基准构造负例、随机采样、其他模型被判错误的检索结果），比较模型的排序能力。
AI.result: SVO上"正确项胜过人工构造负例"的准确率(85%)显著高于胜过检索负例(77%)；10个检索负例的效果约等于200–430个随机负例。SugarCrePE上顺序反转，其构造负例更难。SVO检索低分主要源于相关性标注不完整：top-1正确率按人工标注为54–90%，按基准标注仅6–21%。未发现探针通过与否同"正确项排第一"之间存在关联。o3与单个标注者的一致度(κ 0.57–0.61)略低于标注者之间(0.64–0.68)。
AI.conclusion: 探针评测与检索评测并不等价：探针通过不能预测检索首位正确；数据集标注完整性显著影响检索得分。建议检索评测采用经判定或模型挖掘的困难负例，并配合更完整的相关性标注。

title: Explainable and Adaptive Machine Learning for Fraud Risk Detection in Bangladesh's Digital Banking Ecosystem
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Presented at the 11th Annual Banking Conference 2026, Bangladesh Institute of Bank Management (BIBM), Dhaka, Bangladesh, 28 October 2026
summary: The rapid expansion of digital banking and mobile financial services creates growing challenges for fraud detection, particularly under severe class imbalance and operational constraints. This study presents an explainable and adaptive machine-learning framework integrating chronological evaluation, leakage-conscious feature engineering, probability calibration, SHAP-based explainability, and adaptive risk prioritization. Experiments use the synthetic PaySim mobile-money benchmark and compare Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM. XGBoost achieved the strongest fixed-threshold performance, with PR-AUC of 0.5658, ROC-AUC of 0.9068, and F1-score of 0.5369. Platt calibration reduced the test Brier score from 0.1141 to 0.0245, improving probability reliability. SHAP analysis identified temporal, destination-account, transaction-type, and amount features as important model drivers. An adaptive top-1% policy reduced false positives from 192 to 117, but recall declined from 0.4236 to 0.2122, demonstrating a clear alert-capacity trade-off. The results provide a reproducible methodological framework rather than evidence of deployment performance in Bangladesh, since PaySim is synthetic. Validation using governed real-world financial data is therefore an important direction for future research.

AI.tldr: 提出一个可解释、自适应的机器学习欺诈检测框架（时序评估、防泄漏特征工程、概率校准、SHAP解释、自适应风险排序），在合成PaySim数据上比较四种模型，XGBoost表现最佳，Platt校准显著改善概率可靠性，并提出按告警容量取舍的自适应Top-1%策略。
AI.motivation: 数字银行与移动金融服务快速扩张，欺诈检测面临严重类别不平衡与运营约束（告警容量有限）；同时模型需要可解释性与可靠的概率输出，以支撑风险排序与业务决策。
AI.method: 构建端到端框架：按时间顺序划分的评估协议、避免数据泄漏的特征工程、概率校准（Platt scaling）、基于SHAP的可解释性分析，以及自适应风险优先级策略；在合成PaySim移动支付基准上与逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM进行对比实验。
AI.result: XGBoost在固定阈值下最优：PR-AUC=0.5658、ROC-AUC=0.9068、F1=0.5369；Platt校准将测试集Brier分数由0.1141降至0.0245；SHAP显示时间、收款账户、交易类型与金额为主要驱动特征；自适应Top-1%策略使假阳性从192降至117，但召回率由0.4236降至0.2122，体现明确的告警容量—召回权衡。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供的是可复现的方法学框架，而非特定地区（如孟加拉国）的部署性能证据，因数据为合成数据；后续需在受治理的真实金融数据上开展验证。

title: PhysAg3D: Bridging 3D Generative and Agentic Models for High-Fidelity and Physically-Interactive Assets
summary: Generating interactive 3D assets from a single image requires realistic appearance, fidelity to the depicted object, and plausible physical behavior. Yet detailed geometry alone does not determine how an object should move or deform. We introduce PhysAg3D, which couples 3D generative models with agentic reasoning and tool use. A vision-language agent first infers semantic parts, candidate interactions, and physical priors from the image; a 3D generator then produces a textured whole-object mesh from the same image. A hierarchical interaction representation links these revisable priors to mechanisms and the generated surfaces they control, organizing interaction construction and refinement. Guided by this representation and observations of the mesh, the agent uses geometric and physical tools to construct parts, joints, deformable regions, and surface bindings while retaining useful generated geometry and materials. Rendered interactions and execution measurements guide targeted revisions within a fixed budget. The framework accommodates both rigid articulation and compliant deformation. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations on real photographs and external benchmarks demonstrate detailed, image-aligned assets with plausible interactions. Ablations support bounded refinement and source-surface preservation. Project Page: supra-3d.github.io/PhysAg3D.

AI.tldr: PhysAg3D 将 3D 生成模型与 VLM 智能体推理和工具调用结合，从单张图像生成具备真实外观、图像一致性和合理物理交互的 3D 资产，统一支持刚体铰接与柔性形变。
AI.motivation: 单图生成交互式 3D 资产需同时满足外观真实、忠实于所描绘物体、物理行为合理；但精细几何本身并不能决定物体应如何运动或形变，缺乏物理先验与可控交互结构。
AI.method: 视觉语言智能体先从图像推断语义部件、候选交互与物理先验；3D 生成器由同一图像生成带纹理的整体网格；提出分层交互表示，将可修订先验与机构及其控制的生成表面关联；智能体在该表示与网格观测引导下调用几何与物理工具，构建部件、关节、形变区域及表面绑定，并保留有用的生成几何与材质；渲染结果与执行测量在固定预算下驱动定向修正。
AI.result: 在真实照片与外部基准上的定量与定性评估显示，方法可生成细节丰富、与图像对齐且交互合理的资产；消融实验验证了有界修正与源表面保持的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以分层交互表示耦合生成先验与智能体工具推理，是在有限预算内实现图像对齐、可交互 3D 资产的可扩展范式，兼容刚体与软体两类交互。

title: Multistep and Multivariate Time Series Explainability with GradientSHAP: A Wind Power Case Study
summary: As the effects of climate change become increasingly apparent, the demand for renewable energy sources such as wind power continues to grow. However, renewables' variable and intermittent nature presents significant challenges in their integration into energy grids. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a powerful tool to address these issues. Still, its adoption in the energy sector has been hindered by the opacity of many AI models, which often function as black boxes. This paper introduces a carefully adapted GradientSHAP approach to provide interpretability for multivariate, multistep wind power forecasting -- a largely underexplored area. This capability is critical for day-ahead grid management and, to the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to apply GradientSHAP in the context of wind power forecasting. To address the inherent dimensionality, we developed novel visualizations that deliver both local and global explanations, uncovering intricate relationships between environmental factors, site-specific conditions, and temporal dynamics. While GradientSHAP is not an out-of-the-box solution, our findings demonstrate that, with thoughtful handling of SHAP values and domain expertise, it can offer valuable insights into model behaviour, supporting more informed and trustworthy decision-making. Nevertheless, its complexity poses challenges for practical implementation. Future research should focus on streamlining these interpretability methods to make them more actionable for routine deployment in critical energy applications.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将改造后的GradientSHAP方法用于多变量、多步风电功率预测的可解释性分析，并通过新颖可视化提供局部与全局解释。
AI.motivation: 风电等可再生能源具有波动性与间歇性，给电网并网带来挑战；AI模型虽有效，但其"黑箱"特性阻碍了在能源领域的应用，而多变量多步风电预测的可解释性研究此前很少被关注。
AI.method: 对GradientSHAP进行针对性适配，并设计新的可视化方式以应对高维度问题，同时给出局部与全局解释，揭示环境因素、站点特定条件与时间动态之间的复杂关系。
AI.result: GradientSHAP并非开箱即用；在合理处理SHAP值并结合领域知识后，能够有效揭示模型行为，为日前电网管理提供可信的决策支持依据。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可为风电预测模型提供有价值的可解释性洞见，但其复杂性给实际部署带来困难，未来需简化此类方法以提升其可操作性。

title: LatentWeave: Test-Time Latent Optimization for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Recent advances in test-time optimization have shown that the multimodal reasoning performance of large multimodal language models (MLLMs) can be improved during inference without modifying backbone model parameters. However, existing approaches primarily operate at the prompt or output level, leaving the latent reasoning process largely uncontrolled and insufficient to prevent error accumulation during autoregressive generation. To address this limitation, we propose LatentWeave, a test-time framework that treats multimodal reasoning as a controllable latent trajectory. LatentWeave performs structured Latent Weaving, progressively refining intermediate hidden states segment-wise to correct emerging deviations, and further introduces Reasoning Anchors via lightweight WEAVE tokens to stabilize reasoning structure and guide answer-oriented generation. These mechanisms are designed to enable fine-grained, step-aware intervention in the latent reasoning process while keeping the main MLLM backbone parameters fixed. Extensive experiments across diverse multimodal reasoning benchmarks report improvements over the evaluated baselines; the contribution of latent optimization, anchor training, and additional test-time computation is analyzed separately in the ablation and efficiency studies. Our code is available at https://github.com/jins7/LatentWeave.

AI.tldr: 提出测试时框架 LatentWeave，将多模态推理视为可控的隐空间轨迹，通过分段"隐空间编织"与 WEAVE 推理锚点，在不改主干参数的前提下实现细粒度、步级干预，减少自回归生成中的误差累积。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型测试时优化多停留在提示或输出层面，隐空间推理过程基本不受控，难以抑制自回归生成中的误差累积。
AI.method: LatentWeave：1) 结构化 Latent Weaving，逐个片段精炼中间隐状态以纠正出现的偏差；2) 借助轻量 WEAVE token 引入 Reasoning Anchors，稳定推理结构并引导面向答案的生成；主干 MLLM 参数保持冻结。
AI.result: 在多个多模态推理基准上相较所评估基线取得提升；消融与效率研究分别分析了隐空间优化、锚点训练及额外测试时计算量的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 在隐空间层面进行步级、可控的测试时干预是提升 MLLM 多模态推理的有效途径，且无需修改主干参数。

title: Spectral Invariant Fusion and Refinement for Domain Generalized Semantic Segmentation
summary: Domain generalized semantic segmentation is challenging because it requires accurate dense prediction on unseen domains without any access to target-domain data during training. Existing methods improve transferability through data diversification, invariant learning, or direct use of foundation models, but they often struggle to simultaneously suppress domain-sensitive interference and preserve fine-grained spatial cues. In this work, we propose SIFR, a frequency-aware dual-stream framework that tackles domain shift at both the fusion and decoding stages. SIFR uses spectral modeling as a unified principle to regulate both heterogeneous prior interaction and dense decoder refinement. Instead of directly fusing frozen CLIP and DINOv2 features, SIFR performs spectral-guided invariant fusion to filter out domain-sensitive responses while preserving complementary semantic and structural information. In addition, SIFR incorporates a spectral decoder refinement module that stabilizes multi-scale decoder features through low-frequency statistics-based normalization and adaptive frequency selection, thereby reducing the propagation of residual domain bias in dense prediction. This design enables SIFR to jointly improve domain robustness and segmentation precision under severe distribution shifts. Extensive experiments on multiple DGSS benchmarks, including synthetic-to-real, real-to-real, and adverse-weather settings, demonstrate consistent improvements over previous state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出SIFR——一个频域感知的双流框架，在融合与解码两个阶段以频谱建模统一抑制域敏感干扰并保留细粒度空间线索，在多种DGSS基准上稳定超越现有SOTA。
AI.motivation: 域泛化语义分割要求在训练中完全不可见目标域数据的情况下实现精确稠密预测。现有方法（数据多样化、不变性学习、直接用基础模型）难以兼顾两件事：抑制域敏感干扰，同时保留细粒度空间线索。
AI.method: 以频谱建模为统一原则，同时调控异构先验交互与稠密解码精化：(1) 频谱引导的不变融合——不直接融合冻结的CLIP与DINOv2特征，而是先做频谱域滤波，剔除域敏感响应并保留语义与结构互补信息；(2) 频谱解码精化模块——利用基于低频统计量的归一化和自适应频率选择来稳定多尺度解码特征，减少残余域偏置在稠密预测中的传播。
AI.result: 在合成到真实、真实到真实、恶劣天气等多类DGSS基准上开展大量实验，相较此前SOTA方法取得一致性提升，在严重分布偏移下同时改善域鲁棒性与分割精度。
AI.conclusion: 频域视角可作为跨阶段（融合+解码）的统一正则手段，有效缓解域偏移，说明在基础模型特征之上进行频谱层面的选择性处理优于直接融合与常规解码。

title: Beyond Selected Breakthroughs: Evaluating Language Models on Randomly Sampled Mathematical Conjectures
summary: The last year has seen a shift in AI-assisted mathematics, with frontier language models producing proofs of and counterexamples to long-standing open conjectures. However, studying only the current set of major breakthroughs provides an incomplete picture of LLM capabilities and the computational resources needed to achieve reported results. To address this, we introduce a new dataset, OpenConjecture, which collects conjectures from mathematics papers published on the arXiv since February 2026. We use these conjectures as a source of open mathematical problems, and apply frontier GPT models to a random sample of 200 of these conjectures over three passes using a reproducible protocol without problem-specific mathematical guidance. Rather than attempt expert verification of these candidate solutions, we analyze the types of problems for which LLMs produce solutions and the characteristics of these solutions. The models we test produce candidate solutions for roughly 60% of the conjectures, with counterexamples about 1.3 times more common than proofs. We estimate solution novelty, assess how solutions cite and relate to existing literature, and analyze whether the proposed resolution relies on either an error in or underspecification of the conjecture.
