We find that models sometimes propose resolutions that are outside the authors' intent (e.g., proposing the trivial group as a counterexample) and that a number of proofs follow closely from existing results, but that some resolutions exhibit at least moderate novelty. Our findings underscore the need for evaluations that go beyond correctness to assess fidelity to the intended statement, attribution, and the nature of the mathematical contribution.

AI.tldr: 论文提出OpenConjecture数据集（取自2026年2月后arXiv数学论文中的猜想），用前沿GPT模型对随机200条猜想做三轮可复现的测试并分析候选解的类型与特征，发现约60%猜想得到候选解、反例约为证明的1.3倍，且部分解脱离作者原意或近乎直接由已有结果推出，呼吁超越“正确性”的评估框架。
AI.motivation: 仅关注少数重大突破会高估LLM能力、低估其所需算力，无法全面刻画模型在开放数学问题上的真实表现，因此需要一个系统化、可复现的基准与分析方法。
AI.method: 构建OpenConjecture数据集，采集2026年2月起arXiv数学论文中的猜想作为开放问题来源；随机抽取200条猜想，在无问题特定数学提示的可复现协议下，用前沿GPT模型进行三轮求解；不依赖专家验证正确性，而是分类问题类型与解的特征，估计解的创新性、分析其对文献的引用与关联，以及是否依赖猜想的错误或表述不充分。
AI.result: 模型对约60%的猜想给出候选解，反例数量约为证明的1.3倍；部分解答超出作者本意（如以平凡群作反例），部分证明紧跟已有结果，但也有少数解具备至少中等程度的创新性。
AI.conclusion: 现有以正确性为核心的评测不足，需建立涵盖对原命题意图的忠实度、归因与数学贡献性质的评估体系。

title: Improving the Intrinsic Interpretability of Differentiable Decision Trees through Euclidean Feature-Concentration Regularisation
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Based on the author's MSc dissertation, University of Birmingham
summary: Differentiable decision trees (DDTs) support end-to-end optimisation and explicit decision paths, but dense oblique splits can obscure the role of individual input features. We propose the Euclidean-Concentrated Differentiable Decision Tree (EU-DDT), which regularises the relative absolute feature weights at each internal node using their normalised squared Euclidean distance from the uniform distribution. This encourages dominance by a small number of features while retaining probabilistic soft routing. Across five matched random seeds, EU-DDT reduces the mean effective number of features from 8.94 to 1.54 on Wine and from 45.28 to 9.06 on Digits. Mean test accuracy changes from 100.0% to 93.9% on Wine and from 92.3% to 94.6% on Digits, illustrating the dataset-dependent trade-off between concentration and predictive performance. We also use EU-DDT to parameterise a PPO actor with an MLP critic. Two random-seed runs per environment show a consistent qualitative increase in concentration while preserving effective task performance. In representative CartPole-v1 and MiniPacman runs, EU-DDT reaches 100% final evaluation success, while mean node concentration increases from 0.1272 to 0.7179 and from 0.0437 to 0.7237, respectively. These results support EU regularisation as a mechanism for reducing node-level feature complexity; the reinforcement-learning evidence remains preliminary because only two seeds are evaluated.

AI.tldr: 提出欧几里得集中式可微决策树(EU-DDT)，通过在内部节点用特征权重的归一化平方欧氏距离对均匀分布做正则化，促使少数特征主导，在保持软路由的同时显著降低节点级特征复杂度。
AI.motivation: 可微决策树支持端到端优化并提供显式决策路径，但稠密的斜向分裂会使单个输入特征的作用变得难以解释；作者希望在不放弃软路由的前提下提升特征层面的可解释性。
AI.method: 对每个内部节点的相对绝对特征权重，计算其到均匀分布的归一化平方欧氏距离，并将其作为正则项加入损失，从而鼓励少数特征主导；同时保留概率软路由。此外，用EU-DDT参数化PPO的actor网络，并搭配MLP critic。
AI.result: 在五个匹配随机种子下，Wine的平均有效特征数由8.94降至1.54，Digits由45.28降至9.06；平均测试准确率Wine由100.0%变为93.9%，Digits由92.3%升至94.6%，呈现出依赖数据集的集中度与性能权衡。强化学习中每种环境两次种子运行，CartPole-v1与MiniPacman均达到100%最终评估成功率，平均节点集中度分别由0.1272升至0.7179、由0.0437升至0.7237。
AI.conclusion: EU正则化可作为降低节点级特征复杂度的有效机制；但由于强化学习仅评估两个种子，相关证据仍属初步，且集中度提升对预测性能的影响因数据集而异。

title: MLLM-GS: Multimodal Large Language Model Prior-Guided Fast Novel View Synthesis in Extreme Environments
summary: Novel view synthesis (NVS) in degraded scenes aims to reconstruct 3D scenes from multi-view observations affected by various degradations, and to generate clear and photorealistic images at unseen viewpoints. Despite recent advances, existing methods often rely on degradation-specific models, limiting their generalization across diverse extreme environments. Generative models provide rich visual priors, but their outputs often suffer from pixel misalignment and color deviations, which can propagate into the reconstructed 3D scene and compromise reconstruction quality. Furthermore, the high computational and memory costs of 3D reconstruction hinder the practical application of NVS in extreme environments. To this end, we propose MLLM-GS, a multimodal large language model (MLLM) prior-guided framework for fast NVS in extreme environments. MLLM-GS consists of two branches: MLLM prior-guided view enhancement and fast 3D scene reconstruction. The former leverages the rich visual priors of a frozen MLLM to enhance views under different severe degradations and introduces a lightweight correction network to reduce pixel shifts and color distortions in MLLM outputs. With supervision from only a few paired clean views, this branch produces reliable enhanced views for all degraded observations, providing pseudo-GT views for subsequent 3D reconstruction. The latter improves 3DGS efficiency by optimizing rasterization, Gaussian memory layout, and parameter updates, reducing redundant computation, memory-access overhead, and optimization costs. Extensive experiments on multiple degraded scenes demonstrate that MLLM-GS effectively handles various severe degradations and achieves high-quality NVS with significantly lower reconstruction time and memory consumption. Project Page: https://wzlwlm13.github.io/MLLM-GS

AI.tldr: MLLM-GS：利用冻结的多模态大模型视觉先验+轻量校正网络增强退化视图，并优化3DGS实现极端环境下快速高质量新视角合成。
AI.motivation: 现有退化场景NVS方法依赖特定退化类型模型，泛化性差；生成模型输出存在像素错位与颜色偏差并传播到3D重建中；且3D重建计算与显存开销大，难以实用。
AI.method: 双分支框架：(1) MLLM先验引导的视图增强分支，用冻结MLLM的丰富视觉先验增强不同严重退化视图，并引入轻量校正网络抑制像素偏移与颜色失真，仅需少量成对干净视图监督，为所有退化观测生成可靠增强视图作为伪GT；(2) 快速3D重建分支，通过优化光栅化、高斯内存布局与参数更新，降低冗余计算、访存开销与优化成本。
AI.result: 在多个退化场景上的大量实验表明，MLLM-GS能有效应对多种严重退化，实现高质量NVS，且重建时间与内存消耗显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 融合MLLM视觉先验与高效3DGS优化，可在无需退化专用模型的前提下实现强泛化、低开销的退化场景新视角合成。

title: Retrieving from Your Own Mistakes: On-Policy Training of Embedding Models for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Complex questions in retrieval-augmented generation require evidence spread over several documents, and an answer is reliable only when the retriever finds all of it. Chain embedding retrievers collect such evidence step by step, re-encoding the question together with the passages retrieved so far, and we find that they are already strong: trained only on gold histories, a small chain embedding retriever that calls no language model outperforms graph-based systems and is competitive with a search agent. This training, however, leaves a gap. At test time the retriever conditions on its own retrievals, which soon contain mistakes: by the third step, about half or more of the states it visits hold a wrong passage, and these passages lower its chance of retrieving a missing gold passage well beyond what the difficulty of the states explains. We propose on-policy state training, which trains the encoder on the states it reaches itself. At every epoch the current encoder retrieves chains for the training questions; each state it visits, including those built on its own mistakes, is labeled with the earliest gold passage still missing while the other missing gold passages are masked, so that no correct continuation is penalized; and the encoder is updated contrastively on these states mixed with teacher-forced ones, so that its training distribution follows it as it learns. The resulting retriever retrieves complete evidence more often than teacher-forced training and the systems we compare, and it transfers without further training to harder long-chain variants of HotpotQA and 2WikiMultiHopQA that we construct. On the same states, it recovers from its own mistakes far more often, and controlled comparisons attribute the gain to training on the states the encoder currently reaches.

AI.tldr: 提出 on-policy state training，让链式嵌入检索器在自己的检索状态（含犯错状态）上训练，显著提升多文档完整证据检索能力与错误恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 复杂问答需要跨多篇文档的证据，只有检索器找全证据答案才可靠。链式嵌入检索器逐 步收集证据，但仅用 gold histories 做 teacher-forcing 训练；测试时它以自身检索结果为条件，第三步起约半数以上状态含错误段落，这些错误段落大幅降低后续漏检 gold 段落的概率，形成训练/测试分布错配。
AI.method: on-policy state training：每个 epoch 用当前编码器为训练问题检索链，访问到的每个状态（包括建立在自身错误上的状态）以"最早缺失的 gold 段落"为标签，其余缺失 gold 段落做 mask 以避免惩罚正确延续；在这些状态与 teacher-forced 状态混合上做对比学习更新编码器，使训练分布随学习过程同步漂移。
AI.result: 完整证据检索成功率高于 teacher-forced 训练和对比系统；无需再训练即可迁移到自建的 HotpotQA 与 2WikiMultiHopQA 长链难变体；在相同状态上从自身错误恢复的频率大幅提高；对照实验将增益归因于"在当前编码器可达状态上训练"。
AI.conclusion: 仅用 gold histories 训练的链式嵌入检索器已很强（小模型、不调用 LLM 即优于图方法、与搜索智能体相当），但其瓶颈在于推理时的状态分布偏移；on-policy state training 通过让训练分布跟随自身检索行为，有效缩小该差距。

title: Factorized Representations of Concurrent Temporal Variables in Pretrained Language Models
summary: Language models often need to maintain multiple contextual variables that evolve independently within a document. Prior work has identified structured representations of individual temporal or contextual quantities, but their joint organization remains less understood. We study this question using controlled documents with independently phased language-switch and topic-change timers. Across ten pretrained checkpoints, both timers are linearly decodable from the same hidden states. Removing a timer-associated centroid plane substantially reduces access to its associated variable while having little effect on the concurrent timer, although the planes are nonorthogonal and contain cross-timer information. Separate timer contributions also explain most reproducible variation among joint-state centroids. These signatures persist from 3 to 51 timer values and across Qwen3 checkpoints from 0.6B to 14B. Schedule position affects continuation probabilities, but the tested centroid displacement produces no consistent timer-specific output effect. Together, these results support approximate factorization based on selective accessibility and approximately additive joint-state geometry in overlapping subspaces.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语言模型能否在隐藏状态中对多个独立演化的上下文变量（语言切换计时器与话题切换计时器）进行联合组织，发现两者可从同一隐藏状态线性解码，且呈现"选择性可及性"的近似因子化与近似可加的联合状态几何。
AI.motivation: 已有工作识别了单个时间/上下文量的结构化表征，但多个独立演化的上下文变量在模型内部如何联合组织仍不清楚，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构造带有独立相位语言切换与话题切换计时器的受控文档；在十个预训练检查点上做线性解码探测；通过移除计时器相关的质心平面对其可及性做因果干预；并分析联合状态质心之间的可重现变异来源。
AI.result: 两个计时器均可从同一隐藏状态线性解码；移除某一计时器的质心平面显著降低其对应变量的可及性，而对同时存在的另一计时器影响很小，尽管两平面非正交且互相包含跨计时器信息；单独计时器贡献可解释联合状态质心间大部分可重现变异。这些特征在3至51个计时器取值、以及Qwen3从0.6B到14B的检查点上均保持稳定。调度位置影响续写概率，但所测试的质心位移未产生一致的计时器特异输出效应。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持基于选择性可及性的近似因子化，以及重叠子空间中近似可加的联合状态几何。

title: A New AFIB Detection Method with Deep Neural Networks
summary: Early detection of atrial fibrillation (AFIB), characterized by irregular heart rhythms, can potentially save thousands of lives annually [20]. Numerous studies have attempted to address this challenge using various algorithms and methodologies. This paper introduces a novel and robust method that enhances the precision of AFIB detection. Neural Networks (NN) are widely recognized for their ability to identify complex electrocardiogram (ECG) patterns, facilitating the accurate detection of irregular heart rhythms. This study explores multiple conventional machine learning algorithms alongside neural network approaches to develop a robust AFIB detection system. To evaluate the effective- ness and robustness of the proposed method, the MIT BIH arrhythmia database (MITDB) and the Long-term Atrial Fibrillation Database (LTAFDB), both available on the Physionet site. Our approach presents a novel feature engineering technique, employing specific features such as a time series of the differences in successive heart rates (dBPM) rather than traditional inter-beat intervals. The model analyzes inputs labeled into five distinct classes, using only clean intervals identified through a new labeling method for training while treating others as outliers. This strategy ensures a more accurate and reliable AFIB detection process. The best-performing model, a Deep Neural Network (DNN), achieved an F1 score of 95.18% for binary atrial fibrillation classification on a benchmark dataset distinct from the training set. Models trained using our approach have demonstrated superior performance than previously published models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于dBPM（相邻心率差的时间序列）特征工程与新型标注方法的房颤（AFIB）检测框架，用DNN在MITDB与LTAFDB上取得95.18%的F1分数。
AI.motivation: 房颤（不规则心律）的早期检测每年可挽救大量生命，已有研究采用多种算法但检测精度与鲁棒性仍有提升空间，作者希望提升AFIB检测的准确性。
AI.method: 采用传统机器学习算法与神经网络并行比较；核心创新为特征工程——使用相邻心率差值的时间序列（dBPM）替代传统的心搏间期（inter-beat intervals）；输入被标注为五个类别，并设计新的标注方法仅用“干净”间期参与训练，其余视为离群点；在PhysioNet的MITDB与LTAFDB两个数据库上进行评估。
AI.result: 表现最佳的模型为深度神经网络（DNN），在与训练集不同的基准数据集上二分类房颤检测F1分数达95.18%；作者称其性能优于已发表模型。
AI.conclusion: 基于dBPM特征与“干净间期”标注策略的DNN方法能显著提升房颤检测的精度与鲁棒性，具备优于既有方法的检测效果。

title: BiHashFormer: Hash-Driven Dual-Branch Transformer for Efficient Object Detection in HRW Shots
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 34 pages including supplementary material and the NeurIPS checklist. Code: https://github.com/Purecoo00/BiHashFormer
summary: Recent advances in gigapixel-level imaging have brought High-Resolution Wide shots to the forefront of research. However, these images present significant challenges: extreme sparsity of foreground, gigapixel-level resolutions and interleaving of foreground and background. This causes traditional detectors and attention mechanisms to be hindered by background, resulting in inefficiency and inaccuracy. To tackle this problem, we propose BiHashFormer, a dual sparsified branch transformer built on hashing. RoI Selector will predict the foreground proportion for top-k selecting target-containing windows. The compression branch processes windows selected and refines attention into HashAttention by discarding half of the key-value pairs, reducing cost and improving efficiency. The compensation branch uses HashMiner to perform low-cost hash searches in the remaining regions, recovering features of missed objects. Experiments confirm that the selection relationship in HashAttention is one-way and reveal the preference of different queries for keys. In experiments on the gigapixel benchmark PANDA, BiHashFormer reduces 37.5% backbone FLOPs while improving AP50 to 81.0%. Moreover, this parallel dual-branch structure allows the model to avoid inference delays caused by inter-branch dependencies, while achieving much greater stability than single-branch models, specially with low rates of RoI selection.

AI.tldr: BiHashFormer是一个基于哈希的双稀疏分支Transformer，通过RoI Selector选取含目标窗口、HashAttention压缩KV对、HashMiner哈希搜索补偿漏检目标，在十亿像素基准PANDA上减少37.5%骨干FLOPs同时将AP50提升至81.0%。
AI.motivation: 十亿像素级高分辨率广角图像存在前景极度稀疏、分辨率极大、前景与背景交织等问题，导致传统检测器和注意力机制受背景干扰，效率低且精度差。作者希望在大幅降低计算成本的同时保持甚至提升检测精度。
AI.method: 提出双稀疏分支Transformer：(1) RoI Selector预测前景比例，top-k选取含目标的窗口；(2) 压缩分支处理被选窗口，将注意力精炼为HashAttention，丢弃一半key-value对以降低开销；(3) 补偿分支用HashMiner在剩余区域做低成本哈希搜索，恢复漏检目标特征；双分支并行结构避免分支间依赖造成的推理延迟。
AI.result: 实验证实HashAttention中的选择关系是单向的，并揭示了不同query对key的偏好。在PANDA基准上，骨干FLOPs减少37.5%，AP50提升到81.0%；并行双分支结构避免了依赖导致的推理延迟，且比单分支模型更稳定，尤其在RoI选择率低时。
AI.conclusion: 哈希驱动的双稀疏分支设计可有效克服十亿像素图像的前景稀疏与背景干扰问题，在效率、精度与稳定性上取得优势，适合高分辨率广角图像的目标检测。

title: Prefix Executability: Evaluating Tool-Using Agents Beyond Final Success
summary: Tool-use benchmarks often score agents by final task success, but terminal outcomes can obscure whether the intermediate tool-call trajectory was executable. We propose prefix executability as a trajectory-level evaluation protocol for tool-using agents. The protocol measures whether every prefix of a predicted tool-call sequence remains executable under tool schemas, state preconditions, and data dependencies, and summarizes reliability using Prefix Executability Curves (PEC), First-Error Depth (FED), Trajectory Executability Rate (TER), horizon-normalized AUC-PEC, and Recovery Rate (RR). We instantiate the protocol on stratified samples from BFCL-v3 multi-turn and ToolSandbox, and on the complete Airline/Retail base splits of $τ^3$-bench. We observe that outcome-only and prefix-level rankings diverge: agents whose execution is conditioned on an unverified plan often achieve higher point-estimate final success than non-plan-conditioned baselines while substantially lowering TER and AUC-PEC. These divergences are precisely the failure modes that prefix executability is designed to expose: they reveal whether apparent success rests on an executable trajectory, where invalidity first enters, and whether success follows recovery from an earlier failure. As a validation intervention, explicit pre-execution plan checking can improve executable-prefix survival while maintaining competitive terminal success. These results show that final success alone is insufficient for evaluating tool-use agents and that prefix-level executability provides an actionable reliability signal for comparing agents, diagnosing failures, and assessing validation mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"前缀可执行性"这一轨迹级评测协议，用PEC、FED、TER、AUC-PEC、RR五项指标衡量工具调用序列的每一步在工具schema、状态前置条件和数据依赖下是否仍可执行，并证明仅看最终任务成功率会掩盖轨迹层面的可靠性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用（tool-use）智能体基准多以最终任务成功率打分，但终局结果无法反映中间工具调用轨迹是否真正可执行；某些依赖未经验证计划的智能体可能以高失败率换取较高的点估计成功率，这种差异在outcome-only评测下不可见。
AI.method: 提出prefix executability评测协议：检查预测工具调用序列的每个前缀在工具schema、状态前置条件与数据依赖下是否仍可执行；用Prefix Executability Curves (PEC)、First-Error Depth (FED)、Trajectory Executability Rate (TER)、horizon-normalized AUC-PEC、Recovery Rate (RR)进行汇总。实验对象为BFCL-v3多轮与ToolSandbox的分层样本，以及τ³-bench的完整Airline/Retail基础split；并设计"显式执行前计划检查"作为验证性干预。
AI.result: outcome-only排名与prefix-level排名出现分歧：以未经验证计划为执行条件的智能体虽在最终成功率点估计上高于非计划条件基线，却显著降低TER与AUC-PEC。前缀可执行性据此可揭示表观成功是否建立在可执行轨迹上、无效性首次出现在何处、以及成功是否源于对早期失败的恢复。执行前计划检查干预可提升可执行前缀存活率，同时维持有竞争力的终局成功率。
AI.conclusion: 最终成功率不足以评估工具使用智能体；前缀级可执行性提供了可操作、可诊断的可靠性信号，可用于智能体比较、失败归因与验证机制评估。

title: ElasticFormer: Detecting Objects in HRW Shots via Elastic Computing Vision Transformer
comment: Published at CVPR 2026. 14 pages including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/Purecoo00/ElasticFormer
summary: Recent advances in gigapixel-level imaging have brought High-Resolution Wide shots to the forefront of research. However, these images present significant challenges: extreme sparsity of foreground, gigapixel-level resolutions and diverse target counts. This makes traditional close-up detectors inaccurate and slow as they are overwhelmed by the background. Although previous research has explored sparse backbones, their fixed sparsity patterns lack the adaptability required to handle diverse target numbers. To address this, we introduce ElasticFormer, a sparse backbone that dynamically allocates computational resources based on foreground proportion. After scoring windows based on variance, proposed ElasticSelector module will predict the foreground proportion for top-k selection. The mechanism guides the model to select target-containing windows, scaling resources in areas where objects are clustered. We introduce a novel loss function combined with the 3-phase training strategy for ElasticSelector, allowing it to function properly when bounding box annotations are missing. A WSOD study is carried on PASCAL VOC 2007 to evaluate its extensibility. Further, ElasticNet is created to verify its backbone-agnostic nature. In experiments on the PANDA gigapixel benchmark, ElasticFormer reduces backbone FLOPs by 80% while achieving a significant improvement in AP50 when compared to fixed-ratio sparse methods.

AI.tldr: ElasticFormer是一种根据前景比例动态分配计算资源的稀疏骨干网络，用于千兆像素级高分辨率宽幅图像的目标检测，在PANDA基准上减少80%骨干FLOPs并提升AP50。
AI.motivation: 千兆像素级高分辨率宽幅图像存在前景极度稀疏、分辨率极大、目标数量多变的问题；传统近距离检测器被背景淹没而变慢变差，而已有稀疏骨干的固定稀疏模式无法适应目标数量变化。
AI.method: 提出ElasticSelector模块：先基于方差对窗口打分，再预测各窗口前景比例并进行top-k选择，从而引导模型选中含目标窗口并在目标聚集区域分配更多资源；同时设计新损失函数并配合三阶段训练策略，使ElasticSelector在缺少边界框标注时仍能正常工作；另构建ElasticNet验证骨干无关性。
AI.result: 在PANDA千兆像素基准上，相比固定比例稀疏方法，ElasticFormer减少80%骨干FLOPs且AP50显著提升；并在PASCAL VOC 2007上进行WSOD研究评估可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 动态、自适应稀疏的资源分配优于固定稀疏模式，可在大幅降低计算量的同时提升千兆像素图像检测精度，且方法具备骨干无关的通用性。

title: Training language models in simulation for psychiatric intake
comment: 76 pages, 8 figures, 15 tables (27 pages main text, 7 main figures, 2 main tables)
summary: In psychiatric practice, the clinical intake interview remains a primary diagnostic instrument, requiring the clinician to establish rapport while disentangling complex, overlapping presentations. Here, we show that multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation environments improves language model performance on structured text-based psychiatric intake, spanning history-taking, differential diagnosis, and initial management planning. In a randomized, double-blind crossover study ($N = 60$ matched scenario pairs, 120 encounters) comparing the RL-trained agent against its identically prompted base model, 32 board-certified psychiatrists role-played standardized patients while a separate panel of 15 independent, board-certified psychiatrists scored the de-identified transcripts. The trained agent outperformed the base model in 76.7% of matched scenario pairs ($p < 0.0001$), with gains on an adapted clinical-examination rubric ($d_z = 0.77$, $p < 0.0001$), patient-centered communication (82.0% vs. 65.2%, $p < 0.001$), and differential diagnosis appropriateness (68.3% vs. 33.3%, $p < 0.001$). Across 127 psychiatrist-validated simulated intake scenarios, the trained agent nearly doubled its base model's clinical rubric score (0.706 vs. 0.379; composite reward 0.564 vs. 0.294, $p < 0.0001$). To systematically probe conversational safety, we established two Delphi-consensus taxonomies, of clinical safety risks and relational competencies, from which 256 challenging adversarial presentations were derived; we find that training in simulation environments more than halved under-triage of acute safety risks (12.9% vs. 30.5%, $p < 0.0001$). Simulation environments thus provide a controlled testbed for training and stress-testing psychiatric conversational agents, with gains that transferred to psychiatrist-enacted encounters, though residual gaps require safeguards and clinician oversight.

AI.tldr: 多轮强化学习训练的对话智能体在模拟环境中显著提升了结构化精神科接诊表现（病史采集、鉴别诊断、初始管理），并在精神科医师角色扮演的随机双盲交叉试验中优于同提示的基座模型，急性安全风险漏诊率减半，但仍存在残余差距需监督保障。
AI.motivation: 临床接诊访谈是精神科核心诊断工具，要求医师在建立融洽关系的同时梳理复杂重叠的临床表现。论文试图验证模拟环境中的多轮强化学习能否提升语言模型在结构化文本精神科接诊中的能力，并系统评估其对话安全性。
AI.method: 采用模拟环境中的多轮强化学习训练智能体。开展随机双盲交叉研究（N=60 匹配情景对，共120次接诊）：32名委员会认证精神科医师扮演标准化患者，15名独立认证精神科医师对去标识化转录文本评分。评估工具包括改编临床检查量规、患者中心沟通指标、鉴别诊断适当性。另基于两项德尔菲共识分类学（临床安全风险、关系胜任力）衍生256个对抗性挑战情景，检验安全性。
AI.result: 训练智能体在76.7%匹配情景对中优于基座模型（p<0.0001）；临床量规d_z=0.77，患者中心沟通82.0% vs 65.2%，鉴别诊断适当性68.3% vs 33.3%（均p<0.001）。在127个经医师验证的模拟情景中，临床量规分0.706 vs 0.379，复合奖励0.564 vs 0.294（p<0.0001）。对抗性测试中急性安全风险漏诊率由30.5%降至12.9%（p<0.0001）。
AI.conclusion: 模拟环境可作为精神科对话智能体的受控训练与压力测试平台，训练增益可迁移至真实医师参与的接诊场景；但残余差距要求配备安全防护措施与临床医师监督。

title: Heterogeneous Co-Evolution Learning for Tool-Efficient Search Agents with Zero Labels
summary: Deep search agents extend language models by interleaving reasoning with external retrieval. However, effective search-agent training requires addressing two challenges beyond final-answer optimization. First, the capability frontier of agents is largely determined by training questions, whereas fixed or labeled task collections cannot adapt as agents improve. Second, outcome-only reinforcement learning treats all successful trajectories equally, even when some correct answers rely on redundant searches, creating an inherent tension between answer accuracy and tool efficiency. To address these issues, we introduce \textsc{ZEST-Search}, a zero-label and tool-efficient framework for search-agent training via heterogeneous co-evolution. Starting from unlabeled reference questions, \textsc{ZEST-Search} constructs validated search tasks online through an answer-first and evidence-path-guided generation process. A heterogeneous proposer adaptively constructs training tasks around the solver's evolving capability boundary, while the solver learns search-augmented reasoning through reinforcement learning. To jointly optimize task difficulty and search efficiency, \textsc{ZEST-Search} employs an intermediate-difficulty reward for the proposer and a task-local tool-aware reward for the solver, encouraging informative tasks and correct answers with fewer redundant searches. Experiments on seven general-domain and multi-hop question answering benchmarks demonstrate that \textsc{ZEST-Search} consistently improves search-agent performance while achieving higher tool efficiency without labeled search-training data or expert search trajectories. Further analyses show that heterogeneous generation, adaptive difficulty control, and tool-aware optimization enable more effective search-agent training.

AI.tldr: 提出ZEST-Search，一个零标注、工具高效的搜索智能体训练框架，通过异质协同进化实现任务在线生成与求解器能力同步提升。
AI.motivation: 现有搜索智能体训练存在两个问题：一是固定或带标注的任务集无法随智能体能力提升而自适应调整，能力前沿受训练问题限制；二是仅基于结果奖励的强化学习将所有成功轨迹同等对待，忽视了冗余搜索，导致答案准确率与工具效率之间存在张力。
AI.method: 从无标注参考问题出发，采用"答案优先+证据路径引导"的生成流程在线构建可验证搜索任务；异质提议器围绕求解器不断演进的能力边界自适应生成任务，求解器通过强化学习学习搜索增强推理。奖励设计上，对提议器采用中等难度奖励，对求解器采用任务局部、工具感知的奖励，鼓励生成有信息量的任务并减少冗余搜索。
AI.result: 在七个通用领域与多跳问答基准上，无需标注搜索训练数据和专家搜索轨迹，ZEST-Search稳定提升搜索智能体性能，同时获得更高的工具效率。
AI.conclusion: 异质生成、自适应难度控制与工具感知优化是提升搜索智能体训练效果的关键因素，二者协同实现了零标注下的准确率与效率双优。

title: UniRA: Unified Representation Alignment and Auto-Encoding for Efficient Diffusion Generation
summary: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) have become the dominant architecture for high-fidelity image synthesis, yet they suffer from slow training convergence and high computational cost. Two recent lines of work address this from complementary angles: Representation Alignment (REPA) accelerates DiT training by aligning intermediate features with a pretrained external representation model (e.g., DINOv2), while Representation Auto-Encoders (RAE) replace the pixel-space VAE with a compact representation-space tokenizer learned from self-supervised features. However, these approaches are developed and applied in isolation: REPA still relies on a pixel-space VAE for latent diffusion, and RAE does not exploit the alignment signal that accelerates the diffusion backbone. We present \textbf{UniRA}, a unified framework that couples representation alignment and representation auto-encoding into a single objective. UniRA learns a representation-space tokenizer whose output serves simultaneously as the diffusion target and the alignment anchor, so the tokenizer, the diffusion backbone, and the external representation model are co-optimized. We give a theoretical result showing that this joint optimization preserves the representation quality of the external model while accelerating diffusion convergence, and we derive a principled weighting that balances the reconstruction, alignment, and generation objectives. On ImageNet class-conditional generation at 256*256 and 512*512, UniRA matches or surpasses state-of-the-art DiTs (SD3, REPA, RAE) in FID while reducing training steps by up to 5*. We further show that the unified representation space supports improved zero-shot classification and linear probing, confirming that generation and understanding benefit from a shared, aligned latent space.

AI.tldr: UniRA 将表征对齐（REPA）与表征自编码（RAE）统一为单一目标：学习一个表征空间 tokenizer，其输出同时作为扩散目标与对齐锚点，使 tokenizer、扩散骨干与外部表征模型协同优化。
AI.motivation: DiT 训练收敛慢、计算开销大。REPA 通过对齐预训练外部表征（如 DINOv2）加速训练，RAE 用自监督特征学到的表征空间 tokenizer 替代像素空间 VAE，但二者彼此孤立：REPA 仍依赖像素空间 VAE，RAE 未利用对齐信号。作者希望将两条互补路线耦合。
AI.method: 提出统一框架 UniRA：表征空间 tokenizer 的输出同时充当扩散目标和表征对齐锚点，从而联合优化 tokenizer、扩散骨干与外部表征模型；给出理论结果说明该联合优化在保持外部模型表征质量的同时加速扩散收敛；并推导出平衡重建、对齐与生成三项损失的原则化权重。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 256×256 与 512×512 类别条件生成上，UniRA 的 FID 匹配或优于 SOTA DiT（SD3、REPA、RAE），训练步数最多减少 5 倍；统一表征空间还支持更好的零样本分类与线性探测。
AI.conclusion: 将表征对齐与表征自编码联合建模可同时提升生成效率与表征质量，共享且对齐的潜空间使生成与理解任务共同受益。

title: FIRME: Registry-Anchored Memory Graphs for Evolving, Heterogeneous Investor Knowledge
comment: 20 pages. Accepted at the 3rd Workshop on LLMs and Generative AI for Finance (AI4F) at ACM ICAIF 2026 (non-archival)
summary: Financial AI workflows that reuse investor knowledge need persistent memory that integrates observations across sources and periods without losing identity or provenance. In a knowledge graph, recurring observations may use different surface forms, fragmenting relationship histories and preventing evidence from accumulating. We introduce Fusion and Identity Registry for Memory Evolution (FIRME), a registry-anchored memory graph that reconciles incoming observations to persistent canonical relationships and retains their source, time, and context. Within periods, rule-based fusion links investor-call discussions to portfolio cash-flow signals, directly or through a fixed product-topic ontology. Across periods, canonical identities and persistent aliases direct recurring observations to the same relationship history; deterministic updates summarize reinforcement, inactivity, and reactivation. We evaluate FIRME on proprietary investor-call and cash-flow records and on S&P 500 earnings-call transcripts. Compared with a historical registry that retains canonical identities and semantic fallback but omits alias memory, FIRME increases final-period Correct Match Rate by 7.8-12.1 percentage points across four dataset-backend settings under a fixed-judge and fallback-review protocol. A blinded human audit of 200 incoming observations per setting finds Correct Match Rate gains of 9.0-16.5 points and reattachment-recall gains of 22.5-29.0 points, with higher observed merge precision in all four samples. A separate audit finds valid evidence paths for 293 of 300 outputs from full within-period fusion in the investor-call setting. Extraction-faithfulness and round-trip diagnostics assess source grounding and preservation of extractor-derived graph content.

AI.tldr: 提出FIRME：一种以注册表为锚的记忆图谱，将跨来源、跨周期的投资者观察归并到持久的规范关系上，保留来源、时间与上下文，解决表面形式差异导致的证据碎片化问题。
AI.motivation: 金融AI工作流复用投资者知识需要跨来源、跨周期的持久记忆，且不能丢失身份与溯源。但知识图谱中反复出现的观察常以不同表面形式表述，导致关系历史被割裂、证据无法累积。
AI.method: FIRME以注册表为锚的记忆图谱：周期内采用规则融合，将投资者电话讨论与组合现金流信号直接或经固定产品-主题本体关联；跨周期通过规范身份与持久别名把重复观察导向同一关系历史；并采用确定性更新刻画加固、沉寂与重新激活。
AI.result: 在自有投资者电话与现金流记录及S&P 500财报电话记录上评估：相比保留规范身份与语义回退但缺少别名记忆的历史注册表，四个数据集-后端设置下末期正确匹配率提升7.8–12.1个百分点；每设置200条观察的盲审显示正确匹配率提升9.0–16.5点、重挂接召回提升22.5–29.0点，合并精度均更高；投资者电话设置下300个输出中293条具备有效证据路径。
AI.conclusion: 持久别名记忆与规范身份注册显著提升跨期关系归并的准确性与证据累积能力，并保持来源可溯；提取忠实度与往返诊断进一步验证了图内容对抽取结果的保真与来源接地。

title: Smartphone Indoor Localization Enhanced by Hierarchical Multi-Sensor Context Recognition
summary: Smartphone indoor localization requires low-cost, robust positioning across scene transitions and phone-use variations. Pedestrian dead reckoning (PDR) enables infrastructure-free deployment but accumulates errors from heading drift, structural transitions, and carrying-mode changes. Existing methods often treat contextual cues as a single event stream or local correction signal, limiting their ability to address distinct localization errors. This paper presents a framework enhanced by hierarchical multi-sensor context recognition. A jointly data- and model-driven recognition model predicts environment, scene, and activity probabilities, which are converted into scene-event and action-context segments. Scene-event segments guide scene-constrained PDR correction through corridor heading constraints, landmark attraction, fixed-lag backtracking, and vertical-transition handling. Action-context segments drive action-aware RoNIN-based position compensation for carrying-mode-dependent drift. Experiments on cross-floor and multi-action trajectories against LiDAR-SLAM references show that the proposed framework outperforms PDR and representative learned inertial odometry baselines, demonstrating that hierarchical semantics provide reliable, localization-specific correction cues.

AI.tldr: 提出层级多传感器情境识别框架，将“场景事件”与“动作情境”两类语义分别用于PDR的场景约束修正与动作感知位置补偿，提升手机室内定位鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 手机室内定位需低成本、跨场景切换与持握变化下稳健；PDR虽免基础设施但存在航向漂移、结构转换、携带模式变化导致的误差累积。现有方法把情境线索当作单一事件流或局部修正信号，难以分别应对不同性质的定位误差。
AI.method: 构建层级多传感器情境识别：数据与模型联合驱动的识别模型输出环境、场景、活动概率，并转化为场景事件段与动作情境段。场景事件段用于场景约束PDR修正（走廊航向约束、地标吸引、固定滞后回溯、垂直转换处理）；动作情境段驱动基于RoNIN的动作感知位置补偿，以抑制携带模式相关漂移。
AI.result: 在跨楼层与多动作轨迹上，以LiDAR-SLAM为参考，所提框架优于PDR及代表性学习式惯性里程计基线。
AI.conclusion: 层级语义可为定位提供可靠且面向具体误差类型的修正线索。

title: Mind The Gap (MTG-AD): Dataset and Fine-grained Evaluation for End-to-End Inline Audio Descriptions
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations & Datasets Track, camera ready
summary: Audio descriptions (AD) are essential for making visual media accessible to blind and low-vision (BLV) users. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer a scalable solution for generating audio descriptions on-demand, their performance on ``inline'' audio descriptions -- which must fit within existing silences in a video -- remains under-explored, particularly for diverse user-generated content (UGC). We present a comprehensive investigation into MLLM-generated inline audio descriptions. First, we introduce MTG-AD, a professionally annotated dataset of 36 hours of videos, each averaging $\sim$5 mins. and 8k+ descriptions in total, co-created by paired blind and sighted AD professionals to provide a high-quality benchmark for this task. Second, we propose MTG-AD-Eval, an evaluation framework based on audio description expert guidelines that provides fine-grained, reference-free actionable metrics for model improvement. Crucially, our framework evaluates the end-to-end task: it renders the generated scripts into audio tracks to assess their fit within the original video's natural silences, minimizing disruptive overlaps. Our analysis across frontier MLLMs reveals that while models accurately describe visual events and substantially reduce speech overlaps, gaps persist in narrative pacing and flow. Finally, we empirically validate that our automated and reference-free metrics correlate significantly with human quality ratings from sighted raters and 7 BLV participants, finding that while users narrowly prefer human-authored audio descriptions, they find MLLM-generated audio descriptions highly beneficial for comprehension. We provide actionable system design guidance and release MTG-AD at https://hf.co/datasets/google/mind-the-gap-inline-ad and MTG-AD-Eval at https://github.com/google/mtg-ad.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究MLLM生成"内联式"音频描述（inline AD）在UGC视频上的表现，发布MTG-AD数据集（36小时、8k+条描述）与MTG-AD-Eval评估框架，揭示模型视觉描述准确、语音重叠显著降低，但叙事节奏与流畅性仍有不足，且自动化无参考指标与人工评分显著相关。
AI.motivation: 音频描述对盲人和低视力用户获取视觉媒体至关重要，MLLM可按需生成AD，但其在必须嵌入视频原有静音间隙的"内联式"AD上表现缺乏研究，尤其在多样化UGC内容上。
AI.method: 1) 构建MTG-AD数据集：36小时视频（平均约5分钟），共8k+条描述，由盲人与明眼AD专家配对共同标注；2) 提出MTG-AD-Eval：基于AD专家指南的细粒度、无参考、可操作的评估框架；3) 端到端评估：将生成文本渲染为音轨，检验其在原视频自然静音中的适配度，最小化干扰性重叠；4) 跨前沿MLLM进行系统分析，并与明眼评分者及7位BLV用户的人工评分做相关性验证。
AI.result: 模型能准确描述视觉事件并大幅减少语音重叠，但在叙事节奏与流畅性上仍存在差距；自动化无参考指标与人工质量评分显著相关；用户略偏好人工撰写AD，但认为MLLM生成的AD对理解内容高度有益。
AI.conclusion: 内联式AD是MLLM可规模化应用但有改进空间的方向，需重视节奏与流畅性；论文提供可操作的系统设计建议，并开源MTG-AD数据集与MTG-AD-Eval框架。

title: Agentic University: Collaborative Agents for Personalized Learning
summary: Large language models support personalized tutoring, content generation, and adaptive learning paths. However, capability development requires these resources and interactions to form a coherent learning process that evolves with the learner. A central challenge is to align goals, activities, and assessment while using learning evidence to decide what should follow. We introduce Human-Participatory Multi-Agent Organization and instantiate it in Agentic University (AU). In AU, learners participate as organization members and work with specialized agents to maintain a revisable Capability Program. The program connects personal goals, learning activities across modalities, and layered assessment, while learner feedback and performance guide subsequent support. Our evaluation shows advantages in program organization, assessment design, and revision quality. Users achieved larger mean assessment gains (12.19 versus 5.61 points on a 50-point scale) and reported stronger cognitive support. This work contributes an organizational approach to adaptive learning that makes learner participation a continuing basis for multi-agent coordination. The Agentic University project is available at \href{https://github.com/AgenticOrgLab/AgenticUniversity.git}.

AI.tldr: 提出"人类参与式多智能体组织"(Human-Participatory Multi-Agent Organization)并落地为"Agentic University (AU)":学习者作为组织成员与专用智能体协作维护可修订的"能力项目"(Capability Program),贯通个人目标、多模态学习活动与分层评估,并以学习证据驱动后续支持。
AI.motivation: 大模型可支撑个性化辅导、内容生成与自适应学习路径,但仅靠资源与单次交互难以构成随学习者演化的连贯学习过程;核心挑战在于对齐目标、活动与评估,并利用学习证据决定下一步。
AI.method: 以组织化视角设计多智能体协作框架:学习者作为组织成员参与,与角色化/专用智能体协同构建并持续修订 Capability Program;该程序显式连接个人目标、跨模态学习活动与多层评估,并将学习者反馈与表现作为协调智能体后续支持的持续依据。
AI.result: 在项目组织、评估设计与修订质量方面表现更优;用户平均评估提升更大(50 分制下 12.19 对 5.61),并报告更强的认知支持感知。
AI.conclusion: 贡献了一种面向自适应学习的组织化方法,使学习者参与成为多智能体协调的持续基础;项目已开源。

title: Preserving Utility in Continual LLM Unlearning via Orthogonal Projections
summary: Unlearning concerns the task of removing the influence of a sensitive portion of the training data, such as protected, copyrighted or private text, from a model without retraining it from scratch. While unlearning requests happen continuously during a model's lifetime, the vast majority of LLM unlearning methods are ill-suited for iterated removal, yielding steep decay in forgetting and utility upon sequential unlearning. This decay stems from interference between successive updates, as each new deletion can undo earlier ones or push the model further along directions already degraded by them. To address this, we introduce Continual Orthogonal Projection (COP), a gradient-projection scheme that restricts each update to the orthogonal complement of activation subspaces cached from prior forget sets. This approach provably guarantees first-order non-interference with earlier deletions. COP stores only a low-rank basis per layer, requiring neither past gradients nor previous forget sets, and plugs into unlearning methods that update the model through gradient steps on a differentiable loss without modifying its objective. Experiments on standard LLM unlearning benchmarks (TOFU and RWKU) show that COP preserves utility across sequential requests without weakening forgetting, preventing the collapse of standard objectives and forgetting more effectively than continual-specific baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出Continual Orthogonal Projection (COP)，一种梯度投影方案，将每次遗忘更新限制在先前遗忘集激活子空间的正交补中，保证对早期删除的一阶非干扰，并仅需每层低秩基，实现LLM持续遗忘且不损失效用。
AI.motivation: LLM生命周期内遗忘请求持续发生，但绝大多数遗忘方法不适合迭代删除；顺序遗忘时连续更新相互干扰，新删除会撤销先前删除或将模型推向已退化方向，导致遗忘效果与效用急剧衰减。
AI.method: COP将每次梯度更新投影到由先前遗忘集缓存的激活子空间的正交补上；每层仅存储一个低秩基，无需历史梯度或先前遗忘集；可作为插件接入任何通过可微损失梯度步更新模型的遗忘方法，且不修改其目标函数。
AI.result: 理论证明一阶非干扰性；在TOFU与RWKU基准上，COP在连续请求中保持效用且不削弱遗忘，防止标准目标崩溃，遗忘效果优于持续学习专用基线。
AI.conclusion: COP通过正交投影有效解决顺序遗忘中的更新干扰问题，为LLM持续遗忘提供理论可证、存储高效且通用的解决方案。

title: Implicit Bias of (Stochastic) Gradient Descent on Deep Linear Diagonal Networks
summary: Modern machine learning models are often overparameterized, i.e., have more parameters than training data. This typically implies that the loss function admits multiple minimizers so that training methods (and their hyperparameter choices) have significant influence on the computed solution. We study this so-called implicit bias phenomenon in the context of training deep linear diagonal networks. Previous work has shown that the gradient flow for learning such networks converges to (almost) sparse solutions when initialized small. For an arbitrary number of layers, we extend this analysis to the practically more realistic (stochastic) gradient descent iterations. Our approach identifies (stochastic) gradient descent as a perturbed (stochastic) mirror gradient descent. This allows us to establish convergence and characterize the limiting solution, relating it to weighted $\ell_1$-minimization. Moreover, we provide sufficient conditions on the step sizes and quantify the influence of the step sizes on the implicit bias.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究深度线性对角网络在随机梯度下降下的隐式偏置，将SGD刻画为带扰动的随机镜像梯度下降，并证明其收敛到与加权ℓ1极小化相关的稀疏极限解。
AI.motivation: 过参数化模型损失存在多个极小解，训练方法与超参选择显著影响最终解（隐式偏置）。已有工作仅针对小初始化下深度线性对角网络的梯度流证明了趋近稀疏解，缺乏对更贴近实际的（随机）梯度下降迭代的普适分析。
AI.method: 对任意层数的深度线性对角网络，将（随机）梯度下降识别为带扰动的（随机）镜像梯度下降，从而建立收敛性并刻画极限解，将其与加权ℓ1极小化相联系；同时给出步长的充分条件，并量化步长对隐式偏置的影响。
AI.result: 证明了（随机）梯度下降迭代的收敛性，刻画了极限解并建立其与加权ℓ1极小化的关系；给出保证结论成立的步长充分条件，并量化了步长对隐式偏置的作用。
AI.conclusion: 将梯度流的隐式偏置分析从任意层数的深度线性对角网络推广到（随机）梯度下降，揭示了算法（步长）与加权ℓ1正则化之间的隐式对应关系，说明训练超参可控制解的稀疏结构。

title: DINOv2 for PET: A Pre-Training Domain Benchmark Across Classification, Segmentation, and Prognosis
summary: DINO (self-DIstillation with NO labels) has become a stan- dard for self-supervised pre-training, producing features that generalise across datasets and downstream tasks. In medical imaging it has been adopted mainly for radiology (X-ray, CT and MRI), where even natural- image DINO features transfer well. In the literature, these features have been reported to transfer worse to functional imaging such as PET. Yet PET-specific DINO models have barely been introduced, and even less validated across multiple tasks and datasets. We present PET-DINOv2-2D, the first DINOv2 model pre-trained on 2D PET, and benchmark it against open-source encoders: the origi- nal DINOv2 (pre-trained on the LVD-142M natural-image dataset) and OmniRad (pre-trained on CT, MRI and ultrasound). Using the same lightweight heads for every backbone, and despite far less pre-training data, PET-DINOv2-2D matches or outperforms both on three down- stream PET tasks: normal/abnormal classification, lesion segmentation and recurrence-free survival prognosis. Its advantage is largest when few labels are available, suggesting that PET pre-training gives more transferable, label-efficient features. Code is made available at https://github.com/nuclivision/pet-dinov2-2d/.

AI.tldr: 首个在二维PET图像上预训练的DINOv2模型 PET-DINOv2-2D，在正常/异常分类、病灶分割、无复发生存预后三项下游任务上匹配或超越原始DINOv2与OmniRad，且标签稀缺时优势最明显。
AI.motivation: 自然图像DINO特征在放射影像（X-ray、CT、MRI）上迁移良好，但对PET等功能成像迁移效果较差；而PET专用的DINO模型鲜有提出，更缺乏跨多任务、多数据集的验证。
AI.method: 构建PET-DINOv2-2D：在二维PET数据上进行DINOv2自监督预训练；与两个开源编码器（LVD-142M自然图像预训练的DINOv2、CT/MRI/超声预训练的OmniRad）对比，所有骨干网络统一配备相同的轻量下游头。
AI.result: 尽管预训练数据量远少，PET-DINOv2-2D在正常/异常分类、病灶分割、无复发生存预后三项任务上均匹配或优于两个基线；在标签数量有限时优势最大。
AI.conclusion: PET专属预训练可提供更具可迁移性与标签效率的特征，支持功能性成像领域采用专用自监督模型。

title: Algebraic World Model: From Exploration to Proofs
comment: 29 pages, 9 figures, 14 tables. Project page: https://ephemeral6.github.io/awm-site/. Ancillary files contain the Lean 4 model of the running example lp85
summary: AI has made remarkable progress in mathematics, solving challenging problems with machine-checkable proofs in Lean, yet typically relying on predefined mathematical definitions and formal specifications. This raises a natural question: can it reason rigorously about an unknown world? We introduce the Algebraic World Model (AWM), a framework that turns interaction with unfamiliar environments into explicit mathematical models supporting formal reasoning. AWM explores the environment and develops executable Python hypotheses, continually testing and revising them against observations. It then structures these hypotheses into typed objects and shared rules, simplifies their structure through category-theory-guided transformations, and formalizes the resulting model in Lean 4 to prove reachability and impossibility. AWM can formally prove that a goal is unreachable, even beyond explored trajectories. On two impossible game levels, it constructs closed, kernel-checked Lean proofs excluding every legal winning sequence in all six runs, while Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, equipped with coding tools, produce none in twelve baseline runs. Four of AWM's six initial bounds are correct, compared with one for Opus 5.5 and none for GPT-6 Astra; given only feedback that a cheaper win exists, AWM revises its rules and constructs new proofs, reaching six of six correct bounds. Moreover, AWM produces interpretable mathematical models whose rules can be inspected and tested step by step. Across all 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games, these models enable Lean to replay the winning trajectories of all 183 levels and generalize beyond observed play, predicting unseen transitions and detecting changes in game mechanics. With Claude Opus 5, AWM clears all levels with a score of 99.9, while its certified winning trajectories use only 43% of the human baseline's actions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出代数世界模型（AWM）框架，将未知环境中的交互转化为可形式化推理的显式数学模型，并在Lean 4中证明目标可达性与不可达性。
AI.motivation: 当前AI在数学上取得显著进展，能够在Lean中产生机器可验证的证明，但通常依赖预定义的数学定义与形式规范。由此引出核心问题：AI能否对未知世界进行严格推理？论文希望让智能体在与陌生环境交互中自动构建可形式推理的数学理论。
AI.method: AWM先探索环境并提出可执行的Python假设，持续用观测检验与修正；随后把假设结构化为带类型的对象与共享规则，借助范畴论引导的变换对结构进行化简，最终将所得模型形式化到Lean 4中，用于证明可达性与不可能性。
AI.result: 在含失败轨迹的不可达设定中，AWM于两个不可获胜游戏关卡上构造了封闭的、经内核检查的Lean证明，排除全部合法获胜序列（6次运行全部成功），而Claude Opus 5.5与GPT-6 Astra在12次基线运行中均未产出证明；初始边界有4/6正确（Opus 5.5为1/6，GPT-6 Astra为0），仅给定“存在更优解”的反馈后自动修正规则，达到6/6正确。在全部25个公开ARC-AGI-3游戏中，模型使Lean能够重放全部183个关卡的获胜轨迹，并能泛化预测未见转移、检测游戏机制变化；配合Claude Opus 5，AWM以99.9分通关所有关卡，其经认证的获胜轨迹仅使用人类基线43%的动作数。
AI.conclusion: AWM表明智能体可从不熟悉的交互中自主构建可解释、可检验、可形式化的数学世界模型，实现对未知世界的严格推理，并在不可达性证明、泛化预测与高效通关方面显著优于强基线，为形式化世界建模提供了可行范式。

title: Grounding Predictive Reliability through Masked Observability
summary: An uncertainty estimate is meaningful only if its semantics can be tied to observable predictive behavior. Normal-Inverse-Gamma (NIG) evidential regression provides a structured decomposition of predictive variability into data-scale and predictive-mean components, but marginal likelihood does not identify their allocation. We address this semantic ambiguity in masked representation learning. MORSE (Masked Observability for Reliable Structured Encoding) predicts the same hidden target under controlled changes in visible context and uses normalized cross-context variation to ground predictive-mean uncertainty, while a Gaussian objective learns the conditional mean and data scale. The normalized variation plays the role of the NIG factor $1/ν$, which the marginal leaves unidentified; this yields a policy-relative observability variance that measures dependence on visible evidence, distinct from variation induced by resampling the training set. On a Gaussian-process benchmark with a contextual reference built from analytic Bayes conditional means, MORSE has the lowest log-variance error among compared evidential, ensemble, and dropout estimators in all nine tested settings, while the estimator closest to training-set variation perturbs the model rather than its context in every setting, so the two references separate the estimators empirically. MORSE amortizes observability estimation into one forward pass per observation state. On a heteroscedastic pulse benchmark, its predictor's cross-context variance approaches a large-sample reference as training data increase. MORSE also improves low-label transfer on PTB-XL and in-distribution trajectory prediction on IMPTC.

AI.tldr: MORSE通过在多上下文下预测同一隐藏目标并用归一化跨上下文变化来锚定预测均值不确定性，解决NIG证据回归中边际似然无法辨识不确定度分配的语义模糊问题。
AI.motivation: NIG证据回归将预测变异性分解为数据尺度与预测均值两部分，但边际似然无法辨识二者的分配，导致不确定性语义与可观测预测行为脱节。作者在掩码表示学习中针对这一语义模糊性提出解决思路。
AI.method: MORSE（Masked Observability for Reliable Structured Encoding）在可见上下文受控变化下预测同一隐藏目标，用归一化跨上下文变化来锚定预测均值不确定性，其角色相当于NIG中边际似然无法辨识的因子1/ν；数据尺度与条件均值由高斯目标学习。由此得到一种"策略相对"的可观测性方差，衡量预测对可见证据的依赖，区别于重采样训练集带来的变异。可观测性估计被摊销为每个观测状态一次前向传播。
AI.result: 在基于解析贝叶斯条件均值构建上下文参考的高斯过程基准上，MORSE在全部9种设置下的对数方差误差均低于所比较的证据、集成与dropout估计器；而最接近训练集变异的估计器在每种设置中都扰动模型而非其上下文，从经验上区分了两类参考。在同方差脉冲基准上，随训练数据增加，其预测器的跨上下文方差趋近大样本参考。MORSE还提升了PTB-XL的低标签迁移与IMPTC的分布内轨迹预测。
AI.conclusion: 通过以归一化跨上下文变化替代不可辨识的NIG因子，MORSE赋予预测均值不确定性可观测的语义，实现了更准确、可摊销且可迁移的不确定性估计。

title: Segment Anything Model Based Context Guided Mamba Unet for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Medical image segmentation is crucial for clinical diagnosis and treatment planning, requiring both global contextual understanding and fine-grained structural precision. While the Segment Anything Model (SAM) demonstrates strong generalization capabilities, its direct application to medical images often lacks domain-specific adaptability. Meanwhile, State Space Models (SSMs)-based methods, such as Mamba, efficiently capture long-range dependencies but may struggle with preserving fine anatomical details. To address these challenges, we propose a segment anything model based context guided mamba unet, SAMBA-UNet, a novel framework that integrates SAM's context knowledge with Mamba's hierarchical feature learning to enhance both global representation and local detail refinement. Specifically, we introduce the Hierarchical Context Enhancement Module (HCEM), an attention-based fusion module that deeply incorporates the multi-level features of SAM and Mamba to improve detail perception and segmentation precision. Additionally, we employ LoRA and Adapter-based fine-tuning to adapt SAM to medical imaging tasks, further enhancing its domain-specific segmentation capability and robustness. We conducted a comprehensive study on several medical segmentation datasets, including Synapse, ISIC17, and ISIC18, evaluating our method across multiple metrics. Experimental results demonstrate that SAMBA-UNet achieves state-of-the-art performance, effectively balancing generalization, segmentation accuracy, and computational efficiency. Our code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出SAMBA-UNet，将SAM的上下文知识与Mamba的层次特征学习结合，并设计HCEM融合模块与LoRA/Adapter微调，在Synapse、ISIC17、ISIC18上取得SOTA分割性能。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割需兼顾全局上下文与细粒度结构精度；SAM泛化强但缺乏医学领域适应性，Mamba类SSM方法能高效建模长程依赖却易损失细解剖细节。
AI.method: 构建基于SAM的上下文引导Mamba U-Net框架：用HCEM（基于注意力的融合模块）深度融合SAM多层级特征与Mamba层次特征以增强细节感知；采用LoRA与Adapter微调使SAM适配医学影像任务。
AI.result: 在Synapse、ISIC17、ISIC18等多个数据集、多指标上验证，达到SOTA性能，在泛化性、分割精度与计算效率间取得良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: SAM与Mamba的互补融合（结合参数高效微调）可有效提升医学图像分割的精度与领域适应性；代码将在录用后开源。

title: Efficient Scalable Oversight via Rewinding
summary:
Scalable oversight asks how a weak verifier can check the outputs of computations performed by more powerful AI systems. One proposed approach uses relativizing interactive proofs, in which a weak verifier checks the output of a complex oracle-aided computation by interacting with one or more powerful provers. A prominent example is debate, which is highly efficient but assumes that one of two powerful AI models, or provers, is truthful. For certain classes of oracle-aided computations, this assumption can be removed, but at substantially greater computational cost.
  In this work, we introduce \emph{rewindable interactive proofs} (RIPs), a new model of relativizing interactive proofs for scalable oversight. In an RIP, the verifier may rewind the prover to an earlier state of the interaction and continue from there. This is possible when the prover is an AI model, since the verifier can save a snapshot of the model's state and later restore it. We construct a relativizing RIP for computations whose outputs are robust to changing a small fraction of oracle answers. Our construction is more efficient than prior relativizing proofs that do not assume a truthful prover, and it uses no cryptography.
  In our construction the honest prover runs in time linear in that of the original computation, and the verifier, after a one-time preprocessing step, runs in time nearly linear in the input length (which can be much smaller than the computation itself). We implement our protocol, report a preliminary MNIST experiment, and show that an RIP can be faster than a state-of-the-art deployed proof system.
  RIPs may be of independent interest. Rewinding is possible whenever the verifier controls the prover's machine, for example when the prover runs on trusted hardware or in a virtual machine whose state can be checkpointed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可回卷交互式证明"(RIPs)，利用验证者可对AI证明者状态做快照与恢复的能力实现回卷，为稳健型预言机计算构造了无需密码学、且比现有不假设证明者诚实的相对化证明更高效的协议。
AI.motivation: 可扩展监督问题：弱验证者如何核验更强AI系统的计算输出。现有方案中，辩论(debate)高效但需假设两名强大证明者之一诚实；去除该假设的既有相对化交互证明方案计算开销过大。作者希望在不假设诚实证明者的前提下，降低开销。
AI.method: 引入可回卷交互式证明(RIPs)模型：验证者可把证明者回卷到交互的早期状态并从那里继续，这在证明者是AI模型时可行（保存模型状态快照后恢复）。针对"输出对少量预言机答案改变具有稳健性"的一类计算构造相对化RIP，不使用密码学。
AI.result: 诚实证明者运行时间为原计算时间的线性量级；验证者在一次性预处理后以关于输入长度近线性的时间运行（输入可远小于计算本身）。实现了协议，报告了初步MNIST实验，并显示RIP可比现有已部署的先进证明系统更快。
AI.conclusion: RIPs可作为独立有价值的模型：只要验证者控制证明者所在机器（如可信硬件或可做检查点的虚拟机），回卷即可实现。

title: On the Fundamental Limits of Prefill-Based Decoding Length Prediction
summary: Predicting how many tokens a large language model (LLM) will decode, using only prefill-phase hidden states, is a key primitive for inference scheduling. We show that current benchmarks conflate predictor quality with task hardness: when the target model, dataset, or sampling configuration changes, reported accuracy collapses even though the predictor is unchanged. We trace this instability to an overlooked error source---the inherent stochasticity of autoregressive decoding---and derive bounds that every prefill-side method must obey. Our analysis treats decoding as a stopped stochastic process. The per-step stopping probability of a response is not constant but ramps up over hundreds of steps, so the decode length inherits a central limit theorem from the many local decisions that determine where a response ends; this yields per-prompt normality with an explicit error term, together with an affine variance law $σ=αμ+b$ whose slope is the coefficient of variation of the number of response segments. Empirically, the normal law reproduces the per-prompt MAE and the central mass of the decode-length distribution to within a few percent, and the residual departures from normality (mild right skew, slight excess kurtosis) are the ones predicted by the sampling-noise correction. Under fixed model, data, and sampling conditions, a broad design space of predictors (MLP, EGTP, FiLM, soft-label, and Mixture-of-Experts variants) converges to similar performance close to the bound, confirming that \emph{system error dominates model error}. We argue for a benchmarking protocol that fixes the model, data, and sampling parameters and that reports relative-error metrics alongside absolute ones. Code and analysis tools are available at https://github.com/ShwStone/DecodingPredict.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出仅用prefill阶段隐藏状态预测LLM解码长度的现有基准混淆了预测器质量与任务难度，并将不稳定性归因于自回归解码的内在随机性，进而用"停时随机过程"给出每prompt正态性与仿射方差律这一理论上界，证明系统误差主导模型误差。
AI.motivation: 解码长度预测是推理调度的关键原语，但现有评测中当目标模型、数据集或采样配置变化时，报告精度会崩塌，即便预测器本身未变；作者希望揭示这一现象背后的被忽视误差来源，从而厘清预测器质量与任务难度，并建立合理的评测协议。
AI.method: 将解码建模为停时随机过程：每步停止概率并非常数，而是在数百步内递增，解码长度由众多局部决策共同决定，因而继承中心极限定理。由此推导出带显式误差项的每prompt正态性，以及仿射方差律σ=αμ+b，其斜率等于响应分段数的变异系数；并给出所有prefill侧方法必须遵守的误差界。实验上对比MLP、EGTP、FiLM、soft-label、MoE等多种预测器设计，并在固定模型、数据、采样条件下评测。
AI.result: 正态律能以数个百分点以内的精度复现每prompt MAE与解码长度分布的中心质量；残差的非正态偏离（轻微右偏、略超额峰度）恰为采样噪声修正所预测。在固定模型、数据与采样条件下，广泛设计空间的预测器（MLP、EGTP、FiLM、soft-label、MoE变体）性能趋同并逼近该理论界，表明系统误差主导模型误差。
AI.conclusion: 解码长度预测的精度上限主要由解码随机性决定，而非预测器架构；因此应建立固定模型、数据与采样参数的基准协议，并在绝对指标之外同时报告相对误差指标。代码与分析工具见 https://github.com/ShwStone/DecodingPredict。

title: Going deep, reaching further: What can Boltzmann machines efficiently represent?
comment: 34 pages of main text + 32 pages of appendices, 14 figures, 2 tables
summary: While universal approximation theorems theoretically underpin the representation capabilities of machine learning models, they have two shortcomings: They do not focus on efficient representations and they tend to be insensitive to depth and other heuristically important properties. In this work we show that these two shortcomings are intertwined. We prove that machine learning models which are deeper or have higher-order interactions can efficiently represent a larger set of functions, i.e. have larger efficient reach. It follows that deep Boltzmann machines (DBMs) have maximal efficient reach, restricted Boltzmann machines (RBMs) sub-maximal, and k-body generalizations of RBMs form a hierarchy between the two, even though all are universal. More generally, (i) we provide a full characterization of machine learning models with maximal efficient reach; (ii) we derive separations between deep and shallow models for three representation tasks; and (iii) we prove that the efficient reach of shallow models constitutes an infinite hierarchy indexed by the interaction order. The proofs draw on different methodologies, namely on (i) a recent characterization of universal spin models; (ii) computational complexity bounds for spin models; and (iii) communication complexity bounds applied to shallow models. This work shows that universal machine learning models can strongly differ in their efficient representation capabilities, and provides a theoretical foundation for heuristic observations.

AI.tldr: 本文指出通用逼近定理的两大缺陷（不关注高效表示、对深度等启发式重要属性不敏感），并证明二者相互交织：更深或具备高阶交互的模型具有更大的"有效可达集"（efficient reach）。据此给出最大有效可达集的完全刻画、深度与浅层模型在三个表示任务上的分离，以及由交互阶数刻画的浅层模型有效可达性无限层级。
AI.motivation: 通用逼近定理虽理论上保障了机器学习模型的表示能力，但存在两个缺陷：其一，它不关注表示是否高效；其二，它往往对深度及其他启发式重要的性质不敏感。作者希望说明这两个缺陷本质上是相互关联的，从而为"深度有用""高阶交互有用"等经验性观察提供理论基础。
AI.method: 理论证明方法，融合三类工具：(i) 近期关于通用自旋模型（universal spin models）的刻画；(ii) 自旋模型的计算复杂度界；(iii) 应用于浅层模型的通信复杂度界。"有效可达集"（efficient reach）作为核心度量。
AI.result: (1) 更深或高阶交互的模型能高效表示更大的函数集，即有效可达集更大；(2) 由此得到 DBMs 具有最大有效可达集，RBMs 为次最大，k-体 RBM 推广构成二者之间的层级，尽管三者均为通用的；(3) 给出最大有效可达集模型的完全刻画；(4) 导出深度与浅层模型在三个表示任务上的分离；(5) 证明浅层模型的有效可达性构成以交互阶数索引的无限层级。
AI.conclusion: 通用的机器学习模型在高效表示能力上可以存在显著差异；深度与交互阶数是决定有效可达性的关键结构因素。该工作为关于深度优势和高阶交互的经验性（启发式）观察提供了理论支撑。

title: EPC-RawDC: Equivariant Physics Constrained 3D Diffusion with Raw Data Consistency for CBCT to CT Image Synthesis
summary: Cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used for image guided and adaptive radiotherapy, but scatter, noise, reconstruction artifacts, and inaccurate Hounsfield units limit its quantitative use. Recent diffusion approaches for CBCT to CT synthesis remain largely image driven, with limited use of the underlying acquisition physics. We propose EPC-RawDC, a conditional 3D latent diffusion framework that combines volumetric generative modeling with two complementary constraints derived from the same scanner specific CBCT forward model. First, geometry equivariant projection constraint exploits the rotational equivariance of the CBCT forward operator by supervising the synthesized CT through correspondingly transformed reference projections. Second, raw data consistency uses noisy projection measurements of the individual acquisition as scan specific supervision during training. The framework was evaluated on two independent clinical cohorts with distinct scanner geometries and projection sources. For JUST, the physics constraints used measured clinical raw CBCT projections acquired with an Elekta system, whereas for SynthRAD2025 the projection data were simulated from the reference CT using a Varian geometry with Poisson photon statistics. EPC-RawDC achieved an SSIM of 0.97 in both cohorts and improved PSNR over DDPM by 2.66 dB on SynthRAD2025 and 2.10 dB on JUST, while reducing mean MAE by 20.3% and 19.0%, respectively. On SynthRAD2025, projection consistency and equivariant errors were reduced by 55.0% and 41.4% relative to DDPM. These results demonstrate that combining a volumetric diffusion prior with scanner geometry and scan specific projection measurements improves quantitative CBCT to CT synthesis across both simulated and measured projection domains. Code available after publication at https://github.com/ALZAHRAALTALIB/EPC-RawDC.

AI.tldr: 提出EPC-RawDC——一种条件3D潜扩散框架，将体素生成建模与源自同一扫描仪CBCT前向模型的两项互补物理约束（几何等变投影约束、原始数据一致性）结合，实现跨模拟与实测投影域的定量CBCT-to-CT合成。
AI.motivation: CBCT广泛用于图像引导与自适应放疗，但散射、噪声、重建伪影及不准确的HU值限制其定量应用；现有扩散式CBCT-to-CT合成基本是纯图像驱动，对采集物理（前向成像模型）利用不足。
AI.method: 条件3D潜扩散生成框架。约束一：几何等变投影约束，利用CBCT前向算子的旋转等变性，通过对参考投影作相应变换来监督合成CT。约束二：原始数据一致性，训练时以单次采集的含噪投影测量作为扫描特异的监督信号。评估于两个几何与投影来源不同的临床队列：JUST（Elekta系统实测原始投影）与SynthRAD2025（依参考CT按Varian几何并用泊松光子统计模拟投影）。
AI.result: 两队列SSIM均为0.97；PSNR较DDPM分别提升2.66 dB（SynthRAD2025）与2.10 dB（JUST）；平均MAE分别降低20.3%与19.0%；SynthRAD2025上投影一致性与等变误差较DDPM分别降低55.0%与41.4%。
AI.conclusion: 将体素扩散先验与扫描仪几何、扫描特异投影测量相结合，可在模拟与实测投影域同时提升定量CBCT-to-CT合成性能；代码将于论文发表后公开。

title: Ramanujan Challenge Results: AI-Assisted Evaluation Pipeline for Multi-Format Proofs
summary: As AI's mathematical capabilities rapidly improve, meaningful benchmarks are shifting from university-level problems and math olympiads to research-level mathematics. The Ramanujan Challenge is a benchmark comprised of research-level problems in number theory, including unpublished results and open conjectures. It presented concrete formulas for mathematical constants whose correctness can be checked numerically, while their proofs may require non-obvious mathematics. Here, we analyze the Challenge submissions, measuring the relative success of different AI models, Computer Algebra Systems (CAS), and formal tools. We find correct submissions that are conceptually distinct from the official solutions, and a proof of one of the published open conjectures. Evaluating the submissions exposed a second challenge: judging complex proofs reliably at scale. We introduce an AI-assisted evaluation pipeline for natural language proofs, CAS code, and Lean formalizations that assesses semantic and logical correctness. Compared with the conventional one-shot LLM judgment, our pipeline reduces false-positive verdicts on natural language proofs from 23% to 6% and improves judgment accuracy on supporting code from 46% to 58%. This approach provides a methodology for evaluating research-level mathematics at scale, with potential applications across mathematics and AI for science.

AI.tldr: 本文分析 Ramanujan Challenge（研究级数论问题基准）的提交结果，比较不同 AI 模型、CAS 与形式化工具的表现，并提出一套 AI 辅助的证明评估流水线，显著降低自然语言证明的假阳性判定并提升代码判定准确率。
AI.motivation: 随着 AI 数学能力提升，大学水平题目与奥数已不足以构成有意义的基准，需要转向研究级数学；同时大规模可靠评判复杂证明本身成为新的难题。
AI.method: 对 Ramanujan Challenge（含未发表结果与开放猜想的研究级数论问题）的提交进行系统分析，度量不同 AI 模型、计算机代数系统（CAS）和形式化工具的相对成功率；并构建 AI 辅助的评估流水线，对自然语言证明、CAS 代码和 Lean 形式化进行语义与逻辑正确性判定。
AI.result: 发现与官方解答概念上不同的正确提交，以及针对某已发表开放猜想的一个证明；相比传统一次性 LLM 判定，该流水线将自然语言证明的假阳性判定率从 23% 降至 6%，对支撑代码的判定准确率从 46% 提升至 58%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了在规模上评估研究级数学的方法论，可推广至数学及 AI for Science 领域。

title: Activation Probes Are Reliable With a Handful of Positive Examples
comment: Presented at the Mechanistic Interpretability workshop at NeurIPS 2025
summary: Efforts to monitor advanced AI for rare misalignments face a data challenge: abundant aligned examples but only a handful of misaligned ones. We test activation probes in this "few vs. thousands" regime on spam and honesty detection tasks. For our tasks, training with many negative examples is on average more positive-sample-efficient than balanced training for small numbers (1-10) of positive samples. We also find that LLM upsampling can provide a performance boost equivalent to roughly doubling the number of real positive samples, though excessive upsampling hurts performance. Finally, we show a positive scaling trend, where larger models are more positive-sample-efficient to probe. Our findings suggest we should leverage the large number of negative samples available to amplify the signal from rare but critical misalignment examples.

AI.tldr: 在"少数正例 vs. 大量负例"的不平衡场景下测试激活探针，发现多用负例比平衡训练更具正例效率，LLM上采样约等效于把真实正例翻倍，且模型越大正例效率越高。
AI.motivation: 监测先进AI的罕见失准（misalignment）面临数据困境：对齐样本充裕，失准样本极少。作者希望在"1-10个正例、数千个负例"的极端不平衡设定下，探究如何高效利用大量负例来放大稀有但关键信号的检测能力。
AI.method: 在垃圾邮件检测与诚实性检测任务上评估激活探针（activation probes）。对比"大量负例+少量正例"训练与平衡训练的正例效率；测试LLM上采样（upsampling）生成合成正例的效果及其过量时的退化；并考察不同规模模型的正例效率缩放趋势。
AI.result: 在1-10个正例的小样本区间，大量负例训练平均比平衡训练更具正例效率；LLM上采样带来的性能提升约等效于真实正例数量翻倍，但过度上采样会损害性能；观察到正向缩放趋势，即更大模型的可探测正例效率更高。
AI.conclusion: 应充分利用可得的大量负例来放大稀有但关键的失准样本信号；负例不是负担，而是提升小样本探针效率的关键资源。

title: Localizing Concepts in Visual Autoregressive Models
summary: Understanding the internal routing of visual concepts is crucial for the safe and controllable adaptation of generative models. While concept localization has been widely studied in diffusion models, the emerging paradigm of next-scale visual autoregressive models remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce LoCo, the first model-agnostic framework to localize where and when specific concepts emerge within autoregressive models. Driven by the native coarse-to-fine nature of next-scale generation, our method precisely maps conceptual knowledge across three distinct dimensions: Layer, Scale, and Position. To systematically localize and evaluate concept routing without context bias, we propose LoCoBench, a comprehensive dataset spanning 10 diverse categories. Extensive probing on image and video autoregressive models like Infinity, HunyuanImage-3.0, and InfinityStar shows that the localized positions are both interpretable and causally related to concept emergence. Building on these insights, we apply our localization method to three key applications: concept erasure, model personalization, and adversarial concept injection. Experiments demonstrate that our targeted intervention achieves state-of-the-art performance, substantially reducing computational overhead while preserving benign utility. Overall, our findings offer insights into how conceptual knowledge is routed during autoregressive generation, introducing a practical pathway for more interpretable, efficient, and secure adaptation.

AI.tldr: LoCo：首个模型无关的框架，在下一尺度（next-scale）自回归生成模型中对视觉概念的出现位置与时机进行定位（Layer、Scale、Position 三维度），并配套提出 LoCoBench 数据集；基于定位结果实现概念擦除、个性化与对抗概念注入应用，达到 SOTA 且大幅降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型中的概念定位已有较多研究，但新兴的 next-scale 视觉自回归范式尚属空白；理解视觉概念在模型内部的“路由”对生成模型安全可控的适配至关重要，因此需要填补该空白。
AI.method: 提出 LoCo，模型无关的概念定位框架，利用 next-scale 生成原生由粗到细的特性，沿 Layer、Scale、Position 三个维度精确映射概念知识；同时构建 LoCoBench，覆盖 10 类类别的数据集，用于在无上下文偏置条件下系统定位与评估概念路由；在 Infinity、HunyuanImage-3.0、InfinityStar 等图像/视频自回归模型上进行大量探针实验，并将定位用于概念擦除、模型个性化、对抗概念注入三类下游应用。
AI.result: 探针实验表明定位到的位置具有可解释性，且与概念涌现存在因果关联；基于定位的定向干预在概念擦除、个性化与对抗概念注入上取得 SOTA 性能，显著降低计算开销并保持良性效用。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了自回归生成过程中概念知识的路由机制，为更可解释、更高效、更安全的模型适配提供了实用路径。

title: Retrieval as Traversal: Value-Indexed Memory for Stateful Long-Context Agents
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Long-Context Foundation Models (LCFM). 7 pages, 1 table
summary: Long-context models repeatedly solve closely related retrieval problems. Attention or global retrieval can retain large stores, but each forward pass again searches for what matters. Recurrent compression avoids this search only by deciding earlier what information to preserve. Neither mechanism directly exploits that useful memories at neighbouring retrieval steps may substantially overlap. We propose an alternative in which retrieval is a persistent local traversal through an address space. We separate a memory's content from its address. Utility is defined by the information revealed by retrieving the content, while geometry determines only how cheaply that information can be reached. This leads to a cost-regularised indexing objective that preserves information value inside local neighbourhoods while charging for every memory made locally accessible. Its marginal-value form gives both attractive and exclusion pressures. Thus, complementary memories should be co-retrievable when the additional value exceeds retrieval cost, whereas redundant memories should not occupy the same retrieval set solely because they are individually useful. As a proof of principle, we test only the simplest fixed-geometry instance on MiniGrid Memory. A persistent local traversal head reaches $0.95$ mean return after $0.59$M training steps with a five-token context, compared with $0.94$M for Gaussian absolute addressing and more than $2$M for categorical absolute addressing. The experiment does not test learned geometry or repeated retrieval. Instead, it motivates the hypothesis that stateful retrieval may be easier to learn than stateless. To test the full proposed method further experimentation is necessary.

AI.tldr: 提出以"持久化局部遍历"取代"每步重新全局检索"的记忆机制：将内容与地址解耦，用代价正则化的索引目标在局部邻域保留信息价值，并收取可达成本，从而鼓励互补记忆共检索、抑制冗余记忆；在 MiniGrid Memory 上以固定几何的最简实例验证，五 token 上下文中 0.59M 步达到 0.95 平均回报，显著快于高斯绝对寻址（0.94M）与类别绝对寻址（>2M）。
AI.motivation: 现有长上下文机制存在结构性浪费：注意力/全局检索虽可保留大容量存储，但每次前向都要重新搜索"什么重要"；循环压缩虽免去搜索，却必须提前决定保留什么。两者都未利用一个事实——相邻检索步所需的有用记忆可能高度重叠。因此作者希望把检索变成沿地址空间的持续局部遍历，使状态在步间延续，减少重复检索开销。
AI.method: 1) 将记忆的内容与地址分离：效用由"检索该内容所揭示的信息"定义，几何仅决定到达该信息的代价。2) 构造代价正则化的索引目标：在局部邻域内保留信息价值，同时对每个被置为局部可访问的记忆计费。3) 采用其边际价值形式，引入吸引压力（互补记忆的联合价值超过检索成本时共检索）与排斥压力（冗余记忆不因各自有用而占据同一检索集）。4) 实现"持久化局部遍历头"，状态跨步保持；实验仅采用最简单的固定几何实例，在 MiniGrid Memory 上以五 token 上下文训练。
AI.result: 在 MiniGrid Memory 上，持久化局部遍历头在 0.59M 训练步达到 0.95 平均回报；高斯绝对寻址需 0.94M 步达到 0.94；类别绝对寻址需超过 2M 步。即在相同五 token 上下文预算下，样本效率约提升 1.6 倍与 3.4 倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 该工作仅为原理性验证：实验未检验学习得到的几何，也未测试重复检索场景，故完整方法仍待进一步实验。结果支持"有状态检索比无状态检索更易学习"的假设，并提示以边际价值加权的局部索引是值得探索的方向。

title: Comparing Human Role-Players and LLM-Simulated Clients in Online Counselling Training: An Analysis of Counselling Patterns
comment: Published at EDM 2025 (18th International Conference on Educational Data Mining), short paper. 7 pages
summary: This study investigates the capabilities of Large Language Models to simulate counselling clients in educational role-plays in comparison to human role-players. Initially, we recorded role-playing sessions, where novice counsellors interacted with human peers acting as clients, followed by role-plays between humans and clients simulated by Mistrals Mixtral 8x7b using 4-bit quantization. These interactions were analysed with a counselling communication pattern system at sentence level. We investigated two key questions: (1) to what extent LLM-generated responses replicate authentic conversational dynamics and (2) whether counsellors' communication behaviour differs when interacting with human versus LLM-simulated clients. The findings highlight both similarities and differences in the application of counselling patterns across scenarios, showing the potential of LLM-based role-playing exercises to enhance counselling competencies and to identify areas for further refinement in virtual client simulations.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较大语言模型（Mistral Mixtral 8x7b，4-bit量化）与真人扮演者模拟咨询来访者的能力，通过句级咨询沟通模式分析发现：LLM生成回应在部分咨询模式上与真人互动存在相似与差异，LLM角色扮演有望用于咨询技能训练并需进一步优化虚拟来访者模拟。
AI.motivation: 新手咨询师需要角色扮演训练，但依赖真人同伴成本高、可扩展性有限；大语言模型可能作为可扩展的模拟来访者替代方案，但其能否复现真实对话动态、以及咨询师面对LLM与真人时的沟通行为是否一致尚不明确。
AI.method: 先录制新手咨询师与真人同伴（扮演来访者）的角色扮演会话，再录制咨询师与由Mixtral 8x7b（4-bit量化）模拟来访者的角色扮演；随后采用句级咨询沟通模式编码系统对两类互动进行分析，围绕两个问题展开：（1）LLM生成回应在多大程度上复现真实对话动态；（2）咨询师面对真人vs LLM模拟来访者时沟通行为是否存在差异。
AI.result: 研究发现两种情境下咨询沟通模式的应用既存在相似性也存在差异，说明LLM模拟在部分维度上能复现真实会话动态，但在某些咨询模式上与真人互动不一致。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM的角色扮演练习在提升咨询胜任力方面具有潜力，同时虚拟来访者模拟仍需在若干方面进一步改进与精细化。

title: Multi-output LSTM soft sensors for industrial anaerobic co-digestion using LSTM-beta-VAE generative data augmentation
summary: Anaerobic digestion (AD) requires close monitoring of key process variables, including pH, the ratio of volatile organic acids to alkaline buffer capacity and biogas production, to maintain biological stability and prevent process failure. While mechanistic frameworks such as the Anaerobic Digestion Model No. 1 are highly parameterised, computationally expensive, and difficult to calibrate for real-time applications, data-driven Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks offer a potentially more adaptable alternative. However, current data-driven approaches in AD are predominantly limited to single-output architectures that focus solely on production yields, as opposed to simultaneous prediction of vital stability indicators. Furthermore, industrial AD datasets are typically sparse and skewed toward steady-state operations. Baseline evaluations demonstrated this scarcity prevents standard algorithms (Random Forest, XGBoost) and unaugmented LSTMs from recognising the transition to unstable operations, resulting in poor estimation of stability indicators. To overcome these challenges, this study proposes a novel generative data augmentation framework using an LSTM-beta-Variational Autoencoder coupled with a multi-output LSTM (MO-LSTM) soft sensor. By synthesising physically valid sequences of these transitions to unstable operations from one year of full-scale plant data, the method safely populates sparse regions of the feature space. Trained on this augmented dataset, the MO-LSTM achieved robust simultaneous estimation across all targets. This approach mitigates data sparsity, providing a basis for hybrid mechanistic-data-driven modelling and early-warning soft sensors in industrial bioprocesses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LSTM-β-VAE生成式数据增强框架结合多输出LSTM软测量，实现对厌氧消化过程pH、VFA/碱度比与产气量的同步预测。
AI.motivation: 厌氧消化需实时监测pH、挥发性有机酸与碱性缓冲容量之比、产气量等稳定性指标以防过程失稳，但ADM1等机理模型参数多、计算昂贵、难实时校准；现有数据驱动方法多为单输出、仅预测产量，且工业数据稀疏、偏向稳态，基线算法（RF、XGBoost、未增强LSTM）难以识别不稳定工况转变。
AI.method: 构建LSTM-β-变分自编码器（LSTM-β-VAE）生成式数据增强框架，基于一年全规模工厂数据合成物理合理的失稳过渡序列，安全填充特征空间稀疏区域；再将增强数据用于训练多输出LSTM（MO-LSTM）软测量模型。
AI.result: 基线评估显示，数据稀缺导致RF、XGBoost及未增强LSTM无法识别向不稳定运行的过渡，稳定性指标估计效果差；经增强数据训练的MO-LSTM对所有目标实现了稳健的同步估计。
AI.conclusion: 该生成式增强方法缓解了数据稀疏问题，为工业生物过程的机理-数据混合建模及早期预警软测量奠定基础。

title: BRACHIO: Broad Representations Across Centres for Head-and-neck Imaging Oncology (HECKTOR 2026)
comment: HECKTOR Challenge 2026, MICCAI, head and neck cancer, PET imaging
summary: The HECKTOR 2026 challenge benchmarks machine learning for head and neck cancer, where teams delineate primary and nodal tumour volumes, perform TN staging, and predict recurrence-free survival (RFS). This report describes the submissions for the HECKTOR challenge of team nucli. As the three tasks span both dense and global information from multicentric PET/CT scans, we utilise self-supervised pre-trained encoders, training a 2D DINOv2 encoder (PET-DINOv2-MIPs) on HECKTOR 2026's PET scans. Our final test submission ensembles a DynUNet trained from scratch with a SwinUNETR whose Swin trunk was initialised from a SimMIM-pre-trained checkpoint for segmentation, reaching a mean Dice of 0.5409. For TN staging, GTVp/GTVn geometric features from the segmentation masks are fit to stage probabilities by logistic regression (LR) and fused with PET-DINOv2-MIPs deep features (PCA + LR) via a second-level LR, reaching balanced accuracies of 0.3962 (T-stage) and 0.6432 (N-stage). For the RFS prognosis task, we fine-tune the last two blocks of the PET-DINOv2-MIPs ViT-S encoder jointly with an MLP head under a CoxPH loss, concatenating clinical covariates with the imaging features, reaching a test Harrell's C-index of 0.6577 and a weighted challenge score of 0.5802. The prognosis result is comparable to the best entry of the previous edition and consistent with our internal cross-validation, while our segmentation result is well below it and limits the staging results that depend on it.

AI.tldr: 本文报告HECKTOR 2026挑战赛中nucli团队的方法：利用自监督预训练编码器完成头颈癌分割、TN分期与无复发生存预测三项任务。分割采用DynUNet与SwinUNETR集成，分期采用几何特征与深度特征融合的逻辑回归，预后采用PET-DINOv2-MIPs微调+CoxPH损失，最终测试C-index为0.6577、加权挑战得分为0.5802。
AI.motivation: 三项任务（分割、TN分期、RFS预后）分别依赖多中心PET/CT的稠密空间信息与全局信息，需要统一的表征学习策略；同时，分割质量直接影响依赖其掩膜的下游分期，因此希望借助自监督预训练编码器提升特征质量。
AI.method: 在HECKTOR 2026的PET扫描上训练2D DINOv2编码器（PET-DINOv2-MIPs）；分割集成从头训练的DynUNet与以SimMIM预训练权重初始化Swin主干（trunk）的SwinUNETR；TN分期以GTVp/GTVn几何特征的LR与PET-DINOv2-MIPs深度特征（PCA+LR）经二级LR融合；RFS预后在CoxPH损失下联合微调PET-DINOv2-MIPs ViT-S编码器最后两个block与MLP头，并拼接临床协变量。
AI.result: 分割平均Dice为0.5409；TN分期平衡准确率T-stage 0.3962、N-stage 0.6432；RFS预后测试Harrell's C-index为0.6577，加权挑战得分为0.5802。
AI.conclusion: 预后表现与上一届最佳参赛方案相当，且与内部交叉验证一致；但分割结果明显低于该水平，并限制了依赖分割掩膜的分期结果，说明分割环节是整体性能的主要瓶颈。

title: VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents
summary: Building and scaling computer-using agents (CUAs) across desktop, mobile, and web environments requires reliable task-completion verification for data curation, evaluation, and reinforcement learning. Typical automated approaches prompt vision-language models (VLMs) to judge trajectories or generate programs to inspect application state. However, both rely on partial views of complex digital environments. VLM judges are restricted to supplied observations, while generated programs depend on accessible state. These views can omit decisive evidence or leave completion judgments unsupported. Tailoring separate verifiers to different platforms and access settings adds further engineering cost. We present VeriCUA, a platform-agnostic framework for verification through agentic exploration. It treats verification as dynamic evidence gathering and assessment within a shared procedure for online and offline settings across platforms and observation modalities. After inspecting the available context to construct a task rubric, the verifier selects GUI or code checks for unresolved requirements and combines their findings under explicit evidence rules. Experiments show improved agreement with reference labels over the compared baselines across these settings, with the largest offline gains on hard cases and stronger rejection of false completion claims online. Further analyses connect these gains to complementary evidence and test-time exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出平台无关的任务完成验证框架VeriCUA，将验证重构为智能体式动态证据收集与评估，在桌面/移动/Web、在线/离线及多种观测模态下统一使用同一流程，优于VLM评判与程序生成两类基线。
AI.motivation: 构建与扩展计算机使用智能体（CUA）需要可靠的完成验证以支撑数据筛选、评测与强化学习。现有自动方法或用VLM评判轨迹，或生成程序检查应用状态，但二者都只依赖局部视图：VLM评判仅限给定观测，生成程序受限于可访问状态，可能遗漏决定性证据、无法支撑完成判定；且为不同平台与访问设置分别定制验证器会带来额外工程成本。
AI.method: VeriCUA以验证为动态证据收集与评估，在线与离线、跨平台与多观测模态共享同一流程。先检查可用上下文构建任务评分量表（rubric），再针对未满足的要求选择GUI检查或代码检查，并依据显式证据规则综合二者发现。
AI.result: 在各设置下与参考标签的一致性均优于对比基线；离线设置中困难样本提升最大，在线设置中对虚假完成声明的拒绝更强。
AI.conclusion: 性能提升源于互补证据与测试时探索；统一的智能体式验证流程可跨平台、跨访问设置复用，减少定制化工程成本。

title: Quantum-Inspired Convolutional Networks for High-Resolution Pseudo-Label Generation from Multimodal Earth Observation Data
summary: Accurate land-cover mapping from multimodal Earth observation (EO) data remains a challenge in regions where high-resolution annotations are scarce or costly to obtain. This work introduces a quantum convolutional encoder-decoder network for pseudo-label generation using Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery, guided only by coarse MODIS-derived land-cover maps. The proposed framework uses quantum-inspired convolutional blocks to enhance feature extraction and cross-sensor fusion, enabling the model to infer a fine-scale semantic structure from heterogeneous inputs. Experiments were conducted on the DFC2020 dataset, which provides a quadruple of Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 multispectral, low-resolution MODIS labels and high-resolution reference land-cover maps. The proposed training framework first learns a robust representation of multimodal inputs through the reconstruction branch before any supervision from low-resolution labels is applied. This self-supervised stage enables the model to capture a fine-scale spectral-spatial structure, which is then used to generate high-resolution pseudo-labels. These pseudo-labels are subsequently evaluated through classification metrics on the test data, demonstrating that the proposed approach produces more spatially coherent and class-consistent compared to classical baselines. The results highlight the potential of quantum-inspired deep learning to improve label generation in low-annotation remote sensing scenarios, offering a scalable path towards high-quality land-cover products for EO applications.

AI.tldr: 提出一种量子卷积编码-解码网络，利用Sentinel-1/2多模态数据与粗糙MODIS标签生成高分辨率伪标签，在DFC2020上取得更空间连贯、类别一致的结果。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率地表覆盖标注稀缺且昂贵，需要低成本方式生成高质量精细标签。
AI.method: 量子启发卷积块增强特征提取与跨传感器融合；先以重建分支进行自监督学习表征，再在粗分辨率标签监督下生成伪标签。
AI.result: 在DFC2020数据集上，生成的伪标签在分类指标上优于经典基线，空间连贯性与类别一致性更好。
AI.conclusion: 量子启发深度学习可改善低标注遥感场景下的标签生成，为高质量地表覆盖产品提供可扩展路径。

title: Uncertainty-aware Coarse-to-Fine Main Pancreatic Duct Segmentation for Width Measurement in 3D MRCP
summary: Assessment of the main pancreatic duct (MPD) from volumetric magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography (MRCP) scans is an essential task for ductal dilatation diagnosis and pancreatic cancer analysis. However, manual assessment is affected by reader variability in which automated analysis may assist. Nevertheless, fully automated and uncertainty-aware MPD analysis from volumetric MRCP remains underexplored area of research. In this study, we propose an automatic and uncertainty-aware deep learning-based pipeline for MPD segmentation and maximum-width analysis from MRCP scans. A coarse localisation model first identifies the ductal region-of-interest, followed by a fine model that segments the MPD within the region. The dataset consists of 256 MPD-segmented MRCP scans from 69 patients. A randomly selected holdout test subset of 14 patients with 55 MRCP volumes was used for evaluation.
