We employed a five-model cross-validation ensemble for improved performance and uncertainty estimation. The best MPD segmentation performance was 0.634 DSC, 0.744 precision, and 0.593 recall. The mean absolute error for maximum MPD width prediction was 0.355~mm and dilated MPD ($\geq 5$~mm) was detected with 75.0\% sensitivity and 74.4\% specificity. These novel results suggest that automated MPD segmentation can be used to aid MRCP-based duct measurements.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自动且可感知不确定性的深度学习流程，用于MRCP体积扫描中主胰管（MPD）的分割与最大宽度分析，采用粗定位+细分割的两阶段方法与五模型交叉验证集成。
AI.motivation: MPD评估对胰管扩张诊断与胰腺癌分析至关重要，但人工评估存在阅片者间变异，而全自动且能估计不确定性的MPD分析研究尚不充分。
AI.method: 两阶段流程：粗定位模型先识别胰管感兴趣区域，再由精细模型在该区域内分割MPD；采用5模型交叉验证集成提升性能并估计不确定性；数据为69例患者的256例MPD分割MRCP扫描，测试集为14例患者的55个体积。
AI.result: 最佳MPD分割DSC为0.634、精确率0.744、召回率0.593；最大宽度预测平均绝对误差0.355 mm；扩张MPD（≥5 mm）检测灵敏度75.0%、特异度74.4%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明自动化MPD分割可辅助基于MRCP的胰管测量，为不确定性感知的胰管分析提供了新基线。

title: Advancing Clinical Genomic Analysis with a Skill-Centred Agent
summary: Clinical genomic analysis requires experts to integrate evolving guidelines, databases, and computational evidence. As sequencing has become increasingly accessible, this complex and labor-intensive process has become a major bottleneck to the timely use of genomic information in clinical decision-making. To fill this gap, we developed ClinGeX, a large-language-model agent that composes 105 curated executable skills through task-specific retrieval and dependency-aware orchestration. On 223 temporally held-out benchmark cases, ClinGeX achieved 71.7\% macro-averaged task-level concordance with expert reference classifications, compared with 45.7\% for the strongest comparator. In a three-condition, counterbalanced human-AI collaboration study, 45 clinical genomic professionals assessed 135 clinically derived cases under routine (no AI assistance), DeepSeek-assisted and ClinGeX-assisted conditions. ClinGeX assistance increased raw case-level concordance across criterion-level variant analysis, genomic interpretation in rare disease and molecular oncology decision-making (51.1\%, 57.8\%, 64.4\% versus 15.6\%, 31.1\%, 20.0\% in comparator conditions) and reduced reported interpretation time in all scenarios. During an exploratory one-month real-world non-interventional assessment, 11 experienced professionals submitted feedback on 96 self-selected analysis episodes and reported frequent conclusion adoption and time savings. These findings support executable domain skills as a promising approach to augment specialist genomic interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ClinGeX——一个通过任务特定检索与依赖感知编排调用105个可执行技能的大语言模型智能体，在基准测试与45名临床基因组专业人员的人机协作实验及真实场景探索性评估中，显著提升解读一致性并缩短解读时间。
AI.motivation: 临床基因组分析需专家整合不断更新的指南、数据库与计算证据，流程复杂且劳动密集；测序可及性提高后，该过程成为基因组信息及时用于临床决策的主要瓶颈，亟需自动化辅助手段。
AI.method: 构建LLM智能体ClinGeX，将105个经过策展的可执行技能通过任务特定检索与依赖感知编排组合，以执行临床基因组分析任务；采用223例时间上留出的基准测试、三条件平衡设计的人机协作研究（无AI、DeepSeek辅助、ClinGeX辅助，45名专业人员评估135例临床病例），以及为期一个月、11名专业人员、96个自选分析情境的非干预真实世界探索性评估。
AI.result: 基准测试中，ClinGeX任务级宏观平均一致率为71.7%，最强对照为45.7%；人机协作研究中，ClinGeX辅助在变异分析、罕见病基因组解读与分子肿瘤决策三个场景的病例级原始一致率分别为51.1%、57.8%、64.4%，对照条件为15.6%、31.1%、20.0%，且各场景自报解读时间均缩短；真实世界评估中报告结论采纳频繁并节省时间。
AI.conclusion: 可执行领域技能是增强专科基因组解读的一条有前景的路径，能够提升一致性并提高效率。

title: Surface Conditioning for Zero-Shot Multivariate Correction in a Marine Biogeochemistry Emulator
summary: Bias correction in process-based models usually means iterative data assimilation with explicit covariance modelling. We propose a lightweight alternative based on a neural emulator of marine biogeochemistry (BGC), showing that the conditioning pathway of its autoencoder can serve as an observation injection point. The decoder is conditioned on surface variables via Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM), originally designed to incorporate physical boundary forcings. We extend these inputs to include surface chlorophyll-a and replace the simulated field with satellite observations at inference time. The surface substitution propagates through the water column, improving agreement with depth-resolved observations at all depths, and spreads to other output variables in a pattern consistent with expected trophic relationships.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于神经代理模型的轻量级偏差校正方法：利用自编码器解码器的FiLM条件通路，在推理时将表层叶绿素a由模拟场替换为卫星观测，实现无需迭代同化的观测注入。
AI.motivation: 传统过程模型（海洋生物地球化学BGC）的偏差校正依赖迭代数据同化与显式协方差建模，流程繁重、成本高，因此需要更轻量的替代方案。
AI.method: 构建海洋BGC的神经网络代理模型（自编码器架构），解码器通过FiLM以表层变量为条件（原用于注入物理边界强迫）；将条件输入扩展到表层叶绿素a，并在推理阶段用卫星观测替换模拟的表层场。
AI.result: 表层替换效应沿水柱向下传播，在全部深度上改善与深度分辨观测的一致性，并以符合预期营养级关系的模式扩散到其他输出变量。
AI.conclusion: FiLM条件通路可作为观测注入点，为过程模型提供免迭代同化的轻量级偏差校正路径，且校正效果可跨深度与跨变量一致传播。

title: Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled Mamba Network for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Accurate multi-organ segmentation in computed tomography (CT) is essential for computer-aided diagnosis, treatment planning, and disease monitoring. However, substantial variations in organ shape and size, together with low tissue contrast and ambiguous boundaries, complicate the modeling of heterogeneous anatomical structures. To address these challenges, we propose a Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled Mamba Network (MCDNet), which integrates adaptive local structural enhancement with channel-decoupled long-range modeling. Specifically, we introduce a Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled State-Space (MCSS) block that divides feature channels into separate processing groups, allowing differentiated structural representations to be learned within an efficient state-space framework. Within each group, a Morphology-Aware Enhancement Module (MAEM) combines deformable convolutions with channel attention to adapt local feature extraction to anatomical shape variations. Group-wise state-space modeling then captures long-range spatial dependencies, and channel gating adaptively integrates the resulting features. Experiments on the Synapse abdominal CT dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of MCDNet, achieving an average Dice Similarity Coefficient of 81.61% for multi-organ segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出MCDNet，将通道解耦的Mamba状态空间建模与形态感知可变形卷积结合，用于CT多器官分割，Synapse上平均Dice达81.61%。
AI.motivation: CT多器官分割中器官形状尺寸差异大、组织对比度低、边界模糊，异构解剖结构建模困难；现有方法难以兼顾局部形态适应性与高效长程依赖建模。
AI.method: 设计Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled State-Space (MCSS)块：将特征通道分组解耦，各组内用Morphology-Aware Enhancement Module (MAEM)（可变形卷积+通道注意力）自适应提取局部形态特征，再以分组状态空间建模捕获长程空间依赖，最后通过通道门控自适应融合特征。
AI.result: 在Synapse腹部CT数据集上验证有效性，多器官分割平均Dice相似系数为81.61%。
AI.conclusion: 形态感知的局部增强与通道解耦状态空间长程建模相结合，可有效应对器官形态多变与边界模糊问题，提升CT多器官分割精度。

title: FARMS: A Verifiable Foundation for Automated Computational Science
summary: Automated computational science could accelerate discovery by selecting, adapting and developing numerical methods. This prospect requires mathematical knowledge that AI systems can interpret and reuse with explicit guarantees. Here we present FARMS, a faithful and efficient foundation that transforms computational mathematics into AI-ready computing knowledge. FARMS connects formal statements to source context, algorithmic meaning and quantitative guarantees through source preparation, reusable representations and semantic review. Across 171 targets in randomized numerical linear algebra and numerical partial differential equations, 157 were accepted by the pipeline, with mean estimated costs of US \$0.85-2.29 per target across sources. Lean-checked implications from explicit source premises connect selected statements to computational skills, illustrated by a heat-flow solve and wave-response compression. FARMS therefore supports an affordable, reusable knowledge foundation for trustworthy automated computational science.

AI.tldr: FARMS：将计算数学知识转化为可解释、可复用的AI就绪知识库，通过形式化陈述连接源文献语境、算法语义与量化保证，并实现低成本自动化。
AI.motivation: 自动化计算科学需要AI能选择、改造和开发数值方法，但其前提是AI系统能够解释并复用带有显式保证的数学知识。现有计算数学知识缺乏面向AI的结构化、可验证表示。
AI.method: 提出FARMS框架，通过三步流程：源文献准备（source preparation）、可复用表示、语义审查（semantic review），把形式化陈述与源语境、算法语义及量化保证相连接；以显式源前提为基础，用Lean检验其蕴含关系，并与计算技能对接。
AI.result: 在随机数值线性代数与数值偏微分方程共171个目标中，157个被流水线接受；各来源平均估计成本为每目标0.85–2.29美元；以热流求解与波响应压缩为例，展示了Lean检验的蕴含关系可将选定陈述连接至计算技能。
AI.conclusion: FARMS为可信的自动化计算科学提供了低成本、可复用的知识基础，将形式化保证与算法实践相衔接。

title: AI at a Turning Point: From ChatGPT through Neural Networks to Neuromorphic AI
summary: The tension between the established technologies of connectionist AI and their neuromorphic challengers is attracting growing attention, above all because of the enormous energy demand of the former and the low power consumption of the latter. Developing and running large AI models consumes gigawatt- to terawatt-hours of energy, while the human brain operates on a continuous 20 watts. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) counter this energy demand with a frugal approach and bring elements of self-organization into the methodological repertoire of AI: local learning instead of global error backpropagation, event-driven computing, and time as a carrier of information. They do not replace today's AI but extend it; in hybrid systems each approach can be deployed where its strengths lie. This monograph explains the field in a generally accessible yet mathematically rigorous way. Using the text-generation module of ChatGPT as an example, the principle, elegance, and computational cost of transformer-based AI are presented and compared with the coding, learning, and network-design methods of SNNs. Throughout, relevant mechanisms of the human nervous system serve as model and reference point. Topics include spike-timing-dependent plasticity, population and temporal coding, the Neural Engineering Framework, neuromorphic hardware from Loihi 2 to commercial edge processors, and the prospects for classical and neuromorphic AI to complement and extend each other.

AI.tldr: 本文是一部专著（monograph），以ChatGPT文本框生成模块为例，系统对比连接主义AI（transformer）与脉冲神经网络（SNN）的原理、编码/学习/网络设计方法与计算成本，并以人脑神经系统机制作为参照，论证SNN在能效上的优势及其与经典AI互补混合部署的前景。
AI.motivation: 连接主义AI与神经形态计算的张力日益凸显：训练与运行大型AI模型消耗吉瓦时至太瓦时级能量，而人脑仅需约20瓦持续功耗。SNN以事件驱动、局部学习、时间编码等节俭方式应对能耗问题，并将自组织要素引入AI方法论，因此需要对其与主流AI进行系统、可比较的梳理。
AI.method: 以通俗但数学严谨的方式阐述该领域：以ChatGPT的文本生成模块为案例，呈现transformer类AI的原理、优雅性与计算代价；与之对比SNN的编码（population coding、temporal coding）、学习（spike-timing-dependent plasticity、局部学习替代全局误差反传）与网络设计方法；全程以人脑神经系统的相关机制为模型与参照，并涵盖Neural Engineering Framework及从Loihi 2到商用边缘处理器的神经形态硬件。
AI.result: 以教学性/综述性方式给出连接主义AI与SNN在原理、方法学与能耗上的系统对照框架，展示SNN的事件驱动计算、时间作为信息载体与局部学习带来的低功耗特性及其与Transformer式全局反传训练的本质差异。
AI.conclusion: SNN并不取代当今AI，而是对其进行扩展；在混合系统中，两种方法可各自部署于其优势所在之处，经典AI与神经形态AI具备互补并相互增强的前景。

title: Neural Blind Deconvolution for Image Scanning Microscopy
summary: Image scanning microscopy (ISM) acquires one scanned image per detector element, which are then fused into a single image by multi-image deconvolution to obtain a super-resolved image. Its accuracy, however, depends on point spread function (PSF) models that sample- and system-induced aberrations often invalidate. Since differences between the scanned images encode aberration information, we propose a training-free blind Deep Image Prior (DIP) framework that jointly estimates the specimen and the detector-dependent PSFs. The PSFs are parametrised through the detector geometry and shared excitation and emission PSFs, reducing the unknowns while preserving the physical ISM model, and a Gaussian pre-initialisation stabilises the blind optimisation. On experimental tubulin data, blind DIP recovers finer filamentous structures than multi-image deconvolution and DIP with fixed theoretical PSFs, while adapting the PSFs to the measurements.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的盲深度图像先验（DIP）框架，联合估计样本与探测器相关PSF，用于图像扫描显微（ISM）中超分辨重建，在管蛋白实验数据上优于多图像反卷积与固定理论PSF的DIP。
AI.motivation: ISM通过多图像反卷积将每个探测器单元对应的一幅扫描图像融合为超分辨图像，其精度高度依赖PSF模型，而样本与系统引入的像差常使理论PSF失效；不同扫描图像之间的差异本身蕴含像差信息，故需在重建中同时校正PSF。
AI.method: 构建免训练的盲DIP框架，交替/联合优化样本图像与探测器相关PSF。PSF通过探测器几何并结合共享的激发与发射PSF进行参数化，在保持ISM物理模型的前提下减少未知量；并采用高斯预初始化以稳定盲优化过程。
AI.result: 在实验管蛋白数据上，盲DIP相比多图像反卷积以及使用固定理论PSF的DIP，能恢复更精细的纤维状结构，同时使PSF自适应于实际测量数据。
AI.conclusion: 将PSF估计纳入DIP优化可实现免监督、物理一致的ISM盲超分辨重建，缓解像差导致的模型失配，提升结构分辨能力。

title: Optimal Contextual Pricing in Non-Stationary Environments
summary:
We study contextual dynamic pricing in a non-stationary environment. In each round, a seller observes a buyer's context, posts a price, and receives only binary purchase feedback. The buyer's value is linear in the context and an unobserved feature vector that may change over time, subject to a known total variation budget $V$. We measure dynamic regret against the first-best benchmark that extracts each buyer's full value.
  For identical contexts, we develop a deterministic algorithm that combines binary-search exploration, lower-envelope pricing, and periodic and inconsistency-triggered restarts. It achieves regret $O((\sqrt{TV}+1)\log T)$. With heterogeneous contexts, a new geometric difficulty arises: small feature changes can leave a relaxed feasible set narrow but far from the current feature vector. We address this difficulty through a multiscale shallow-pricing algorithm that maintains relaxed feasible sets and enclosing ellipsoids at several variation scales. Larger scales provide reliable localization certificates, while the smallest active scale determines the exploitation price. The algorithm achieves dynamic regret $O((d^2+d^{3/2}\sqrt{TV})\log^2 T)$, where $d$ is the context dimension. For fixed $d$, both guarantees match the lower bound $Ω(\sqrt{TV}+\log\log T)$ up to logarithmic factors in $T$, establishing near-optimality among deterministic algorithms for every $V\in[0,T]$, including the stationary case.

AI.tldr: 研究非平稳环境下的上下文动态定价，提出确定性算法，在已知总变差预算V下达到近乎最优的动态遗憾。
AI.motivation: 在非平稳环境中，买家价值随上下文线性变化且隐含特征向量可随时间漂移，且仅能观测二值购买反馈。已有工作多针对平稳或反馈更丰富的情形，缺乏对总变差预算约束下上下文动态定价的系统分析与最优性刻画。
AI.method: 将买家价值建模为上下文与随时间变化的未观测特征向量的线性组合，漂移受已知总变差预算V约束，以第一最优（提取买家全部价值）为基准衡量动态遗憾。同质上下文下设计确定性算法，结合二分搜索探索、下包络定价以及周期性重启与不一致触发重启。异质上下文下提出多尺度浅定价算法，在多个变差尺度上维护松弛可行集与外接椭球：大尺度提供可靠定位证书，最小活跃尺度决定利用价格。
AI.result: 同质上下文遗憾为O((√(TV)+1)log T)；异质上下文遗憾为O((d²+d^{3/2}√(TV))log²T)，其中d为上下文维度。固定d时两者均与下界Ω(√(TV)+log log T)在T的对数因子内匹配，涵盖V∈[0,T]的全部取值及平稳情形。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了非平稳上下文定价中确定性算法的近最优保证，证明在任意总变差预算（含平稳情形）下均达到对数因子意义下的最优，并揭示了异质上下文带来的几何困难及多尺度松弛可行集的应对方式。

title: RepConTUR: A Report-Conditioned Volumetric Multimodal Model for Abdominal Tumor Segmentation
summary: Tumor delineation is required for radiotherapy planning, yet automatic segmentation is limited by errors, predominantly false positives, that distort dose and increase editing time. The radiology report accompanies the scan and localizes disease at the suborgan level, but existing text-promptable models condition on short referring phrases, and most operate in 2D. We present RepConTUR, a single native-3D early-fusion multimodal model that conditions volumetric abdominal tumor segmentation on the narrative report. We extend AbdomenAtlas 3.0 to a suborgan-level promptable segmentation dataset and generate report-based VQA pairs, yielding four report-derived tasks on the same annotations: referring segmentation (RES), report-grounded segmentation (GSEG), report generation (RRG), and visual question answering (VQA). We train RepConTUR, comprising a 3D CT encoder, an early-fusion language model, and a native-3D segmentation module, jointly on the four tasks. Across liver, kidney and pancreas, RepConTUR attains the highest Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), instance-wise precision, and detection F1 among the text-promptable baselines, and adding the report raises mean precision while leaving recall comparable. Against two vision-only specialists, nnU-Net and the report-supervised R-Super, RepConTUR attains the highest value on every in-domain metric for liver and pancreas and the highest mean DSC, recall, precision, and detection F1 over the four out-of-distribution public cohorts. Ablations indicate that conditioning on the narrative report raises detection F1 from 0.499 to 0.528 within the same model, that joint GSEG training raises RES F1 from 0.450 to 0.482, and that the native-3D segmentation module raises GSEG F1 from 0.139 to 0.528 over its 2D counterpart. Code is available at https://github.com/Oncosoft-Research/RepConTUR.

AI.tldr: 提出RepConTUR，一个原生3D、早期融合的多模态模型，以放射报告为条件进行腹部肿瘤体积分割，并构建了子器官级可提示分割数据集与报告派生VQA任务，实现四任务联合训练。
AI.motivation: 放疗计划需要肿瘤勾画，但自动分割误差（以假阳性为主）会扭曲剂量并增加人工编辑时间。放射报告可从子器官层面定位病灶，然而现有文本可提示模型仅依赖短指代短语且多为2D，无法利用完整叙述性报告。
AI.method: 将AbdomenAtlas 3.0扩展为子器官级可提示分割数据集，并生成基于报告的VQA对，在同一标注上构造四个报告派生任务：指代分割(RES)、报告接地分割(GSEG)、报告生成(RRG)、视觉问答(VQA)。RepConTUR由3D CT编码器、早期融合语言模型和原生3D分割模块构成，四任务联合训练，单模型直接处理体积数据。
AI.result: 在肝、肾、胰腺上，RepConTUR的DSC、实例级精确率和检测F1均优于文本可提示基线；加入报告提升平均精确率且召回率相当。与nnU-Net和R-Super相比，肝与胰腺所有域内指标最优，并在四个分布外公开队列上取得最高平均DSC、召回率、精确率和检测F1。消融显示：报告条件使检测F1由0.499升至0.528；联合GSEG训练使RES F1由0.450升至0.482；原生3D分割模块使GSEG F1由0.139（2D对照）升至0.528。
AI.conclusion: 完整叙述性报告作为条件可有效抑制假阳性、提升检测精度，原生3D与早期融合架构、以及多任务联合训练是关键增益来源；作者公开了代码。

title: Possibility-based Inference: A Deterministic Framework for Robust and Reliable Uncertainty Quantification in Decision-Making
summary: Decision-making under uncertainty remains a key issue in Machine Learning (ML), particularly in the deployment of safety-critical systems, where reliable quantification of system behavior is essential for evaluating behavioral impacts and strengthening confidence in ML models. This contribution, influenced by fuzzy set theory and grounded in Bayesian statistics, addresses challenges related to data precision and the performance-accuracy trade-off in Bayesian inference (BI). To this end, we introduce a possibility-based contrastive grade of prediction as an alternative quantification method to existing latent posterior-based approaches for parameter estimation (approximation) and model selection. Unlike conventional Bayesian inference, which represents uncertainty within the probabilistic framework, the proposed model adopts a possibility-based representation that allows uncertain and potentially conflicting information to be characterized more flexibly. Rather than focusing on isolated aspects of a problem, the resulting mathematical framework provides a systematic approach to data mining while mitigating overly confident, yet implausible predictions generated by highly specialized deep learning architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于可能性的"对比预测等级"（contrastive grade of prediction），作为潜在后验方法的替代，用于贝叶斯推断中的参数估计与模型选择，以更灵活地表达不确定与冲突信息并抑制深度模型的过度自信预测。
AI.motivation: 不确定性下的决策在安全关键系统部署中至关重要，需要可靠量化系统行为。现有贝叶斯推断在数据精度与"性能—精度"权衡方面存在不足，且概率框架对不确定乃至冲突信息的刻画不够灵活；同时高度专门化的深度学习架构易产生过度自信但不合理的预测。
AI.method: 受模糊集理论启发并以贝叶斯统计为基础，构建可能性（possibility）表示框架；引入"基于可能性的对比预测等级"作为量化方法，替代现有基于潜在后验的参数量化与模型选择方式，从系统性角度处理数据挖掘问题，而非仅关注问题的孤立方面。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果；所提框架在理论上提供了对不确定与潜在冲突信息更灵活的表征，并为参数估计（近似）与模型选择提供统一量化手段，同时缓解过度自信但缺乏合理性的预测。
AI.conclusion: 将可能性表示与对比预测等级引入贝叶斯推断，可作为概率型不确定性表示的补充，提升安全关键场景下不确定性量化的灵活性与可靠性。

title: SelfThinker: Self-Evolving Reasoning via Reliability-Verified Intrinsic Visual Thoughts
summary: Unified multimodal models can both generate and understand images within a single set of weights, offering an opportunity to use image synthesis as training supervision for visual comprehension. However, existing visual chain-of-thought methods rely on human-annotated helper images during training and require slow image generation at test time. We present SelfThinker, the first self-evolving framework that turns a unified model's self-generated visual thoughts into stronger understanding without human image annotations. Given a visual problem, SelfThinker samples candidate helper images from its generation pathway and uses its frozen understanding pathway to score each candidate via conditional pointwise mutual information. High-utility visual thoughts then refine the generator via flow matching and serve as privileged teacher context for on-policy self-distillation. At inference, SelfThinker reasons directly from the original image in text without generating intermediate images. Although trained only on small synthetic visual-search and navigation datasets, SelfThinker transfers broadly to natural-image and spatial benchmarks, raising the seven-benchmark average of ThinkMorph-7B from 52.7 to 64.0 (+11.3 points). Controlled image-perturbation probes further show that SelfThinker surpasses ThinkMorph-7B by up to 40.4 points and its pretrained BAGEL-7B backbone by up to 23.2 points across fine-grained and spatial perception tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhangquanchen/SelfThinker.

AI.tldr: SelfThinker：首个自进化框架，将统一多模态模型自生成的"视觉思考"转化为更强的理解能力，无需人工标注辅助图像，且推理时不再生成中间图像。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型的生成与理解共享权重，使图像合成可作为视觉理解的训练监督。但现有视觉链式思考方法依赖人工标注的辅助图像进行训练，且测试时需缓慢地逐步生成图像。
AI.method: 给定视觉问题，从生成通路采样候选辅助图像，用冻结的理解通路以条件逐点互信息（conditional PMI）为每个候选打分；高效用视觉思考一方面通过流匹配（flow matching）精炼生成器，另一方面作为特权教师上下文进行在线自蒸馏（on-policy self-distillation）。推理时仅基于原图直接以文本推理，不生成中间图像。
AI.result: 仅在小型合成视觉搜索与导航数据上训练，即广泛迁移至自然图像与空间基准：ThinkMorph-7B 七基准平均分由 52.7 提升至 64.0（+11.3）；受控图像扰动探针显示，在细粒度与空间感知任务上分别最高超过 ThinkMorph-7B 40.4 分、超过预训练骨干 BAGEL-7B 23.2 分。
AI.conclusion: 自生成视觉思考可实现无标注自进化式理解增强，并获得高效的无图像生成的推理范式；小规模合成数据训练即可带来显著且可迁移的性能增益。

title: Pre-Crime for Agents, at the Last Second: Probing When a Recruited Agent Gives In
summary: When AI agents share channels and credentials, one agent can press another to break its operator's rule, a first step towards collusion. Output filters check only what an agent has already written. Can an overseer tell beforehand that an agent is about to give in? We show that a linear probe on the agent's activations can, in a controlled multi-agent setting. Across six scenarios, a peer presses a target for up to 20 rounds to reveal a secret, such as a deploy token; the target often refuses, then gives in. Read at each model call before its output is written, the probe picks out the one that leaks. On held-out Qwen3-32B episodes, at a threshold set to flag 5% of benign calls, it catches 82% of leaking calls. At a similar flag rate, a zero-shot decision-model monitor catches 26%. On gpt-oss-20b, a probe on its reasoning reaches AUROC 0.91. A bag-of-words classifier trained on the same calls comes close, so most of the gain comes from training on labels, not activations. The probe also flags permitted disclosures: it reads the coming disclosure more than the violation. The warning is short-range, and halting on any alarm would stop most benign episodes, which a second text check does not fix. A warning raised before generation could let an overseer stop an agent that is about to give in, ahead of others acting on its messages or recruitment spreading through a swarm.

AI.tldr: 该论文验证了在受控多智能体场景中，对智能体激活值训练线性探针，可在其输出生成前预测其即将违规泄露秘密，预警能力显著优于零样本决策模型监视器。
AI.motivation: 多智能体共享通道与凭证时，一个智能体可能被同伴施压而违背运营者规则，这是走向串谋的第一步。现有输出过滤器只能检查已生成内容，无法在事前阻止。作者希望回答：监督者能否在智能体"即将让步"之前就预知？
AI.method: 构建受控多智能体环境：6类场景中，同伴至多20轮施压目标智能体泄露部署令牌等秘密。在每个模型调用、输出写出之前读取激活值并训练线性探针，识别即将泄露的那次调用。基线包括零样本决策模型监视器、基于相同调用训练的bag-of-words分类器；在Qwen3-32B留出回合与gpt-oss-20b上进行评估（后者探测其推理过程）。
AI.result: Qwen3-32B留出回合上，在将5%良性调用标为告警的阈值下，探针捕获82%的泄露调用；同等告警率下零样本决策模型监视器仅26%。gpt-oss-20b推理探针AUROC达0.91。消融显示bag-of-words分类器效果接近，说明增益主要来自有标签训练而非激活本身。探针也会标记"被允许的披露"，更偏向读取即将发生的披露而非违规；预警为短程，任何告警即中止会误停大多数良性回合，二次文本检查无法修复。
AI.conclusion: 生成前的激活探针可作为事前监控信号，让监督者在智能体即将让步时提前干预，防止他人响应其消息或招募在群体中扩散；但其短程性、对合规披露的误报及高误停率限制了直接可用性。

title: SHPRR: An Algorithm for Pure Exploration under Constrained Regret
summary: Best Arm Identification (BAI) conventionally measures the cost of experimentation by the number of samples collected. In many operational settings, however, the cost of exploration relative to a trusted baseline already in place is equally important. We study BAI under both a fixed sampling horizon and a regret budget. Unlike generic resources considered in constrained pure exploration, regret has a distinctive structure: sampling better arms is less costly relative to the baseline. We theoretically show that the regret cost of exploration decreases across the phases of Sequential Halving, a widely used pure-exploration algorithm. This observation yields improved guarantees on the probability of identifying the best arm and motivates a more effective allocation of the regret budget. We propose Sequential Halving with Proportional Regret Rationing (SHPRR), which front-loads the regret budget to allow more exploration when many arms remain. Experiments on synthetic and real-world instances show that SHPRR improves best-arm identification performance over uniform regret allocation and existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在固定采样预算与regret预算下的最佳臂识别（BAI），发现规划regret在Sequential Halving各阶段递减，提出SHPRR算法将regret预算前移分配以提升识别性能。
AI.motivation: 传统BAI以采样次数衡量实验成本，但在实际运营中，相对于已部署的可信基线，探索所带来的regret成本同样重要。而约束型纯探索中的通用资源缺乏regret的独特结构：采样更优臂的相对成本更低，因此需要针对regret预算设计专门的最优分配策略。
AI.method: 作者理论上证明Sequential Halving（SH）在探索过程中各阶段的regret成本递减，由此得到最优臂识别概率的改进保证，并据此设计Sequential Halving with Proportional Regret Rationing (SHPRR)：按比例将regret预算前置到臂数较多的早期阶段，从而在剩余臂较多时进行更多探索。
AI.result: 理论上给出SH各阶段regret成本递减的性质及由此改进的最佳臂识别概率保证；在合成数据与真实数据实验上，SHPRR相比均匀regret分配及现有基线方法取得更好的最佳臂识别性能。
AI.conclusion: regret作为探索成本具有可利用的结构性优势；通过在SH各阶段按比例前置分配regret预算，可在固定采样预算与regret预算情形下有效提升BAI效果，验证了regret感知预算分配的价值。

title: SynthFaces: Balanced Large Scale Human Dataset
summary: The pursuit of fair and equitable AI in human-centric tasks is critically hindered by the inherent biases and privacy risks of real-world datasets, which offer imbalanced representations of identity and often contain sensitive personal information. Consequently, state-of-the-art generative models trained on this skewed data exhibit unfair performance, particularly in identity-preserving generation. In this work we propose a pipeline for controllable generation of dataset with diverse faces for generative models training and finetuning. We achieve this by expanding foundational Arc2Face diffusion model with a flow matching generative model in the manifold of identity embeddings. We demonstrate that such approach achieves both goals of generative fidelity and label diversity not present in real human-centric datasets. As a result we collect and further contextualize a highly balanced identity-centric dataset of humans named SynthFaces. By design, our released images and identities are synthetic, reducing direct reliance on real personal images; we empirically check identity separation with a nearest-neighbor non-leakage metric. We purpose it for training and tuning of fair models for various downstream tasks, and showcase its usability in finetuning an existing adapter-based method for personalized generation.

AI.tldr: 提出以 Arc2Face 扩散模型为基础、在身份嵌入流形上结合 flow matching 生成模型的可控数据集合成流水线，构建高度平衡的合成人脸数据集 SynthFaces，用于训练/微调更公平的生成模型。
AI.motivation: 真实以人为中心的数据集存在身份表征不均衡与隐私敏感信息，导致生成模型（尤其身份保持生成）出现不公平性能。作者希望同时获得高保真与标签多样性，并降低对真实个人图像的依赖。
AI.method: 以 Arc2Face 基础扩散模型为起点，扩展一个在身份嵌入（ID embedding）流形上运行的 flow matching 生成模型，实现可控的人脸数据集生成；并通过最近邻非泄露度量实证检验身份可分性。
AI.result: 收集并情境化构建了身份高度平衡的 SynthFaces 数据集，兼具生成保真度与真实数据集中缺失的标签多样性；图像与身份均为合成，最近邻非泄露度量验证身份分离。
AI.conclusion: SynthFaces 可用于各类下游任务的公平模型训练与调优，并在实验中展示了其对现有基于适配器的个性化生成方法微调的有效性。

title: Collaborative AI agents for autonomous experimental research with solid-state quantum spins
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures. Code available at https://github.com/E-zClap/auctopus
summary: An autonomous research laboratory could conduct an entire study, from formulating questions to preparing manuscripts. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers one route towards this goal. Recent AI systems take on several research roles, but may draw conclusions that the evidence does not support. Here, we present an autonomous research laboratory in which agents based on large language models assess one another's work and can stop or redirect investigations. They can generate and reject research questions, require separate theoretical checks and conduct experiments designed to challenge their claims. We demonstrate these capabilities by investigating ensembles of quantum spins in diamond. The agents derived the minimum number of calibration settings needed to predict responses to a defined family of microwave pulse sequences. They checked the result computationally and designed experiments to distinguish competing predictions. An initial experiment agreed with the theoretical predictions, but repeated reference measurements showed that the signal was drifting during data collection. The agents therefore treated the result as inconclusive and revised the measurement protocol without relaxing the acceptance criteria. The revised experiment met those criteria and supported the theoretical predictions. This study demonstrates that collaborating AI agents can select research questions, derive theoretical results and test their predictions experimentally.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个由大语言模型智能体构成的"自主研究实验室"，智能体之间相互评估、能否决或重定向研究方向，并在金刚石量子自旋体系上完成了从提出问题、推导理论结果到实验验证的完整研究流程。
AI.motivation: 现有AI系统虽已承担部分研究角色，但可能得出证据不支持的结论；作者希望验证AI智能体能否实现从提问到成稿的自主研究闭环，并通过相互审查机制提升结论可靠性。
AI.method: 构建基于大语言模型的多智能体科研系统，智能体可相互评审工作并中止或调整研究；系统能生成与否决研究问题、要求独立的理论核验、设计旨在挑战自身主张的实验。在金刚石量子自旋系综上做验证：推导预测给定微波脉冲序列族响应所需的最少校准参数数目，进行计算核验，并设计区分竞争预测的实验。
AI.result: 智能体推导出最少校准参数数并完成计算验证；初步实验符合理论预测，但重复参考测量发现采集期间信号漂移，智能体据此判定结果不确定，并在不放宽验收标准的前提下修改测量方案；修订后的实验满足验收标准并支持理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 协作式AI智能体能够选择研究问题、推导理论结果并通过实验检验预测，展示了自主研究实验室的可行性。

title: Exploring the Potential of Symbolic Regression in Precision Livestock Farming
summary: The ability to predict farrowing time in pigs is crucial for optimal farm management and ensuring piglet survival. This study investigates the potential of explainable artificial intelligence for precision livestock farming, focusing on acceleration sensor data from sows around the time of farrowing. Accurately predicting farrowing allows farmers to balance both, piglet safety by avoiding piglet crushing events and the mother sow's welfare, by avoiding early crating. Traditional machine learning models often lack interpretability (``closed-box'' problem). Explainable artificial intelligence offers a solution by revealing the decision-making processes within the models. This work is split into two stages. First the detection of nest building behaviour and second the prediction of the remaining time to farrowing. The nest building detection was possible for 166 out of 180 sows and successful within 48 hours before farrowing for 149 sows. The nest building detection is purely based on the change of a sow's activity level and uses no machine learning techniques. Further, this study utilizes symbolic regression, an open-box modelling technique that generates interpretable mathematical formulas, to predict the remaining time until the onset of farrowing. The results are compared with closed-box models, like support vector regression and artificial neural networks, for both explainability and performance. Notably, symbolic regression achieved a mean absolute error of 9.28 hours for the time-to-farrowing prediction, outperforming the closed-box models in terms of performance and interpretability. This research demonstrates that explainable artificial intelligence, specifically symbolic regression, can offer both interpretable results and competitive performance in precision livestock farming.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用母猪分娩前后的加速度传感器数据，先用无机器学习的行为学方法检测筑巢行为，再用符号回归（可解释的"开箱"模型）预测距分娩的剩余时间，MAE达9.28小时，性能与可解释性均优于支持向量回归和神经网络等"闭箱"模型。
AI.motivation: 准确预测母猪分娩时间对农场管理与仔猪存活至关重要：既可避免仔猪被压死，又可避免过早限位栏关押以保障母猪福利。传统机器学习模型存在"闭箱"问题，缺乏可解释性，难以取得养殖者信任。
AI.method: 研究分两阶段：①基于母猪活动水平变化（不使用机器学习）检测筑巢行为；②采用符号回归生成可解释的数学公式来预测距分娩的剩余时间，并与支持向量回归、人工神经网络等"闭箱"模型在可解释性和性能上进行比较。数据来源为母猪分娩前后加速度传感器数据。
AI.result: 筑巢行为检测在180头母猪中成功覆盖166头，其中149头在分娩前48小时内成功检出。符号回归预测距分娩时间的平均绝对误差为9.28小时，在性能和可解释性两方面均优于闭箱模型。
AI.conclusion: 可解释人工智能，尤其是符号回归，能够在精准畜牧业中同时提供可解释的结果与有竞争力的预测性能，为分娩预测与动物福利管理提供实用方案。

title: Learning a Motion Manifold to Constrain Ambiguity in Unsupervised 4D Medical Image Interpolation
summary: Unsupervised 4D medical image interpolation reconstructs intermediate anatomical states from temporally sparse observations without intermediate supervision. Distinct motion fields may attain comparable endpoint agreement while producing different intermediate anatomy, giving rise to motion ambiguity. This ambiguity is difficult to constrain when many independently adjustable motion variables must be estimated from the observed endpoints. We develop a framework that learns a motion manifold to restrict candidate motion fields while retaining sample-specific variation. Cross-Sample Spectral Basis Learning extracts recurring motion structure from endpoint-derived dense estimates and encodes it in a shared spectral basis. Sample-Conditioned Cayley Basis Reorientation uses predicted motion coordinates to rotate the effective motion directions for each endpoint pair without increasing the number of independent coordinates. Their composition defines a nonlinear family of complete velocity fields across endpoint pairs, accommodating anatomical and motion-state differences within a restricted representation. Integrating each predicted field supports bidirectional reconstruction at arbitrary intermediate times. Theoretical analysis establishes sufficient conditions under which endpoint observations distinguish nearby motions within the learned family. Experiments on ACDC and 4D-Lung demonstrate state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated methods trained without intermediate volumes and competitive results against methods using intermediate supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出一种学习运动流形的无监督4D医学图像插值框架，通过谱基学习与Cayley基重定向约束运动场，缓解端点一致性下的中间解剖歧义，在ACDC与4D-Lung上取得同类无中间监督方法中的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 从时间稀疏观测重建中间解剖状态时缺乏中间监督，不同运动场可在端点一致的同时产生不同的中间解剖结构，形成"运动歧义"；当需从端点估计大量独立可调的运动变量时，该歧义难以约束。
AI.method: 学习一个运动流形以限制候选运动场并保留样本特异性。包含两部分：跨样本谱基学习（Cross-Sample Spectral Basis Learning），从端点导出的稠密估计中提取可复现的运动结构并编码为共享谱基；样本条件Cayley基重定向（Sample-Conditioned Cayley Basis Reorientation），用预测的运动坐标旋转各端点对的有效运动方向而不增加独立坐标数。二者组合构成端点对间完整速度场的非线性族，积分后可支持任意中间时刻的双向重建；并给出端点观测可区分族内邻近运动的充分条件。
AI.result: 在ACDC和4D-Lung数据集上，在无中间体数据训练的被评估方法中达到最优性能，并与使用中间监督的方法相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 以低维共享谱基加样本条件旋转的方式约束运动表示，可在不增加独立参数的前提下缓解运动歧义，理论分析与实验共同支持该框架的有效性。

title: LLM-Integrated Bayesian State Space Models for Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Forecasting in the real world requires integrating structured time-series data with unstructured textual information, but existing methods are architecturally limited by fixed input/output horizons and are unable to model or quantify uncertainty. We address this challenge by introducing LLM-integrated Bayesian State space models (LBS), a novel probabilistic framework for multimodal temporal forecasting. At a high level, LBS consists of two components: (1) a state space model (SSM) backbone that captures the temporal dynamics of latent states from which both numerical and textual observations are generated and (2) a pretrained large language model (LLM) that is adapted to encode textual inputs for posterior state estimation and decode textual forecasts consistent with the latent trajectory. This design enables flexible lookback and forecast windows, principled uncertainty quantification, and improved temporal generalization thanks to the well-suited inductive bias of SSMs toward modeling dynamical systems. Experiments on the TextTimeCorpus benchmark demonstrate that LBS improves the previous state-of-the-art by 13.20% while providing human-readable summaries of each forecast. Our work is the first to unify LLMs and SSMs for joint numerical and textual prediction, offering a novel foundation for multimodal temporal reasoning.

AI.tldr: LBS：将LLM与贝叶斯状态空间模型统一，实现多模态时间序列的概率预测。
AI.motivation: 现实预测需融合结构化时序数据与非结构化文本，但现有方法受限于固定输入/输出窗口，且无法建模与量化不确定性。
AI.method: 提出概率框架LBS，含两部分：(1) SSM骨干从潜状态捕获时序动态，数值与文本观测均由该潜状态生成；(2) 预训练LLM经适配后编码文本输入以进行后验状态估计，并解码与潜轨迹一致的文本预测。
AI.result: 在TextTimeCorpus基准上较此前SOTA提升13.20%，并为每次预测提供人类可读摘要。
AI.conclusion: 首个统一LLM与SSM进行数值与文本联合预测的工作，支持灵活回看/预测窗口与原则化不确定性量化，为多模态时序推理提供新基础。

title: DWISE: Denoising Workload-Informed Scheduling Engine
summary: Unlike autoregressive large language models (AR-LLMs), diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising many tokens in parallel, offering a promising path to efficient inference. Existing serving frameworks, however, schedule dLLM requests with policies designed for AR models, namely first-come-first-served (FCFS) admission and prefill priority. We find that both policies are ill-suited to dLLMs, wasting much of their speed. FCFS ignores that a dLLM request's decoding cost is highly heterogeneous and unknown at arrival, causing severe head-of-line blocking. Prefill priority, widely used in AR-LLM serving to keep time-to-first-token low, sharply cuts dLLM efficiency, as rounds that run only prompts leave most of the batch idle. We present DWISE, a Denoising Workload-Informed Scheduling Engine for efficient dLLM serving. DWISE schedules requests by their remaining work, measured in a block-level unit shared by prefill and denoising, so both phases share a round. To predict the unknown denoising workload, DWISE combines a lightweight prompt-based predictor at admission with a single refinement from the first denoising round's hidden states, which capture model-specific information absent from the prompt and require no additional model execution. Implemented in SGLang and evaluated on five models from three dLLM families under bursty workloads, DWISE reduces mean end-to-end latency over SGLang by 5.4$\times$ on average and up to 14.9$\times$ while preserving task accuracy. The code will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: DWISE：面向扩散语言模型(dLLM)服务的去噪工作量感知调度引擎，按剩余工作量统一调度prefill与去噪，平均降低端到端时延5.4倍（最高14.9倍）。
AI.motivation: 现有dLLM服务框架沿用AR模型调度策略（FCFS准入+prefill优先），但FCFS忽略dLLM请求解码代价高度异构且到达时未知，造成严重队头阻塞；prefill优先使仅跑prompt的轮次令batch大量空闲，显著降低效率。
AI.method: DWISE按“剩余工作量”调度，采用prefill与去噪共享的block级单位，使两阶段可同轮执行。为预测未知的去噪工作量，准入时用轻量prompt级预测器，并结合首个去噪轮次隐状态做一次精修（隐状态含prompt缺失的模型特定信息且无需额外模型执行）。基于SGLang实现。
AI.result: 在3个dLLM家族共5个模型、突发性负载下评测，相比SGLang平均降低端到端时延5.4倍、最高14.9倍，同时保持任务准确率。
AI.conclusion: 针对dLLM特性的工作量感知、跨阶段统一调度可显著提升服务效率，且无需牺牲精度，代码将开源。

title: VideoMemBench: How Well Do MLLMs Remember in Video Conversations?
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can now process hour-long videos, making extended multi-turn dialogue over a single video a natural mode of use. Sustaining such a dialogue requires more than answering each question in isolation: the model must retrieve and reuse information established earlier in the conversation, both what it has seen and what it has said, an ability we term in-context video memory. Existing video QA benchmarks leave this ability unmeasured: their questions are mutually independent, never reference one another, and each is answerable from the video alone, so nothing ever requires carrying information across turns. We introduce VideoMemBench, in which each sample pairs a single video with a long multi-turn dialogue, whose turns are connected by typed cross-turn dependencies: an Episodic Dependency refers back to a visual episode described in an earlier turn, probing memory of what the model has seen, while an Answer Dependency builds on the model's own earlier answer, probing memory of what the model has said. Every dependency is verified considering two properties: 1) necessity, meaning the question cannot be answered without its earlier turns, and 2) non-leakage, meaning the question does not restate the information from its earlier turns. To enforce these properties, we design a construction pipeline with three LLM roles: a planner, a generator, and a judger, with each dialogue reviewed by human experts. VideoMemBench comprises 326 videos with 2,476 turns, of which 1,387 depend on earlier turns, including multi-parent dependencies and long-range call-back. Among over 20 evaluated open- and closed-source MLLMs, Claude Opus 5 performs the best with an overall score of only 45.7\%, highlighting the challenge of in-context video memory. Our dataset and evaluation are released.

AI.tldr: 提出VideoMemBench，用于评测MLLM在长视频多轮对话中的"上下文内视频记忆"能力，即复用先前看到与说过的信息。
AI.motivation: MLLM已可处理小时级视频，多轮对话成为自然使用模式，但现有视频QA基准的题目彼此独立、不互相引用、仅凭视频即可回答，无法测量跨轮次携带信息的能力。
AI.method: 构建每条视频配长多轮对话的样本，轮次间以类型化跨轮依赖相连：Episodic Dependency回溯先前轮次描述的视觉片段（考察"看过什么"），Answer Dependency基于模型先前答案（考察"说过什么"）。每个依赖验证必要性（无前序轮次无法作答）与非泄漏性（不复述前序信息）。采用planner-generator-judger三角色LLM流水线构建，并由人工专家审校。
AI.result: 数据集含326个视频、2,476轮对话，其中1,387轮依赖前序轮次，包含多父依赖与长程回溯。评测20余个开源与闭源MLLM，最佳为Claude Opus 5，总分仅45.7%。
AI.conclusion: 现有模型在上下文内视频记忆方面仍面临显著挑战；数据集与评测已开源发布。

title: NeurEO: dissecting Earth observation embeddings with computational neuroscience
comment: Originally published at the EurIPS 2025 REO workshop
summary: Earth embeddings are compressed representations of rich Earth observation data that enable downstream models to tackle a wide range of complex geospatial tasks. Yet, this increase in performance comes at the cost of decreased interpretability, as the semantic meaning of Earth embeddings is unknown. To address this challenge, we borrow methods from the field of computational neuroscience, which aim to interpret activity in (biological) neurons. Here, we adapt and apply these methods to assign meaning to AlphaEarth embeddings. We analyse embedding features both as stand-alone data, equivalent to spontaneous neural activity, and in relation to land cover and elevation correlates, equivalent to stimulus-response neural activity. We demonstrate correlational and multi-scale structure in the embedding features. Embedding features can display highly specific and directional tuning to land cover and elevation, such as a `North vs South woodland edge' response. When we remove the main trends of combined land cover responses (like water versus land tuning), we discover fine-grained representational details with increased effective dimensionality. Together, our analyses start to unravel what these Earth embeddings represent, which is critical for developing trustworthy downstream applications.

AI.tldr: 借鉴计算神经科学方法解读AlphaEarth Earth embeddings的语义含义。
AI.motivation: Earth embeddings虽提升下游地理空间任务性能，但语义不可知导致可解释性下降，需明确其表征内容以支撑可信应用。
AI.method: 将embeddings特征分别作为独立数据（类比自发神经活动）及与土地覆盖、高程相关的刺激-响应数据（类比刺激-响应神经活动）进行分析。
AI.result: 发现embeddings存在相关性与多尺度结构；特征对土地覆盖和高程表现出高度特异性和方向性调谐（如"南北林地边缘"响应）；去除土地覆盖综合响应的主要趋势后，呈现更细粒度表征并提升有效维度。
AI.conclusion: 研究初步揭示Earth embeddings的表征内容，为开发可信的下游应用奠定基础。

title: Turing LLM Post-Training: Calibrated Distillation and Efficient Dynamic-MoE Execution
summary: We study post-training for dynamically routed mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, focusing on integrating independently optimized specialists while keeping consolidation efficient. Our approach combines calibrated multi-teacher on-policy distillation (C-MOPD), which matches each selected teacher on a local Top-$K$ support with teacher-wise loss normalization and clipping, with an execution path that uses post-capacity bounded-width dispatch, final-route replay, and asynchronous rollout--training overlap. On Turing-20B-A2B, the selected model achieves a four-domain normalized integration score of 0.9988 and retains at least 90.16\% of the measured specialist gain in every domain. At matched $K=32$, the full calibration objective scores 0.9962, compared with 0.9724 without calibration and 0.9834 without clipping. At a matched 8K response cap, the model exceeds both shared SFT and Qwen3-8B on all four reasoning-enabled mathematics and code benchmarks (unweighted mean: 85.92, versus 80.33 for Qwen3-8B and 74.21 for SFT), and improves over SFT on ten of twelve broader evaluation metrics. In a PPU-based profile, the combined execution configuration reduces consolidation step time from 398.7 to 139.3 seconds, an observed 2.86$\times$ speedup over serial execution. These results demonstrate strong specialist integration alongside more efficient consolidation, while reflecting the complete training and execution framework rather than any single component.

AI.tldr: 本文研究动态路由MoE模型的后训练，将校准式多教师on-policy蒸馏（C-MOPD）与高效的执行路径结合，在保持专家能力的同时（Turing-20B-A2B四域归一化集成分数0.9988）将整合步骤时间从398.7s降至139.3s（2.86×加速）。
AI.motivation: 动态路由MoE模型需要整合各自独立优化的专家模型，但直接整合往往导致专家能力损失，且整合过程（consolidation）计算开销大、效率低。论文旨在同时解决"专家集成质量"与"整合效率"两个问题。
AI.method: 提出C-MOPD（校准式多教师on-policy蒸馏）：在每个所选教师的局部Top-K支撑集上匹配教师分布，并采用逐教师损失归一化与裁剪；执行侧采用post-capacity有界宽度分发、最终路由重放（final-route replay）以及异步rollout-训练重叠。
AI.result: Turing-20B-A2B四域归一化集成得分0.9988，各域至少保留90.16%专家增益；K=32时完整校准目标0.9962，无校准0.9724，无裁剪0.9834；8K响应上限下在四个推理数学/代码基准全面超过共享SFT与Qwen3-8B（均值85.92 vs 80.33 vs 74.21），并在12项更广评测中10项优于SFT；PPU配置下整合步骤时间398.7s→139.3s，2.86×加速。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明该方法能实现强专家集成与更高效整合，但性能体现的是完整训练与执行框架的联合效果，而非任何单一组件的贡献。

title: Hierarchical Step Decomposition for Training-free Online Video Step Grounding
summary: Given a set of procedural steps, Video Step Grounding (VSG) aims to identify which steps occur in a video and localize when they are performed. Existing methods are either offline, requiring access to the full video before making predictions, or online, but relying on fixed-length video segments producing noisy, over-segmented outputs. In this work, we propose Hierarchical Step Decomposition (HSD), a training-free framework for online VSG that leverages the semantic understanding capabilities of Large Multimodal Models. HSD addresses two central challenges in online grounding: constructing semantically coherent temporal segments from a streaming video, and bridging the semantic gap between coarse procedural step descriptions and visual observations. To construct elementary temporal units, HSD incrementally groups incoming segments into semantically consistent events, using an anchor caption that is continuously validated against the visual stream. Based on these events, we perform zero-shot procedural step classification and selectively refine uncertain predictions by decomposing candidate steps into finegrained substeps that capture more nuanced visual evidence. By operating on semantically coherent events rather than every fixed-length segment, HSD reduces redundant computation and produces more stable predictions. Experiments on HT-Step, Ego4D Goal-Step, and CrossTask show that HSD substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods, overall achieving better step recognition, more accurate temporal localization, and faster inference.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架HSD，利用大型多模态模型实现流式视频中的在线步骤定位，通过语义一致事件构建与不确定预测的细粒度子步骤分解，在三个数据集上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有VSG方法要么离线（需完整视频），要么在线但依赖定长片段，导致输出噪声大、过度分割；同时存在粗粒度步骤描述与视觉观测之间的语义鸿沟。
AI.method: 训练无关的层次化步骤分解框架：1）增量地将流入片段聚合为语义一致事件，使用持续对照视觉流校验的锚点描述；2）基于事件进行零样本步骤分类；3）对不确定预测选择性分解为细粒度子步骤以捕获更细微视觉证据。
AI.result: 在HT-Step、Ego4D Goal-Step、CrossTask上显著优于SOTA，步骤识别更准、时序定位更精确、推理更快。
AI.conclusion: 以语义一致事件替代定长片段可减少冗余计算并提升预测稳定性，为在线VSG提供了有效的免训练方案。

title: TACFormer: Transformer-Based Generative Model for Target-Conditioned De Novo PROTAC Design
summary: Targeted protein degradation (TPD) represents a fundamental shift in drug discovery, moving beyond traditional target inhibition toward the event-driven removal of disease-causing proteins. A prominent strategy for TPD is the use of proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs), heterobifunctional molecules that selectively route a protein of interest (POI) to the ubiquitin-proteasome system for degradation. While PROTAC design still relies heavily on trial-and-error synthesis and experimental testing, deep generative models offer a promising means to explore PROTAC chemical space in silico and generate novel molecules. However, many existing generative methods formulate PROTAC design primarily as a linker-generation problem, with POI-binding (warhead) and E3-ligase-binding components fixed in advance. This restricts exploration of the full PROTAC chemical space and often leaves the POI implicit through the predefined warhead, rather than using protein-level information as an explicit conditioning signal during generation. To address these limitations, we propose TACFormer: a transformer-based generative model for target-aware de novo PROTAC design. The model conditions a GPT-style molecular decoder on pretrained ESM-2 representations of POI sequences, allowing POI-level information to steer full-molecule generation. Our results show that TACFormer generates highly novel and chemically diverse PROTACs while showing consistent POI-dependent shifts in generated chemical space. In particular, molecules generated under specific target conditions preferentially populate chemical neighborhoods associated with POIs in the held-out dataset, while extrapolating to novel chemotypes. By natively integrating biological context into the generative process, TACFormer moves PROTAC design toward a more biology-informed exploration of degrader chemical space.

AI.tldr: TACFormer是一个基于Transformer的生成模型，以POI序列的ESM-2蛋白表征为条件，驱动GPT式分子解码器实现靶点感知的PROTAC全分子从头设计。
AI.motivation: 现有PROTAC生成方法多将设计简化为linker生成问题，固定warhead与E3配体，限制了化学空间探索，且POI信息被隐含于预设warhead中，未作为显式条件信号利用蛋白层面信息。
AI.method: 将GPT风格分子解码器条件化于预训练ESM-2对POI序列的表征，进行端到端的整分子生成，而非仅生成连接子。
AI.result: 生成的PROTAC具有高新颖性与化学多样性；在特定靶点条件下，生成化学空间呈现一致的POI依赖性偏移，分子优先富集于留出数据集中相应POI相关的化学邻域，同时外推至新化学型。
AI.conclusion: 原生整合生物语境可将PROTAC设计推向更具生物学信息指导的降解剂化学空间探索，摆脱对试错合成与预设warhead的依赖。

title: EventSeeColor: Learning to Reconstruct Color from Monochrome Events
summary: Event cameras capture visual brightness changes under challenging lighting conditions. However, traditional event-based image reconstruction targets grayscale intensity and produces images without scene color. Color distinguishes surfaces with similar intensity. Reconstructing color from events can reveal appearance differences that reconstructed grayscale images cannot express. Although monochrome event cameras do not directly measure color, their event-triggering patterns depend on surface reflectance, illumination, and the sensor's spectral response. These patterns may contain cues that support color reconstruction. In this paper, we present EventSeeColor, which uses event-reconstructed grayscale and aligned events to jointly guide a diffusion colorizer. Grayscale-derived semantic context supports color inference, while region-balanced chroma supervision and local RGB refinement improve color distribution, brightness, and texture. In the combined evaluation on two real event datasets, EventSeeColor achieves the best structural similarity, learned perceptual scores, and chromatic-region color difference among the external methods.

AI.tldr: EventSeeColor 利用事件相机重建的灰度图与对齐事件联合引导扩散着色器，实现从单色事件数据重建彩色图像。
AI.motivation: 事件相机能在挑战性光照下捕捉亮度变化，但传统事件图像重建仅针对灰度强度，无法表达同等强度下不同表面的颜色差异；而单色事件相机的触发模式蕴含反射率、光照与光谱响应线索，可用于颜色恢复。
AI.method: 提出 EventSeeColor：以事件重建灰度图与对齐事件共同引导扩散着色（diffusion colorizer）；灰度图提供语义上下文辅助颜色推断，并引入区域均衡色度监督（region-balanced chroma supervision）与局部 RGB 细化以改善色彩分布、亮度与纹理。
AI.result: 在两个真实事件数据集联合评测中，EventSeeColor 在结构相似度、学习感知指标及彩色区域色差上均优于外部对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 单色事件数据可借助事件触发模式与灰度语义先验实现有效彩色重建，扩散着色框架在该任务上表现领先。

title: Data-driven Random-feature Approximation of Koopman Generators of Nonlinear Continuous-time Systems
summary: Learning continuous-time dynamical systems from data is an active area of research. The Koopman formalism is often used here, because it is a flexible approach that is informative about the system's fundamental properties. The formalism represents dynamical systems through linear operators acting on a suitable function space. A practical difficulty arising in the numerical approximation of Koopman operators is the choice of a ``dictionary'', meaning an effective finite-dimensional representation of the function space. In this paper, we focus on learning dynamical systems in continuous-time, and so we consider numerical approximations of the Koopman generator instead of the Koopman operator. Our main contribution is a data-driven random-feature method to obtain a parsimonious and effective function representation for Galerkin approximation methods such as gEDMD. The representation we construct is data-informed, which allows us to improve upon data-agnostic methods. We empirically demonstrate the suitability of our method for forecasting tasks and system analysis. The numerical experiments show that our approach is accurate, and faster than iterative optimization. Further, we prove convergence of our approximation of the vector field and the resulting trajectories. In addition to the numerical results, we also make theoretical contributions, including a general convergence criterion for the semigroup generated by the gEDMD approximation and a counterexample showing that gEDMD does not generally preserve exponential boundedness. With our contribution, we advance the frontier of efficiently learning continuous-time dynamics from data, towards interpretable and mathematically robust modelling based on the Koopman framework.

AI.tldr: 提出一种数据驱动的随机特征方法，为gEDMD等Galerkin近似构建精简有效的函数字典，用于连续时间Koopman生成元的学习，兼具精度、速度与收敛性保证。
AI.motivation: 连续时间动力系统的Koopman生成元数值逼近中，字典（有限维函数空间表示）的选择是核心难题；现有数据无关方法效果有限，迭代优化字典代价高。
AI.method: 构造数据驱动的随机特征表示作为字典，用于Koopman生成元的Galerkin近似（如gEDMD）；证明向量场与轨迹的收敛性，给出gEDMD半群收敛的一般判据，并构造反例说明gEDMD一般不保持指数有界性。
AI.result: 数值实验表明方法在预测与系统分析任务上准确，且快于迭代优化；理论证明向量场与轨迹收敛；指出gEDMD不保持指数有界性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推进了高效、可解释且数学稳健的连续时间动力学数据驱动建模，拓展了Koopman框架的实用边界。

title: Beyond CCT: Multi-channel SPD recovery for per-shot camera color correction
summary: Modern cameras correct color via two or three pre-calibrated 3x3 matrices interpolated by Correlated Color Temperature (CCT). This collapses the illuminant SPD to a scalar. LEDs, fluorescents, and mixed sources sit off the Planckian locus, and metameric illuminants with the same chromaticity demand different optimal CCMs that a CCT pipeline cannot distinguish. We recover the illuminant SPD instead using non-negative least squares against a basis dictionary, conditioned on the camera white point and a multi-channel ambient-light sensor (ALS). A closed-form 3x3 CCM is then fit per shot. On a synthetic benchmark of 300 illuminants and 3,100 reflectances, mean angular error drops from 1.89 to 1.20 degrees, with a 1.7x tail reduction on the LED-like off-Planckian group (n=45) where metameric ambiguity is tangible. The gain holds under realistic ALS imperfections and observation noise, and the same off-Planckian advantage carries over to 1,684 real measured SPDs.

AI.tldr: 提出用非负最小二乘在基字典上恢复光源SPD（结合相机白点与多通道环境光传感器），再逐张拟合闭式3x3 CCM，替代CCT插值的两/三矩阵方案，显著改善离普朗克轨迹光源的色差。
AI.motivation: 现有相机用2–3个预标定3x3矩阵按CCT插值校色，将光源SPD压缩为一个标量；LED、荧光灯及混合光源位于普朗克轨迹之外，且同色度异谱（metameric）光源需要不同的最优CCM，CCT流水线无法区分。
AI.method: 以相机白点和多通道环境光传感器（ALS）读数为条件，对基字典做非负最小二乘（NNLS）重建光源SPD；随后对每张拍摄图像闭式求解最优3x3 CCM。
AI.result: 在300个光源、3100条反射率的合成基准上，平均角度误差由1.89°降至1.20°；LED类离普朗克组（n=45）尾部误差降低1.7倍。在ALS不完美与观测噪声下增益仍保持，并在1684条实测SPD上复现离普朗克优势。
AI.conclusion: 以SPD重建替代CCT标量假设，可有效缓解同色度异谱歧义，为离普朗克及混合照明提供更稳健的白平衡/CCM方案，且对传感器误差具有鲁棒性。

title: CovFedAvg: Local Low-Loss Curves and Federated Model Selection
summary: Clients observing different parts of a prediction task may learn locally equivalent models with incompatible behavior outside their observed support. We study whether redundant models permit local low-loss paths toward a compatible shared model. CovFedAvg retains local models and curve controls on clients, fits a common endpoint through aggregated gradient contributions, and selects an actual candidate model using distributed training losses. No centralized calibration examples or client-to-client sample exchange are required. Exact selection guarantees no higher evaluated training loss than the previous model and the current-round FedAvg candidate; this is not a global-optimality, stationarity, generalization, or differential-privacy guarantee. We state conditional client-compatibility and approximate-selection bounds and retain corrected transformation identities and a separate full-gradient safeguard theorem for reference algorithms. A complementary input-support example recovers the shared absolute-value regression, while matched direct fine-tuning also solves it. Across a synthetic support task, recorded activity-recognition subjects, and participating and future gas-sensor batches, we evaluate five methods, five seeds, two network widths, and 20 rounds without calibration data. At width 16, CovFedAvg raises participating-Gas macro balanced accuracy from FedAvg's 88.88% to 89.84%; matched distributed fine-tuning reaches 91.65%. Results support feasibility and modest gains over FedAvg, but do not establish a curve-specific advantage over equally costly optimization. Exact-sum numerical experiments establish data flow; end-to-end privacy requires additional mechanisms and analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出CovFedAvg：在客户端保留本地模型与曲线参数，通过聚合梯度贡献拟合共同端点，并用分布式训练损失选出实际候选模型；无需集中校准数据或客户端间样本交换。实验显示相较FedAvg取得适度提升，但不证明曲线方法优于同等代价的直接微调。
AI.motivation: 客户端只观测预测任务的不同部分，会学到局部等价但支撑集外行为不相容的模型。作者研究冗余的本地模型能否提供通向相容共享模型的低损失局部路径。
AI.method: CovFedAvg在客户端保留本地模型与曲线控制点，通过聚合各客户端的梯度贡献拟合一个共同端点，再借助分布式训练损失在候选模型中选择实际模型；不需要集中校准样本，也不需要客户端间交换样本。作者给出精确选择保证（不劣于上一轮模型与本轮FedAvg候选）、条件性客户端相容性与近似选择界，并为参考算法保留修正后的变换恒等式与独立的满梯度保障定理；另给出输入支撑示例以恢复共享绝对值回归。
AI.result: 在合成支撑集任务、已记录的活动识别受试者数据以及参与与未来气体传感器批次上，评估5种方法、5个随机种子、2种网络宽度、20轮且不使用校准数据。宽度16时，CovFedAvg将参与Gas宏平均平衡准确率从FedAvg的88.88%提升至89.84%；匹配的分布式微调达到91.65%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持可行性及相对FedAvg的适度提升，但未确立曲线方法相对同等代价优化方法的特有优势；精确求和数值实验仅验证数据流动可行性，端到端隐私仍需额外机制与分析。保证范围限于不劣于既有候选，而非全局最优、驻点性、泛化或差分隐私。

title: AdMuse: Skill-Guided Creative Advertising Image Generation
summary: An outstanding creative advertising image should both attract attention and communicate a product's positioning. How to choose a persuasive conceptual bridge before rendering begins is challenging for advertising generation. We present AdMuse, a skill-guided multi-agent framework that distills high-quality advertisements into reusable creative skills for cross-domain advertising strategy. Rather than retrieving isolated exemplars, AdMuse abstracts recurring bridge patterns into a skill library that can guide new product briefs. At generation time, AdMuse coordinates skill routing, multi-candidate ideation and selection, and VLM-guided visual refinement: diverse skills propose alternative concepts, relative judgment selects the most promising direction, and vision-language feedback helps realize the selected intent in the final image. This design treats advertising creativity as a structured decision process rather than a single prompt-writing step. Experiments across diverse product and brand positionings show that AdMuse produces visually compelling advertisements that faithfully communicate product positioning.

AI.tldr: AdMuse是一个技能引导的多智能体框架，将高质量广告蒸馏为可复用的创意技能库，通过技能路由、多候选构思与选择、VLM引导的视觉精修，生成既吸引注意又能传达产品定位的广告图像。
AI.motivation: 创意广告图像需兼顾吸引注意力与传达产品定位，而"渲染前如何选择有说服力的概念桥梁（conceptual bridge）"是广告生成的关键难点，现有方法依赖孤立示例检索，难以跨域迁移创意策略，且将创意视为单步提示写作，缺乏结构化决策。
AI.method: 1）从高质量广告中蒸馏可复用"创意技能"，将反复出现的桥梁模式抽象为技能库，而非检索孤立样本；2）生成时进行技能路由，由多样技能提出备选概念；3）多候选构思与相对判断选择最优方向；4）VLM引导的视觉精修，将选定意图落实到最终图像。整体将广告创意建模为结构化决策过程。
AI.result: 在多样化产品与品牌定位上的实验表明，AdMuse能生成视觉上具吸引力、且忠实传达产品定位的广告。
AI.conclusion: 将广告创意拆解为技能抽象、路由、候选选择与视觉精修的多智能体结构化流程，可有效提升跨域广告生成的创意质量与定位一致性。

title: Learning Calibrated Confidence for Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary:
Complex information seeking on the Web often requires collecting evidence from multiple documents and reasoning across them, as in multi-hop question answering. Multi-agent systems address such tasks by dividing work among specialized agents, where upstream agents produce intermediate answers and supporting evidence that downstream agents build upon. However, upstream answers vary in correctness, and most systems provide no quantitative signal about it, leaving the downstream agent to judge whether to trust or verify what it receives based solely on the textual evidence.
  In this paper, we propose MASCAL. Each agent learns to produce a correctness probability for its answer by jointly optimizing task performance and confidence calibration in reinforcement learning; the upstream agent passes this probability at handoff, giving the downstream agent a quantitative basis for its decisions, and the final answer also carries a calibrated probability, quantifying the reliability of the system output. To guide the downstream agent in using this signal during training, we introduce confidence-aware weighting, which increases the learning weight at positions responsive to the upstream probability, so that the agent learns more from decisions where it actively uses the signal. Across three collaboration architectures spanning Web retrieval and reasoning tasks, MASCAL improves task accuracy and calibration quality for both agents, and generalizes to deeper collaboration chains and different model scales. Intervention analysis confirms that upstream confidence affects downstream decision behavior, and the learned final confidence supports selective answering and targeted rechecking.

AI.tldr: MASCAL让多智能体系统中的每个智能体在强化学习中联合优化任务性能与置信度校准，输出答案的"正确概率"并在交接时传递，配合置信度感知加权训练下游智能体，从而提升多跳问答等任务上的准确率与校准质量。
AI.motivation: 复杂信息检索（如多跳问答）需跨多文档收集证据并推理，多智能体系统通过分工协作处理此类任务，上游智能体产出中间答案与证据供下游依赖。但上游答案正确性参差不齐，多数系统不提供量化信号，下游只能凭文本证据自行判断是否信任或核验，缺乏可靠依据。
AI.method: 提出MASCAL：每个智能体在强化学习中联合优化任务表现与置信度校准，学习为自身答案输出正确概率；上游在交接时传递该概率，为下游决策提供定量依据，最终答案也附带校准概率。训练中引入置信度感知加权（confidence-aware weighting），提高对上游概率敏感位置的学习权重，使智能体更充分地学习主动使用该信号的决策。
AI.result: 在覆盖Web检索与推理任务的三类协作架构上，MASCAL同时提升双方智能体的任务准确率与校准质量；并可泛化到更深的协作链与不同模型规模。干预分析证实上游置信度确实影响下游决策行为，学到的最终置信度可支持选择性作答与针对性复查。
AI.conclusion: 通过将校准的正确性概率作为智能体间交接的量化信号，并辅以置信度感知加权训练，MASCAL有效增强了多智能体信息检索系统的可靠性与可解释性，为选择性作答和复核提供了可用的置信度依据。

title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Video generation is shifting from end-to-end synthesis toward agentic generation, where planning, tool use, and feedback enable coherent, controllable multi-shot videos. In parallel, video world models provide action-conditioned observations and predicted futures, serving as interactive environments for agents. We study their intersection through the agent harness: an executable runtime that constructs context, exposes tools, maintains state, routes feedback, and manages budgets around video models. This report examines three directions. First, agentic video generation, where harnesses coordinate scripting, shot planning, asset management, production, and editing, alongside the evaluation challenges of these systems. Second, agentic world modeling, where harnesses mediate observation, control, execution, and state. We discuss hybrid designs in which game engines or agent-written programs maintain world state while video models render observations, and how agents and world models can mutually evaluate and improve one another. Third, recursive self-improvement (RSI) in video model development, distinguishing output revisions, updates to harness state, generator parameters, and evaluators, and changes to the improvement procedure itself. We identify how these improvements feed back into subsequent development. Across these directions, we analyze essential agent capabilities, including audiovisual perception, long-horizon planning, memory, code-based interaction, feedback-guided control, skill reuse, and multi-agent coordination. We conclude with challenges in autonomous video production, lifelong memory, programmable hybrid control, autonomous model development, provenance, cost accounting, and evaluation linking video quality and task performance to sustained improvements in models and harnesses.

AI.tldr: 本文以"智能体运行框架（harness）"为统一视角，系统考察视频生成与视频世界模型的交汇，提出智能体视频生成、智能体世界建模、视频模型开发中的递归自我改进三条方向，并总结关键智能体能力与开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 视频生成正从端到端合成转向规划、工具调用与反馈驱动的智能体式生成；同时视频世界模型可作为智能体的交互环境。二者缺乏统一的分析框架，本文旨在通过harness这一可执行运行时概念将二者联系起来。
AI.method: 概念性综述/立场报告，不涉及具体模型实验。以harness（负责构建上下文、暴露工具、维护状态、路由反馈、管理预算）为核心抽象，沿三条方向展开分析，并归纳跨方向的智能体能力与挑战。
AI.result: 给出三方向的分析框架：（1）智能体视频生成中harness协调脚本、分镜规划、资产管理、制作与剪辑，并讨论其评估难题；（2）智能体世界建模中harness中介观测、控制、执行与状态，提出游戏引擎或智能体编写程序维护世界状态、视频模型渲染观测的混合设计，以及智能体与世界模型互相评估改进；（3）视频模型开发中的RSI，区分输出修订、harness状态更新、生成器参数更新、评估器更新与改进流程本身的变更。
AI.conclusion: 跨方向总结音视频感知、长程规划、记忆、代码交互、反馈引导控制、技能复用与多智能体协作等关键能力；指出自主视频制作、终身记忆、可编程混合控制、自主模型开发、溯源、成本核算，以及将视频质量与任务表现关联到模型与harness持续改进的评估等开放挑战。

title: Low-Bit GDN Recurrent-State Quantization: Global Gradient-aware Allocation and Pure-Write Sliding Windows
summary: Linear attention stores historical information in a recurrent state of fixed size, providing a compact memory representation for long-context inference. Reducing state precision further lowers per-request storage requirements, but quantized writeback errors enter subsequent recurrences, degrade prediction quality on long-reasoning tasks, and can be accompanied by repetitive generation and excessively long outputs. We propose Global Gradient-aware Allocation (GGA) and the Pure-Write Sliding Window (PW) to address precision allocation and recent-information maintenance. GGA combines candidate quantization residuals with gradient sensitivity to future prediction loss to allocate head bit widths under a model-wide mixed-precision budget. PW independently maintains recent pure writes as FP8 vector pairs, propagates them through the full GDN state transition, and merges them into the low-bit historical state only after they leave the window. Across seven evaluations on Qwen3.5-4B/9B, GGA allocation alone improves over STEPQuant@4 by 19.48/29.84 percentage points. Adding PW-S8 yields seven-task macro-averages of 69.83%/78.63%, improving over STEPQuant@4 by 38.39/41.21 percentage points, respectively. Both precision reallocation and window maintenance improve task scores while mitigating excessively long outputs: at @6, GGA reduces mean generation length, averaged equally across tasks, by 10.45%/14.65% relative to STEPQuant; adding PW-S8 to GGA@4 further reduces mean generation length by 32.32%/36.77%. Comparisons at similar storage budgets further show that using additional capacity to maintain recent writes yields higher task scores and shorter mean outputs than solely increasing the bit width of the accumulated state.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对线性注意力定点尺寸循环状态在低精度量化下的写入回写误差累积问题，提出GGA（全局梯度感知分配）与PW（纯写滑动窗口）两种机制，在模型级混合精度预算下显著提升长推理任务分数并抑制超长输出。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力以固定大小循环状态存储历史信息以支持长上下文推理，降低状态精度可减少单请求存储开销，但量化写入回传（writeback）误差会进入后续循环，损害长推理任务的预测质量，并伴随重复生成与输出过长问题。核心问题在于"精度如何分配"与"近期信息如何保持"两点未被很好解决。
AI.method: 提出两项技术：1) Global Gradient-aware Allocation (GGA)：将候选量化残差与对未来预测损失的梯度敏感度结合，在模型级混合精度预算约束下为各注意力头分配比特宽度；2) Pure-Write Sliding Window (PW)：独立以FP8向量对形式保留窗口内的近期"纯写入"，使其经完整GDN状态转移传播，仅在离开窗口后才合并进低比特历史状态。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-4B/9B上共七项评测：仅GGA分配相对STEPQuant@4提升19.48/29.84个百分点；加入PW-S8后七任务宏平均达69.83%/78.63%，相对STEPQuant@4提升38.39/41.21个百分点。生成长度方面，@6设置下GGA使等权平均生成长度相对STEPQuant降低10.45%/14.65%；GGA@4再加PW-S8进一步降低32.32%/36.77%。
AI.conclusion: 精度重分配与窗口维护均能在提升任务分数的同时缓解输出过长。相近存储预算下的对比表明：将额外容量用于维护近期写入，比单纯提高累积状态位宽能获得更高任务分数与更短的输出，说明"近期信息的精确保留"比"历史状态的整体提精度"更具性价比。

title: Benchmarking color judgment in multimodal LLMs with CIE-computable ground truth
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are now used as zero-shot judges of image quality, but their color judgments are rarely tested with colorimetric ground truth. We present a five-task benchmark based on the CIE colorimetric framework: AWB pair judgment, skin-tone bias direction, CCT estimation, CIE Delta E 2000 pair ordering, and color naming under changing illuminants. We test eight MLLM endpoints, including four Qwen3-VL variants, GLM-4.5V, GPT-5.4, Claude-Opus-4.7, and Gemini-3.1-Pro. The models often solve coarse binary AWB judgments, but they remain weak on numeric CCT estimation and on some fine color-difference judgments. On ColorChecker-24 stimuli, the three closed-weight frontier models reach CCT MAE of 715-1056 K, compared with 1358-2133 K for the five open-weight models. A non-ColorChecker control shows that this advantage is partly template-dependent. The results suggest that current MLLMs have useful color words and coarse visual priors, but their color judgments are not reliably calibrated to CIE-computable color differences.

AI.tldr: 本文构建基于CIE色度学框架的五任务基准，评估八个MLLM端点的颜色判断能力，发现模型擅长粗粒度二分类AWB判断，但在数值CCT估计与精细色差判别上较弱，且颜色判断未可靠校准到CIE可计算的色差。
AI.motivation: MLLM已被用作零样本图像质量评判者，但其颜色判断很少用色度学真值检验，缺乏对其颜色感知可靠性的系统量化评估。
AI.method: 提出五个任务的基准：AWB成对判断、肤色偏色方向、CCT估计、CIE ΔE 2000成对排序、变化光照下的颜色命名；测试八个MLLM端点（四个Qwen3-VL变体、GLM-4.5V、GPT-5.4、Claude-Opus-4.7、Gemini-3.1-Pro），并设置非ColorChecker对照以检验模板依赖性。
AI.result: 模型通常能完成粗粒度二分类AWB判断，但在数值CCT估计和部分精细色差判断上表现较弱；在ColorChecker-24刺激上，三个闭源前沿模型CCT MAE为715–1056 K，五个开源模型为1358–2133 K；非ColorChecker对照显示该优势部分依赖模板。
AI.conclusion: 当前MLLM具备可用的颜色词汇与粗粒度视觉先验，但其颜色判断并未可靠校准到CIE可计算的色差，作为图像质量零样本评判者存在局限。

title: H$^2$R: Hierarchical Hint-Based Reward for Mathematical Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards has shown great promise in enhancing mathematical reasoning in large language models. However, existing approaches provide limited intermediate supervision for complex, multi-step reasoning tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{Hierarchical Hint-based Reward}, a framework that leverages the intrinsic sub-question structure of mathematical problems as structured intermediate conditioning signals during RLVR training. Unlike chain-of-thought prompting, these hierarchical hints serve as logically grounded intermediate milestones that effectively reduce the reasoning horizon toward the final answer. To validate this framework, we introduce \textbf{HiMath}, a benchmark of hierarchically structured mathematical problems. Across diverse LLMs, hierarchical hints consistently improve reasoning performance even without task-specific training. When integrated into RL training via H$^2$R, they boost Qwen2.5-Math-7B accuracy on HiMath from 30.4\% to 39.1\% using hierarchical hints, and up to 45.6\% with Oracle Hierarchical Hints. This pronounced improvement demonstrates that incorporating reliable intermediate checkpoints into reward design is essential for sustaining complex mathematical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出 Hierarchical Hint-based Reward（H²R）框架，利用数学题内在的子问题结构作为结构化中间条件信号用于 RLVR 训练，并构建分层结构化数学基准 HiMath；将分层提示融入 RL 训练后，Qwen2.5-Math-7B 在 HiMath 上的准确率从 30.4% 提升至 39.1%（使用 Oracle 分层提示可达 45.6%）。
AI.motivation: 现有 RLVR 方法对复杂多步数学推理缺乏充分的中间过程监督，难以提供细粒度的阶段性指导，导致长程推理中的信用分配困难。
AI.method: 1）提出 Hierarchical Hint-based Reward：借助数学问题固有的子问题层级结构，作为逻辑上合理的中间里程碑（而非链式思维提示），以缩短通向最终答案的推理跨度；2）构建 HiMath 基准，由分层结构化的数学问题组成；3）将分层提示作为结构化中间条件信号集成进 H²R 的奖励设计与 RL 训练流程。
AI.result: 在多种 LLM 上，分层提示即使未经任务特定训练也能持续提升推理表现；经 H²R 集成进 RL 训练后，Qwen2.5-Math-7B 在 HiMath 上的准确率由 30.4% 提升至 39.1%（分层提示），使用 Oracle Hierarchical Hints 时进一步升至 45.6%。
AI.conclusion: 将可靠的中间检查点纳入奖励设计，对于维持复杂数学推理能力至关重要；分层子问题结构可作为有效的中间监督信号，显著缓解 RLVR 的中间监督不足问题。

title: TaskFrame: Connecting Task-Level Planning with Frame-Level Control for Game Agents
summary: Building general game agents requires both high-level task reasoning and low-latency action control in rapidly changing visual environments. These capabilities favor models with substantially different computational profiles, making them difficult to realize within a single model. In this work, we present TaskFrame, a hierarchical planner-controller framework that connects task-level planning with frame-level keyboard-and-mouse control. A vision-language task planner decomposes a high-level goal into an ordered sequence of atomic instructions and is optimized through supervised learning and dependency-aware GRPO. The hidden states of special goal tokens that terminate each atomic instruction provide continuous goal embeddings that are cached and reused across control steps. A causal Transformer controller combines the embedding of the active goal with recent observations to predict discrete keyboard and mouse-button actions and continuous camera motion at every game step. We train the system in three stages: planner training, controller pretraining, and joint alignment. Experiments in Minecraft show that TaskFrame is competitive with general-purpose vision-language models on instruction decomposition, and that in closed-loop evaluation the agent achieves a higher combat success rate than the evaluated baselines.

AI.tldr: TaskFrame：分层"规划器-控制器"框架，将高层任务规划与帧级键鼠控制解耦为两个计算profile不同的模型并联合训练，在Minecraft中指令分解媲美通用VLM，闭环战斗成功率超过基线。
AI.motivation: 通用游戏智能体需同时具备快速变化视觉环境下的高层任务推理与低延迟动作控制，二者所需计算特性差异大，难以在单一模型中兼顾。
AI.method: 层级规划器-控制器：VLM任务规划器将高层目标分解为有序原子指令序列，经监督学习与依赖感知GRPO优化；终止每条原子指令的特殊goal token隐状态作为连续目标嵌入，被缓存并在多个控制步复用；因果Transformer控制器将当前目标嵌入与近期观测结合，逐步预测离散键盘/鼠标按键与连续相机运动。三阶段训练：规划器训练、控制器预训练、联合对齐。
AI.result: Minecraft实验显示，指令分解能力与通用VLM相当；闭环评估中战斗成功率高于所评估的基线。
AI.conclusion: 以"语义目标嵌入"为接口解耦规划与控制的三阶段分层框架，可在保持低延迟的同时获得强任务推理，是构建通用游戏智能体的可行范式。

title: When to spend privacy: optimal allocation in private learning
summary: Privacy accounting bounds the cumulative privacy cost of Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent but does not determine how to allocate a fixed budget across iterations. We formulate the complete Gaussian noise-variance schedule as an open-loop control under a composed zero-Concentrated Differential Privacy constraint, explicitly accounting for schedule selection. For expected quadratic terminal tracking, we prove that every local minimizer exhausts the certified budget, yielding an exact-budget simplex formulation. We introduce Privacy-Budget Adjoint Mirror Descent (PB-AMD), combining pathwise adjoint gradients with entropic updates that preserve positivity, charge floors, and the prescribed budget. Under regularity and coercivity assumptions, we establish existence and budget stability of optimal schedules, design-to-training utility stability, and deterministic, stochastic, and sample-average stationarity guarantees. A linear-quadratic reduction yields an explicit square-root allocation law. Experiments demonstrate tracking improvements over several allocation rules and predictive improvements over uniform allocation in a learning-rate restart setting, where learning-rate allocation performs similarly. Comparisons at a common stationarity tolerance show lower schedule-optimization times than projected gradient descent on the tested problems. The framework connects certified privacy accounting with optimization through nonlinear training dynamics.

AI.tldr: 将差分隐私SGD的完整高斯噪声方差调度建模为组合zCDP约束下的开环控制问题，证明最优解必然用尽隐私预算并给出精确预算单纯形形式，提出隐私预算伴随镜像下降（PB-AMD）求解，得到平方根分配律及理论与实验保证。
AI.motivation: 隐私会计只给出累计隐私代价的上界，却不回答如何在固定预算下跨迭代分配噪声/学习率，缺乏将认证隐私会计与训练动力学优化连接起来的原理性方法。
AI.method: 在组合零集中差分隐私（zCDP）约束下把高斯噪声方差调度表述为开环控制问题，显式纳入调度选择；对期望二次终端跟踪目标证明每个局部极小点都耗尽认证预算，从而化为精确预算单纯形问题；提出PB-AMD，将路径伴随梯度与保正性、收费下限及预算约束的熵式镜像更新结合；在线性二次简化下导出显式平方根分配律。
AI.result: 在正则性与强制性假设下证明最优调度的存在性与预算稳定性、设计到训练的效用稳定性，以及确定性、随机与样本平均意义下的平稳性保证；实验中跟踪性能优于多种分配规则，在学习率重启动设置下预测性能优于均匀分配（学习率分配效果相近），并在共同平稳性容差下相比投影梯度下降具有更低调度优化时间。
AI.conclusion: 该框架经由非线性训练动力学把认证隐私会计与优化相连接，为固定隐私预算下的调度设计提供了原理化、可证明且计算高效的途径。

title: LoRe-MIM: Lost-or-Replaced Masked Image Modeling for Self-Supervised Representation Learning in Whole-Body PET/CT
summary: Deep learning models for whole-body positron emission tomography/computed tomography (PET/CT) hold significant clinical potential for disease detection, treatment planning, and response assessment. However, the time and cost associated with expert annotations remain major bottlenecks in developing robust and generalizable models. Although self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a promising approach to mitigating annotation scarcity, its application to whole-body PET/CT remains relatively underexplored due to the limited availability of large-scale datasets and the challenges associated with learning complementary cross-modal representations. To address these limitations, we curate a heterogeneous, multi-tracer, multi-institutional cohort comprising 6,531 whole-body PET/CT scans and propose LoRe-MIM (Lost-Or-Replaced Masked Image Modelling), a novel self-supervised framework designed to learn multimodal representations through masked image reconstruction. Specifically, LoRe-MIM introduces a masking strategy in which image regions are either replaced with zeros (Lost) or substituted with corresponding complementary imaging modality (Replaced), encouraging the model to capture both modality-specific characteristics and cross-modal relationships. We evaluate the learned representations across multiple downstream tasks, including multimodal PET/CT image reconstruction, patch-based classification into cancer vs. non-cancer, whole-body lesion segmentation, label-efficient training, and robustness assessment. Experimental results demonstrate that LoRe-MIM consistently outperforms the corresponding state-of-the-art baselines across these tasks, highlighting its potential as a scalable and generalizable self-supervised learning framework for whole-body PET/CT analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出LoRe-MIM自监督框架，通过"丢失或替换"(零值丢失/模态替换)的掩码图像重建学习全身PET/CT跨模态表征，在多项下游任务上优于SOTA基线。
AI.motivation: 全身PET/CT深度学习在疾病检测、治疗规划与疗效评估中潜力巨大，但专家标注耗时昂贵成为瓶颈；自监督学习虽可缓解标注稀缺，却因大规模数据匮乏和跨模态互补表征学习困难而在全身PET/CT领域探索不足。
AI.method: 构建含6,531例全身PET/CT扫描的异质、多示踪剂、多机构队列；提出LoRe-MIM自监督框架，采用掩码图像重建，被掩区域或置零("Lost")或替换为对应互补模态("Replaced")，促使模型同时捕获模态特有特征与跨模态关系。
AI.result: 在多模态PET/CT图像重建、patch级癌症/非癌症分类、全身病灶分割、标签高效训练及鲁棒性评估等下游任务中，LoRe-MIM均持续优于相应的最先进基线。
AI.conclusion: LoRe-MIM是一种可扩展、可泛化的全身PET/CT自监督学习框架，能有效缓解标注瓶颈并提升多任务表征质量。

title: Observability-Aligned Evidential Masked Pretraining for Reliable VRU Motion Prediction
summary: Vulnerable road user (VRU) prediction must operate under partial observability and distribution shift, so reliable uncertainty matters alongside accuracy. Masked pretraining is attractive in this setting because it naturally exposes the model to missing content during self-supervision, but existing time-series masked autoencoding methods are typically deterministic and do not constrain how confidence should change with observability. We introduce eCoMAE, an evidential masked pretraining method for multivariate time series that explicitly aligns predictive evidence with what is observed. eCoMAE combines block-wise time-step masking with a Normal-Inverse-Gamma decoder and three observability-aware mechanisms: uncertainty-weighted mean consistency on positions visible in both a masked view and a reference pass, evidence suppression on masked positions, and representation consistency across stochastic masks. On IMPTC benchmark for VRU intention prediction under leave-one-environment-out weather shift, eCoMAE improves the strongest baseline from 0.7971 to 0.8068 in OOD accuracy and from 0.0718 to 0.0648 in OOD AURC. Additional evaluation on pedestrian trajectory forecasting across IMPTC, Waymo, nuScenes, and inD further yields the best fine-tuning MSE on all four datasets. These results show that observability-aligned evidential pretraining improves reliability under shift and remains effective beyond the primary benchmark.

AI.tldr: 提出eCoMAE——一种面向多元时间序列的证据式掩码预训练方法，通过对齐预测证据与可观测性提升分布偏移下的不确定性可靠性。
AI.motivation: 脆弱道路使用者（VRU）预测需在部分可观测与分布偏移条件下运行，除精度外还需可靠的不确定性；掩码预训练天然暴露缺失内容，但现有时序掩码自编码方法多为确定性，且未约束置信度应随可观测性变化。
AI.method: eCoMAE将块状时间步掩码与Normal-Inverse-Gamma解码器结合，并设计三种可观测性感知机制：(1)在掩码视图与参考前向均可见位置上施加不确定性加权均值一致性；(2)对掩码位置进行证据抑制；(3)跨随机掩码的表示一致性。
AI.result: 在IMPTC基准的留一环境出（天气偏移）VRU意图预测任务上，OOD精度由最强基线的0.7971提升至0.8068，OOD AURC由0.0718降至0.0648；在IMPTC、Waymo、nuScenes、inD四个数据集的行人轨迹预测上均取得最优微调MSE。
AI.conclusion: 可观测性对齐的证据式预训练能提升分布偏移下的可靠性，并在主基准之外保持有效性。

title: Self-training for cross-centre coronary vessel segmentation in X-ray angiography using pre-contrast frame subtraction
summary: Deep learning models for coronary vessel segmentation in X-ray angiography often perform poorly on data from centres that were not represented in training. Apart from differences in equipment, the labels of the largest public dataset (ARCADE) are incomplete, as only the segments defined in the SYNTAX score are annotated. In this study, we evaluated whether self-training with pseudo-labels can improve performance on external data without additional manual annotation. Pseudo-labels were generated from two sources, namely the predictions of an nnU-Net model trained on ARCADE and a contrast map obtained by subtracting a pre-contrast frame from the same sequence. The nnU-Net predictions were extended along the contrast map, and pixels detected only in the subtraction image were assigned an ignore label and excluded from the loss. Six models were trained and tested on ARCADE and on two external datasets (XCAD and XACV). All first-round models initialised with the baseline predictions performed better than both the baseline and a control model fine-tuned for the same number of epochs. The model trained on the XCAD pool improved the macro-averaged Dice score by 2.7 points (95% CI 2.3-3.2), while the control decreased it by 0.6 points.
