AI.conclusion: 以潜在3D高斯记忆替代随时间增长的时间上下文/显式3D记忆，并通过潜在空间直渲消除重编码瓶颈，可在保证一致性与质量的同时实现实时交互式世界生成。

title: Your LR Schedule May Not Be Principled: Effective Learning Rate Scheduling in Weight-Normalized Training
summary: Weight-normalized (WN) training is emerging as a compelling alternative to conventional weight decay (WD), with recent studies reporting substantial pretraining loss gains. We show that these gains are driven primarily by the induced effective learning rate (ELR) trajectory rather than by normalization alone. Matching ELR trajectories largely collapses the training loss dynamics of WN and WD. Schedule design should therefore target ELR rather than the nominal learning rate (LR) alone. Building on this principle, we propose AIR (Affine Inverse-square-Root decay), which combines a theoretically derived $1/\sqrt{t}$ decay with an affine adjustment to satisfy prescribed peak and terminal LRs over a finite training horizon. We further identify late-stage ELR scheduling as a key source of its gains, because a shared late schedule attenuates the effect of earlier LR choices. Experiments on 128 B-token Mixture-of-Experts pretraining demonstrate that AIR outperforms cosine and other candidate schedules in training loss, downstream performance, and hyperparameter robustness, reducing terminal training loss by approximately 0.01 relative to cosine at matched cumulative LR. Applying the same ELR trajectory to WD reproduces the corresponding training dynamics, showing that the benefits extend beyond fixed-norm training and establishing ELR as the principled scheduling object.

AI.tldr: WN与WD的预训练收益主要由有效学习率(ELR)轨迹驱动而非归一化本身；据此提出以ELR为调度目标、结合1/√t衰减与仿射调整的AIR调度器，在128B token MoE预训练中显著优于余弦等调度。
AI.motivation: 近期研究报道权重归一化(WN)相对权重衰减(WD)带来显著预训练损失收益，但收益来源未被厘清。作者质疑"归一化本身"是主因，认为需要识别真正的驱动因素，并据此改进学习率调度设计。
AI.method: 1) 通过匹配WN与WD的有效学习率(ELR)轨迹，验证损失动力学的重合程度；2) 提出AIR(Affine Inverse-square-Root decay)调度：理论推导的1/√t衰减叠加仿射调整，以满足有限训练周期内指定的峰值与终端学习率；3) 分析晚期ELR调度对早期LR选择的遮蔽效应；4) 将同一ELR轨迹施加于WD以验证可迁移性。
AI.result: 匹配ELR轨迹后WN与WD的训练损失动力学基本塌缩一致；在128B token MoE预训练中，AIR在训练损失、下游性能与超参鲁棒性上优于余弦及其他候选调度，在匹配累积学习率条件下终端训练损失较余弦降低约0.01；将相同ELR轨迹用于WD可复现对应训练动力学。
AI.conclusion: WN的收益主要由诱导的有效学习率轨迹而非归一化本身决定，ELR才是原则性的调度对象；调度设计应面向ELR而非名义LR，AIR提供了一条理论上可解释、实践上更优且对超参更稳健的实现路径，其收益不限于固定范数训练。

title: Difficulty Calibration Across Time for Membership Inference in Diffusion Models
summary: Modern diffusion models are trained on massive datasets that often include copyrighted or private images. Membership inference attacks (MIAs) address this by testing whether a given image was in a model's training set. The standard approach scores an image by its reconstruction loss and flags low-loss images as members. This often fails because some images are simply easier to reconstruct than others, so a simple unseen image can score a lower loss than a complex training image. Difficulty calibration separates memorization from how difficult an image is to begin with. We show how to calibrate along two axes of time: training time and diffusion time. First, across training time, we introduce Reference-Model Calibration (RMC), which compares a fine-tuned model's loss against an earlier checkpoint. This cleanly isolates newly memorized data and gives near-perfect auditing, even without text captions. Since earlier checkpoints are not always available, we next present Temporal Self-Calibration (TSC), which calibrates across diffusion time using only a single model. Our key observation is that an image's difficulty persists across noise levels, whereas memorization is localized in time. By comparing the loss at a target timestep against neighboring timesteps from the same model, TSC attenuates image difficulty using the model's own trajectory. Empirically, our methods beat the state of the art by a wide margin, and unlike most existing attacks, generalize across different model parameterizations such as $x$-, $v$-, and $ε$-prediction models. Code is available at https://github.com/MichaelJoseph777/TSC.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对扩散模型成员推断攻击（MIA）中"重建损失受图像固有难度干扰"的问题，提出沿训练时间与扩散时间两个轴进行难度校准的RMC与TSC方法，显著超越现有SOTA并跨参数化泛化。
AI.motivation: 现代扩散模型在含版权或隐私图像的大规模数据上训练，需要MIA检验某图像是否属于训练集。标准方法以重建损失打分、低损失判为成员，但图像本身难易程度不同，简单未见图像可能比复杂训练图像损失更低，导致误判。需要将"记忆"与"图像固有难度"分离。
AI.method: 沿两个时间轴做难度校准：(1) 训练时间轴——Reference-Model Calibration (RMC)，将微调模型的损失与早期检查点比较，隔离新近记忆的数据，无需文本caption即可近乎完美的审计；(2) 扩散时间轴——Temporal Self-Calibration (TSC)，仅用单一模型，利用"图像难度跨噪声水平持续存在、而记忆在时间上局部化"的观察，将目标时间步的损失与同一模型邻近时间步损失比较，用模型自身轨迹衰减图像难度。
AI.result: 实验中两种方法大幅超越现有最优方法；与多数现有攻击不同，可泛化到x-、v-、ε-prediction等不同模型参数化形式。
AI.conclusion: 通过沿训练时间（RMC）与扩散时间（TSC）双轴进行难度校准，可有效分离记忆信号与图像固有难度，实现高精度且跨参数化通用的扩散模型成员推断攻击；代码已开源。

title: Is It the Curriculum or Just the Easy Start? Benchmarking Unsupervised Environment Design on Quadrupeds
comment: 22 pages, 10 figures. Code, level space and evaluation suite: https://github.com/Solvro/ml-wojtek-ued
summary: Unsupervised environment design (UED) methods such as PLR, ACCEL, SFL and PAIRED are compared mostly on 2D mazes, grid worlds and BipedalWalker, while terrain curricula for legged robots are hand-designed and evaluated against a few baselines. We present a benchmark that runs fourteen UED, domain-randomisation and robotics curricula under one protocol on five 3D quadrupeds in MuJoCo MJX: the closed-chain W01-TEK and the open-chain Unitree Go1 and Go2, Google Barkour vB and Boston Dynamics Spot. Levels are vectors of eight interpretable terrain parameters, and all curricula drive the same PPO student at matched environment-step budgets. The evaluation reports success on random and held-out structured terrains, interquartile means with stratified bootstrap intervals, capability envelopes and a level-by-level domination comparison. We compare methods within each robot and report, per level set, the top group of methods not significantly below the best. No method is in the top group on every robot and level set. Methods with easy or low-difficulty training levels, curated or not, fill the top groups on in-distribution random levels of Go1 and Barkour, and of W01-TEK apart from PAIRED+BiBC. The success-driven terrain curriculum from legged-robot practice is in a top group most often, domain randomisation on uniform levels in none, and PAIRED in none outside Spot, where the fourteen methods lie within 3.8 points on random levels of difficulty 0.25. On three robots the leader on in-distribution random levels is not the leader on held-out terrain. We collect the results into a per-robot guide to choosing a curriculum.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一基准，在MuJoCo MJX的五个3D四足机器人上以同一协议比较14种无监督环境设计(UED)、域随机化与机器人课程方法，并给出按机器人的课程选择指南。
AI.motivation: 现有UED方法(PLR、ACCEL、SFL、PAIRED等)多只在2D迷宫、网格世界和BipedalWalker上比较，而腿足机器人地形课程在实践中靠手工设计、仅与少量基线对照，缺乏严格、可复现的横向评测。
AI.method: 构建统一基准：五种四足机器人(闭链W01-TEK，开链Unitree Go1、Go2，Google Barkour vB，Boston Dynamics Spot)；关卡表示为8维可解释地形参数向量；14种课程在相同环境步数预算下驱动同一个PPO学生；评估包括随机地形与留出结构化地形成功率、四分位均值及分层bootstrap区间、能力包络、逐关卡支配比较，并按关卡集报告"不显著劣于最优"的顶级方法组。
AI.result: 没有任何方法在所有机器人和关卡集上都处于顶级组。含简单/低难度训练关卡的方法(无论是否精选)在Go1、Barkour以及W01-TEK(除PAIRED+BiBC外)的分布内随机关卡上占据顶级组；腿足机器人实践中的成功率驱动地形课程最常进入顶级组，均匀关卡上的域随机化从未进入，PAIRED除Spot外也从未进入；在Spot难度0.25随机关卡上14种方法差距在3.8个百分点内。三个机器人上，分布内随机关卡的领先者并非留出地形上的领先者。
AI.conclusion: 分布内表现不足以代表泛化能力，课程选择应结合留出结构化地形评估；作者将结果整理为按机器人选择课程的指南。

title: Probing Spatial State Representations in Visual Foundation Models
summary: An observer sees only part of the surrounding world, yet must keep track of what lies beyond the current view. Spatial perception therefore involves more than recognizing individual images: it calls for a persistent spatial state that is updated under self-motion and used to guide action. Do visual foundation models provide representations that support such a state? We study this question through four levels of spatial capability---spatial structure, object persistence, predictive spatial update, and actionability---using frozen-feature probes on ten representations under streaming egocentric observations of static indoor environments. The resulting capability profiles vary across tasks, network layers, and prefix lengths: strong readout of the visible scene does not ensure accurate object persistence or future-feature retrieval. Matched controls separate readout accuracy from reliance on visual history and motion. Native future prediction retains recoverable spatial structure, but a spatial reader trained on real features does not transfer to predicted features unchanged. Finally, goal-dependent candidate selection does not establish reliable continuous action utility: predicted actions respond to goal changes, yet supplying the correct goal does not reliably improve progress. Across the four levels, object persistence and actionability build on camera-pose readout, whereas feature prediction builds on visible-scene readout. Together, these findings motivate evaluating spatial representations not only by what can be decoded from them, but by whether that information is maintained beyond observation, updated predictively, and used for goal-directed action.

AI.tldr: 该文在流式第一人称室内观测下，用冻结特征探针系统评估十种表征的四个层级空间能力（空间结构、物体持续性、预测性空间更新、可操作性），揭示"可读出"不等于"可维持、可预测、可行动"。
AI.motivation: 观察者只能看到部分世界，却需追踪视野之外的信息，因此空间感知要求一个在自运动下更新、并指导行动的持续空间状态。作者追问：视觉基础模型是否提供了支持这种空间状态的表征。现有评估多只考察可从特征中解码什么，忽视信息是否被维持、预测性更新和用于目标导向行动。
AI.method: 在静态室内环境的流式第一人称观测下，对十种表征（冻结特征）进行四层级探针评测：空间结构、物体持续性、预测性空间更新、可操作性；并设计匹配对照，将读出准确性与对视觉历史、运动的依赖分离；同时测试原生未来预测特征的可迁移性，以及依赖目标的多候选选择能否带来连续行动效用。
AI.result: 能力画像随任务、网络层与视线前缀长度而显著变化：可见场景的强读出并不能保证准确的物体持续性或未来特征检索。原生未来预测保留了可恢复的空间结构，但在真实特征上训练的空间读取器无法原样迁移到预测特征。预测动作能响应目标变化，但提供正确目标并不能可靠提升推进效果。物体持续性与可操作性与相机位姿读出相关，而特征预测则建立在可见场景读出之上。
AI.conclusion: 空间表征的评估不应只看"能解码出什么"，还应看该信息能否在观测之外被维持、被预测性更新，并用于目标导向行动。

title: Composing and Steering Diffusion Models with Generalized Feynman-Kac Correctors
summary: Diffusion models have become the leading paradigm in generative modeling, yet many applications require sampling from distributions that are not those of any single pretrained model, but are instead defined through combinations of several models, possibly tilted toward high values of a downstream reward. Naively combining the scores of the models yields incorrect samples, while existing corrections are restricted to specific families of targets. In this work, we introduce the generalized Feynman-Kac correctors (GFKC), a principled framework for sampling from an arbitrary target function of several pretrained diffusion models. We show that the geometric interpolation between an arbitrary initial function and the target function of the models satisfies a Feynman--Kac partial differential equation, and derive its potential in closed form. To evaluate this potential during generation, we further generalize the log-probability ODE to track the density of each model along trajectories driven by a different velocity field. The resulting algorithm operates entirely in the log domain, incorporates reward-based steering at no additional conceptual cost, and corrects the generation on the fly, without retraining or fine-tuning the models. We validate the method on analytic Gaussian models, where it closely matches the ground-truth targets, and on diffusion models trained on MNIST, where it samples from non-trivial combinations of the models and enables effective steering.

AI.tldr: 提出广义Feynman–Kac校正器（GFKC），可对多个预训练扩散模型构成的任意目标函数（含奖励加权）进行采样，无需重训或微调。
AI.motivation: 许多应用需要从多个预训练模型组合得到的分布中采样（可能还带下游奖励倾斜），而简单地将各模型分数相加会产生错误样本，现有校正方法又仅适用于特定目标族。
AI.method: 证明任意初始函数与模型目标函数之间的几何插值满足Feynman–Kac偏微分方程，并给出势函数的闭式解；进一步推广对数概率ODE，使其能在由不同速度场驱动的轨迹上追踪每个模型的密度，从而在生成过程中实时计算该势函数。算法完全在对数域中进行，可无额外概念成本地加入奖励引导，并在生成时在线校正，无需重训练或微调。
AI.result: 在解析高斯模型上与真值目标高度吻合；在MNIST训练的扩散模型上，能够从模型的非平凡组合中采样，并实现有效的奖励引导。
AI.conclusion: GFKC为组合式与奖励引导的扩散采样提供了有原则的统一框架，且具即插即用优势。

title: SonoWorld4D: From One Video to a 4D Audio-Visual Scene via Diffusion Synchronization
summary: Recent progress in visual scene generation has extended beyond static 3D scenes toward the more challenging problem of generating dynamic 4D scenes from minimal input. However, sound, despite being intrinsically coupled with dynamic objects and events, remains largely unmodeled in prior work. We introduce Video-to-4DAVScene, a new task that turns a video into an explorable, time-varying 4D audio-visual scene, and present the SonoWorld4D framework for this task. Given a monocular video, our method generates a 360 static background, reconstructs explicit motion trajectories of dynamic, sound-emitting foreground objects, and synthesizes a physically-grounded sound field consistent across multiple sources through dual-space audio diffusion synchronization. The resulting 4D scene supports real-time novel-view visual and spatial audio rendering. Evaluation on real-world dynamic scenes and a user study demonstrates SonoWorld4D generates 4D audio-visual scenes with perceptually realistic, physically grounded spatial audio consistent with scene geometry and visual content.

AI.tldr: 提出新任务 Video-to-4DAVScene（单目视频生成可探索的时变 4D 视听场景）及框架 SonoWorld4D，联合建模 4D 视觉与空间音频，支持实时新视角视觉与空间音频渲染。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉场景生成已从静态 3D 发展到由极少输入生成动态 4D 场景，但声音虽与动态物体和事件内在耦合，却在大规模上未被建模，导致生成的 4D 场景缺乏物理一致的空间音频。
AI.method: 输入单目视频：生成 360° 静态背景；重建发声前景动态物体的显式运动轨迹；通过双空间音频扩散同步（dual-space audio diffusion synchronization）合成跨多声源、物理合理的声场。
AI.result: 在真实动态场景上的评测与用户研究表明，SonoWorld4D 生成的 4D 视听场景具有感知真实、物理合理、且与场景几何和视觉内容一致的空间音频，并支持实时新视角视听渲染。
AI.conclusion: 将空间音频纳入 4D 场景生成是可行且有效的，为从视频构建可探索、视听一致的动态 4D 场景提供了新任务定义与基线框架。

title: SCARL: Sequence Confidence-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves language-model reasoning by scoring sampled responses with a rule-based verifier and reinforcing those that pass. Where a classifier's training couples predicted probability to labels, nothing ties an RLVR policy's confidence in a response to its reward: aligned training would drive responses with the same advantage toward equal confidence, yet the advantage is blind to confidence. Under this sequence-confidence misalignment, a success the policy barely found earns the same update as one it produces with near certainty, and a confident error is corrected no harder than an exploratory one. We propose SCARL (Sequence Confidence-Aligned Reinforcement Learning), which reshapes, but never re-signs, each advantage with the alignment gap between the response's group-relative confidence and the outcome its advantage certifies, normalized into shares of each class's advantage budget. Misaligned samples absorb the force, responses with the same advantage are driven toward equal confidence, and repairing the misalignment doubles as a remedy for the entropy collapse that erodes exploration. SCARL provably reduces to its base estimator when a class's confidences agree, adds no extra passes and one hyperparameter. On Qwen3-4B-Base it lifts average Pass@32 by 2.4 points over DAPO and is best among nine compute-matched methods on both coverage and per-draw accuracy; applied unchanged across four estimators and four backbones, it improves 14 of 16 settings while preserving policy entropy and widening the confidence-correctness separation. Our code is available at https://github.com/kezhh163/scarl.

AI.tldr: RLVR 中策略对回答的置信度与其获得的奖励(优势)未对齐，SCARL 通过对优势做序列置信度对齐重加权来缓解该问题，并兼治熵坍缩，在多个估计器与骨干上普遍提升性能。
AI.motivation: RLVR 用规则验证器给采样回答打分并强化通过者，但分类器训练会把预测概率与标签耦合，RLVR 策略的置信度却与奖励完全脱钩：同样优势的回答被推向相同置信度，而优势对置信度无感知。这导致"侥幸成功"与"笃定成功"获得同等更新、自信错误与探索性错误被同等修正，即序列-置信度错位。
AI.method: 提出 SCARL(Sequence Confidence-Aligned Reinforcement Learning)：对每个优势不改变符号、仅按"组内相对置信度"与该优势所认证结果之间的对准差距进行重塑，并归一化为各类别优势预算中的份额；错位样本承担更多更新力度，使同优势回答被推向一致置信度。理论上当某类置信度一致时退化为原估计器；不增加额外前向传播，仅多一个超参数。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-4B-Base 上平均 Pass@32 较 DAPO 提升 2.4 点，在九个等算力方法中覆盖率与单次采样准确率均最优；无需改动即用于四种估计器与四种骨干，16 个设置中 14 个提升，同时保持策略熵并扩大置信度-正确性分离度。
AI.conclusion: 序列-置信度错位是 RLVR 中被忽视的优化偏差来源；以优势重加权方式修复可同时提升性能、维持探索性熵并改善置信度校准，且实现成本极低、可即插即用于现有估计器。

title: Luggage re-identification: A study of strategies towards a real-world application
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at The 2026 IEEE International Conference on Content-Based Multimedia Indexing (IEEE CBMI)
summary: Luggage re-identification (ReID) is a critical task in video surveillance for forensics, security or border management (suspicious or abandoned luggage recognition), as well as luggage management (lost luggage recovery). It enables the association of observations of the same luggage across disjoint camera views in complex environments such as airports, train stations and border crossing. While existing approaches primarily focus on appearance-based cropped image matching under relatively clean conditions, real-world scenarios are characterized by frequent occlusions, cluttered background and crowded scenes which significantly degrade performance. Yet, strategies leveraging the complementarity of multiple shots and views from different video streams is overlooked. In this paper, we study strategies for an end-to-end pipeline that operates from multiple video streams to detect and re-identify luggage. We evaluate different variants on a benchmark dataset acquired in real-world environments to address the questions of selecting and merging different views and shots of the same luggage as well as training on different environment datasets for an overall ReID performance improvement in practical applications.

AI.tldr: 提出面向多路视频流的端到端行李检测与重识别(ReID)流水线，重点研究同一行李多视角/多快照的选择与融合策略，以及在多环境数据集上训练以提升真实场景鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有行李ReID方法多在较干净的条件下基于裁剪图像的外观匹配，而真实场景中的遮挡、杂乱背景与拥挤显著降低性能；同时，利用不同视频流多快照、多视角互补性的策略被忽视。
AI.method: 构建从多路视频流到检测与重识别的端到端流水线，在同一真实环境基准数据集上系统比较不同变体，考察视角与快照的选择与合并方式，以及跨不同环境数据集训练对整体ReID性能的影响。
AI.result: 在真实环境采集的基准数据集上对多种流水线变体进行了评测，给出多视角/多快照选择与融合策略以及跨环境训练对ReID性能的影响分析。
AI.conclusion: 多视角与多快照的互补性利用及跨环境训练是提升真实应用场景下行李ReID实用性能的有效途径。

title: IMPACT: Inverter-Informed Multimodal Learning for Photovoltaic Generation Forecasting
summary: This work develops a physics-informed multimodal deep learning framework for 10- to 110-minute-ahead probabilistic photovoltaic power forecasting. The forecasting model is built on a four-branch architecture that separately encodes plant-level temporal history and inverter-level spatial cloud dynamics through a graph attention encoder with a learned adjacency, known-future solar geometry, and the current meteorological state, fused through gated cross-attention. The geometry branch adds two forward-looking physical signals, spatial cloud heterogeneity and inverter ramp-down activity, each empirically weighted toward the horizon where it is most predictive. The decoder anchors its prediction to a smart persistence baseline, learning a horizon-conditioned correction, and the resulting quantile forecasts are calibrated online through a kernel-weighted adaptive conformal calibration step. The proposed model outperforms all 14 baselines, achieving a forecast skill score (FSS) of 0.2950, 0.099 above the next-best model. A branch-composition ablation shows that every branch contributes positively and the model retains substantial skill in challenging overcast and variable sky conditions (FSS 0.198 and 0.255).

AI.tldr: 提出物理信息驱动的多模态深度学习框架，用于10–110分钟光伏功率概率预测，FSS达0.2950，优于14个基线。
AI.motivation: 光伏功率超短期至短期概率预测需同时刻画电站时序历史、逆变器级空间云动态与太阳几何等物理先验，单一模态或纯数据驱动模型难以在各预测步长上同时保持精度与可靠性。
AI.method: 四分支架构：图注意力编码器（学习式邻接）编码电站级时序历史与逆变器级空间云动态；已知未来太阳几何分支；当前气象状态分支；经门控交叉注意力融合。几何分支引入两个前向物理信号（空间云异质性与逆变器降功率活动），并按预测步长经验加权。解码器以智能持续性基线为锚，学习步长条件化修正；分位数输出经核加权自适应保形校准在线标定。
AI.result: 优于全部14个基线，FSS 0.2950，较次优模型高0.099；分支消融显示各分支均有正贡献；在阴天与多变天空条件下仍保持较高技巧（FSS 0.198与0.255）。
AI.conclusion: 物理信息融合与步长自适应设计可显著提升多步长概率光伏预测的技巧与鲁棒性，在线保形校准保障了分位数预测的可靠性。

title: Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
comment: 22 pages, 10 figures; under review at ICLR 2027
summary: Pixel-space generative Transformers typically use one token per image patch, so capturing finer detail requires more tokens and makes global attention increasingly expensive. We observe that finer detail does not necessarily require more global communication: low-frequency structure benefits from global exchange, while high-frequency detail can be modeled locally. Based on this insight, we introduce SpecSlot, a pixel-space rectified-flow Transformer that decouples output detail from the length of the global attention sequence. SpecSlot expands each spatial anchor into multiple slots, each assigned a disjoint band of DCT coefficients; this separates anchor density from spectral subdivision. Only the lowest-frequency slot from each anchor participates in global attention, while all slots interact locally. This allows the model to increase spectral detail without enlarging the global sequence. A spatial head further adds a local correction to the spectral prediction, while the generative state, target, and loss remain in pixel space. On ImageNet-256, SpecSlot achieves a comparable final FID to a FLOPs-matched JiT control while converging faster. On ImageNet-512, it improves FID by 2.84 over the control with 3.9% fewer FLOPs, and comes within only 0.69 FID of JiT-B/16 at 38.2% lower cost. On text-to-image generation, SpecSlot surpasses JiT-B/8 on DPG-Bench by 1.06 at 40.6% lower forward cost.

AI.tldr: 提出SpecSlot：一种像素空间rectified-flow Transformer，通过将每个空间锚点扩展为多个分别承载不相交DCT系数频带的slot，把全局注意力序列长度与输出细节解耦——仅最低频slot参与全局注意力，所有slot做局部交互，从而在不扩大全局序列的前提下提升频谱细节。
AI.motivation: 像素空间生成式Transformer通常每个图像patch仅一个token，捕捉更细细节需增加token数，导致全局注意力代价急剧上升。作者观察到更细细节并不必然需要更多全局通信：低频结构受益于全局交换，高频细节可在局部建模。
AI.method: SpecSlot基于rectified flow，将每个空间锚点扩展为多个slot，每个slot负责一组不相交的DCT系数频带，从而把锚点密度与频谱细分解耦；仅每个锚点的最低频slot参与全局注意力，所有slot进行局部交互；另设空间头在频谱预测上叠加局部修正，且生成状态、目标与损失均保持在像素空间。
AI.result: ImageNet-256上最终FID与FLOPs匹配的JiT对照相当但收敛更快；ImageNet-512上FID较对照改善2.84且FLOPs少3.9%，与JiT-B/16的FID差距仅0.69而成本低38.2%；文生图任务上在DPG-Bench上超过JiT-B/8达1.06，前向成本低40.6%。
AI.conclusion: 通过频带解耦的slot设计，SpecSlot实现细节表达与全局注意力序列长度的分离，在图像与文生图生成中取得更优的质量—效率权衡。

title: NECA: Neighbor Event Curve Augmentation for Multi-Horizon ICU Deterioration Prediction
summary: Early prediction of ICU organ dysfunction events supports timely clinical monitoring and intervention, but estimating short-term organ-specific risk from early ICU records remains challenging due to irregular measurements, heterogeneous clinical variables, and the need to predict risk across multiple future horizons. Existing supervised models usually treat each patient as an isolated sample and do not explicitly use the observed event timing of similar historical patients. We propose Neighbor Event-Curve Augmentation (NECA), a model-agnostic method that retrieves training-set patients with similar early-window profiles and converts their subsequent organ dysfunction event onset times into cumulative event-curve features over 6h, 12h, 24h, and 42h. These features are concatenated with the original patient representation and used by standard downstream predictors. On PhysioNet 2012 and a 4,000-stay MIMIC-IV subset, NECA improves average PR-AUC and ROC-AUC across four organ dysfunction event tasks and seven supervised learners. The largest gain appears for neurological dysfunction events, where task-level average PR-AUC increases from 0.461 to 0.557 on PhysioNet 2012. Ablations show that clinically meaningful retrieval and horizon-specific neighbor risk drive most of the improvement, while the full cumulative curve adds task-dependent temporal context. These results support similar-patient event timing as a structured temporal risk signal for ICU organ dysfunction event prediction. The source code will be publicly released upon acceptance of this paper.

AI.tldr: 提出模型无关的Neighbor Event-Curve Augmentation (NECA)：检索早期窗口画像相似的历史患者，将其后续器官功能障碍事件发生时间转换为6/12/24/42h的累积事件曲线特征，与原表征拼接后供任意下游预测器使用，在PhysioNet 2012与MIMIC-IV子集上提升四个器官功能障碍任务的PR-AUC/ROC-AUC。
AI.motivation: ICU早期记录存在测量不规则、变量异质、需跨多个未来时间窗预测风险等问题；现有监督模型将患者视为孤立样本，未显式利用相似历史患者已观察到的事件时序信息。
AI.method: NECA为模型无关的检索增强方法：以早期窗口患者画像检索训练集中相似患者，将其后续器官功能障碍事件起病时间聚合为6h、12h、24h、42h四个horizon的累积事件曲线特征，并与原始患者表征拼接，交由标准下游预测器训练。消融包括临床有意义检索、horizon-specific邻居风险、完整累积曲线三部分。
AI.result: 在PhysioNet 2012与4,000条stay的MIMIC-IV子集上，跨四个器官功能障碍事件任务与七种监督学习器，NECA平均提升PR-AUC与ROC-AUC；神经系统功能障碍增益最大，PhysioNet 2012上任务级平均PR-AUC由0.461升至0.557。消融显示临床意义检索与horizon-specific邻居风险贡献主要增益，完整累积曲线提供任务相关的时间上下文。
AI.conclusion: 相似患者的事件时序可作为结构化的时间风险信号用于ICU器官功能障碍事件预测；NECA具模型无关性与可插拔性，代码将在论文录用后开源。

title: Towards Diverse and Comprehensive Benchmarks for Mutual Information Estimation
summary: Mutual information (MI) estimation is a central problem in machine learning and statistics; however, existing benchmarks typically evaluate estimators on simplified, low-dimensional distributions, leaving their performance on complex, realistic data largely unexplored. We address this gap with a comprehensive benchmarking framework grounded in a unified copula-theoretic perspective that subsumes existing benchmarks as special cases. Within this framework, we propose two complementary families of tests: a copula-first family that systematically varies ground-truth MI, dimensionality, and marginal complexity using synthetic and flow-based transformations; and a marginals-first family that couples real-world image data with controlled dependency structures, extending the classic same-class-pairing paradigm. We use this suite to extensively evaluate three classes of estimators: non-parametric, discriminative, and generative. Contrary to prevailing assumptions, our results indicate that there is no universal winner: each category can systematically outperform all other estimators under specific setups. By analyzing these cases, we identify fundamental estimation barriers and propose new tests that more effectively stress these specific limitations. We share the open source code at https://github.com/VanessB/mutinfo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一copula视角的互信息估计基准框架，包含copula-first与marginals-first两类互补测试，系统评测非参数、判别式、生成式三类估计器，发现不存在普适最优方法，并据此提出更具挑战性的新测试。
AI.motivation: 现有互信息估计基准多在简化低维分布上评测，难以反映估计器在复杂真实数据上的表现，缺乏系统性与代表性。
AI.method: 构建基于统一copula理论的基准框架，将已有基准纳入为特例；设计copula-first族（通过合成与基于流的变换系统改变真实互信息、维度与边缘复杂度）与marginals-first族（将真实图像数据与受控依赖结构耦合，扩展同类配对范式）；在此套件上评测非参数、判别式与生成式三类互信息估计器。
AI.result: 结果显示无普适最优估计器：每一类估计器在特定设置下均可系统性优于其他类别；通过案例分析识别出根本性估计障碍，并提出能更有效施压这些局限的新测试。
AI.conclusion: 互信息估计的性能高度依赖数据场景，基准设计需覆盖边缘复杂度与依赖结构两个维度；所提框架与新测试为诊断估计器失效模式提供了系统工具。

title: Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis: integrating reinforcement learning and conformal prediction for reliable wafer defect classification
summary: Semiconductor manufacturing is a complex, multi-step process that requires both high precision and low operating costs. Therefore, detecting defects in a high-volume setting is an important component of wafer map analysis for reliable production. However, most state-of-the-art deep learning approaches require a full scan of the surface, which hinders the development of high-throughput inspection systems. To address this problem, we propose Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis (UFLD), a novel algorithm that employs reinforcement learning for adaptive measurement acquisition and provides a prediction uncertainty level after each step, stopping the process once sufficient information is obtained. Unlike existing methods that rely on ensemble models or auxiliary confidence estimation deep learning models, UFLD utilizes a more parameter-efficient conformal prediction framework to determine the optimal stopping time. The proposed UFLD reduces acquisition time by about $40\%$ and achieves $98.4\%$ inspection accuracy, without requiring an additional learned confidence-estimation network. We validated our approach on the MixedWM38 dataset, demonstrating its advantages over existing adaptive acquisition procedures and standard convolutional neural networks.

AI.tldr: 提出不确定性感知反馈回路诊断算法UFLD，用强化学习自适应采集晶圆图局部测量并以共形预测确定最优停止时刻，将采集时间缩短约40%同时达到98.4%检测准确率。
AI.motivation: 半导体制造需要在量产条件下进行高精度、低成本的缺陷检测，但现有先进深度学习方法通常要求对整个晶圆表面进行全扫描，严重制约高吞吐量检测系统的实现。
AI.method: UFLD将测量采集建模为强化学习驱动的自适应过程：每一步仅采集局部测量并输出预测不确定性，当信息足够时提前终止。与依赖集成模型或额外置信度估计网络的方案不同，它采用参数效率更高的共形预测框架来判定最优停止时机，无需额外的学习型置信度估计网络。
AI.result: 在MixedWM38数据集上验证，采集时间减少约40%，检测准确率达98.4%，性能优于现有自适应采集方法与标准卷积神经网络。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性感知的早期停止机制可在保证高检测精度的前提下显著降低晶圆图检测的测量成本，为高吞吐量半导体缺陷检测提供了一种参数高效、无需额外置信度估计网络的可行方案。

title: Wavelet Phase Diffusion for Structurally and Semantically Consistent Sim-to-Real Translation
comment: Accepted by WACV 2027. 20 pages, 15 figures. Project page: https://kit-mrt.github.io/Wavelet-Phase-Diffusion/
summary: Simulation-to-reality translation must bridge the appearance gap between synthetic and real domains while preserving structural and semantic consistency. Conditioning-based methods achieve spatial alignment but introduce computationally expensive control modules. Paired-data methods achieve realism but rely on complex synthesis pipelines, often altering scene geometry and semantics. Training-free editing methods avoid both constraints but lack a learned appearance prior, limiting their perceptual quality. Recently proposed phase-preserving diffusion presents a promising alternative, but Fourier-domain formulations are constrained by global spectral coupling. This coupling induces spatial artifacts such as ringing and boundary leakage, thereby degrading structural and semantic consistency. We introduce Wavelet Phase Diffusion, which addresses this through two components. First, we operate in the Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Packet Transform domain, whose localized wavelet packets enable spatially adaptive phase injection without global spectral interference. Second, Low-Frequency Randomization (LFR) replaces the low-frequency packet, decoupling the model from the synthetic illumination prior and enabling in-distribution real-world appearance. Both components train on unpaired open-domain data, and introduce negligible inference overhead. The spatial locality further enables instance-level translation, where individual objects or regions are translated to photorealistic appearance independently while the surrounding scene remains untranslated. On vKITTI $\to$ KITTI image translation, $ψ$-PD outperforms prior methods in realism and semantic consistency while maintaining competitive structural alignment. For CARLA video translation, $ψ$-PD approaches the realism of paired-data methods while reducing VLM planner ADE and FDE by $5.4\%$ and $5.1\%$, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出Wavelet Phase Diffusion（ψ-PD），在双树复小波包变换域进行局部化相位注入并结合低频随机化（LFR），实现无需配对数据、推理开销极低的仿真到真实图像/视频翻译。
AI.motivation: Sim-to-real翻译需弥补合成与真实域的外观差异，同时保持结构与语义一致性。现有方法各有局限：基于条件控制的方法空间对齐好但控制模块计算昂贵；配对数据方法真实感强但依赖复杂合成流程且常改变场景几何与语义；免训练编辑方法规避上述问题但缺乏学习到的外观先验，感知质量受限；相位保持扩散前景可期，但其傅里叶域公式受全局频谱耦合约束，导致振铃、边界泄漏等空间伪影，损害结构与语义一致性。
AI.method: 两个核心组件：(1) 在双树复小波包变换（DTCWPT）域操作，利用局部化的小波包实现空间自适应相位注入，避免全局频谱干扰；(2) 低频随机化（LFR）替换低频包，使模型脱离合成光照先验，获得分布内的真实世界外观。两者均在无配对开放域数据上训练，推理开销可忽略；空间局部性进一步支持实例级翻译（单个物体/区域独立翻译，周围场景不变）。
AI.result: 在vKITTI→KITTI图像翻译上，ψ-PD在真实感与语义一致性上优于先前方法，并保持有竞争力的结构对齐；在CARLA视频翻译上，ψ-PD接近配对数据方法的真实感，同时将VLM规划器的ADE和FDE分别降低5.4%和5.1%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将相位注入从全局傅里叶域迁移到局部化的小波包域并引入低频随机化，ψ-PD解决了全局频谱耦合带来的空间伪影问题，在无需配对数据和低推理开销下实现了高质量、语义一致的sim-to-real翻译，并支持实例级翻译，且下游规划性能得到改善。

title: A Pretrained Model for Bayesian Filtering in Heterogeneous Dynamical Systems
summary: Filtering has not yet had its foundation-model moment: state estimation is still dominated either by online Bayesian filtering algorithms that require known dy- namics as inputs, or by learning-based neural filters trained from scratch for a single system or parametric family. The core challenge is structural heterogene- ity: dynamical systems differ in their governing dynamics, physical scales, and noise levels, precluding a shared representation space for a reusable filter. To bridge this gap, we introduce FilterFM, the first pretrained model for Bayesian filtering that estimates latent states across heterogeneous dynamical systems with a single checkpoint. FilterFM employs a hierarchical two-level observation se- quence encoder and a prior-to-posterior state-reconstruction module that together handle varying observation and state dimensions across heterogeneous systems, while modeling state uncertainty via quantile prediction. Trained on a mixture of heterogeneous filtering tasks, FilterFM exhibits superior in-domain performance, delivering significant gains in estimation accuracy, runtime efficiency, and noise robustness compared to existing baselines. Beyond in-domain performance, it marks the first model to successfully enable zero-shot filtering on unseen dynamics, bridging the generalization gap in state estimation. Furthermore, we uncover clear scaling behaviors in foundation-model-based Bayesian filtering, which combined with comprehensive component ablation studies, validate the structural optimality of our design and broaden the generalization scope for this research field.

AI.tldr: FilterFM 是首个用于贝叶斯滤波的预训练基础模型，用单一 checkpoint 跨异构动力系统估计隐状态，并首次实现零样本滤波。
AI.motivation: 现有状态估计要么依赖需已知动力学的在线贝叶斯滤波，要么为单一系统/参数族从零训练神经滤波器；核心障碍是动力系统在动力学、物理尺度与噪声水平上的结构异质性，难以共享表示空间，缺乏可复用的滤波基础模型。
AI.method: 提出 FilterFM：采用层级式两级观测序列编码器，结合先验到后验的状态重建模块，以适应异构系统间不同的观测与状态维度；通过分位数预测建模状态不确定性；在异构滤波任务混合数据上预训练。
AI.result: 域内性能优于基线，在估计精度、运行效率与噪声鲁棒性上显著提升；首个实现未见动力学上的零样本滤波；并揭示基础模型式贝叶斯滤波中清晰的 scaling 行为，组件消融验证了设计的结构最优性。
AI.conclusion: FilterFM 以单一模型统一异构系统的贝叶斯滤波，弥合状态估计的泛化差距，并通过 scaling 规律与消融研究扩展了该方向的研究范围。

title: Framework-Conditional Open Materials Generation
summary: Theoretical predictions of novel materials rely on a variety of techniques, from data-mining-based ion substitution methods to fully de novo generative models. Each approach imposes specific constraints and encounters unique challenges when extrapolating beyond the distribution of known materials to discover new ones. The foremost goal of materials generation is to produce stable, unique, and novel (S.U.N.) structures. Predicted structures that meet these criteria, however, typically result from novel chemical compositions mapped onto known structural prototypes or frameworks. We leverage this heuristic insight to present a new generative paradigm for the de novo prediction of inorganic crystalline materials constrained by their structural framework---i.e., the unit cell shapes and respective particle positions. Our method, termed OMatG-FC (Open Materials Framework-Conditional Generation), learns via a combination of discrete flow matching on the atomic species and stochastic interpolants for the volume scaling of the unit cell lattice, while fixing in-place the fractional coordinates and the unit-volume lattice vectors, dramatically reducing the dimensionality of the problem compared to unconstrained (framework-free) generation. Our method is more flexible than existing prototype-constrained methods, demonstrating capability for discovery of unseen, stable prototypes derived from known structural frameworks. We also investigate the number of unique frameworks in the MP-20 dataset, demonstrating the propensity of duplicate frameworks within the dataset and providing a framework-split version. We benchmark the performance of our model using the LeMat-GenBench suite using three ML interatomic potentials and achieve state-of-the-art S.U.N. rate below the convex hull, eschewing the need to learn atomic packings for materials discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出框架条件生成范式 OMatG-FC，在固定分数坐标与单位体积晶格矢量的条件下，用离散流匹配生成原子种类、随机插值生成晶胞体积缩放，大幅降维，并在 LeMat-GenBench 上取得凸包以下的 S.U.N. 率新纪录。
AI.motivation: 材料生成的首要目标是获得稳定、独特、新颖（S.U.N.）结构，但现有数据挖掘式离子替换与端到端从头生成模型各有约束与局限；且经验表明，满足 S.U.N. 的预测结构多是把新化学组分映射到已知结构原型/框架上，因此可在框架约束下生成以降低搜索维度。
AI.method: OMatG-FC（Open Materials Framework-Conditional Generation）：以结构框架为条件，固定分数坐标与单位体积晶格矢量，将学习任务分解为原子种类的离散流匹配（discrete flow matching）与晶胞晶格体积缩放的随机插值（stochastic interpolants）；相比原型约束方法更灵活，可发现由已知框架派生的未见稳定原型；同时统计 MP-20 中唯一框架数量，揭示重复框架问题并提供 framework-split 划分。
AI.result: 在 LeMat-GenBench 基准上使用三种机器学习原子间势评估，取得凸包以下 S.U.N. 率的最先进水平；并量化了 MP-20 中框架重复的普遍性，给出框架划分版本用于更严谨的基准测试。
AI.conclusion: 通过框架条件化并固定几何自由度，无需学习原子堆积即可高效发现新材料，为无机晶体的从头生成提供了降维且更灵活的范式。

title: Reinforcement learning for control of partial differential equations
summary: Controlling dynamical systems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs) remains a challenging task in scientific computing, owing to high-dimensional state spaces, distributed actuation, nonlinear dynamics, and stringent real-time constraints. Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for synthesizing feedback controllers that adapt to varying operating conditions and can be deployed efficiently in real-time. This review provides a unified perspective on RL and PDE-constrained optimization, and surveys model-free, model-based, and multi-agent RL approaches to PDE control, with particular emphasis on sample efficiency, generalization across parametric variations, and scalability to high-dimensional problems. Two demonstrative examples, the stabilization of a chaotic system and a flow control problem, illustrate the performance and pitfalls of RL agents in practice. Finally, we discuss evaluation and benchmarking practices, current limitations, and open research directions toward reliable, data-efficient, and scalable RL for scientific computing.

AI.tldr: 该综述从强化学习与PDE约束优化的统一视角，系统梳理无模型、基于模型和多智能体RL在PDE控制中的方法，重点讨论样本效率、参数泛化与高维可扩展性。
AI.motivation: PDE控制的动力学系统具有高维状态空间、分布式驱动、非线性动力学和严格实时约束，控制难度大；RL为合成可适应工况变化、可实时部署的反馈控制器提供了新范式，但相关研究分散，亟需统一梳理。
AI.method: 综述性研究：建立RL与PDE约束优化的统一框架，分类考察无模型、基于模型与多智能体RL方法，并以混沌系统镇定和流动控制两个示例进行实证说明，同时讨论评估与基准测试实践。
AI.result: 通过两个示例展示了RL智能体在实际PDE控制中的性能表现与潜在陷阱；归纳了现有方法在样本效率、参数变化泛化及高维可扩展性方面的进展与不足。
AI.conclusion: 当前RL用于PDE控制仍存在局限，未来需面向可靠、数据高效、可扩展的方向发展，并建立规范的评估与基准测试体系。

title: Rural Readiness: Domain Generalization with Adversarially Chosen Domains
summary:
Predictive models trained at well-resourced data-rich institutions often fail when deployed in new populations. Motivated by the goal of building clinical diagnosis and decision-making algorithms for data-scarce rural populations using the general knowledge learned from data-rich hospitals, we formulate the fundamental question of \emph{domain generalization with adversarially chosen domains}, which asks a learner to perform on any unseen target domain nearly as well as the worst hypothesis consistent with the evidence from the observed source domains.
  Assuming only that the hypothesis class contains a "universal" predictor with small error on all $k$ source domains, we characterize the sample complexity of this objective up to logarithmic factors. Letting $d$ denote the VC dimension of the hypothesis class, we find, somewhat surprisingly, that the sample complexity reduces significantly from $Ω(dk)$ to $O(d)$ under a small relaxation of the learning goal in which, roughly speaking, we allow the learned model to compete with hypotheses that perform well on 99% instead of 100% of the source domains. By applying this insight to the meta-distributional setting, in which source domains are selected according to a distribution on distributions, we obtain a corresponding improvement over known sample complexity upper bounds. We also study the effect of data access to the target domain and show that a small labeled sample from the target domain does not improve the worst-case sample complexity on the source domains.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"对抗性选择域上的域泛化"问题：要求学习器在任意未见目标域上表现接近与源域证据一致的最差假设。在假设类含有一个在全部k个源域上误差都小的"通用"预测器的条件下，刻画了该目标的样本复杂度：将学习目标略微松弛（允许与在99%而非100%源域上表现良好的假设竞争）后，样本复杂度从Ω(dk)大幅降至O(d)。
AI.motivation: 在资源丰富机构训练的预测模型部署到新人群时常失效。作者希望利用数据丰富医院学到的通用知识，为数据稀缺的农村人群构建临床诊断与决策算法，因此需要研究域泛化在目标域未知且可能被对抗性选择时的样本复杂度。
AI.method: 形式化"对抗性选择域上的域泛化"问题：学习器需在任意未见目标域上逼近与观察到的k个源域证据一致的最差假设的表现。仅假设假设类（VC维为d）中存在一个在所有k个源域上误差都小的"通用"预测器，在此条件下刻画样本复杂度（精确到对数因子）；并推广到元分布设置（源域按"分布上的分布"抽样），以及分析目标域数据访问的影响。
AI.result: 在仅假设存在通用预测器的条件下，样本复杂度从Ω(dk)显著降低到O(d)，代价是对学习目标做小幅松弛——大致允许学习模型与在99%（而非100%）源域上表现良好的假设竞争。将这一洞见应用于元分布设置，得到相对已知上界的相应改进。此外发现，目标域的一小份有标签样本并不能改善源域上的最坏情形样本复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 对学习目标的小幅常数松弛可带来样本复杂度从与源域数量k线性增长到仅依赖VC维d的根本性改善，为从数据丰富机构向数据稀缺人群迁移临床模型提供了理论依据；目标域少量标注样本在该最坏情形框架下无助于降低源域样本需求。

title: Nonlinear Dynamical Systems as Scalable and Efficient Physical Neural Networks
summary: The rapid growth in the size of state-of-the-art machine-learning (ML) models has led to increasing compute demands, spurring the development of energy-efficient hardware accelerators. Physical systems trained to perform ML inference, known as physical neural networks, have been proposed as accelerators in part because of their potential to be highly energy efficient. However, the ML inference accuracies reported in most investigations of physical neural networks have been substantially below the state of the art for conventional digital neural networks. In this work, we show in simulation studies that by applying modern ML training practices, including model compression, various candidate physical neural networks based on nonlinear dynamical systems can achieve accuracies as high as 99.2% on MNIST handwritten-digit recognition. We also show for one dynamical system that using it as the core building block of a parameter-efficient ML architecture inspired by MLP-Mixers enables accuracies of up to 86.4% on CIFAR-10 image classification (92.2% with pretraining and knowledge distillation), compared with 64% for the same system without the mixer architecture. The mixer approach achieved its accuracy while using $>5\times$ fewer trainable parameters than the baseline. Finally, we present back-of-the-envelope estimates for inference energy efficiency and speed when using an example physical dynamical system, suggesting that orders of magnitude improvements may be possible over digital-electronic neural networks.

AI.tldr: 通过引入模型压缩等现代训练实践，非线性动力系统类物理神经网络在仿真中可将MNIST准确率提升至99.2%，并在类Mixer架构下于CIFAR-10达到86.4%（蒸馏后92.2%）。
AI.motivation: 物理神经网络被认为具备高能效潜力，但既有研究报道的推理精度远低于常规数字神经网络，亟需缩小这一精度差距。
AI.method: 在仿真中，对基于非线性动力系统的多种候选物理神经网络应用模型压缩等现代ML训练实践；并将其中一个动力系统作为核心模块，构建受MLP-Mixer启发的参数高效架构（含预训练与知识蒸馏），同时给出推理能效与速度的数量级估算。
AI.result: MNIST上准确率最高达99.2%；CIFAR-10上达86.4%（预训练+知识蒸馏下92.2%），而无Mixer架构的同一系统仅64%，且可训练参数少5倍以上；初步估算显示推理能效与速度可能较数字电子神经网络提升数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 现代训练实践与架构设计可显著弥合物理神经网络与传统数字网络之间的精度鸿沟，同时保留其潜在的数量级能效优势。

title: The Precision Wall: An Optimizer-Dependent Boundary for Optimization under Power-Law Measurement Spectra
summary: In low-rank matrix sensing of a rank-$D$ factor $U^\ast \in \mathbb{R}^{V \times D}$, replacing isotropic Gaussian designs with power-law measurement covariance $Σ= \mathrm{diag}(j^{-s})_{j=1}^V$ leaves the Burer--Monteiro landscape free of spurious local minima, yet division-normalised first-order optimizers stall above a critical exponent $s^\ast$. We trace this failure to a numerical precision wall. At the ground truth, the smallest non-gauge expected Hessian eigenvalue scales at leading order as $V^{-(s+1)}D^{-s}$. When this curvature drops below the effective denominator floor $ε_O$ of optimizer $O$, normalisation noise overwhelms rare-direction gradients, yielding the leading-order boundary $s^\ast_O(V, D) = [\log(1/ε_O) - \log V]/\log(VD) + δ_O$, where $δ_O$ is a metric-dependent detection lag. With $δ_{\mathrm{Adam}}$ calibrated on four configurations and frozen, this formula predicts Adam's onset within $0.45$ across all 16 cells of a held-out grid ($V \in \{64,128,256,512\} \times D \in \{4,8,16,32\}$), separates fixed-$VD$ pairs, and distinguishes denominator-precision walls from conditioning and sign-quantisation walls. The approximation fails at $D = 2$, reflects a finite-$D$ spectral crossover, and saturates below $\varepsilon_0 = 10^{-8}$ at a dynamical floor.

AI.tldr: 论文指出幂律协方差下归一化一阶优化器在临界指数以上失效源于"数值精度墙"，并给出可预测失效边界 $s^\ast_O(V,D)$ 的解析标度公式。
AI.motivation: 低秩矩阵感知中，将各向同性高斯设计换成幂律测量协方差后景观无伪局部极小，但 division-normalised 一阶优化器（如 Adam）在临界指数 $s^\ast$ 之上停滞；需解释该失效机制的根源并给出可预测的判据。
AI.method: 将失效归因于数值精度：在真值处最小非规范期望 Hessian 特征值主导阶为 $V^{-(s+1)}D^{-s}$，当其低于优化器的有效分母下界 $\epsilon_O$ 时，归一化噪声淹没稀有方向梯度；据此推导边界 $s^\ast_O(V,D)=[\log(1/\epsilon_O)-\log V]/\log(VD)+\delta_O$，其中 $\delta_O$ 为度量相关的检测滞后，$\delta_{\mathrm{Adam}}$ 由四个配置标定后冻结。
AI.result: 冻结参数的公式在 16 个留出网格单元（$V\in\{64,128,256,512\}\times D\in\{4,8,16,32\}$）上以 0.45 以内误差预测 Adam 的失效起点；可区分固定 $VD$ 的配对，并能区分分母精度墙与条件数墙、符号量化墙。该近似在 $D=2$ 失效，反映有限 $D$ 的谱交叉，并在 $\epsilon_0=10^{-8}$ 以下于动力学下界处饱和。
AI.conclusion: 幂律协方差下归一化优化器的停滞由分母精度下界导致的曲率检测极限决定，可用简洁标度律外推预测；其适用范围受有限 $D$ 谱交叉与 $\epsilon_0$ 动力学下界限制。

title: Numerical Integration on Bounded Domains via Learned Reflected Diffusions
summary: We study high-dimensional integration on bounded convex domains. Given a non-negative integrand $r$, the goal is to estimate $Z=\int_{D}r(x)\,\mathrm dx$ on $D\subset\mathbb R^d$. Standard Quasi-Monte Carlo does not adapt its evaluation points to the integrand, while effective importance sampling requires a proposal that captures its concentration. Learned diffusion samplers can supply such a proposal, but existing methods are formulated on $\mathbb R^d$ and do not respect the domain constraint $x\in D$. We instead build the proposal from reflected dynamics that stay in $D$ by construction. A reflected diffusion progressively transforms the target distribution toward the uniform distribution on $D$, and a neural score model is trained to reverse this process. A change-of-measure formula for reflected diffusions yields a training objective without additional boundary terms and an unbiased importance-sampling estimator of $Z$. For non-smooth integrands, where reparameterization gradients may be undefined or uninformative, we derive a REINFORCE estimator of the training gradient using Gaussian proposal densities before reflection, without evaluating reflected transition densities or differentiating $r$. We evaluate on numerous synthetic targets and real-world problems, demonstrating strong performance of the proposed method, as well as favorable scaling with the dimension of the problem and the number of points used for the Monte Carlo estimate.

AI.tldr: 提出基于反射扩散过程的变分重要性采样方法，用于有界凸域上的高维积分，训练目标无需边界项，并提供无偏估计量及适用于非光滑被积函数的REINFORCE梯度。
AI.motivation: 标准拟蒙特卡洛不根据被积函数自适应调整采样点，而有效的重要性采样需要一个能刻画被积函数集中性的提议分布。学习型扩散采样器可提供此类提议，但现有方法均在 $\mathbb R^d$ 上构造，无法满足域约束 $x\in D$。因此需构造天然停留在有界凸域内的提议分布。
AI.method: 以反射动力学构造提议分布：反射扩散过程将目标分布逐步变换为 $D$ 上的均匀分布，训练神经得分模型反向该过程。利用反射扩散的测度变换公式，得到不含附加边界项的训练目标，以及 $Z$ 的无偏重要性采样估计。针对非光滑被积函数，在反射前的 Gaussian 提议密度上推导训练梯度的 REINFORCE 估计，无需计算反射转移密度，也无需对被积函数 $r$ 求导。
AI.result: 在大量合成目标与实际问题上的实验表明该方法性能强劲，并且随问题维度及蒙特卡洛估计点数的增加呈现良好扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 反射扩散为有界凸域上的自适应高维积分提供了契合域约束的提议构造，兼具理论上的无偏性与对非光滑被积函数的适用性，具有良好维度扩展性。

title: Machine Learning-Based Detection of Mobile Money Scan Messages in Ghana: A Comparative Evaluation of Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine, and Randon Forest Classifiers
summary: Mobile money (MoMo) is Ghana's preferred retail payment channel, recording GHC518.4 billion in transactions in December 2025 and over 26.7 million active accounts (Graphic Online, 2026). This growth has coincided with increased social-engineering fraud over Short Message Service (SMS) and Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD), where fraudsters impersonate network operators, agents, relatives, or regulators to obtain personal identification numbers (PINs), identity data, or funds. We present a supervised machine-learning pipeline for classifying scam and legitimate Ghanaian MoMo SMS messages using a labelled corpus of 220 messages across 18 scam and legitimate subcategories. Domain-specific normalisation of currency amounts, phone numbers, and USSD codes preceded TF-IDF vectorisation of unigrams and bigrams. Using stratified five-fold cross-validation and a 20% held-out test set, we trained and evaluated Multinomial Naive Bayes, linear support vector machine (SVM), and Random Forest classifiers using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC). Held-out accuracy, F1, and AUC were 1.00 for Naive Bayes and linear SVM; cross-validated accuracy averaged 96.6% (+/-3.3), 94.9% (+/-4.6), and 92.0% (+/-4.2). Discriminative n-grams reflected imperative urgency ("send," "claim," "please send") and PIN solicitation ("PIN," "pincode"); legitimate messages featured confirmatory and cautionary language ("balance," "successful," "do not share"). Findings are contextualised in Sub-Saharan African SMS fraud detection, small template-based corpus ceiling effects, and a pathway toward larger naturalistic multilingual corpora. Interpretable classical classifiers achieve high accuracy on structured MoMo scam text and suit carrier- or handset-level filtering in low-resource, on-device settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建基于TF-IDF与经典监督分类器（朴素贝叶斯、线性SVM、随机森林）的加纳移动货币（MoMo）短信诈骗识别流水线，在220条标注语料的18个细分类别上取得高准确率，并验证其适用于低资源、端侧过滤场景。
AI.motivation: 加纳MoMo交易规模与活跃账户激增（2025年12月交易额5184亿塞地、活跃账户超2670万），SMS/USSD社交工程诈骗同步上升，诈骗者冒充运营商、代理商、亲属或监管方套取PIN、身份信息与资金，亟需轻量可解释的本地化检测手段。
AI.method: 使用220条标注的加纳MoMo短信语料（含18个诈骗与正常子类）。先做领域特定归一化（金额、电话号码、USSD代码），再进行unigram+bigram的TF-IDF向量化；采用分层五折交叉验证加20%留出测试集，训练并评估多项式朴素贝叶斯、线性SVM与随机森林，指标含准确率、精确率、召回率、F1、MCC与AUC-ROC。
AI.result: 留出集上朴素贝叶斯与线性SVM的准确率、F1、AUC均为1.00；交叉验证平均准确率分别为96.6%(±3.3)、94.9%(±4.6)、92.0%(±4.2)。判别性n-gram显示诈骗文本含紧迫祈使语（"send""claim""please send"）与PIN索取词（"PIN""pincode"），正常文本则含确认与警示语（"balance""successful""do not share"）。
AI.conclusion: 可解释的经典分类器在结构化MoMo诈骗文本上达到高精度，适合在低资源环境下部署于运营商侧或手机端过滤；但结果受模板化小语料的天花板效应限制，后续需构建更大规模的自然、多语言语料。

title: Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm
summary: Foundation models are typically trained in stages: pretraining, midtraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL), with changes in both data and learning algorithms. We show that this algorithmic separation is not fundamental. By deriving suitable RL objectives as maximum-likelihood fitting to model-generated target distributions, we place all of these stages under a single likelihood-based training algorithm, unified training. This perspective turns the foundation-model training lifecycle into a problem of choosing which data to train on, in what proportions, and when, with conventional staged training as a special case. We instantiate this framework in a unified training system that mixes static data and RL generations within a single trainer. Across controlled and real-world experiments, unified training improves the accuracy-compute tradeoff and task coverage while preserving broader capabilities, and provides a stronger starting point for continual learning. This work lays the groundwork for a unified science of foundation-model training, connecting mathematical principles, training infrastructure, and the development of model capabilities.

AI.tldr: 论文论证“预训练—中训练—SFT—RL”的分阶段训练并非本质必需：通过将各类RL目标推导为对模型自生成目标分布的最大似然拟合，把全部阶段统一到单一基于似然的算法（unified training）中，并以在同一训练器内混合静态数据与RL生成样本的系统实例化，在精度—算力权衡、任务覆盖与持续学习上取得改进。
AI.motivation: 现有基础模型训练将数据与算法同时按阶段切分（预训练、中训练、SFT、RL），形成算法层面的割裂，缺乏统一理论视角与配套训练基础设施。作者希望验证这种“算法分离”是否根本必要，并寻求把训练生命周期统一为“选什么数据、以何种比例、在何时训练”的问题。
AI.method: 关键在于理论归约：将合适的RL目标推导为对模型自生成目标分布的最大似然拟合，从而把各训练阶段纳入同一个基于似然的训练算法（unified training），传统分阶段训练成为其特例。系统层面实现为统一的训练系统（unified trainer），在单一训练器内混合静态数据与RL生成数据，并按配比与时机调度。
AI.result: 在受控实验与真实场景实验中，unified training 改善了准确率—算力（accuracy-compute）权衡与任务覆盖度，同时保持更广泛的能力不退化，并为持续学习提供更强的起点。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段训练只是统一框架的特例，基础模型训练可被重构为单一似然驱动的数据调度问题。该工作为“统一的基础模型训练科学”奠基，将数学原理、训练基础设施与模型能力发展三者连接起来。

title: An ODE-based Sampler for Discrete Diffusion Models
summary: The marginals of a continuous diffusion model can be reproduced by a deterministic ordinary differential equation (ODE), known as the probability flow ODE, which provides a foundation for accelerated sampling and consistency distillation. In this paper we address the question whether an analogous formulation exists for discrete diffusion models and answer it affirmatively by introducing exponential residual flows (ERFs). Our framework augments the discrete state with a continuous residual variable for each token and position. These residuals evolve deterministically according to piecewise-defined ODEs whose vector fields depend on the current discrete state and the forward and backward rate matrices of the prescribed diffusion model. The discrete state changes whenever a residual reaches zero. We prove that this construction preserves the marginals of the original diffusion. We derive a practical discretization of our sampler and specialize it to masked and uniform diffusion. The deterministic trajectories of ERFs support consistency distillation and yield empirical improvements over previous approaches across a variety of benchmarks including code and text generation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出指数残差流（ERF），为离散扩散模型构造与连续概率流ODE对应的确定性采样框架，并保持原扩散边际分布。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散模型的边际可由概率流ODE确定性复现，从而支持加速采样与一致性蒸馏；但离散扩散模型是否存在类似构造尚属未解问题，本文正面回答该问题。
AI.method: 为每个token与位置引入连续残差变量以增广离散状态；残差按分片定义的ODE确定性演化，其向量场依赖当前离散状态及给定扩散模型的前向/后向速率矩阵；当某残差归零时离散状态发生跳变。作者证明该构造保持原扩散的边际分布，并给出实用离散化采样器，专门化到masked扩散与uniform扩散。
AI.result: 理论上证明边际保持性；实验上ERF的确定性轨迹支持一致性蒸馏，在代码与文本生成等多项基准上相较既有方法取得经验性提升。
AI.conclusion: 离散扩散模型同样存在确定性的"概率流"对应物（ERF），其分片ODE+跳变机制可作为加速采样与一致性蒸馏的统一基础。

title: world2vec: Mechanistic world models through latent dynamics learning
summary: World models can achieve strong control performance without faithfully capturing the dynamics of their environment, limiting their potential for mechanistic interpretability and scientific discovery. Here, we introduce world2vec to learn mechanistic world models without reward information directly from observations and actions. World2vec learns latent dynamics that faithfully reproduce the true system over long prediction horizons, with at least one order of magnitude fewer parameters than DreamerV3, TD-MPC2 and LeWM. This enables state of the art performance in controlling continuous environments from pixels and accurate system identification across a benchmark of 71 attractors, demonstrating how world models are amenable to scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: world2vec 无需奖励信号，直接从观测与动作中学习机制性世界模型，潜在动力学可在长预测时域上忠实复现真实系统，参数比 DreamerV3、TD-MPC2、LeWM 至少小一个数量级，并在像素连续控制与 71 个吸引子系统辨识基准上达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型即便控制性能强，也未必忠实刻画环境动力学，这限制了其用于机制可解释性与科学发现；同时主流模型参数冗余较大。
AI.method: 提出 world2vec，在无奖励信息的条件下，仅用观测与动作学习潜在动力学，强调长时域上对真实系统的忠实复现，并保持极小参数量。
AI.result: 在像素输入连续控制任务上达到 SOTA；在 71 个吸引子基准上实现准确的系统辨识；参数量相比 DreamerV3、TD-MPC2、LeWM 至少减少一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型可同时兼顾紧凑参数、忠实动力学与控制性能，具备作为科学发现工具的潜力。

title: Rethinking Neural Thickets Without Weight Perturbations
comment: Project page can be found here: https://kyutai.org/logit-psv
summary:
The Neural Thickets hypothesis posits that pretrained language models lie in dense neighborhoods of task-specific experts in weight space, which random Gaussian perturbations can uncover. We reproduce the reported gains, but show that they do not require this geometric explanation. Perturbing a single decoder block already recovers much of the improvement, while keeping the model entirely frozen and adding a random bias to its output logits matches or exceeds full-weight perturbations on most reasoning tasks. This suggests an alternative explanation based on output diversity, validation-based selection, and voting. We formalize this view as Perturb-Select-Vote (PSV), a general procedure that generates perturbed predictors, selects high-performing members on a small validation set, and aggregates their predictions.
  This interpretation connects Neural Thickets to established inference-time methods, including sampling, self-consistency, and verifier-guided selection. A first-order analysis further shows that small weight perturbations act primarily through their induced logit shifts. We extend this analysis to vision, where logit PSV substantially improves performance under domain shift, including on Earth observation, while full-weight perturbations provide little additional benefit. Together, these results suggest that the gains attributed to nearby weight-space experts can instead be obtained through output diversity, selection, and voting. Logit PSV realizes these benefits with a fully frozen model, providing a simple, training-free alternative to full-weight perturbation ensembles across language and vision.

AI.tldr: 本文重审并挑战"神经灌丛"(Neural Thickets)假说：实验表明预训练语言模型的性能增益不需要"权重空间稠密专家邻域"的几何解释，而可由输出多样性、验证集选择与投票机制(Perturb-Select-Vote, PSV)充分说明。仅对单个解码块扰动、甚至完全冻结模型并在logits上加随机偏置，即可在多数推理任务上达到或超过全权扰动的效果；在视觉域（含地球观测）的域偏移下，logit层面的PSV同样显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: Neural Thickets假说声称预训练语言模型位于权重空间中稠密的任务专家邻域内，随机高斯扰动即可"挖出"这些专家从而带来增益。作者质疑该几何解释的必要性，试图给出更简洁、更可操作的替代解释（输出多样性+选择+投票），并将结论推广到视觉任务与域偏移场景。
AI.method: (1) 复现原始增益并做消融：仅扰动单个解码块；完全冻结权重，仅在输出logits上加随机偏置。(2) 提出通用流程PSV(Perturb-Select-Vote)：生成扰动预测器→在小验证集上筛选表现优异成员→聚合预测。(3) 一阶分析：说明小权重扰动主要通过其诱导的logit偏移起作用。(4) 将分析扩展至视觉，考察logit层面的PSV在域偏移（含地球观测）下的表现。
AI.result: 单块扰动即可恢复大部分改进；冻结模型+logit随机偏置在多数推理任务上达到或超过全权扰动。一阶分析证实小权重扰动的效应主要等价于logit偏移。在视觉域偏移（含地球观测）任务中，logit PSV显著提升性能，而全权扰动几乎无额外收益。
AI.conclusion: 归因于"邻近权重专家"的增益可改由输出多样性、验证选择和投票获得；logit PSV在完全冻结模型下即可实现，是一种简单、免训练的替代全权扰动集成方案，适用于语言与视觉任务，并可作为连接采样、自洽性与验证器引导选择等推理时方法的统一视角。

title: Propose-Filter-Release: Scaling Noise to Typical Sensitivity via Private Filtering
summary:
An estimator can be accurate and stable on typical data, yet sensitive to a few possible records. Differentially private mechanisms commonly scale their noise to the worst-case influence of a single record, which lets these records dictate the noise even when the remaining data would allow far less. Removing them first would restore the smaller scale, but the removal must itself be private.
  We introduce \emph{propose-filter-release} (PFR), which, by privately filtering its input, turns a mechanism that protects the addition or removal of a typical record, one that fits the remaining data, into one that is differentially private in the standard sense, on every input. Using our novel filtering step, PFR requires only a concave friendliness score, which measures how well a record fits a dataset, and a release mechanism that is friendly-DP, that is, private when the changed record fits the remaining data. For every such score and release mechanism, it guarantees differential privacy under public conditions on the number of records, so it is a general privacy primitive, comparable to propose-test-release, and FriendlyCore can be viewed as one of its implementations.
  We illustrate the generality of PFR by instantiating it for scalar statistics, principal subspace estimation, the KL divergence of user histograms, the effective resistances of a graph, and treatment-rule selection.

AI.tldr: 提出 propose-filter-release（PFR）通用隐私原语：先用私有过滤剔除"不友好"记录，使原本只在典型数据上成立的友好型 DP 机制升级为对任意输入都满足标准 DP 的机制。
AI.motivation: 差分隐私机制通常按单条记录的最坏影响来标定噪声，导致少数离群/极端记录主导噪声尺度，即便其余数据本可支持更小噪声。直接剔除这些记录可恢复小尺度，但剔除过程本身必须私有。
AI.method: 提出 PFR 框架，仅需两个组件：(1) 凹的"友好度得分"（衡量记录与数据集的契合程度）；(2) 满足"friendly-DP"的发布机制（即当变化记录与剩余数据契合时满足 DP）。通过新颖的私有过滤步骤，在记录数量的公开条件下保证标准 DP。该原语与 propose-test-release 可比，FriendlyCore 可视作其一种实现。
AI.result: 通过为标量统计量、主子空间估计、用户直方图的 KL 散度、图的有效电阻以及治疗规则选择等任务实例化 PFR，验证了其通用性。
AI.conclusion: PFR 是一个通用隐私原语，可将"仅对典型数据稳健"的机制系统性地转化为标准差分隐私机制，兼顾噪声尺度的自适应性与严格的隐私保证，适用范围广泛。
